Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands. We welcome applications from candidates across the EU who are willing to relocate to Maastricht for this opportunity. Are you an experienced manufacturing professional with a background in cell therapy and GMP? Would you like to play a key role in producing advanced therapies that have a direct impact on patients' lives? Then this position as Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician could be the perfect next step in your career.  Job Description You will become part of an international pharmaceutical organization, focused on advanced cell and gene therapies. Working in a state-of-the-art GMP cleanroom, you will contribute to the manufacturing of innovative medicines while receiving comprehensive onboarding and continuous training. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your technical expertise within a fast-growing and highly regulated industry. As a Cell Therapy Manufacturing Technician, your responsibilities include:

• Executing manufacturing activities in a GMP-compliant cleanroom using aseptic techniques
• Performing cell culture processes, including media preparation, cell expansion, and harvesting
• Accurately completing batch records and manufacturing documentation
• Identifying, documenting, and reporting deviations while supporting quality investigations
• Maintaining high standards of GMP compliance, quality, and safety
• Contributing to process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives
• Working in a 6-shift schedule, including evenings, nights, and weekends
Profile

• MBO or HBO degree in Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline
• Minimum of 2 years of experience in GMP manufacturing, preferably within cell therapy, ATMP, or biopharmaceutical production
• Experience working in a cleanroom environment using aseptic techniques
• Strong attention to detail with a quality-focused mindset
• Good communication skills in English
• A collaborative and proactive approach to teamwork
• Willingness to work in a 5-shift rotation
Please note: This position is intended for manufacturing professionals. Candidates with a PhD are not eligible for this vacancy and will not be considered.

 Employment Conditions

• Salary: €3,000 - €4,000 gross per month, depending on experience, plus 27% shift allowance
• Initial 12-month contract with the intention of permanent employment
• Extensive onboarding and GMP training programme
• The organization offers excellent long-term career prospects and opportunities for professional growth.
• Location: Maastricht, the Netherlands
• Vacancy number: 27390
Important Notice Only candidates who already hold a valid EU work permit or have unrestricted authorization to work within the European Union are eligible to apply. Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Applications from candidates who require sponsorship or who do not meet the work authorization requirements will not be considered

jobs.occupation: AI-informed adaptive mid-field MRI for personalized treatment of depression
jobs.description: We are seeking a postdoc for 12 months to develop an AI pipeline predicting antidepressant response from mid-field MRI perfusion and digital mood and symptom data. You will test the approach in a pilot MRI study, working towards making precision psychiatry accessible in clinical care. Depression affects many people, but antidepressant treatment does not work equally well for everyone. Predicting treatment outcomes early could help clinicians make more informed decisions and tailor treatment to individual patients. In this postdoc project, you will investigate how adaptive, AI-informed mid-field MRI, guided by questionnaire data, can provide clinically useful biomarkers for predicting antidepressant treatment outcomes. By combining artificial intelligence, brain imaging and digital mood and symptom data, you will work towards a more affordable and widely accessible approach to precision psychiatry. You will focus on three main areas: Exploring how adaptive mid-field MRI can reduce scan time and improve prediction performance compared with fixed scanning protocols, while remaining feasible in outpatient clinics and settings with limited resources. Designing an MRI-based prediction pipeline using perfusion measurements from relevant brain regions, acquired with arterial spin labelling (ASL). Developing adaptive MRI acquisition methods in which AI models, including reinforcement learning, determine what to scan next based on the information already collected. You will build on data from a large randomized clinical trial on treatment outcomes in major depressive disorder. Using these data, you will adapt existing prediction models and investigate whether mid-field perfusion MRI can support the early prediction of antidepressant treatment outcomes. You will develop an end-to-end prediction pipeline and translate your methods into an adaptive MRI strategy that can run directly on the scanner. You will also design and conduct a pilot MRI study in healthy volunteers, testia prototype model deployed on the scanner. In addition, you will share your findings with the scientific community and contribute to the further development of the PRESS platform in collaboration with consortium partners from academia and industry. Your responsibilities include: Adapting existing predictive models to explore the feasibility of mid-field perfusion MRI for predicting antidepressant treatment outcomes. Developing an AI-based prediction pipeline that combines MRI perfusion measurements with relevant clinical and digital data. Implementing and testing adaptive mid-field MRI acquisition strategies, including a prototype model deployed on the scanner. Designing and conducting a pilot MRI study in healthy volunteers. Writing scientific papers, presenting your findings at international conferences and contributing to the integration of your methods into the PRESS platform. You have a PhD in artificial intelligence, computer science, (biomedical) engineering, physics, computational neuroscience, technical medicine or a closely related field. You enjoy developing new technical approaches and applying them to clinically relevant challenges. In addition, you bring: Strong programming skills, for example in Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, and experience with modern machine learning workflows. An affinity with, and preferably experience in, one or more of the following areas: MRI or other medical imaging, reinforcement learning or sequential decision-making algorithms, and clinical prediction modelling or health data science. Experience with perfusion imaging or ASL is an advantage. A clear interest in mental health, neuroimaging and translational research at the intersection of AI and medicine. Excellent written and spoken English, good communication skills and the ability to work independently and proactively in a multidisciplinary research environment. You will be employed by Amsterdam UMC Research BV. A contract for 12 months. Classification in salary scale 1

Ultrasound and tomosynthesis are the most prevalent modalities used for breast imaging, and each has its specific advantages and disadvantages. Ultrasound uses sound waves to create a cross-sectional image of the tissue and has excellent depth resolution, but limited resolution in directions perpendicular to the transmitted ultrasound lines. Tomosynthesis uses x rays to create a pseudo-3D representation of the breast with high in-plane spatial resolution, but low out-of-plane (depth) resolution. Therefore, both techniques are complementary to each other.We plan to develop a joint system that will use the information from each modality to improve the image quality of the other, yielding not only a multi-modality imaging system, but a joint imaging system. The combination of tomosynthesis and ultrasound into a single joint imaging system will yield improved images from two independent and complementary sources, with inherent spatial correlation, allowing for improved lesion detection, even in dense breasts, and the direct multi-modal assessment of suspicious lesions. For this multi-disciplinary project, we will be working in collaboration with the Advanced X-ray Tomography Imaging (AXTI) lab of our Department, who will be developing the X-ray aspects of this system (see accompanying vacancy).In this project, you will focus on 3D ultrasound by using an ultra-wide ultrasound transducer that is mounted in a paddle required for acquisition of tomosynthesis data. In this way, a 3D ultrasound dataset can be acquired that can be used to improve the x-ray data by using the high-axial resolution US data. Additionally, the ultrasound data can be improved by using the high-resolution x-ray data. You will develop and validate these methods using both digital and physical phantoms, working towards first patient images at the end of the project. All of this will be in collaboration with a PhD student focusing on the x-ray aspects of the project, and industry partners to facilitate the translation of these methods into clinical evaluation. Tasks will also include presenting at international scientific conferences and writing papers on the newly developed methods and study results.RequirementsYou should be a creative and enthusiastic researcher with a MSc degree in physics, mathematics, engineering, Technical medicine, or similar.Experience or interest in physics modeling, inverse problems, and/or image processing, and affinity with biomedical research.Experience in programming in python, C/C++, Matlab, or similar.Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.Good to knowThe following should be included in your application: CV, letters of motivation, list of completed courses and grades, and reprints or, preferably, links to your thesis or any scientific publications or reports that you have written.The first job interviews will take place in November 2026. Please take this into account.

The goal of the project is to unravel the neurophysiological signatures of value-based decision making and controllability.The project will involve experimental design, data acquisition, and advanced statistical and computational modeling of neurophysiological (iEEG, single-neuron activity and local field potentials from micro-electrode recordings) and behavioral data from human volunteers and clinical patients.You will play a key role in the ERC Advanced CHEMCONTROL team, led by Roshan Cools, at Donders which comprises research master students, research assistants, 2 PhD students and a senior postdoc. You are an independent scholar and brain scientist with quantitative skills and expertise in the domain of human motivation, decision making, learning, and cognitive control. You are ready to acquire the skills required for conducting all phases of computational neuroimaging and neurophysiology, including conceptual and experimental design, computational modeling of behavior, data acquisition, data analysis, data interpretation and publication. You are also expected to be a team player, willing and able to work closely with multiple research group leaders, postdocs, fellows PhD students, research assistants and research master students.You have a passion for mechanistic research at the interface of neurophysiology, computational cognitive science, and decision neuroscience. You are curious, ambitious, and can work independently. Your English is fluent in speaking and writing at an academic level. jobs.description: Are you a hands-on technician who likes fixing things, solving technical problems and working with machines? Your work can include: Preventive and corrective maintenance Finding and solving technical problems Mechanical repairs Basic electrical troubleshooting Maintenance on pumps, motors, valves and production equipment Replacing and repairing mechanical components Helping when there is a breakdown Working together with production operators and other technicians Improving the reliability of machines and installations It is a hands-on technical job with plenty of variety. We provide control, predictability and better financial accountability. - Contact us directly Projects run over budget or returns lag behind? This is often due to insufficient insight into the relationship between progress, costs and planning. With good cost control you can avoid financial surprises and make timely adjustments. What is cost control and why is it crucial? Cost control, or cost management, is the process of monitoring, analyzing and adjusting project costs against budget. It is closely related to cost management: the broader set of financial control within projects. Well-organized cost control makes project costs predictable, controllable and accountable to the client, management and board. Especially in technical or long-term projects, this is essential to maintain trust, both internally and externally. cost control  How does cost control work within project organizations? Effective cost control starts with a reasoned budget, but it doesn't stop there. Throughout the project, we continue to test continuously: - How far along are we really in implementation? - What have we spent so far? - How does this compare with the original budget and schedule? - Do we need to make adjustments, and if so, where and when? We set up processes and reports in such a way that you have real-time insight into these dynamics. Not explaining afterwards, but signaling beforehand.  Earned Value Management (EVM): measuring = knowing Earned Value Management (EVM) is a widely used methodology within cost control. It links three dimensions together: - Budget (planned value) - Actual cost - Progress/performance (earned value). By monitoring these integrally, you gain early insight into deviations and trends. jobs.occupation: Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden
jobs.description: Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice between weekly and four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to join an experienced colleague during your first working days. Development opportunities within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Leiden, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders at home. At the start of your shift, you prepare for the route ahead. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel of the delivery van and head towards your first customer. At each stop, you select the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You greet the customer, hand over the groceries and provide friendly service. If there are empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to the next address. This is not a job where you spend your entire shift sitting behind the wheel. Throughout the day, you regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' homes and lift grocery crates. Driving, physical activity and customer contact are all part of the position. You complete your route independently, which means you are responsible for driving safely and handling the orders carefully. After your final delivery, you return to the location and complete your shift. Can I apply without delivery experience? Yes. Previous experience as a delivery driver, courier or professional driver is not required. During your first working days, you can join an experienced colleague. This gives you the opportunity to learn the delivery process and become familiar with the job before completing routesindependently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I need to work every Saturday? No. However, you must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is this a physically active job? Yes. In addition to driving, you will regularly carry grocery crates from the van to customers' doors. You will also be getting in and out of the vehicle throughout your route, so you need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You can work independently and responsibly. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Would you like to combine driving with an active and varied job in Leiden? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed Helal Parwiz by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Barendrecht As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders at home. Your shift starts in Barendrecht, where you prepare for the route ahead. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel and drive to the first customer on your schedule. At each address, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You hand over the groceries carefully, provide friendly service and collect empty crates when necessary. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to the next stop. Driving is only one part of your working day. You regularly get in and out of the van, walk between the vehicle and customers' homes and lift grocery crates. During your first working days, you can join an experienced colleague and learn how a normal delivery route works in practice. You will regularly carry grocery crates and walk between the delivery van and customers' doors. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks throughout your shift. Frontotemporal dementia (FTD) encompasses a group of neurodegenerative diseases that progressively affect behavior, movement, personality and/or language. We aim to identify the molecular and cellular causes of FTD that trigger its onset and early progression with the aim to design evidence-based treatment. Tasks, salary, and working through Charlie works  30 September 2026 4 min read What exactly does a logistics worker do? Do you want to know what a logistics worker does before you start working in the Netherlands? In short, a logistics worker ensures that products end up in the right place. This starts with unloading trucks and ends with preparing orders for shipment. A lot happens in between: scanning, sorting, packing, and sometimes driving a pallet truck or forklift. The job is physical, varied, and very suitable if you enjoy working with your hands. You do not need a diploma, and basic English or Polish is often sufficient on the work floor. That is why this is a popular first job for migrant workers from Poland, Hungary, Slovakia, and Romania. What is a logistics worker? A logistics worker usually works in a warehouse or distribution center. You are part of a team that manages the flow of goods. Think of large centers for webshops, supermarkets, or transport companies. There are thousands of these types of locations in the Netherlands, especially around Venlo, Tilburg, Rotterdam, and Utrecht. The role is broad. PCR vs Certification: Navigating Amazon's New Non‑GMO Requirements for Dietary Supplements  October 23, 2026 Amazon now requires all non-GMO claims for dietary supplements to be substantiated. Acceptable supporting evidence may include a polymerase chain reaction (PCR) test or certification issued under an Amazon-recognized third-party program such as IGEN™. Without valid substantiation, brands risk having 'non-GMO' claims removed, product listings suppressed or products removed from sale. For brands selling dietary supplements on Amazon, it is therefore important to identify an efficient way to meet these requirements while minimizing delays and administrative burdens. PCR or certification? While Amazon accepts both seller-supplied PCR testing and third-party certification as valid evidence of non-GMO claim substantiation, these two options offer very different operational and commercial outcomes for brands. PCR testing provides point-in-time verification and places ongoing responsibility on the brand, including managing documents, maintaining records and ensuring substantiation remains current as products, suppliers and formulations evolve. As a result, PCR testing typically serves as standalone evidence of non-GMO status, without delivering additional program or marketing benefits. Certification programs, by contrast, provide a more comprehensive, structured framework that supports substantiation requirements while offering ongoing oversight, consumer-facing recognition, and broader marketing value beyond Amazon compliance. Depending on the program, certification may also streamline enrollment and create recognizable trust signals that strengthen consumer confidence and brand positioning. You will carry grocery crates, walk between the delivery van and customers' doors and get in and out of the vehicle throughout your shift. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amsterdam You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You are comfortable working independently. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Almere As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Almere, you take online grocery orders on the final part of their journey: from the delivery location to the customer's front door. At the beginning of your shift, you collect the keys to your delivery van and check the route prepared for you. Once you are ready, you head out to your first address. Navigation guides you between customers in Almere and the surrounding area. At each stop, you select the correct order from the van and check it with a handheld scanner. You then carry the grocery crates to the customer's door. You make sure every order is handed over in a friendly and professional way. If a payment needs to be processed, you take care of it. Empty crates and returnable packaging can also be collected before you leave. Then it is time for your next delivery. You will spend plenty of time behind the wheel, but this is not a job where you sit down all day. Getting in and out of the van, walking to customers' doors and carrying grocery crates are all part of a normal shift. Once your final order has been delivered, you return to the Almere location. You complete the route, return your equipment and leave the van ready for its next shift. Do I need previous experience? No. Previous experience as acourier or delivery driver is not required. An experienced buddy will train you during your first working days. You will learn how to use the van, scanner and delivery systems and how to handle different situations at the customer's door. How flexible are the working hours? You can submit your availability and work between 12 and 32 hours per week. Deliveries take place from Monday through Sunday, with shifts available at different times of the day. You need to be available for at least two shifts per week and at least two Saturdays per month. Is this an active job? Yes. Driving is only one part of the role. Throughout your shift, you regularly get in and out of the van and carry grocery crates to customers. You should therefore be comfortable with physical activity while working. Are there opportunities to develop? Yes. After gaining experience, you may have the opportunity to become a buddy. In this role, you help new delivery drivers during their first working days. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Almere You are at least 18 years old. You have a valid category B driving licence. You speak Dutch and/or English. You are available for at least two shifts per week. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. You are friendly and helpful towards customers. You are comfortable working independently. You drive safely and responsibly. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. What are the main challenges that international professionals face when looking for work in the Netherlands? Language is often mentioned first. Even though many people in the Maastricht Region speak English with varied proficiency, employers still often ask for Dutch at a certain level. However, I think the bigger challenge is how internationals present themselves. They have strong experience, but it is not always clear to Dutch employers how this fits their specific needs. It is about making your value as an employee and as a person visible and understandable. Many internationals already have strong skills. Why can it still be difficult for them to find the right job? Internationals often have great soft skills, such as flexibility and perseverance. These are very valuable, but they are not enough on their own. Employers also want to see clear, practical skills. You need to explain what you can do in a specific role and why that matters to the employer. It is about connecting your experience to what the company is looking for. jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Junior IT Recruiter
jobs.description:
Looking to start your career in recruitment? Enjoy talking to people, asking questions and finding out what makes them tick?

I'm looking for a Junior IT Recruiter to work alongside me at Oliver James in Brussels. You'll learn how to find, qualify and build relationships with IT professionals, helping us fill roles with the right people.

This role is 100% focused on candidates. There is no business development, client prospecting or responsibility for winning new clients. Your focus will be on building a strong candidate network within your IT specialisation and matching those people with opportunities we're already working on.
What you'll do

• Find the right people. Use LinkedIn Recruiter, our database and referrals to identify IT professionals who match our recruitment needs.

• Start conversations. Reach out to candidates, introduce relevant opportunities and get them interested in speaking with you.

• Get to know your candidates. Run qualification calls to understand their experience, technical skills, career goals, availability and salary or rate expectations.

• Build lasting relationships. Stay in regular contact with promising candidates, including those who aren't ready to move yet.

• Know who's ready for their next move. Maintain an up-to-date shortlist of qualified, engaged candidates so we can respond quickly when a suitable role comes in.

• Keep things organised. Record useful notes and next steps in our recruitment system, making sure conversations lead to proper follow-up.

• Work closely with me. Understand the requirements of each role, share what you're hearing from candidates and help identify the strongest matches

Who we're looking for

You don't need recruitment experience or a technical background. We're looking for someone who wants to learn and is willing to put in the work.

You'll be a good fit if you:

• Speak fluent French and English. Dutch is a plus.

• Enjoy speaking with people and feel comfortable picking up the phone.

• Are curious enough to go beyond a CV and understand what someone actually does and wants.

• Can stay organised while following up with several candidates at different stages.

• Keep going when someone doesn't reply or an initial approach doesn't work.

• Welcome feedback and want to improve.

• Have an interest in technology and are willing to learn the differences between IT roles.

What you'll learn:

• You'll receive hands-on training and work closely with an experienced headhunter specialising in the Belgian software engineering market.

• You'll also develop your understanding of IT specialisations so you can have increasingly confident and relevant conversations.

• As you progress, you'll take more ownership of your candidate network and become someone people turn to when they're considering their next career move.

Interested?

Send me your CV or a short message explaining why this role interests you.

Previous recruitment experience isn't required.

I'd like to hear what makes you want to give it a go.

As Purchasing & Logistics Assistant, you will play a key role in keeping our purchasing and logistics operations running smoothly. Your responsibilities cover the entire operational flow, from placing purchase orders and coordinating with suppliers to checking incoming invoices and preparing shipments for customers and partners. When products are unavailable or delivery dates change, you take the initiative to find suitable alternatives and keep things moving.
 

In addition to the above, you will also contribute to the smooth day-to-day running of our office by taking care of a range of general and very practical facility and office management tasks.
 

This is a hands-on role combining practical warehouse and logistics activities with administrative & office-related responsibilities. We are therefore looking for someone who works proactively, takes ownership of their responsibilities and naturally spots what needs to be done. You enjoy bringing structure to day-to-day operations, solving practical problems and making sure things get done without having to be asked twice.
 

More details in PDF file enclosed.

• A solution-oriented attitude and the ability to find practical alternatives when things do not go according to plan. 
• The flexibility to switch between administrative tasks and hands-on operational work throughout the day. 
• Confidence in communicating with suppliers, couriers, colleagues and other external contacts. 
• A reliable and structured approach, with a strong focus on accuracy, follow-up and getting things done. 
• A willingness to take ownership of both the bigger picture and the smaller practical details that keep an organisation running smoothly.
 

You are comfortable working at a desk when the task requires it, but you are equally happy to receive deliveries, check goods and take care of practical logistics activities. You understand that a well-functioning operation depends on both accurate administration and effective execution.
 

Given the practical and on-site nature of this role, you live within maximum 30 minutes' driving distance of our workplace in Hasselt.
 

Experience with purchase order systems, ERP software, courier platforms and international shipping documentation is an advantage.

• Experience with OWL and front-end customization.
• Previous experience in high-volume transactional or usage-based billing environments.

jobs.description:
European HQ Brussels | Fiber Laser & Press Brake Expertise | Technical & Commercial Support | International En
Join the European headquarters of an international CNC machine tool manufacturer as a Product Specialist Fiber Laser & Press Brake in Brussels. In this permanent role, you will combine technical product expertise with commercial support, helping dealers, sales teams and customers across Europe find the right fiber laser and press brake solutions.
 You will work in an international environment and travel approximately one week per month across Europe for customer and dealer visits, machine demonstrations and trade fairs.

 Job at a glance

• Location: Brussels, Belgium
• Contract: Permanent
• Working hours: Full-time, 38 or 40 hours per week
• Salary: Up to approximately €5,500 gross per month, depending on experience
• Travel: Approximately one week per month within Europe
• Languages: Fluent Dutch and English
• Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field
• Benefits: Electric company car, charging or fuel card, insurance, pension plan and €10 meal vouchers
• Working hours: Flexible
About the organisation

This international machine tool manufacturer is a market leader in CNC machine tools across the Western world. Its product portfolio includes CNC machining centers, lathes, fiber lasers and press brakes.
To further strengthen its fiber laser and press brake activities in Europe, the company is looking for a Product Specialist who combines technical expertise with strong commercial awareness.
 You will join a small, approachable and international team at the European headquarters in Brussels. The working environment offers considerable autonomy and short communication lines.

 

 
Your new role
As Product Specialist Fiber Laser & Press Brake, you will be the European point of reference for fiber laser and press brake solutions.

You will support dealers, sales teams and end customers throughout the commercial and technical process, from pre-sales and machine configuration to demonstrations, training, product launches and technical support.

What will you do?

• Provide technical support for product- and application-related questions.
• Advise customers, dealers and sales teams on applications and suitable machine configurations.
• Analyse and resolve product-related technical challenges.
• Support dealers and sales teams throughout commercial sales processes.
• Develop clear product positioning and technical sales arguments.
• Deliver product and application training to dealers and sales teams.
• Demonstrate fiber laser and press brake machines at customer sites, events and trade fairs.
• Support new product launches across the European market.
• Gather customer, dealer and market feedback and identify potential business opportunities.
• Collaborate with Sales, Service, Marketing and Product Management.
• Maintain regular contact with international colleagues and stakeholders.The position covers the European market, with approximately one week of international travel per month.
 
 
What do you need? Essential
• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field.
• Experience in a technical, engineering, product management or technical-commercial environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to translate technical challenges into practical solutions.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly to different audiences.
• A customer-focused and commercially minded approach.
• Experience coordinating projects and working with internal and external stakeholders.
• A structured way of working with attention to quality and detail.
• A proactive and results-oriented mindset.
• Fluent Dutch and English.
• Willingness to travel approximately one week per month within Europe.Your strengths
 You are eager to learn and motivated to develop in-depth knowledge of fiber laser, press brake and CNC machine technologies. You enjoy combining technical problem-solving with customer contact and commercial thinking, and you are comfortable working with colleagues and stakeholders across different European markets.

Your work contributes directly to safe start-up, operational readiness and long-term compliance.

Compliance & Conformity Management
    
• Identify and assess applicable European, national and regional legislation.  
• Develop compliance and conformity roadmaps for industrial projects.  
• Translate requirements related to CE Marking, the EU Blue Guide and regulatory frameworks into clear project deliverables.  
• Coordinate interfaces with inspection bodies, notified bodies, certification organisations and authorities.  
• Support clients in managing compliance risks throughout the project lifecycle.   
Project Governance & Stakeholder Management
    
• Establish project governance structures, reporting lines and decision-making processes.  
• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across clients, engineering teams, contractors and suppliers.  
• Define responsibilities, interfaces and escalation paths.  
• Support steering committees, reviews and key project decision points.   
Operational Readiness & License to Operate

• Monitor project readiness, compliance status and key risks.  
• Support evidence-based decisions for commissioning, handover and ...

• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2 or equivalent) is considered a plus.   
Knowledge & Affinity
  
You have experience or affinity with several of the following domains:
    
• European product legislation and conformity assessment;  
• CE Marking and EU Blue Guide principles;  
• EU New Legislative Framework (NLF);  
• Industrial commissioning and operational readiness;  
• Environmental permitting and compliance requirements;  
• Occupational safety and statutory inspections;  
• Governance, stakeholder management and stage-gate methodologies.

• Build trust through a professional, solution-oriented approach.

Oversee contractor-led tool installations for the Málaga cleanroom (Fab 5) project, with a focus on safety and conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines. 

 

What you will doFor the Málaga Fab 5 project, tool installations will be performed by the contractor. imec’s role focuses on safety oversight and validating that the installations conform to imec’s required standards and guidelines. That’s where you come in. Onboarding and training will take place in Leuven, Belgium until mid-2028, after which the position location will transfer to Málaga, Spain.  
As Project Lead, your role combines contractor oversight, safety follow-up and installation conformity validation on behalf of imec. 
The contractor is responsible for installation execution and day-to-day coordination of the installation works. You will monitor progress, review safety and quality matters, and coordinate interfaces with imec stakeholders, keeping a clear distinction between contractor execution and imec oversight. 
Your focus is to validate conformity with imec’s installation standards, guidelines and safety requirements. You will review contractor deliverables and installation evidence, follow up deviations and corrective actions, and support installation acceptance by imec rather than directly managing execution. 
You will: 
 
 

• Oversee contractor-led installations and coordinate interfaces with imec 

• Review contractor schedules and monitor progress against agreed milestones 

• Flag scope deviations and their impact on timelines, budgets and priorities 

• Validate installation conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines through reviews, inspections and supporting records 

• Provide safety oversight and follow up contractor actions on safety and quality findings 

• Keep internal stakeholders and external partners informed 

• Escalate risks and non-conformities, track corrective actions and review evidence for installation acceptance 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electromechanical Engineering.  

• You have at least 5 years of relevant technical experience.  

• You have experience overseeing contractor-led technical projects and reviewing installations against defined standards and guidelines.  

• You communicate openly and proactively with both internal customers and external partners about the status of ongoing work, and you escalate issues promptly when needed.  

• You adapt easily to changes and time pressure and combine a practical mindset with a strong focus on safety, quality and conformity.  

• You are fluent in English and Spanish.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with business analysts and software developers for our equipment integration solution. You will be supported by dedicated test engineers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You perform the crucial task of analyzing how our equipment integration software platform can implement business requirements. The specifications to be passed on to internal and more often external developers can range from straightforward configuration to additional logic to be defined. 

• Some business requirements will result in equipment integration being dependent on related configuration or even features to be implemented in adjacent applications, especially the MES. You thus will gain sufficient knowledge about adjacent CIM applications to effectively collaborate with their business analysts and functional analysts. 

• You have an active role in test preparation and debugging. You will be supported by our PMO team during all phases of the software lifecycle. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience. 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials. 

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab. 

• You have participated in a CIM project, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. 

• You have strong analytical skills and are solution oriented. You can challenge assumptions and question approaches. 

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are dependable. 

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment. 

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment. 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with equipment engineers and software developers.  

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial task will be the verification of equipment to host communication as specified during purchasing. Semiconductor equipment communication follows a comprehensive set of standards. However, these standards allow for differences in implementation and scope definition which often cause complications with equipment integration.

Who you are

jobs.occupation: Process Engineer – Thin film and wafer metrology
jobs.description:
What you will do
 

Manage and optimize thin-film and wafer metrology tools, developing automated measurement recipes and ensuring equipment stability, quality, throughput, and safety. 
You will be a member of the in-Line Metrology Process Engineering team. This team is responsible for the standard metrology processes and tools in the cleanroom. 
 
 

• As a process engineer you will be responsible for multiple tools with a focus on thin film & wafer metrology. You will work on different measurement techniques like ellipsometry, reflectivity, wafer shape (bow, warp), four-point-probe (sheet resistance), microHall, etc.  

• You will create the automated measurement recipes on your tools which will be run by the operators afterwards.  

• You are the expert on the applications that you own and support the customers with your expertise.  

• You own multiple metrology equipment, and you will be responsible for process & tool qualification, the stability, and problem prevention as well as improvements in efficiency, throughput, safety and quality.  

• You will troubleshoot issues related to the metrology processing together with your colleagues.  

• You will communicate effectively with the stakeholders via multiple channels (IT systems, meetings, mail, etc.)  

• You will work in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts.  

• You will work in a shift regime, working in two shifts (Early/Late) including 1weekend (Sat + Sun) out of 4, to support the operations department which is working 24/7.  

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or Engineering or equal by experience and display strong engineering skills and mindset. PhD’s without industry relevant experience will not be considered.  

• A solid theoretical foundation and hands-on experience in one or more of the techniques listed below is an asset: 
 
 

• Ellipsometry, wafer shape metrology, sheet resistance.    

• Knowledge of the following techniques is a plus: MOKE, FMR, CIPT, MH, XRR, XRD.  

• As timing is critical in our business, we are looking for people who can evaluate and respond effectively to incoming requests and issues in a timely matter. A proactive mindset and flexibility is key.  

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong proactive communication and reporting skills are required. You strive to document and report your work to highest quality standards.  

• Given the international character of imec, fluency in English is a must.  

• Process & quality driven analyzer: You manage multiple priorities with a proactive “can do” attitude.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities for your career development. 
 
 

• As a member of our Fab Engineering team, you will closely work with experts of the MES and related software – commonly referred to as CIM.  

• You have an active role throughout the entire equipment lifecycle, from automation specification during procurement, to requirement gathering after commissioning, to operational improvement after production release. You make sure that operations and engineering requirements regarding CIM integration are sufficiently specified and can be implemented accordingly. To enable this implementation, you need to understand equipment behavior and communication capabilities – which frequently requires exploration and diligent testing.  

• While technical knowledge and interest is crucial to be successful in this job, you will collaborate with hardware and software engineers who either deliver details to you or must pick up conclusions made by you. Data Specialist is a pivotal role, putting equipment communication capabilities into practice.  

• Commonly known as Industry 4.0 features, in semiconductor manufacturing such equipment communication feeds applications like MES, SPC, FDC (Fault Detection and Classification), APC (Advanced Process Control), and AMHS (Automated Material Handling).  

• With this open position we are specifically looking for candidates who will work with Metrology equipment, i.e. measuring process results and product properties.  

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience.  

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials.  

• Prior experience in or knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You have participated in CIM projects, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS.  

• You understand measurement techniques, why different equipment is needed to measure different properties, and how measurement results can be reported.  

• You have a pro-active approach and are solution oriented. You cannot wait to roll up your sleeves and dive right into the action. You easily work independently and are an effective team player as well.  

• You thrive in a complex and demanding environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with developers of the same and adjacent software applications, Functional Analysts, and Business Analysts, to deliver a modern CIM application landscape.  

• Your primary contact will be the developer team lead, responsible for establishing our in-house development capability for the commercially sourced Equipment Integration platform, and we will assign an additional mentor during your onboarding.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial tasks will be configuration of existing equipment controller software modules, followed by developing clones of software modules for the same equipment type.  

• As we insource more functionality of the commercially sourced Equipment Integration platform, you will start developing equipment controller software modules for new equipment types. You will also be involved in developing custom solutions interfacing with the commercial platform.  

• You will participate in equipment model testing, both with software emulators as well as physical connection to the equipment hardware.  

Who you are 
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development, specifically related to hardware automation, and performing Java OOP.  

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You understand concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS.  

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent.  

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired.  

• You feel comfortable in a complex and demanding environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do 
 

You will join our SEM-TEM operations team within the FAB, where we perform both in-line and out-of-line electron microscopy inspections. These inspections are essential at various stages of process development, enabling us to characterise materials and processes at wafer level with a high degree of precision. By delivering accurate and timely insights, we support our internal customers in developing innovative chip manufacturing processes that meet ever more demanding requirements. To achieve this, we rely on cutting-edge cleanroom facilities and highly advanced equipment. In this role, you will help ensure the health, quality and reliability of our microscopy tools through close collaboration with equipment suppliers and internal users. In short, you will support the teams carrying out microscopy analyses and contribute to the smooth and high-quality execution of SEM and TEM inspections. 
 
 

• As a SEM/TEM Hardware Assistant Technician, your key responsibilities will include:  

• Monitoring and following up on the overall health and performance of the tools.  

• Acting as the main point of contact with equipment suppliers to report, discuss and resolve tool-related issues.  

• Serving as the first point of contact for internal users when tool health or performance issues arise.  

• Contributing to the achievement of hardware performance targets and key performance indicators (KPIs).  

• Supporting statistical process control (SPC) activities for TEM tools to help maintain stable and reliable performance.  

Who you are 
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a scientific field such as physics, engineering, chemistry, or another relevant discipline. (or equivalent by relevant experience)  

• Hands-on experience with laboratory tools, microscopy equipment or micromachining systems would be a strong advantage.  

• You are well organised, able to plan effectively, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where multitasking and setting priorities are essential.  

• You are a communicative team player with a good command of English.  

• You are willing to work in a shift system, including early, late and night shifts, (24/7) as well as one weekend in four.

What you will do
 

Operational Excellence 
 
 

• Contribute to day-to-day operational readiness of SEM tools within a 24/7 production environment  

• Collaborate with First Line Support (FLS), Equipment, and Process Engineers to ensure tool availability, stability, and performance  

• Act as a technical bridge between Operations and Engineering to enable smooth coordination and handovers  

• Support cross-functional initiatives aimed at reducing cycle time and improving tool efficiency  

• Escalate tool or process issues and follow up on non-conformities related to tool behaviour, inspection quality, or data integrity   

Inspection & Process Support 
 
 

• Manage incoming SEM metrology requests and verify their alignment with tool capabilities and process specifications  

• Advise requesters on optimal inspection strategies, including recommending more suitable metrology techniques when appropriate  

• Review and interpret inline SEM/XSEM output, as well as macro- and microscopic wafer inspections; share findings with process engineers and other stakeholders  

• Support timely wafer movement by proactively screening flows and reports (e.g., hold queues, tool down/forecast reports), and contribute to reducing hold times  

• Coordinate inspection reservations and align with stakeholders to minimize cycle time impact, supporting the fab’s overall KPI targets  

• Review and append SEM and FIB signature/authorization requests  

• Share Best Known Methods (BKMs) and documentation templates to support consistent and high-quality inspection output across the team   

Team & Knowledge Sharing 
 
 

• Collaborate with operators, FLS, and engineers to execute daily priorities efficiently and accurately  

• Support training, onboarding, and continuous learning within the team  

• Contribute to knowledge transfer by sharing insights on inspection data interpretation, inspection techniques, and tool behaviour 

Who you are
 
 

• A bachelor's in chemistry, Physics, Electronics, Electromechanics, or similar industrial experience  

• Eager to learn and self-organized  

• Good sense of urgency and the flexibility to take on tasks in function of project needs  

• Accurate and organized  

• Dedicated to a high standard of quality and work  

• Resilient and problem-solving  

• Independent and proactive  

• Decisive and assertive  

• Good social- and communication skills  

• Proficient English   

We seek a candidate who thrives in a dynamic work environment, showcasing an adaptability to diverse projects or research topics. You’ll be a key team player, ready to support colleagues and tackle impactful projects within the timelines of our trusted global partners.

PMO-C²Trust — Turning Compliance and Conformity into Operational Readiness.
 

Are you an experienced Project Manager who thrives in complex industrial environments where engineering, compliance, safety, permitting and operational readiness converge? Do you enjoy bringing structure to multidisciplinary projects and helping clients navigate regulatory and conformity requirements with confidence? Then the role of

• hands-on FME, PyQGIS or QGIS plugin development

• You speak French fluently and have a professional knowledge of English. Dutch is an asset.🌟 Who are you?

jobs.occupation: Senior RF/MMW – Analog and Mixed Signal IC Researcher
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced IC design researcher who can participate actively in the innovation and design of advanced RF/mmw and high speed (Gs/s) integrated circuits in the most advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies.
Apply 
 

Company
 

Imec performs world-leading research in nano-electronics. Imec leverages its scientific knowledge with the innovative power of its global partnerships in ICT, healthcare and energy. Imec delivers industry-relevant technology solutions. In a unique high-tech environment, its international top talent is committed to providing the building blocks for a better life in a sustainable society. Over 5000 expert scientists from over 95 countries shape tomorrow’s world with their research which is typically 5 to 10 years ahead of the market. Imec is headquartered in Leuven (Belgium) and has offices in the Netherlands, Taiwan, US, China, Japan and India. 
The Imec RF/mmWave and High-Speed ADC group in Leuven enjoys a world-class reputation in advanced high speed ADC and in millimeter-wave (mm-wave) RF Designs. In these fields our expertise is in the design of record-breaking high sampling rate ADCs and integrated RF/mm-wave front-ends in advanced CMOS and III-V based technologies. The design group also performs research in the fields of circuit design for advanced (optical) wireline communication, future RF technologies, mm-Wave sensing for life sciences, and mm-Wave imaging. 
The circuit design group is technically mentored by Piet Wambacq and Jan Craninckx and has an established state-of-the-art research reputation that has been confirmed over the years by our extensive presence in top conferences in solid-state circuit design, such as ISSCC, RFIC, ESSCIRC, VLSI and CICC. 
 
As an independent research center, we collaborate closely with top players in both industry and academia, giving our people continuous exposure to both the latest evolutions in industrial challenges and approaches, as well as into the newest emerging academic ideas and paradigms.
 

What you will do
 

We are looking for an experienced IC design researcher who can participate actively in the innovation and design of advanced RF/mm-wave and high speed (Gs/s) integrated circuits in the most advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies. 
 

Your key responsibilities will be: 
 
 

• Research and design of innovative high-speed, low-power RF and analog/mixed-signal integrated circuits in advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies.  

• Drive the bottom-up evolution of these integrated circuits considering the evolution of scaling.  

• Together with the team, bring new ideas and new technical innovations based on your solid technical experience.  

• Take part in technical interactions with external partners and towards new prospects.  

• Publish your state-of-the-art research results in international conferences or journals.  

Who you are
 
 

• You have a PhD degree in the domain of high-speed analog/mixed-signal and RF/mm-wave IC design or equivalent through experience.  

• You have solid design experience, and you have designed in advanced CMOS technologies (28nm, 16nmFF, 5nm).  

• You have experience designing in IIIV technologies.  

• You have a profound understanding of transistor-level circuits.  

• Experience in state-of-the-art high-speed analog/RF circuit design is a strong plus.  

• You are familiar with the various steps and tools in the design and layout of high performant analog and mixed signal circuits  

• You have solid understanding of solid-state devices, analog/RF circuits, up to the system architecture.  

• You have a broad interest in circuit design and are willing to contribute to multiple high speed analog circuit research domains  

• You can work independently yet in close collaboration with experts from other technical fields.  

• You have excellent reporting skills and can present technical results and choices clearly and concisely.  

• You can easily integrate into an international team.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Data Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
Oliver James is partnering with a leading enterprise organization migrating its core legacy systems from Adabas (Mainframe) to PostgreSQL.

We are seeking a Data Functional Analyst to bridge the gap between legacy business logic and modern database architecture. Working directly alongside Data Engineers and DBAs, you will define data mappings and ensure a seamless, high-integrity migration.
Key responsibilities

• 
Legacy Data Analysis & Mapping: Deep-dive into Mainframe data structures and define accurate functional target mappings to PostgreSQL relational schemaq

• 
Technical & Functional Guidance: Act as the primary functional advisor for Data Engineers and DBAs, writing clear functional specifications to guide ETL/ELT pipeline development and schema design

• 
Data Quality & Reconciliation: Design data validation strategies, define test scenarios, and execute cross-database reconciliation checks (Mainframe legacy vs. PostgreSQL) to guarantee 100% data integrity and consistency

• 
Data Lineage & Documentation: Maintain comprehensive data dictionaries, mapping rulebooks, and lineage documentation throughout the migration lifecycle

• 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the functional point of contact for resolving legacy data ambiguities and translating complex business rules for the technical delivery team

• 
Functional Data Expertise: 3 years of experience as a Data Functional Analyst, Business Data Analyst, or Data Consultant on large-scale data transformation projects

• 
Database & SQL Skills: Strong, mandatory expertise in PostgreSQL and advanced proficiency in SQL and relational data modelling concepts

• 
Mainframe Experience: Solid functional understanding of Mainframe database environments (knowledge of Adabas is nice to have, but not mandatory)

• 
Migration Track Record: Hands-on experience working on complex legacy-to-relational data migration projects

• 
Language skills

• 
Fluent English (written and spoken)

• 
Professional fluency in French and/or Dutch (essential for local team and business stakeholder collaboration)

• 
Communication & Mindset: Excellent analytical skills, rigorous attention to detail, and the ability to articulate complex functional rules clearly to technical teams

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

The opportunity

Our client, a Belgian federal public administration, is running a major digital transformation programme to modernise its business applications, strengthen collaboration between teams and build a more integrated, agile IT landscape. The programme is organised into domains, each led by a Domain Delivery Lead who brings several agile squads together around one vision.

We are recruiting three Domain Delivery Leads, each owning one domain of the programme

• Platform & Integration: the cross-domain technical backbone: integration, releases, Azure cloud, DevOps, security and data migration.

• Public Sector Transformation: a high-profile, politically sensitive public service domain.

• Digital Public Services: a domain delivering strategic applications behind core public services.

All three are senior delivery and programme management roles. You lead through influence, clarity of vision and trust rather than control. You will not be writing code or building infrastructure; you make it possible for several agile teams to deliver.
What you will do

• Unite several agile squads around a shared vision and keep business and team priorities aligned

• Create the conditions for autonomy and coach teams towards maturity (servant leadership)

• Build the overall plan with the teams, manage cross-team dependencies and arbitrate priorities transparently

• Run domain rituals: cross-team syncs, reviews and retrospectives

• Remove blockers by connecting the teams with the business, IT and other domains

• Manage change requests, report progress and risks to governance bodies and escalate in good time

• Manage suppliers as partners and own the domain budget

• A builder, not a caretaker: someone who likes to create, evolve and unite teams, brings fresh ideas and challenges existing practices.

• A servant leader: you lead through trust, remove obstacles and help squads grow in autonomy.

• A strong business to IT translator: you explain complex IT in simple business language and turn policy and business needs into a clear roadmap.

• Proven at scale in the public sector: multiple squads, budgets and capacity on large digital transformations, ideally in government.

How you work

You influence without hierarchical authority, adapt your message to every audience, handle conflict diplomatically and stay calm and solution-focused under pressure.

• Business process reengineering and change management in digital transformations

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Permanent Control Officer - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Our mission? To foster a trustworthy, secure environment for both our colleagues and clients.

We’re seeking a proactive professional to join our IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) team, a key function within Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). Here, you’ll play a pivotal role in helping IT and Business Units navigate operational risks tied to IT and Cyber Security, while reinforcing an adaptive, resilient control framework across the bank.

 

AND IN DETAIL

• Identification and assessment of risks: You’ll analyse data from risk systems, reports, and governance bodies, turning complex information into practical, risk-based insights. Your conclusions will help leaders make informed decisions.
• Controls Execution & Reporting: You’ll interpret, adapt, and run control tests (compliance, fraud, outsourcing, etc.), then report findings to the CIO, ensuring controls align with IT’s strategic priorities.
• Regulatory & Internal Reporting: You’ll prepare precise, high-impact reports for the Internal Control Committee (ExCo), regulators (NBB/BNB, ECB), and Group entities (CDF/IT Group), shaping risk discussions at the highest level.
• Procedure Governance: As the gatekeeper for IT risk and security procedures, you’ll ensure they’re up to date, accessible, and visible, keeping our compliance framework structured and resilient.
• Governance Body Support: Acting as NAC secretary for major IT initiatives, you’ll track stakeholder conditions (Business & Functions), driving accountability and alignment in high-impact projects.
• Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA): You’ll conduct the annual RCSA for all IT risk categories, using the RISK ORM methodology to assess risks, incidents, and recommendations, giving a full picture of IT’s risk profile, including external threats.
• Regulatory Reporting – IT Risk Questionnaire: You’ll coordinate the bank’s response to the ECB’s IT Risk questionnaire (via Group) and the NBB’s BNP Paribas Fortis reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, regulator-ready, and endorsed by the CISO/CIO.
• Compliance Controls Execution: You’ll run IT-wide compliance checks (awareness, ethics, etc.), report findings to the IT Management Team, and drive remediation where needed, ensuring actions are documented and evidenced.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Background & Experience

• A Master’s degree in IT, economics, or engineering, with a strong IT foundation.
• 10+ years of experience, including at least 5 years in Risk or IT whether in financial services, consulting, or another regulated industry.  
What You Bring to the Table

• IT & Security Process Insight: You understand how IT and security technologies integrate into risk and operational frameworks and where the gaps might be.
• Risk Assessment Skills: Hands-on experience in identifying and evaluating IT and cyber risks, with a practical (not just theoretical) approach.
• Regulatory & Standards Know-How: Familiarity with frameworks like EBA guidelines, DORA, ISO 27001, or NIST and the ability to apply them in real-world IT risk and compliance scenarios.
• Control Design & Testing: You can translate regulations and policies into effective controls and know how to test whether they actually work.
• Agile Mindset: Experience with Agile methodologies in a risk or control environment is a plus, but adaptability matters most.
• Process Thinking: You quickly grasp end-to-end processes, spot risks, and propose practical solutions without getting lost in bureaucracy.
• Clear Communication: Whether it’s a report for executives or a presentation for regulators, you distill complex topics into concise, actionable messages.
• Stakeholder Alignment: You bridge the gap between technical teams, business units, and regulators keeping everyone aligned without losing sight of compliance and risk goals.
• Collaboration: You thrive in cross-functional teams, working smoothly with colleagues and partners to execute risk and control initiatives.  
Practicalities

• Languages: Fluent in French or Dutch, with strong English (written and spoken).
• Tools: Comfortable with SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Nice-to-have: Experience with RISK 360 is a plus, but not a must.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

This is not just a risk management role - it’s an opportunity to:

• Engage diverse stakeholders, from technical teams to C-level executives, across all areas of BNP Paribas Fortis.
• Drive creative solutions, transforming complex cyber risks into practical, forward-thinking strategies.
• Shape a resilient future by proactively managing cyber risks to strengthen the bank’s defenses.
If you thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where innovation and collaboration are key, this is your chance to make a tangible impact in banking cybersecurity

 

And in detail

Your Key Role as IT & Cyber Risk Specialist :

You serve as the critical link between technical risks, business priorities, and strategic decisions, ensuring IT and cybersecurity risks are proactively identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable strategies—fully aligned with the bank’s objectives.

Why this role stands out:

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Tribes, Functions, and Business Units, clearly articulating risks to both technical teams and leadership—enabling data-driven decision-making.
• Proactive risk intelligence: From Shadow IT exposures to operational vulnerabilities, you assess, prioritize, and drive mitigation, delivering practical solutions that balance security with business continuity.
• Strategic advisory: Provide targeted recommendations to IT and business stakeholders, ensuring risks are managed without compromising operational goals.
• Enterprise-wide alignment: Report risks, trends, and insights to Cyber Security, IT, and Business Management, while sharing best practices across the BNP Paribas Group—reinforcing a unified risk posture.
• Process optimization: Leverage your expertise to refine risk management methods and tools, ensuring they remain efficient, scalable, and future-ready."

Your talents and skills

• Risk-to-Solution Mindset: You break down complex IT and cybersecurity challenges, turning them into clear, actionable insights for leadership—viewing risks as solvable challenges, not just warnings.
• Bank-Specific Acumen: Deep understanding of BNP Paribas Fortis’ businesses, functions, and strategic goals, ensuring risk management aligns with our priorities.
• Technical + Risk Expertise: Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, architecture, and security, blending technical knowledge with risk awareness to design practical solutions—not just identify risks.
• Multilingual Communication: Fluent in French or Dutch + professional English, with strong written and verbal persuasion skills. You adapt seamlessly between IT, business, and management discussions.
• Practical Framework Application: Proven ability to operationalize IT processes, Cyber Security Management Systems, and control frameworks—ensuring they deliver in practice.
• Certifications & Methodologies: CISSP, CISM, Operational Risk Management, or Agile experience are a plus, but not mandatory.

European HQ Brussels | CNC Machine Expertise | Technical Sales Support | European Scope | International Environment | Permanent Contract

 

 Job at a glance

• Location: Zaventem, Brussels region, Belgium
• Contract: Permanent
• Working hours: Full-time, 38 or 40 hours per week
• Salary: Up to approximately €5,500 gross per month, depending on experience
• Travel: Approximately one week per month within Europe
• Languages: Fluent Dutch or French, combined with fluent English
• Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field, or equivalent experience
• Benefits: Electric company car, fuel or charging card, insurance, pension plan and €10 meal vouchers
• Working hours: Flexible
• Work arrangement: Mainly office-based, combined with European travel
 About The Organisation
This international machine tool manufacturer is a market leader in CNC machine tools across the Western world. Its product portfolio includes CNC machining centres, lathes, fiber lasers and press brakes.
 The organisation works with a network of dedicated distributors across different European countries. These local partners are responsible for selling and supporting the machines within their respective markets.

 

What will you do?Technical sales and pre-sales support

• Provide technical support to European distributors, Sales Managers and Sales Engineers.
• Advise on CNC machines, options, applications and configurations.
• Translate customer requirements into suitable technical solutions.
• Support sales teams throughout the commercial process, including product positioning, promotions and special pricing requests.
• Resolve technical or commercial issues that could delay a sale.
Relationship building and commercial insight

• Build strong relationships with distributors and local sales teams.
• Maintain regular contact to understand market needs, challenges and opportunities.
• Identify sales blockers, risks and potential business opportunities.
• Gather field feedback and translate it into actionable commercial insights.
• Share relevant market intelligence with the Sales Manager and internal teams.
Cross-functional coordination

• Collaborate with Sales, Applications, Service, Logistics, Marketing, IT and Product Management.
• Coordinate and follow up on cross-functional issues until resolution.
• Maintain regular contact with international colleagues and stakeholders.
• Support new product launches across Europe.
Training, demonstrations and customer visits

• Deliver product and application training to distributors and sales teams.
• Demonstrate CNC machines at customer sites, events and trade fairs.
• Support and coordinate customer and distributor visits to the European headquarters and showroom.
• Ensure machines, tooling and materials are ready for demonstrations.
• Support the coordination and smooth operation of the showroom.
Reporting and independent working

• Work autonomously and organise activities independently.
• Provide structured weekly reporting to the Sales Manager.
• Report and escalate sales blockers, missed opportunities and critical issues.
• Keep internal stakeholders informed about relevant customer and market developments.
 

What do you need?
Essential
• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in electromechanics, industrial engineering or another technical field.
• Equivalent technical expertise gained through professional experience can also be considered.
• At least approximately five years of relevant experience in a CNC, machining, manufacturing, engineering, product management or technical-commercial environment.
• Practical knowledge of CNC machines or experience working in a production environment.
• Experience with machining centres, lathes, fiber lasers or press brakes is a strong advantage.
• The ability to understand technical challenges and translate them into practical solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Experience supporting sales teams, customers, distributors or other commercial stakeholders.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly to different audiences.
• A customer-focused and commercially minded approach.
• Experience coordinating projects or working with different internal and external stakeholders.
• A structured way of working with attention to quality and detail.
• Fluent Dutch or French, combined with fluent English.
• Willingness to travel approximately one week per month within Europe.
• The ability to work independently and confidently in an international environment.
• A good working knowledge of Microsoft Office. Experience with SAP is an advantage.Your strengthsYou are technically strong, communicative and commercially aware. You enjoy solving technical problems, but you also understand the urgency and business impact behind a sales opportunity.You are comfortable taking ownership, coordinating different stakeholders and following issues through until they are resolved. As you will regularly work independently and travel throughout Europe, you can structure your own activities and make well-considered decisions.
 You are also:

• Mature and confident in your communication
• Hands-on and solution-oriented
• Proactive and responsive
• Customer-focused
• Commercially minded
• Structured and detail-oriented
• Comfortable working autonomously
• Capable of building trusted professional relationships
• Eager to deepen your knowledge of CNC machine technologies
• Able to remain calm and effective when priorities change or rapid action is required
