For our client in the food industry, located in the Oudenaarde region, we are looking for an Order Picker who is willing to work in a 3-shift system.

Your responsibilities 

 
• You collect products from the cold and hot production lines and store them in the correct location in the refrigerator. 
 
• You label products correctly and register batch numbers, expiry dates and returnable packaging in MAPA. 
 
• You monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner. 
 
• You check incoming deliveries for quantity, temperature and condition, and register the information in MAPA. 
 
• You assist drivers with loading and unloading and correctly apply the FIFO principle. 
 
• You keep the warehouse, refrigerators and loading bays clean and tidy and ensure that returnable packaging is stored in the correct location. 
 
• You work an early, day or late shift – working hours vary depending on the schedule and the day. 

What are we looking for in an Order Picker?
 

 
• You have a good command of English. 
 
• You are comfortable working in a chilled environment of approximately 7°C. 
 
• You can operate an electric pallet truck and a reach truck. 
 
• You are flexible and available to work early, day and late shifts, including occasional Saturdays or Sundays. 
 
• You work accurately: quantities, temperatures, batch numbers and expiry dates must be correct. 
 
• You are able to maintain an overview when several orders need to be prepared at the same time and can determine which tasks should be given priority.

Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German. French is an asset.

Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, French, Dutch and German

Katoen Natie is a global leader in logistics and engineering, renowned for our innovative and sustainable solutions for complex supply chains. Our team of dedicated professionals works to enhance our processes and services. Are you ready to leverage your experience and expertise in a dynamic and growing company? • Maintain an organized and orderly workspace by placing goods in their designated locations.
• Conduct daily maintenance checks on the forklift and report any issues or damages.
• Actively contribute to the compliance with safety and health regulations in the workplace.
• Willingness to do fysical work.
If you are looking for a job in the harbour in a logistic envoirement, have no doubt and apply for this function!

• Minimum of 3 years of experience as a forklift operator.
• Thorough knowledge of forklift operations.
• Excellent understanding of safety and health regulations.
• Physically fit and capable of working in shifts.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Team player with effective communication skills in Dutch or English

Comecer is expanding its international Service Team! To strengthen our team in Belgium, we are looking for 
Field Service Engineers, preferably based in the 
Brussels–Leuven region. You will be employed by Orise NV 
(former Process Automation Solutions), based in Belgium, and part of ATS Corporation, while working closely with Comecer Netherlands BV and the wider Comecer team.
 

In this role, you will help install, maintain and support high-tech systems that play a critical role in the (radio)pharmaceutical and nuclear medicine sectors.
 

Comecer’s solutions are developed and manufactured in Joure (The Netherlands) and are used in complex laboratory environments worldwide.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you will be 
responsible for installing, servicing, and maintaining Comecer equipment at customer sites throughout Belgium. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance, ensuring that each system performs optimally and meets all operational requirements. In addition, you will provide 
training and technical support to end users, helping them understand and operate the equipment effectively. Throughout every assignment, you will communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal teams, representing Comecer as a trusted, solution-oriented technical expert.

What you bring
 

You bring hands‑on experience in repairing technical equipment and troubleshooting both mechanical and electrical issues. You are able to read and interpret electrical, pneumatic and mechanical drawings, and you have a background in electronics, electromechanics or mechanical engineering. In this role, strong communication skills and a customer‑focused attitude are essential, along with a willingness to travel within Belgium and occasionally abroad. You have an energetic, proactive and solution‑driven mindset.
 

Requirements:
 
 

• Technical degree at secondary or bachelor level (electromechanics, electronics or mechatronics). 

• Strong English and French skills; Dutch is an advantage. 

• Experience with PLC-controlled systems is considered as a plus. 

• Valid category B driving licence.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Data department builds and maintains both future-ready and traditional data platforms, tools, and services to ensure easy, secure data access. It empowers data consumers with self-service capabilities while upholding governance and quality standards.

The department delivers scalable, compliant, and user-centric data solutions to meet business needs. Within this framework, the Tribe designs and implements structured, optimized data stores for APIs, reporting, and analytics. They ensure compliance, security, and governance of data assets through modern data management practices, supported by high-quality documentation and tooling. Their mission is to enable reliable, scalable, and well-governed data consumption across the organization.

At BNP Paribas Fortis, you will contribute to innovation by designing advanced data pipelines and infrastructure that power AI, real-time analytics, and strategic decision-making as part of our digital transformation. 

As a Data Engineer, you will address challenges such as scalability, latency, and compliance, ensuring secure, high-quality data flows while collaborating in Agile teams. Your work will unlock data-driven insights, combining technical excellence with regulatory requirements to shape the bank’s future.

The Tribe Data Services comprises over 160 colleagues, organized into more than 10 squads, primarily based in Brussels, with some team members working nearshore or offshore.

AND IN DETAIL

As a Functional Data Engineer, you will:

• Build and maintain optimized data stores by designing, developing, and ensuring well-structured, high-performance data assets (e.g., databases) tailored for APIs, reporting, analytics, and BI tools.
• Enable data-driven decision-making by delivering reliable, accurate, and accessible data for business intelligence, reporting, and analysis services while maintaining related infrastructure.
• Collaborate with internal clients and teams as a trusted partner, understanding stakeholder needs, guiding them on data solutions, and working cross-functionally while adhering to Tribe methodologies and standards.
• Ensure compliance and risk management by strictly following data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR) and banking security policies, mitigating risks in data collection, processing, and storage to safeguard client and institutional data.
• Drive continuous improvement by proactively identifying opportunities to enhance data quality, efficiency, and innovation—whether through new tools, automation, or process optimizations—while aligning with business and regulatory requirements.
• Collect the data from the source and design it into models that will be used by developers.  In this role you are the bridge between the business needs and the developers. You translate requests into models that will be interpreted by the developers.
• Uphold data quality and governance by implementing validation rules, monitoring, and metadata management to maintain accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
• Support stakeholders and troubleshoot issues by resolving data incidents (e.g., broken pipelines, latency problems) and partnering with analysts, product owners, or business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions—such as creating self-service datasets or optimizing queries for reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• Education and experience:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT or engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
• Equivalent experience: minimum 3 years.  
• Hard skills:
• Working experience with databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL.
• Knowledge of SQL, including writing complex queries and performance tuning.
• Profound Knowledge of data warehouse (DWH) modeling (e.g., Kimball, Inmon, Data Vault).
• Understanding or knowledge of ETL tools like Informatica PowerCenter.
• Understanding of Big Data technologies such as Spark, Astronomer.
• Extended knowledge of PowerDesigner tool (or equivalent)  
• Soft skills:
• Problem-solving mindset: ability to troubleshoot complex data issues and propose scalable solutions.
• Collaboration: strong team player with experience in cross-functional Agile teams.
• Ownership and accountability: takes responsibility for data quality, delivery timelines, and system reliability.
• Communication: ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Continuous learning: stays updated on emerging data technologies.  
• Languages:
• You communicate fluently in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an asset.

jobs.description:
Are you a true foodie who has always dreamed of working in the food industry?

Do you have experience in production and are you ready to turn your passion for snacks into a career? Then we are looking for you!

As a production hero at our food company, you will be responsible for producing the tastiest snacks available.

From mixing the perfect ingredients to controlling the production process, you are the key to our success.

You think it is something for you?

Call Konvert Food Roeselare on the number 051 24 56 29

What we expect from our new production hero:
 

 
• Experience in food production is a plus! (School leavers are also possible!!)
 
• Problem-solving ability
 
• Passion for good food and an eye for quality
 
• Willingness to work in night shift (21h-5h)
 
• Fluent knowledge of English!

What type of breed are we looking for? 
 

Our D2C channel is where we meet pet parents directly. No middleman, no shelf to fight for. It's how we build real relationships with the people (and pets) who love our food.
 

And it's not a side project. Our webshop is a serious business in its own right, representing a significant share of everything we sell, with a subscription base, a real tech team behind it, and years of compounding growth already on the clock. You'd be stepping into something that works, with the mandate to make it considerably bigger.
 

We're looking for a 
D2C & Digital Product Manager to own the roadmap that gets us there. You'll lead our Digital Product Team (2 full stack developers, a data engineer and product designer) and report directly to our Head of D2C.
 

You won't own the P&L. You'll own the roadmap that drives it, which in practice means you decide what we build, in what order, and why.
 

What is in your bowl? 
 

Own the roadmap that drives the channel
 

You decide what we build next and what waits. That means holding a clear point of view on where the growth actually is, translating it into a prioritised roadmap, and defending it when six good ideas arrive in the same week. You'll be measured on whether the channel grows profitably and sustainably, not on how many things got shipped.
 

Turn first-time buyers into a pack that stays
 

First purchase, subscription, loyalty. That's the journey, and it's yours to design end to end. Every step where a pet parent hesitates, churns, or quietly stops caring is a step you get to fix. CAC, LTV, AOV, retention and variable margin are the scoreboard, and CRM is one of your sharpest tools for moving them.
 

Own the campaign calendar
 

Product launches, seasonal moments, always-on lifecycle flows. You plan them, build them with your team, run them, and evaluate them honestly afterwards, together with Brand and Media.
 

Lead a team of four by example
 

Two full stack developers, one data engineer, one product designer. You'll set the direction, protect their focus, coach them, and raise the bar on craft. You won't be doing their jobs, but they should never feel like they're building for someone who doesn't understand what they do.
 

Keep us ahead on new technology
 

Including AI, and including whatever comes after it. You'll have an opinion on which new tools genuinely change the work and which ones are noise, and you'll put the useful ones in front of the team rather than in a deck.
 

Our stack 
 

We've built a headless shop on 
React + Shopify, with 
Klaviyo for CRM and lifecycle and 
Contentful for content. We design in 
Figma and the team runs on 
Notion. You don't need to have used all of it. You do need to be genuinely at home in a modern digital stack.

You're commercial to the bone. You can look at a roadmap and say which item moves LTV and which one just moves a ticket to Done. You've lived with numbers like CAC, AOV, variable margin, retention and forecast accuracy, and when one of them slips you know which lever to reach for.
 

You're hands-on in the engine room. You write the copy for the test yourself rather than waiting three weeks for a copywriter. You click through the feature before it ships. When the data doesn't explain the behaviour, you call a customer. Not because nobody else will, but because you want to know.
 

You've led a team of strong individual contributors. Developers, designers, data people. Specialists who are better at their craft than you are, and who can tell within a week whether you actually respect it. You've given them direction and honest feedback, protected their focus, and helped them get better at what they do. You'll be leading four of them from day one, so this one matters.
 

You live in the middle of Marketing, Design and Technology. You're as comfortable debating a campaign angle as you are reviewing a prototype or talking through a data model with an engineer. Those three worlds meeting is where you do your best work.
 

You prioritise like saying yes has a cost. Because it does. There will always be more good ideas than capacity, and you're the one who decides. You're comfortable being the person who says not this quarter, and explaining why.
 

You build brands, not discounts. You've seen what promo-led growth does to a business over time, and it doesn't excite you. What excites you is a customer who comes back because they love the thing, not because it was 20% off.
 

You know CRM is a craft, not a send button. You've built lifecycle programmes where the timing, the segment and the message all earned their place. You can tell relevant communication from noise, and so can your customers.
 

You get people around you moving without needing the org chart. Brand, Media & Partnerships, Logistics and Finance all have their own plans. You create clarity, you build the shared one, and people follow it because it makes sense.
 

You care about pets. Edgard and Cooper were real dogs, and everything we make still starts from one question: is this actually good for the animal eating it? You need to care about that answer. Ideally you live with a cat or a dog yourself and know exactly how it feels when the food runs out on a Sunday evening. For us this is essential, not a nice-to-have.
 

You bring 5+ years of experience in D2C, e-commerce or digital product, and you're 
fluent in Dutch and English.

Your expertise in the Belgian insurance market, on a long-term assignment with a software vendor serving the country’s leading insurers.

Our client is an international software vendor whose insurance division develops a modular solution covering the entire insurance value chain: distribution, policy management, claims and accounting.

What makes it stand out? A human-sized Belgian team on the insurance side, backed by an international organisation and by product and development teams of several thousand people.

€63,000–€95,000 gross/year · Hybrid (2 days on-site per week, at client premises or company office; 3 days from home) · Permanent, full-timeThe systems that track assets, flag maintenance needs and inform mission readiness do not run on gut feeling, they run on clean data and sharp analysis. As Analytics Engineer you will split your time between being embedded at a defence customer site as part of a structured Forward Deployed Engineer team and contributing to the Product Engineering Team, turning raw operational data into the dashboards and insights that operational teams actually rely on. The rotation structure means you carry real on-site ownership while a full team provides backup and coverage; you are not alone.

Your Mission

• Own the SQL layer end-to-end, from raw source data through to production-ready models, with performance and maintainability as the standard.
• Build and maintain analytical and dimensional models that underpin asset tracking, maintenance workflows, readiness reporting and mission planning, datasets that operational teams act on, not prototypes.
• Author and publish dashboards and views in close cooperation with client stakeholders, translating operational requirements into analytical deliverables that are clear, accurate and fit for a defence environment.
• Apply Python for data transformation, lightweight analysis and integration glue work, keeping pipelines reliable and documented.
• Elicit and interpret requirements directly from French- and Dutch-speaking client teams when forward deployed, then translate those needs into concrete analytical outputs.
• Own testing and technical documentation during on-site rotations, with clean handover to the wider engineering, testing and documentation teams between deployments.
What success looks like

Over time, the client teams you support will reach for your dashboards first because the data behind them is trustworthy and the models are built to last. Requirements you gather on-site translate cleanly into working deliverables. Domain experts recognise that you understood what they needed — not just what they said. The components you build are documented well enough that the wider team can maintain, extend and take them into operational use without relying on your recall.

What you bring

• Production-grade SQL, complex transformations, modelling and query optimisation, not basic retrieval.
• Practical Python scripting for ETL, data transformation, analysis and automation; this is not a software engineering role, but the code you write must be clean and maintainable.
• Analytical and dimensional modelling at mid-to-senior level — this is the core technical differentiator for the role.
• Dashboard authoring experience in at least one BI or analytical tool; you will work with proprietary tooling here and ramp up on it after joining, so transferable experience is what counts.
• Consulting and requirements-gathering skills, when forward deployed you are the primary client interface, and the ability to elicit, interpret and translate operational requirements is essential.
• Professional working proficiency in French, Dutch and English — you will conduct requirements discussions in both French and Dutch and coordinate in English; all three are required for delivery and this is not flexible.
• Git discipline and comfort working in structured, security-conscious environments with the composure that client-facing work in defence demands.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role (we support candidates through the clearance process).
The language requirement and clearance eligibility are firm; for everything else, we consider the overall strength of your experience.

Nice to have

• Experience working with logistics, maintenance, asset-management or defence-operations data.
• Prior experience with Oracle or PostgreSQL in a data modelling or transformation context

You decide how you work. Prefer fixed days every week? Great. Rather work different shifts depending on your schedule? That's perfectly fine too.
 

What will you be doing?
 

As part of our kitchen team, you'll help bring every dish to life:
 
 

• Assisting with the preparation of ingredients and dishes 

• Grilling and preparing meat and fish 

• Helping with the finishing and plating of dishes 

• Ensuring every plate looks as good as it tastes 

• Supporting your colleagues during service 

• Maintaining cleanliness and hygiene standards throughout the kitchen  

Our goal is simple: every plate leaves the kitchen looking irresistible and comes back completely empty.

Who are we looking for?
 
 

• You're motivated and eager to learn 

• You enjoy working as part of a team 

• You can stay focused, even during busy services 

• You have a good command of English 

• Additional languages are always a plus 

• Experience is welcome, but certainly not required  

Whether you've spent years behind the stove or can barely tell a whisk from a spatula, we'll provide the training you need to succeed.

Join our Global Support Network (Gsn) and help ensure the reliability and availability of our healthcare IT solutions used by customers around the world.

As a Senior Support Engineer / Domain Expert, you will solve complex technical problems in business-critical customer environments, working closely with regional support teams, Cloud Operations, Professional Services, Product Management, Quality, and R&D. You will combine deep technical troubleshooting with strong customer engagement and take ownership of issues through resolution.

Beyond resolving incidents, you will help us prevent them by identifying recurring problems, improving our monitoring and observability capabilities, sharing knowledge, and contributing to more proactive and predictive support.

What you'll do

 
• Solve complex technical problems:
  
   
• Diagnose and resolve complex incidents affecting enterprise healthcare IT solutions.
   
• Take end-to-end ownership of technical issues and drive them toward resolution.
   
• Analyze logs, metrics, diagnostics, and system behavior to identify root causes.
   
• Coordinate technical activities across teams during critical customer situations.
   
• Communicate findings, recommendations, and resolution plans clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
  
 
• Be a technical expert:
  
   
• Build and maintain deep expertise in our products, technologies, and solution architectures.
   
• Provide advanced technical guidance to support teams around the world.
   
• Work across enterprise applications, operating systems, databases, networking, integrations, cloud, and containerized environments.
   
• Collaborate with R&D and other specialists on challenging technical issues and escalations.
  
 
• Prevent tomorrow's incidents:
  
   
• Identify recurring issues, technical trends, and systemic problems and contribute to root cause analysis and corrective actions.
   
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our monitoring and observability platform, helping us identify emerging issues proactively, prevent incidents, and improve the reliability of our customers' environments.
   
• Turn lessons learned into technical documentation and reusable knowledge.
   
• Contribute ideas that improve product quality, support processes, automation, and operational efficiency.
  
 
• Help the team and our services grow:
  
   
• Share knowledge and mentor colleagues across our global support organization.
   
• Contribute to the operational readiness of new releases, upgrades, and customer deployments.
   
• Represent customer needs and operational experience when collaborating with Product Management, R&D, Quality, and other stakeholders.
   
• Explore opportunities to use automation and AI-assisted diagnostics to improve customer outcomes.
  

What will help you succeed

You enjoy solving difficult technical problems and are comfortable when the answer is not immediately obvious. You combine technical curiosity with a strong customer focus and

 
• Take ownership and follow problems through to resolution
 
• Communicate complex technical topics clearly
 
• Remain effective in high-pressure customer situations
 
• Collaborate well across teams, cultures, and geographies
 
• Enjoy sharing knowledge and helping others succeed
 
• Bring a continuous learning and improvement mindset

Fluent written and spoken English is required; additional languages are an advantage. A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, or a related discipline is preferred, although equivalent professional experience...

We are looking for someone with:

• 3 to 5 years of experience in technical customer support, enterprise software support, healthcare IT, or a comparable technical role.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, ideally gained in business-critical or mission-critical environments.

• A good understanding of enterprise application architectures, networking, operating systems, databases, and system integrations.

• Hands-on Kubernetes experience, including supporting and troubleshooting containerized applications and environments.

• Hands-on AWS experience, with practical knowledge of cloud infrastructure, networking, monitoring, and operations.

• Experience analyzing logs, metrics, diagnostics, and other technical data to isolate complex problems.

• Experience working directly with customers and managing technical escalations.

• Familiarity with ITSM and ITIL-based support processes.

• Experience with healthcare IT is an advantage, but not essential.

PROJECT

You work within the multi-national research environment of the Department of Mechanical Engineering of the Royal Military Academy. As a university, we conduct research in various technological domains, including unmanned systems, land mobility, and landmines manipulations, aimed at enhancing user comfort. Our work balances the development of novel and beneficial applications with efforts to mitigate potential risks associated with these technologies. As a military research lab, we focus on applications in public security and Defense. Examples of practical applications include ground robots for detecting and neutralizing landmines, unmanned vehicles for patrolling tough complex conditions, and studies to improve vehicle and environmental conditions.

 

In this position, you will work alongside a large team of research engineers, each leading their own projects. Your role will be to assist in the implementation of various projects, by contributing to the related electro-mechanical aspects. Given our strong involvement in European-scale collaborative projects, you will punctually prepare and follow on-site test campaigns, mainly on military test sites in Flanders, sometimes abroad.

 

WHAT WE OFFER within the projects

• Highly varied job content, giving you the opportunity to work on a very wide range of novel electro-mechanical systems (air, ground, maritime) in a very international context. You will be deployed in a large variety of projects and will be required to work together with dozens of researchers and other technicians to reach objectives. To make this a bit more specific, you will be deployed as an example in these projects:
• TiPODS: To support the construction (steelwork, electronics, automation), commissioning, maintenance, and usage of a test facility for land vehicle tires testing.
• AURORA: To support the development of a new generation of demining robots with dual manipulators
• STRATUS: To develop novel drones that are composed maximally of EU-sourced & developed components
• Opportunity to work in and with an international & dynamic team of research engineers.
• The flexibility and freedom to innovate and bring your own ideas.
• The ability to have an impact and work on societally relevant topics. As an example: many of our research projects are currently seeking solutions for mine clearance in Ukraine.
• An employer that strives towards maintaining a good work-life balance for its employees.
• Training opportunities to get new practical skills and/or improve your current skills (potential example: machinery certifications, heavy trailer driving license, A2-pilot flying license).
• Possibility of travelling for field trials with partners.
MAIN TASKS

• Manufacture mechanical components for scientific research (machining, welding, etc.).
• Utilize specialized instruments (sensor installation, cameras, measurement devices, etc.).
• Conduct mechanical and electrical tests on test benches, ensuring compliance with international standards.
• Calibrate and test laboratory equipment for specific experiments.
• Actively contribute to all project phases, including metalwork, electrical/electronical work, technical drawing, and system assembly.
• Participate in test campaigns (including equipment preparation, maintenance, execution, and problem solving).
• Assist in procurement and maintenance of equipment (including repairs and calibration of instruments). 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

The applicant shall have a professional bachelor's degree in electromechanics (a level 6 qualification according to the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) or similar) and should have relevant experience in the field of electronics, metalwork, and mechatronics.

Explicitly, we are not looking for an academic profile but a technical professional profile!

 

This position is ideally open for experienced profiles (minimum 3 years of experience).

However, young graduates are also encouraged to apply.

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills:

• Proven experience with electro-mechanical systems and troubleshooting
• Knowledge of security measures to perform work related to electricity (certifiable BA4/BA5 or similar)
• Demonstrated ability to think outside the box and devise innovative solutions to technical challenges in the field (a "MacGyver" mindset). In other words, a problem solver
• Driving license B (or in the process of getting it).
 

¿RECOMMENDED¿ skills:

• Proven workshop experience and skills (ex: welding, electrical design, mechanical design, CNC, etc.)
• Proven experience with robotic systems and troubleshooting
• Training or experience in system integration
• Experience with electrical measurement devices
 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills:

• Experience in programming with Labview/ROS/Matlab/C++/Python
• Proficiency in 3D printing technologies and design software (CAD) for rapid prototyping and repairs
• Knowledge of PCB design and soldering
• Drone Pilot License can be an advantage and/or experience with flying drones
 

Personal skills:

• You are highly motivated (read proactive) to develop technical/workshop skills that are not yet mastered.
• You have a practical mindset, showcasing a hands-on approach to problem-solving.
• You take initiative, you are involved and result oriented.
• You are honest, loyal toward the institution and respect confidentiality.
• You improve the team-spirit and solve interpersonal conflicts. 
 

Other skills:

• The applicant shall have very good knowledge of French or Dutch (oral & written) and a minimum knowledge of (or be willing to learn) the other language (oral), since lots of campaigns will be performed in Belgium. This will be tested during selection.
• The applicant shall have good knowledge of English (oral & written), which will be tested during selection.
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher is likely to be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defense.
• The researcher will be working within the context of European Defence Fund projects. Due to this project framework, this position is only open for NATO / EU citizens.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium. 
CONTRACT

• Probable date of recruitment: 15 January  2027, in consultation with the applicant.
• Status: Full-time employment (38 hours / week) based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant).
• To be very clear: your contract will be open-ended, but the financing of the contract will be tied to a project that ends in Spring 2030. The financing of your contract beyond that period is therefore not 100% guaranteed. However, the RMA-MECA dept has a policy to keep the good elements and this position will in any case be required beyond that date as well, so if we're happy with you there is a high chance that we will offer you a follow-up beyond that date if you decide to stay.
• Wage scale: NBI1. RMA-Patrimony applies a merit-based research career track, allowing personnel to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations. Your bruto and netto salary can be simulated precisely via this tool: simulateur de salaire.
• Holiday pay.
 

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a BOSA test;
• End-of-year bonus;
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member);
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute);
• Meal vouchers (6€/day);
• Digital allowance: 15€/month;
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours;
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu);
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week;
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days/week max);
• Holidays: 
• 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years)
• 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays).
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...);
• Entitlement to services offered by the `Office Central d'Action Sociale et Culturelle de la Défense' (OCASC): among others holiday centres, discount on travel organised by the tour operator...;
• Possibility to benefit from the nursery funded by Belgian Defence (subject to availability).

For our client in Beernem, we are looking for an experienced tiler.
 

You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling
 
• A driving licence is required!
 
• You speak fluent Dutch or English
 
• You have a VCA certificate or are willing to obtain one

• You will pick goods for the customer based on an order form. Accuracy and attention to detail are very important.

• You will use a scanning system to pick the correct goods.

• You will also use a manual transpallet or an electric transpallet to move the picked goods.

• You will work independently according to imposed procedures.

• Knowledge of the Dutch or English language

• Eye for detail to accurately record numerical codes and perform quality checks

• Logistics insight

• Good physical condition to manually take the goods from the racks and place them on the transpallet

• You work in dayshift, starting at 08-9h or 10h

• Own transport or via Maxmobile from Gent-Dampoort Station

Opportunity

Hybrid (2 days on-site per week) · Permanent, full-time

About the role

You'll keep one or more defence software Squads moving, running ceremonies, clearing blockers, and turning Agile principles into daily practice, with senior Scrum Masters and Agile Coaches alongside you as you find your footing. This is a permanent role in a Spotify-inspired organisation (Squads, Chapters, Tribes), and the mentoring structure is a deliberate design feature, not a vague promise.

Your Mission

What you'll do

• Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, Retrospectives and Backlog Refinement, so your Squad leaves each session with clarity and a workable plan.
• Identify and remove impediments that slow delivery, escalating where needed and working with stakeholders to keep momentum.
• Partner with Market Product Managers on backlog refinement, sprint readiness and prioritisation so the Squad is always working on the right things.
• Collaborate with Tech Writers to make sure documentation is planned and aligned with sprint goals, not bolted on afterwards.
• Monitor team health and track Agile metrics, using what you learn to support continuous improvement in ways of working.
• Coordinate with other Scrum Masters, Chapters and stakeholders to surface and manage cross-Squad dependencies before they become blockers.
What success looks like

Over time, your Squads run ceremonies that feel purposeful rather than routine: the team arrives prepared, leaves aligned, and the retrospective actually changes something. Impediments get named early and resolved rather than accumulating. You start spotting dependency risks before they surface as problems, and your collaboration with Market Product Managers and Tech Writers becomes a natural part of the Squad rhythm rather than a coordination overhead.

 

What you bring

• Up to two years of experience in an Agile environment, as a Scrum Master, Project Coordinator, Business Analyst, QA or a comparable role where you worked alongside or within Agile ceremonies.
• Working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, conceptual fluency you can apply in a real Squad, not necessarily a certification.
• Facilitation and communication skills strong enough to keep a room moving and surface issues without creating friction.
• Organisational discipline to track dependencies and keep multiple moving parts visible.
• Ability to build working relationships across multidisciplinary teams, including people in technical, product and writing roles.
• Professional working proficiency in English.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role. ILIAS Solutions supports candidates through the clearance process and is glad to explain what is involved before you apply.
If you meet most of the above, we encourage you to apply. The eligibility requirement for the required security authorisation is not flexible.

Nice to have

• PSM I or CSM certification, if you already hold one, great; if not, that is fine.
• Hands-on experience in a Spotify-inspired organisation with Squads, Chapters and Tribes.
• Exposure to Agile metrics and structured retrospective or improvement practices.
• Familiarity with tools like Jira or comparable Agile board software.

jobs.occupation: Strategic Projects Lead - Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
About UsZymofix is a dynamic and innovative startup dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

The RoleAs Business Operations Associate your core role will be to take ownership of projects that matter, from first idea to finished result. The job is mostly project-based. One project might be a market study for a new crop or region, the next might be designing the layout of our new offices or setting up our company OKRs. 
You will often get a question with little more than a goal attached. We trust you to figure out the rest: to structure the problem yourself and to deliver work of a high standard.
 

What You'll DoYour main focus is on strategic and operational projects. You will:
 
 

• Take full ownership of company-wide projects, from scoping and planning to execution and follow-up. 

• Conduct market research and analyses, for example on new markets, crops, competitors or customer 

• segments, and translate findings into clear recommendations. 

• Set up and follow up on our company OKRs together with management and team leads. 

• Handle confidential information, such as financial, strategic and personnel matters, with discretion.  

As Zymofix grows, new projects will land on your desk.

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• You hold a master's degree in Bioscience Engineering (bio-ingenieur). 

• You are mature and discreet, and you know how to handle confidential information. 

• You set a high standard for the work you deliver: well thought out, structured and well presented. 

• You need few instructions to deliver a strong result. You structure a problem yourself, ask the right questions and take it from there. 

• You enjoy project work and are comfortable juggling several projects at once. 

• You have strong analytical skills and can turn research and data into clear, actionable conclusions. 

• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English, both spoken and written. 

• A first work experience, for example in consulting or a startup environment, is a plus.

• 
Testing & UAT: Coordinate testing and user acceptance with HR and business teams, ensuring issues are addressed before go-live.

•

• 
Risk & issue management: Identify risks, track mitigation actions and resolve or escalate issues.

• 
Change & rollout: Coordinate communication, training, business readiness and transition to operational support.

• 
Team leadership: Functionally manage up to five team members, including Business Analysts, developers and testers.

Required skills:

• 
At least 5 years of experience in IT project management in a business or industry environment

• 
Proven experience implementing business applications delivered by external suppliers

• 
Experience analysing RFP responses, evaluating supplier proposals and supporting solution selection

• 
Strong supplier management and coordination skills

• 
PMP, Prince2 or equivalent project management certification

• 
Strong stakeholder management, communication and executive reporting skills

• 
Experience managing budgets, planning, risks and project dependencies

• 
Ability to lead projects independently and coordinate business and technical teams

 

Preferred experience:

• 
Previous implementation of a Workforce Management solution or a similar HR application

• 
Knowledge of HR processes, particularly workforce planning, employee scheduling, time and attendance, and employee evaluations

• 
Experience with application integrations and data migration

• 
SAP knowledge is a strong plus

• 
A retail/Supply background is an asset

 

Education & languages:

• 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or equivalent

• 
Good understanding of current and emerging technologies

•

The R&I Policy Officer will support CLERENS in their work for the Batteries European Partnership Association (BEPA). BEPA represents the battery innovation community in Brussels, representing both industry and research members. BEPA is the private partner in the Horizon Europe Batt4EU Partnership with the European Commission.

In close cooperation with the Secretary General and other BEPA team members, the consultant will help BEPA transition from the current Horizon Europe framework to the new R&I ecosystem that will come with the new EU budget. The R&I Policy Officer will bring strong technical expertise in batteries to support multiple BEPA Technical Working Groups and/or Task Forces. These working groups range in size from 50 to almost 200 battery experts and prepare the official inputs given by BEPA to the European Commission on the strategic direction of battery research within the Horizon Europe Programme and beyond.

Main Duties:

¿            You lead the operational management of BEPA Working Groups and Task Forces, working alongside chairs and co-chairs to ensure outputs are delivered on time. You own the agenda, drive discussions, present updates, and coordinate the dissemination of information.

¿            Support, together with the Secretary General and Executive Director, the monthly meetings of the Executive Board meetings, by preparing and following up on the strategic decisions taken;

¿            Contribute, in terms of content and organisation, to BEPA events, like the General Assembly and the Battery Innovation Days, and smaller events like technical workshops and matchmaking events;

¿            Actively engage with the BEPA members. Follow up on enquiries by current members, engage with prospective members by conducting proactive outreach activities and welcoming new members into the organisation;

¿            Support the BEPA Communication Officer by providing content for BEPA publications (e.g. newsletter, website, social media, etc.);
 
¿            University or advanced degree (doctorat) in battery or electrochemical engineering, electrochemistry, (battery) materials science, or a closely related technical field.

¿            In-depth technical knowledge of the battery sector: battery science, cell chemistry, materials, manufacturing, and system integration, combined with a solid understanding of the industry landscape, markets, value chains, and key players.

¿            Between 3-5 years of relevant experience in battery or energy-related R&I, whether in industry, a research institution, or a European association; experience with EU-funded innovation projects is an asset.

¿            Good knowledge of the workings of the European Union, in particular in the sphere of research and innovation (Horizon Europe); previous experience engaging with EU institutions or R&I policy is an asset.

¿            Ability to quickly grasp new topics and process information effectively, and to put thoughts into actions quickly.

¿            Ability to communicate effectively, both orally and in writing, with attention to detail.

¿            Capacity to collect, organise and analyse quantitative and qualitative data.

¿            Ability to plan and work independently, manage stress, multiple deadlines and effectively prioritise workload.

¿            Fluency in English is necessary; any additional European language is an asset.

¿            Proficiency in MS Office applications is a must; acquaintance with other software is a strong advantage.
 
¿            The opportunity to work for a great European initiative concretely supporting the clean energy transition.

¿            A challenging, multi-faceted role in a dynamic team with room to grow and take on additional responsibilities.

¿            A stimulating and dynamic international environment.

 

Applications

To apply, please send a motivation letter and CV in English to the HR Manager, Eftychia Michailidou at hr@clerens.eu with ¿BEPA - R&I Policy Officer¿ in the subject line.

 

Be aware that applications are reviewed continuously upon arrival; therefore, applying as soon as possible is advisable. Due to the expected high number of applications, only short-listed candidates will be contacted for interviews.

About Us: 
 

Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

 
 

Job Description & Key Responsibilities:
 

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Production Technician to join our microbial production team. In this role, you will play a key part in producing beneficial microorganisms used in biostimulant, biocontrol, and biofertilizer products that support healthy crop growth. Training will be provided, so prior microbiology experience is not required — though it's a plus. Curiosity and attention to detail matter most.
 

 
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• You independently carry out production tasks according to standard procedures: you prepare supplies, sterilize, inoculate, harvest and handle downstream processing. 

• You work under sterile conditions and strictly follow hygiene and sterility protocols, giving contamination no chance. 

• You safeguard product quality at every stage by performing in-process quality and sterility checks.

About UsZymofix is a dynamic and innovative startup dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating innovative, effective, and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high levels of productivity. Positioned at the forefront of innovative and sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to cultivate healthy products and enhance their yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

 
 

Job descriptionWe are looking for a hands-on and detail-oriented Accounting, Controlling & Billing Officer to join our growing team at Zymofix. You will play a key role in keeping our financial operations running smoothly and accurately as we scale.
 

The ideal candidate combines solid accounting knowledge with a strong controlling mindset and a keen eye for accurate billing and invoicing. You thrive in a dynamic startup environment where initiative and versatility are valued. You will work closely with management and act as the go-to person for financial administration, controlling, and billing.
 

The role requires strong organizational skills, a high degree of autonomy, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
 

 
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 

• Manage day-to-day accounting tasks including accounts payable/receivable, invoicing, bank reconciliations, and expense tracking. 

• Own the billing cycle end-to-end: generate and send customer invoices, monitor payment terms, follow up on outstanding balances, and resolve billing discrepancies. 

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports and support the annual audit process. 

• Develop and maintain controlling processes, including cost tracking, margin analysis, and variance reporting against budget. 

• Ensure compliance with local tax regulations and assist with VAT filings and other statutory obligations. 

• Support budgeting and forecasting processes in close collaboration with management. 

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records in the accounting system. 

• Monitor cash flow and support working capital management. 

• Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, and reporting efficiency. 
 

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 

• Minimum 2–3 years of relevant experience in an accounting, controlling, or billing role. 

• Solid knowledge of Belgian accounting standards and VAT regulations. 

• Proficiency with accounting software (e.g., Allegro or similar) and MS Office (Excel in particular). 

• Experience with Notion is a plus. 

• High level of accuracy, discretion, and organizational skills. 

• You are a proactive self-starter who can work independently in a fast-moving environment. 

• Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail, particularly around numbers and financial data. 

• Excellent communication skills, verbal and written in Dutch and English (French is a plus).

Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative startup dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. Job Description & Key Responsibilities
 

We are looking for a Pilot Plant Technician with a critical mindset to join our team. You will be responsible for:
 
 

• Operating, maintaining, and analyzing the existing pilot plant installations, covering substrate production, the fermentation section, laboratory analysis, and downstream processing 

• Production of fermentation substrates using a novel thermophysical pretreatment system. 

• Cultivation of microorganisms in several pilot-scale solid-state fermenters. 

• Managing and maintaining the equipment/machine park, carrying out both preventive and reactive maintenance, including troubleshooting technical issues. 

• Assisting with small-scale construction projects (e.g. installing drying ovens, cleanroom ventilation), sometimes coordinating with external contractors. 

• Providing onsite assistance for larger new-build projects as the pilot plant expands.  

 
 

 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• A technical bachelor's degree, or equivalent through relevant experience; a degree specifically in (electro)mechanics, biochemistry, or a related field is a plus. 

• Strong mechanical aptitude, troubleshooting skills, and basic electrical knowledge; basic knowledge of engines/motors is an additional asset. 

• The ability to read and interpret technical documents, equipment manuals, and process diagrams. 

• Strong problem-solving abilities and a hands-on approach to technical challenges. 

• Willingness and ability to work safely in hazardous environments (chemicals, high-pressure systems, pilot plants), with strict adherence to safety protocols; proven experience in this area, with a track record of promoting a safety-first culture and taking ownership of on-the-spot hazard assessments, is a plus. 

• Experience with lab analysis and working with microorganisms; knowledge of fermentation processes and hygiene practices is a plus. 

• Fluency in English, both verbal and written; fluency in Dutch is a plus.  

The role requires strong technical skills, a high degree of independence, and the ability to collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team. You draw energy from collective success.

Job introduction

When was the last time you translated a business need into a technical solution that could change an entire organization? That’s exactly what you’ll do with us!

As a Senior SAP Development Lead at delaware, you truly understand what businesses need and how we can deliver it. You’re eager to take the lead in transforming ideas into innovative solutions, guide customers through their move to SAP S/4 HANA, and add value to their business processes.

If development is in your DNA and you’re ready to take on a leading role, then you may be the Senior SAP Development Lead we’re looking for.

Who are we?

Did you know delaware is Belgium’s biggest SAP integrator? This means we get to work with the latest SAP technologies, such as all S/4 HANA deployments, SAP Fiori, SAP Cloud Platform services like ABAP Environment, iRPA, HANA Cloud, API Management, and the SAP Business Technology Platform. Enough with the name-dropping though — you probably already know your way around these technologies! And if you don’t, we’ll happily guide you through them .

We are the SAP Development team. We’re a fun-loving and ambitious team with a strong group dynamic. Even though there are more than 60 of us, we’re still a very tight-knit bunch! We love going for drinks together and we organize the best team events. It’s in our nature to coach our teammates: seniors happily share knowledge with newer members of the team (and vice versa). So what’s it like to work with us? ‘Unique,’ ‘adventurous,’ and ‘challenging’ are just three of the words team members have used to describe their experience. Read our stories here.

We have a broad spectrum of projects and customers in a wide variety of sectors and across the entire range of SAP modules. We also offshore development work to our colleagues in Harbin (China), but it’s up to the development lead to decide which tasks stay with us and which are sent to China.

Just so you know: delaware has offices in Antwerp, Ghent, Kortrijk, Lummen, Liège, and Wavre, but we also spend a lot of time working with our customers on-site. We also offer the flexibility to work from home.

Is there a match?

 

• As a Senior Development Lead, we expect you to have more than 3 years of experience in SAP development. You know your way around the ABAP Platform, Adobe Forms, oData services, Fiori configuration, Eclipse ADT, and more; and how they can add value to business processes. Any supplementary knowledge is a plus.
• You have a strong desire and the capacity to turn business requirements into technical solutions.
• Leadership is your strong suit. Your hands-on, no-nonsense approach means you can provide clear guidance to development teams, both in Belgium and abroad.
• You are cut from the right consulting cloth: you’re proactive and a good communicator who combines the drive for results with flexibility and an understanding of the coordination of development trajectories, both in and outside SAP.
• Dutch  is either your native language or you’ve become fluent over your professional career. You can communicate clearly in English.

Who we are looking for 

We are looking for a Senior Data Protection Advisor to integrate our Privacy & Data Governance BU.

The current business dynamics are unprecedented for this department, which is multiplying ambitious projects all over Belgium. In other words, Approach is a major player in Data Protection and Data Governance and is quickly evolving.

 

We are therefore actively looking for people who have the ambition to participate in the development of the data protection department at Approach, while advising clients from various sizes and sectors, helping them improve their privacy and risk management maturity, providing top-notch legal expertise as well as governance recommendations. 

You will have the opportunity to grow your expertise by getting acquainted and/or certified in recognized INDUSTRY and privacy STANDARDS (ISO 27001, ISO 31700, Europrivacy certifications, etc.) with our experts, and advise clients on the latest legislative frameworks.

 

Your role and responsibilities

 

You will join a small team with all levels of seniority. You will integrate your field of action within a more global cybersecurity approach. Therefore, you could rely on the knowledge of your expert colleagues with both technical and legal backgrounds.

 

You could:

• Provide high value services to customers in the light of Approach’s data protection offering/business:
• Bring your knowledge and energy on different steps of data protection projects, autonomously or within the team.
• Advise on all aspects of data privacy.
• Participate in the development of Data Privacy Impact Assessments (DPIA) and supervise their implementation.
• Monitor compliance with the international and local data protection legislations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, e-privacy directive, Data Governance Act, …)
• Drive privacy compliance audits.
• Train employees involved in data processing activities.
• Liaise with national Supervisory Authorities (SA’s)
Use your energy, your proactivity, and your smile to develop our Privacy & Data Protection business unit by (for example):

• Actively contributing to the development of tools and methodologies used by your team.
• Sharing your knowledge about sector news to your team.
• Contributing to develop a business/commercial approach towards potential customers.
• 
Following and coaching junior colleagues on your specific expertise.

 

Your profile

You have :

• Recognized Data Privacy Officer certification OR any other training, certifications, Executive Master, … in the frame of data protection or cybersecurity.
• Minimum 5 years’ experience in a similar function (DPO, Assistant DPO, Privacy officer, legal counsel, …)
• Good understanding of Information Risk Management and methodologies
• Interest in Data Protection technologies and how they link to Data Privacy
• English and Dutch is a must have. Bilingual (FR/NL) is a plus.
• True communicator with Business level communication skills: to make complex legal or data protection concepts easy to understand by a business or a technical audience, and to interact with C-level, to work with legal, GRC and IT departments, to challenge technical implementations and to understand business needs.
Considered as a plus:

 

• Ability to understand senior management considerations (strategic level) and ability to help them in their decision.
• Good understanding of ISO27000 standards
• Experience in risk assessments as assessor or contributor
• Exposure to security audit, as auditor, auditee, remediation owner
• Exposure to (security) incident response and crisis management
Mindset:

 

• Willingness to provide high quality deliverables and to go the extra mile.
• Project oriented by being dedicated to the client’s objectives and give advice.
• Teamplayer
• Manage diverse workloads and prioritize accordingly.
• Ambassador for the professional values that are at the heart of our philosophy:
TOP-NOTCH: We strive for best-of-the-best while staying up to date with the latest technology.

HUMAN-CENTRIC: We care about people in the digital world, listening before interacting respectfully in a responsible environment.

NO-NONSENSE: We go for it, we work together, we are committed to deliver, to exceed expectations.

Your Role and responsibilities
 

We are looking for an Information Security Consultant to join our Security Strategy & Advisory business unit.

 

You will be part of a diversified team with all levels of seniority. You will integrate your field of action within a more global cybersecurity approach. Therefore, you will also benefit from the experience of our 100 experts to teach you the needed skills and make your career take off.

If you want to take a role in a human centric company who put efforts in developing its collaborators, there is a place for you here. Thanks to our Cyber Academy and the support of your own Career Counsellor, Approach puts your skills’ growth at the center of its activities.

As a pure player in cyber security, we take the position of a strategical partner to help our clients securing their information, while providing our consultants many varied opportunities across the whole security roadmap.

Through this wide perspective, our Information Security Consultants advise our customers on how to improve their cybersecurity maturity and resilience. We assist our clients during the whole security journey, from assessing the current state, to proposing security improvements and managing implementation and changes.

Concretely, as an Information Security Consultant, you could:

• Provide high value services to customers in the light of Approach’s Information security offering/business:
• Perform security and risk assessment at client (e.g. perform our ACAM® (Approach Cybersecurity Assessment Methodology) to evaluate their cybersecurity maturity.
• Implemente information security management systems (ISMS), governance, risk management, based on regulations and standards.
• Be the driver of change to manage, coordinate or pilot security projects in line with the decisions.
• Propose security improvements, define priorities and create security roadmaps to follow.
• Accompany your client through the change management process.
• Develop and implement plans to anticipate, address, and mitigate the effects of various business interruptions
• Provide CISO or assistant-CISO services to our customers (i.e. provide strategic and technical advise, organizing the information security related activities, supporting customers to manage security incident(s), …)
Use your energy, your proactivity, and your smile to make our Security Strategy & Advisory business unit grow by (i.e.):

• Actively contributing to the development of tools and methodologies used by your team.
• Sharing your knowledge about topic news to your team (e.g. market needs, trends, technology evolutions that impact information security, …)
• Contributing to develop a business/commercial approach towards potential customers.
• 
Following and coaching junior colleagues.

 

Your profile
 

You have:

• A first relevant experience in Information/IT Security in a similar function
• Knowledge of regulatory and/or sector specific standards and frameworks (e.g. ISO27000, NIS2, DORA, SOC2, CIS Critical Security Controls, ...)
• Ability to understand senior management considerations (strategic level) and ability to help them in their decision.
• English and Dutch is a must have. Bilingual (FR/NL) is a plus.
Considered as a plus:

 

• Recognized Information Security certifications like ISO27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, ISO27005, EBIOS, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, COBIT, ITIL, CCSK
• Exposure to ISMS operation or implementation, cloud security projects, Third-Party risk management projects, business continuity plan (BCP) or disaster recovery plan (DRP), security assessments, security incidents, crisis management, awareness activities, …
Mindset :

 

• Willingness to provide high quality deliverables and to go the extra mile.
• True communicator with Business level communication skills: to talk and negotiate with different customers’ stakeholders at both technical and business level; to lead a security project and be able to explain it to technical and non-technical audience; to perform trainings and conduct meetings with customers’ stakeholders
• Project oriented by being dedicated to the client’s objectives and give advice.
• Teamplayer

• Uncompromised integrity: respect for the confidentiality of both client and company information
• Ambassador for the professional values that are at the heart of our philosophy:TOP-NOTCHHUMAN-CENTRICNO-NONSENSE

Who we are looking for
As an Application Security Analyst, you will integrate our Secure Software Development practice. Together with our 20 experts, we develop, maintain, support and host Specialized Software. Our expertise is two-fold: 

• Proposing our expertise to clients’ development teams in securing their Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC or Secured-SDLC).
• Developing highly secured softwares (Security by design) based on customer’s requirments (e.g. itsme – authentication app) ;
In this frame, we are recruiting an Application Security Analyst who will play a key role in our application security services growth over the next few years.

 
Your role
As an Application Security Analyst your role is to carry out security assessments on applications used by our customers. Based on the results of the assessment, you will propose security recommendations. These are short-, medium- and long-term solutions that will serve as the basis for building an application security roadmap for the company.

Depending on your qualifications, you may be required to implement these recommendations in terms of processes, tools and developer trainings (security champions, awareness).Your main contacts at the customer will be the CISOs and their security teams.

Your tasks will consist of:

• Assess an existing SDLC (i.e., SAMM Assessment but we stay open to other methodologies we’ll define together),
• Give guidance on establishing a secure software development lifecycle (Secure-SDLC / DevSecOps),
• Help development teams to integrate application security best practices (e.g. OWASP ASVS), and security tooling/processes in their development pipeline (SAST, DAST, SCA, CVE follow-up, ...),
• Give training and coaching sessions to new security champions at client. 
• Participate in presales meetings around application security.
The role will evolve to include the following tasks and responsibilities in the short term, depending on your experience and evolution pace.

You will then bring your energy on Solution Owner responsibilities like: 

• Mentorship and support: Providing guidance and mentorship to team members, especially those in junior positions, will be crucial. Your support will help them navigate complex missions, leading their professional growth and ensuring successful project outcomes.
• Technology watch: You will follow new tools, technical evolutions and industry trends, and share your knowledge with the team. This proactive approach will ensure that our offerings remain cutting-edge, relevant, and aligned with our clients’ ever-evolving needs.
• Relationships strengthening with our trusted business partners/suppliers: You will be our key representative in application security associations, or during application security events/conferences/meetings.
• Asset creation: Developing new assets and methodologies to complement and enhance our solutions will be part of your responsibility. These assets and methodologies will not only increase the efficiency of our solutions but also support and empower your colleagues in delivering high-quality results.
 

Your profile
 

• You hold a Bachelor or Master degree.

Introduction
For one of our fastest growing practices we are looking for a Data Quality Assurance Specialist. 

Do you have 3 to 5 years of experience of which at least 2 to 3 years in the field of data analysis and/or data quality? And the prospect of helping to grow a company that believes in together creating an impact with Data at our customers sounds good? 

Then we are delighted to receive your personal application and we’ll contact you for an interview and a (virtual) cup of coffee.

 
Your responsibilities
• Support clients in the execution of activities of the data quality cycle: data analysis, data quality assessment, impact assessment, etc. Allowing them to independently monitor, prevent and remediate emerging critical data quality issues.

• Proven success in contributing to a team-oriented environment.
• Excellent leadership, communication (written and oral) and interpersonal skills.
• Fluent in Dutch and/or French and English.
 
Skillset
• Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Proficiency in SQL supplemented with at least one other scripting language (e.g., Python, Groovy, R, etc.)
• Experience with Data Quality tooling.
• 
Experience with data governance solutions (Collibra, Datahub, Purview, etc.) is a plus.
