You will play a pivotal role in designing, deploying, and scaling cloud-based AI and data solutions, leveraging Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and modern DevOps practices. Your expertise will help us deliver robust platforms and services for a wide range of client projects, ensuring security, scalability, and operational excellence. 

Responsibilities 

• Architect and design cloud solutions and platforms (Azure), translating business needs into scalable, secure, and cost-effective architectures. 
• Automating everything related to the ML lifecycle to ensure efficiency and scalability. 
• Using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices, such as Bicep, to manage and provision resources through code. 
• Implementing best practices for continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, ensuring that ML models are reliably deployed to production environments. 
• Collaborate with data scientists, AI engineers, and business stakeholders to define requirements, select technologies, and deliver end-to-end solutions. 
• Challenge our existing security and reinforce our defenses 
 

Profile

• Master's degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or related field. 
• At least 2 years of experience in data engineering, data science, or related roles. 
• Proficient in Python. 
• Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services, including IaC (Bicep), CI/CD, and cloud security. 
• Knowledge on containerized deployment of ML products – e.g. docker, podman, Kubernetes 
• Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. 
• 
Fluent in English. Dutch and/or French is considered as a plus.

Who are we?

In today’s digital world, organizations need to shift their approach to cyber security. Prevention alone is no longer sufficient. The ability to rapidly detect and respond to threats is essential. Organizations are increasingly turning to trusted strategic partners who can fully unburden them in the domain of detection and response.

That’s where we come in. We offer MDR as a value service to a broad spectrum of customers across different verticals – all equally exciting.

Based in Belgium and the Netherlands, we help companies navigate the digital era and make data-driven decisions with confidence. We proudly serve clients in the top 200 across the Benelux, spanning a wide range of fascinating and diverse sectors.

At Davinsi Labs, we love to inspire each other, collaborate closely, and pursue excellence together. We are building a workplace where fulfillment and happiness take center stage.

Your mission: what can you expect from the job?

You will join our Managed Detection & Response (MDR) teams with a strong focus on security automation and orchestration. As a Security Automation Engineer, your primary responsibility is to design, build, and maintain automated response capabilities using Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR.

Your work will directly impact how efficiently and consistently security incidents are handled across complex customer environments. You will help scale our MDR service by translating detection signals into automated, reliable, and auditable response workflows.

We strongly believe in SOAR as code: automation content is version-controlled, tested, and continuously improved.

You will contribute to and integrate with the following technologies:

• Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR
• Microsoft Defender XDR and other XDR platforms
• SIEM platforms (Microsoft Sentinel and others)
• ITSM platforms (ServiceNow and equivalents)
• Cloud, identity, network, and third-party security tooling
Key Responsibilities

Security Automation & Playbook Development

• Design, build, and maintain response playbooks in Cortex XSOAR for common and advanced security incidents.
• Translate detection alerts from SIEM and XDR platforms into automated investigation and response flows.
• Implement conditional logic, enrichment steps, human-in-the-loop approvals, and automated containment actions.
SOAR as Code

• Manage playbooks, integrations, scripts, and content packs using version control (Git).
• Apply software engineering best practices such as modularity, reusability, testing, and peer review.
• Contribute to standardized automation frameworks that can be reused across customers.
Platform Integrations

• Build and maintain integrations between XSOAR and:
• SIEM platforms o XDR / EDR solutions
• ITSM tools (incident creation, updates, closures) o Identity, network, and cloud security controls
• Troubleshoot and optimize integrations for reliability, performance, and scalability.
Incident Response Enablement

• Collaborate closely with Detection Engineering and Incident Response teams to define:
• Automated investigation steps o Response actions and containment strategies o Escalation and handover points to analysts
• Continuously improve response quality based on real incident feedback.
Automation Lifecycle Management

• Maintain and evolve our automation content library.
• Tune playbooks to reduce noise, false positives, and manual 

Hello, is it me you’re looking for?

• You are passionate about IT security and automation, with several years of relevant professional experience.
• You have hands-on experience with SOAR platforms, preferably Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR.
• You are comfortable building response playbooks and automations end-toend.
• You strongly believe in automation as code and have experience with Gitbased workflows.
• Basic system engineering knowledge (Windows, Linux, networking, identity) is a plus.
• You have experience integrating security platforms such as SIEM, XDR, EDR, IAM, or ITSM tools.
• You understand security operations and incident response processes.
• Experience with scripting (Python, JavaScript) is a strong plus.
• You communicate smoothly in Dutch and English (written and oral). French is a plus.
• 
You are analytical, structured, and not afraid to challenge existing processes to improve them.

With 
20 vessels and 165 colleagues, Plouvier operates a modern inland tanker fleet across Europe. We are looking for an experienced QHES professional with a strong background in 
ADN, dangerous goods and inland tanker operations.

ADN Safety Advisor, you will play an important role in maintaining regulatory compliance and continuously improving QHES standards across our fleet.

ADN and applicable inland shipping regulations.

• Acting as

• Monitoring regulatory developments and translating them into clear procedures. 

• Conducting and reviewing 
risk assessments, work permits and safety procedures.

SIRE/VIQ, BIQ, TMSA, OCIMF and ADN audits and inspections.

ADN and dangerous goods. 

• Experience in

• A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

• Experience with SIRE/VIQ, TMSA or OCIMF is an advantage.

jobs.description:
As a truck mechanic, you’ll be responsible for performing accurate diagnostics and repairs on trucks, with a strong focus on DAF vehicles. You see electrical malfunctions as challenges, read wiring diagrams with ease, and work according to the latest technical guidelines. You communicate clearly with customers and manufacturers about your work and support our branch in Herent when needed.

Your day starts in a fully equipped workshop where you collaborate with a young, dynamic team. You begin by planning the necessary repairs, running diagnostics with advanced equipment, and ensuring every truck is safe and ready for the road. You coordinate colleagues and provide technical support, helping the whole team deliver top results.

Ready to take the next step in your career as a mechanic? Apply today and let our enthusiastic team guide you as you grow and thrive!

• You have a technical diploma (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience

• A bachelor’s degree in automotive technology is a plus

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in the automotive sector

• You have basic knowledge of electronics and experience with wiring diagrams

• You can work independently and take responsibility

• Experience in leading a team is an advantage

• Good command of English is required

• A C(E) driver’s license is an asset but not required

This is a unique opportunity for you to join as an Airbus First Officer on an enhanced salary package with an accelerated command upgrade scenario.
 
 

• You will need to operate the right-hand seat for a minimum of 700 stick hours and successfully complete two Evidence Based Training (EBT) recurrent training modules. 

• Assuming you meet the standards and display the required level of performance, you will then be eligible for accelerated command via an assessment process and an upgrade course. 

To join our Accelerated Command program, you will need the following experience:
 
 

• Minimum of 5,000 hours total flying time (excluding P3, rotary and single/multi-engine piston aircraft) 

• Minimum of 2,000 hours command time on Boeing/ Airbus FBW types 

• Minimum 1,000 hours command time on Airbus FBW 

• Airbus FBW type flown within the past 3 years 

• Minimum 150 hours in past 12 months on Airbus FBW/Boeing 

• Valid ICAO ATPL with matching Authority Class 1 Medical 

• ICAO English Level 5 or above  

*Airbus FBW excludes A220

Are you a motivated and technically proficient pilot who delivers excellence?
 

We’re looking for Direct Entry Captains to join our growing team. To become one of our A350 or A380 Captains,
 
 

• you will need a minimum of 7,000 hours total flying time in multi-crew, multi-engine aircraft (only time in the operating seat of a turboprop and/or turbojet aircraft is counted; simulator time is excluded). 

Qualification
 

To become one of our Airbus Captains, you will need: 
 
 

• Minimum 7,000 hrs total flying time (excluding P3, rotary and single/multi-engine piston aircraft)  

• Minimum 150 hrs in past 12 months on Airbus FBW as a Captain  

• A valid ICAO ATPL with a matching Authority Class 1 Medical  

• ICAO English level 5 or above  

For A380:
 
 

• Minimum of 3,000 hours PIC on Airbus FBW wide-body (A330/A340/A350/A380) 

• You must currently be flying on Airbus FBW wide-body as a Captain   

For A350:
 
 

• Minimum of 3,000 hours PIC on any Airbus FBW (
A320/A330/A340/A350/A380) 

• You must currently be flying on Airbus FBW as a Captain   

*Airbus FBW excludes A220

For a charming Christmas decoration store in the historic centre of Bruges, we are looking for a full-time Sales Associate who enjoys customer contact and creating a warm shopping experience.

What will you do:

• Welcoming customers and assisting them with their purchases

• Advising customers on Christmas Decorations, ornaments and gifts

• Keeping the store tidy and visually attractive

• Replenishing shelves and displays

• Operating the cash register and handling payments

• Helping with deliveries and unpacking new products

• You speak English and/or Dutch

• Flexible and willing to work weekends

• Previous experience in retail or sales is a plus

Headit is looking for an English- and French-speaking Sales Support Administrator for the Middle East & Africa regions.
 

Where will you be working?You will join an international company based in Belgium, whose headquarters are located in the Aartselaar area. It is a forward-thinking organization that is fully committed to the future. Team spirit, collaboration and a positive working environment are central to the company culture.
 

Your responsibilities as a Sales Support Administrator:
 
 

• Act as the first point of contact for customers in your regions 

• Inform customers about import regulations and legislation, including shipping terms, transportation methods, payment terms, customs-related documentation, etc. 

• Coordinate the entire order-to-cash process 

• Work closely with Sales, Supply Chain and Operations to ensure that all orders are processed correctly 

• Organize export shipments: book and coordinate shipments, manage transport and customs documentation, invoicing and delivery follow-up 

• Monitor order parameters and inventory levels to ensure sufficient stock availability 

• Optimize shipments by configuring optimal loading plans 

What does your profile look like?
 
 

• You hold a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or have initial relevant experience in a similar B2B customer service, logistics or supply chain role 

• Strong collaboration and communication skills, enabling you to build long-term relationships with internal and external stakeholders across multiple countries 

• Highly organized and administratively skilled, with good knowledge of MS Office applications 

• An understanding of and/or strong interest in logistics (export, etc.) and supply chain processes 

• Very fluent communication skills in both French and English

I-Coats
 

I-Coats NV is an internationally active SME, founded in 2006 and based in Berchem (Antwerp), Belgium. With a team of approximately 10 employees, the company develops and commercializes innovative overlay finishes and coatings for ropes, nets and steel cables. Through production partners, its products are supplied worldwide to customers across Europe, the United States, Canada, China and Korea. With an annual turnover of €6 million and 90% export activity, 
I-Coats is a dynamic and internationally oriented company with strong growth ambitions.
 

To strengthen the team, we are looking for an experienced and technically strong: 
Project Manager
 

Your role 
 

In this role, you will take a leading position in the development of coatings for customer-specific applications, operating at the intersection of R&D and practical implementation. You will act both as a technical expert and as a project lead, playing a key role in translating customer needs into high-performance and innovative coating solutions.
 

As 
Project Manager, you will be end-to-end responsible for the development and implementation of tailor-made coatings for industrial applications.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• Develop advanced coatings in co-creation with customers, tailored to their specific applications and requirements. 

• Analyze technical challenges and translate them into concrete development and testing trajectories. 

• Work closely with the laboratory team in setting up, executing and interpreting tests. You will evaluate coating performance and make adjustments based on test results and customer feedback. 

• Identify new applications and innovation opportunities with both existing and prospective customers. 

• Ensure a smooth transition from laboratory results to effective production and closely monitor the implementation process. 

• Safeguard technical know-how and actively contribute to the further development of expertise within 
I-Coats’ product niche. 

• Report directly to the Technical Director.  

Your profile
 
 

• You hold a higher technical degree in a relevant field (preferably a Master’s degree in Chemistry, Materials Science or similar). 

• You have several years of experience in an R&D, application engineering or project-driven environment within a multidisciplinary context. 

• You have a strong affinity with coatings and chemical formulations. 

• You combine technical knowledge with a pragmatic mindset and a strong focus on applicability. 

• You work in a structured manner and are capable of independently managing complex projects. 

• You communicate clearly and professionally with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

• You speak Dutch very well. 

• You have a good command of English and solid knowledge of MS Office applications such as Excel and Word.

As Foreman of the Spacer Production ZZ department, you are responsible for coordinating and supervising the production process. You provide operational leadership to a team of approximately 5 operators and ensure that production runs smoothly and according to quality standards and production targets.

You monitor the production schedule and progress and ensure the efficient use of employees, machines and materials. You perform quality checks, monitor process parameters and take corrective action when necessary.

You are also responsible for maintaining a safe working environment and ensuring compliance with safety and environmental regulations. You collect and analyse production data such as output, quality and productivity and report this information clearly to the Production Manager.

From a technical perspective, you carry out minor repairs, identify when components need preventive replacement and independently perform complex machine changeovers

• 
Good technical knowledge.

 
• 
Practical and hands-on approach.

 
• 
Interest in machinery and willingness to work alongside the production team.

 
• 
Natural leadership skills and the ability to lead by example.

 
• 
Good communication skills in Dutch and English.

 
• 
Ability to train and guide operators according to their knowledge and experience.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving skills.

 
• 
Ability to make decisions under pressure.

 
• 
Stress-resistant and able to remain calm in challenging situations.

 
• 
Good planning, organisational and prioritisation skills.

• Be very customer and service oriented.

jobs.occupation: Senior R&D Specialist - Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy
jobs.description:
About you and this role
 

At Dow, our Analytical Science organization plays a critical role in accelerating innovation, supporting manufacturing excellence, and solving complex technical challenges across our global businesses.
 

The Analytical Science team in Seneffe is a key part of this global network, providing world-class analytical expertise to support research, product development, process optimization, and customer-focused innovation. Leveraging advanced analytical technologies and deep scientific knowledge, the team partners closely with R&D, manufacturing, and commercial organizations to deliver impactful solutions across a broad range of material science applications.
 

We now have an exciting opportunity for a 
Senior R&D Specialist – Nuclear Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy to join our Analytical Science division in 
Seneffe, Belgium.
 

In this role, you will apply advanced analytical techniques to solve complex challenges in industrial chemistry and materials science. Working closely with global R&D, manufacturing, and business teams, you will provide critical insights that support product development, process optimization, manufacturing excellence, and customer-focused innovation.
 

As a subject matter expert in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, you will lead analytical investigations, develop new measurement methodologies in a world class NMR lab with global resources, and enhance existing analytical capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate across a diverse global network while supporting multiple high-impact projects simultaneously.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Lead analytical investigations to resolve complex technical, product, and manufacturing challenges. 

• Develop, optimize, and implement advanced NMR methodologies to expand analytical capabilities. 

• Manage and maintain state of the art NMR instrumentation including cryoprobe technology. 

• Interpret complex analytical data and provide technical leadership on projects involving materials characterization, process optimization, and product performance. 

• Drive innovation through the application of advanced analytical techniques and scientific problem solving. 

• Share technical expertise, mentor colleagues, and contribute to capability building within the Analytical Sciences community. 

• Ensure delivery of high-quality analytical results while managing multiple priorities and project timelines.  

Qualifications
 
 

• Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Polymer Science, Materials Science, Biochemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. 

• Demonstrated expertise in Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectroscopy including method development and advanced applications, for example in multidimensional solution-state NMR, pulse programming, solid-state NMR, and/or DNP-NMR. 

• Strong knowledge in at least two of the following areas: analytical chemistry, polymer science, organic chemistry, materials science, coatings or formulation science, chemical processing, polymer characterization, or statistics/data analysis. 

• Proven track record of applying analytical science to solve complex technical challenges. 

• Experience supporting research, product development, manufacturing, or process optimization programs. 

• Fluency in English, both written and verbal. 

• Additional language skills, preferable French, Dutch, Italian, Spanish or German are an advantage.  

Additional Notes
 
 

• This position does not offer relocation assistance 

• Please submit your application in English to be eligible for consideration in the selection process.  

 

Benefits – What Dow offers you
 

We invest in you.
 

Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
 

Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
 
 

• Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives. 

• Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it. 

• Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals. 
 

• Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).   

• Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only). 
 

• Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.   

• Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations. 

• Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building. 

• Workplace culture empowering role-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs. 

• Competitive yearly vacation allowance. 

• Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents). 

• Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured. 

• Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation. 

• Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey. 

• On-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location). 

• Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more. 

• Additionally, some of our locations might offer:

The Associate Operations Manager for Supply Activation & Acquisition plays a pivotal role at Wolt. As Central scales at an unprecedented pace, your mission is to keep courier supply ahead of demand - both in the moment and over the medium term. You will be responsible for leading and mentoring a team of 3, ensuring that intraday activation (weather-driven boosts, DxGy and ARC / radius adjustments) and courier acquisition (job boards, application attainment, reactivations and sign-ups) are tightly coordinated across all Central markets.

Your ability to translate data into fast, defensible calls will be key to keeping Central's ADT, UH% and GOV loss on plan.

What you'll be doing

 * Own Central's intraday activation strategy - activation surges, special events management and day-to-day operations (radius / busyness adjustments, communication flows, etc.) - to keep courier supply matched to demand hour by hour.

 * Lead and mentor a team of 3 and own a multi-million euro activation and acquisition budget across Central markets.

 * Own Central's courier acquisition function: job boards, application attainment, reactivation campaigns and sign-ups.

 * Own and report on Central's UH% and GOV loss KPIs weekly, surfacing risks and driving corrective action with senior leadership.

 * Plan and execute mobilizer strategies and special events coverage (holidays, weather events, local events) ahead of demand spikes.

 * Partner with Support, Product and Global Delivery Ops to build tools and processes that scale activation and acquisition across markets.

 * Serve as the primary point of contact for top management on Central's supply health.

Our humble expectations

 * Proven track record managing complex, data-driven operations across multiple markets, ideally in courier / gig supply, logistics or marketplace operations.

 * Comfortable owning hard KPIs (UH%, GOV loss) and being accountable for the numbers, not just reporting them.

 * Experience leading and developing a small team (3 direct reports).

 * Strong budget ownership experience - able to allocate and defend a multi-million euro spend across activation and acquisition levers.

 * Excellent ability to distill complex operational trade-offs into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

 * Comfortable working under time pressure during weather events, special events and demand spikes.

 * Fluent English skills in both spoken and writing.

jobs.description: 1 Master Thesis "Differentiable Ray Tracing for Radio Propagation Modeling" - JOB ID: 269596  * Differentiable ray-tracing frameworks such as Sionna RT have become powerful tools for wireless channel modeling. Candidates should explain in their cover letter how their background matches one of these areas and demonstrate relevant expertise. * You have solid programming skills in Python; experience with object-oriented software development is an advantage. * You have a basic understanding of electromagnetics, wave propagation, wireless communications, or computer graphics. * Knowledge of ray tracing, geometric optics, optimisation methods, or machine learning is beneficial but not required. * Experience with scientific computing frameworks (e.g., NumPy, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Sionna) is a plus. * You enjoy developing algorithms and solving challenging scientific and engineering problems. * You are able to work independently while collaborating effectively in an interdisciplinary research team. * English language skills commensurate with the roleWhat to expect: * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months * Start date: as soon as possible - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week. * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results. * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities). HRC1854084

Your role

You have already gained experience in product management and are looking for a career opportunity where you can shape the commercial success of a power semiconductor portfolio? Key responsibilities in your new role

 * Develop and evaluate pricing and structures for released products within the 750 V/1200 V OBC and DC/DC converter product portfolio

 * Provide product forecasts and define the final market introduction plan during the commercialization phase of the product portfolio

 * Develop market introduction and go-to-market activities at product level

 * Support the development and execution of product and production strategies, including optimization programs, product transfers, and discontinuation processes

Your profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

 * A degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline

 * At least 3 years of professional experience, preferably in product management within the semiconductor industry

 * Knowledge of semiconductors, especially power electronics, is an advantage

 * An energetic mindset combined with a structured and self-organized working style

 * Excellent English communication and presentation skills; German is an advantage

We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. jobs.occupation: Staff Network Reliability Engineer (f/m/d) / 1610 (Site Reliability Engineer)
jobs.description: About IONOSAt IONOS, we don't just manage servers – we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure – from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.NRE Operations runs the data center networks for the entire IONOS group: the physical fabric and underlay, the SDN overlay, and the virtual network functions on top, across dozens of data centers. We are looking for a senior or staff-level engineer who operates large production networks with a reliability mindset. You define what "healthy" means, catch problems before customers do, lead the hardest incidents, and partner with NRE Automation to push routine operations toward zero manual steps. AI is central to how we work, both to make the network smarter and to make each engineer faster.We expect every engineer here to be fluent with AI, and we mean it in two concrete ways. First, applying AI to the network itself: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis and root-cause analysis, config generation and validation, smarter alerting, and runbook or agent-driven automation. Second, using AI to raise your own output: coding assistants and LLM tooling for scripting, troubleshooting, research, and documentation. Reliability work punishes blind trust, so the skill that matters most is judgment. You need to know when an AI-generated config or diagnosis is trustworthy and when it is not.Tasks- Own reliability of the physical fabric, SDN overlay, and virtual network functions across all IONOS data centers. Set service level objectives and drive down unplanned downtime.- Lead incident response on major network incidents and run postmortems that produce lasting fixes.- Remove toil through automation, working with NRE Automation on pipelines and tooling for lifecycle, patching, and service configuration.- Apply AI to operations: anomaly detection, automated diagnosis, config generation and validation, and automated remediation, with the judgment to know when AI output is trustworthy.- Strengthen observability so problems surface before they reach customers, and shape lifecycle, upgrade, change-management, and capacity practices.- Collaborate with NRE Provisioning on clean handovers.- Share the on-call rotation covering the above.Qualifications- Extensive hands-on experience operating large-scale production data center networks (5+ years for Senior, longer for Staff).- Deep Layer 2 and Layer 3 knowledge: routing (BGP, OSPF) and VXLAN with BGP/EVPN.- Multi-vendor operations across Juniper and Cisco; SONiC and Netbox familiarity is a plus.- Strong Linux fundamentals and the toolkit that goes with them (bash, tcpdump, iptables, git).- Network automation you have built, using Python with Ansible and CI/CD on GitLab.- A reliability-engineering mindset: SLOs, observability, incident command, postmortems, designing out toil.- Fluent, critical use of AI in daily engineering, plus a track record or credible ideas for applying AI to network operations.- Fluent English for international teams; German is a plus. Ownership and a calm approach when things break.Benefits- Hybrid working model.- Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.- At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.- Modern office space with very good transport connections.- Various employee discounts for activities and products.- Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.- Numerous training and development opportunities.- Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

jobs.occupation: Doctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in the Collaborative Project SiProtect (Molekularbiologe/-biologin)
jobs.description: Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN)  headquartered in Frankfurt am Main is seeking to fill the following position at its Senckenberg German Entomological Institute (SDEI) in Müncheberg  starting as of 1 January 2027Doctoral Researcher (m/f/d) in the Collaborative Project SiProtect(part time, 65%)Location: Müncheberg (Brandenburg)Employment scope: part-time, 65% (26 weekly working hours)Type of contract: ideally starting on 01 January 2027; fixed term until 31 December 2030Remuneration: collective agreement of the German Länder, TV-L E 13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.Located east of Berlin, the Senckenberg German Entomological Institute (SDEI) is situated on a modern science campus. An international team of scientists conducts insect research, complemented by an information centre with archive and library.About the projectExploring insect communities with molecular tools. How do crop resilience strategies affect insect communities - and how can molecular technologies help us monitor these changes directly in the field?As a PhD Researcher in the collaborative project SiProtect, you will investigate insect communities associated with rye and contribute to the development of innovative approaches for species identification and biodiversity monitoring.SiProtect explores how amorphous silicate (ASi) can strengthen rye resilience to biotic and abiotic stressors, including insect pests, associated pathogens and drought. Your research will connect field-based entomological monitoring with molecular identification, metabarcoding and portable nanopore sequencing.A particular focus will be the development and validation of a low-cost, portable molecular laboratory based on Oxford Nanopore MinION technology. The resulting workflow aims to accelerate species identification under field conditions and provide a transferable approach for sustainable crop protection and biodiversity monitoring.Your tasks- Plan and conduct entomological research activities within the SiProtect research programme, with a focus on insect communities associated with rye- Conduct standardised insect monitoring using Malaise traps, pan traps, sticky traps and sweep netting- Identify collected insects using morphological and taxonomic approaches and contribute to a reference database for rye-associated insect communities- Establish, optimise and validate metabarcoding approaches for bulk insect samples and compare their performance with conventional identification methods- Portable sequencing: Develop and validate a low-cost, portable molecular laboratory based on Oxford Nanopore MinION sequencing for rapid field-based species identification- Develop and apply computational pipelines for molecular species identification and insect community analysis- Assess responses of pest and beneficial insect communities to rye resilience strategies and integrate morphological and molecular monitoring data- Contribute to interdisciplinary research within the SiProtect consortium and develop new approaches for sustainable crop protection and biodiversity monitoring- Publish research findings in international journals and present results at scientific conferences and project meetingsYour profile- Completed Master’s degree in entomology, biology, ecology, molecular biology, biodiversity research or a related discipline- Good knowledge of the major insect orders and families of the German fauna and experience using taxonomic identification literature- Basic practical experience in molecular biology, ideally including DNA extraction, polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and gel documentation- Interest in and ideally initial experience with DNA barcoding, metabarcoding or molecular species identification- Basic programming skills in R and/or Python- Experience handling dried or ethanol-preserved entomological specimens is an advantage- Ability to organize research activities independently and work in a structured and reliable manner- Strong communication skills and an interest in interdisciplinary and collaborative research- Valid Class B driving licence and willingness to undertake fieldwork- Good written and spoken English, German skills are an advantageWhat you can expectThis position offers the opportunity to combine field entomology, molecular biology, metabarcoding, nanopore sequencing and bioinformatics within an interdisciplinary research project. You will contribute to a scientifically relevant question at the interface of crop resilience, biodiversity and sustainable agriculture, while developing a transferable methodological approach for field-based insect monitoring.We look forward to welcoming a curious and collaborative researcher who is keen to develop new methods and contribute their own ideas to SiProtect.We offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.Would you like to apply?If so, please upload your complete and detailed application materials (cover letter, current resume, copies of your educational and employment certificates, if available) in electronic form as a single PDF file by 22 November 2026  to the careers page on our website:https://www.senckenberg.de/de/stellenanzeigen/﻿Please note that applications for this position can only be accepted if they are submitted via our online application portal. This ensures that your application is processed correctly and can be considered as part of the selection procedure. Applications sent by email to the recruiting team or directly to individual staff members cannot be considered.For data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/For further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung please visit www.senckenberg.deContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainIf you have any technical questions regarding the position, please feel free to contact Dr. Lara-Sophie Dey at lara-sophie.dey@senckenberg.de.For any questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact us atrecruiting@senckenberg.de.

jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day You join a team that is being built right now. Transformation of Industry is setting up a dedicated Function Controlling for the first time, and you are part of it from the start. On 25 August 2026 Siemens Energy announced preparations for the legal and operational separation of Transformation of Industry into a standalone company, a fast-growing business with around 17,000 employees, €6 billion of revenue and a double-digit profit margin. Headcount, external spend and project costs have moved, and the functional leadership team needs a clear view of the financial impact. A new company is being built, and with it a new Finance organization: the central Business Controlling team of Transformation of Industry is developing into the Corporate FP&A department of that company, an organization of more than 100 finance professionals. knowledge of SAP, Power BI, SAC or comparable tools is a plus* Fluent English; additional languages are an asset but not requiredAbout the TeamOur Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. Transformation of Industry does not yet have a dedicated Function Controlling — you are the person who builds it, for a functional cost base estimated at more than €600 million. You define the operating model, the cost center and manpower steering logic, the reporting cadence and the standards that the functions will be steered by, and you build the team that runs them.You are not starting from an empty page. A part of the team will transfer into the new unit, so you begin with experienced colleagues who know the business, the processes and you grow the team around them. Siemens Energy's corporate Function Controlling team supports you closely on top of that, so you can build on proven methods and standards rather than invent everything yourself.The timing makes the task unusually rewarding. On 25 August 2026 Siemens Energy announced preparations for the legal and operational separation of Transformation of Industry into a standalone company, a fast-growing business with around 17,000 employees, €6 billion of revenue and a double-digit profit margin. A standalone company needs its own function cost transparency from day one — and few finance leaders get the chance to shape a controlling discipline that does not exist yet, with experienced colleagues behind them, for a company that is coming into existence around them.Your second role is that of Finance Business Partner to the corporate functions — IT, HR, Communications, Legal & Compliance, Procurement and Finance among them. You are the financial counterpart their leaders turn to, and just as importantly you develop your own people into that role: a function controller who only reports numbers is not yet a business partner, and getting the team there is one of your central tasks.You are joining the central Business Controlling team of Transformation of Industry at a moment when it is preparing to evolve towards a Corporate FP&A department for a future standalone company, potentially bringing together more than 100 finance professionals. We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly’s operational and analytical systems.This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.What you will do- Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.- Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.- Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.- Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.- Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.- Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.- Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.- Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.What we are looking for- Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.- Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.- Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.- Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.- Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.- Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.- Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.- Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.Useful experience, but not required- DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.- Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.- GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.- Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.- Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.- Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.What we offer youAt Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.- Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.- Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.- Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.- Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.- A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.About SmartlySmartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Direct experience with every technology listed here is less important than the judgment to learn, reason from first principles, and ship useful platform capabilities.About SmartlySmartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.Visit Smartly (http://smartly.io/)  to learn more.The processing of your information is described in our Candidate Privacy Notice (https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/67ed4ab7f914accf87aa070c/698a11cb716926c1d76c1641_Smartly.io%20Group%20-%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Candidates%20-%201_2026.pdf) .

In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support simulation and modeling capabilities around the innovative DeckFinder product, the global standard for Automatic Take-off and Landing (ATOL) solutions, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for anIntern within Simulation and Modeling (d/f/m)Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Simulation Engineer (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in optimizing our simulation environment as an intern (d/f/m)!- Location: Taufkirchen- Start: February 2027- Duration: 6 months- Your locationOur site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. You also participate in Hive through our VSOP, so you share in the value you help build.Über unsWe work in deep-tech and dual-use technology, an industry where women and other underrepresented groups have historically had limited access. We build RF communication and orchestration systems for unmanned platforms across air, land, sea, and space, at a moment when European technological sovereignty is a real strategic question, not an abstract one.- Real ownership, real deployment. We, the Max Planck Institute for Medical Research, are one of 85 institutes and research centers of the Max Planck Society (MPG) for the advancement of science. Our focus is on basic medical research. We currently employ around 270 people in science and administration, mainly at our location in Heidelberg. Another location for our institute is currently being established in Heilbronn. We are also part of the Health + Life Science Alliance Heidelberg Mannheim, an association of the region's leading life science research institutions.The MPG strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. As the MPG has set itself the goal of employing more people with severe disabilities, applications from people with severe disabilities are expressly welcome. In addition, the MPG wants to increase the proportion of women in areas where they are underrepresented. Women are therefore expressly encouraged to apply.The female reproductive tract is a highly dynamic system in which tissue mechanics, active forces, and fluid flow interact with cellular and physiological processes. Yet, how these physical properties contribute to reproductive function remains poorly understood.Within the ERC Starting Grant project REPROMECH – Quantitative Mechanics of the Oviduct: Force, Flow, and the Physiological Operating Point, our group investigates how forces and mechanical properties shape the function of the female reproductive system. We combine approaches from reproductive biology, mechanobiology, and experimental biophysics to quantitatively characterize living tissues across cellular and tissue scales.The doctoral project will investigate the mechanical properties of the female reproductive tract and their relationship to tissue function.Tasks- Quantification of mechanical properties of the female reproductive tract using complementary mechanical measurements and advanced microscopy- Preparation and culture of ex vivo tissue samples- Histological characterization of biological samples- Quantitative image and data analysis- Critical analysis and interpretation of experimental resultsProfile- You hold a Master’s degree or equivalent in reproductive biology, developmental biology, biology, biophysics, physics, bioengineering, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, or a related discipline.- We are looking for a candidate with strong experimental aptitude, excellent practical laboratory skills, manual dexterity, and a quantitative and analytical mindset.- You should enjoy technically demanding experimental work, be able to interpret complex data critically and rigorously, and be motivated to work across disciplinary boundaries.- Willingness to work with laboratory mice and to complete the required laboratory-animal training is essential.- Previous experience in reproductive biology, experimental biophysics, microscopy, or work with laboratory animals is advantageous but not required. Candidates with a background in reproductive biology and an interest in quantitative and biophysical approaches are particularly encouraged to apply.- Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English are required.Our offerThe position is funded for an initial period of three years within the ERC Starting Grant REPROMECH, with the possibility of extension, and is available from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible.We offer a vibrant international research environment, access to state-of-the-art infrastructure for quantitative microscopy and mechanobiology, and opportunities for scientific training and conference participation.Remuneration: 75% of pay group E13 under TVöD Bund.We look forward to receiving your application, including a cover letter, curriculum vitae, copies of relevant degree certificates and transcripts, and contact details of two academic referees. Applications must be submitted electronically via the application portal (https://bewerbermanagement.net/en/jobposting/5572b068e91236d723de14e45b3737686f35fab70/apply) by 1 November 2026.For further information, please contact Dr. Stephanie Möllmert (stephanie.moellmert@mr.mpg.de (https://mailto:stephanie.moellmert@mr.mpg.de) ).For general questions, please contact Ms. Julia Gauglitz (julia.gauglitz@mr.mpg.de (https://mailto:julia.gauglitz@mr.mpg.de) ) from human resources.

jobs.occupation: Senior Electronics PCB & ECAD Design Engineer - RF & Mixed Signal (m/f/d) (Forschungs- und Entwicklungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description: RoleHive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.As our Senior Electronics Hardware Engineer, you own our electronic designs end to end: from requirements through schematic capture, PCB layout, and manufacturing release to bring-up and debugging. You take a hardware requirement and independently turn it into a robust, manufacturable PCB assembly, spot problems early, and keep projects moving without waiting for direction. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. Most importantly, you enjoy designing hardware yourself and seeing it ship. You report into our CTO organization.Bring-up, rework, and close work with mechanical, firmware, and production happen hands-on in our Munich office, so we expect you on site most days of the week.ResponsibilitiesSchematic & PCB Design- Own electronic hardware designs from requirements to manufacturing release, including schematics and design reviews- Select components based on performance, availability, lifecycle, cost, and manufacturability- Place and route multilayer boards, and define stack-ups, design rules, controlled-impedance requirements, and layout constraints- Review designs for manufacturability, reliability, EMC, signal and power integrity, and thermal behavior where relevant- Design with certification in mind: support EMC and radio (CE/RED) pre-compliance and certification testing with external labs, and feed the findings back into the designECAD Libraries & Engineering Data- Create and maintain schematic symbols, footprints, padstacks, and ECAD libraries- Define and maintain electrical, physical, and manufacturing design rule sets- Keep engineering data clean: design documentation, revision history, and versioning that let anyone pick up a design later and improve it- Improve engineering workflows and automate repetitive tasks where it pays offManufacturing & Supply- Generate, review, and release manufacturing outputs and technical documentation- Work directly with PCB fabrication and PCBA assembly partners on stack-ups, fabrication constraints, assembly guidelines, and production requirements- Review BOMs and qualify alternative components based on availability, lifecycle, and technical requirements, together with Operations- Make sure designs scale from prototype runs to serial production volumesBring-up, Test & Integration- Bring up, debug, and validate boards, including burn-in testing, soldering, and rework- Work closely with mechanical and embedded firmware engineers through design, integration, and bring-up- Reproduce and qualify hardware issues from production and the field so they get fixed at the root cause- Handle sensitive and export-controlled design data in line with our dual-use export control requirementsRequirementsYou do not need to tick every box or master every topic from day one. If the core is there and you have the drive to grow into the rest, we want to hear from you.Must Have- 5+ years of professional experience in electronic hardware and PCB development- Degree in electrical engineering, electronics, or a comparable technical foundation- A track record of independently taking PCBs from schematic to manufacturing release: boards you designed that went into production- Strong schematic design and component selection skills, working confidently from datasheets- Strong PCB layout skills on multilayer and high-density boards, including blind and buried vias, built on a solid understanding of grounding, power distribution, differential interfaces, controlled impedance, and high-speed design- Practical understanding of PCB fabrication and PCBA assembly, including direct work with manufacturers on stack-ups, fabrication rules, assembly requirements, and production issues- Hands-on lab skills: board bring-up, debugging, lab equipment, soldering, and rework- Strong experience in at least one professional ECAD environment, such as Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, Siemens Xpedition, or comparable. - Ownership mindset: you drive designs forward without continuous supervision, and an undocumented design change is a problem for you, not a shortcut- Fluent English (German is a plus)- Willingness to undergo security vetting where projects require it- Based in Munich or willing to relocateNice to Have- Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, which our existing products are built on- Experience with BOM management or component lifecycle tools- RF and wireless electronics or communication systems, the core of what we build- Ethernet and high-speed digital interfaces, power electronics, or embedded systems- EMC/EMI-conscious design and experience taking products through EMC and radio certification (CE/RED)- Electronics for robotics, UAVs, or other ruggedized systems, ideally in defense, aerospace, or another regulated environment- Connector selection, wiring harness, and pinout definition- Scripting or engineering automationAbout usWe work in deep-tech and dual-use technology, an industry where women and other underrepresented groups have historically had limited access. We encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box below.Why Hive- Build sovereign technology that matters. We build RF communication and orchestration systems for unmanned platforms across air, land, sea, and space, at a moment when European technological sovereignty is a real strategic question, not an abstract one.- Real ownership, real deployment. Our products are already in serial production and in the field. What you build ships, and you see the result.- Small team, direct access. Around 30 people. You'll work directly with founders and not through multiple layers of management.- You shape the foundations. We're still building the structures, career paths, controlling, compliance, that let a fast-growing company scale well. You'll help decide what they look like.- Modern Munich office, with the tools and equipment to do your best work.What You Get- Compensation. We benchmark salaries to stay competitive for the market and the role, not just what an early-stage budget can spare.- Equity. You participate in Hive through equity/VSOP, a genuine stake in what we build, not just a paycheck.- A role you shape, not one you're handed. We're too early for fixed job descriptions or a career ladder. What you own grows as you take on more, not by climbing steps someone else defined.- No bureaucracy. Small, flat team. Decisions happen in a conversation, not a sign-off chain.Compensation and equity terms vary by role and level.Hive Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or marital status. Please don't include data on ethnic origin, political views, religious beliefs, union membership, health, or sexual orientation in your application.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Leiterplatten-Designsysteme (PCB-Design)

jobs.description: Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany. jobs.description: About Allianz Global InvestorsAllianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process.109407 | Asset & Investment Management | Professional | n.a. | Allianz Global Investors | Full-Time | PermanentThe Private Markets Solutions Team designs and manages diversified private markets portfolios across bespoke mandates and evergreen funds, translating client objectives and market views into allocation, portfolio construction and investment decisions. The team retains end-to-end responsibility for portfolio strategy, pacing, investment decisions and ongoing portfolio steering. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.The PositionWe are looking for a Technical Specialist (m/f/d) for the Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC), based in Mannheim (Germany)*. On a daily basis, we support numerous customers from seven countries and provide remote, telephone and email support for inquiries, technical questions and complaints regarding our Roche analytical systems. That’s what moves us: Safe and easy routines for our customers means more patients we can help. We are proud of who we are, what we do and how we do it, with a clear goal in mind: Doing now what patients need next.The OpportunityOur international Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) is responsible for technical and application customer service for Roche analytical systems in in-vitro laboratory diagnostics. As an Technical Specialist (m/w/d), you will be the direct contact for inquiries from our customers in diagnostic laboratories and hospitals in the RCSC countries (Germany, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium, Greece and Turkey). Your main tasks are:* You will support our customers in hospitals and diagnostic laboratories in the Netherlands and Belgium as well as colleagues in the field by telephone, digitally and via remote connection and support them from the acceptance of technical product problems to the derivation of suitable measures for problem solving.* You identify the causes of product problems, work out solutions and initiate appropriate measures.* You carefully document your activities in the supporting customer relationship management (CRM) system.* You prepare product information and support the transfer of information to the customer and the exchange of knowledge within the organization.* *We are flexible as to where you work. Your place of work can be Mannheim (Germany) or Almere (The Netherlands). In any case, you will actively seek the exchange and cooperation with your colleagues at the RCSC in Mannheim* Occasionally, you conduct customer training sessions in the local language.* Occasionally, you support field service colleagues during on-site service visits to the customer lab.Who you are* You are fluent in Dutch/Flemish, and English. Ideally, you also speak German or another language such as Turkish or Greek.* You have successfully completed your engineering studies (e.g. medical technology, electrical engineering, mechatronics) or degree. Alternatively, you have trained as a technician or computer scientist plus professional experience.* Ideally, you have several years of experience in the medical-technical field, through technical customer support (field service or hotline) or in a laboratory function.* You have in-depth knowledge of technology (mechanics, electrical engineering). You are familiar with IT network structures, communication protocols and IT interfaces and have experience in the area of server operating systems.* You are quick on the uptake and can solve complex problems in a structured manner using your analytical skills.* You are open minded and have intercultural experience.* You show a high degree of communicative and social competence in personal and virtual cooperation. Working in a team is your strength.* Customer satisfaction is your strongest motivation.So far, so good? It gets even better. We offer you a wide range of top benefits  at our locations. Only with you can we improve the lives of patients. Your contribution makes Roche unique. That's why we offer exceptional benefits that support you in shaping your life, your finances, and your health the way you want. Find out more here: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DECV only - Simply upload your CV and apply!Your contact to us! With people. For people.Do you need further support?Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq.Who we areA healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.Let’s build a healthier future, together.Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.occupation: Rare Disease Manager (Key Account Manager) for NF1, Middle East of Germany (all genders) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.Your Role: As a Rare Disease Manager (Key Account Manager) for Neurofibromatose Typ 1 (NF1) , you will be at the heart of transforming how patients with rare diseases access life-changing therapies — your work directly influences treatment pathways and outcomes for some of the most underserved patient populations. You will own your territory like a true entrepreneur, taking full accountability for strategy, execution, and sustainable business growth across hospitals, treatment centers, and referral networks. You will develop and execute customized strategic account plans that strengthen centers of excellence, optimize referral pathways, and accelerate time-to-treatment for patients in need. Building deep, trust-based partnerships with physicians, nurses, pharmacists, and multidisciplinary teams will be your daily currency — and you will do it with scientific credibility and genuine care. Leveraging your deep scientific expertise, you will engage healthcare professionals as a peer and trusted partner, translating complex clinical evidence into meaningful conversations that drive better standards of care. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional colleagues in Medical Affairs, Market Access, Marketing, and Commercial teams to align strategies and maximize impact across the healthcare ecosystem. Data is your compass: you will use CRM tools, market analytics, and territory business planning to identify opportunities, monitor performance, and continuously refine your approach. You will champion disease awareness and patient education initiatives, playing a key role in shaping the rare disease landscape in your region. Acting as the voice of the customer, you will bring actionable field insights back to the organization — directly influencing strategy at a national level. This is a rare opportunity to combine commercial excellence with genuine patient impact — if that drives you, this role was made for you.Your territory covers key hubs across the Middle East of Germany — mainly Dresden, Leipzig and Göttingen area — and ideally, you already call one of these regions home.Who You Are:- You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Medicine, or a related life science field; a qualification as Pharmaceutical Representative per local regulatory requirements is a plus.- You bring at least 4–5 years of commercial experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare industry, with a proven track record in strategic account management and market development.- You have hands-on experience in rare disease environments and a strong understanding of the complex stakeholder dynamics involved.- You possess deep knowledge of healthcare systems, reimbursement pathways, and patient access processes, ideally with exposure to high-cost specialty therapies.- You are scientifically agile — able to engage with complex clinical data and translate it into compelling, compliant customer discussions.- You combine an entrepreneurial mindset with strong analytical capabilities, taking ownership of results and thriving in ambiguous, fast-evolving environments.- You are a skilled communicator and relationship builder, experienced in working across cross-functional teams and navigating complex stakeholder landscapes.- You are fluent in German and English and highly willing to travel within your territory, including overnight travel as required.- A valid driving license is required.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!
