In order to fill a fixed-term position in full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for severalPostdocs (2 years) (m,f,x)The Cluster of Excellence "CASA: Securing the Digital Society" is funded by DFG for the years 2026-2032 with approximately 53 million euros. CASA aims to strengthen the resilience of our digital society. The emergence of disruptive technologies in recent years, especially artificial intelligence and quantum computers, has caused substantial new challenges for cybersecurity research. In the second funding phase, CASA will specifically address these challenges. Thematic priorities include the security of quantum technologies, protection against Al-based disinformation and societal polarization, and new approaches to defending against ransomware. In addition to technical questions, it also investigates the interaction of human behavior and cybersecurity. Research at CASA, which is based at the Horst Görtz Institute for IT Security, follows a strongly interdisciplinary approach. Researchers from the fields of computerscience, cryptography, electrical engineering, mathematics, and psychology work together in an unique constellation in Europe. This holistic approach is unparalleled and holds the potential for scientific breakthroughs. The Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften - ISAS - e. V. develops efficient analytical methods for health research. Thus, it contributes to the improvement of the prevention, early diagnosis, and therapy of diseases like cardiovascular diseases or cancer. Overall, the institute strives to advance precision medicine by combining knowledge from different fields such as biology, chemistry, computer science, medicine, pharmacology, and physics. ISAS is a member of the Leibniz Association and is publicly funded by the Federal Republic of Germany and its federal states.We invite applications for the Research Group Biofluorescence: PhD candidate (f/m/d)This project, funded by the DFG as part of CRC 1752, "DYNAMO: Immediate Tumor Dynamics in Melanoma Therapy“ (https://www.uni-due.de/crc1752/) seeks to combine high-resolution multi-omics profiling, advanced computational modeling, and clinically aligned biomarker stratification, in order to generate actionable, patient-specific predictions and resistance-targeting interventions in melanoma therapy. You will be responsible for finding out the role of neutrophils for the early development of therapy resistance in human melanoma. The project is being carried out in collaboration with University Hospital Essen and the University of Duisburg-Essen.You will be responsible for- Experimental setup and execution of neutrophil functional profiling in the context of melanoma immune regulation and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) response- Functional assays of neutrophils including migration, phagocytosis, and ROS production- Optimization and standardization of neutrophil functional assays for primary human samples- Few-cell proteomics for deep molecular characterization of neutrophil subsets- Multicolor flow cytometry of PBMCs and immune cell populations- Live-cell imaging and advanced microscopy for dynamic immune cell behavior analysis- Planning and execution of stimulation and inhibition experiments to dissect signaling pathways regulating neutrophil function in the melanoma context- Data processing, analysis, interpretation, and visualization of experimental results in collaboration with computational partnersYour profile- Completed diploma or master’s degree in molecular biology, cancer biology, immunology, cell biology, bioinformatics, translational medicine or related disciplines- Experience in molecular and cellular biology techniques, ideally with hands-on experience with functional immune cell assays (preferably with neutrophils or myeloid cells) is an advantage- Strong interest in melanoma biology, tumor immunology, immune checkpoint therapy, translational cancer research, and tumor–immune interactions- Experience with cell culture, flow cytometry, microscopy, proteomics workflows or high-dimensional immune profiling approaches is desirable- Experience with bioinformatics or biostatistics is beneficial but not required- Ability to work independently and in interdisciplinary teams, with strong organizational skills and analytical thinking- High level of self-motivation, scientific curiosity, reliability, creativity, and team-oriented personality with enthusiasm to work in a collaborative research environment- Fluent in spoken and written EnglishWe offer- A clear research topic as well as multifold training and support for PhD students in framework of ISAS and the Leibniz association- Opportunities for scientific training and development in an international environment and an excellent working atmosphere in a very dynamic and professional team- Access to state-of-the-art technologies including few-cell proteomics, high-dimensional flow cytometry, and advanced microscopy platforms- Integration into an interdisciplinary, internationally visible, translation-oriented cancer immunology research network- The opportunity to present your data on international conferences and participate in workshops- A wide range of opportunities for further training and qualifications- Flexible working times, mobile working and attractive social benefits- Family-friendly infrastructure and support from a family serviceNon-residents who apply for this job will receive help from the institute to find accommodation and to handle authorities. Applications from disabled applicants are welcome. ISAS supports the principle of equal opportunity for all employees and therefore particularly encourages women to apply.The part-time position (65%) starts on October 1, 2026, and is offered until June 30, 2030. The salary will be according to the German TV-L and falls within the pay group 13. The time limitation of the contract is based on the Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz (WissZeitVG).ISAS collects and processes the personal data of its applicants in accordance with European and German legal regulations. **

• Highly self-driven and result oriented

• Strong desire to contribute to the team success

• Structured way of working, showing attention to detail and following procedures

• Motivated to acquire new knowledge, and use this to develop and deliver high-quality training

• Be able to work both alone managing own projects and form part of a team

**What Maersk Training Offers

**Joining Maersk Training means becoming part of a globally respected organisation dedicated to developing competence, safety, and operational excellence across the maritime and energy industries.

**As Technical Instructor, you can expect:

**

• A full-time, permanent position with long-term career opportunities

• An attractive compensation package reflecting your experience and expertise

• A daily lunch arrangement

• The opportunity to work in a truly international environment with colleagues, clients, and participants from across the globe

• A collaborative culture where you become part of a highly skilled and dedicated team of instructors

jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager – Industrial Energy Clients
jobs.description:
Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Do you want to make a difference and help industrial companies navigate the energy transition?

Vattenfall’s Business Sales Department offers a wide range of products in the energy field. We operate in a highly competitive and dynamic market, serving large corporate customers, partners, and resellers. Our ambition is to be number one for the customer.

We are looking for a Key Account Manager to join our Industrial Production Clients team within Business Area Customers & Solutions. This is an opportunity to strengthen Vattenfall’s position as the preferred energy partner for industrial customers in Denmark and across the Nordic region.

Our customers operate in an increasingly complex environment where competitiveness, energy supply, commercial risk, and sustainability ambitions are closely connected. In this role, you will help customers navigate these challenges while building long-term partnerships that create value for both the customer and Vattenfall.

Vattenfall has established a strong position within the Industrial Production client segment in Sweden, Finland, and Denmark. As we continue to build an even stronger customer platform in Denmark, you will become an important part of our Nordic sales organization and contribute directly to its future growth.

You will join a Nordic sales team of thirteen Key Account Managers across Sweden, Finland, and Denmark and report to the Sales Manager and Head of Industrial Production Clients Nordic. Based in Copenhagen, you will work closely with colleagues across the region. The team has a collaborative, knowledge-sharing culture, supported by flexible working conditions that combine office collaboration with remote work when appropriate.

Your role

As Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing long-term, profitable business and strategic customer partnerships within the Nordic Industrial Production client segment. You will work with prospects and customers to understand their operations, energy needs, market exposure, decision-making structures, and long-term priorities.

From this insight, you will identify opportunities, offer relevant solutions, and negotiate contracts. You will act as a trusted advisor, helping prospects and customers navigate the energy transition, manage market risks, and achieve their sustainability ambitions, including reducing their environmental footprint.

You will coordinate cross-functional expertise across Vattenfall to develop and deliver customer solutions. This includes close cross-functional collaboration to ensure alignment, a seamless customer experience, and long-term value creation.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Develop and manage long-term strategic relationships with industrial prospects & customers in Denmark and across the Nordic market.

• Identify customer needs and translate them into tailored, value-creating energy solutions.

• Take commercial ownership of customer opportunities from early development through internal alignment, negotiation, and contracting.

• Lead commercial discussions and contract negotiations in close collaboration with relevant specialists.

• Coordinate cross-functional bid and solution-development activities, ensuring clear ownership, alignment, and progress.

• Act as a trusted advisor by translating energy-market and industry developments into relevant customer insights.

Manage and develop a profitable customer portfolio while contributing to Vattenfall’s customer offering and commercial platform in Denmark.

Your profile

You are a commercially minded professional with experience in B2B sales, key account management, business development, or another field involving complex customer solutions. Experience from the energy commodity business is highly relevant, while experience from sectors with complex instruments, such as insurance or finance, may also provide a strong foundation.

You combine strategic and commercial focus with operational capability. You are genuinely interested in customers and their industry challenges, and you are motivated to create the best possible value through collaboration. Structured, proactive, and self-driven, you enjoy working independently as well as in a cross-border team.

Your credibility is built through business insight, sound judgement, and clear communication. You are trustworthy, solution-oriented, and comfortable involving the right colleagues to move customer opportunities forward. You bring creative thinking and a drive to continuously develop and improve.

To succeed in this role, you bring:

• A relevant degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Science, or a comparable field.

• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• Strong and demonstrated business acumen.

• Experience in B2B sales, key account management, business development, or other complex commercial environments.

• Knowledge of energy commodities, electricity markets, energy procurement, risk management, or comparable complex solutions.

• Strong communication, influencing, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.

• A genuine interest in customers, their operations, and their industry challenges.

• A proactive, collaborative, and solution-oriented way of working.

• Experience with electricity supply agreements, commodity contracts, hedging solutions, power purchase agreements, Nordic electricity markets, or decarbonisation strategies is an advantage.

• An established network within Danish industry or the energy sector would also be beneficial.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Location  Copenhagen

Our offer

Looking for a career with growth?

Looking for a role where your superpowers can be leveraged to the maximum and with limitless opportunities for growth?

The scale and ambition of our wind, battery and solar business means you can really find your element with us. We’ll also provide you with all the learning and development you need to expand your horizons.

We strive to be the best place to work in the industry with highly competitive pay and conditions and an open, supportive culture. A commitment to a healthy work-life balance aims to ensure everyone plays to their strengths, whatever their background and experiences.

You will be part of a growing team of 1,700+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities where our positive approach to diversity is reflected in the fact that more than a quarter of staff are women.

More Information

For more information about the position you are welcome to contact hiring manager Annelie Gerborn, annelie.gerborn@vattenfall.com.  For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Christian Pathuel, christian.pathuel@vattenfall.com

We welcome your application in English no later than 22-11-2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to building a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be a good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. Click here for further information.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

Since Vattenfall is a part of the Swedish critical infrastructure, many of our services are security classed. If this position is security classified the final candidates might be subject to a security vetting process, according to Swedish legislation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.description:
_Do you enjoy turning strategic ambitions into concrete results? Would you like to help shape the future of some of the Nordics' leading private brands? Then you might be the Strategy Consultant we are looking for.

_As a Strategy Consultant, you will play a key role in moving our From Good to Great strategy forward. Working at the intersection of strategy, transformation and commercial development, you will help shape and deliver initiatives that create real impact across the business.

You will be part of our newly created Strategy and Business Development team, reporting to the General Manager working closely with colleagues across the organisation, including Procurement, Supply Chain, Design Development, Quality and PMO, while also collaborating directly with our CEO, Senior Leadership Team and Nordic Partners.

**Key Responsibilities

**The role covers a broad range of responsibilities, including:

• Manage key value streams within larger transformation programmes with responsibility for the plan, deliverables and realised benefits

• Run smaller strategic projects end-to-end, from scoping through implementation and handover to the organisation

• Structure ambiguous strategic questions into hypotheses, analyses and decision-ready recommendations for the CEO and Senior Leadership Team

• Build business cases and financial models to support prioritisation, investment decisions and benefit tracking

• Analyse category, supplier and price/value performance to support private brand and sourcing decisions

• Identify and assess new business opportunities and strategic partnerships

**To Thrive In This Role, We Imagine That You

**

• Have a relevant master’s degree, for example in business, economics, finance, strategy or a related field

• Have 2-4 years of experience in consulting or an in-house strategy, transformation or commercial function

• Are a skilled problem solver, qualitatively and quantitatively, including financial modelling and business cases

• Have a solid business understanding of how strategy affects financial, operational and commercial performance

**

Responsibilities and technologies

About you

Continue developing with us

Join an inclusive community

The conference floor is where deals start. The dinner is where trust is built. The clip is what 10,000 people see the next morning. Own all three.

**About The Job

**GetWhy is the end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform trusted by the world’s most influential brands, including eBay, Arla, Warner Brothers and The Coca Cola company, to understand their customers at scale. We’re backed by $40M in Series A funding and scaling aggressively into the enterprise market.

In our category, events aren’t a nice-to-have. They are a strategic weapon. Industry conferences, hosted experiences, executive dinners and brand activations are where relationships form, pipeline is built, and GetWhy cements its position as the category leader in AI-powered qualitative research.

We’re hiring our first Lead, Global Events & Community to own how GetWhy shows up in the world. This is a high-ownership role for someone with taste, commercial instinct and relentless execution. You’ll design experiences enterprise buyers actually want to attend, turn every event into content that travels far beyond the room, and build the playbook that lets GetWhy show up brilliantly on every continent.

What you’ll do

Own the global event strategy

• Set GetWhy’s global events strategy with the marketing leadership, from tentpole industry conferences (IIEX, ESOMAR, Quirk’s) to hosted events, executive roundtables and product showcases.

• Plan, produce and execute 15–20+ events per year across Europe, the US and beyond, each tied to clear pipeline, brand and customer goals.

• Own the global events budget, sponsorship negotiations, and relationships with agencies, venues and production partners.

Make GetWhy unmissable at every conference

• Have a strong point of view on world-class conference presence, from booth concept and spatial design to merch and the small details people remember.

• Replace badge-scanning booths with live experiences: let attendees run a real GetWhy study, see AI-moderated interviews in action, and leave with an insight.

• Secure speaking slots and sponsorships that put GetWhy at the centre of the industry conversation.

Put customers on stage

• Build a flagship GetWhy-hosted event where customers present the work they’ve done with GetWhy and show other brands how to do the same.

• Recruit and prepare customer and executive speakers, and make sure every GetWhy representative on stage or on the floor is briefed and on message.

Own the side events and intimate moments

• Design VIP dinners, executive roundtables and side events around major conferences, where the real relationships are built.

• Partner with Sales and Customer Success on account-based events that move specific deals and expansions forward.

Run the content machine

• Capture on-site content at every event, including video, photos and short clips that show GetWhy’s presence on the ground.

• Turn events into social media content, such as live posts, recaps, reels and LinkedIn stories, working with the wider marketing team.

• Conduct on-site interviews with customers, speakers and industry leaders, creating content for social, the website and sales enablement.

• Make sure every event keeps working for weeks afterwards through recaps, clips and follow-up campaigns.

Turn events into revenue

• Build the pre- and post-event engine: invitations, promotion, lead capture, qualification and a seamless handoff to Sales.

• Track and report on pipeline, ROI, reach and brand impact for every event, and double down on what works.

Build the playbook

• Create scalable playbooks and “event in a box” toolkits so local teams and partners can host on-brand GetWhy events anywhere.

• Grow the events function over time, including freelancers, agencies and future hires.

• Stay ahead of new event formats and technologies, and bring the best of them to GetWhy first.

Who you are

You’re not looking for an event coordination role. You’re a builder who sees events as the highest-leverage channel in a B2B enterprise sale, and you want to prove it on a global stage.

• 3–6+ years in event marketing, field marketing or experiential marketing for B2B SaaS, enterprise tech or a high-growth scale-up.

• A portfolio of standout events, with a track record that ties them directly to pipeline and revenue.

• Real taste. You know what makes a booth, a dinner or a keynote memorable, and you can explain why.

• Commercially minded. You think about pipeline and impact, not just logistics.

• A poster, not a scroller. Social media is second nature, and you know what makes an event clip worth watching.

• Comfortable behind a camera and in front of people. You can film, run an interview and do basic editing on the fly.

• A strong operator who can run several events in parallel across time zones without dropping quality.

• An excellent communicator who can brief a designer, negotiate with a venue and pitch an executive audience.

• Comfortable with CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

• A willing traveler. You go where the events are and you bring the energy.

Bonus points

• Experience from the insights, market research or MarTech industry. You know the conferences, the audience and the culture.

• Experience at an AI-native research company or a frontier AI or tech company known for its events.

• You’ve built an events function from scratch, including playbooks, processes and measurement.

• You’ve produced a flagship owned event or customer conference.

• A network of event organisers, venues and production partners across Europe and the US.

What we offer

• A fast-scaling, ambitious company where events are a core growth engine, not an afterthought.

• The chance to build GetWhy’s global events function from the ground up and define how a category leader shows up in the world.

• Real ownership, a seat close to leadership, and the budget and trust to try bold ideas.

• Work with some of the world’s most influential brands as customers, speakers and partners.

• Annual company retreats and Friday bar events. We work hard, and we celebrate hard.

How to apply

Click apply and upload your CV, LinkedIn profile, and a link to a portfolio of events you’ve produced. Event photos, clips or social posts you’ve made are a big plus.

If we see a match, we’ll invite you to a conversation online or at our office. The process includes a short creative assignment, where you’ll pitch how GetWhy should show up at one of our key industry conferences.

This isn’t the easiest events job out there. It’s the one that will define how a category leader shows up in the world. Let’s build GetWhy together.

You’ll be working with our procurement process and governance from developing the sourcing strategies to contract handover. In this role, you'll be coordinating with our category managers, business stakeholders and colleagues in supporting functions. jobs.occupation: Service Manager Level 1 SCADA & Power Plant Control
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Job Description

Are you an experienced SCADA engineer or technical service lead who wants to remain hands-on while taking responsibility for reliable service delivery? Would you like to combine solving technical problems with guiding colleagues and improving business-critical services supporting renewable energy?

As our new Service Manager Level 1 SCADA & Power Plant Control, you will be responsible for the reliable, secure and efficient delivery of agreed SCADA and Power Plant Control services supporting Vattenfall’s renewable-energy operations. Your scope includes WTG and substation SCADA, hybrid park controllers and interfaces to WTG Power Plant Controllers.

You will combine hands-on SCADA engineering and incident resolution with functional leadership of a dedicated service team of Level 1 SCADA and Power Plant Control engineers. Alongside your own technical assignments, you will prioritise the team’s work, coordinate suppliers and support functions, and drive continual improvement while meeting agreed service levels.

Working closely with customers, stakeholders and the Asset Service Area OT O&M Manager, you will help develop standardised, proactive service delivery that combines effective incident response with preventive maintenance, lifecycle planning and long-term service improvement.

Be in your element with BA Wind

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Qualifications

Y****our role

You will take responsibility for the delivery and performance of the services within your agreed scope, from their introduction into operation through ongoing support, improvement and eventual replacement or retirement.

Your service scope covers Level 1 SCADA for WTGs and substations, together with assigned Power Plant Control systems and interfaces, including hybrid park controllers and interfaces to WTG Power Plant Controllers. You will take responsibility for their operational support, controlled changes, lifecycle management and continual improvement within agreed ownership boundaries.

This role combines hands-on senior SCADA engineering with functional service leadership and does not include personnel line management. You will personally undertake engineering work while coordinating and prioritising the service team’s activities, monitoring outcomes and making risks, dependencies and resource needs visible. Capability and capacity requirements will be aligned with the Asset Service Area OT O&M Manager, with resources requested from the respective line managers.

You will apply your practical engineering expertise to diagnose faults, restore services and implement controlled technical changes within your agreed scope and authorisation. You will provide technical guidance to colleagues, assess operational risks and challenge proposed solutions, combining hands-on delivery with effective planning and coordination across organisational boundaries.

You will participate in the team’s on-call rotation, personally diagnosing and resolving incidents affecting SCADA and Power Plant Control services outside normal working hours, within your agreed technical scope and authorisation. You will involve other engineers, OEMs and suppliers when specialist support is required, follow agreed escalation arrangements and contribute to root-cause investigations and corrective and preventive actions.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Service scope and support arrangements: Maintaining clear service definitions, ownership boundaries, agreed service levels, support responsibilities and escalation arrangements, aligned with the agreed service mapping, the Asset Service Area OT O&M Manager and customer expectations.

• Service delivery and hands-on engineering: Managing reliable, secure and efficient day-to-day delivery of SCADA and Power Plant Control services, including monitoring, incidents, service requests, problems, changes and lifecycle activities. Personally configuring, testing, commissioning, maintaining and improving assigned systems, controllers and interfaces within approved procedures and authorisations, while balancing engineering assignments with service-leadership responsibilities and agreed priorities.

• Service performance: Monitoring performance against agreed service-level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational targets. Reporting on service availability, incident response and restoration, recurring issues, risks and improvement actions.

• Incident response and problem management: Personally diagnosing and resolving incidents affecting assigned SCADA systems, Power Plant Control systems and interfaces, while coordinating additional engineers, OEMs, suppliers and support functions as required. Ensuring timely service restoration and clear stakeholder updates, investigating root causes and implementing or assigning corrective and preventive actions, with follow-up to completion.

• Backlog and delivery planning: Managing and prioritising the service team’s backlog, dependencies and delivery plans based on higher-level guidance, operational impact, risk and available capacity. Planning your own engineering assignments alongside service-leadership responsibilities, balancing urgent operational needs with planned maintenance, lifecycle work and improvements, and making capacity trade-offs visible.

• Capability and capacity planning: Identifying the skills and capacity required to deliver agreed services and roadmap commitments, aligning them with the Asset Service Area OT O&M Manager, and requesting resources from the respective line managers and making the consequences of resource gaps visible.

• Lifecycle engineering and controlled change: Executing the agreed service roadmap through hands-on engineering and coordination of upgrades, migrations, patching, configuration changes and lifecycle replacements. Preparing, implementing or reviewing assigned changes, with appropriate risk assessment, testing, rollback arrangements, documentation and operational handover through approved processes.

• Supplier and stakeholder coordination: Coordinating contributions from suppliers, specialists and internal support functions, monitoring delivery against agreed responsibilities and service commitments, and following up on issues. Supporting technical and service-related purchasing or contract discussions with the responsible procurement and contract owners.

• Project requirements and transition to operations: Providing OT operations and maintenance requirements to projects whose deliverables will enter the service team’s scope. Agreeing operational acceptance criteria with the relevant stakeholders and participating in readiness reviews and handovers, checking support coverage, monitoring, documentation, recovery arrangements and unresolved risks.

• Operational documentation and knowledge: Producing and maintaining technical records, configuration information, operational runbooks and troubleshooting guidance for your own engineering work. Ensuring that the service team maintains relevant service and asset records, clear support responsibilities, escalation arrangements and accessible operational knowledge.

• Continual improvement and technical guidance: Using service-performance data and operational experience to identify, prioritise and implement improvements that reduce recurring incidents and strengthen reliability, efficiency and supportability. Standardising repeatable services and work packages, contributing to technical reviews, and supporting colleagues through practical guidance, knowledge sharing and appropriate automation.

• Security, compliance and audit support: Ensuring that applicable cybersecurity, regulatory and operational requirements are incorporated into service delivery and lifecycle planning, in collaboration with the responsible service engineers, cybersecurity and compliance functions. Coordinating relevant evidence and follow-up actions for audits and reviews.

• Risk management and escalation: Maintaining visibility of service risks, dependencies, delivery constraints and outstanding decisions. Escalating issues beyond the service team’s mandate or capacity to the Asset Service Area OT O&M Manager and other responsible stakeholders, with clear recommendations and operational consequences.

Your profile / who are you?

You hold a relevant bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, automation or control engineering, computer engineering, industrial IT, systems engineering or a related discipline. Alternatively, you have developed equivalent professional competence through a relevant technical qualification and substantial hands-on experience in SCADA or industrial OT engineering and operational support.

You have several years of hands-on experience engineering, operating and supporting SCADA systems or comparable industrial OT solutions, including recent practical experience diagnosing faults, restoring services and implementing controlled changes. You can personally diagnose faults, restore services and implement controlled technical changes. You have also demonstrated the ability to coordinate technical work, prioritise operational needs and guide colleagues or suppliers. Your background may be as a senior engineer, technical lead or service manager who has remained technically active; a previous formal Service Manager title is not required.

You understand the demands of supporting business-critical systems and can translate operational needs into clear priorities, responsibilities and delivery plans. You are comfortable taking responsibility for service outcomes while working with engineers, suppliers and line managers in a matrix organisation.

You have excellent written and spoken English skills and can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. The role may be subject to security clearance, and candidates must be able to meet the applicable screening requirements.

You bring knowledge and experience in:

• Operational service management: Applying structured incident, problem, service-request, change, configuration and lifecycle-management practices, with clear ownership, service levels and follow-up.

• Hands-on SCADA engineering: Practical experience configuring, integrating, testing, commissioning, maintaining, operating and supporting SCADA systems and interfaces, including documenting and validating technical changes.

• SCADA and OT environments: Understanding the role of SCADA in asset monitoring and control, including interfaces and dependencies between WTG and substation systems, power plant control, central control systems and supporting infrastructure. You can engage meaningfully with specialists and assess the operational implications of technical proposals.

• Service leadership and prioritisation: Coordinating multidisciplinary service teams and suppliers, managing backlogs and dependencies, identifying capacity requirements and resolving competing priorities within an agreed mandate.

• Operational resilience and secure engineering: Practical experience supporting service availability through monitoring, backup and recovery of SCADA applications and configurations, secure access, vulnerability handling and controlled technical changes, in collaboration with the teams responsible for supporting infrastructure.

• Service introduction and handover: Translating operations and maintenance needs into project requirements and acceptance criteria, assessing operational readiness and coordinating the transition of new or changed solutions into supported services.

• Supplier and stakeholder management: Establishing clear expectations, following up on service commitments, coordinating across organisational boundaries and handling escalations constructively.

• Incident and problem management: Diagnosing faults across SCADA applications, Power Plant Control systems, interfaces and connected systems, including dependencies on server services, networks, certificates and service accounts. Personally restoring services within your technical scope and authorisation, investigating root causes and implementing corrective and preventive actions, with specialist or supplier support where required.

• Performance analysis and improvement: Using service metrics, incident trends, risks and operational feedback to identify improvement priorities, track actions and communicate progress and results.

Additional experience that would be valuable:

• Experience with wind-turbine and substation SCADA platforms, hybrid park controllers, or OEM-specific WTG Power Plant Controllers and their interfaces.

• ITIL or comparable service-management training, or relevant OT cybersecurity training.

• Experience with service-management, backlog-planning, reporting and knowledge-management tools.

Personal traits

To succeed in this role, we believe that you:

• Take ownership of service outcomes and follow through on commitments, decisions and improvement actions.

• Lead through clear priorities, constructive challenge and collaboration, including where you do not have direct line authority.

• Remain calm and decisive during operational incidents, communicating clearly and involving the right people at the right time.

• Work in a structured and transparent way, making risks, dependencies, resource constraints and delivery progress visible.

• Use sound judgement to balance immediate service restoration, operational risk, long-term reliability, maintainability and agreed delivery priorities.

• Build effective relationships across engineering, Operations, projects, suppliers and support functions, and actively encourage knowledge sharing.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Location: Kolding, Denmark or Amsterdam, Netherlands

Additional Information

Our offer

Looking for a career with growth?

Looking for a role where your superpowers can be leveraged to the maximum and with limitless opportunities for growth?

The scale and ambition of our wind, battery and solar business means you can

At Intempus, our goal is simple: make time tracking as easy, intelligent and automated as it can possibly be. We're building the future of time tracking and our ambitions are high. This means that our system needs to deliver a stable and great user experience at all times — especially since our user base keeps growing fast.

That’s why we're looking for you: an experienced DevOps Engineer ready for the challenge.

What we offer

• 
A role where you can grow, learn and make a real impact

• 
A helpful, social and diverse workplace with a flat hierarchy and open communication

• 
A healthy work/life balance

• 
55 friendly, driven and skilled colleagues

• 
Flexibility, including two days of remote work per week

• 
A centrally located, modern office at Visma House in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen

• 
… and much more!

Your role

As part of our four people DevOps team, your main responsibility will be keeping our systems running smoothly around the clock. More specifically, you will:

• 
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that ensure fast, reliable and secure delivery of changes to our applications

• 
Automate infrastructure and server configuration using tools like Ansible, Terraform or whatever fits best — we're moving from a fully manual setup to infrastructure and configuration that's fully documented and managed as code

• 
Monitor and troubleshoot day-to-day issues across our servers and applications

• 
Design and implement improvements using the best tools the DevOps ecosystem has to offer — anything from a new secrets management solution to better container deployment workflows

• 
Collaborate with developers to improve tooling around development and test environments

• 
Keep our infrastructure and applications updated and secure

• 
Automate wherever possible, to cut down on manual effort and maintenance overhead

Who are you?

You're proactive and take ownership of your work. You thrive in a team with plenty of freedom, where ideas are shared openly and people genuinely listen to and support each other.

You communicate clearly, both in writing and in person, and you actively help foster a good team environment.

You hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent, and you bring at least 7 years of experience in a DevOps role or similar (e.g. System Administrator).

On the technical side, you have experience with:

• 
Managing Linux systems for at least two years (we run Debian-based Linux across all our servers)

• 
Bash scripting — you're comfortable working in a bash shell

• 
Docker — building, testing, deploying and maintaining containerized applications in production

• 
A programming language (our CI/CD pipeline and much of our automation is written in Python)

• 
git

• 
A CI/CD tool (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.)

• 
An infrastructure-as-code tool, ideally Terraform

• 
A configuration management tool, ideally Ansible

• 
Container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes, HashiCorp Nomad)

Nice to have, but not required:

• 
Managing PostgreSQL databases

• 
Cloud services with any provider

Who are we?

Intempus is a Danish software company with offices in Copenhagen and Aarhus. Since 2012, we've built, refined and optimized our own time-tracking system, and we continue to hold high ambitions for our product.

Our team of 55 includes a development team of 35 driven engineers. We are part of the Visma Group but operate day-to-day as an independent company.

Take a look at our team in the Copenhagen office here!

Ready to join us?

Apply now if you can see yourself as our new DevOps Engineer. Job start is January 1st, 2027, but we are flexible for the right candidate. The role is on-site at our office at Visma House in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen.

Please submit your application in English, as we are an international team, and include your resumé, educational diploma and references.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Digital & Strategy Marketing Manager - Shape Hilti Denmark's marketing strategy
jobs.description:
**What’s the role?

**Hilti Denmark is looking for a Digital & Strategy Marketing Manager to lead and develop our digital marketing, branding, communications, and strategic marketing initiatives. In this role, you will be responsible for driving an integrated marketing strategy that strengthens our brand, engages customers and employees, supports commercial growth, and delivers measurable business impact.

As part of the Danish Marketing Leadership Team, you will lead a team of five employees and collaborate closely with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and regional and global teams. This is a unique opportunity for an experienced marketing professional who enjoys combining strategic leadership with hands-on execution.

**What You'll Do

**As our Digital & Strategy Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for translating business priorities into impactful marketing initiatives while ensuring strong execution across digital channels, communications, campaigns, pricing, and strategic business projects.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Lead and develop a high-performing marketing team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability.

• Shape and execute Hilti Denmark's brand, communications, and digital marketing strategy to strengthen market position and customer engagement.

• Own the digital customer journey across content, social media, Hilti Online, and demand generation, driving traffic, conversion, and growth.

• Translate strategic business priorities into impactful go-to-market initiatives and integrated marketing campaigns.

• Use data, customer insights, and market intelligence to optimize performance and influence key business decisions.

• Partner across sales, finance, product, and trade functions to enhance commercial effectiveness, pricing excellence, and sustainable growth.

**What You’ll Bring

**We're looking for an ambitious marketing leader who combines strategic thinking with strong commercial understanding and the ability to turn ideas into action.

**We Imagine That You Have

**

• A university degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field, combined with solid experience in digital marketing, campaign management, strategic marketing, or similar disciplines.

• At least 5 years of experience operating successfully in cross-functional, matrix organizations, with a proven ability to influence stakeholders across functions and organizational levels.

• Strong leadership capabilities with experience developing people, fostering collaboration, and driving high-performing teams.

• A data-driven and analytical mindset, with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to translate insights into business actions and growth opportunities.

• Hands-on experience with digital marketing channels, customer engagement, content strategies, and performance measurement, coupled with strong communication and storytelling skills.

• Fluency in English. Danish and experience within B2B and/or the construction industry are considered strong advantages.

**What’s In It for You

**This is an opportunity to take ownership of a broad and highly visible marketing leadership role with significant business impact. You will combine people leadership, strategic responsibility, and operational execution while helping shape the future direction of Hilti Denmark's marketing organization.

• A leadership role with responsibility for key marketing activities and strategic business initiatives.

• The opportunity to lead and develop a talented team in a collaborative and high-performing environment.

• Close collaboration with senior leaders and international stakeholders across the Hilti organization.

• A dynamic role combining brand management, digital marketing, demand generation, analytics, and business strategy.

• Continuous development opportunities, supported by coaching, feedback, and extensive learning resources.

• Long-term career opportunities within a global organization known for developing its people.

**Why Hilti

**Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

**Commitment to Inclusion

**At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

**Legal Notice

**Does this sound like you? We look forward to your application!

You can apply for this position by clicking “Apply now” and uploading your CV. You do not need to submit a cover letter, but we encourage you to include a few sentences in your CV about what motivates you to apply for the role.

If your profile matches the position, you will first be invited to a short video interview. After that, selected candidates will be invited for an in-person interview. If you have any questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact our recruitment team at DKTeamRecruiting@hilti.com

**Do you want to help ensure quality in energy infrastructure projects? Can you turn quality requirements into practical activities and support projects through to handover? And do you have experience with quality management, audits and inspections? Then join COWI as our new Quality Consultant.

****Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**We are looking for a Quality Consultant to join COWI and support our customers’ construction and operational projects on assignments of both shorter and longer duration. You will help ensure that projects follow the customer’s governance framework and can be handed over to the operations organisation at the required quality level, with all supporting documentation. Your work may span electricity transmission projects, including cables, overhead lines and substations; gas distribution and transmission networks, including natural gas and biogas facilities and stations; oil pipelines; and gas storage facilities.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Support projects in applying internal processes and tools and provide guidance and support on quality-related matters.

• Consistently promote and embed quality management in projects so that documentation, products and deliverables meet the specified requirements

• Plan, carry out and document the necessary quality activities in collaboration with the project team, including internal and external audits and inspections of project partners.

• Ensure that quality-related experience and lessons learned are shared within the customer’s organisation.

• Prepare project quality plans.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways, but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

You work in a structured and systematic way and take a proactive approach to building relationships. You collaborate and communicate on an equal footing with internal and external stakeholders involved in construction projects. You bring professional credibility in your field and can work independently.

On top of that, you will have:

• An understanding of the structure and application of quality management systems.

• Experience with project- and process-related work.

• Experience with quality management activities in infrastructure and construction projects, including quality assurance (QA) and providing input to quality control (QC) activities.

• Experience carrying out quality activities, including audits and inspections of internal and external parties involved in projects.

• Experience using the Microsoft Office suite.

• The ability to communicate in Danish and English, both orally and in writing, at negotiation level.

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarters in Lyngby.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Looking for a workplace where you can make real change? A meaningful job where you have the freedom, trust and responsibilities to play an important role and not just be a small fish in a big shoal? Does being a part of a social, passionate, and international team sound right to you? Join us!

Your position

In your new position as a Telecom & Network Engineer in the Telecom Engineering Department, you will join a multicultural, diverse team of skilled, enthusiastic telecommunication specialists from all over the world. As a telecom engineer with a strong network background, you will create, design and develop integrated critical communication systems for the offshore energy industry. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, or in Gdynia or Norfolk. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel from 10-30 days per year depending on which office you will be working at.

“This is an exciting chance to become part of an expanding energy industry, where you can benefit from outstanding career development opportunities. You’ll collaborate with highly skilled and dedicated professionals who are committed to excelling in their field. The role involves working on diverse projects of various scales worldwide, within a collaborative team environment where success is shared” says Head of Engineering, Technology Solutions, Kurt Thorøe.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As a Telecom & Network Engineer, you will design integrated telecom solutions with a strong focus on industrial network technologies. You will take technical responsibility for assigned systems throughout the project lifecycle, from requirements and design through configuration, integration, testing and final documentation Each project is tailored to meet the unique requirements of our clients, providing you with the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge, customized solutions.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

• Designing and engineering different telecommunication solutions for our clients, which could include network design, CCTV, Line-of-Sight radios and other integrated telecom systems, with a strong focus on network technologies.

• Designing network architecture in accordance with applicable OT security requirements and principles.

• Prepare detail design specification for network to be used for actual implementation.

• Ensuring integration and interface coordination between telecom systems

• Verify configurations and equipment in preparation for Factory Acceptance Tests.

• Performing system configuration, integration and testing as required by the project.

• Following up on subcontractors’ designs, securing technical requirements and interface management.

• Supporting and interacting with subcontractors, customers and other teams across the organisation, such as Telecom Service and the Tender team.

Your profile & qualifications

You are a detail-oriented and structured engineer with a curious and analytical mindset. In addition, you have a proactive and organised approach to your work and thrive in a workday with lots of variation and teamwork.

We imagine that you hold:

• Minimum 5 years of experience within telecom engineering, preferably with strong experience in designing and configuring industrial network systems and a solid understanding of both physical and logical network technologies.

• Knowledge of OT security standards and practices, such as the Purdue Model, IEC 62443, or similar frameworks.

• A relevant degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Network Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience from the maritime or offshore energy industry; broader telecommunications experience is considered an advantage.

• Strong technical ownership and project mindset, with the ability to drive assigned systems forward and foster positive collaboration within project teams.

• Strong analytical and technical writing skills, combined with professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

Apply

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.occupation: Sales & Business Development Director – Defence & Maritime Security
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY

Saildrone is a maritime defense company and the global leader in autonomous unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). With more ocean miles and real-world operational experience than any USV manufacturer or operator, Saildrone maintains active, combat-deployed systems supporting national security and force projection around the world, 24/7/365.

Saildrone’s manufacturing and R&D headquarters are located in Alameda, CA, with business development and sales operations in Washington, DC, an established European entity supporting regional business development, sales, and operations, and a deployment hub in the Middle East. By combining proven autonomous operations, edge computing, advanced sensing, renewable power, and the most advanced and robust unmanned surface technology on the planet, Saildrone is shaping how the Navy of the future operates. Join a fast-moving, mission-driven team at the forefront of maritime security and autonomous innovation.

THE POSITION

The Sales & Business Development Manager will be responsible for identifying, developing, shaping, and capturing business opportunities across defence, maritime security, intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, maritime domain awareness, and hydrographic sectors.

The successful candidate will establish and maintain relationships with defence and government stakeholders, military end users, procurement organizations, defence industry partners, maritime agencies, and commercial customers while driving the adoption of Saildrone's autonomous maritime solutions and services.

While the primary responsibility will be Germany, the role will also support selected strategic opportunities across Eastern Europe.

As Saildrone expands its Fleet of autonomous vessels, commercial activities, customer engagements, and operational footprint the successful candidate will be expected to assume a leadership role in building and growing the demand and European infrastructure for Saildrone’s next generation platform helping establish the foundation for long-term growth in one of Saildrone's most important international markets.

The ideal candidate will combine strong defence sales experience, deep knowledge of the German and European defence ecosystem, an understanding of government and political processes, and the ability to build trusted relationships with senior military, government, and industry leaders.

THE TEAM

The European Sales & Business Development team at Saildrone Europe is responsible for driving the company's growth and market expansion across Europe and selected international markets. The team works closely with government agencies, defence organizations, maritime security stakeholders, research institutions, and commercial customers to identify opportunities, develop strategic partnerships, and deliver innovative maritime domain awareness, Bathymetry, and Meteorology and Oceanography solutions. Through customer engagement, market analysis, proposal development, contract negotiations, and cross-functional collaboration with product, engineering, operations, and executive leadership, the team helps shape Saildrone's regional strategy and ensures customers realize the full value of Saildrone's autonomous maritime technologies. Our mission is to strengthen maritime security, enhance situational awareness, and support data-driven decision-making through persistent, autonomous ocean intelligence.

THE RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and execute Saildrone's sales and business development strategy across Germany and Selected Eastern European Countries.

• Identify, qualify, shape, and capture opportunities for Saildrone's autonomous maritime solutions and associated data services.

• Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline that supports ambitious revenue growth objectives.

• Lead customer engagements from opportunity identification through contract award and execution.

• Develop account strategies and long-term customer engagement plans.

• Achieve annual sales targets and contribute to Saildrone's regional growth objectives.

• Support proposal development, contract negotiations, commercial discussions, and bid submissions.

• Act as a subjected matter expert of our next generation platform

• Establish and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders

• Develop a detailed understanding of customer requirements, capability priorities, and future acquisition programs.

• Represent Saildrone at military exercises, trials, demonstrations, conferences, and industry events.

• Support customer operational evaluations and capability demonstrations

• Build relationships with UK and international defence primes, shipbuilders, system integrators, and maritime technology providers.

• Support industrial cooperation, offset, and localization discussions where appropriate

THE QUALIFICATIONS

• Minimum 8 years of experience in defence, maritime, aerospace, security, or government sales.

• Proven track record of winning and growing complex defence and government business opportunities.

• Strong commercial sales background with responsibility for customer relationships, revenue generation, and business growth.

• Extensive knowledge of the German and European defence acquisition and procurement environment.

• Strong understanding of Germanys governmental and political processes influencing defence spending and capability development.

• Established network across Germanys defence, maritime, and security sectors.

• Experience in engaging with senior military officers, government officials, and industry executives.

• Excellent presentation, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a geographically dispersed team.

• Willingness to travel extensively throughout Germany and Europe,

• Eligibility to obtain and maintain Security Clearance in Germany.

Saildrone offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits tailored to each global region. Please note that specific benefits listed below may vary or be adapted for roles based in Denmark in accordance with local labor standards and Danish market practices.

To view Saildrone's candidate privacy policy, please visit: https://www.saildrone.com/privacy-policy.

BENEFITS

At Saildrone, we’re building operational capability that matters—and that requires people who can do their best work over the long term. We invest in our team’s well-being, financial security, and professional growth so you can focus on delivering real-world impact with confidence and stability. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you and your family while you contribute to a mission with lasting significance.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**Ready to shape how Boozt grows and develops one of its most important departments across markets?

We are looking for a Marketing Manager for a maternity cover of approximately 13 months to lead the marketing agenda for our Kids department.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of customer insight, commercial priorities, Buying strategy and marketing. You will help define what Kids should stand for at Boozt, identify the categories, themes and moments we should prioritise, and translate these into a strong marketing plan across our markets.

You will work closely with Buying & Merchandising, our market and campaign teams and specialist functions across CRM, E-commerce, Media, Brand & Creative and Social to ensure that the right Kids priorities are brought to market in the right way.

This is a role for a commercially strong marketer who combines strategic thinking with a practical understanding of what it takes to create relevant, high-performing marketing in a fast-moving e-commerce environment.

**What You Will Do

**You will be responsible for developing and continuously strengthening the Kids marketing agenda.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Own the Kids marketing plan and positioning, defining the key categories, themes and customer opportunities to prioritise throughout the year, based on commercial performance, customer insight, seasonality and Buying strategy.

• Work closely with Buying & Merchandising to ensure that assortment priorities, strategic category opportunities, launches and relevant brand initiatives are translated into strong customer-facing marketing opportunities.

• Drive the Kids agenda across markets and campaigns, adapting priorities with the market/GTM team to reflect local customer needs, commercial potential and seasonality, while ensuring Kids is represented in larger Boozt campaigns with the right categories and propositions.

• Set the direction for customer-facing marketing partnering with Campaign Leads, E-commerce, CRM, Media, Brand & Creative and Social to translate Kids priorities into relevant campaigns, onsite experiences, customer journeys and content. You own the commercial direction and priorities, while specialist teams drive execution.

• Own performance and continuous improvement, using data and customer insights to measure impact, identify growth opportunities, challenge existing plans and strengthen the Kids marketing agenda.

**How The Role Works

**You will be the **marketing owner for the Kids department.

****This Means You Are Accountable For Defining

**

• what Marketing should prioritise within Kids

• why those priorities matter

• when they are relevant

• which markets they matter in

• what commercial or customer outcome they should deliver

**YOUR PROFILE

**We are looking for someone who combines strong commercial judgement with a genuine understanding of customers, categories and marketing. You know how to turn insights into clear priorities and bring people together around opportunities that drive business results.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• At least 5 years of experience in e-commerce, retail or consumer marketing, preferably within fashion, kidswear or a related category.

• Strong commercial understanding, connecting customer behaviour, category performance, seasonality and marketing opportunities.

• Experience developing marketing strategies and plans, translating business and customer insights into clear priorities and actionable initiatives.

• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with performance data. Experience with Qlik Sense, Google Analytics or similar tools is an advantage.

• Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to challenge constructively, make clear recommendations and prioritise across Buying, commercial, creative and digital teams.

• Strong marketing judgement, a high quality bar and a structured, proactive approach, combined with the flexibility to navigate a fast-moving environment.

• Fluency in English, our company language.

**WHY JOIN NOW?

**Boozt is evolving how Marketing works across markets, departments and specialist teams.

This role therefore offers the opportunity not only to lead the Kids marketing agenda during the maternity-cover period, but also to contribute to how we build a stronger, more commercially focused and more market-relevant marketing organisation going forward.

**Apply today – we’re excited to learn more about you!

**_Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

_Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Denmark at the time of employment. Please note that this position does not include visa sponsorship or relocation support.

We review applications on an ongoing basis. You can read more about the process under **Recruitment.

****BOOZT PERKS

**

• Great personal and internal career development opportunities

• A culture built on our values of trust, freedom, and responsibility

• Driven and passionate international colleagues

• A generous employee discount

• Healthy and delicious breakfast and lunch, top-quality coffee, and fresh fruit available all day

• In-house gym, onsite masseuse, and medical doctor

• An amazing HQ in central Copenhagen – the iconic, energy-efficient Krystallen building, recognized for its architectural design and sustainability. Enjoy breathtaking city views and much more!

Senior Manager in Partnerships

The Danish and Icelandic Affiliate | Novo

Are you passionate about building partnerships that can shape the future of healthcare? Do you have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to turn emerging opportunities into sustainable solutions for patients and the business?

We are looking for a Senior Manager in Partnerships to join the Danish and Icelandic Affiliate to help identify, develop and drive business growth through strategic partnerships.

In this exciting position you will build strong collaboration with eHealth providers and healthcare partners supporting our ambitions for patients and our business.

What you’ll bring

• An advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) in Business Administration, Project Management or a related field.

• At least 5 years of experience in strategic partnerships, external stakeholder management, commercial strategy or consulting.

• Experience managing teams and developing talent, including setting objectives, coaching and managing performance.

• Solid business development and key account management experience and a proven track record of developing, negotiating and managing strategic partnerships and alliances.

• A strong understanding of the healthcare ecosystem and the trends and challenges shaping the industry.

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex information into actionable insights.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English, written and spoken.

What you’ll do

As Senior Manager, Partnerships, you will identify, develop, and maintain strategic partnerships opportunities aligned with Novo's strategic priorities.

A key part of your role will be exploring what comes next. You will identify changes in the healthcare environment, assess emerging opportunities and help translate them into new partnerships, patient solutions and commercial approaches.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Identify and develop strategic partnerships and new business opportunities, from market insight and initial dialogue through implementation and ongoing relationship management.

• Analyse market developments and identifying opportunities for growth across our existing and future portfolio.

• Build new collaborations, ecosystems and commercial solutions that respond to changes in the healthcare environment and support sustainable business growth.

• Drive performance management through clear objectives, KPIs and regular reviews to ensure ROI and make timely decisions on when to scale, adapt or stop initiatives.

• Lead the Key Account Managers in driving performance with e-Health providers and pharmacies within obesity and diabetes through territory planning, customer segmentation and coordinated, compliant customer engagement.

• Develop patient solutions that improve patient access, education and adherence in collaboration with the marketing team.

• Drive cross-functional execution and translate partnership performance into recommendations, working closely with Commercial, Communication, Sales, MAPA and Medical and providing relevant insights to Leadership Teams.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Partnerships team in the Danish and Icelandic Affiliate and report to the Director, Sales & Partnerships. You will lead a team of five, including Strategic Partnerships Managers, an Associate Alliance Manager and Key Account Managers, covering Denmark. Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

**The Experience You’ll Bring

**You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Experience integrating AI technologies like OpenAI and Pinecone into production systems to build innovative, data-driven solutions. Experience with vector databases, transformers, NLP and LLMs is a plus.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

What we value

“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

**Knowing when it’s good enough

**We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

**Knowing when to slow down

**Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

**Make time to experiment

**We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

**What we offer

**You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.
