jobs.description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a one-year postdoctoral researcher position within Intelligent Computing Architectures, focusing on Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning. The appointment runs for one year from March 1, 2027, with the possibility of extension subject to available funding.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to design, optimize, and evaluate hybrid quantum-classical learning systems under realistic hardware constraints. The project is platform-independent and will investigate how noise, limited quantum resources, device connectivity, and classical computational overhead affect learning performance and practical implementation.

Possible research directions include hardware-aware model design and training, quantum-classical ensemble learning and mixture-of-experts, resource-efficient learning methods, and automated architecture search. The specific research programme will be defined with the successful applicant according to their expertise and the project objectives, with a focused and achievable scope for the initial year. Evaluation will include suitable classical baselines and explicit assessment of computational resource requirements.

The successful candidate will work on model design, quantum programming, simulation, training, and experimental evaluation of hybrid quantum-classical learning systems. The position includes collaboration with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners, identifying relevant research and implementation opportunities, and supporting joint activities. The candidate will also contribute to research proposals and funding applications related to quantum machine learning, intelligent computing architectures, and resource-efficient computing, as well as publications, technical documentation, and project reporting. The research will be supervised by Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio.

 

As a Postdoc in Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning, your key responsibilities will be to:

• 
Design, implement, and simulate hybrid quantum-classical learning models, investigating the effects of noise, connectivity, finite sampling, resource limitations, and training conditions. Explore suitable methods such as hardware-aware training, ensemble learning, mixture-of-experts, or architecture search within the agreed research program.

• 
Conduct reproducible experimental evaluations of learning performance, trainability, noise resilience, and computational resource requirements using quantum programming frameworks and machine learning tools. Compare results with suitable classical baselines and correlate observed behavior with model design and hardware constraints.

• 
Support collaboration with Danish and international academic, industrial, and technology-development partners in quantum machine learning and intelligent computing architectures, identify relevant research and implementation opportunities, contribute to joint activities, and prepare research proposals, funding applications, publications, technical documentation, and project reports.

 

What we offer 

• 
A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing section integrating expertise in analog/digital IC design, spintronics, advanced computing, semiconductor technologies, and energy-efficient system architectures. 

• 
An opportunity to develop a platform-independent research program in hardware-aware quantum machine learning, combining quantum programming, simulation, and machine learning methods with resource-aware evaluation.

• 
Opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with national and international academic and industrial partners in quantum machine learning, microelectronics, AI accelerators, and advanced computing.

• 
Strong support for professional development through the Lecturer Training Programme and mentoring, as well as opportunities to develop experience in research proposal writing, project development, and collaboration with Danish and European technology partners. 

• 
An open and collaborative research culture within SDU’s Faculty of Engineering (TEK), at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME), supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, computing architectures, quantum computing, and artificial intelligence.

 

What we expect 

Applicants should hold a PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Quantum Computing, Machine Learning, or a closely related field (the degree should have been completed within the last 6 years at most): 

• 
Demonstrated experience in quantum programming using frameworks such as Qiskit, PennyLane, or equivalent tools, including implementation and simulation of quantum circuits.

• 
Demonstrated experience in machine learning, including model implementation, training, and evaluation, with strong programming skills. Experience in quantum machine learning, hybrid quantum-classical models, noise-aware optimization, ensemble methods, or automated architecture search is an advantage.

• 
A strong research track record demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications and the ability to work effectively in collaborative research environments. Experience in writing research proposals, funding applications, or project plans is highly desirable.

• 
Team player with strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners across Denmark and Europe. 

All candidates must demonstrate excellent verbal and written English skills, along with very good communication abilities and the ability to communicate technical results to multidisciplinary and international partners.

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, semiconductor technologies, spintronics, photonics, and advanced computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. The postdoc will work with Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio on hardware-aware quantum machine learning, with opportunities to connect this research to the section’s expertise in AI accelerators and energy-efficient computing architectures.

The position
The Centre for Quantum Mathematics (QM) at the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), seeks outstanding candidates to fill a number of 3-year assistant professor positions in Quantum Mathematics with emphasis on pure mathematics with relations to quantum theory.
The targeted starting date of the position is 01.08.2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

About the Centre for Quantum Mathematics (QM)
Over the past seven years, QM has built a highly international and interdisciplinary research environment spanning a broad spectrum of pure mathematics, mathematical physics and quantum computer science. The Centre has attracted leading international researchers to Odense and developed a unique research environment spanning both fundamental and applied research.

The University of Southern Denmark has recently invested DKK 50 million in the Centre for Quantum Mathematics, on top of its continuous substantial basic funding of the centre, which will enable the Centre to further expand its scientific capacity, attract and retain leading international researchers, increase the acquisition of competitive external research funding and establish strategic collaborations with industry, public authorities and international partners.

As part of this continued development and expansion, QM will move into a new dedicated building from next year. The new building will be located on the SDU campus in Odense and will provide a dedicated research environment for the Centre and its growing international research community.

Research activities and funding
The QM centre is located at the Faculty of Science on the international campus in Odense, Denmark and it is hosting several large European, Danish and American grants including “New Structures in Low-Dimensional Topology” (Simons Collaboration) & “Topological Photonic Quantum Computing and its Applications” (Innovation Fund Denmark) both led by PI and Centre Director Jørgen Ellegaard Andersen; “Mathematics of the open topological string” (VILLUM Investigator) led by Professor Vivek Shende; “The Quantum Geometry of Dynamical Systems” (VILLUM Ascending Investigator) and “The Emergent Geometry of Categories” (DFF Sapere Aude) both led by Associate Professor Fabian Haiden; “New invariants in low-dimensional topology via quantum field theory” (VILLUM Young Investigator) led by Associate Professor Du Pei, “Global Categorical Symmetries and Phases of Quantum Matter” (VILLUM Young Investigator) led by Assistant Professor Apoorv Tiwari, “From Pertubative to Non-pertubative Quantum Field Theory by cutting and gluing” (DFF Sapere Aude) led by Assistant Professor Konstantin Wernli and finally “Leveraging Algebraic Geometry for High-Precision Fundamental Physics“ (DFF Sapere Aude) led by Associate Professor Matthias Wilhelm.

Job description
A successful candidate will drive internationally competitive research, collaborate with the world community in the field, and attract competitive external research funding. The candidates are expected to contribute significantly to QM’s excellent research and teaching environment and to provide outstanding education. The candidates will get the opportunity to shape this development together with the team and implement research project ideas with national and international impact. 

Topics of interest: Algebra, algebraic geometry, differential geometry, algebraic topology, complex geometry, quantum topology, geometric analysis, operator algebra, number theory statistics, probability theory and mathematical physics.

We offer
Our new colleagues will become part of an inspirational international research environment with excellent facilities and strong collaborations with a vast international network, research organizations and regulatory stakeholders. jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Organic and Supramolecular Chemistry: Electrically Controlled Cargo Release in [2]Rotaxanes via Mechanochemical Retro Diels-Alder Reactions at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
A 3-year (5+3) or 4-year (4+4) PhD position in organic and supramolecular chemistry is available for a highly motivated candidate at the Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy (FKF) at the University of Southern Denmark. The position is funded by a DFF-Research Project 1 grant from the Independent Research Fund Denmark – Natural Sciences and is available from January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.
The project focuses on the design and synthesis of electroactive molecular machines capable of converting electrically controlled molecular motion into mechanical force. In particular, the project will investigate whether redox-induced shuttling in mechanically interlocked molecules can be used to trigger the cleavage of covalent bonds and thereby enable controlled cargo release.

Project Background
The aim of this project is to develop electrically responsive molecular machines capable of converting redox-induced molecular motion into covalent cargo release.
Specifically, the project will focus on the design and synthesis of [2]rotaxanes incorporating a redox-active monopyrrolotetrathiafulvalene (MPTTF) unit, a cyclobis(paraquat-p-phenylene) (CBPQT4+) macrocycle, and a furan-based unit linked to a cargo molecule through a Diels–Alder adduct.
Upon electrochemical oxidation of the MPTTF unit, the CBPQT4+ macrocycle is expected to undergo shuttling along the molecular axle. The central hypothesis is that this redox-induced motion can generate sufficient mechanical force to promote a retro-Diels–Alder reaction, resulting in the release of the covalently attached cargo molecule. A key objective is to establish a direct mechanistic relationship between redox-induced macrocycle movement, the generation of mechanical force, and the cleavage of a covalent bond.
The project will involve extensive synthetic organic chemistry, the preparation and characterization of mechanically interlocked molecules, and investigations of their electrochemical and mechanical properties using techniques such as NMR spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, UV–vis spectroscopy, and cyclic voltammetry.

By combining synthetic, spectroscopic, and electrochemical studies, the project aims to establish whether electrically driven molecular motion can be harnessed to induce covalent bond cleavage. The results are expected to contribute to the fundamental understanding of force transduction in artificial molecular machines and may provide a foundation for future applications in controlled molecular release.

Qualifications
The ideal candidate holds a Master's degree (5+3 programme) or a Bachelor's degree (4+4 programme) in chemistry or a closely related field, preferably with a strong background in synthetic organic chemistry.

The successful candidate should have:

• 
Extensive practical experience in synthetic organic chemistry.

• 
A strong interest in supramolecular chemistry and molecular machines.

• 
Experience with standard analytical and spectroscopic characterization techniques.

• 
The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research environment.

• 
Good communication skills and proficiency in written and spoken English.

Previous experience in supramolecular chemistry, mechanically interlocked molecules, or tetrathiafulvalene chemistry would be an advantage but is not a prerequisite.
The successful candidate will also be expected to contribute to the supervision of Bachelor's and Master's students working on research projects within the group.

To learn more about the PhD programme at the Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy, read more here. 

Natural Science Research – Interdisciplinary Strength
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science, SDU and is located in Odense. At the Department, we contribute to solving some of society’s greatest challenges within energy, environment, health, and sustainability. We succeed because we build bridges between disciplines and transcend traditional boundaries. Our interdisciplinary mindset is not only a fundamental condition, but also our strength. And it is a strength that ensures our research and education are recognized both nationally and internationally.

Our vision is to create and apply knowledge across the natural sciences. We are unique in housing research within physics, chemistry, and pharmacy under one department, which provides excellent opportunities to explore the intersections between these disciplines. Read more about our vision here.

jobs.occupation: Tenure-track Assistant and Associate Professorships in Algorithms at SDU Vejle
jobs.description:
We seek candidates to join the Algorithms Section at the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science and contribute to the development of the new SDU Centre for Computer Science and AI in Vejle.
The starting time is negotiable with a preference for Summer 2027. 

The academic environment
Hired candidates will join the Algorithms Section, which spans SDU’s campuses in Odense and Vejle, and become part of the new SDU Centre for Computer Science and AI. Based at the new campus in Vejle, in the heart of Denmark’s Triangle Region and its strong and developing IT ecosystem, the centre offers an inclusive, international and collaborative environment for research and education in Computer Science and AI. It connects research, teaching and innovation through collaboration across research groups and with companies, public organizations and international partners.
The Centre for Computer Science and AI at SDU Vejle connects fundamental computer science with AI, data and advanced digital systems. Its shared focus is how architectures, AI, data and advanced algorithms can transform the specification, design, development, validation, deployment and operation of digital systems. The research environment is also home to SustainAI, an international research group advancing the design, development, evolution, testing and operation of sustainable, high-quality and AI-enabled software systems.
We encourage applications from researchers who can complement or strengthen the Algorithms Section while building links to the centre’s wider scientific environment in areas such as data analytics, data science and machine learning; optimization and computational efficiency; programming languages; software engineering and DevOps; AI-driven development and software evolution; and software architectures, cloud-edge computing, and autonomous and agentic systems.

At SDU Vejle, the department is responsible for international BSc and MSc programmes in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence. The programmes provide a strong setting for research-based teaching, supervision, and student collaboration with researchers and external partners.

Research profile
We seek candidates with a strong research record in efficient algorithms, broadly understood as spanning algorithm design, analysis and implementation as well as complexity theory. Relevant areas include, but are not limited to, approximation algorithms, combinatorial optimization, cryptology, data structures, fine-grained complexity, experimental algorithmics, and algorithmic research bridging to machine learning and AI.
Scientific excellence is the primary requirement. We particularly welcome candidates in algorithms engineering, optimization, or computational efficiency, whose work combines strong algorithmic foundations with the design, implementation and rigorous evaluation of algorithms for real-world problems.
Each appointment should help create a clear and distinctive identity for the Vejle environment by building critical mass, adding a missing capability, or creating a strong bridge between research areas. Candidates must strengthen at least one core area and connect meaningfully with other parts of the centre through research, education or external collaboration.

Industrial collaboration
Industrial collaboration is a defining theme of the centre. Successful candidates are expected to demonstrate an interest in engaging with companies and public organizations and the potential to contribute to the digital transformation of industry at local, national and international levels. Relevant activities may include collaborative research, industrial PhDs, student collaborations, and experimentation with industrial data and systems.

Qualifications
Successful candidates for a tenure-track assistant professorship must demonstrate a promising research record within the area of the call and some experience with teaching and supervision at BSc or MSc level. They are expected to contribute to research-based teaching, student projects and thesis supervision, including activities that connect students, researchers and external partners.
The Danish tenure-track system provides a focused pathway toward a permanent academic position. Before the end of the sixth year of employment, and contingent upon a positive academic assessment, the Assistant Professor will transition to a tenured Associate Professor position. Read more about SDU’s tenure-track program here.

The evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. Emphasis will be placed on the ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. 
As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the tenure evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution. 
The evaluation will also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities. 
Successful candidates for an associate professorship must have an international profile, a distinguished research record within the area of the call, and a proven ability to attract third-party funding. Demonstrated success in building and leading research teams, and a strong record of developing and leading research, innovation or industry-engaged activities, will be an advantage. Extensive teaching and supervision experience across BSc and MSc levels is expected.

Application
In addition to the documentation required under SDU’s appointment procedures, applicants should describe:

• 
Possible existing collaboration with industry or public organizations and plans for developing future external partnerships.

• 
How they would collaborate with existing groups in Vejle, supported by concrete examples of potential research, educational or practical collaboration.

Conditions of employment
Appointment as a Tenure Track Assistant Professor is temporary and for an initial up to 6 years period. 
During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

The Danish tenure track employment
The Danish tenure-track employment is a focused assistant professorship with a guaranteed assessment for a permanent position as an associate professor within the tenure-track assistant professor’s field of study.
The head of department will host annual performance- and development reviews, to ensure the progress of the assistant professor’s development towards meeting the qualifications of an associate professorship. A formal midterm evaluation will be conducted by a committee, consisting of the head of the department and two external researchers with relevant qualifications, with the purpose of ensuring the focus of the assistant professor’s activities, as well as to create the basis for the planning of the remaining period.

To qualify for the position as Tenure Track Assistant Professor you must have obtained a PhD degree by the employment date.

The transition from assistant professor to associate professor
Within the last year of employment, the tenure-track assistant professor is expected to transition into a position as an associate professor position, based on a positive assessment conducted by a formally approved assessment committee, consisting of a chairman appointed by SDU and minimum one external committee member approved by the dean and the academic council.

Successful applicants to tenure-track assistant professor positions must be scholars with an internationally competitive research profile, whose potential is at the forefront of their discipline. The applicants for tenure-track assistant professorships are assessed based on the criteria of the applicant’s potential to reach an international level of scholarly excellence during the tenure-track period. The candidate will only be promoted to associate professor when the assessment committee confirms that the candidate has scholarly merits at a level of international excellence beyond what can normally be expected for associate professors, with reference to the qualification policy of the research group in which the position is announced.
Indicators of relevant scholarly merits could be documented through scholarly output independent of the PhD supervisor, ground-breaking publications, achievement of excellence grants, and international research network.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc position in the intellectual history of corporate politics
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Business School invites applications for a postdoc position in the field of the intellectual history of corporate politics at the Department of Business Humanities and Law. The expected starting date is 1 May, 2027 or as agreed upon by consultation. The postdoc position is a non-tenured full-time position of 2 years, with the possibility of 1 additional year of teaching obligations.

The research will be conducted as part of the Independent Research Fund Denmark Sapere Aude Grant project Visions of corporate politics: Intellectual histories of the state-firm analogy. The project team will consist of the PI, one postdoc and one PhD.
Read more about the project here: https://dff.dk/en/our-funded-projects/meet-the-researchers/research-leaders/eksterne-personer-en/research-leaders-2025/mathias-hein-jessen/

The central objective of the research project is to analyze contemporary contestations over the state-firm boundary as well as mobilizations of analogies between state and firm in projecting political and economic visions. The project analyzes the constitution of the state-firm distinction as well as what it terms contemporary ‘visions of corporate politics’ represented by ideologically distinct answers to the crisis of liberal democracy which both contest the state-firm boundary and mobilize the state-firm analogy to legitimize their vision: On the one hand attempts to democratize or politicize the firm and on the other hand attempts to build political communities on principles of corporate governance. The postdoc project will focus on one of the two contemporary visions of corporate politics.

Examples of potential research topics: the democratization of the firm; democratic or economic planning; employee ownership; platform cooperativism or socialism; network states; gov-corps; start-up governments; freedom cities.

The research conducted will be team-based and oriented towards delivering on the project objectives. Taking the project framework into consideration, applicants are required to outline their reflections on how to approach the study.

The position is mainly in-place. The candidate should be able to be regularly present and attend meetings in Copenhagen.

For more information about the position, please contact PI of the project Associate Professor Mathias Hein Jessen (mhj.bhl@cbs.dk). 

Research environment
The Department of Business Humanities and Law is dedicated to an integrated approach to the contemporary challenges facing business and society drawing on the humanities, interdisciplinary social sciences, and law. The core research areas of the Department of Business Humanities and Law are organized into different research Units: Governance, Culture and Learning; Entrepreneurship, Ethics and Leadership; and CBS Law. Faculty within these groups have research backgrounds in areas of political science, sociology, philosophy, history, anthropology, law, theology, aesthetics, design and innovation, tourism and leisure management, cultural economics, leadership and strategy, pedagogic study, and other areas. What unites faculty in our department is an overriding concern for the organization of the human within its multiple environments: work, nature, economy, civil association, the state, and corporation. 

Teaching responsibilities of the Department comprise undergraduate and graduate teaching as well as teaching in post-experience and doctoral education. Some programs are taught in Danish, some in English.

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

Are you an experienced OT SCADA professional who wants to help secure the reliable operation of business-critical systems? Would you like to apply your technical expertise in an operational technology environment supporting the future of renewable energy?

As our new OT SCADA Engineer (Integration & Operations), you will be responsible for engineering, integrating, maintaining, operating, and continuously improving SCADA systems, ensuring data flows between power plants, market-facing control applications used by BA Markets, the Operational Control Centre’s monitoring and control systems, and other data consumers underpinning Vattenfall’s business-critical renewable-energy Operational Technology applications.

You will participate in the team’s on-call rotation to support business-critical services that operate around the clock. You will help restore service during incidents and implement corrective and preventive improvements.

A key part of your role will be applying structured engineering, security and lifecycle-management principles to keep the platforms reliable, supportable and compliant with Vattenfall standards and operational requirements. You will work closely with internal colleagues, external stakeholders and suppliers.

Be in your element with BA Wind

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Your role

As an OT SCADA Engineer, you will take ownership of SCADA systems and related data flows throughout their lifecycle, from initial analysis and engineering through implementation, operation, improvement and eventual replacement or decommissioning.

You will combine hands-on technical work with structured planning, documentation, and collaboration. Your focus will be on maintaining secure, reliable, and scalable SCADA systems and proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen performance, availability, and operational resilience.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Engineering, configuring, commissioning, maintaining, and improving OT SCADA solutions and interfaces for assets in operation and development.

• 
Delivering and supporting reliable data flows from plant-level systems through approved OT integration layers to monitoring, control, analytics, reporting, and data-platform consumers.

• 
Assessing site and interface readiness, identifying integration prerequisites, technical constraints, dependencies, risks and ownership boundaries, and defining requirements and integration approaches.

• 
Configuring, deploying, and supporting resilient SCADA integration components, including industrial edge devices or gateways, connectors, and data pipelines, with appropriate monitoring, troubleshooting, deployment documentation, and operational handover.

• 
Planning, estimating, and tracking assigned work, making dependencies, risks, and progress visible, and documenting and maintaining technical records and operational knowledge.

• 
Providing operational support, including incident diagnosis, service restoration, root-cause and problem analysis, defining and implementing preventive and proactive improvement actions.

• 
Participating in the team's on-call rotation, providing specialist OT SCADA support for business-critical services outside normal working hours.

• 
Improving observability and data quality through health monitoring, completeness checks, alerting, backfilling support, performance analysis, and clear operational ownership.

• 
Planning and executing lifecycle upgrades, migrations, patches, configuration changes, and component replacements using approved change and DTAP practices.

• 
Producing requirements, designs, implementation guides, configuration records, test cases, support documentation, and operational handover packages including operational runbooks, support responsibilities and escalation arrangements

• 
Supporting technical purchasing and supplier coordination through technical evaluations, solution validation, and design reviews.

• 
Preparing and executing tests and commissioning checks for assigned solutions, recording test evidence, tracking defects to resolution, and supporting factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT), acceptance decisions, and operational-readiness assessments.

• 
Standardizing repeatable integration services and work packages for asset projects, while supporting refinement and estimation of less standardized initiatives.

• 
Supporting internal and external audit activities.

Your profile

You hold a relevant bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, automation or control engineering, computer engineering, technical computer science, industrial IT, or a related discipline. Alternatively, you have developed equivalent professional competence through a relevant technical qualification and substantial experience in OT SCADA engineering.

You have several years of hands-on experience engineering, integrating, and supporting SCADA systems or comparable industrial OT solutions, including responsibility for systems in operation. You thrive when taking ownership of solutions from analysis and design through to implementation, operation, and continuous improvement. You are equally comfortable working independently and collaborating with colleagues, suppliers, and stakeholders across the organisation. To succeed in this role, you must have excellent written and spoken English skills. The role may also be subject to security clearance, and candidates must be able to meet the applicable screening requirements.

You bring knowledge and experience in:

• SCADA systems and interfaces: configuring, integrating, commissioning, managing, maintaining, operating, and supporting SCADA applications, gateways, and interfaces connecting operational assets with central systems and data consumers.

• Industrial communications: working with relevant industrial protocols such as OPC UA, IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus TCP or MQTT, as well as APIs and vendor-specific interfaces where applicable, and diagnosing communication and integration issues.

• Operational resilience: practical understanding of high availability, service monitoring and logging, SCADA application and configuration backup and recovery, and configuration management, including dependencies on hosting and network services.

• Operational data flows: understanding signal mapping, timestamps, data quality, buffering, and the recovery of missing historical data.

• Incident and problem management: diagnosing faults across SCADA applications, interfaces, source and target systems, including dependencies on server services, networks, certificates and service accounts; restoring services; investigating root causes; and implementing preventive and proactive improvements.

• Controlled technical changes: planning and delivering upgrades, migrations and configuration changes with appropriate testing, deployment documentation, rollback arrangements and operational handover.

• Secure OT operation: applying OT security requirements, including access controls, certificate handling, system hardening and vulnerability management, within approved architectures and change procedures and in collaboration with cybersecurity and infrastructure teams.

• Engineering documentation: producing and maintaining clear technical documentation of SCADA system architectures, configurations and procedures.

• Supplier collaboration: supporting technical purchasing, assessing and validating solutions, supporting acceptance testing and coordinating technical work with colleagues and external suppliers.

Additional experience that would be valuable:

• Renewable energy, utilities or comparable industrial environments.

• OEM SCADA interfaces.

• Industrial edge platforms or gateways.

• SCADA historians, SQL databases, scripting and automation.

Personal traits

To succeed in this role, we believe that you:

• Bring strong analytical skills, approach technical challenges with proactive, structured problem-solving, and remain composed when resolving operational incidents.

• Communicate clearly and can connect technical, operational and supplier-related perspectives.

• Are comfortable taking end-to-end responsibility, from analysis and planning through implementation and delivery.

• Work independently while contributing actively and collaborating effectively across disciplines with internal and external stakeholders.

• Are organised, reliable and committed to high-quality documentation.

• Take a proactive approach to continuous improvement.

• Use sound judgment to balance immediate service restoration, long-term reliability, maintainability and agreed delivery priorities.

• Are willing to participate in the team’s on-call rotation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.description:
With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

About the team

Join our Transfer Pricing team of more than 45 colleagues in Copenhagen and Aarhus. We help international and Danish businesses turn complex tax, finance and operating-model questions into practical solutions. As a Manager, you will bring your experience to a collaborative team, take a leading role in client engagements and contribute to developing our people and practice.

You will lead a broad range of projects for clients across sectors. Working with colleagues across Deloitte, you will turn complex analyses into practical advice and take responsibility for engagements from planning through to delivery. You will also help develop less experienced colleagues and continue building your own technical and leadership skills through training in Denmark and at Deloitte University in Paris.

Ready to take the next step in your career? In this role, you will:

• Manage transfer pricing engagements across advisory, compliance and disputes, overseeing teams, timelines and quality.

• Build client relationships and deliver practical advice with colleagues across Deloitte’s international network.

• Develop less experienced colleagues through feedback, work review and knowledge sharing.

• Help grow our practice by spotting new opportunities and shaping solutions for existing and new clients.

We work in a dynamic, international environment with an informal tone, where quality, collaboration and different perspectives are central to how we create value for clients and for each other.

AI-enabled and digital tools are a natural part of how we work. You will help identify where they can add value to research, analysis and delivery, while applying sound judgement and maintaining responsibility for the quality of the work. No specialist AI expertise is required, but curiosity and a willingness to improve how we work matter most.

We value the community that extends beyond client work. Our employee association brings people together throughout the year - from social events to shared experiences that cut across teams and business units. We celebrate the wins, big and small, and make a point of recognising individual and shared milestones.

The role is full-time, and we are looking for professionals for our offices in both Copenhagen and Aarhus, Denmark.

We are looking for experienced transfer pricing professionals who are ready to take responsibility for client engagements and contribute to the development of our team. You may already be working as a Manager ready for the next step.

You combine technical expertise with a practical understanding of client needs. You take ownership, collaborate openly and are comfortable coordinating the work of others while remaining hands-on with analysis and delivery.

What you bring to the team:

• A relevant academic background, such as law, economics, finance, accounting or business.

• Solid experience in transfer pricing, gained in an advisory firm, an in-house role or a comparable environment (minimum 5 years).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex technical and financial information into clear recommendations.

• Curiosity about technology and judgement when using AI-enabled tools.

• Clear written and verbal communication, and confidence discussing technical matters with clients and colleagues.

• An interest in developing others through guidance, feedback and knowledge sharing.

• A strong client-service mindset and an interest in building relationships and contributing to new opportunities.

• Work permit in Denmark

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

Send your CV, grade transcript and an application outlining your motivation for joining our Transfer Pricing team and highlighting relevant experience by 4 December 2026. We regularly call for interviews, so send your application already today.

Please do not hesitate to contact Partner Cecilie Emilie Rendtorff at crendtorff@deloitte.dk or Aske Haahr Lauridsen at aslauridsen@deloitte.dk if you have any questions about the position.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Student Assistant - Digital Transformation & Solutions (Palantir Foundry / Skywise)

Organization: Product Management - Transformation

Location: Ørestad, Copenhagen

Working Hours: 15-20 hours per week (flexible around lectures and exams)

Start Date: Flexible / As soon as possible

Do you want to combine your university studies with hands-on experience in a leading global aerospace company? Are you eager to master enterprise data platforms, work with cutting-edge digital tooling, and turn business strategy into impactful digital solutions?

At Satair, an Airbus Services Company, we are looking for a motivated Student Assistant to join our Transformation team situated within the Product Management organization. You will be part of a multi-disciplinary group of transformation managers, product specialists, and data professionals driving digitalization across our commercial product portfolio and services.

Working directly inside Airbus Skywise (powered by Palantir Foundry), you will help build data pipelines, expand our business ontology, and craft intuitive tools that empower product managers and business stakeholders to make data-driven decisions on a global scale.

**What The Job Is...

**You will sit at the intersection of business requirements and technical execution, helping turn product strategies, market dynamics, and portfolio needs into scalable digital tools. In this role, you will gain verifiable, enterprise-grade experience with Palantir Foundry-one of the most sought-after platforms in modern data and enterprise architecture.

**Your primary tasks will include:

**

• Building and maintaining data transformation pipelines and ontology logic using SQL, PySpark, and TypeScript within Airbus Skywise

• Designing and expanding object models, properties, and relationships within the Skywise Ontology to reflect core business concepts, product portfolios, and commercial workflows

• Developing intuitive decision-support tools, applications, and interactive interfaces using Foundry Workshop

• Collaborating with transformation leads, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into clear, functional digital solutions

• Assisting with ad-hoc business data analysis, pipeline monitoring, and troubleshooting

**What We Are Looking For

****Core requirements:

**

• Active enrollment in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field

• Working proficiency in SQL, Python, and TypeScript

• Solid grasp of relational data structures, data modeling, and business logic

• Strong curiosity and eagerness to learn-no prior experience with Palantir Foundry or Skywise is required; we provide full onboarding and mentorship

• Clear, professional communication skills in English (written and spoken)

**An added advantage (Priority 2):

**

• UI/UX design capabilities: Experience or strong interest in user interface design, visual hierarchy, wireframing, or mapping intuitive user journeys for business applications and decision tools

• Experience with PySpark or large-scale data processing

• Basic version control using Git

• Interest in digital product management, portfolio strategy, or agile transformation

**Location & Working Setup

**

• Location: Our modern office in Ørestad, Copenhagen-located right beside the M1 Metro and regional train lines for an easy commute from DTU, ITU, KU, and CBS.

• Hours: Approximately 15-20 hours per week, planned around your university lecture schedules.

• On-Site & Hybrid Setup: To give you a solid foundation, your onboarding will take place primarily on-site at our Ørestad office so you receive close, daily mentorship in Skywise from senior team members. Once you are comfortable with the platform and workflows, hybrid flexibility will be available.

• Exam Flexibility: We prioritize your academic success and offer full flexibility during university exam periods.

**What We Offer At Satair

**

• Practical Enterprise Experience: Build verifiable, highly marketable skills in Palantir Foundry and the Skywise ecosystem.

• Strategic Business Impact: Work on solutions that directly shape product decisions, portfolio visibility, and digital transformation across an international organization.

• Mentorship & Career Growth: Direct coaching from experienced transformation, product, and data professionals, with potential opportunities for Master’s thesis collaboration or future graduate roles.

• Informal & Inclusive Culture: A flat, international environment where student perspectives are valued and independent initiatives are encouraged.

• Employee Perks: Competitive hourly pay, an outstanding subsidized in-house canteen, social team events, and modern office facilities.

**About Satair, An Airbus Services Company

**Satair is a premier global provider of aftermarket material management and service solutions for the civil aviation industry. As an Airbus company, we operate across 11 international locations with more than 1,800 dedicated employees, keeping commercial fleets flying safely, efficiently, and sustainably.

**Ready to come on board?

**Submit your CV and a brief cover letter (or a summary of relevant projects and coursework) as soon as possible. Applications are evaluated on an ongoing basis.

Satair is committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds, genders, ages, and perspectives.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

Netcompany DK and NBS are part of the wider Netcompany Group. While Group Finance defines the finance framework, standards, and processes, you are responsible for translating these into the local context and supporting the Danish business in making informed financial and strategic decisions.

You will work closely with the local Finance leadership team, Group Finance and your fellow Accounting managers across the Netcompany Group. We are ambitious in how we develop our Finance organisation and actively embrace new technology and ways of working.

**

We’re looking for a Commercial Enablement Manager to drive commercial readiness and effectiveness across Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, and our partner network. Using data, customer insight and market intelligence, you’ll shape our enablement strategy to strengthen our value proposition, focus on the right opportunities and drive measurable revenue growth.

Reporting to the Director of Revenue Operations (RevOps), you’ll join our newly established Revenue Operations & Commercial Strategy team, alongside Business Intelligence, Marketing Automation & AI, and Product Marketing. Together, we own the commercial revenue engine across Sales and Marketing.

Your focus will be turning insight into action to improve pipeline, conversion, retention and cross-sell. You’ll play a key role in our 2027 priorities, including ABM in priority sectors, growth in DACH and the Nordics, partnerships and portfolio cross-sell.

We are open to on-site, hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET).

**About Us

**Our group brings together three European software brands that help organisations earn and use data with trust: Cookie Information for consent management; Piwik PRO for privacy-by-design analytics and data activation; and Sheltr for reliably finding personal data in internal data sources.

Headquartered in Copenhagen with an office in Wrocław, our team of 180 people have been building trusted data solutions since 2011. We work with companies and marketing teams across various industries that take control of their data model, including some of the most data-sensitive clients in healthcare, finance, energy & utilities, and the public sector. We are proud that our clients rely on us to meet GDPR and EU data residency requirements across EMEA and the US, as this regulatory depth is hard to build and replicate. We believe compliance and performance are not opposites. Consented data, auditable analytics and full visibility of personal data belong to one data journey; together they form a foundation that marketing, IT, legal and the C-level can rely on.

Our journey is to move from a regulation-driven house of brands to one unified company with a clear point of view. We are creating a new category around this complete data journey, and together we are building an enterprise-ready, data-driven revenue engine led by thought leadership. Want to join us on this journey? Keep reading to find out how you can help shape this with us.

The Role

As our Commercial Enablement Manager, you’ll own the commercial enablement strategy and execution, roadmap and performance across Cookie Information, Piwik PRO and Sheltr. Through combining strategic direction with data-driven decision-making, you’ll equip our teams and partners to turn commercial opportunities into results.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Align programmes, content and priorities with commercial objectives, product strategy and brand positioning across all three brands.

• Partner with BI and RevOps to analyse CRM, pipeline, win/loss, sales conversation and customer data, identify performance gaps and measure revenue impact.

• Develop account- and sector-specific playbooks, messaging, competitive positioning, objection handling and customer proof points across the buying and renewal journey.

• Lead our commercial events strategy by setting objectives and target-account strategies for conferences, executive events and partner events, and measuring their impact on pipeline and customer relationships in collaboration with our events agency.

• Turn insights from Sales, CS, customers and partners into actionable improvements for Marketing, Product and RevOps.

• Own partner enablement by shaping partner onboarding, certification, train-the-trainer programmes, co-branded resources and sector initiatives that help agency and reseller partners sell our portfolio independently.

• Support launches, new propositions and priority segments, measuring adoption, knowledge and field effectiveness to continuously improve enablement.

• Equip customer-facing teams and partners to communicate our value in marketing analytics, privacy-first data and compliance.

**About You

**You’re a strategic, data-driven commercial thinker who turns customer insight and business performance into practical action. You understand that effective enablement is about driving measurable improvements, not simply producing more content or training. You’re comfortable setting direction, influencing stakeholders and owning outcomes, while staying close to what customer-facing teams need to succeed.

You bring:

• A commercial and data-driven mindset where you use data to set priorities, identify performance gaps and demonstrate the business impact of your work.

• Customer-centricity with the ability to turn feedback from Sales, Customer Success, customers and partners into improvements in messaging, processes and commercial effectiveness.

• Events expertise through your experiences shaping conferences, executive events or partner events around clear commercial objectives and measurable outcomes.

• Stakeholder leadership through cross-functional team alignment, influence without direct authority and coordination of internal stakeholders and external agencies towards shared goals.

• The ability to simplify complex topics, communicate a compelling value proposition and lead effective presentations and train-the-trainer programmes.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves:

• Experience with Piwik PRO or other web analytics platforms, such as GA4, Adobe Analytics or Matomo.

• Knowledge of GDPR/ePrivacy, consent management and data governance, or experience selling into regulated sectors such as healthcare, finance, energy and the public sector.

• Experience enabling agency partners in regulated markets, including US healthcare.

• Experience supporting multi-brand portfolios, cross-sell motions and commercial teams across European markets.

• Familiarity with enablement platforms such as Highspot, Seismic or Showpad, and conversation intelligence tools such as Gong.

• Knowledge of German, French or a Nordic language.

What we offer

• A compelling product and market opportunity helping us turn growing demand for privacy-first analytics and trusted data solutions into commercial growth.

• Ownership and impact potential where you can come and build our enablement strategy and shape how we sell across three brands and multiple European markets.

• Strategic breadth by connecting data-driven ABM, sector strategy, partner development, customer engagement and high-impact events.

• A voice in the business working closely with Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Marketing and RevOps to influence how we go to market.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.

This is what our recruitment process looks like:

• A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

• An in-depth interview with the hiring manager and a member of the team (online)

• A final interview with the hiring manager, including a live case (online)

This process is subject to change. All applicants who progress to the screening call will be informed of the full process as some stages may be combined and/or in person.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

**Your impact begins here

**As Accounting Controller, you will keep month-end close accurate and on time across a number of countries in Business Area (BA)West, while making the way we work simpler. You will oversee key affiliate finance processes, support Accounting Managers and drive projects that standardise, simplify and digitalise accounting. Your work gives affiliates reliable financial information and the support they need, strengthening Finance across Novo.

**What You’ll Bring

**To succeed in this role, you bring:

• A master’s degree in business, finance, economics or a similar field.

• More than 4 years of relevant experience from finance, consulting or a related environment, including accounting, financial reporting or finance operations.

• A solid understanding of month-end close activities and core finance processes, with knowledge of Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R) and/or Order-to-Cash (O2C).

• SAP experience.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to carry out structured ad hoc analyses.

• Experience working with stakeholders across countries or business areas.

• A proactive, service-oriented mindset, with strong organisational and communication skills and attention to detail.

• The ability to manage routine activities while contributing to projects and improvement initiatives, and the confidence to raise questions and drive improvements.

**What You’ll Do

**You will combine reliable delivery of day-to-day accounting with active work to improve how accounting runs across Business Area West.

• Perform routine accounting and reporting tasks for a number of countries during month-end close.

• Oversee affiliate finance processes across P2P, R2R and O2C, monitor process performance and follow up on issues to keep delivery timely and accurate.

• Support Accounting Managers with ad hoc analyses, reporting and general accounting questions.

• Guide and support affiliates and relevant Finance stakeholders.

• Participate in and drive projects across Accounting and Finance, identifying opportunities to improve processes, efficiency and collaboration.

• Contribute to standardisation and continuous improvement across the Accounting & Taxation organisation.

You will join the Accounting & Taxation BA West Centre of Excellence (CoE), based in Copenhagen, and report to the Associate Director Accounting & Taxation CoE. The CoE is responsible for Accounting & Taxation for nine affiliates across 11 countries: Denmark & Iceland, Sweden, Norway, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium & Luxembourg, Finland, Ireland and Portugal. It provides expertise, governance and support across accounting, tax, compliance and process excellence.

The team includes Accounting Managers and controllers who work as dedicated finance partners to individual affiliates, while two roles focus on the Business Area as a whole. You will work closely with Accounting Managers, affiliates and Finance stakeholders, and with colleagues in our shared service centre in Bangalore. Together you will keep processes running reliably and speak up early when something needs follow-up.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in an international finance environment where your expertise is valued and your voice counts. Combining day-to-day accounting with improvement projects gives you room to build new skills, broaden your view of Finance across several countries and see the difference your ideas make.

You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership, in a team that works together to improve how accounting runs.

• Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,180.00 to 838,130.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are motivated by delivering high-quality accounting support and making change happen across a complex organisation, apply by 19.11.2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: C# /.NET Software Developer – Team Sport Application
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop cutting-edge software applications for our world-leading products? Looking to use and grow your development skills in a fast-paced and creative environment? If this sounds like an exciting challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Team Sport Application: Where Trackman goes beyond golf

Trackman products generate extremely accurate measurements using a patented combination of camera and radar, which provide valuable insights for athletes ranging from top worldclass professionals to enthusiastic amateurs, as well as coaches, scouts, analysts and clubs of all levels.

As part of our company's continued expansion, we are looking for a .NET C# backend developer. You will join a department of 45+ skilled developers, and work in our Team Sport Application department, responsible for products used in baseball, softball, American football and football (soccer). You will be part of refinement, planning, implementation, testing and deployment to our customers.

We build applications hosted on distributed Linux servers running Docker, on Microsoft Azure technologies, on mobile devices and customer laptops. You will get to interact with skilled developers working across a range of platforms and apps. We always work with the latest LTS .NET version using C# with web frontends in React.

As part of our development toolkit, our teams actively use AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude to speed up coding, testing, and documentation — letting our developers spend more time on solving interesting problems and less on repetitive tasks.

You will join a team of skilled developers who love what they do and, in a role, where you can have a big impact both on what is being built and how it is built. We value having our developers being part of refinement and you will be deeply involved in finding great solutions from a technical as well as a user perspective together with our Head of Products and UI/UX designers.

Required skills:

• 
3+ years of working with .NET and excellent C# programming skills

• 
Professional usage of an IDE like Visual Studio or Rider

• 
Work in an agile environment with a strong focus on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and clear communication

• 
Good understanding of architectural patterns and software design principles

• 
Good communication skills and a positive and proactive mindset

• 
Experience with Git and Azure Infrastructure

Additional skills (not required, but nice to have):

• 
Experience with using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude)

• 
Experience with Docker and Azure Pipelines

All we ask is that you bring passion, curiosity and structure to our workplace. We are a company of many nationalities. Whether you are from abroad or already living in Denmark, we welcome talented people of any gender, nationality and belief. We think the right mix of people makes for the best culture and product.

At Trackman, we see AI not as a replacement for great developers, but as a tool that makes great developers even more effective — accelerating code reviews, catching bugs earlier, and freeing up time for the creative problem-solving that moves our products forward.

The IT landscape is evolving faster than ever and staying up to date with AI-assisted development is quickly becoming a fundamental part of the software development process.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**As our Lead Engineer- Data, you will set the architectural direction of the data platform that enables both the decisions we make internally and the data-driven features our customers rely on. Working with the Data, ML, Platform, and Product Engineering teams, you will keep ingestion, modelling, and orchestration dependable, and define the modelling, testing, and documentation standards the data function depends on. You will innovate on how people work with data, building the agentic tooling and semantic modelling that let teams across Planday work from trusted data with confidence.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Set the architectural direction of our data platform so it serves analytics, product engineering, and AI/ML from one coherent design, collaborating with Platform and ML engineering on shared infrastructure.

• Design the dbt models, semantic layer, and quality standards the data function depends on, with the validation and lineage to make them trustworthy downstream.

• Own orchestration and observability in Dagster, and onboarding new sources in a way that scales.

• Innovate on self-serve and AI-enabled analytics, from semantic models and agentic workflows to our BI layer.

• Build the historical and low-latency foundations that make predictive and real-time use cases possible.

• Introduce better modelling standards, tooling, and development environments.

• Keep the platform reliable, performant, cost-effective, and compliant.

**Success looks like

**

• Architecture that holds up as we scale and as new use cases emerge, and that other engineers follow as a pattern.

• Analysts ship faster and more efficiently because your tooling & standards remove friction.

• A drop in repeat requests to the data team, as stakeholders answer their own questions through agentic workflows.

• ML and product teams have the historical and real-time data they need, without bespoke workarounds.

• Strong working relationships with the Data, ML, and Platform teams.

**

• Deep, hands-on Snowflake and dbt experience: modelling, semantic layers, agents & skills, testing, performance and cost tuning.

• Production experience with a pipeline orchestrator, ideally Dagster (or similar Airflow, Prefect), including dependent workloads, partial failures, and observability.

• Software engineering discipline across CI/CD, testing, and code review.

• The ability to turn technical trade-offs into clear narratives that help stakeholders decide and trust the work.

As Safety Surveillance Principal Process Specialist, you will keep Safety Surveillance ready for every audit and inspection, and make sure the way we monitor safety information keeps pace with legislation. You will be a highly visible process expert: leading our contribution to inspections, co-driving regulatory surveillance and shaping how we integrate processes after acquisitions. Your work keeps surveillance of Novo’s marketed and developmental products compliant, simpler and focused on the work that adds most value.

What you’ll bring

You know drug safety from the inside, and you know what it takes to get an organisation ready for an inspection. You will also bring:

• A Master’s degree in Life Sciences, such as Pharmacy, Medicine, Veterinary Science or Biology, or a related field.

• At least 5–7 years of experience in pharmacovigilance, including supporting safety activities in clinical trials.

• Hands-on experience facilitating inspection set-ups, training colleagues and preparing an organisation for audits and inspections.

• Expertise in Safety Surveillance processes and an enterprise mindset: you understand the end-to-end process and can turn complex internal and external requirements into practical ways of working.

• A solid background in handling deviations and implementing process changes.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior internal stakeholders and external parties, and a collaborative mindset across functions and geographies.

• Resilience and a calm demeanour in a very busy environment, with the ability to multitask and prioritise your workload through complexity and challenge.

Desirable, but not essential:

Experience in process management and project management.

What you’ll do

You will be a recognised expert in key Safety Surveillance processes, helping the team work with greater simplicity and focus. The role covers a diverse range of tasks, and you could be part of an inspection from day one.

• Lead audits and inspections: coordinate Safety Surveillance contributions, prepare colleagues for interviews, ensure high-quality responses and keep oversight of findings and the associated corrective and preventive actions.

• Act as Process Expert for the signal management process and co-drive the Regulatory Surveillance process, ensuring full compliance with applicable legislation.

• Handle deviations and change requests in close collaboration with colleagues in Safety Surveillance and other relevant functions.

• Support integration and acquisition activities by helping integrate pharmacovigilance processes and systems following company or product acquisitions and mergers.

• Contribute to process improvement projects aligned with our strategic objectives, using your end-to-end view of Safety Surveillance.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Safety Surveillance Centre of Expertise, a team of five engaged and skilled colleagues within Safety Surveillance, and report to the Director of Safety Surveillance Centre of Expertise.

Safety Surveillance is a department within Global Patient Safety in Research & Development, with departments in Bangalore, India, and Boston, US. Together, we are globally accountable for surveillance of all safety information for Novo’s marketed products and products in development. We also handle safety label updates, Risk Management Plans and aggregate reports.

You will work closely with colleagues across Safety Surveillance and partner with Global Patient Safety, other headquarters functions and affiliates during audits and inspections. When processes need to change, you will bring the right people together, create clarity on what needs to happen and help the team move forward with pace.

What you can expect here

You will have real visibility as a process expert, and the opportunity to influence how Safety Surveillance works and make a lasting impact. You will be trusted to take ownership, encouraged to make your voice heard, and supported by colleagues who give honest feedback and never compromise on patient safety or quality.

The pace is high and the work is varied. Through process improvement projects and a broad range of tasks, you will build new skills and deepen your understanding of safety surveillance end to end.

About the team

Join our Transfer Pricing team of more than 45 colleagues in Copenhagen and Aarhus. We help international and Danish businesses turn complex tax, finance and operating-model questions into practical solutions. As a Manager, you will bring your experience to a collaborative team, take a leading role in client engagements and contribute to developing our people and practice.

You will lead a broad range of projects for clients across sectors. Working with colleagues across Deloitte, you will turn complex analyses into practical advice and take responsibility for engagements from planning through to delivery. You will also help develop less experienced colleagues and continue building your own technical and leadership skills through training in Denmark and at Deloitte University in Paris.

Ready to take the next step in your career? In this role, you will:

• Manage transfer pricing engagements across advisory, compliance and disputes, overseeing teams, timelines and quality.

• Build client relationships and deliver practical advice with colleagues across Deloitte’s international network.

• Develop less experienced colleagues through feedback, work review and knowledge sharing.

• Help grow our practice by spotting new opportunities and shaping solutions for existing and new clients.

We work in a dynamic, international environment with an informal tone, where quality, collaboration and different perspectives are central to how we create value for clients and for each other.

AI-enabled and digital tools are a natural part of how we work. You will help identify where they can add value to research, analysis and delivery, while applying sound judgement and maintaining responsibility for the quality of the work. No specialist AI expertise is required, but curiosity and a willingness to improve how we work matter most.

We value the community that extends beyond client work. Our employee association brings people together throughout the year - from social events to shared experiences that cut across teams and business units. We celebrate the wins, big and small, and make a point of recognising individual and shared milestones.

The role is full-time, and we are looking for professionals for our offices in both Copenhagen and Aarhus, Denmark.

We are looking for experienced transfer pricing professionals who are ready to take responsibility for client engagements and contribute to the development of our team. You may already be working as a Manager ready for the next step.

You combine technical expertise with a practical understanding of client needs. You take ownership, collaborate openly and are comfortable coordinating the work of others while remaining hands-on with analysis and delivery.

What you bring to the team:

• A relevant academic background, such as law, economics, finance, accounting or business.

• Solid experience in transfer pricing, gained in an advisory firm, an in-house role or a comparable environment (minimum 5 years).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex technical and financial information into clear recommendations.

• Curiosity about technology and judgement when using AI-enabled tools.

• Clear written and verbal communication, and confidence discussing technical matters with clients and colleagues.

• An interest in developing others through guidance, feedback and knowledge sharing.

• A strong client-service mindset and an interest in building relationships and contributing to new opportunities.

• Work permit in Denmark

Please do not hesitate to contact Partner Cecilie Emilie Rendtorff at crendtorff@deloitte.dk or Aske Haahr Lauridsen at aslauridsen@deloitte.dk if you have any questions about the position.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve.
