You will use your technical expertise to solve complex challenges, strengthen operational resilience and improve the systems that enable us to supply high-quality medicines to patients.

What you’ll bring

You are an experienced, curious and solution-oriented automation professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges in a production environment. You combine hands-on automation expertise with a structured approach and the ability to collaborate across technical and business functions.

We’re looking for:

• 
A relevant degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field.

• 
At least five years of experience with industrial automation, preferably within pharmaceutical, biotech, food, chemical or another regulated manufacturing environment.

• 
Strong knowledge of PLC, SCADA, historian, process control, industrial communication and automation infrastructure technologies. Knowledge of iFIX and WinCC would be an advantage but is not essential.

• 
Hands-on experience with platforms such as Siemens, Rockwell, Emerson, ABB, Schneider Electric, AVEVA, Ignition or comparable technologies.

• 
Experience with troubleshooting, automation projects, commissioning, testing, qualification and transitioning solutions into stable operation.

• 
An understanding of system lifecycle management, change control, documentation, computerised equipment validation and risk-based decision-making in a regulated environment.

You will also bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to challenge existing solutions, influence technical direction and build trusted relationships across functions.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will take ownership of automation solutions throughout their lifecycle and help turn technical challenges into sustainable improvements. You will:

• Ensure stable, reliable and compliant automation systems supporting critical manufacturing processes and equipment.

• Design, implement and improve solutions across PLC, SCADA, historian, control system and industrial infrastructure environments.

• Drive solutions to complex automation challenges together with Production, Engineering and external partners.

• Support projects from early concept and design through testing, commissioning, qualification, handover and operational readiness.

• Lead lifecycle activities including upgrades, migrations, patching, standardisation and obsolescence management, while identifying opportunities to improve system reliability and production performance.

• Provide technical expertise during troubleshooting, root cause investigations, deviations and corrective and preventive actions, while sharing knowledge with colleagues and exploring technologies that can strengthen future manufacturing capabilities.

To support the production as an advanced Automation Professional you will become part of future on-call establishment.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the IT/OT and automation organisation at our Bagsværd site within Global Manufacturing & Supply.

Working closely with colleagues across Production, Quality, Engineering and IT/OT, as well as external partners, you will help ensure our automation, control systems and infrastructure are reliable, compliant, secure and prepared for future demand.

You will work in an environment where technical knowledge is shared across disciplines and where your contribution is visible in the solutions that support manufacturing performance, product quality and the patients we serve.

What you can expect here

You will have the opportunity to take ownership of technically complex automation challenges and influence solutions from early design through implementation and lifecycle management.

The role offers broad exposure to production technologies and improvement initiatives, alongside opportunities to build relationships across automation, production, engineering and quality. Most importantly, you will be able to see how your technical expertise contributes to reliable manufacturing and medicines reaching patients.

What we offer

At Novo, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary:  For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200  to 838,100 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to use your automation expertise to strengthen reliable and future-ready manufacturing, apply for the Advanced Automation Professional role in Bagsværd.

The Application deadline is the 11th of November 2026.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**The Manager, Corporate Supply Chain Planning is responsible for coordinating end-to-end supply planning and execution for assigned products across Genmab’s global commercial supply chains, ensuring reliable and compliant product supply to markets.

Working closely with CMOs and internal cross-functional stakeholders, the Manager maintains up-to-date supply plans and coordinates operational planning and execution processes. The role ensures transparency of batch status, supply priorities, responsibilities, and risks, with timely follow-up and escalation to support supply continuity in a global, GxP-regulated environment. The role also collaborates with Clinical Supply to support alignment across commercial and clinical supply needs.

You will be joining the Corporate Supply Chain Planning team, reporting to the Senior Director. The team is responsible for Genmab’s global supply chain planning activities and supports Genmab’s mission to transform patient lives through innovative antibody medicines.

**Key Responsibilities

**As Manager, Corporate Supply Chain Planning you will be responsible for planning and executing supply chain activities across commercial programs, for an assigned product/product group or supply chain, ensuring alignment between demand, manufacturing, and distribution.

• Oversee daily supply chain operations, including order management, replenishment, inventory planning, and supply planning across international markets

• Coordinate operational planning and execution processes across Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing Life Cycle Management, Logistics, and CMOs for assigned products, ensuring supply plans remain up to date and that batch status, priorities, responsibilities, and risks are transparent across functions

• Facilitate daily operational meetings to coordinate activities, track agreed actions, and escalate issues impacting supply through established governance

• Act as key interface with CMOs to align on production schedules, execution, and supply priorities

• Serve as key user of ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA), supporting planning, execution, and data integrity

• Ensure GxP compliance across the supply chain in collaboration with Quality Assurance, including deviation handling, root cause analysis, and CAPA implementation

• Identify, assess, and mitigate supply and capacity risks, developing contingency plans that strengthen business resilience and protect patient supply

• Support audits, inspections, and regulatory compliance activities through proper documentation and process adherence

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, new product introductions, CMC project activities, and process standardization efforts that improve planning maturity, execution reliability, and scalability

• Contribute to the S&OP process for assigned products through supply planning inputs, risk assessments, and scenario evaluations

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Life Sciences, or a related field

• +6 years of experience in supply chain planning, logistics, or a related function

• Experience within biotech, pharmaceutical, or other GxP-regulated industries is preferred

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA) and supply planning tools

• Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and forecasting (e.g., Excel, Power BI, or similar tools)

• Familiarity with global supply chain operations and Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) is an advantage

**Moreover, You Meet The Following Personal Requirements

**

• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills

• Solid written and verbal communication skills

• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities

• Ability to operate effectively in high-pressure, deadline-driven environments

• Advanced user of Microsoft Office Suite

• Understanding of GMP/GDP requirements within regulated supply chains

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK584.000,00---876.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Are you ready to lead Deloitte’s most strategic pursuits across the Nordics? Join our Nordic Technology & Transformation Sales Excellence team as an experienced Pursuit Lead and head some of our largest and most complex pursuits from early positioning through proposal and client presentation_._

About us

With more than 8,000 employees, Deloitte is one of the largest professional services firms across the Nordics. We help clients navigate complex business and technology transformations by combining deep industry expertise with leading capabilities in Audit, Tax, Advisory, and Consulting.

Join our diverse Nordic Technology & Transformation Sales Excellence team and help shape Deloitte’s most strategic pursuits. We combine pursuit expertise, insight and creativity to develop compelling propositions that stand out with clients. Our open, supportive culture encourages knowledge-sharing, fresh thinking and innovative tools to improve how we work. You will have opportunities to grow professionally and personally, build relationships across Deloitte and help shape the team’s approach to strategic pursuits.

This role could be placed in either Copenhagen, Denmark or in Oslo, Norway.

What will be your role?

We are looking for an experienced Pursuit Lead to join our team. You will project manage some of Deloitte’s most strategic pursuits across the Nordics, leading the end-to-end pursuit process from pre-RFP planning through proposal development, client presentations and follow-up. Using strong project management skills, you will create structure, momentum and quality across complex pursuits, while working closely with pursuit leadership and multidisciplinary teams.

Beyond managing the process, you will, together with rest of the Sales Excellence team, bring a strategic mindset, helping teams develop compelling and differentiated propositions.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Leading the pursuit process: Drive the plan with the client service pursuit lead, set milestones and deliverables, track assignments, manage meetings and logistics, and mitigate risks to deliver high-quality submissions that meet client requirements.

• Developing the winning strategy: Work with the Pursuit team to shape compelling value propositions, winning messages and a differentiated strategy for each opportunity.

• Coordinating proposal and presentation development: Oversee documents, design and quality and risk reviews, ensuring consistent strategic messaging across all deliverables.

• Engaging stakeholders and governance: Align senior leaders, subject-matter experts, client service teams and other internal stakeholders; facilitate leadership and quality reviews; and coordinate quality and solutions reviews.

• Managing risks proactively: Identify content and knowledge gaps, identify risks and escalate issues when appropriate.

• Driving innovation and continuous improvement: Apply best practices and lessons from past pursuits and the wider network. Use AI and innovative tools to improve research, collaboration, content and quality, and support learning initiatives that strengthen Deloitte’s sales excellence capabilities.

Who are we looking for?

You are a structured and proactive pursuit professional who can work independently while enabling effective collaboration and momentum across diverse teams. You combine sound judgement and analytical thinking with strong interpersonal skills. You maintain composure, flexibility and attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

What you bring to the team:

• Strong project management skills: Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage complex workstreams and maintain excellent quality control over milestones and deliverables.

• Pursuit and proposal experience: At least three years of experience in pursuit and proposal development, preferably in B2B / Professional services sales. A former consulting client-service background combined with pursuit experience is an advantage.

• Stakeholder leadership: Experience collaborating with and building consensus among executive, management and delivery stakeholders, including the ability to navigate differing opinions constructively.

• Proactive and analytical mindset: A self-starting approach, strong analytical skills and the ability to identify gaps, challenges and risks before they affect delivery.

• Resilience and flexibility: Ability to work well under pressure, maintain composure and adapt to shifting priorities and deadlines.

• Team orientation and interpersonal skills: A collaborative working style and strong relationship-building skills that foster trust, alignment and effective teamwork across diverse stakeholders.

• Language skills: Proficient in written and spoken English. Knowledge of another Scandinavian language is a benefit.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

What impact will your role make?

Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration and high performance. We do not just aspire to make solutions. We wish to create an impact that makes a positive and crucial difference for the people around us, our clients and our society. Deloitte is where you’ll find unlimited opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.

Do you want to be part of our team?

Please submit your CV and answer a few questions about your experience.  We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the position once the right candidate has been identified.

The formal application deadline is December 1st, 2026.

Please do not hesitate to contact Karine Bergeron at kabergeron@deloitte.no if you have any questions about the position.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

jobs.occupation: Nordic Global Benefits Management Leader - Copenhagen or Stockholm area
jobs.description:
Shape the future of Global Benefits Management across the Nordics – building on a strong client portfolio, accelerating growth, raising our market profile and developing the next generation of Nordic GBM talent.

The Role

Lead WTW’s Nordic Global Benefits Management business within Integrated & Global Solutions. This high-impact role combines market leadership, business development, client management and people leadership across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland. As a visible senior representative of WTW, you will build trusted relationships with executive decision-makers and help multinational organisations turn global benefits strategies into action.

This is a market-facing growth role. You will originate, shape and convert significant GBM opportunities across the Nordic region while protecting and expanding WTW’s existing client portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

• Shape the market – Be a recognised voice for GBM across the Nordics and strengthen WTW’s profile with multinational employers, external advisers and internal stakeholders.

• Accelerate growth – Build and convert a sustainable, multi-year Nordic pipeline, winning significant new GBM mandates and creating a stronger platform for long-term growth.

• Lead priority pursuits and client relationships – Shape compelling value propositions, navigate complex commercial discussions and help teams convert major opportunities into long-term mandates. Act as executive sponsor for selected priority clients, protecting renewals, expanding relationships and maintaining continuity from the sales process through implementation and ongoing delivery.

• Connect the best of WTW – Bring together capabilities and people from different parts of WTW to address complex client needs across the Nordics and beyond.

• Ensure excellent delivery – Provide oversight across client engagements, helping teams deliver against agreed objectives, quality standards, budgets and timelines.

• Grow our people – Coach and mentor Nordic GBM colleagues, strengthen commercial capability, support succession planning and develop future leaders.

About you

You are an established senior leader with deep knowledge of the Nordic market, a strong network and a proven record of delivering growth. Strategic and hands-on in equal measure, you build credibility quickly with C-suite executives, international benefits leaders and colleagues at every level.

Experience and capabilities

• 10+ years’ experience advising multinational organisations on global or regional employee benefits programmes and related consulting services.

• A strong record of winning complex engagements, meeting sales and utilisation goals, and building trusted relationships with senior decision-makers across the Nordic market.

• Demonstrated success managing major client relationships, leading cross-country teams and delivering multiple high-quality projects on time and within budget.

• A confident professional presence, with polished written and verbal communication skills.

• Sound judgement, strong problem-solving skills and the flexibility to diagnose issues and move them towards resolution.

• The ability to see the bigger picture, connect capabilities across practices and turn data into clear insights and practical solutions.

• A genuine commitment to coaching, training and mentoring colleagues.

• Confidence using Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint, together with AI-enabled tools.

• A bachelor’s degree.

• Willingness to travel across the Nordic region and internationally as required.

• International work or living experience and foreign-language skills are welcome but not essential.

What we offer

Join a collaborative international team with a strong client portfolio and significant room to grow. You will have the platform to shape WTW’s Nordic GBM strategy, build a high-performing regional business and make a visible contribution to our ambitions. We offer flexible working arrangements and a competitive total rewards package, including performance-related and locally relevant benefits.

About WTW and IGS

WTW combines data, insight and expertise to create solutions across people, risk and capital.

You will join WTW’s Integrated & Global Solutions (IGS) team and be based in the Copenhagen or Stockholm area, with flexibility around location.

IGS brings together more than 350 colleagues across WTW’s global network to address the headquarters needs of multinational clients. We help organisations navigate the business, cultural, linguistic and regulatory complexities of operating across markets.

Equal Opportunity Employer

WTW is committed to equal opportunity and an inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from qualified candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, perspectives and locations.

Combine hands-on software development with team leadership and make a real impact on cybersecurity and global security

Are you an experienced software engineer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges and helping other developers succeed? Do you want to combine hands-on development with team leadership and have a direct influence on the architecture and evolution of mission-critical products?

This is your opportunity to make a difference.

Our client, Arbit Cyber Defence Systems, is growing rapidly and is looking for a dedicated Software Development Team Lead to join its R&D department in Hvidovre, just outside Copenhagen.

In this key role, you will lead a team of software engineers while remaining close to the code, the architecture and the technology. You will take ownership of software releases, Linux systems and development processes, helping ensure that your team delivers robust, high-quality software that meets the highest standards of security and performance.

If you are ready to combine technical depth with people leadership and contribute to protecting critical networks and sensitive information across borders, this could be your next career move.

About Arbit Cyber Defence Systems

Arbit develops high-end network protection solutions for an international customer base, including intelligence agencies, armed forces and national governments. Its certified Cross Domain Solutions, including Data Diodes and TRUST Gateways, enable secure data transfer between networks operating at different security classification levels. With customers operating in some of the world’s most demanding security environments, Arbit plays an important role in protecting sensitive information and securing critical digital infrastructure across national borders.

Arbit’s R&D department brings together two development teams—Release and Project—alongside project management, hardware engineering and quality assurance specialists. You will join a highly skilled, collaborative environment where technical excellence, innovation and reliability are essential.

The role: Technical leadership with real influence

Reporting directly to the CTO, you will lead the Release development team, taking responsibility for its technical direction, delivery and people development. You will work closely with the CTO on technical decisions and development planning, helping translate product ambitions into robust, well-engineered solutions.

You will balance hands-on engineering with leadership, ensuring that your team has the direction, structure and support it needs to succeed.

Your Key Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership & Software Development

• Combine hands-on software development with responsibility for the architecture, design and continuous improvement of Arbit’s core products.

• Develop high-performance software components for unidirectional data transfer, with a strong focus on security, reliability and maintainability.

Release Management & Linux Systems

• Own software releases, ensuring efficient development processes, reliable CI/CD pipelines and delivery of high-quality software on time.

• Oversee Linux systems, make sure that a good infrastructure and hardware/software integration is built.

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, motivate and develop your team, creating a positive environment where people thrive, grow their skills and deliver their best work.

• Set priorities, drive progress and represent the team within the organisation.

Collaboration & Innovation

• Work closely with the CTO on technical decisions, architecture and development planning.

• Collaborate with Project Development, Quality Assurance, Service Delivery and Product Management to ensure thorough testing, smooth delivery and continued product innovation.

Your background

We are looking for an experienced software engineer with a strong systems mindset and a genuine interest in leading people.

You understand that a single line of code can affect the security, reliability and performance of an entire hardware/software system. You enjoy diving into technical details, but you also know how to create clarity, set direction and bring out the best in a team.

You may already be an experienced Team Lead looking for a role with substantial technical depth—or a senior engineer who is ready to take the next step into formal leadership.

What you bring

• Extensive software engineering experience: At least 10 years of professional software development experience, ideally including the development of a software product from the ground up through to production. Experience with Java and C++ is highly relevant.

• Leadership potential: Experience in team leadership and people management is an advantage. Alternatively, you may have mentored less experienced developers and be ready to take on your first formal leadership role.

• Strong systems understanding: A solid foundation in computer science, software architecture and system design, ideally complemented by knowledge of relevant standards and compliance requirements.

• Linux expertise: Practical experience with Linux system management and a good understanding of system integration, build environments and release infrastructure.

• A structured, proactive approach: You create momentum, establish clear priorities and take ownership of progress and results.

• A collaborative mindset: You communicate clearly, build strong working relationships and enjoy working across disciplines.

• Relevant education: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field.

• Language skills: Fluency in English is essential. If you are not fluent in Danish, you should have a good understanding of the language.

Security clearance: Due to the nature of Arbit’s customers and products, you must be eligible to obtain and maintain a SECRET (HEMMELIGT) security clearance.

Why join Arbit?

• Make a difference: Develop advanced cybersecurity solutions for international clients and help protect critical networks and sensitive information.

• Shape technology and people: Influence core product development while leading a skilled team of engineers in a collaborative R&D environment.

• Flexibility and benefits: Enjoy flexible working hours, the option to work from home, a pension scheme, healthcare, fitness facilities and team-building activities.

• A close-knit team: Join a growing company with more than 25 employees, an informal culture and a strong team spirit.

More about Arbit Cyber Defence Systems

Founded in 2006, Arbit has established itself as a specialist in advanced cybersecurity solutions for highly sensitive environments. As the need to protect critical networks and information continues to grow, Arbit’s technology plays an increasingly important role.

Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insight they need to make better financial decisions. All connected directly to the Danish tax authority. We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.

Our platform has grown with us. The infrastructure that keeps Skatteguiden running has reached a scale and complexity that deserves full-time, specialist ownership, and the work ahead makes this an unusually good time to join.

About the role

You'll be joining the Platform team as a Platform Application Engineer, the counterpart to our Operational Platform team, which owns the infrastructure. Where they own the systems that keep Skatteguiden running, you'll own the shared application-layer services that the rest of engineering depends on.

The team treats these services as a product, with engineers distributed across several product teams as their users. Every product team touches payments, identity, and integrations. Your job is to make those services reliable, well-designed, and genuinely easy to build on, across a microservices architecture that favours low coupling and event-driven communication over direct dependencies.

We operate on a simple principle: you build it, you own it. That means end-to-end accountability, from design and implementation through to what happens when something goes wrong. Incidents aren't escalated to someone else's queue; they're yours to understand, resolve, and learn from.

What you'll do

Own the shared application platform. Design and build the core backend services underpinning payments, identity, authorisation, and third-party integrations — the shared foundation that product teams rely on every day.

Build and maintain payment services. Design payment flows that are reliable, observable, and compliant. Work with product teams to support new features and providers without coupling concerns or creating fragility in the critical path.

Own identity and authorisation. Design the systems that manage who our users are and what they can do — from OAuth flows and token management to fine-grained permission models and audit trails.

Integrate security and privacy into the application layer. Work with our Head of Security & Privacy to translate requirements into technical controls — particularly in identity, authorisation, and data handling — with GDPR and ISO 27001 in mind.

Integrate third-party systems. Own the integration layer connecting messaging, payment providers, and others. Ensure resilience, observability, and clear contracts.

Improve the developer experience. Build shared libraries, abstractions, and internal tooling that make it easier for product engineers to build on top of platform services correctly and confidently. Reduce the cognitive load on teams that shouldn't need to think about auth or payment internals.

Who we're looking for

You're likely a senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, and who sees that role not just as backend development but as a product discipline — with the engineers who depend on your services as your primary users.

You take end-to-end ownership seriously. You don't consider something done when the code is merged, you care about how it behaves in production, you're on the hook when it doesn't, and you treat incidents as feedback worth acting on.

You're genuinely collaborative, someone who makes the people around them better, shares context freely, and doesn't work in isolation. And you're curious: you like trying new things, you're not attached to the way things have always been done, and you get energy from learning.

Must-have

A senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, writes clean, maintainable services, takes API design seriously, and cares about the boundaries between components.

Hands-on experience deploying and debugging services on Kubernetes in production; you know how to get code running reliably in a Kubernetes environment without needing to own the cluster.

Experience designing MySQL schemas for production, migrations, indexing, query performance, and keeping data models clean as requirements evolve.

Working knowledge of message brokers such as RabbitMQ, event-driven patterns, consumer reliability, and how to design async communication that is easy to reason about across a distributed codebase.

Understanding of identity and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, RBAC), and how to implement them securely and maintainably at scale.

Security, privacy, and compliance awareness. You design with GDPR, auditability, and least-privilege access in mind from the start, not as an afterthought.

A platform as a product mindset. Experience thinking about developer experience as a product discipline, not just an engineering concern.

Genuine enthusiasm for AI. You use it daily, and you're always looking for new ways to apply it.

Nice-to-have

Experience building or operating payment integrations — familiarity with PSPs, webhook reliability, idempotency, and reconciliation.

Familiarity with React and TypeScript — enough to read, understand, and occasionally contribute to frontend code when the work calls for it.

Familiarity with Azure. You know your way around the platform — how services connect, how access and permissions work, and how to build in a cloud-native context.

Familiarity with our observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry.

Familiarity with our GitOps tooling: ArgoCD and GitHub Actions.

Why join us

A substantial project from day one. The hosting migration means designing a production system from scratch, rare at any company.

Real influence. The architectural decisions made in this team will shape how Skatteguiden is built and operated for years. It's a small team with a high degree of autonomy, and the work is genuinely consequential.

Strong engineering culture. We take the technical foundations seriously. Security, architecture, and technical debt get real attention, not just lip service.

The product matters. Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden. Your work keeps it running and makes it possible to grow.

Solid company. We're independent, profitable, and growing. No VC pressure, no bloated roadmap. Just a clear mission and a team that cares.

A company that's serious about AI. We use AI across the business and we're only going deeper. Being a small, focused team means we can move fast on this, no lengthy approval chains, no slow rollouts. If you're always looking for ways to work smarter with AI, you'll fit right in.

Good people. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. The culture is professional, informal, and genuinely collaborative.

Practical detailsLocation

Copenhagen. We're an office-first company, and it's a deliberate choice. We're moving fast, we have big ambitions, and we genuinely believe that being physically together is one of the things that makes that possible. Things move quicker when you can turn your chair and talk to someone. We want to be upfront about this so you know what to expect.

And if we're asking people to be in the office, we want it to be worth their while. We're a five-minute walk from Rådhuspladsen, stocked with everything from fruit to fizzy drinks to afternoon snacks, and lunch is at Claus Meyer's canteen just across the street, proper food, not an afterthought. If you're putting in a long day, dinner is covered too.

Start: As soon as possible

Salary: Competitive and based on your experience.

Reporting to: CTO

Screening call with our recruiter (30 min) ONLINE

Technical interview with the manager and an engineer (120 min) ONSITE

Meeting with our CEO (45 min) ONSITE

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

The Opportunity

Veo’s web platform brings together some of our most important customer experiences. We are looking for a Staff Experience Designer with deep Web expertise to own design outcomes for our Core Web Experience and help raise its quality across the teams that contribute to it.

This is a hands-on, AI-first individual-contributor role. You will lead complex cross-team design work, bring a strong point of view, and support other designers with feedback, frameworks, and shared patterns.

You will partner with Stakeholders, Product Managers, and Engineers to connect customer needs, business goals, and technical realities, align teams, and carry ideas through to high-quality outcomes.

**What You Will Do

**

• Create frameworks, prototypes, and reusable guidance, and provide constructive feedback that helps other designers and teams deliver high-quality work.

**What You Could Bring

**

• 10+ years of experience in product design with a strong track record of designing and shipping sophisticated web products and leading complex work involving multiple teams.

Veo is a global leader in AI-based sports camera technology. Our innovative, fully automatic camera solution enables sports teams to record matches and training sessions without a camera operator. We’re democratizing the world of sports by granting video analysis for teams on all levels—a privilege that used to be only for the few. More than 40,000 clubs in 90+ countries record their games every week.

But what truly sets us apart? Our people. We’re a diverse group of innovative thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who believe in delivering an incredible product—and having fun while doing it.

The Opportunity

Veo's Revenue Platform is the engine that drives the business. Each subscription, order, invoice, payment and shipment passes through the platform that our team built. We are looking for a senior engineer to help take it to the next level.

The team owns the core revenue engine that sits between Veo's products and the systems that run the business: billing, payments, CRM, ERP and fulfillment. Other teams use our APIs to sell, quote, bill and provision. Finance relies on us to get the numbers right.

The foundations are in place. The next chapter is about making the platform more robust, easier to build on, and ready for new markets, products and pricing models. You'll model subscription lifecycles, amendments, quotes, tax and payment flows. You'll make workflows stay correct when a third-party API fails halfway through an order. You'll also work closely with Finance, Sales and Product so the business logic in code matches how the business actually works.

What You Will Do

• Evolve and scale backend services in Rust that process real revenue: orders, subscriptions, invoicing, payments and provisioning.

• Strengthen our Temporal workflows so they are reliable, idempotent and safe to change, through versioning and replay.

• Shape the Revenue Platform API into a clear, OpenAPI-first product that internal teams can adopt with confidence.

• Improve our integrations with billing, payment, CRM, ERP and logistics providers, and handle their failure modes properly.

• Turn ambiguous commercial requirements (pricing changes, new markets, new payment methods) into correct, well-documented business logic.

• Own what you ship in production: observability, alerting, incident response, and data migrations that touch thousands of customer accounts.

• Incorporate modern AI development tools into your workflow to iterate quickly and build thoughtful software solutions.

• Set technical direction for the platform's next phase, and raise the bar through design reviews, code reviews and testing.

What You Could Bring

• 5+ years as a software engineer, with significant backend experience.

• Backend experience using Python, Rust, or another comparable language. Rust in production is ideal, but we'll also consider strong backend engineers who have built real things in Rust and want to go deeper.

• Experience in revenue-critical domains is a plus: billing, subscriptions, payments, e-commerce, or financial systems.

• Strong API design skills, and experience integrating with third-party APIs that don't always behave.

• Experience building distributed systems where correctness under failure matters.

• The judgement to make architectural calls and to improve a live system without stopping the business.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams. You've worked closely with product managers, designers, finance, data and commercial stakeholders, and you're comfortable bringing them along on technical trade-offs.

• A product-oriented mindset. You care about the outcome, not just the code. You ask why before how, and you treat the platform's API and its internal users with the same care as an external product.

• Curiosity about modern AI development tools and how they can support everyday engineering workflows.

• Fluent English, written and spoken.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking a Senior Logistics Consultant to provide strategic logistics and maritime advisory services to clients, support the development and expansion of PEAK Wind's logistics service portfolio, and oversee the day-to-day management of client and managed vessels.

Introducing the Operations Delivery Team

You will become part of our Operations Delivery team, where we work collaboratively to support renewable energy projects around the world. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Operations Delivery Manager and work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As a Senior Logistics Consultant, you will contribute to the success of our clients and renewable energy projects. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Manage and optimise client and PEAK Wind vessel fleets, ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant operations.

• Lead vessel chartering, procurement, tendering, and contract management activities.

• Act as the primary interface with vessel owners, OEMs, ports, regulators, classification societies, and clients.

• Oversee vessel maintenance, assurance, audits, and operational readiness programmes.

• Represent clients during vessel newbuild, mobilisation, commissioning, and major modification projects.

• Develop logistics strategies, drive operational improvements, and deliver cost optimisation initiatives.

• Provide consultancy and advisory services on maritime logistics and asset management topics.

• Act as PEAK Wind's logistics and maritime Subject Matter Expert (SME), analysing operational performance and providing insights to internal stakeholders and clients.

• Own logistics assumptions and benchmarks used in OPEX modelling and business case development.

• Develop PEAK Wind’s logistics service offerings and lead strategic initiatives that strengthen client value and market competitiveness.

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• Bachelor's degree in maritime studies, marine engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience e.g. in vessel management, logistics optimisation, or maritime operations.

• Experience in offshore renewables is an advantage

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written

• A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to take initiative

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross-functional team

• Strong project management and stakeholder management competencies

• Experience and industry recognised qualifications in safety management

Why Join PEAK Wind

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth.

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

As a Senior Front-End Engineer, you will co-own the front-end experience for Performativ's trading and analytics platform, building high-performance interfaces used by wealth managers and financial institutions. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct ownership of architecture, implementation, and production outcomes.

About the team 👥

The engineering team owns the platform that powers portfolio management, trading, analytics, reporting, compliance, and client engagement at Performativ. Front-end engineers work closely with backend engineers, product, and design to turn complex financial workflows into software that advisors can use every day.

The team ships continuously and gives engineers ownership over implementation decisions. On the front end, the current focus is scaling a Next.js and React architecture across increasingly sophisticated workflows while keeping performance, server and client boundaries, theming, and shared components under control.

About the role 🎯

We are looking for a Senior Front-End Engineer to co-own the quality, performance, and architecture of our trading and analytics interfaces. This role is responsible for building production UIs, shaping front-end architecture, and raising the standard of our shared component infrastructure.

You will work closely with backend engineering, product, and design to ship financial workflows from requirements through production. You will co-own the end-to-end front-end scope, including server and client boundaries, hydration strategy, state management, performance, multi-tenant theming, testing, and the component library used across the platform.

This role requires deep React and TypeScript expertise, strong architectural judgment, and the ability to turn complex financial workflows into fast, usable interfaces. You need to be comfortable making implementation decisions independently and shipping production software without management overhead.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together from our city-center office, with working from home possible when there is a good reason. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What you'll do 📈

• 
Build high-performance trading, analytics, and portfolio management interfaces used by wealth management professionals.

• 
Co-own front-end architecture across Next.js 15, React Server Components, TypeScript, and our shared application infrastructure.

• 
Define server and client boundaries, hydration strategies, and state patterns that keep the platform responsive as complexity grows.

• 
Scale our shared component library and multi-tenant theming across the platform.

• 
Improve runtime performance, bundle size, rendering behavior, and application responsiveness.

• 
Ship production features quickly while making architectural decisions that hold up as the product scales.

• 
Use AI coding agents where they improve engineering throughput while maintaining control over code quality and implementation decisions.

• 
Strengthen front-end testing and delivery across Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, and CI/CD workflows.

• 
Co-own implementation decisions from product outcome through production deployment.

What we're looking for 🔍

• 
Have built sophisticated production web applications with React and TypeScript and can structure front-end codebases that continue to work as product complexity grows.

• 
Understand modern React architecture, including React Server Components and the Next.js App Router, or can demonstrate the technical depth to become productive with them quickly.

• 
Have shipped production work using AI coding agents and understand where they improve engineering output and where direct engineering judgment is required.

• 
Have improved front-end performance through decisions around bundle size, hydration, rendering, data fetching, and runtime behavior.

• 
Are comfortable managing server state with TanStack Query and can make deliberate decisions about colocated state and client state libraries.

• 
Have built or extended component systems using tools such as Radix, shadcn/ui, or custom design systems.

• 
Understand usability, accessibility, and interaction design well enough to make sound UX decisions without treating design as somebody else's problem.

• 
Have shipped tested production software using tools such as Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

Preferred experience ➕

• 
Have worked on trading, investment management, portfolio analytics, or other data-intensive financial applications.

• 
Have worked with AG Grid or comparable data-grid infrastructure for complex datasets and interactions.

• 
Have worked in a pnpm and Turborepo monorepo with generated API types from OpenAPI specifications.

• 
Have designed front-end systems supporting multiple tenants, brands, or configurable themes.

• 
Have mentored engineers or raised engineering standards without moving away from hands-on development.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Work that reaches production fast. We ship weekly. Your work will be used by advisors and financial institutions within days, not quarters.

• 
Colleagues who set a high bar. Our team comes from Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, and Amazon. Standards are high. Politics are absent.

• 
Career compression. People here take on scope in twelve months that takes five years elsewhere. If you can carry it, we will give it to you.

• 
Direct access to founders, customers, and the market. You will sit in the rooms where decisions get made.

• 
Backing from leading venture funds, and a mandate to become the European standard rather than a regional alternative.

About Performativ 🚀

Wealth management runs on software built for a different era. Batch files. Overnight reconciliation. Client reports assembled by hand. Advisors spend more time fighting their systems than advising clients. The industry has accepted this for thirty years.

We are replacing that layer. Performativ is one platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, and client engagement, built from the ground up for how wealth is actually managed today. Banks, family offices, and independent advisors across Europe run on it.

We are a scaleup, not a startup. The product is live, the customers are real, and the growth is ahead of plan. We intend to be the system European wealth management runs on. That is not positioning. It is the plan we are executing against.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com

The bar 🔥

We are builders. We move fast, we say what we think, and we do not manage each other. Autonomy is the default, which only works if you are the kind of person who does not need to be told twice.

This is not a role for someone looking to coast inside a growing company. It is a role for someone who wants scope, wants pressure, and wants to point at something in two years and say they built it. If that is you, apply. If it is not, this will be uncomfortable, and we would rather say so now.

Benefits

Join Pharmacosmos in a newly established function, in a role combining people leadership with direct involvement in clinical processes, compliance and continuous improvement.

Build and lead a new Clinical Administration & Compliance function

As Director, Clinical Administration & Compliance, you will report directly to the Senior Director, Head of Clinical Operations, Trine Kolding, and take on a key role combining leadership with hands-on responsibility for clinical trial administration, processes and operational GCP compliance.

You will lead and develop the Clinical Administration and Process Management functions, setting clear priorities and direction while fostering collaboration, accountability and high-quality delivery. At the same time, you will remain actively involved in developing, implementing and continuously improving processes that support effective and compliant clinical trial execution across R&D.

A key responsibility will be to translate ICH-GCP, regulatory expectations and internal requirements into practical, risk-based ways of working. You will contribute directly to operational compliance, documentation practices, TMF quality, sponsor oversight and inspection readiness, ensuring that processes are robust, pragmatic and consistently applied. Working closely with trial teams and stakeholders across R&D, you will identify opportunities to simplify and strengthen processes and drive improvements through implementation.

A hands-on leader who enjoys making compliance work in practice

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience from clinical research or clinical development within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or CRO environment, combined with strong practical knowledge of ICH-GCP and the processes and documentation required to execute and oversee clinical trials. You have hands-on experience with clinical trial processes, SOP implementation, TMF and essential documentation, as well as inspection readiness.

You have gained leadership experience, ideally within Clinical Operations, Clinical Process Management or a related area, while remaining motivated by direct involvement in the work. Experience working across functions and navigating multiple stakeholders within an R&D and trial-execution environment is essential.

You genuinely enjoy working with clinical processes, compliance and continuous improvement and are motivated by a role that combines leadership with hands-on responsibility. You bring a pragmatic and risk-based mindset, enabling you to translate regulatory requirements into practical ways of working while balancing compliance, simplicity and effective trial delivery.

As a person, you are structured, collaborative and confident in engaging stakeholders across Clinical Operations and the wider R&D organization. You are comfortable setting direction and priorities while staying close to the details, and you have the judgement and drive to identify areas for improvement and turn them into sustainable ways of working. You communicate clearly at all levels and have the natural authority to engage and motivate people. You are fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

Join a highly collaborative Clinical Operations team

You will join a highly collaborative Clinical Operations environment built on trust, ownership and strong collegial relationships. We learn from each other, share responsibility and solve new challenges together rather than working in silos.

As Pharmacosmos continues to grow, you will have a genuine opportunity to shape how we work as the organization develops and make a visible contribution to both Clinical Operations and the wider R&D organization.

Play a crucial role in an exciting international growth journey

This is your chance to embark upon a personal and organizational journey in a dynamic company where your know-how is greatly needed for the future development of Pharmacosmos. The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search. For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Sr. Executive Search Consultant, Lars Nordlund, on +45 3123 3018. All requests will be handled confidentially. If this position is for you, do not hesitate to apply by uploading your CV - it is not necessary to include a cover letter.

Pharmacosmos

Pharmacosmos A/S is a global leader in carbohydrate chemistry and innovative treatments for iron deficiency and iron deficiency anaemia. Building on our foundational expertise in carbohydrate chemistry and cell cycle biology, we develop innovative treatments for unmet patient needs, with a focus on iron metabolism and blood-related disorders. Founded in 1965 and headquartered in Denmark, our team is made up of more than 650 specialists across the UK, Ireland, the Nordics, Germany, Canada, and the USA. Are you motivated by leading people at the intersection of quality, laboratory systems and daily operations?

Join Bavarian Nordic as QC Manager for LIMS & Release and help your team deliver dependable system support and release activities that enable vaccine manufacturing.

**Your team and leadership environment

**LIMS & Release consists of 12 colleagues: four responsible for raw material release and Certificates of Analysis (CoAs), one dedicated IT Application Specialist, and seven working with daily LIMS activities and supporting the LabVantage project.

The team handles raw material release and CoAs, maintains LIMS methods and specifications, and provides day-to-day support to end-users, primarily within QC. This includes troubleshooting and resolving LIMS-related issues.

You will join a QC department of approximately 90 employees across six teams. Our Core Leadership Team of Senior Managers works closely with First-Line Managers, the Operational Excellence Partner and a Quality Integrator to develop people and processes and maintain strong quality oversight.

QC is undergoing significant change as we support increased production demands, improve efficiency and reduce lead times. As a first-line manager, you will translate changing priorities into clear direction while maintaining employee engagement, well-being and a strong quality mindset.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Lead a team with diverse responsibilities. Create shared direction across release activities, application support and daily LIMS work. Provide feedback, coaching and development planning so employees have the competencies and support they need to succeed.

• Ensure dependable daily delivery. Maintain an overview of workload, priorities and operational risks across raw material release, CoAs and LIMS support. Balance daily activities with the team’s contribution to the LabVantage project and respond to changing QC and manufacturing needs.

• Maintain compliant systems and processes. Ensure team activities comply with cGMP and the Bavarian Nordic Quality Management System. Promote data integrity, accurate documentation and inspection readiness across release processes and the maintenance of LIMS methods and specifications.

• Connect users and improve workflows. Coordinate with QC end-users, IT and manufacturing stakeholders to resolve issues and align priorities. Use data and digital tools to improve transparency and workflows, strengthening the team’s support for laboratory operations and reducing delays.

**Your profile

**

• You combine a people-focused leadership style with an understanding of how laboratory systems and release processes support quality operations. You can bring colleagues with different areas of expertise together and translate competing needs into clear priorities.

• A relevant scientific degree and experience from a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment, preferably within QC, laboratory support or a similar operational area.

• Experience with LIMS and an understanding of the importance of controlled methods, specifications and reliable laboratory data. Experience with LabVantage is an advantage.

• An understanding of raw material release and Certificates of Analysis, or relevant experience supporting comparable quality processes.

• A solid understanding of cGMP, data integrity and Quality Management Systems. Leadership experience is an advantage, together with the ability to develop people across different disciplines.

• A structured approach to prioritisation and improvement, with clear communication and the ability to collaborate across laboratory, IT and manufacturing functions.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic

**You will lead a team that connects laboratory systems, data and release activities with the needs of QC and manufacturing. The role offers broad cross-functional collaboration and the opportunity to influence processes, user support and digital ways of working.

You will be part of a leadership team that values employee development, coaching and collaboration. Through daily improvements and the team’s support for the LabVantage project, you can help shape how QC works while developing professionally in an international vaccine company.

**Ready to make a difference? Apply now!

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

**About BLAST

**BLAST is a global competitive entertainment company working with some of the world's biggest game publishers, brands and entertainment properties to create world-class esports and live entertainment experiences.

We operate globally across multiple ecosystems, delivering everything from large-scale arena events and broadcasts to digital products and content.

Our values — Make it Bold, Make it Together and Make it Happen — shape how we work, collaborate and deliver.

**At BLAST, we bring people together - across borders, stages, and time zones. Now we're looking for a Global Mobility Consultant to join our team and help us ensure that our people can thrive wherever in the world our events take them.

You'll be part of a small but passionate team of colleagues, working closely with People and Culture, Travel, Finance, Legal, and Live Events to build and run a world-class mobility framework that supports BLAST's global growth.

**What You'll Be Doing - Your Impact

**As our new Global Mobility Consultant, you'll make it easier for people to move across borders with confidence - whether they're employees, freelancers, or part of our extended network.

**Your key responsibilities include:

**

**You're an excellent communicator, a proactive problem-solver, and a trusted partner to your colleagues. You thrive in a dynamic environment, love the details, and care about creating smooth experiences for people on the move.

**Requirements

****Experience:

**

• A degree in HR, Business Administration, Legal - or equivalent experience

• 3+ years of experience with international assignments and cross-border employment particularly in relation to North America and Asia

• Strong understanding of mobility processes and compliance

• Solid experience working with Excel (e.g. data management, formulas, reporting) Proficiency in tools like Smartsheet, Google Sheets, and AI and automation tools and platforms

• Experience providing team leadership, guidance, and mentorship within a small team environment

• Previous background in the sports, entertainment, or fast-paced live events industry, given the scale of international tournaments

• Demonstrated flexibility, interpretation, and creativity in navigating complex or ambiguous visa regulations across global destinations lacking standardized visa categories

• Experience with budget tracking, cost control, PO creation, and managing financial considerations related to global mobility and travel

• Proven ability to manage high-pressure situations, tight event deadlines, and complex logistical escalations independently

• Strong cross functional stakeholder engagement skills to coordinate seamlessly across all the internal Blast teams as well as external vendors

• Willingness to work flexible hours during major events or travel occasionally between the London and Copenhagen offices

**Benefits

****What We Offer - Life at BLAST

**

• At BLAST, you'll join a creative, collaborative, and international environment where no two days are the same. We're proud of our culture - one where people are seen, heard, and encouraged to bring ideas forward

**Here's a glimpse of what you'll get:

**

• A fast-paced and supportive workplace

• Great colleagues

• Flexible working conditions

• Centrally located office in Copenhagen

• Personal and professional development opportunities

• Friday bars, social events, and access to world-class esports action

Ready to join us?

We're excited to meet you. Apply now and help us shape the future of Global Mobility at BLAST
