jobs.occupation: Regulatory Compliance Specialist - 12 month parental leave cover
jobs.description:
As Regulatory Product Compliance Specialist in GN Hearing, you will contribute to our purpose of Bringing People Closer, by helping ensure that our hearing aid products remain compliant throughout their lifecycle.

You will support regulatory assessments, product changes, documentation, and process improvements that help bring safe and compliant medical devices to market and keep them there. In this role, you will support lifecycle compliance for hearing aids across new products and in‑market devices.

This fixed-term role - 12-month parental leave cover - offers a meaningful opportunity to develop your experience and expand your network. You will be part of a collaborative team, work on relevant priorities and gain insights that support your continued professional development—while making a valued contribution throughout the assignment. You will also build valuable knowledge of our organization, ways of working and opportunities across the business, helping you develop relationships and visibility for future roles in our company, should relevant opportunities arise.

**The Team You Will Be Part Of

**At our global HQ in Ballerup, Denmark, you will join the Regulatory Operations team and report to the Director, Regulatory Operations.

We are a collaborative team where learning, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are part of our everyday work. We encourage new ideas and give you the opportunity to develop both your technical and professional skills, while helping bring safe and compliant medical devices to market.

**Your Contribution Is Appreciated, And You Will

**

• Support regulatory compliance activities across the lifecycle of hearing aid products.

• Contribute to regulatory assessments and product change activities to help maintain continued compliance.

• Collaborate with colleagues across functions to support product development and product lifecycle improvements.

• Contribute to process improvements and efficient day-to-day ways of working.

• Identify opportunities to automate and streamline repetitive tasks using digital tools and AI where relevant.

• Support Agile ways of working

• Prepare and maintain clear regulatory documentation.

At GN Hearing we encourage flexible working when possible. We trust our people to fulfill their responsibilities, to know when in-person collaboration creates the most value, and to be present when it matters most.

**To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

**

• Hold a degree in Engineering or another relevant technical field

• Bring relevant experience from studies, internships, student roles, or an early-career position

• Have an interest in medical device regulation and quality, with some familiarity with frameworks such as MDR, FDA, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, or IEC 62366, or similar

• Understand how to work within procedures, controlled documentation, change control, and audit-ready processes

• Take a structured and risk-based approach to your work

• Communicate clearly and can adapt technical or regulatory topics to different audiences

• Work well both independently and in collaboration with others

• Are curious, analytical, and motivated to learn

• Are proficient in English, written and spoken

**You may be especially effective in this role if you have also worked with or have an interest in:

**

• Automation or digital tools, such as Python, Power Automate or Power BI

• AI tools that support efficiency and process improvement

• Agile or Scrum ways of working

**We encourage you to apply

**If your experience does not match every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. We know that relevant skills can come from different types of roles, studies, and experiences. We value transferable skills and motivation to learn. We also welcome applications from recent graduates who bring curiosity, structure, and a strong motivation to grow within medical device regulatory and quality work.

**We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. To support a fair and consistent process, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo.

If you need any adjustments or accommodations during the interview process, please let the Hiring Manager know when accepting the invitation to interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than November 30th, 2026.

Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying.

Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we may close the position before November 30th if we identify the final candidate earlier.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we develop technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We help people with hearing loss address real-life challenges, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and create strong experiences for audio and gaming users.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement **here.

**We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.occupation: Senior Product Development Manager (Maternity Leave Cover, 6-12 months)
jobs.description:
**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

****Full-time

****Maternity leave cover: January - June 2027

**As Senior Product Development Manager, you'll be the senior product voice in the Menu & Innovation team, owning our highest priority global NPD projects and the systems, standards and ways of working that sit behind every product we launch. Based at our Global HQ in Copenhagen, you'll work closely with Brand, Marketing, Operations, Technical, Franchise partners, Supply Chain and our supplier partners to make sure JOE products are consistently great in every market. This is a lead role in the menu & product team: you'll set the direction for how we develop, test and approve products worldwide, coach the wider team, and help shape how the team grows and operates globally. You'll have real scope to define the future of our global menu, always keeping juicer ease at the heart.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Drive end-to-end ownership of high priority global NPD projects, including new categories, new occasions and growth platforms, from brief through to in-store launch.

• Lead on all global NPD systems and processes, defining and continuously optimising them as JOE scales.

• Define and own the JOE global product testing framework and approach for all products, from scale-up kitchen trials to product operational testing to global scale commercial consumer testing.

• Lead on future NPD team growth strategies and the expansion of our global operating model.

• Own all core EPD quality workstreams across defined products and categories.

• Own all product and ingredient standards, making sure the JOE quality bar is upheld globally.

• Lead high functioning cross-functional project teams; with all global teams and local markets, from Operations and Marketing to Franchise and Supply Chain.

• Champion best-in-class trend diagnosis, coaching the wider team on how to diagnosis, read & interpret trends, in a Joe way, and run sharp competitor reviews to keep a finger on the pulse.

• Partner with all key suppliers, owning strong relationship management and engagement across current and new suppliers for current and future projects.

• Maintain and nurture a tightly connected global product network across equity and franchise; now and as it scales, so opportunities are identified, shared and recognised and everyone stays aligned.

• Key point of contact for our franchise team (current and new) on all product activity beyond equity stores; ensuring global brand consistency whilst driving local relevancy

**WHO YOU ARE

**

• A defining ability to translate concepts into scalable, operationally sound recipes without losing sight of brand and quality standards.

• Excellent project management skills and experience

• Senior stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions, markets and franchise partners.

• Experience coaching and developing others

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• Min. 8 years' experience in corporate product development, ideally within QSR (Quick Service Restaurant), with a track record of owning global or multi-market launches.

• Proven experience building or improving NPD systems, processes and testing frameworks, including scale-up, operational and consumer testing.

• Deep familiarity with stage-gate or gate approval governance.

• Strong supplier management skills, with experience owning relationships across a global supply base.

• Fluent in English - other languages are a bonus!

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 130 friendly faces come together!

• Enjoy our fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Join us for our lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars-there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Stay fit and healthy with our well-equipped fitness facilities, complete with showers and a relaxing steam room to refresh after your workouts.

Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

We are looking for a CRM & Lifecycle Manager to join Hårklinikken as we continue to develop and grow our global ecommerce business.

We operate six Shopify sites across the US, UK, EU, Denmark, Iceland and the UAE, with the US representing our largest growth market and subscriptions playing a central role in our model.

You will own the CRM and lifecycle journey across our markets, building the communication, flows and experiences that help turn first-time clients into long-term relationships. From onboarding and treatment support to subscriptions, repeat purchase, loyalty and win-back, you will help clients stay engaged, consistent and cared for throughout their journey with us.

Working hands-on in Klaviyo and Recharge, you will use data and customer insights to understand where clients engage, where they drop off and what helps them stay. You will continuously test and improve the lifecycle journey, with a particular focus on the first 90 days and subscription retention.

Success in this role means improving 90-day retention, increasing the number of subscribers who stay for at least three deliveries, strengthening repeat purchase rates and growing CRM revenue across markets.

You will track cohorts and LTV by market and share what you learn, helping those insights shape our wider acquisition and ecommerce activities.

Primary Relationships

You will report to the Global Director of Ecommerce and work closely with the Senior Ecommerce Manager as part of our ecommerce team in Copenhagen.

You will also collaborate closely with Brand, our clinics and our Client Care Teams, particularly around campaigns, the client journey, loyalty and client feedback.

You will work closely with our Content Marketing Manager, providing clear briefs for CRM campaigns and customer communications.

Key Responsibilities

• Klaviyo. Build and run flows, segments, campaigns and SMS across six markets, working with our Content Marketing Manager who develops copy from your briefs.

• The first 90 days. Own the onboarding journey for new clients, helping them start their treatment right and stay with it.

• Subscriptions in Recharge. Manage sign-ups, retention, churn and win-back, testing what helps subscribers stay longer.

• Consultation to treatment. Develop booking reminders and post-consultation flows that help turn consultations into lasting treatments, both in our clinics and at home.

• Loyalty, reviews and client feedback. Work closely with our Client Care Team to understand where clients get stuck and what brings them back.

• The campaign calendar. Coordinate the campaign calendar so CRM, the site and paid media go live at the same time with the same message.

Core Competencies

This role requires strong CRM and lifecycle experience combined with a hands-on, structured and analytical approach. You are comfortable working with data, understanding customer behaviour and turning insights into actions that strengthen retention.

You keep many moving parts on track and care about the client, not just the open rate. You understand how to grow retention through value rather than discounts, and you know when one email is one too many. You don't need to tick every box to be the right fit. We would love to hear from you if you bring strong CRM or lifecycle experience, a customer-focused mindset, a genuine interest in building relationships that last and supporting our mission

What You Bring:

• 3-5 years of experience in CRM, retention or lifecycle marketing, ideally within DTC ecommerce.

• Strong hands-on Klaviyo skills, with experience building flows, segments and templates yourself.

• Experience with subscriptions, ideally Recharge.

• A track record of delivering results that you can demonstrate through data.

• Confidence working with data, with the ability to read a cohort and understand what to test next.

• Fluent English.

It is an advantage if you also have:

• Experience working across several markets or Shopify storefronts, ideally including the US.

• Experience with a premium beauty, wellness or personal care brand with a regimen or subscription model.

• Experience with loyalty or review platforms.

• Proficiency in a Scandinavian language.

Who Are We?

Founded in 1992 in Copenhagen, Hårklinikken is a leading scalp and hair health clinic with more than 30 years of experience. We help clients achieve optimal scalp health and long-lasting hair gain, combining expert guidance with clean and gentle products formulated to support healthy hair growth.

Our approach began with Hårklinikken’s founder and lead researcher, Lars Skjøth, who developed a diagnostic, consultation-based approach centred around understanding each client’s individual scalp and hair needs. Today, The Hårklinikken Method brings together decades of expertise with the personalised care that has been at the heart of Hårklinikken from the beginning.

Clients come to us in different ways, whether through a consultation or by discovering and purchasing our products online. Through virtual consultations or in person at our clinics in New York, Beverly Hills, Copenhagen, Aarhus, Dubai and Reykjavik, our Hair Specialists combine their expertise with an individual assessment of each client’s scalp, hair, lifestyle and environment to create a personalised regimen designed around their specific needs.

However their journey begins, we are here to guide and support our clients along the way. From helping them find what is right for their individual needs to supporting them in achieving the best possible results, we want every client to feel confident, understood and cared for throughout their Hårklinikken journey.

We’re on a mission to help as many people as possible achieve fuller, stronger, healthier hair with products that are powered by science, perfected by experts and proven by over 100,000 clients.

What We Offer

• A new team, where you shape how we work from day one.

• Full ownership of CRM and subscriptions across six markets.

• Short decision paths in an owner-led company.

• Close collaboration with our clinics, where the treatment starts.

• A real work-life balance, with flexibility in how you plan your day.

• An international team and modern clinics with a strong focus on quality and aesthetics.

• Growth opportunities in a safe work environment.

• Pension, holiday allowance and discounts on our products and treatments.

The role reports to the Global Director of Ecommerce and is based on site in Copenhagen. It is a permanent, full-time position, starting as soon as possible and ideally no later than 1 March 2027.

Questions? Contact Emma Cronwall Trampedach at +45 3133 5432.

Equal Employment Opportunities

We offer equal employment opportunity to qualified individuals without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We strongly believe that cultivating a diverse workplace gives a company strength. The combination of unique skills, abilities, experiences, and backgrounds creates an environment that produces extraordinary results.

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Launch Manager for global launch projects
jobs.description:
Supply Chain Launch Manager for global launch projects

Would you like to help orchestrate the global launch of new products, representing our supply chain throughout the entire launch projects?

Join a global group of skilled supply chain professionals and follow new products from early development all the way to market – as your input will ensure that we deliver the best products to people with intimate healthcare needs.

“WE play a key part in planning and executing successful launches – and we are a valued voice in the process, allowing us to set a clear direction,” explains Head of Supply Chain Launch, Global Supply Chain Management, Daniel Arildsen.

Join our highly experienced Launch department

Together, we are 7 colleagues, responsible for supply chain activities related to bringing new and innovative products to market within Chronic Care and Wound Care products. A good part of our time, we spend working with our factories in Hungary, Costa Rica, and soon Portugal.

“As we are each dedicated to different projects, discussing what we’ve learned with each other is very important to us. And we’ll be there to make sure you get to ease into the position,” says Daniel.

Ensure that supply chain is covered in every project

As part of the Coloplast global supply chain, you will find yourself in the middle of a web of stakeholders working towards launching new Chronic Care and Wound Care products. Here, you will be dedicated to specific projects, acting as supply chain lead or subject matter expert, representing the voice of supply chain and making sure supply chain is on track for launch.

Specifically, you will be the subject matter expert from supply chain, staying up to date on project progression. Moreover, you will plan the launch and make sure that systems, manufacturing, stock levels, etc. are ready for launch. And when you meet a bump in the road, you will figure out solutions with the project team.

From early project development until post-launch, you will:

•    Influence project decisions and direction early, to avoid supply chain risks

•    Drive the supply chain plan with manufacturing sites, balancing project deliverables and commercial considerations to launch on time

•    Produce launch scenarios in collaboration with other departments and ensure alignment with the rest of the organization

•    Coordinate activities at our production sites and flag supply chain risks

•    Make sure systems, such as planning, base data and distribution, are ready for launch

•    Follow up on delivery performance of newly launched items after launch

Your work may take you traveling roughly 2 weeks per year, primarily to our factory in Hungary. However, you will have a say on how the trips are planned, so they will fit with the rest of your life.

Supply chain knowledge and stakeholder management skills

In this role, you must be able to work cross-functionally, using your good stakeholder management skills to incorporate a wide range of input from across the business. Also, you can work with limited supervision in your projects, representing the voice of supply chain, making decisions, and setting a direction for your area.

Finally, we imagine that you:

•    Have a degree in supply chain or engineering

•    Have some experience, either within supply chain or logistics and a good conception of production processes

•    Possibly have some experience working in projects, allowing you to consider both commercial and supply chain perspectives

•    Are good at Excel and at adapting to new systems

•    Are fluent in English

Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please reach out to Head of Supply Chain Launch,

Global Supply Chain Management, Daniel Arildsen on DKDAAR@coloplast.com. We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply. This position will remain open until a suitable candidate has been found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Data Scientist for Agentic Applications - Aarhus or Gdansk
jobs.description:
Experienced Data Scientist for Agentic Applications - Aarhus or Gdansk

Available in 2 locations

Viby J, Denmark, 8260

Gdansk, Poland, 80-244

Category: Information Technology

Permanent

Do you want to help shape the next generation of AI-powered business capabilities and are you motivated by turning business opportunities into intelligent agentic products?

“At Arla, we are scaling proven Data Science and Machine Learning capabilities into business-critical products that support commercial decisions across our markets. We are looking for someone who can combine strong quantitative modelling skills with modern software and AI engineering practices to help drive this journey.” says Andreas Therkildsen, Manager, IT Product Architect.

How you will make an impact

You will join a dedicated product team responsible for the Net Revenue Management (NRM) Commercial Intelligence Platform and its growing portfolio of pricing, promotion, forecasting, and AI-enabled capabilities. Working closely with commercial stakeholders, product owners, architects, engineers, and data specialists, you will:

• Build a deep understanding of pricing, promotions, demand drivers, and commercial decision-making within Net Revenue Management.

• Design and develop statistical, econometric, and machine learning models that generate actionable business insights.

• Apply Machine Learning models and inference techniques to evaluate commercial initiatives and identify revenue opportunities, and understand why the models perform as they do.

• Develop and operationalize forecasting, pricing, and promotional effectiveness models in production environments.

• Partner up with engineers and architects to establish scalable MLOps, model monitoring, and AI-enabled development practices.

• Help identify and mature new AI and Data Science opportunities into trusted business capabilities that create measurable value.

What will make you successful

You have hands-on experience with Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Engineering and modern AI tooling. You enjoy solving real business challenges and working at the intersection of business, data, and technology. You understand that successful solutions require strong statistical foundations, trusted data, and robust engineering practices. The ideal candidate brings:

• Strong experience with Bayesian hierarchical models using tools such as PyMC, Stan, or NumPyro, combined with solid statistical inference and model validation practices.

• Strong econometrics and causal inference expertise, including price elasticity modelling, endogeneity challenges, and deriving reliable insights from real-world commercial data.

• Strong Python and SQL skills, combined with experience deploying and maintaining models through automated pipelines, monitoring, testing, versioning, and MLOps practices.

• Practical experience with machine learning approaches such as XGBoost, LightGBM, and forecasting techniques for demand and baseline prediction.

• Daily use of AI-enabled development tools such as Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar, with the ability to critically evaluate generated outputs.

• A product-oriented mindset and the ability to translate business opportunities into scalable analytical solutions.

It is an advantage if you also have experience with:

• Pricing, Promotions, Revenue Growth Management, Commercial Intelligence, or Net Revenue Management.

• Optimization techniques and decision modelling using tools such as OR-Tools, Pyomo, or Gurobi.

• Advanced causal inference methods such as Causal Forests, Synthetic Control, Bayesian Structural Time Series, DoubleML, or EconML.

• Time-series forecasting approaches such as state-space models or Prophet.

• Databricks, Spark, Azure, and modern cloud-based data platforms.

• Retail and consumer datasets, or an MSc/PhD within Statistics, Econometrics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related discipline.

What do we offer?

This position is based in Aarhus, Denmark or Gdańsk, Poland, with an expectation of 50% office presence. You will work alongside skilled product teams, architects, engineers and data specialists and can help shape the future of AI-powered commercial capabilities within one of Arla’s strategically important business domains. We offer a flexible hybrid working model, competitive salary and benefits, and opportunities for professional development in a rapidly evolving AI landscape.

Would you like to join us?

If you are ready to help turn AI opportunities into real business value, we would love to hear from you. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once the right candidate is found.

For more information, please contact Andreas Therkildsen, Manager, IT Product Architect, athec@arlafoods.com.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Senior Director, Commercial Excellence & Commercial Strategy
jobs.description:
Do you thrive at the intersection between commercial strategy, transformation and execution. Do you enjoy setting the direction and then rolling up your sleeves to make it happen? Join 3Shape’s CCO Leadership Team and shape how a global MedTech leader grows. We are looking for someone who isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo and brings a healthy disruptive edge to how things are done.

About 3Shape

3Shape started with a simple idea: to make 3D scanning better. We applied it first to the hearing industry and then to dentistry, and today our scanning and CAD/CAM solutions help dental and hearing professionals treat more people, more effectively. Every second of every day, a 3Shape scanner is in use somewhere in the world. We are 2,200+ colleagues of 45+ nationalities, headquartered in central Copenhagen at Kongens Nytorv.

Our commercial organisation is approximately 1,000 people strong and delivers our products to customers in 29 countries across Europe, the Americas and Asia. Our flagship products include a mixture of hardware and software; TRIOS intraoral scanners, the Dental System CAD software and the 3Shape Unite platform.

Your new role

As Senior Director, Commercial Excellence & Commercial Strategy, you report directly to our SVP of Commercial (CCO) and act as a close sparring partner. You sit on the CCO Leadership Team with the leaders of Global Customer Success, Global Marketing and our three Regional VPs, and you lead a team of Commercial Excellence Managers, transformation agents, project managers and data and reporting specialists.

You own the commercial strategy for Dental Clinics, DSOs (dental service organisations) and Laboratories, and you build Commercial Excellence into a global function that turns strategic choices into growth across markets.

Leading leaders and running Commercial Excellence should come naturally to you. The real stretch in this role is driving a transformation and professionalization of the commercial organization with the aim of lifting topline growth.

You will work side by side with colleagues at our Copenhagen headquarters in Denmark, in an office-based role, and you will regularly travel to spend time with our great people in local sales hubs and meet customers at leading dental events around the world.

What you will do

Commercial strategy & transformation

• Own the three-year commercial strategy and the annual commercial strategy cycle, linked to budget, targets and business plans.

• Turn the strategy into a roadmap with clear owners, milestones and KPIs, and keep execution on track.

• Lead the CCO transformation portfolio and challenge how we get most impact across segments, markets, channels and new offerings.

• Build alignment across global functions, regions and markets, including through our Country Manager forum.

Commercial Excellence

• Define and scale the global Commercial Excellence operating model, from customer potential and territory management to sales plays and tools.

• Turn market, customer and competitor insight into decision-ready recommendations for the CCO Leadership Team.

• Set the CRM standard and the commercial performance framework together with IT, Data Management and Financial Planning & BI.

• Partner with Finance and Portfolio and Product Strategy (PPS) on pricing and discount governance, and enable go-to-market for new offerings.

• Drive launch excellence for new products and offerings, with a repeatable launch playbook, clear market readiness criteria and adoption KPIs that get new solutions into customers’ hands quickly across all markets.

What success looks like

• A three-year commercial strategy with clear priorities agreed in the CCO Leadership Team and linked to budget and targets.

• Commercial transformation delivering tangible impact with revenue growth, efficiency gains and capability uplift in priority markets, with learnings carried into the rest.

• Commercial Excellence established as a recognised discipline, with a strong team and a clear role across Commercial, Portfolio and Product Strategy (PPS) and Finance.

• CRM adopted to standard in all markets, and leadership decisions taken on a shared, current picture of market, customers and competitors.

• A proven launch excellence model in place, with new offerings reaching target adoption faster across markets.

Who you are

You are an experienced senior commercial leader with documented results from comparable roles. You hold a master’s degree in economics, business or similar, and you bring:

• Experience leading leaders and engaging, inspiring and developing people.

• A track record of owning and driving commercial strategy from within the business, rather than as an external advisor, with measurable results to show for it.

• Deep Commercial Excellence experience, including shaping and growing the function in a fast-growing organisation. MedTech experience is a plus.

• Experience leading complex, cross-functional transformations with executive stakeholders.

• Executive presence and the courage to challenge senior leaders and established ways of working.

• International experience from a global matrix organisation.

What 3Shape offers

• Real influence on how a global MedTech leader grows, a premium brand guided by innovation and customer focus.

• A strategic mandate across regions to shape our global commercial approach, with real room to influence and make decisions.

• A seat on the CCO Leadership Team and high visibility with senior leaders across 3Shape.

• A role as the CCO’s personal sparring partner on the commercial path forward.

• Global scale and impact across 29 countries, and the opportunity to lead a strong, international team.

• An attractive healthcare package, daily breakfast and lunch from our own chefs, and plenty of social clubs and activities.

• Modern offices in central Copenhagen, near Kongens Nytorv and Nyhavn.

Application process

• To apply, click "Apply now" and attach your CV including a short motivation in one document.

• Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About Apylon And The Opportunity

Apylon is building the intelligent revenue management platform for European healthcare. Billions of euros flow between hospitals and insurers through fragmented, manual workflows — a maze of rules, conditions and requirements.

We believe this is a machine learning and automation problem disguised as financial operations.

Apylon is backed by experienced operators and top-tier investors in healthcare and fintech. Our team draws on experience from Zendesk, Pleo, Wawa Fertility, Sibill, and some of the largest multi-country hospital groups in Europe.

As a Founders Associate, you’ll work directly with the founding team on the highest-priority challenges facing the company. This is a unique opportunity to gain exposure to all aspects of building a venture-backed startup — from strategy and operations to customer success and fundraising.

Delivering healthcare is hard. Getting paid for it shouldn’t be.

You’ll be responsible for

• Working directly with founders on day-to-day operations, strategic initiatives and special projects.

• Supporting customer onboarding and success — ensuring our healthcare clients get maximum value from Apylon.

• Conducting market research and competitive analysis to inform product and go-to-market strategy.

• Building and improving internal processes and operations as we scale.

• Supporting fundraising efforts — preparing materials, coordinating with investors, and managing due diligence.

• Wearing many hats — from data analysis to customer calls to operational firefighting.

• Helping build the company culture and team as we grow.

Who you are

• 1-3 years of experience in consulting, investment banking, venture capital, or a high-growth startup.

• Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills — you can structure ambiguous problems and drive to solutions.

• Strong communication skills — you can write clearly and present confidently.

• Highly organized with excellent attention to detail.

• Self-starter who takes ownership and gets things done without constant direction.

• Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change — you thrive in fast-paced environments.

• Genuinely curious about healthcare, fintech, and building companies.

Bonus points

• Previous startup experience or entrepreneurial ventures.

• Experience in healthcare or fintech.

• Fluency in German, Danish, or Italian.

• Technical background or comfort working closely with engineering teams.

What Apylon offers

• The chance to solve one of Europe’s biggest healthcare inefficiencies.

• Competitive salary + stock options (you’ll own part of what you build).

• 25 days of annual leave + local public holidays.

• Lunch on us

• Regular off-sites and social events — we like building together, not just working together.

• Unparalleled learning opportunity — direct exposure to all aspects of building a company.

• A clear path to growth as the company scales.

• This role may require international travel within the EU on a roughly monthly cadence.

Working at Apylon means embarking on a highly ambitious mission to rebuild the financial infrastructure of European healthcare. We’re already live with leading private hospitals, processing thousands of invoices, proving that complex payer rules can be turned into code - powering transparent, automated, and intelligent revenue operations.

How to apply. If you're excited by the challenge of building intelligent, high-impact systems at the core of European healthcare and enjoy shipping fast, we'd love to hear from you.

**Contact The Hiring Manager

Simon Sylvest

CEO & Co-founder

simon@apylon.co

Customised customer solutions require a supplier base that can support complexity, speed and technical value creation. As Sourcing Manager – Design-to-Order (DTO), you will strengthen NOVENCO’s competitive position by building supplier partnerships that support engineered solutions, modular thinking, cost optimisation and supply chain resilience.

**Your Impact

**

• Identify, evaluate and develop suppliers for customised components, balancing quality, cost, delivery performance, sustainability and supply chain risk.

• Bring the right suppliers into early design phases to support Design for Manufacturing principles and optimise total cost of ownership.

• Negotiate framework agreements, contracts and pricing structures that support volatile demand, complex components and project-specific requirements.

• Build long-term supplier partnerships capable of handling special materials, technical complexity, variable order volumes and long lead times.

• Monitor supplier performance through KPIs, with particular focus on delivery reliability, quality, cost efficiency and compliance with standards.

• Identify commonalities across customised products to increase component reuse, reduce complexity and support a more scalable supply base.

**What Drives Success

**

• Solid experience with Design-to-Order sourcing, international procurement and global supply chain management.

• Strong understanding of modular architecture, supplier segmentation, risk management, compliance and relevant quality and sustainability standards.

• Commercial strength combined with technical understanding from a project-oriented or engineered-to-order environment.

• Ability to challenge design concepts early to prevent unnecessary cost, complexity and material risk.

• Strong negotiation skills and professional English communication, both written and spoken.

**What We Offer

**

• A central role in Global Sourcing with direct impact on NOVENCO’s supplier strategy and competitiveness.

• The opportunity to shape strategic supplier partnerships for complex, customised and technically demanding solutions.

• Close collaboration with R&D, Project, Quality, Product Development and Supply Chain stakeholders.

• Exposure to international suppliers, markets and material networks, including expected travel of 30–40 days per year.

• Competitive salary and employee benefits in line with company policy.

• 25 days’ annual leave plus 5 days Feriefri after the qualifying period.

• Standard auto-enrolment pension scheme and access to a healthcare scheme.

• Professional development and training through NOVENCollege, with clear progression paths.

**Context

**The role is part of Global Sourcing and reports to the Head of Global Sourcing. You will work at the intersection of customised customer solutions, DTO, R&D, Projects and Supply Chain, with supplier visits in Denmark and internationally.

**How To Apply

**Please submit your CV via our careers page. Applications are reviewed on receipt and interviews are scheduled on a rolling basis.

NOVENCO Building & Industry is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

**Join Our Team as a Quality Control Manager

**We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Quality Control Manager to lead and develop our incoming quality control activities. This is a key role within our organization, ensuring that incoming materials and components meet quality requirements while supporting continuous improvement across our operations.

The successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining product quality, driving process improvements, and supporting production through strong quality leadership.

**Key Responsibilities

****Incoming Quality Control

**

• Take overall responsibility for Incoming Quality Control (IQC) activities.

• Ensure all incoming materials, components, and products comply with established quality requirements and specifications.

• Investigate and manage supplier-related quality issues and non-conformances.

• Work closely with Procurement, Supply Chain, Production, and Engineering teams to resolve quality concerns.

**Process Development and Improvement

**

• Lead the implementation of new procedures and standards for incoming inspection processes.

• Continuously improve inspection methods, quality controls, and efficiency.

• Develop and maintain inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and quality documentation.

• Support supplier qualification and supplier quality improvement initiatives.

**Quality Documentation

**

• Own and maintain controlled documents related to Quality Control activities.

• Ensure procedures, work instructions, forms, and records are current, accurate, and compliant with applicable standards and internal requirements.

• Support internal and external audits as required.

**Team Leadership

**

• Directly manage and develop one QC Technician.

• Conduct performance reviews, provide coaching, and support employee development.

• Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Operational Support

**

• Participate in daily production meetings and provide quality-related input.

• Collaborate with production teams to address quality concerns and minimize disruptions.

• Support root cause investigations and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities.

• Monitor quality performance and drive actions to improve product and process quality.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor's degree in Quality Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related technical field.

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in Quality Control, Quality Assurance, or Manufacturing Quality.

• Previous leadership experience is preferred.

• Experience with incoming inspection processes and supplier quality management.

• Familiarity with ISO 9001 and other relevant quality management systems.

• Strong knowledge of incoming inspection methodologies, AQL (Acceptable Quality Level) sampling plans, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, and Statistical Process Control (SPC).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and quality management software systems.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

**Personal Competencies

**We are looking for a candidate who is:

• Structured and detail-oriented.

• Proactive and solution-focused.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

• A strong communicator with excellent collaboration skills.

• Results driven with a continuous improvement mindset.

• Capable of balancing strategic initiatives with day-to-day operational responsibilities.

**What We Offer

**

• An exciting opportunity to shape and improve our quality processes.

• A collaborative and professional working environment.

• Opportunities for personal and professional development.

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• The chance to make a significant impact on product quality and operational excellence.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The AP Manager leads the Accounts Payable team and is responsible for ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely processing of supplier invoices and payments globally, safeguarding financial integrity and operational efficiency. The role ensures high-quality Accounts Payable execution across the team, oversees month-end and audit processes, and acts as the escalation point for suppliers and internal stakeholders. As part of Shared Services, reporting to the Head of P2P, this position leads a team of 7 FTEs across multiple entities and is accountable for financial governance, KPI performance, and driving the function's transition from manual to automated, scalable processes. The role is a full-time position and reports to the Head of Procure to Pay.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Lead, coach and develop a team of 7 FTEs across the Accounts Payable function.

• Approve journals and oversee approval of new vendors and vendor changes.

• Own the monthly close process for Accounts Payable, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.

• Manage and delegate audit deliverables across quarterly, interim, and yearly cycles.

• Maintain control and oversight of the supplier invoice workflow, including monitoring and clearing backlog to keep processing on track.

• Own KPI reporting and performance tracking, providing visibility to the Head of P2P and key stakeholders.

• Drive continuous improvement, leading automation and process projects to move the function towards scalable, less manual ways of working.

• Ensure adherence to company policies, financial controls, and regulatory requirements, maintaining strong governance within the AP function.

**KEY EXPECTATIONS

**In this role, you take full ownership of your team's output and workload distribution, manage complex operational and people challenges, and drive process improvement across the function. You lead rather than execute - setting direction, removing blockers, and holding the team accountable to a high standard. You build the case for change, adapt quickly when priorities shift, and are a dependable leader who drives both team performance and function-wide results.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

**Job title: Regional Pharmacovigilance Director

****Department: PV Excellence

****Location: Søborg, (Greater Copenhagen), Denmark

****Your impact begins here

**As Regional Pharmacovigilance Director, you will lead pharmacovigilance (PV) governance and oversight across Region Emerging Markets, with patient safety at the heart of everything you do. You will drive operational excellence and compliance, build strong partnerships and strengthen regional capabilities. Working with Global Patient Safety and regional and affiliate leadership, you will turn regional PV priorities into action and deliver meaningful impact for patients.

**What You’ll Bring

**We are looking for a strategic, collaborative leader who thrives in a complex, international environment. You inspire alignment, drive results through influence and foster a culture of quality, compliance and patient safety across a diverse regional community.

• A Bachelor’s degree, or a Master’s/PhD, in life sciences and/or pharmaceutical industry, combined with a minimum of 7 years’ relevant experience in Pharmacovigilance.

• Demonstrated experience conducting and/or leading PV activities at a regional level.

• Extensive knowledge of international PV legislation, including GVP.

• Demonstrated ability to lead, influence and build alignment across teams without direct reporting lines.

• Strong strategic and business acumen, with the ability to translate priorities into clear direction and drive execution.

• Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to communicate with impact in a complex, multicultural matrix environment.

• Agile, proactive and focused on practical ways forward, with sound judgement, accountability and attention to detail.

• Self-motivated and able to work independently, navigate ambiguity and adapt effectively across diverse organisational and cultural settings.

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience working with PV requirements in diverse customer engagement initiatives, such as digital health initiatives, market research programmes and patient support programmes.

**What You’ll Do

**You will lead PV strategy and governance for the region and oversee PV activities across affiliates, enabling robust compliance, capability and patient safety in a growing business environment.

**More Specifically, You’ll

**

• Lead regional PV strategy and community: Provide leadership with PV strategy in the region, make sure key messages reach all levels of the organisation in a timely and effective way, and foster collaboration and knowledge-sharing to promote a culture of safety and compliance.

• Oversee regional PV activities: Lead the design and continuous optimisation of the affiliate PV operating model and resourcing strategy, using risk, workload and business needs to ensure sustainable capabilities and clear accountabilities.

• Safeguard compliance and regulatory readiness: Maintain regional oversight of PV compliance and performance through risk-based monitoring and trending of key indicators, escalate material issues and drive sustainable remediation. Implement new or revised local PV requirements through documented impact assessments and change control and keep Global Patient Safety updated on significant developments.

• Govern third parties and support inspection readiness: Provide strategic oversight of regional and affiliate PV vendors, distributors and other third parties performing PV activities, including governance, performance monitoring, issue escalation and effective Pharmacovigilance Agreements. Support audit and inspection preparation, follow up on findings and CAPAs, and share learnings across affiliates.

• Partner with the business and strengthen affiliates: Engage with regional and affiliate leadership and cross-functional teams (e.g. Medical, Marketing, Regulatory Affairs, Quality) to promote robust PV practices. Guide affiliates in resolving complex operational and compliance challenges, identify root causes, implement scalable improvements and support training and a robust capability framework.

• Represent the region globally: Act as the primary point of contact for the region in global governance forums, bring forward regional insights, best practices and regulatory requirements, and facilitate regional adoption of global processes, systems and transformation programmes.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the PV Excellence team within Global Patient Safety (GPS) in Research & Development, the team responsible for ensuring the integrity, quality and compliance of our global PV system. In Research & Development, colleagues explore bold scientific ideas and advance them into clinical testing, combining curiosity, AI tools and human data.

You will work closely with GPS departments, our Global Business Services centre in Bangalore, Novo affiliates, R&D, health authorities and contractual partners worldwide. In the region, your partners will be affiliate and regional leadership and key stakeholders in Medical, Marketing, Regulatory Affairs and Quality.

Based in Denmark, you will bring perspectives together across markets and cultures and help teams move from regional insight to global action.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued and your voice is heard. You will be trusted to take ownership, supported to perform at your best, and able to grow with your colleagues on the job and through relevant learning offerings.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 940,800.00 to 1,448,700.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead PV oversight across Region Emerging Markets with patient safety at the heart of your work, apply for the Regional Pharmacovigilance Director role by 22 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Please do not hesitate to contact Ragid Maarouf Senior Manager at +45 30 93 00 00 if you have any questions about the position.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Are you excited about building something customers love, shipping fast, together as a team?

We're reshaping how Product and Tech work at PriceShape, and you'll help build it. You'll join a small product team that owns its part of the product end to end. You'll ship to production every day, in small steps, behind feature toggles. You'll build with agents from your first week. And underneath it all is a genuinely hard problem. We collect and match pricing data from across the web, and it has to be complete, correct and fresh enough for our customers to act on it.

While agents write most of the code, we rely on senior human judgment and evaluation. If you want to be part of improving our product and our speed of learning, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

You'll be a developer in one of our product teams, working in a small team with one or two other developers, a product manager, a designer and a tech lead.

Your team owns its part of the product, all the way from the customer problem to the service running in production. You'll build it, ship it and run it, together with the rest of the team. Developers here are part of finding the solution, not a step after it has been decided.

Not all of this is in place yet. Some of it you'll find working well, and some of it you'll help us build. Some people here have done a lot of this before, but we're all still learning better ways.

You can work on-site in our Aarhus HQ or remotely from the EU or the UK. English is our working language, and the team is international.

Shaping solutions with your team

• 
You'll hear customer problems first hand, often enough to make good product and technical calls without asking.

• 
You'll bring technical options, costs and what has recently become possible into the conversation early. We explore more than one solution for every problem.

• 
You'll cut the work so the riskiest assumption reaches production first. Nothing we plan should take more than a week to reach production.

Building and shipping

• 
You'll ship small changes to production continuously. We work trunk based with feature toggles, and roll changes out gradually so they can be turned off without a new deploy.

• 
You'll write the tests as part of the change. There is no test phase and no one else whose job is to find your bugs.

• 
You'll watch how each change behaves in production and improve it in the next deploy when the evidence says so.

• 
You'll change infrastructure through code, the same way you change everything else.

Building with agents

• 
Claude Code is rolled out across the engineering team, and agents are a normal part of how we build.

• 
Most of the detailed decisions in a working day are yours. You make them in a tight loop with an agent, guided by your team's documented product principles, design system and technical decisions. When something falls outside them, you pull in the right person.

• 
You'll keep the context in your repositories current, so the next developer or agent starts from how the code actually works.

• 
You're responsible for what an agent produces in the same way as for code you wrote by hand.

Running what you build

• 
Your team runs its part of the product in production, including availability, scalability, security and bugs. You'll be part of that, including when something breaks.

• 
You'll make sure problems show up in monitoring before customers notice them.

• 
You'll keep dependencies current and fix small issues as they appear, a day at a time, rather than saving them up for a big project.

Working toward outcomes

• 
Your team works toward outcomes, and you'll know which outcome your work serves and whether it moved.

• 
Work is done when the outcome moved or when we decided to stop. When we stop, we stop cleanly, with nothing half built left behind.

What We're Looking For

• 
7+ years building and running production software. You've built it, shipped it in small steps and run it, including when it broke. This matters most.

• 
Solid experience with TypeScript, Node, and cloud infrastructure.

• 
You've worked as a peer in a cross-functional team, shaping solutions with product and design.

• 
You build with agents as a normal part of your work, and you improve the context they work from.

• 
You enjoy working in English in an international team.

What You Can Expect From Us

• 
Empowered collaboration: Work as a peer in a cross-functional team, and closely with our commercial teams.

• 
Support and development: Regular coaching and feedback.

• 
Room to experiment: An environment where curiosity, testing and learning are expected.

• 
An international workplace: Colleagues from 25+ nationalities across disciplines and markets.

• 
Flexibility and balance: Flexible working hours, social activities, pension, health insurance and modern offices in Aarhus and Stockholm.

About PriceShape

PriceShape is a global leader in competitor monitoring and dynamic pricing. Our platform helps brands and online retailers track vendors' prices, stock availability, and trends while implementing tailored pricing strategies.

We’re a diverse team of 80 employees from 24 nationalities, working from a modern, centrally located office in Aarhus C. We prioritize work-life balance, trust, community and focus on personal and professional growth opportunities.

We offer flexible hours, social events, pension and health insurance, great work facilities and an in-house canteen.

How to apply

If you think the position is attractive and suitable, please send us a job application and your CV as soon as possible. We process and interview on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Clinical Trial Supply Manager/ Senior Clinical Trial Supply Manager
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about clinical trial supply management? Do you have experience within GMP/GDP-regulated environments and managing complex clinical trial supply chains?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Clinical Trial Supply Manager.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

As Clinical Trial Supply Manager at Ascendis Pharma, you will be responsible for managing selected areas of the Clinical Trial Supply Chain in collaboration with internal and externally stakeholders. The Clinical Trial Supply (CTS) department comprises three closely collaborating teams: CTS - Coordination, CTS-IRT and CTS - Preparation & Handling.

We are seeking a passionate Clinical Trial Supply Manager to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in managing the clinical trial supply activities across Phase 1-3 studies. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be part of a dedicated and highly experienced Clinical Trial Supply department comprising 12 colleagues. The position is based in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will depend on your experience and may include:

• Coordinating internal CTS trial meetings and activities and collaborating with internal departments incl. CMC, Trial Management, QA, IT, and Regulatory Affairs

• Forecasting, planning, and facilitating the supply of IMP for clinical trial supplies, including managing IMP Packaging and Labelling activities, packaging design, label text development, and planning of packaging runs

• Managing IRT setup, incl. IRT specification, UAT preparation and execution, Go-live and close-out, as well as managing IRT system changes after Go-live

• Managing IMP distribution from CMOs to clinical sites incl. direct-to-patient (DtP) shipments and management of temperature excursions during storage at depots and clinical sites and during shipments

• Managing drug accountability activities, including returns, reconciliation and destruction

• Participating in meetings with CMOs, suppliers and vendors, trial teams and Investigator Meetings

• Maintaining documentation in the QMS and eTMF, including reviewing and preparing trial-related instructions and manuals

Qualifications and Skills:

Ideally, you hold a relevant academic degree in pharmacy or a related field and have at least 5 years of relevant experience in clinical trial supply management or a GMP/GDP-regulated environment.

Furthermore, you have:

• Proven experience in managing complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders

• A strong understanding of regulatory requirements

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office

• Fluency in written and spoken English and Danish

Key competencies:

You are a collaborative and quality-focused team player with a structured and analytical approach to your work. You are adaptable, take ownership, and have a can-do attitude. You thrive in a fast-paced, informal environment where priorities may change and close collaboration is key.

Travel: 2–10 days per year

Office: Denmark, Hellerup, Tuborg Havn

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Sara Østergaard, Director Clinical Trial Supply PM Team at sbo@ascendispharma.com.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

Job Title: Senior Director, Corporate Procurement

Department: Corporate Procurement

Location: Bagsværd, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**Shape the future of a diverse, business-critical portfolio, strengthen an experienced leadership team and raise the bar for global category excellence. You will challenge established approaches, unlock cross-category opportunities and use commercial judgement, strategic partnerships and AI-enabled insights to make our procurement decisions smarter, faster and more valuable.

As our new Senior Director, you will set the global procurement direction for the services and technologies that enable Novo to operate, innovate and grow. You will lead one of our three global category clusters called Corporate Services. The cluster covers Professional Services, External Workforce and Digital Solutions with approximately DKK 20 billion in annual spend.

**What You’ll Do

**Reporting to the Vice President, Corporate Procurement (reporting to CFO), you will join Corporate Procurement Management and lead the Corporate Services cluster through three experienced team leaders (two Directors and one Associate Director) and their 23-person teams in Denmark, who drive category management and strategic sourcing. You will work closely with our Category Management Support function and our Global Business Services teams in Bangalore (India), which manage tactical sourcing.

**You Will

**

• Lead through others: Set direction, empower your leaders and build a culture of accountability, honest feedback, development and constructive challenge.

• Drive global category excellence: Set the cluster’s strategic direction, connect business priorities with market opportunities and enable ambitious category strategies that deliver measurable value.

• Unlock cross-category opportunities: Find synergies across the three categories and challenge how we access expertise, deploy technology and partner externally to strengthen competitiveness, flexibility and innovation.

• Shape demand and business opportunities: Anticipate evolving needs, challenge established commercial and delivery models, and build the senior partnerships and sponsorship to turn opportunities into results.

• Advance AI-enabled category excellence: Use technology, data and AI to deepen market intelligence, accelerate decisions, automate lower-value work and raise the impact of category management.

• Strengthen strategic supplier ecosystems: Build partnerships that bring innovation and critical capabilities while improving commercial value, performance, sustainability and resilience.

**Who You’ll Work With

**Corporate Procurement is a global strategic function with an ambitious cost, innovation and value agenda. We manage Novo’s indirect spend, supplier base and global Source-to-Pay processes and systems, with teams in Bagsværd, Bangalore and Boston and category and sourcing managers across the globe.

We bridge business priorities with market opportunities and supplier capabilities, using market intelligence, AI and automation to move faster, decide better and deliver greater enterprise value.

You will partner with colleagues across Corporate Procurement and senior stakeholders Enterprise IT, People & Organisation, Legal, Finance and other business areas, as well as regional procurement colleagues and senior executives at strategic suppliers.

As part of Corporate Procurement Management, you will also help shape the wider procurement agenda, build and grow the future leadership of the organisation, strengthen cross-category collaboration and build a more intelligent, agile and high-performing organisation.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are an accomplished procurement and people leader with deep domain expertise, strategic perspective and strong business partnering skills. Above all, you succeed through others: setting clear direction and enabling experienced leaders and experts to make sound decisions, grow and deliver together.

You have a clear view of how procurement creates enterprise value and use market insight, supplier capabilities and internal expertise to shape opportunities with the business.

**To Succeed, You Will Bring

**

• Solid experience in category management and global strategic procurement.

• A strong record as a leader of leaders, delivering results, developing experienced category leaders and experts, and driving high engagement organisations.

• Deep category expertise across complex indirect spend, with strong credibility in at least one of Professional Services, External Workforce or Digital/IT and sound understanding of the others.

• Proven ability to partner with and constructively challenge senior executives, aligning a global matrix organisation around shared outcomes.

• Experience leading complex negotiations, strategic supplier relationships and transformation, balancing value, quality, innovation, agility and risk.

• Experience leveraging shared services and specialist capabilities in global procurement operating models to maximise strategic capacity and performance.

• Strong analytical judgement and financial acumen, with an understanding of how AI, automation and advanced analytics improve procurement intelligence, productivity and decisions.

You combine curiosity, courage and commercial judgement, and coach others through difficult decisions with clarity, care and integrity.

**What You Can Expect

**You will lead one of our most diverse and strategically important global portfolios, influencing how Novo accesses critical expertise, technology and supplier innovation. With ~DKK 20 billion in annual spend, an experienced leadership team and direct access to senior decision-makers, you will have the scale and mandate to make a real difference.

Our Corporate Procurement organisation has high ambitions for category excellence and enterprise value, and we value leaders who bring new perspectives, challenge conventional thinking and raise the bar for themselves and their teams.

Guided by the Novo Way, we create focus and speed through clear priorities, simple ways of working and decisive action. We care for our people, show respect and never compromise on safety and ethics.

As part of a strong procurement leadership community, you will broaden your enterprise perspective, develop other leaders and keep growing as a senior executive.

**Start now

**Ready to shape global category excellence, develop outstanding leaders and connect business ambition with market opportunity?

Apply for the Senior Director, Corporate Procurement role by November 22, 2026.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV.

For further information, please contact Executive Search Advisor Kristoffer Baadsgaard at +45 30 77 56 05.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
