jobs.occupation: Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a fixed-term position as Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design, is open for appointment from January 1, 2027, or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is 2 years.

Your work tasks
Your work will include developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models based on circuit data, board geometries, simulation results and design images. You will develop surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic solvers, enabling faster evaluation of design alternatives. The position may also involve computer vision for recognizing circuit structures, component placements and printed circuit board geometries from photographs or other images. In addition, you will investigate graph-based methods for representing circuit relationships, evaluating design rules and generating or testing hypotheses for circuit designs. You will contribute to the development and verification of agentic workflows, where artificial intelligence systems combine models, tools and design rules to reason through and support electronics design tasks. You will prepare datasets, document computational workflows, validate model performance and share results with colleagues working in artificial intelligence, power electronics, semiconductors and software development.

The position is offered within the research field of Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design and contributes to AAU Energy’s focus areas of Digital Transformation and Artificial Intelligence, and Energy Efficiency in Components and Systems. The Research Assistant will be affiliated with the Section of Power Electronics System Integration and Materials.

Your competencies
You have a relevant master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics, artificial intelligence or a related field, and you are interested in working at the intersection of machine learning and power electronics design. You have a solid foundation in applied machine learning. Familiarity with electronic systems, including printed circuit boards, circuit topologies, components and the physical principles that influence electrical, thermal and electromagnetic performance, will help you engage with the engineering context of the role.

You have practical experience developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models, and you can translate complex engineering challenges into data-driven methods suited to a research environment. You are comfortable working with structured and unstructured engineering data, including circuit representations, board geometries, simulation data and images. Experience with computer vision, graph-based machine learning or graph neural networks will support your work with methods that interpret circuit layouts and geometries, reason about relationships between components, and generate or assess design hypotheses.

You are interested in developing surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic simulation tools while maintaining sufficient accuracy for use in electronics-design workflows. You work systematically with model validation, data quality and reproducible experiments, and you understand that artificial intelligence methods for engineering need to be technically robust as well as useful to domain specialists.

You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and dialogue, and you work well in a multidisciplinary environment where colleagues with expertise in artificial intelligence, power electronics and software development collaborate closely. You take responsibility for your tasks, ask constructive questions when assumptions need clarification, and contribute with curiosity and sound technical judgement to the development of new methods for intelligent electronic-system design.

Who we are
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements 
Appointment as a research assistant requires academic qualifications at master's degree level.

How to apply  
Your application must include the following: 

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position. 
• Curriculum Vitae (CV). 
• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and potential PhD diploma). 
• Documentation of teaching qualifications (optional). 
• Additional qualifications in relation to the position. 
• References/recommendations. 
You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment. 

Do you have any questions? 
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.    

Selected candidates will be invited for an interview. Interviews are expected to be held during December 2026

Further information 
Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Research assistant”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Are you passionate about renewable energy and eager to work at the forefront of the global energy transition? PEAK Wind is seeking an AI Engineer to help shape our AI roadmap and to build and orchestrate the agents our colleagues and clients will use every day. At PEAK Wind, AI is moving from prototypes into production, and renewable energy operations produce exactly the kind of complex, high-volume data where AI can deliver significant value.

Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our Data & Intelligence (D&I) team, where we work within PEAK Wind’s asset management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, analytics, and AI capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. Our team consists of highly motivated professionals who bring diverse backgrounds and a strong commitment to excellence. We support one another, share knowledge, and celebrate both individual and collective achievements.

You will report to the Head of Data & Intelligence and work day-to-day with our small team of engineers who have been building internal AI products at PEAK Wind for several years. You will work closely with colleagues across different areas, bringing your perspective to a collaborative and purposeful team environment.

How You Will Make an Impact

As an AI Engineer, you will take AI solutions from idea to production and keep them there. You will co-own our AI roadmap: helping decide which agents we build, in what order, and what “working” means for each of them. Then you will build them.

Our agent portfolio serves two audiences. Internally, our agents give colleagues across PEAK Wind a well-governed way to work with company knowledge, generate reports, and analyse wind farm performance. Other internal agents help our own engineers specify and build new features faster. Externally, we provide agent-driven capabilities in our client-facing products.

On smaller initiatives you may be the engineer primarily responsible for taking the solution from first conversation to deployment. On larger initiatives, you will work closely with Product Owners, data engineers, and domain experts in asset management. Either way, the distance from an idea to something running is deliberately short. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Co-develop and maintain the PEAK Wind AI roadmap with the AI team, turning business needs into scoped, sequenced deliverables

• Design, build, and deploy agentic systems for internal colleagues, from reporting and wind farm analysis to engineering-productivity agents

• Design, build, and deploy AI-driven features and agents in our client-facing products, working with SCADA, operations, and asset management data

• Orchestrate multi-agent workflows: tool use, memory, retrieval over company and client data, and integration with our platform through APIs

• Build the evaluation systems that tell us whether an agent works, before and after it reaches production

• Own the data and infrastructure work behind your own agents on the cloud.

• Implement responsible-AI practices for operational energy data: access control, data isolation between clients, logging, and guardrails

• Ship early and iterate put prototypes in users’ hands fast and feed what you learn back into the roadmap

• Collaborate with Product Owners and stakeholders to understand what they need, and push back when AI is not the right tool

• Document what you build so others can maintain, extend, and trust it

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your mindset, curiosity, and drive to make an impact. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or similar, or an equivalent track record of shipping software

• Hands-on experience in software development, ML, data engineering, or AI Engineering, including AI applications you have helped take into production

• Strong Python and/or TypeScript, and hands-on experience with at least one agent framework

• Experience building or extending evals for LLM and agent behaviour, or an interest in developing deeper expertise in this area

• Experience building in cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure; familiarity with PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern web stacks is an advantage

• You code with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor as a matter of course

• Professional experience in the energy industry or another complex technical environment; renewable energy or SCADA experience is an advantage but not required

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike

• A go-doer mentality: you would rather ship something real this week and improve it next week than perfect it in a document

• A structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to take initiative, including owning a product from idea to delivery

• The ability to stay calm and constructive in a high-paced environment

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to thrive in an international, cross-functional team

This role is designed for an engineer who has already gained some hands-on experience building AI solutions and is now looking to deepen that expertise in a highly practical, production-focused environment and enjoys building and learning.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• A real mandate to build with AI: an existing roadmap, internal users who want what you build, and clients ready to adopt it

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

On-call Waiters & Bartenders - Bring your personality to Hobo Copenhagen

•

• 
Start date: February 2027, with the exact date to be agreed.

• 
Location: Hobo Copenhagen, Helgolandsgade 3, 1653 Copenhagen V.

• 
Working hours: Morning, daytime and evening shifts, primarily at weekends. You should be available at least every other weekend,  and we’d love to hear if you’re keen to work more.

• 
Questions: Contact Gobo Hansen, F&B Manager, at gobo.hansen@hobohotel.dk.

• 
Application deadline: November 16th

We review applications and meet candidates on an ongoing basis, and positions may be filled before the application deadline.

Chef - full time

Bring your craft to the kitchen at Hobo Copenhagen

You care about good food, enjoy a busy service and know how much a kitchen depends on the people in it. Now you’re ready to help build something new.

We’re looking for chefs to join Hobo Copenhagen in full-time positions, with a primary focus on our evening à la carte restaurant. You’ll also contribute to the food offering in our all-day bar, working as part of one kitchen team.

Our restaurant offers dishes made for sharing, good ingredients and confident flavours. We’re looking for people who bring care to their cooking, ideas to the conversation and a willingness to support the team.

Good food starts with us

Together with the Head Chef and your kitchen colleagues, you’ll help build a modern kitchen culture where everyone feels welcome and respected. We value calm, clear communication, constructive feedback and helping each other through a busy service. Everyone should feel comfortable asking questions, sharing ideas and learning.

Your role will include:

• 
Preparing and cooking dishes with attention to flavour, seasoning and presentation, keeping quality consistent throughout service.

• 
Looking after your section, planning your preparation and keeping your station organised and ready for a busy evening.

• 
Contributing ideas as we develop dishes, seasonal menus and the everyday food offering across our restaurant and all-day bar.

•

_**Deliver with focus. Scale with intent 🚀

**Are you a delivery leader who knows how to guide enterprise customers through complex set-ups without over-engineering the journey? Do you care deeply about building scalable, repeatable SaaS delivery rather than one-off custom projects?

At Performativ, we’re building the infrastructure layer for modern wealth management. As our Engagement Manager, you’ll lead the enterprise rollout of our SaaS platform helping customers onboard successfully through structured delivery, clear communication, and lightweight technical engagement.

This is not a professional services consulting role. You won’t be buried in endless customer-specific code or heavy customizations. Instead, you’ll work cross-functionally to help customers adopt our product the right way: cleanly, securely, and in line with platform best practices so they can scale on top of us, not around us.

**What You Will Do

**

• 
Own enterprise set-up programs end to end (kick-off through go-live and hyper-care) against an agreed plan and scope (Statement of Work).

• 
Enable customers to integrate Performativ via standard platform patterns (APIs, SSO, configuration) without custom buildouts, working with product and engineering to flag gaps early and advocate for scalable paths.

• 
Own plan, scope, and change control, keeping scope tied to contract and change visible and decided rather than quietly absorbed, and support the Technical Program Lead on requirements, design documents, and acceptance-criteria sign-off.

• 
Run customer communication, cadence, and governance with reporting that keeps meetings short, and manage risk, dependency, and issue tracking (including customer-side).

• 
Lead a clean handover to Customer Success at go-live or hyper-care exit, including train-the-trainer sessions and supporting materials.

• 
Represent the program in internal capacity and exception reviews, bringing requests the plan cannot absorb back as options rather than committing on the spot.

• 
Build repeatable playbooks, documentation, and artefacts that make the next program faster. You will be measured on this, not only on your own delivery.

**How You Will Work

**You will run multiple programs at once, in a delivery pod alongside the Technical Program Lead, Integration Engineers, Data Migration Specialists, and Product Engineers. None report to you. Rather you get things done through clarity and relationships, not authority. You will report to the COO. This is an in-office role based at our Copenhagen office.

**What We're Looking For

**

• 
7+ years in program or engagement management, consulting, product management, or another delivery-facing role, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder implementations end to end.

• 
Comfort being firm with customers on scope and timeline while keeping the relationship stronger for it.

• 
Any industry background welcome. Experience with enterprise customers (banks, asset managers, regulated industries), balancing urgency against long-term maintainability highly advantageous.

• 
Structured and highly organized, producing written plans, governance cadences, and reporting that stakeholders can act on.

• 
Broad technical literacy across enterprise SaaS delivery: API-based integrations, SSO and security configuration, and data migration and mapping, including enough SQL to read and question a mapping. You do not build the integration, but you understand it well enough to scope it, question it, and know when something does not add up.

• 
Ability to build working fluency in the customer's business domain fast: within 90 days, able to discuss topics such as advice and suitability workflows and customer reporting without a subject-matter expert in the room.

• 
ITIL Foundation, PMP or PRINCE2 Certification would be beneficial.

**Technical Fluency

**

• 
You’re not, necessarily, a developer, but you’re comfortable with APIs, data structures, auth flows (OAuth/SAML), and deployment models.

• 
You can dive into logs, payloads, and basic SQL or Python when needed to unblock yourself or a customer - but you prioritize scalable fixes over tactical workarounds.

• 
You advocate for platform-aligned solutions, not special cases.

**What This Role Is Not

**This role sits in operations, not engineering or commercial, and is project-based: once delivery is complete, you roll on to the next engagement. As a SaaS provider, we do not build bespoke software; delivery works within the bounds of the product.

**We Can Offer

**

• 
Trust and responsibility to shape how Performativ delivers for its largest customers.

• 
A competitive salary and benefits package.

• 
A fast-growing, VC-backed fintech scaleup, working alongside professionals from leading institutions (Goldman Sachs, McKinsey, BCG, Amazon and others).

• 
Career acceleration through professional development and leadership opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Intern auditor til informationssikkerhed i Region Midtjylland - tidsbegrænset stilling
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at styrke informationssikkerheden i en af Danmarks største offentlige organisationer?

I Region Midtjylland søger vi en intern auditor, der skal bidrage til at evaluere og videreudvikle regionens ledelsessystem for informationssikkerhed. Du får en central rolle i arbejdet med at sikre, at krav til informationssikkerhed efterleves, og at regionens politikker, procedurer og sikkerhedsforanstaltninger fungerer efter hensigten.

Som intern auditor skal du planlægge og gennemføre interne audits på tværs af organisationen og medvirke til at skabe overblik over styrker, risici og forbedringsmuligheder, som understøtter ledelsens beslutningsgrundlag. Du bliver samtidig en vigtig sparringspartner, der understøtter en kultur, hvor audit opleves som et redskab til læring, udvikling og løbende forbedring af informationssikkerheden.

 

Dine primære opgaver

Du får ansvar for at etablere og videreudvikle regionens proces for intern audit samt udarbejde og vedligeholde et risikobaseret auditprogram.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

• Udarbejde regionens auditprogram
• Planlægge og gennemføre interne audits i overensstemmelse med auditprogrammet og gældende krav til informationssikkerhed
• Fastlægge auditmål, auditkriterier og auditomfang
• Indsamle og vurdere dokumentation, interviewoplysninger, observationer og øvrige revisionsbeviser
• Vurdere efterlevelsen af ISO 27001 samt regionens politikker, retningslinjer og procedurer
• Identificere afvigelser, risici, forbedringsmuligheder og eksempler på god praksis
• Udarbejde rapporter og præsentere auditresultater for ledelse og relevante interessenter
• Bidrage til opfølgning på identificerede forbedringsområder
• Sikre, at eksisterende audits, tilsyn, it-revisioner og øvrige kontrolaktiviteter inddrages aktivt, så allerede tilgængelig viden udnyttes bedst muligt
 

Om dig

Vi søger en intern auditor, der er tillidsvækkende i dialogen med andre og formår at skabe gode og konstruktive samarbejdsrelationer på tværs af organisationen. Du møder medarbejdere og ledere med en anerkendende og respektfuld tilgang og udviser tålmodighed i auditprocessen. Samtidig har du modet til at identificere og påpege fejl, mangler og forbedringsmuligheder på en saglig og konstruktiv måde. Du ser intern audit som et redskab til læring og kvalitetsudvikling frem for kontrol.

Vi forestiller os derudover, at du:

• Er analytisk stærk og kan omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til klare konklusioner
• Har gode skriftlige og mundtlige formidlingsevner
• Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt
• Evner at skabe samarbejde og tillid på tværs af forskellige fagområder
• Har kendskab til informationssikkerhed og ISO27001
 

Hvem er vi?

Du bliver ansat i informationssikkerhedsteamet i Digital Forvaltning, som er en del af Region Midtjyllands samlede informationssikkerhedsfunktion. Funktionen er et samarbejde mellem Sikkerhed og Compliance, som er en del af Digitalisering og It samt Juridisk Kontor og Digital Forvaltning, som er en del af Regionssekretariatet. 

Digital Forvaltning arbejder for at fremme digitalisering og sikre en systematisk, fælles ramme for informationssikkerhedsarbejdet i hele regionen. Vi er en del af Regionssekretariatet, der også varetager sekretariatsbetjening af regionsråd og direktion samt en række tværgående opgaver.

Arbejdssted: Regionshuset Viborg, Skottenborg 26, 8800 Viborg

 

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår 

Stillingen er tidsbegrænset frem til den 31. december 2028 med evt. mulighed for forlængelse.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Ansøgningsfrist den 5. december 2026. 

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt den 15. december 2026.  

Tiltrædelse: 1. februar 2027 eller efter aftale. 

Løn– og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til gældende overenskomst. 

 

Yderligere information om stillingen

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Rikke Stein, Kontorchef i Digital Forvaltning, på telefonnummer 21359030 eller på mail rikke.stein@rm.dk.

 

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

jobs.description:
Student Assistant for Software Development at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you're energised by software development and thrive on solving real business challenges through technology, we'd love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a student software developer to join our system development team in Global IT.

As a team, we support NNE's engineering project portfolios and build modern applications that help colleagues work smarter across projects and locations.

As a student software developer, you will play an important role in supporting the team's development efforts by contributing to real business-critical solutions, helping maintain high quality through testing, and bringing fresh perspectives on emerging technologies such as Azure and AI.

This is a part-time position of around 2–3 days a week. You will work on real tasks from day one, with a dedicated colleague to guide you, review your code and help you grow.

How you might spend your days

As a student software developer, you’ll be:

• Developing new features and fixing bugs in our applications, APIs and services

• Building front-end components and backend endpoints under guidance from experienced developers

• Helping perform testing of our applications, running test cases, reporting defects and writing automated tests to keep our quality high

• Taking part in our agile ways of working, stand-ups, sprint planning and code reviews

• Exploring new tools and technologies, such as cloud services on Microsoft Azure and AI and sharing what you learn with the team

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• A self-learner who picks up new technologies and tools on your own initiative and is not afraid to ask questions when you get stuck

• Structured and responsible, taking ownership of your tasks and delivering what you commit to

• Collaborative and comfortable working with colleagues across disciplines, locations and cultures

• Curious and proactive in suggesting improvements to tools, processes and technical solutions

• Open to feedback and ready to learn from mistakes, with high spirits and a sense of humour

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Are studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field

• Have a basic understanding of programming in C#/.NET or Python

• Have some experience with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and ideally a modern framework such as React

• Know the basics of relational databases and SQL

• Have used Git for version control

• Communicate well in English, written and spoken

It’s a bonus if you have tried automated testing, CI/CD or cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure.

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 15 November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Ivanna Jurkiv Ditlevsen at +45 3077 4721.

Please note:

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

You don’t need to tick every box to apply. If this sounds like a role where you could thrive and contribute, we encourage you to apply and tell us what you would bring to the team.

Does This Position Sound Like A Match?

Hit the apply button below to apply for the position. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

We’re looking for a commercially minded Legal Counsel to join us on our journey to become one stronger, more integrated SaaS business. You’ll work across commercial contracts, privacy and cybersecurity in the European and North American market, partnering with colleagues across the organisation to find practical solutions and support our growth.

Reporting to our General Counsel, you’ll work at the intersection of commercial law, privacy, cybersecurity and business transformation. You’ll play a key role in enabling business growth, supporting complex customer deals, and ensuring that our legal commitments are practical, proportionate and aligned with how we operate.

Whether you’re building on your experience in private practice or looking to grow further in an in-house role, this is an opportunity for you to take ownership, learn along the way, and make a real difference.

We are open to on-site (offices in Copenhagen and Wrocław), hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET), plus the US East Coast.

**About Us

**Cookie Information, Piwik PRO, and Sheltr, are leading SaaS brands specialising in privacy-first compliance and analytics. Together, we’re building intuitive, user-friendly products that help organisations navigate data privacy and marketing insights. With headquarters in Copenhagen and an office in Wrocław, our teams have been working across various industries to build trusted data privacy solutions since 2011.

We’re bringing our brands closer together to build one company with a shared identity in the group, a clear focus and ambitious plan for the future. The Legal, Compliance and Cybersecurity team has a core role to play in making that happen.

The role

These will be your main tasks:

Handle commercial contracts, particularly sales contracts

• Draft, review and negotiate customer contracts for EU and US customers.

• Support partner, reseller and supplier agreements, as well as more specialised regulatory requirements such as DORA-related terms and US healthcare BAAs.

• Work closely with Sales and Account Management to find solutions that support our commercial goals while managing legal risks.

Privacy compliance and cybersecurity

• Support GDPR compliance, international data transfers, sub-processor management and relevant UK and US privacy requirements.

• Work with our Cybersecurity team on NIS2 compliance and related contractual requirements.

• Help our Cyber Security and Compliance teams to respond to customer privacy and security questionnaires, audits and due diligence requests.

• Advise Product teams on privacy, consent and data protection, helping ensure that our commitments reflect how we actually work.

Help shape the way we work

• Improve legal templates, processes and ways of working as the business grows.

• Collaborate with colleagues across Sales, Product, Security, Finance and Operations.

• Contribute to shaping our legal function and how we support the wider business.

**About You

**You’re a structured, independent, and commercially minded lawyer who enjoys working with people and finding practical solutions. You combine sound legal judgement with a practical understanding of how a business operates. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, thinking creatively and making decisions, even when the answer isn’t entirely straightforward.

You know that good legal advice is not just about identifying risks; it’s about helping the business understand those risks and finding a way forward.

You bring:

• 2-5 years of experience with commercial contracts, gained in-house or at a law firm.

• An understanding of B2B contracting and an interest in SaaS or technology businesses.

• Working knowledge of GDPR and privacy law in a commercial context, or relevant experience with HIPAA and US privacy law.

• The ability to communicate clearly, and comfortable working directly with Sales on live deals and making pragmatic judgement calls.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves

• Experience with cybersecurity regulations (NIS2 and/or DORA).

jobs.occupation: Senior Electrical Engineer, High Voltage (GIS); Location: DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Are you a seasoned HV engineer with extensive GIS expertise? Do you understand what it takes to specify the right GIS solution and navigate the trade-offs between performance, reliability, cost, footprint and delivery schedules? Can you translate customer requirements into practical, value-driven solutions? Then join our team and help shape the projects that are driving the global transition towards renewable energy!

Your position 

In your new position, you will be a key contributor to our major tender projects, collaborating closely with a team of experienced engineers to translate customer requirements into robust and scalable offerings. Drawing on your expertise in high-voltage GIS solutions, you will help shape technical decisions, collaborate with strategic suppliers, and strengthen our value proposition.

Beyond tender activities, you will contribute to the continuous development of our HV competencies, product portfolio, and ways of working, helping strengthen our technical foundation for future growth.

You will join our Product Line Management (PLM) Solution Engineering team, a multidisciplinary group collaborating with customers, suppliers and colleagues across the organization.

As part of PLM, you will contribute to our ambition of making offshore substations more modular, standardized, and repeatable.
You will help define not only the solutions we deliver today, but also the solutions we bring to market tomorrow.

Building on our strong offshore substation capabilities, we are also exploring opportunities within onshore substations. Experience with onshore transmission systems, including EHV GIS/AIS, grid transformers, reactive compensation, harmonic filtering or grid connection equipment, will therefore be considered an advantage and may provide opportunities to contribute beyond our offshore portfolio.

Working in an international and collaborative environment, you will help transform proven engineering concepts into repeatable products that support the continued growth of renewable energy worldwide.

The position is full-time and includes approximately 10-30 travel days per year. We place a high value on flexibility, and most travel can be planned to align with both business requirements and personal preferences.

"We have built a leading position within offshore substations, and PLM plays a key role in ensuring that we maintain and strengthen that position. By developing scalable solutions, standardizing our products, and challenging established ways of working, we make sure that we are ready to meet the demands of both today’s and tomorrow’s energy markets. We currently support projects across Europe, the UK, North America, and Asia, but our ambition is simple: to be ready wherever the next opportunity emerges."
– Jannick Elmbæk Olsen, Director, Product Line Management

Your tasks & responsibilities
As our new Senior High Voltage Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, positioning, and continuous improvement of the products and solutions offered within our offshore substation product line. Working closely with customers, suppliers, procurement, and our project execution teams, you will help shape solutions that remain competitive, scalable, and aligned with future market demands.

Your tasks will include:

• Support tender activities by defining and evaluating 66 kV and 230/275 kV GIS solutions.
• Translate customer needs, market trends, and supplier capabilities into competitive product offerings.
• Optimize solutions with respect to performance, reliability, footprint, cost, and lead time.
• Develop and maintain the GIS product roadmap in line with future market requirements and emerging technologies.
• Collaborate with Procurement and strategic suppliers to strengthen competitiveness and drive cost optimization.
• Contribute to the standardization and modularization of our GIS product portfolio.
• Ensure a seamless handover of as-sold solutions to our EPC engineering teams.

Your profile & qualifications 

To succeed in this role, you are an experienced High Voltage Engineer with extensive GIS expertise and a passion for developing competitive solutions for the renewable energy industry.

We imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
• Have extensive experience with medium- and high-voltage GIS systems, including 66 kV array systems and 230/275 kV transmission-level applications, from offshore wind, utilities, transmission, manufacturing, or EPC projects.
• Experience with offshore GIS applications, technology qualification, or emerging SF6-free switchgear technologies is considered an advantage.
• Understand the technical and commercial drivers behind GIS selection, including performance, cost, footprint, weight, and lead time.
• Are comfortable working with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to balance technical and commercial requirements.
• Have a strategic mindset and enjoy translating market needs into scalable product offerings.
• Communicate clearly in English and can translate complex technical topics into sound business decisions.
• Thrive in a collaborative and international environment and enjoy working across disciplines and cultures.
• If you also bring experience or exposure to onshore substations, grid connections, or related high-voltage systems, we would be interested to hear about it.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

European LifeCare Group (ELCG) is strengthening its executive leadership team and is seeking an experienced, business-minded Group CFO to lead its next phase of growth and professionalisation.

ELCG is one of Europe’s leading independent providers of vaccinations and preventive healthcare services. The company operates across Denmark, the UK, the Netherlands and Sweden, providing services that directly impact people’s health and wellbeing. It is a market leader in its niche, built on a strong operational foundation and owned by Findos, a private equity investor.

With a proven track record of organic and acquisition-driven expansion, ELCG is entering a new phase focused on scalability, digitalisation and operational excellence. The Group CFO will play a central role in developing the financial platform to support these ambitions.

The role

Reporting to the CEO, you will lead Group Finance and serve as a key partner to the leadership team, the Board and Findos. You will:

• Lead and further develop a professional, business-oriented finance function covering FP&A, Controlling and Finance Operations.

• Build a consistent group-wide operating model with strong governance, transparency and commercial focus.

• Drive financial planning, performance management and data-driven decision-making.

• Act as a strategic partner to the CEO and Findos, balancing long-term vision with hands-on execution.

• Support commercial development, acquisitions, integration and digital transformation initiatives across multiple markets.

• Play an active role in shaping a fast-moving, entrepreneurial organisation where speed, pragmatism and ownership are essential.

Candidate profile

We are looking for an experienced and energetic finance leader with strong analytical and commercial capabilities, ideally coming from international service, healthcare, retail-style or multi-site operations.

You thrive in both strategic and operational contexts and enjoy working close to the business, combining structure, execution power and curiosity.

Key requirements:

• At least 10 years of progressive finance experience, including five years in a senior leadership role such as CFO or Finance Director.

• Experience from international, multi-entity organisations in growth or transformation environments.

• Proven ability to lead teams and create alignment between finance, operations and commercial functions across geographies.

• A strong understanding of ERP, consolidation and BI/reporting systems, with a genuine interest in digitalisation and automation.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work effectively with executive management, boards and owners.

• A master’s-level degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related field.

• A hands-on and visible leadership style, with the confidence to work close to the details and lead by example in a growing business.

Experience working in a private equity-owned company and supporting acquisitions or post-merger integration would be an advantage.

Personal characteristics

You are energetic, structured and business-oriented, with high integrity and natural authority. You are proactive and pragmatic, and willing to get involved directly when needed.

You create clarity in complexity, inspire collaboration and balance strategic thinking with practical execution. You are a team player who communicates transparently, builds trust and thrives in a fast-moving growth environment.

Contact and application

European Search Company is assisting ELCG with this recruitment. For further information about the position, please contact Brian Ranvits on +45 20 48 05 48.

If you see yourself in the role, please apply using the button below. Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and the position will remain open until it is filled.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

At Genmab, we’re committed to building extra[not]ordinary futures together, by developing antibody products and pioneering, knock-your-socks-off therapies that change the lives of patients and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. From our people who are caring, candid, and impact-driven to our business, which is innovative and rooted in science, we believe that being proudly unique, determined to be our best, and authentic is essential to fulfilling our purpose.

The Role and Department

We are looking for an Associate Director, Technology Transfer Lead, to lead a team of Project Managers responsible for global process transfers in Genmab’s late-stage CMC organization. The scope covers biological intermediates (BI, e.g. monoclonal antibodies), chemical intermediates (CI), conjugated drug substance (DS) and drug product (DP).

You will report to the Senior Director, Head of Late-Stage Manufacturing Development Project Management, within Genmab Tech Ops in Denmark. You will work across CMC teams and technical functions, Quality, Regulatory Affairs and Supply Chain to align transfers with program strategy and supply needs.

You will combine people leadership with oversight of transfers across sites and contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs). You will lead selected complex transfers, ensuring receiving-site readiness, documented handover and continuity of supply.

**Responsibilities

****Team leadership and development

**

• Lead and develop a team of Project Managers, including resource planning, recruitment, performance management and professional development

• Coach team members in transfer leadership, stakeholder management and resolving issues across sites. Set clear expectations and encourage open dialogue and shared accountability

• Work with the Senior Director to align team priorities and resources with the transfer portfolio, address capacity constraints and strengthen collaboration across the project organization

**Global Process Transfer Responsibilities

**

• Translate transfer strategies into integrated plans with clear scope, ownership, milestones, budgets and dependencies across BI, CI, DS and DP

• Lead planning with sending and receiving sites, coordinating gap assessments, process and analytical knowledge transfer, and readiness of facilities, equipment, materials and documentation

• Coordinate engineering and GMP campaigns, comparability, process validation and regulatory activities with functional leads. Establish transfer acceptance criteria and ensure documented handover to routine manufacturing

• Maintain current plans and risk assessments, manage dependencies between transfer streams, and escalate issues with clear options and recommendations. Protect supply continuity throughout the transfer

CDMO collaboration and project governance

• Represent transfer programs in internal governance forums and relevant joint project and steering committees with CDMOs, within agreed responsibilities and decision authority

• Follow up on CDMO scope, deliverables, timelines and budgets with technical leads, Quality, External Manufacturing and Procurement. Prepare governance decisions and ensure agreed actions have clear owners and follow-up.

• Strengthen consistent transfer planning and readiness reviews, share lessons learned, and improve the Project Manual and tools. Support compliance with applicable quality processes in collaboration with Quality and functional experts

**Requirements

**

• 
Master’s degree or higher in natural sciences, pharmacy, engineering or a related discipline

• 
Extensive CMC experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, including technology transfer and late-stage development or commercial manufacturing of biologics

• 
Demonstrated experience leading complex transfers between manufacturing sites and CDMOs, including integrated planning, budget management, risk management and coordination across regions

• 
Sound understanding of antibody manufacturing and the interfaces between BI, CI, conjugation and DP.

• 
Experience with antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) technology transfers is an advantage

• 
Practical understanding of process and analytical transfer, comparability, process validation, manufacturing readiness and the associated CMC submission requirements

• 
Working knowledge of GMP and global CMC regulatory expectations, and experience managing CDMO relationships and project governance.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex issues, present recommendations and collaborate across functions and cultures.

**About You

**You enjoy developing people and taking responsibility for delivery. You set clear priorities, delegate effectively and remain available as a coach and sparring partner. You bring structure to complex transfers and act early when risks or competing demands arise.

You build constructive relationships with technical specialists and manufacturing partners, and challenge assumptions while maintaining trust. You connect decisions across the supply chain, exercise sound judgment and value a ONE-Team approach to delivering shared goals.

**Location and Travel

**The role is based in Denmark, with international travel to Genmab locations and external manufacturing partners.

Genmab leverages the effectiveness of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are designed as open, community-based spaces that work to connect our employees. Whether you’re in one of our collaboratively designed office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK624.000,00---936.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

**About The Role

**At FLS, we have simplified our business and strengthened our profitability in recent years. We are now shifting our focus to accelerating profitable growth. To steer this journey, we are establishing a Corporate Growth Office that leads our strategic growth and profitability initiatives in close cooperation with our Business Lines, Group Functions and other stakeholders.

As Director, Corporate Growth Office and Strategy, you will build and run the engine that turns our strategic ambitions into owned, tracked and delivered results. You will own the portfolio management, governance and operating rhythm of the Corporate Growth Office. This spans the monthly Growth Office reviews in our Executive Leadership Team and in each Business Line performance review. You will also connect the initiative portfolio to our corporate strategy process. As deputy to the Head of Corporate Growth Office, you will be a trusted sparring partner to Business Line Presidents, Finance and initiative owners.

Reporting to the Head of Corporate Growth Office, you will join a small, high-calibre team at our headquarters in Copenhagen. Around 80% of the role is dedicated to running the Corporate Growth Office and around 20% to corporate strategy work. The Growth Office enables, challenges and connects: our Business Lines own the delivery of their initiatives, and you will make sure it happens with pace, rigour and transparency.

**What You Gain

**This is a rare opportunity to build a Growth Office from the ground up at a pivotal moment for FLS, and to shape how a global industrial company steers its growth. You will gain:

• Close collaboration with our CEO, the Executive Leadership Team and Business Line Presidents and Business Line management teams.

• An enterprise-wide view of how FLS creates value across Business Lines, Group Functions, sales areas and our mergers and acquisitions (M&A) agenda.

• Visible impact, as your work shows directly in our results and in how we work together as one FLS.

• A broad platform for your professional development, combining growth office leadership with corporate strategy.

• The chance to help the mining industry move towards a more sustainable future.

**You will play a key role in

**_Setting up and running the Corporate Growth Office

_

• Designing and embedding the Growth Office operating model with the Head of Corporate Growth Office, including governance forums, roles and decision rights, the stage-gate process, value rules and reporting standards.

• Turning our corporate management model into a working operating rhythm, including the monthly Growth Office review in the Executive Leadership Team and the Growth Office segment of each monthly Business Line performance review.

• Building an in-house playbook and capability, so that FLS eventually runs its growth agenda with its own people, tools and routines.

_Managing the growth portfolio

_

• Owning one Group-wide view of growth workstreams and initiatives, with clear owners, milestones, value targets, risks and interdependencies.

• Running the stage-gate process from idea to realised value, including gate-readiness checks and rigour tests before key decisions.

• Keeping the pipeline healthy through quarterly re-prioritisation and backfilling of initiatives, and spotting off-track initiatives early.

_Executive governance and reporting

_

• Preparing decision-ready material for the Executive Leadership Team and Business Line leadership on value delivered against plan, value at risk, stage-gate decisions and blockers.

• Maintaining decision and action logs, driving follow-up and escalating issues that need executive attention.

• Contributing to Executive Leadership Team and Board updates and to the messages cascaded to the wider organisation.

• Deputising for the Head of Corporate Growth Office in executive forums.

_Value tracking with Finance

_

• Defining the baselines, impact categories and validation rules that make reported value credible, together with Group and Business Line Finance.

• Reconciling initiative value with forecasts, budgets and actual results every month.

• Rolling out and governing a common initiative-tracking software platform as the single source of truth.

_Partnering with Business Lines and Group Functions

_

• Acting as the Growth Office’s lead partner for selected Business Lines and Functions and challenging the ambition, pace and quality of their plans.

• Helping each Business Line establish its own Growth Office cadence in line with our common practice.

• Coordinating cross-Business Line and cross-functional initiatives, and supporting the integration of acquisitions into the growth portfolio.

_Corporate strategy

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in tidal flat sediment dynamics
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly motivated and ambitious postdoc researcher for a 20-months position commencing 1 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management invites applicants for a postdoc position, dealing with the impact of sea-level rise and coastal squeeze on tidal flat evolution and sediment characteristics in coastal wetlands. The project is part of the research project ‘WadProof - Future-proofing the intertidal resource capital of the Danish Wadden Sea World Heritage Site’, funded by the Aage V. Jensen Charity Foundation.

  The research project

  The postdoc is part of the multidisciplinary ‘WadProof’ project focusing on advancing knowledge on the effects of sea-level rise and coastal squeeze on coastal wetland tidal flats sediment characteristics, the benthic fauna and the feeding opportunities for migratory birds in the Wadden Sea. The primary focus of the research will be to explore recent and historical changes in tidal flat development and texture, assess the effects of dikes and evaluate controlling drivers and forcing of tidal flat sediment characteristics and dynamics.

  The applicant will be collecting and analysing tidal flat surface sediment and core data, collect hydro- and sediment dynamic data and test remote sensing techniques using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) and orthophoto to map intertidal marine sediment type distributions. During the fellowship there will be periods with fieldwork in the Wadden Sea, laboratory and course work, teaching and dissemination.

  Who are we looking for?

  We are looking for candidates within the fields of physical geography, marine geology or other geosciences. Applicants should have a PhD degree and interest in estuarine and coastal geomorphology and good communication skills in spoken and written English. Experience with collection and analysis of empirical data, including processing of satellite and UAV data is considered an advantage.

  Our group and research - and what do we offer?

  The postdoctoral  researcher will be a member of the research group ‘Geomorphology, processes and landscapes’ in the Section for Geography. The research group studies processes that shape coastal, estuarine, marine, fluvial and glacial landscapes. We work at multiple temporal and spatial scales ranging from grains to landscapes and from seconds to millennial. The group uses quantitative methods with a strong focus on empirical data collection to map, analyse and understand the physical processes that shape the earth surface. Our group currently comprises two professors, two associate professors, postdocs and PhD students.

  The group is a part of Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. We are located in Copenhagen. In the project you will be collaborating with researchers from Aarhus University and from the coastal department of the Danish Environmental Agency

  The postdoc’s duties will include research as well as teaching. The post may also include performance of other duties.

  Further information on the Department is linked at https://ign.ku.dk/english/. Inquiries about the position can be made to Associate Professor Mikkel Fruergaard at email: mif@ign.ku.dk

  The position is open from 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  Terms of employment

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Terms of appointment and payment accord to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State.

  Negotiation for salary supplement is possible.

  You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The application, in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include 

   	
• Cover letter, including the candidate’s motivation and a brief outline of suggested research contribution to the project (max 1,000 words). 	
• Curriculum Vitae, including a complete publication list, conference presentation list, and overview of teaching experience. 	
• Documentation: Diplomas for Master’s and PhD degrees. If the PhD is not yet awarded, please specify the expected date of submission and/or defence in the CV. 	
• Publications: Up to five selected articles (published or unpublished). The selected articles must be uploaded as attachments and marked with an asterisk (*) on the publication list.   The deadline for applications is 29 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. 

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews will be held during week 1 in 2027.

Research Associate in Next Generation Sequencing

Job Description

At Traitomic, we help companies unlock the potential of biology to create better-performing crops and microbes. Across agriculture, food and biotech, companies need biological solutions that deliver higher impact and reach the market faster. Whether starting from a genetic target, a desired phenotype or a commercial objective, Traitomic bridges the gap between biological potential and market-ready traits. Combining gene discovery, a proprietary non-GM/non-GE trait development process and deep scientific expertise, we accelerate the development of tailored crop and microbial improvements with unprecedented speed and specificity.

As part of our next phase of growth and long-term goals, we are expanding our in-house Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) and Data analysis platform in Copenhagen to support our Trait Development projects across microbial, plant, fungi and algae projects. This is a unique and challenging entry level position covering molecular biology, and more specifically, sequencing. You will be working with DNA isolations, long-read sequencing and automation, across a variety of species including microbial, fungi and plants.

As our new Research Associate in NGS, you will conduct NGS experiments and develop ownership of end-to-end sequencing projects. This will include sample reception, DNA extraction, QC and library preparations as well as other molecular biology work. You are not required to work independently from the beginning, and you will be specifically trained, but independent work is expected after a learning period.

Who Do We Imagine You Are

We’re looking for someone who wants to grow into a DNA sequencing specialist and build expertise and experience in genomics with us over time. Maybe you just graduated from your BSc. or MSc. program, and maybe you have already built some solid hands-on laboratory experience through a thesis, student job or similar. You enjoy being in the lab, getting things done and are motivated to continuously learn, rather than doing the same thing every day. Most importantly, you are curious, reliable and get motivated from dynamic environments where no two days look the same.

What You Will Do

• Extract plant and microbial DNA using commercial kits and liquid handlers

• Perform DNA quality checks, including DNA concentrations and DNA integrity tests

• Prepare manual and automated multiplexed nanopore libraries for whole genome and amplicon sequencing

• Set up, load and monitor sequencing runs for GridION and PromethION platforms, including flow cell tracking (pore QC, usage, wash and storage)

• Ensure traceability of samples from start-to-end of their sequencing life cycle, and proper documentation

• Maintenance and care of our sequencing devices and liquid handlers

• Support in lab organization, sample and reagent inventory

What We Are Looking for

• A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in biology, biotechnology, or a related field

• Hands-on experience in molecular biology work, specifically in DNA or RNA research. This can come from an academic thesis (BSc. or MSc.), internships and/or student jobs

• Ability to independently execute day-to-day experimental work within project objectives and priorities

• A structured approach to data recording and documentation

• A team-spirited approach to working with others, openly sharing progress and challenges, seeking input when troubleshooting, and supporting colleagues when needed

• Strong communication and organizational skills. English is the working language of the company

It would be an advantage if you have experience with:

• Academic specialization in genetics or molecular biology

• Direct exposure with sequencing workflows and protocols, ideally with Oxford Nanopore (MinION, GridION or PromethION)

• Experience in any of these: magnetic bead purification of nucleic acids, phi29 amplification of DNA, PCR and its variants, lab automation

• Data analysis in genomics

The Traitomic team

As a Research Associate at Traitomic, you will become part of a small, but highly dedicated and motivated start-up team, that unlocks the natural genetic diversity of plants and microbes with cutting-edge trait development technology. With a proactive approach and entrepreneurial mindset, you will have the possibility to help us shape, strengthen and grow Traitomic further.

Learn more about us and what we do here: https://www.traitomic.com

The deadline for applying is 22 of November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the deadline, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible. A cover letter is not required. However, we would appreciate a few lines in your CV outlining your motivation for applying.

We are committed to an equal and fair recruitment process for all applicants, and we aim to guide our hiring decisions by diversity and transparency. We welcome applicants from a broad range of backgrounds and experiences, regardless of ethnicity, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, age or disability.
