Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

**Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

• In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

• You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

• You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

• You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

• You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

• Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

**This includes things like...

**

• Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

• Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

• Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

• Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

• Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

**You’re a great match if

**

• You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

• You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

• You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

• You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

• You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

**Nice to haves

**

• You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

• Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

• Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

• Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

• Experience building systemic or open-world games

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**

• You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

• You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

• You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

• You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

• You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

**Practicalities

**

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• Our working language is English.

**We offer

**

• Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• Pension plan and private health insurance.

• Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

jobs.occupation: Manager – Bespoke Software Development & Adjacent Markets team
jobs.description:
Manager – Bespoke Software Development & Adjacent Markets team

Bring your software development expertise and leadership together in a role where people, technology and delivery meet. Lead a team across Aarhus and Warsaw, turn customer needs into customer-tailored Bespoke software solutions and connect Defence expertise with opportunities across Systematic. Along the way, help your team grow and shape AI adoption in developing software.

Your role: Drive software delivery and develop your team

As Manager in the SitaWare Extensions program, you will report to the Senior Director and lead one of the Defence Bespoke Development teams alongside the Adjacent Markets service function.

Your main focus will be delivering customer-tailored Bespoke software solutions that extends SitaWare Headquarters, Frontline and Edge – from software add-ons to system, tactical radio and military equipment integrations. You will take ownership of delivery on schedule, within budget and to the agreed quality. Alongside this, you will act as Project Manager for non-Defence business units in Systematic connecting them with Defence expertise, coordinating and delivering the services they need.

You can look forward to:

• Managing and driving software projects forward by setting priorities, aligning capacity and schedules, tracking progress and budgets, and managing stakeholders, risks and issues

• Developing your team across Aarhus and Warsaw through 1:1s, development talks, creating opportunities for professional and personal growth and recruitment

• Contributing your team's expertise to Defence bids for Bespoke software and representing Defence services in bids across other business units

• Building strong internal partnerships and coordinating communication on SitaWare releases, change requests, defect handling and hotfixes

• Shaping better ways of working, from processes and guides to the use of AI and agentic AI throughout the software development life cycle

You should expect 5–15 travel days a year.

Your team: Bringing SitaWare expertise together

You will lead 8–10 software architects, software engineers and test engineers across Aarhus and Warsaw, including interns and student workers, with a team lead already in place in Warsaw.

You will be part of a wider international network of colleagues across Defence Services, Product Development and other Systematic business units. The Adjacent Markets function draws on specialist expertise from other teams as needed, giving you a broad technical network and connections across the organisation.

You bring: Technical depth, people leadership and the drive to deliver

You combine a solid foundation in software development and architecture with experience guiding projects and leading people. Over several years as a project manager or software engineering manager, you have delivered medium to complex software projects or commercial off-the-shelf software products. You also bring some years of people management experience, an understanding of commercial customer contracts and experience providing services to other business units.

We are also looking for:

• A master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, software design and architecture, data science or cybersecurity, or equivalent

• Experience with system integration software, preferably within Defence, Maritime, Energy/Utilities, Transportation/Logistics or Healthcare, and with AI and agentic AI in the software development life cycle

• Confidence using Jira, D365 Project Management, Confluence and the Microsoft Office suite, including SharePoint, to support planning, collaboration and reporting

• Hands-on experience with technologies such as Java, C#, Angular, Docker, Git, deployment pipelines or cloud platforms is an advantage, along with any Defence domain knowledge from industry or the military

• Fluent English and the ability to bring clarity to technical discussions and collaboration across teams

• A proactive, decisive approach with strong ownership and follow-through, combined with the ability to motivate and involve people, put customers first, embrace change and communicate clearly with stakeholders at every level

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Thomas Frandsen Røjkjær, Director Extensions, Defence.

Communications Manager, Defence - Aarhus, Denmark

Do you want to shape how Systematic is seen across the Nordic defence sector, as the thought leader behind C5ISR software that supports allied forces every day? As our new Communications Manager, you will drive external communications for Systematic Defence in the Nordics working closely with international colleagues and taking real ownership of our story, from breaking news to speaker platforms.

The job

As Communications Manager, you will turn complex defence technology, customer developments and industry trends into clear, relevant stories for Nordic audiences. Working across Defence, Sales, Product Management and the international MarCom organisation, you will identify strong angles, engage subject-matter experts and take stories from idea to publication. You will also build trusted media relationships and help position Systematic and the SitaWare suite as an authoritative voice within C5ISR.

As a Senior Service Engineer at DESMI, your primary responsibility is to install, service, maintain, and repair our customers’ products and equipment, primarily related to pumps. You will be responsible for ensuring that the products are serviced correctly, operate reliably, and meet the customers’ needs. Your role also involves delivering excellent customer service and maintaining strong relationships with our customers.

**Work Tasks

**Your work will include gaining knowledge of, or developing expertise in, our own pump range – particularly our centrifugal pumps used by district heating and industrial customers. You will also work with sprinkler units and pressure boosting systems at various customer sites. Work on equipment from other manufacturers should also be expected.

You will perform regular maintenance to ensure optimal performance of the equipment, identify and resolve faults during maintenance, and carry out repairs either on-site or at the company’s facilities. Troubleshooting and diagnosing faults, followed by implementing appropriate solutions, will often take place in close collaboration with the Service Manager.

Customer service is an important part of the role. You will deliver excellent customer service, respond to customer inquiries, and provide technical support and guidance when needed.

Documentation is also a key responsibility. You will be expected to complete accurate documentation of all tasks performed, including installations, maintenance, and repairs, and report back to management regarding status updates and any challenges encountered.

DESMI currently uses an IT-based Field Service system, so good IT skills and language skills are considered an advantage.

**About You

**

• We imagine that you have experience with installation, maintenance, and repair of technical products.

• Technical knowledge and skills relevant to our product range.

• You possess strong problem-solving abilities, good communication skills, and a customer-focused mindset.

• You are able to work independently and efficiently.

• Your background may include experience as an electrician, automotive mechanic, agricultural mechanic, electro-mechanic, marine engineer, or another relevant technical education or professional experience within the field.

DESMI offers a wide range of training courses depending on your current competencies.

It is necessary that you have a flexible approach to working hours and are prepared to perform service and repairs while systems are still in operation when required. We always strive to provide the best possible service to our customers, as fully functioning installations are essential to their operations. Much of our equipment forms part of critical infrastructure.

DESMI Denmark A/S’ service organization performs preventive maintenance, emergency troubleshooting, and repairs on all pump installations. Services are provided both on request and through established service agreements. As our new Service Technician, you will therefore work with many different types of pump applications. Currently, we primarily work with three product groups: submersible pump installations, dry-installed gear and centrifugal pumps, and sprinkler systems.

The department in Hvidovre currently consists of 12 service technicians and 4 office staff. In addition to the service department in Hvidovre, DESMI Denmark A/S also has service departments in Kolding and Nørresundby. Altogether, the service organization consists of 35 employees.

jobs.occupation: 171819 Clinical Associate Professor (Research) of Paediatrics (Fixed-term, 5 years)
jobs.description:
Clinical Associate Professor (Research) of Paediatrics (Fixed-term, 5 years)

  Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
 University of Copenhagen

   

  The University seeks to appoint a clinical associate professor (research) of Paediatrics to the Department of Clinical Medicine to commence as soon as possible.

  The clinical research professorship (research) is combined with a clinical position at Zealand University Hospital, Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine.

  It is a requirement for appointment that the applicant is accepted for both the clinical associate professorship (research) and the clinical position. In order to be considered the applicant must send an application to both the Faculty (the clinical associate professorship (research)) and to the hospital (the clinical position) cf. the simultaneously advertised clinical position. This also applies to applicants who are already employed at the Hospital. Applicants should only apply for a clinical position at one of the hospitals. The advertisement for the clinical position is available from 

  Sundhedsjobs.dk - Clinical position as staff specialist combined with a clinical associate professorship (research) in Paediatrics- Børn og Unge, Sjællands Universitetshospital

  Information on the Department of Clinical Medicine, University of Copenhagen can be found at: Institut for Klinisk Medicin – Københavns Universitet

  Job description

  The clinical associate professors’ (research) duties will primarily consist of:

   	
• Research - Conduct and lead research on the development, treatment, and outcomes of diabetes in children and adolescents. The research is anchored in the Clinical Research Unit, Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine, and carried out in collaboration with departments at Zealand University Hospital, other hospitals, and regional and national research partners. Responsibilities include dissemination of research findings through peer-reviewed publications, presentations, and other academic activities. 	
• Research-based teaching – Deliver pregraduate teaching and examinations as part of the Clinical Course in Paediatrics for medical students, including lectures and student-centred learning activities such as tutorials. Supervise bachelor’s, master’s, and PhD students, and contribute to teaching within the mandatory Research Training Programme for Doctors in Specialist Training. 	
• Research leadership - Co-leadership of the Clinical Research Unit in the Department of Paediatric and Adolescent Medicine. Conduct independent research and development activities, and provide academic leadership, mentorship, and supervision for early-career researchers. 	
• Obligation to share knowledge with the rest of society – Contribute to the dissemination of scientific knowledge to healthcare professionals, patients, policymakers, and the wider public. 	
• Academic assessments – Participation in academic assessment and evaluation activities as a member of the assessor group within the Department of Clinical Medicine.   The division between the different tasks may vary over the 5-year period of employment. Teaching obligations are equivalent to a previous external clinical associate professorship rate B.

  Any current employment as clinical associate professor (rate A, B or rate C) will expire if the applicant is employed as a clinical associate professor (research).

  Required qualifications 

  The qualification requirement for the clinical associate professor (research) is a master’s degree in medicine, specialist status as well as further teaching and research qualifications, for example PhD or doctorate and subsequently documented scientific production on an international level. In addition, there will be an emphasis on experience with scientific guidance, research administration and international research collaboration.

  The clinical associate professors (research) are also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

  Terms of employment

  A clinical associate professor (research) is paid in accordance with Aftale om kliniske lektorer af 11. februar 2024 mellem Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet, Foreningen af Speciallæger og Yngre Læger, Cirkulære om aftale om kliniske lektorer ved universiteter under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet

  Salary and other terms and conditions of appointment are set in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and Akademikerne (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations. The position is covered by the current Ministerial Order on the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

  Questions

  For further information please contact Deputy Head of Department of Clinical Medicine, Professor Lone Baandrup, lone.baandrup@regionh.dk 

  Foreign applicants may find this link useful: For international researchers at the University of Copenhagen – University of Copenhagen

  Application

  The application must be submitted in English and must include the following:

   	
• Application (Including motivations for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages)) 	
• Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding) 	
• A complete list of publications 	
• List of 5 publications to be considered in the assessment (Please note that we do not you to upload a copy of the 5 publications) 	
• Diplomas (Master’s and PhD and other relevant certificates) 	
• Self-declaration form (https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/self-declaration-form-klf.docx) 	
• Teaching portfolio (https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/template-teaching-portfolio.docx (English) or https://ikm.ku.dk/ansat/ansaettelser/dokumenter/skabelon-undervisningsportfolio.doc (Danish)) 	
• Research plan (3‐5 pages) 	
• Teaching plan   Application procedure 

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The head of department  appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at jobportal.ku.dk.

  Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested applicants to apply for this position.

  Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59pm, Monday 30 November 2026.

  Interviews for this position will most likely be held in the month of March 2027.

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

SimCorp is transforming its existing client base to SimCorp One, our flagship enterprise platform for the world’s largest investment managers. SaaS is the foundation that makes this transformation scalable, resilient and commercially compelling.

As Sales Director, SaaS, you will sit at the centre of this growth mission. You will join a global specialist SWAT team working with regional Sales and Customer Success teams to move clients from on-premise deployments to SaaS-based SimCorp One. This is a client-facing, quota-carrying role with real ownership: from the first executive conversation and business case through solution shaping, commercial negotiation and signature.

You will help clients make one of their most important technology and operating-model decisions, while directly contributing to SimCorp’s global SaaS growth and the successful adoption of SimCorp One.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**Own complex SaaS transformation sales

• Lead the SaaS commercial motion for selected existing clients across EMEA, in close partnership with regional Sales and Customer Success teams.

• Own qualified opportunities from first client engagement through discovery, business case, proposal, negotiation and signature.

• Translate each client’s business, operating-model and technology priorities into a credible SaaS transformation roadmap and commercial proposition.

• Carry and deliver a multi-million-euro ARR target, maintaining clear opportunity strategy, forecast discipline and deal momentum.

Orchestrate the deal team

• Mobilise and lead virtual deal teams across Sales, Customer Success, Solution Consulting, Product, Platform, Services, Legal and Commercial Finance.

• Create clarity on roles, decisions, dependencies and next steps, ensuring complex sales processes progress with pace and quality.

• Engage confidently with C-level, technology, operations, procurement and risk stakeholders, adapting the value case to each audience.

• Lead commercial negotiations and internal governance, balancing client outcomes, speed and long-term value for SimCorp.

Accelerate the global SaaS growth engine

• Work as part of the specialist SimCorp One and SaaS SWAT team, sharing expertise and supporting priority transformations across markets.

• Partner with GTM, Marketing and regional leadership to identify the right clients, build pipeline and focus resources where conversion potential is strongest.

• Improve the SaaS pitch, value proposition and competitive positioning against alternatives such as remaining on-premise, running a client-owned cloud journey or full outsourcing.

• Capture field insight and feed it back into offer development, pricing, contracting, product roadmap, sales materials and enablement.

Build market confidence and repeatability

• Act as a visible SaaS thought leader internally and externally, making complex cloud and operating-model topics commercially relevant and easy to understand.

• Use standard sales plays, artefacts and governance while adapting the client journey to market maturity, installed landscape and transformation readiness.

• Create reusable deal patterns and lessons that improve conversion, consistency and scale across EMEA.

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest:

• 10+ years of experience in enterprise software, cloud, managed services, financial technology or a comparable complex solution-sales environment.

• Proven record of winning large, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals and meeting or exceeding multi-million-euro ARR targets.

• Strong commercial understanding of public cloud, SaaS, enterprise technology and recurring-revenue business models.

• Experience selling transformation rather than a standalone product, including the ability to build an executive business case and navigate long decision cycles.

• Good understanding of financial services and preferably the buy-side investment management industry.

Capabilities and working style

• Executive seller: You create trust with senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and connect technology choices to measurable business value.

• Deal orchestrator: You bring the right experts together, simplify complexity and maintain clear governance across large virtual teams.

• Transformation mindset: You understand that a move to SaaS changes technology, operations, risk, economics and ways of working, and you can lead clients through that change.

• Builder and collaborator: You improve the sales motion while executing it, sharing insight freely and contributing to one global SaaS growth mission.

• Disciplined and curious: You combine rigorous forecasting and deal management with the curiosity to understand each client’s context and identify a path forward.

• AI-enabled: You use AI tools responsibly to research, prepare, synthesise and scale high-quality commercial work.

**Benefits

In addition to our traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance through flexible working arrangements and a hybrid workplace model.

We are committed to supporting continuous professional growth through training, knowledge sharing, leadership exposure, and opportunities to work with some of the most sophisticated organizations in the global investment management industry.

There is never just one route for development at SimCorp. We offer an individual approach to career development and encourage employees to pursue paths aligned with their ambitions and interests.

NEXT STEPS

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

Can you turn a showroom visit, a reference site tour or an industry exhibition into an experience that makes a lasting impression?

In collaboration with Actief Hartmanns, Axlab is looking for an Event & Experience Manager who combines creative design with hands-on delivery and a clear commercial focus.

In the position you will own Axlab’s customer-facing experience programme: reference site visits, the headquarters showroom, Axlab Academy, and industry exhibitions. This is an opportunity to combine concept development with practical execution, shaping how visitors experience Axlab’s solutions and building the calendar, materials and processes that ensure consistent quality and continuity.

Your role goes beyond logistics: you will design welcoming, relevant experiences that help visitors understand how Axlab’s solutions work in practice. You will also build the calendar, materials and documented processes that make the programme consistent, scalable, and less dependent on any one individual.

You will be part of the Marcom team and work closely with Sales, Product Management, and external partners. Together with the Graphic Designer & Event Coordinator, you will translate ideas into a strong exhibition presence and cohesive creative execution.

What you will take ownership of

• 
Develop and deliver reference site visits, showroom tours, Academy days and exhibitions that connect customer needs with Axlab’s automated pathology workflows.

• 
Establish and continually improve the showroom experience and reference site concept for prospective and existing customers.

• 
Manage programmes and events from concept to delivery, aligning internal teams, external agencies, and production partners.

• 
Build and maintain the activity calendar, supporting materials, briefings, and documented processes.

• 
Manage suppliers, budgets, and negotiations, with close attention to production details and on-site logistics.

• 
Track event performance and work with Sales and within Marcom to ensure effective lead handling and handover.

• 
Help support the development of a sustainable webinar approach that contributes to sales opportunities.

What you bring

You have at least five years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or customer experience, ideally combining large-scale exhibitions with smaller, hosted experiences. Exhibition or trade show experience is essential, together with relevant experience from the medical device industry. You can demonstrate that you have designed and delivered premium customer or partner experiences, not simply coordinated the logistics.

• 
A bachelor’s degree or higher in marketing, communications, business, hospitality, or event management, or equivalent experience.

• 
Experience establishing and improving a showroom for a company providing anatomic pathology equipment or a medical device company.

• 
Experience developing and refining reference site concepts for prospective and existing customers.

• 
Strong end-to-end project management skills and the ability to collaborate with Sales, Product Management, and external partners.

• 
Experience managing vendors, suppliers, and budgets, including negotiations with agencies and production partners.

• 
Confidence reporting on event performance, handling leads and coordinates their handover.

• 
Fluency in English. Danish is an advantage when working with headquarters and the local reference site network.

Experience developing a webinar strategy that generates sales opportunities is a plus. Alternatively, you are comfortable learning this skill quickly, as you will work closely with your future colleagues in Marcom on this.

Regular travel should be expected, and in busy periods, this can be 50% or more.

A thoughtful host with a hands-on mindset

You make people feel genuinely welcome and adapt naturally to different visitors and situations. You stay calm when plans change, take pride in the details and are just as comfortable shaping an experience concept as managing the on-site logistics. Open and approachable, you build trust with colleagues, suppliers and senior stakeholders, communicate clear briefs, and know who needs which information — and when.

You bring creativity, initiative and a collaborative approach. You are curious about what works, use data and feedback to improve the programme and look for ways to make each visit or event meaningful rather than routine.

Axlab’s Marcom team works to build recognition of the Axlab brand for bringing innovation and automation to pathology laboratories in its direct markets. Through consistent brand storytelling, impactful events, customer experiences and digital channels, the team connects colleagues and customers with that ambition. Professional and personal development opportunities

Social activities and annual global events

Your work tasks    The successful candidate will contribute to research, supervision, teaching, and semester coordination within Lighting Design at the Department of Architecture, Design and Media Technology, Aalborg University, Copenhagen.

Research activities will be conducted with the transdisciplinary Lighting Design Lab and will primarily contribute to externally funded research projects addressing societal challenges through lighting design, technology, and human-centric approaches.

Supervision responsibilities will primarily be associated with the MSc program in Lighting Design, which includes approximately 60 international students. Our work integrates architecture, engineering, AI, and media technology and is often conducted in collaboration with private-sector partners to address relevant societal challenges. Research and experimental activities combine contextual and architectural analysis of the light environment, including daylight and electric lighting, with consideration of human visual and non-visual needs and dynamic lighting conditions.

About Userlink

Userlink runs AI agents in production at several hundred Nordic webshops, including Bahne, XL-BYG, Coolshop and Bygma. The agents handle the customer dialogue before and after the purchase, and every conversation ends up as structured data on demand and purchase barriers. The team is based in Odense.

The product and the direction

Today we sell chat. Email is rolling out now, and phone and social follow. On top of that we are building the brain: a system that brings together every signal about a webshop and its customers, understands why people buy, and why they do not, and acts on it while the buyer is still on the page. The effect is measured against a control group, so the shop can see what it means for revenue.

That moves the sale from a customer service tool to a conversation about growth, and revenue per customer can become several times what it is today.

The role

Ownership of the entire go-to-market in one place: lead generation, new business, partners and existing customers. You run the process from first contact to signature, find out what works and write the sales process the rest of the company will follow.

Lead generation is yours as a minimum. You own where the meetings come from: the customer profile, the lead lists and the sourcing of the right webshops, outbound and the campaigns that have to fill the pipeline. You measure what a meeting costs to acquire and which channels carry, and you shut down the ones that do not. You build it yourself at first and set direction for marketing and meeting booking as they come on board.

The partner channel has to be built. Agencies and platform partners need to be found, judged realistically and sold alongside until they can do it on their own.

Growth in the existing customer base is part of it, especially as email, phone and the brain roll out, measured against clear monthly and quarterly targets.

Price, pitch, customer profile and process are yours. They change when they do not work, and the team is built as the numbers allow. Denmark is home turf, but we already have customers and partners in DACH and the Netherlands, and those markets grow from here.

Decisions are made on arguments, not titles. Ideas get challenged regardless of where they come from, and the best one wins.

Why founding

You do not step into a finished sales organisation. You build the commercial side together with the founder, and what you decide on price, pitch, process and the first hires is what Userlink will sell on for years.

That is why the role comes with equity. You help build the company, and you own part of what you build. In return we expect you to take responsibility like a co-owner, also when things are unclear or go wrong.

jobs.description:
_Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

_Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement—replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

As our new Senior Software Engineer — Wealth Management Systems 📈

You will help the team solve some of the hardest product and data problems across Performativ’s investment platform.

You will work where financial workflows, product decisions, and technical systems meet: portfolio data, reporting, fees, reconciliation, instruments, transactions, cash, performance, and trading. Your contribution will be turning that complexity into coherent solutions that work across customers rather than becoming a collection of one-off customisations.

This is not a narrowly scoped position. We work as one team, and you should be willing to tackle any important problem within our area.

• You will apply deep experience from wealth management, asset management, private banking, portfolio management, investment operations, trading, custody, or related financial infrastructure to develop sound product and system designs.

• You will investigate problems that cross financial data, calculations, APIs, integrations, operational processes, and production systems—determining their root causes and delivering reliable solutions that others can understand and extend.

• You will bring product thinking to ambiguous requirements, working closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to distinguish reusable platform needs from customer-specific preferences.

• You will use AI agents to produce much of the implementation. We expect you to design the solution, direct agents effectively, challenge their assumptions, review their output, and establish the tests and evidence needed for safe production deployment.

• You will lead when your knowledge makes you the right person to lead, follow through on what you take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

Experience with performance calculations, valuations, fees, reporting, reconciliation, corporate actions, or portfolio-management systems would be particularly valuable.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. Autonomy works only when paired with initiative, collaboration, sound judgment, and follow-through.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be technically strong enough to recognise weak abstractions, incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, security problems, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• Trust and meaningful responsibility from your first day, with the opportunity to influence both our platform and how we build it.

• Difficult and consequential problems involving financial data, product design, reliability, security, and real operational workflows.

• The opportunity to define an AI-native approach to developing complex financial software and see your work reach customers quickly.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows into a European market leader.

**About 3Shape

**Things have moved fast at 3Shape ever since our founding in 2000. 3Shape specializes in developing 3D scanning and software technology solutions that enable dental and hearing professionals to treat more people more effectively, and with improved care. Every second of every day, a 3Shape scanner is used all around the globe. A number which is skyrocketing and cementing our position as technology and industry leader, Danish growth comet and unicorn company. We are a truly international workplace with 50+ nationalities and more than 2200 employees globally. We are headquartered in Denmark in the center of vibrant Copenhagen at Kongens Nytorv.

**About The 3Shape 2-Year Graduate Program

**3Shape’s two-year Graduate Program serves as a launchpad for a high-impact career. Graduates rotate through three different departments within the Technical Track, with the possibility of an international assignment. This program gives talented and motivated young professionals the chance to acquire new knowledge, expand their skillset, and gain valuable expertise from the very beginning. Graduates gain unique insights into the core of our business and play an essential role in our strategy to develop future leaders and specialists at 3Shape.

**Become Our Next Technical Graduate

**As a 3Shape Graduate, you will be a valued team member, tackle complex business challenges, and become part of an extensive network of professionals in a global organization. We offer a steep learning curve and expect a lot from you, but in return, you will have opportunities to grow both professionally and personally.

• Rotate through three departments (8 months each) working with e.g., UX/UI, Software Development, Computer Science, IT, Data, Discovery, Regulatory Affairs, Product Management, and Production and Supply Chain.

• Play an essential role in an international and innovative organization that is constantly evolving.

• Lead and contribute to real projects with measurable impact.

• Broaden your horizons by working as part of integrated teams across the globe and collaborating with people from diverse backgrounds.

• Join a well-established, social, and friendly community of current and former Graduates.

• Receive ongoing feedback, coaching, and support from rotation managers, a mentor, and a buddy.

**We Fuel Your Career With

**

• Comprehensive onboarding - including an offsite, teambuilding, and networking with the Senior Leadership Team.

• Regular meetings with your Graduate Manager focused on your development and well-being.

• Multiple training sessions (such as Case Challenge, People Module, Technical Training, etc.).

• A production visit to our site in Poland.

• Quarterly Graduate-community activities with Graduates from our two cohorts

**What Makes a 3Shape Graduate?

**You are about to complete or have just completed a master’s degree. You have achieved top academic results and are highly proficient in English. You are enthusiastic, focused, and eager to learn.

• An excellent collaborator with an empathetic approach and a global mindset.

• Versatile and adaptable.

• Thrives in an international environment.

• Motivated to take responsibility.

• Strong analytical thinker with solid problem-solving skills.

• Brings positive energy and is eager to apply knowledge and make an impact.

**What 3Shape Offers

**

• A vibrant, international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled colleagues - over 20 nationalities represented in our Denmark-based office.

• An attractive healthcare package

• Daily breakfast, Friday juices, and healthy lunches prepared by our private chefs.

• A good social work environment with many optional activities and clubs, from wine and beer tastings to board games, running, and paddle.

• Modern offices and R&D labs in downtown Copenhagen, near Kongens Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.

**Application Process

**

• Application deadline: 15/12/2026

• Graduate Program start date: 01/09/2027

• To apply, click "Apply Now" and attach your CV, answer two screening questions, and submit your academic records. Only complete applications will be considered.

• Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis – please apply as soon as possible.

• After a successful application and initial video call screening, candidates will be invited to our headquarters in Copenhagen for an assessment center on Friday, January 29th.

• If you have questions about the position or process, contact people@3shape.com.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

**About Us

**3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday across the globe on LinkedIn.

jobs.occupation: Join Nykredit Markets as a Quantitative Developer (Analyst/Associate)
jobs.description:
_Would you like to help develop the next generation of quantitative models, tools, and AI solutions in Nykredit Markets? Do you thrive at the intersection of financial markets, technology, and innovation, and are you motivated by turning complex challenges into concrete solutions? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

_A key part of Nykredit Markets’ new strategy is a comprehensive upgrade of our quant platform and models. In Quantitative Solutions, we are responsible for this initiative and are currently developing Dragonfly — a modern, scalable, and highly optimized quant platform used for market making, pricing, and risk management of financial instruments across asset classes.

We are therefore looking for a Quantitative Developer who wants to work closely with the business and help develop and maintain solutions used daily by traders, sales professionals, and other specialists in Nykredit Markets.

**Your primary responsibilities:

**

• Design and development of analytics applications: Design, develop, and maintain Dragonfly applications and tools for pricing, risk management, and modeling of financial markets and instruments.

• Building scalable and robust quant infrastructure: Ensure that our quant platform and models run reliably and scale effectively, from infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to monitoring and operations.

• Monitoring and optimizing production flows: Ensure robust processes, high data quality, and stable operation of our models and quant platform.

• Staying ahead with AI and new technology: Identify relevant AI use cases and help turn them into business solutions that create value in Markets and for our clients.

• Quantitative analysis and technical problem-solving: Work on complex financial and technological challenges and translate technical or quantitative analyses into concrete improvements and new opportunities.

**Are you the one we are looking for?

**We welcome applications from recent graduates, final-year Master’s students, and candidates with up to three years of relevant work experience. Depending on your qualifications and experience, the role will be at Analyst or Associate level.

We expect that you:

• hold a relevant university degree in finance, economics, IT, natural sciences, or engineering, with strong academic results,

• have strong software development and programming skills, including experience with Python and modern application development,

• have an interest in, and preferably experience with, AI or machine learning,

• are familiar with generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, or modern AI tools,

• understand software architecture, data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems,

• are analytically strong and motivated by solving complex financial and technical challenges,

• communicate effectively and collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders,

• have an interest in financial markets and quantitative analysis.

Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, cloud-native technologies, MLOps, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Django, React, or web development is an advantage, but not a requirement.

**Your new team

**You will join the QS Financial Engineering team, one of three teams in Quantitative Solutions. We are a department with a high level of professional expertise, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to our day-to-day work. The department consists of desk quants, quant developers, and financial engineers. Together, we ensure that Nykredit Markets has the right models, applications, and analytical decision-support capabilities to remain in the strongest possible position in the market.

**About Nykredit Markets

**Nykredit Markets is part of the Nykredit Group, one of Denmark’s largest financial institutions. Nykredit Markets offers a broad range of financial services and products within capital markets, including trading in bonds, credit, FX, and equities. We serve both institutional and private investors with advisory services and tailored investment solutions.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

_We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and review applications as we receive them.

_We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

Do you have experience with automation and communication systems for high-voltage substations? Can you lead technical work packages and coordinate specialist contributions to deliver an integrated solution? Join COWI as our new Technical Lead and contribute to the development of Denmark’s electricity transmission infrastructure.

Take technical responsibility for substation automation projects

We are looking for an experienced engineer to take technical responsibility for substation automation and communication systems in high-voltage substation projects. You will work on projects ranging from new substations to extensions, refurbishment and replacement of systems at existing sites. You will coordinate specialist contributions, manage technical interfaces and ensure that individual work packages meet the requirements of the overall substation automation solution.

The role combines technical expertise with responsibility for coordinating engineering activities, monitoring progress and ensuring the quality of technical deliverables. You will work closely with the project manager, technical specialists and other engineering disciplines throughout project execution.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Lead and coordinate the technical delivery of substation automation and communication systems.

• Plan and follow up on engineering activities, technical deliverables and milestones within your scope.

• Coordinate specialist contributions and ensure consistency across technical work packages.

• Ensure that technical solutions and documentation comply with project requirements, customer specifications and applicable standards.

• Manage technical interfaces between automation, communication systems, protection systems, primary equipment and auxiliary systems.

• Identify and resolve technical issues in collaboration with specialists and other engineering disciplines.

• Participate in project meetings and advise the project manager on technical matters, dependencies and risks within your area of responsibility.

• Coordinate technical activities with customers, suppliers and other project stakeholders.

Your expertise

You combine a strong technical foundation with a structured approach to planning and coordination. You can assess how individual systems and specialist contributions fit together, communicate technical requirements clearly and follow through on agreed actions.

You work independently and build effective working relationships with colleagues, customers and project partners.

You will also bring:

• A degree in electrical engineering or an equivalent technical qualification, together with more than five years of relevant experience in automation for high-voltage substations.

• A solid understanding of substation automation systems, including control and monitoring functions, communication networks and interfaces to protection equipment.

• An understanding of how substation secondary systems interface with high-voltage primary equipment.

• Experience coordinating technical work packages, planning engineering activities and following up on specialist deliverables.

• The ability to assess technical solutions, manage interfaces and maintain an overview of quality, progress and dependencies.

• Professional proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

We build and continuously improve solutions that provide visibility into the performance, stability, and health of critical business systems across our hybrid infrastructure.

You will help shape the future of Saxo's observability landscape by designing and operating solutions for metrics, logs, traces, and events across cloud and on-premises environments. Your work will enable engineering teams to better understand, monitor, and improve the systems that power Saxo.

**Team perspective

**_"We are the eyes and ears of Saxo Bank's platform health. Our work is critical to maintaining stable and continuous operations across the organisation.

__Our team is based in Denmark and India and consists of five specialists. While supporting our current platforms, we are also executing our roadmap for the next generation of observability capabilities."

_**Responsibilities

**

• Own and support the day-to-day operation of Saxo's observability platform.

• Partner closely with engineering teams to deliver meaningful monitoring and visibility across business-critical systems.

• Drive priorities, technical direction, and platform improvements within the team.

• Act as the observability platform architect, ensuring scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

• Play a key role in delivering the next generation of Saxo's observability platform in collaboration with Enterprise Architecture, platform teams, and business stakeholders.

**What Success Looks Like

**

• Build expertise across our observability ecosystem, including Elastic, Grafana, Kibana, Kubernetes, SCOM, and Windows Server.

• Improve visibility, reliability, and operational efficiency by reducing alert noise, enhancing dashboards, and driving actionable insights.

• Define and promote standards for logging, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.

• Collaborate with engineering, platform, and security teams to ensure observability is embedded across solutions.

• Lead incident investigations, contribute to post-mortems, and turn lessons learned into platform improvements.

• Optimise platform performance, scalability, and cost.

• Share knowledge through documentation, best practices, and technical guidance across the organisation.

**Your profile

**You have 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or a similar role, with a strong focus on observability.

**You Bring Hands-on Experience With Observability Technologies Such As

**

• Metrics: Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, or similar.

• Logging: Elastic Stack, Splunk, Loki, Cloud Logging, or similar.

• Tracing: OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Zipkin, X-Ray, or equivalent tracing solutions.

**You Also Have Experience With

**

• SRE practices, including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, and incident management.

• Distributed systems and cloud-native architectures.

• Operating and optimising Elastic Stack in production environments.

• Grafana and Kibana for dashboarding, visualisation, and alerting.

• Windows Server administration and monitoring, ideally including SCOM.

• Public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

• Kubernetes, Docker, and container-based environments.

• Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD tooling (Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, Pulumi, GitOps, etc.).

• Scripting or development experience in languages such as Java, Python, or Node.js.

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

Mission Control creates secure, self-service platform capabilities that enable product teams to build, deploy, and operate services independently. **We value passion 🔥

You will be part of the family from day one, and responsible for making your mark and driving forward your vision. Autonomous work is embedded in our culture, and we are committed to ensure you have all the tools and support you need while acknowledging the importance of flexibility.

Senior Gameplay Programmer on WHAT THE CAR?

Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? What about having creative and technical ownership from ideation through to release? Read on!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to help us continue to build upon CAR’s success by expanding upon its absurdly silly universe! We believe the best people to come up with ideas are the ones implementing them, so we expect a high degree of creativity and game design knowledge from our Gameplay Programmers, in addition to their crazy tech skills. This role involves around 60% programming and 40% game design.

Here’s what that looks like day to day

• 
Build and ship gameplay code. You’ll implement features end-to-end in an existing Unity/C# codebase and ship regularly in a live environment.

• 
Generate design ideas. You’ll take part in shaping features, articulate intent, evaluate tradeoffs, and iterate through discussion with the team.

• 
Keep the game healthy. Fix bugs, improve systems, review test videos, and document findings so issues don’t come back to haunt us.

• 
Extend and refine what’s there. You’ll build on existing mechanics, making them more robust and enjoyable for players.

• 
Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.

• 
Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

You’re a great match if

• 
You have 8+ years of commercial game development experience, having shipped at least two games as part of a team

• 
You have strong Unity and C# skills. You’re comfortable navigating a shared codebase and writing maintainable code you’d be proud to hand off

• 
You care about stability, performance, and long-term maintainability, and you leave systems better than you found them

• 
You genuinely value collaboration and working very closely with every member of the team

• 
You approach other people’s ideas with openness and try to understand the intention before giving feedback or pushing back

Nice to have

• Experience working on live games

Requirements for any job at Triband

• 
You thrive in taking ownership - you spot problems, design and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• 
You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture

• 
You value a positive work environment

• 
You contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place

Practicalities

• 
37-hour work week, with flexible work hours

Silly but ambitious projects

• 
The chance to contribute to great games that reach millions of players

•

From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. Join us as Executive Protection Advisor at Maersk

Maersk’s Protective Services function helps keep our executive leadership, their families and designated senior leaders safe, connected and able to lead the business with confidence. We do this through intelligence-led advice, structured programmes and discreet coordination across the countries where Maersk operates.

We are looking for an Executive Protection Advisor to take ownership of our Executive Protection and Event Security programmes; co-own the executive scope of our Travel Risk Management programme and the family coverage within our Expat and Family Security Programme; and act as a trusted advisor to senior executives across Maersk and A.P. Moller Holding, as well as designated family members.

This role is for someone who leads through structure and judgement rather than visibility. You can balance operational delivery with programme development, build trust with senior stakeholders, and translate exposure into proportionate, discreet and workable solutions.

The role in brief

The Executive Protection Advisor is the trusted operational and advisory point of contact for our executive population and their closest support functions. The role sits at the centre of a global Protective Services team and works directly with the Head of Protective Services.

Approximately 60% of the role is operational. You will advise on executive travel, events, residences and family security situations; manage incidents and threats when they arise; and coordinate with Regional Heads of Security, vendors and authorities to ensure the right support is in the right place at the right time.

The remaining 40% is strategic. You will own and continuously develop the Executive Protection Programme and the Event Security Programme. You will also co-own the executive scope of Travel Risk Management and the coverage for families of Maersk’s executive leadership within our Expat and Family Security Programme, while contributing to the continued professional maturity of the function.

International travel is part of the role, including support for events, oversight of site visits, and the development and maintenance of vendor relationships. The role is based in Copenhagen.

What you will do

Programme ownership and development

·  Own the Executive Protection Programme (EPP), including its appendices, procedures and workflows, and ensure it remains current and operationally usable.

·  Own the Event Security Programme (ESP), including triggers, templates, planning standards and governance.

·  Co-own the executive travel scope of our Travel Risk Management programme and the family coverage within our Expat and Family Security Programme.

·  Prepare decision-ready executive briefings for leadership review and approval.

Executive, family and residential advisory

·  Act as the trusted contact for senior executives and designated family members on protective services matters.

·  Conduct individual exposure assessments and translate findings into proportionate, discreet, and practical measures.

·  Coordinate residential security across alarms, access control, surveillance, physical improvements and vendor delivery.

Executive travel and event coordination

·  Coordinate protective services for senior executive travel.

·  Plan and oversee event security for leadership events, off-sites and public engagements.

·  Coordinate with Regional Heads of Security, local offices, vendors and authorities to ensure consistent delivery.

Incident, threat and harassment case management

·  Lead the initial assessment of threats, harassment or incidents affecting executives, family members, or company locations.

·  Coordinate with Global Threat Intelligence, Cyber Security, Legal, HQ Security, and relevant authorities.

·  Maintain clear documentation, follow-up actions, and After-Action Reviews.

Intelligence, vendors and authorities

·  Define Protective Services’ intelligence requirements and coordinate with Global Threat Intelligence.

·  Support vendor evaluations, RFP processes and procurement collaboration across executive protection, residential security, event security and intelligence suppliers.

·  Build and maintain professional relationships with Danish and international police, authorities and security partners.

Training and onboarding

·  Deliver security onboarding and briefings for new members of Maersk’s executive leadership, Executive Assistants and relevant support functions.

·  Develop audience-appropriate awareness materials, briefings, and checklists.

About you

You are a trusted advisor, not a frontline operator. You bring the composure of someone who has worked closely with senior leadership, and you understand that judgement and discretion matter more than visibility in this environment.

You are structured, take ownership and follow matters through to closure. You are comfortable with ambiguity, able to bring orders to incomplete information, and confident in turning it into a workable plan.

You are proactive and anticipate what is coming. You engage early with Executive Assistants, regional partners and vendors, ensuring Protective Services remains a step ahead.

You communicate with clarity and confidence. You can turn a complex security topic into a concise, decision-ready briefing for a senior leader, and you can raise concerns respectfully but firmly when the situation requires it.

You understand that this is a people-focused role. Trust is the foundation, discretion is the standard and continuity is essential to effective delivery.

Qualifications

Required

·  Danish citizenship, as the role requires eligibility for national security clearance and professional cooperation with Danish authorities, including the Police and PET.

·  A relevant background in corporate protective services, executive protection, security risk management, intelligence, police, military or diplomatic security.

·  Documented experience of working professionally with authorities on security matters, or a demonstrated ability to build and maintain such relationships.

·  Experience in at least two of the following four core areas: executive protection; family and residential security; event security; or executive travel coordination.

·  Strong judgement and the ability to act autonomously in sensitive situations.

·  Exceptional discretion and interpersonal awareness.

·  Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

·  A valid driver’s license and the ability to travel internationally.

Preferred

·  Experience in a global corporate environment with executive stakeholders.

·  Experience developing and maintaining security programmes, procedures, or playbooks.

·  Experience coordinating with Regional Security teams across multiple geographies.

·  Working knowledge of ISO 31030 (Travel Risk Management) or similar standards.

·  Experience with vendor evaluation, procurement collaboration, and performance oversight.

·  Danish language skills.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. About the Role

Our GTM organization is at an inflection point after reaching more than €100M ARR in 2025. The challenge? Keeping an iconic game feeling fresh, modern, and innovative for hundreds of millions of players around the world.

Come help evolve the visual experience of Subway Surfers, designing new features, game modes, and player journeys while continuously improving the experience that keeps players coming back. Some days you'll be crafting entirely new interfaces. Other days you'll make a tiny change that unlocks a surprisingly big impact. That's the fun part.

**You'll start taking ownership of more impactful work across the game, designing engaging interfaces and helping improve the player experience through thoughtful UI/UX solutions. You'll collaborate closely with the team to iterate on designs based on player feedback, insights, and performance data.

**By 12 months...

**You'll be a trusted contributor to the future of Subway Surfers, able to lead individual UI/UX initiatives across major features. At this point, your contributions to the UI style guide and visual framework will have enabled a smoother collaboration across teams, ensuring Subway Surfers will remain an evergreen.

**Requirements

• A strong portfolio demonstrating solid UI design work for games, with clear examples of creating intuitive, polished, and engaging player experiences.

Jobbeskrivelse

Do you have experience working with children with special needs, and do you enjoy an active one-to-one role? Then you could become an important source of support for a 9-year-old boy who loves movement, play and safe, predictable routines.

About the role

You will provide regular one-to-one support for a 9-year-old boy with autism and an intellectual disability. He needs close support, clear structure and a calm approach that helps create predictability.

The boy is energetic, enjoys being active and particularly likes outdoor play, trips to the playground and running in the woods. He also enjoys activities such as puzzles, music, bubbles, balloons and sensory toys. Your role is to plan and take part in activities that match his pace and needs. As he has limited awareness of danger, it is important that you stay close to him and remain attentive to his surroundings.

The role includes assistance with personal care, including bathing, changing diapers and toilet training. You will also provide support at mealtimes, with a focus on motivating and guiding him towards gradually becoming more independent.

The boy does not communicate verbally and uses only a few English words. It is therefore important that you are able to communicate in English, including with his parents, who do not speak Danish.

The boy has food allergies and has an EpiPen, which must be used in the event of an allergic reaction. The family will provide thorough instructions on its use. He also has asthma, and his parents are responsible for all medication management.

About you

You may be a qualified pedagogue/social educator or have relevant experience working with children with special needs. You approach the child with calmness, patience and clarity, and you enjoy an active working environment where you take part in play and physical activities.

At the same time, you are able to create structure and a sense of security, be attentive and provide clear boundaries when needed. As communication with the family takes place in English, you must be able to communicate confidently in English.

A driving licence is an advantage. Alternatively, you must be comfortable using the family’s cargo bike, which will be provided.

Working hours

The position is for 16 hours per week. The working hours are:

Two weekdays per week: 3 hours after school, from 2:30 pm to 5:30 pm

Thursdays: 9:30 am to 1:30 pm (4 hours)

Sundays: 11:00 am to 5:00 pm

What we offer

You will become part of a family-owned company with many dedicated employees. You will have a dedicated adviser who is available for guidance and support. Outside office hours, a staffed emergency phone line is always available, so you are never on your own.

Salary and pension are provided in accordance with the national collective agreement between FOA and the Danish Chamber of Commerce (Dansk Erhverv). You are covered by DUOS’ liability and occupational injury insurance, and health insurance is included as part of your pension scheme.

We offer a wide range of courses, and as a DUOS employee, you will receive relevant induction and ongoing professional development. Working with people at DUOS also gives you the opportunity to develop both personally and professionally.

Would you like to become our new colleague?

Please submit your application via the link. You must have a profile on mit.duos.dk and be logged in to apply. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. The position is available for an immediate start.

If you have any further questions, please contact Recruitment Consultant Trine Ankær Johansen on +45 36 34 49 90. You can also find answers to general questions in our FAQ.

We are people helping people

At DUOS, we help people in their everyday lives, support them through challenging situations and contribute to their well-being and quality of life. As one of Denmark’s largest and longest-established welfare service providers, we strive to be there where support is needed.

We understand the importance of combining empathy with the right professional expertise, and we know that finding the right match between an employee and the person receiving support is essential for our services to make a meaningful difference.

Join the DUOS team and make an important difference in another person’s life.

Learn more about DUOS at www.duos.dk.
