jobs.occupation: DevOps / Platform Engineer — Reliability, Performance & Production Ownership
jobs.description:
DevOps / Platform Engineer — Fully Remote, Performance & Production Ownership

Want to work fully remotely with real freedom and ownership while operating high-throughput, low-latency systems that serve billions of shoppers?

For the right person, this is a high-trust role where you have flexibility in how you structure your work and the opportunity to make a significant impact on the technology behind billions of e-commerce experiences.

We’re building the infrastructure behind better e-commerce experiences for billions of shoppers every year.

Our systems serve more than 2,000 requests per second. Our in-house search engine delivers a p50 latency of sub-ms, while our entire infrastructure maintains 99.998% uptime.

We work with modern technology, use AI as a fundamental part of how we build, and continuously push the limits of reliability, performance, and innovation. Our goal is simple: connect e-commerce shoppers with the right products at the right time while helping merchants create a better customer experience and improve their bottom line.

We’re proud of the systems we’ve built—and we want someone who is excited to help make them even faster, more reliable, and more capable.

This job will be perfect for you if

• You enjoy operating high-throughput production systems where latency, reliability, and customer impact matter

• You care deeply about reliability, latency, throughput, and system performance

• You can investigate problems across infrastructure, application code, databases, queues, and networks

• You are comfortable reading, writing, debugging, and optimising production code

• You proactively identify failure scenarios before they become incidents

• You build automation and tooling instead of accepting repetitive manual work

• You enjoy improving CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, and developer experience

• You have handled serious production incidents and understand the responsibility that comes with on-call

• You think beyond whether a deployment succeeded and care about how the system behaves afterwards

• You can communicate clearly during incidents and take ownership when things matter

• You are curious about new technology and enjoy finding better ways to build and operate systems

• You want to work closely with software engineers rather than treating infrastructure as a separate world

• You thrive in a remote environment where freedom is matched by responsibility

A normal day for you

No two days will be the same, but your work might include:

• Investigating why a service, query, or piece of application code is slower than it should be

• Improving the reliability and performance of systems serving thousands of requests per second

• Reviewing metrics, traces, logs, and alerts to identify issues before they affect customers

• Designing and implementing infrastructure, automation, and internal tooling

• Writing, reviewing, debugging, and optimising production code

• Working with developers to improve how systems are built, deployed, and operated

• Responding to incidents when needed, then making sure the underlying problem is permanently addressed

• Exploring how new technologies and AI-powered tools can improve our engineering workflow

• Thinking proactively about scaling, capacity, resilience, and potential failure scenarios

AI is part of the job

We’re an AI-first company. AI and agentic coding are already part of how we build, investigate, automate, and improve systems.

You should already be comfortable using AI in your daily engineering workflow—for example, to investigate incidents, generate and review code, build internal tooling, automate operational work, and improve your own productivity.

How we work

This role can be fully remote for the right person.

We believe in giving people the freedom to structure their work in a way that helps them perform at their best. We care about impact, ownership, communication, and results—not about watching when or where you work.

You’ll need to work with meaningful overlap during CET working hours and participate in our PagerDuty/on-call rotation. Freedom comes with responsibility, especially when you are responsible for production systems.

On-call includes holidays

If you are scheduled to be on call and a genuine production alarm goes off—whether that is on a normal weekday, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year’s Eve, or New Year’s Day—you are expected to respond, take ownership, and stay with the issue until our systems are fully up and running again.

This is an important part of the role and is not optional. We are looking for someone who genuinely stands behind their work and understands that production ownership sometimes means being there when things go wrong.

At the same time, your goal is to make this situation as rare as possible. The best engineer is not the person who enjoys firefighting every holiday, but the person who builds reliable systems, strong monitoring, and effective automation so that firefighting is never needed.

How to apply

Instead of starting with a traditional cover letter, please send us a maximum 10-minute video.

We are hiring a human being—not AI-generated slop, a spotless resume, or someone who simply knows how to present the right keywords. We know the kind of person we are looking for, but the process also needs to be mutual. You should get the opportunity to meet the people behind the company and decide whether this is the right environment for you.

That is why we want to meet you upfront and see how you think, communicate, and explain your experience—not only evaluate what is written on paper.

**In The Video, Please Tell Us

**

• Who you are

• The production systems you have owned

• A difficult reliability or performance problem you solved

• What you changed and the measurable result

• How you approach incidents and on-call responsibility

• How you currently use AI and agentic coding

• Why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role

• What you are looking for in your next team and role

The video does not need to be polished. Please don’t spend time producing a perfect presentation or reading a script. We want to see the real person, understand how you think, and hear about the work you have actually done.

You may also include a short written example of a system that was slow, unreliable, or difficult to operate. Explain how you found the root cause, what you changed, and what improved afterwards.

If you are primarily an infrastructure administrator, this probably isn’t the right role. If you are a production-minded software engineer who enjoys making systems faster, more reliable, and easier to operate, we would love to hear from you.

Since you’ll be carrying this function on your own, your ability to connect with people across teams is what makes you effective, and it’s something you’ll get to build from the ground up.

A Snapshot of Your Day

As a software developer in our turbine software team, you will play a key role in developing the embedded software that controls wind turbines. Your day will involve close collaboration with team members and stakeholders from around the world, working through the full software development lifecycle—from requirements clarification and implementation to testing and maintenance. You’ll contribute to innovative projects, participate in agile SCRUM teams, and help ensure our solutions are robust, secure, and high-performing. With a flexible work environment, you’ll have the opportunity to balance independent tasks with teamwork, both in the office and remotely.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Develop and maintain control software in C++ for Linux-based embedded systems, ensuring reliable operation of wind turbines.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver high-quality software solutions.

• Conduct comprehensive software testing, including unit, integration, and acceptance tests, employing strong CI/CD practices and AI-assisted programming.

• Refactor and enhance existing code to maintain fleet performance and participate in innovation initiatives such as code camps and ideation events.

• Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by following agile development principles within a SCRUM and SAFe environment.

What You Bring

• Academic degree in IT, Software, Electronics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, combined with 5+ years of experience in C/C++ software development.

• Proficiency in object-oriented programming, software testing, continuous integration, embedded control mechanisms, and middleware development for Linux-based x86 and ARM platforms, including Linux system hardening for cyber-security.

• A keen interest in control of mechanical areas such as aerodynamics, mechanics, hydraulics, and power electronics, with a passion for integrating hardware and software into safe, high-quality solutions.

• Experience working with real-time protocols (e.g., ProfiNet), version control systems (Git), task management tools (Jira), and agile development methodologies such as SCRUM and SAFe.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, combined with a structured and proactive approach, an ownership mindset, and a passion for delivering high-quality software solutions in the renewable energy sector.

About the Team

You’ll join a diverse and innovative team dedicated to advancing renewable energy through pioneering software solutions. Our team thrives on mutual support, open communication, and a shared commitment to making a positive impact on the world.

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• Medical benefits

• Employer-funded pension

• Subsidised lunch and more

Can you keep an overview in a busy operational environment, bring structure to your tasks and make the right priorities when plans change? Do you enjoy working with people, taking responsibility and finding solutions?

Blue Water Shipping is looking for a dedicated Port Agent to join our Cruise & Port Agency team in Greve. **

• Planning and coordination of daily port operations

• Daily communication with vessels, customers, ports, authorities and suppliers

• Attendance of vessels and operations at the pier when required

• Handling vessel clearances and relevant documentation

• Coordination of crew changes, transportation and other crew-related services

• Arranging services, supplies, spare parts and other vessel requirements

• Customer invoicing and administrative follow-up

• Handling changing operational requirements and finding solutions when plans change

• Supporting port calls in other Danish ports when required

We are also open to candidates with transferable experience from other service-oriented or operational environments. Most importantly, you are reliable, service-minded, proactive and motivated to learn.

We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership and follows tasks through

• Is proactive, solution-oriented and adaptable

• Remains calm and structured under pressure

• Communicates confidently and professionally with different stakeholders

• Works well both independently and as part of a team

• Enjoys a fast-paced, international environment

• Has an interest in shipping, port operations and the maritime industry

You should have strong written and spoken English skills, be comfortable with MS Office and new IT systems, hold a valid Category B driving licence, and be able to travel within Denmark and occasionally abroad.

• Hands-on experience within the international shipping and cruise industries

• Training and continuous professional development

• The opportunity to gradually take responsibility for your own vessel calls and customers

• Close cooperation with experienced colleagues across Blue Water Shipping

• Exposure to international customers, vessels, ports and maritime professionals

• A strong community where cooperation, commitment and team spirit are important

**Contact

**If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Pernille Marcussen, Manager, Cruise & Port Agency, at +45 42124613 or pmar@bws.dk.

Apply as soon as possible, as we review and interview on an ongoing basis.

**Build full-stack AI agents for science, with freedom, room to be creative, and real ownership, in a lively startup in Copenhagen.

**An AI agent is only as useful to a scientist as the data it can see and trust. Dalea gives research labs structured data with full provenance, and we want AI co-scientists that do real scientific work on top of it. You'll own the AI side of that.

What you'll own

• The agent harness and the framework for AI co-scientist agents, from architecture to the workflows they run.

• Our MCP integrations, which give agents access to lab data with a traceable record of what they do.

• Model choices: following the field, testing new models against what labs actually need, and adopting what works.

• How we evaluate AI quality.

• The infrastructure the AI runs on: inference, model serving and agent execution.

• Full-stack work wherever the AI needs deeper integration with the platform, and help elsewhere when the team needs it.

What you bring

**Must-haves

**

• You've designed and built an LLM agent system used in production, and made the architecture decisions yourself.

• Strong full-stack TypeScript (React, Next.js or close equivalents), and you're comfortable in Python.

• You've owned the direction of a technical area, including a significant rework.

• You've shipped quickly in a small team or an early-stage product.

**Nice To Have (none Of Them Required)

**

• MCP servers or clients, agent frameworks or harness tooling (open source counts)

• Tools for scientists, or a background in bioinformatics, computational biology or AI for science

• Mastra or another TypeScript agent framework

• Open-weight models, through inference APIs or self-hosting

• Kubernetes

• Systems where provenance or audit trails matter

You don't need lab or biology knowledge, a PhD or Danish. Hands-on, shipped work counts more than research or publications. If you match the must-haves, apply, even if you have none of the nice-to-haves.

Our stack

TypeScript, Next.js and React. Python for our MCP service. An agent harness built on Mastra. Docker Compose and Kubernetes, hosted on Scaleway.

How we work

Our dev team is the two founders plus up to three new developers, led by our CTO. We discuss progress and priorities closely and continuously, and we expect you to take part: share ideas early, argue for what you think is right, and change course when the evidence says so.

You won't need permission to fix what's broken, and what you build reaches production quickly. We work together at BioInnovation Institute 3–5 days a week. We're building the team and the way we work, and that happens best in person.

**About Dalea

**Dalea is a data management platform for biology and lab workflows. Experiments, structured data, samples and inventory sit in one place, with full data provenance. Everything a lab builds in Dalea can be packaged and shared, so we're building a GitHub for life science: labs publish and reuse each other's workflows instead of rebuilding them from scratch. We work with biotech startups, academic labs, pharma R&D and CROs.

Timing and our funding round

This position depends on our current funding round closing, which we expect in February/March 2027. We can make a conditional offer before then, and we'll be open with you about the timing throughout the process.

What we offer

• Salary: DKK 725,000–900,000 per year, depending on experience

• Warrants: under the Danish

• 7P scheme

• Pension: through ASE

• Location: BioInnovation Institute, Copenhagen, on-site 3–5 days a week. You'll need to live in the Copenhagen area or be willing to move here. We're happy to hear from people relocating within the EU.

• Language: English

• Start: when the round closes

How to apply

Apply here with your LinkedIn profile, your CV and short answers to a few questions. No cover letter needed.

jobs.occupation: Data Portfolio Analyst for Markets Data Office
jobs.description:
Bring your banking and data experience into our newly established Markets Data Office. Join us and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now. Join us in building a new data capability in Markets

About the job

At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets.

We are a newly established team and still in our build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve.

As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets.

This is an opportunity to join early, influence how we work and make a real impact on how data is governed at scale.

What you will do

As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will take ownership of data governance activities within one of our four domain areas. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams to improve how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled.

Depending on your domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market data, price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data.

You will be part of one Markets Data Office with shared standards, tooling and governance practices, while also helping to define and improve these as the team develops.

Your responsibilities will include

• Taking ownership of ongoing data governance activities within your domain and driving them forward

• Identifying and documenting Critical Data Attributes (CDAs) by reviewing data attributes with stakeholders, assessing which are critical for Saxo and driving the governance of Critical Data Elements (CDEs)

• Analysing data together with data owners to assess quality, identify issues and lead root cause investigations

• Defining and maintaining data definitions, rules, thresholds and documentation used in monitoring and control activities

• Monitoring data quality outputs, tracking remediation and escalating when issues are not being resolved

• Building strong working relationships with data owners, data stewards and stakeholders across business and technology

• Helping shape the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office

A key part of your role will be making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain, helping create transparency and consistency across the organisation.

Who you are

You bring:

• Some years of experience from the banking sector, which is a requirement for this position

• Experience in data analysis, data quality, data governance or a related field

• The ability to understand data in the context of business processes and explain your findings clearly to both business and technical audiences

• The ability to produce clear and structured documentation

• Hands on experience with SQL. Experience with Python is an advantage

• Experience using AI and other technology tools to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working

It would be a clear advantage if you have

• Experience from Markets functions such as trading, market or counterparty risk, investment products or operations, including an understanding of how a trade moves from front to back

• Experience with data governance in financial services, for example CDEs, data ownership, data profiling, data controls, data lineage or BCBS 239

• Experience with Databricks, Great Expectations, OpenMetadata or similar data platforms and data quality tools

We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership. You move your work forward, follow through and take initiative.

• Collaborates naturally. You build trust with business stakeholders, technology teams and colleagues across different domain areas.

• Uses technology naturally. You use technology to analyse, automate, document and find more effective ways of working.

• Is comfortable working in an evolving environment. You can manage changing priorities, bring structure to areas that are still developing and help shape solutions as the team grows.

• Is structured and curious. You have a strong analytical mindset, pay attention to detail and enjoy understanding how things work.

What we offer

• The opportunity to help build a new data function and its foundations from the ground up

• Real ownership and influence on how critical data is governed across Markets

• Exposure to key business domains and critical data flows

• The opportunity to work closely with experienced colleagues across Markets, data and technology

• A role that can develop alongside a growing team

You will join the Markets Data Office at an early stage of its journey, giving you the opportunity to take on new challenges, grow your responsibility and influence how critical data is managed across Markets.

jobs.occupation: Cluster Lead & Theme Integrator – Core Payments Platform
jobs.description:
Payments sit at the heart of what Danske Bank does for its customers every day. As the Core Payments Platform modernises domestic and cross-border payments, this role gives you the chance to lead a cluster of five squads through a period of real transformation. You will combine functional and HR responsibility with ownership of a strategic commercial theme on our cross-border platform.

What you will be doing

The area is undergoing significant change, driven by customer expectations, regulation and platform modernisation. In this role, you will set direction for the squads, build a strong leadership environment and establish effective governance around commercial cross-border initiatives. • Structured, pragmatic approach to moving complex topics towards decisions and delivery

jobs.occupation: Market Data and Exchange Relations Manager
jobs.description:
Want to put your financial markets expertise to work across exchanges, market data providers and multiple asset classes? Join Saxo’s Market Data & Exchange Relations team and take ownership in an area connecting markets, technology and commercial relationships.

About the role

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of financial markets, market data, exchanges and technology in an international environment. You will collaborate with exchanges, market data providers and colleagues across Saxo, helping ensure that the data supporting our trading platforms and internal systems is managed effectively.

The Market Data & Exchange Relations team manages licensing and relationships with the external vendors and exchanges that provide market data to Saxo's trading platforms and internal systems.

Depending on your experience, you may bring established market data expertise to the team or relevant experience from another part of the financial sector and an interest in developing further within market data and exchange relations.

You will gain broad exposure to the financial markets value chain and work across multiple asset classes, including equities, futures, options and bonds.

The position involves collaboration across Saxo's international organisation, including commercial, operational, technology, finance and other specialist teams. You will also engage directly with exchanges and external data providers.

Your responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include a combination of contract management, operational and commercial, including:

• Managing and maintaining relationships with market data vendors and exchanges, including licensing requirements and usage rights

• Negotiating, reviewing and maintaining market data licensing and vendor agreements, including commercial terms, permitted use and redistribution rights

• Acting as a point of contact for exchanges, vendors and other external partners

• Working with internal teams on billing, budgeting and reporting

• Monitoring and analysing market data usage, licensing permissions, entitlements and reporting obligations

• Supporting appropriate and compliant use of licensed market data across the organisation, in line with exchange and vendor licensing terms

• Providing market data licensing expertise and guidance to internal projects, new products and initiatives

• Managing day-to-day enquiries from internal and external stakeholders

• Supporting the ongoing development of processes and controls within the Market Data & Exchange Relations area

The scope and level of ownership can be adapted to your experience.

Your profile

We are interested in candidates with experience from market data, financial markets, exchanges, trading, financial services or a related field.

You may already be an experienced market data professional, or you may have developed relevant knowledge in another area of the financial sector and see market data as your next specialisation.

We expect that you:

• Have relevant professional experience within financial services, market data or a related environment

• Have an interest in financial markets and how data supports trading and investment services

• Are comfortable working with contracts, data, processes and multiple stakeholders

• Take a structured and reliable approach to your work and can manage competing priorities

• Communicate effectively with both specialist and non-specialist stakeholders

• Are comfortable working with Excel, datasets and presentation tools and can learn new systems

• Can work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment

• Are comfortable working in English in an international organisation

Experience working directly with market data vendors, stock exchanges, market data licensing, usage rights, redistribution, entitlements, reporting obligations or market data agreements would be valuable, but candidates with transferable experience from the wider financial sector are also encouraged to apply.

An international role with broad market exposure

This position provides an opportunity to develop a detailed understanding of how financial-market data moves from exchanges and providers into the systems and services used by investors and market participants.

You will work with colleagues and external partners across markets and functions, giving you exposure to both the commercial and operational aspects of market data.

Whether you bring several years of specialist experience or are looking to broaden your financial-markets expertise, the role offers the opportunity to take meaningful ownership while continuing to develop your knowledge.

The position is based at Saxo Bank's headquarters in Denmark.

Curious about how technology and AI can improve the way we work with data? Join Saxo and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now. Join us in building a new data capability in Markets

About the job

At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets.

We are a newly established team and still very much in the build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve.

As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets.

This is an opportunity to join early, learn quickly and have a real influence on how we work.

What you will do

Technology will be an important part of your role. Together with colleagues in the team, you will help strengthen our technical foundation. This could mean building AI supported workflows, contributing to Azure projects, automating manual processes or exploring new tools and platforms.

As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will work across our four domain areas together with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams. Your focus will be on improving how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled. Depending on the domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market and price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data.

You will learn about Markets from experienced colleagues and gradually take ownership of your own areas and tasks. You will be part of one Markets Data Office, working with shared standards, tooling and governance practices. You will sit close to the business and help turn business needs into practical technical solutions. We want you to experiment, test ideas and find better ways of working.

Your responsibilities will include

• Exploring and testing new technology, including AI, and helping the team choose and use the right tools

• Setting up reporting and dashboards for data owners and data stewards, for example in Power BI

• Automating manual parts of our governance work, including data quality checks, documentation and metadata

• Building and maintaining AI supported workflows and data workflows together with colleagues and technology teams, for example in Azure or Databricks

• Testing and validating automated workflows, including AI outputs, before they are used in day to day governance work

• Helping define and maintain data definitions, rules, thresholds and supporting documentation

• Monitoring data quality outputs, following up on remediation and raising issues when they are not being resolved

• Working with data owners, stewards and stakeholders across business and technology, and helping translate between business needs and technical solutions

• Contributing to the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office

A key part of the role is making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain. This helps create transparency and consistency across the organisation.

Who you are

You have recently completed a master’s degree or have around one to two years of professional experience.

• A relevant degree in areas such as information systems, data science, computer science, business analytics or a similar field

• An interest in data and how it supports business processes, combined with an interest in connecting business and technology

• Experience with SQL, Python or similar tools from your studies, a student job or personal projects

• Hands on experience using AI or other technology to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working

• Good communication skills in English and the ability to write clear and structured documentation

You do not need to know everything from day one. What matters most is that you are curious, willing to learn and motivated to build your technical skills.

An advantage if you have

• Familiarity with Azure, Databricks, Power BI, Great Expectations, data catalogue tools such as OpenMetadata or similar technologies

• Experience building with AI beyond everyday use, for example agents, LiteLLM based workflows, prompt engineering or automation using tools such as Power Automate

• Experience from banking or financial services, for example through a student job

• Knowledge of, or an interest in, Markets functions such as trading, risk, investment products or operations, including how a trade moves from front to back

• Exposure to data governance or data quality work such as data profiling, data controls or data lineage, ideally within financial services

We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership. You move your work forward, follow through and take initiative

• Collaborates naturally. You build relationships with business stakeholders, technology teams and colleagues across different domain areas

• Uses technology naturally. You enjoy experimenting with new tools, testing ideas and learning from things that do not work the first time

Team

You will be a part of a team consisting of five skilled financial professionals and will support our financial strategy to align with CIP FS’ ambitious long-term goals.

You will engage senior stakeholders to provide crucial financial insights across our platform companies and regions.

Role

Reporting to the VP of Global Controlling and Financial Reporting, you will contribute to the consolidation of the group’s financial statements and related reporting processes. You will be responsible for ensuring high-quality financial reporting and compliance with relevant accounting standards, and for supporting the business with accurate and timely insights.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Monthly controlling of accounts including cost controlling, balance sheet controlling and intercompany (IC) controlling

• Prepare and analyze consolidated financial statements and management reports

• Driving improvements in reporting processes and financial controls

• Collaborate with finance teams across the organization to ensure best practices in group reporting

• Close cooperation with the global capability center (shared service center)

• Oversight and controlling of service provider activities and point of contact for local service providers responsible for finance and corporate matters

• Act as a contact for auditors and internal stakeholders

You

• Comprehensive knowledge of cost accounting and controlling

• Advanced analytical skills and attention to detail

• Effective time management, with the ability to prioritize assignments and manage short deadlines

• Solid communication skills and ability to collaborate across functions

• Curious and self-driven

jobs.occupation: Join Nykredit Markets as a Desk Quant (Analyst/Associate)
jobs.description:
_Would you like to help develop financial models, applications, and quantitative solutions that support our trading of financial instruments in Nykredit Markets? Are you motivated by combining financial insight, technology, and quantitative analysis in a high-performing environment with strong expertise, significant responsibility, and visible impact? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

_A key part of Nykredit Markets’ new strategy is a comprehensive upgrade of our quant platform and models. In Quantitative Solutions, we are responsible for this initiative and are currently developing Dragonfly – a modern, scalable, and highly optimized quant platform used for market making, pricing, and risk management of financial instruments across asset classes.

We are therefore looking for a Desk Quant who wants to work close to the business and contribute to developing and maintaining solutions used daily by traders, sales professionals, and other specialists in Nykredit Markets.

**Your primary responsibilities:

**

• Trading support: Work closely with our trading desks and contribute to daily market activities where Dragonfly and other quant solutions are used.

• Financial modeling and quantitative analysis: Configure, analyze, and apply our models for pricing and risk management of financial products.

• Development of analytics applications: Design, develop, and maintain Dragonfly applications and tools for the business.

• Model setup and risk calculations: Contribute to the setup, maintenance, and further development of models and risk calculations in both Dragonfly and other trading systems.

• Monitoring and optimizing production flows: Ensure robust processes, high data quality, and stable operation of our models and quant platform.

• Markets-focused use of AI: Help identify and implement AI-driven solutions where they create business value.

**Are you the one we are looking for?

**We welcome applications from recent graduates, final-year Master’s students, and candidates with up to three years of relevant work experience. Depending on your qualifications and experience, the role will be at Analyst or Associate level.

We expect that you:

• hold a relevant university degree in finance, economics, natural sciences, or engineering, with strong academic results,

• have strong analytical skills and are motivated by solving complex financial challenges,

• have a solid understanding of quantitative modeling and financial theory,

• have programming experience in Python and strong Excel skills,

• have an interest in, and preferably experience with, AI or machine learning,

• thrive in a fast-paced environment with a strong performance focus and multiple parallel tasks,

• have an interest in financial markets and products.

**Your new team

**You will join the QS Pricing & Structuring team, one of three teams in Quantitative Solutions. We are a department with a high level of professional expertise, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to our day-to-day work. The department consists of desk quants, quant developers, and financial engineers. Together, we ensure that Nykredit Markets has the right models, applications, and analytical decision support to remain at the forefront of the market.

**About Nykredit Markets

**Nykredit Markets is part of the Nykredit Group, one of Denmark’s largest financial institutions. Nykredit Markets offers a broad range of financial services and products within capital markets, including trading in bonds, credit, FX, and equities. We serve both institutional and private investors with advisory services and tailored investment solutions.

**Want to know more?

**You are welcome to contact me, David Sloth Pedersen, Head of Quantitative Solutions, at quant@nykredit.dk if you have any questions about the position.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

_We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and review applications as we receive them.

_We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

Are you currently studying business, supply chain, or a related field - and looking to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, international work environment? As a Student Assistant you will become an integral part of our CMO department, where you will support our four SRT teams in a cross-functional capacity. Each team manages a cluster of external suppliers, and your role will be essential in ensuring smooth coordination and continuous product supply through collaboration with both suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Your key tasks include:

• Sharing forecast and purchase orders with our global suppliers

• Processing Purchase Orders and coordination

• Liaise with internal stakeholders regarding order status and updates

• Supporting various operational activities across the SRT teams

There is an opportunity to build and expand your areas of responsibility, as personal and professional development is highly valued within Orifarm.

We are looking for someone who can work approximately 15 hours a week. However, we offer flexibility around exam periods.

Who are you?

We imagine that you are currently enrolled in higher education within business, purchasing, supply chain or similar.

The ideal candidate is:

• Highly organized and detail-focused

• Analytically skilled

• Comfortable communicating with a wide range of stakeholders – both internally and externally

• Proficient in English (written and spoken); Danish is a plus

• Confident using Microsoft Office, especially Excel

Who are we?

Our CMO department consists of 23 employees divided into 4 teams with the main objective of ensuring continuous and reliable product supply from our external suppliers within the two business areas: prescription medicine (Specialty) and OTC & Food Supplements.

jobs.occupation: Department Manager for Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Department Manager for Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) at Novo Nordisk Engineering

If you’re energised by electrical and instrumentation engineering and you thrive on combining people leadership with project execution, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a Department Manager to join one of our Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) departments. As part of our E&I organisation, you will divide your time between project execution and department management, ensuring both successful project delivery and the continued development of your team.

Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) plays a key role in designing and delivering safe, reliable, and efficient pharmaceutical production facilities. Our work connects the physical production process with the systems that monitor, control, and safeguard it throughout the entire engineering lifecycle, from conceptual and detailed design to procurement, construction support, testing, commissioning, and qualification.

Your contribution will be important in developing people, strengthening technical excellence, and supporting the continued growth of our E&I capabilities as demand for complex pharmaceutical engineering solutions increases.

How you might spend your days

As a Department Manager, you’ll be:

• Leading and developing a team of approximately 11 employees and consultants

• Contributing to projects while providing technical and managerial leadership

• Managing resource allocation across projects and portfolios

• Driving employee, discipline, and competency development together with senior specialists

• Strengthening collaboration with colleagues in Denmark and Bangalore, India

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Skilled at bringing people together around a common purpose

• Result-oriented with a structured and proactive approach to leadership

• Focused on employee growth, engagement, and development

• Able to build strong professional relationships with customers and stakeholders

• Agile and comfortable prioritising in a dynamic project environment

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You have at least 5 years of leadership experience

• You hold a BSc or MSc within Electrical Engineering, Automation or a related discipline

• You are fluent in written and spoken Danish and English

• You have knowledge of GMP and GEP requirements

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 19th November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Director Jannick Kartman at +45 3075 5575.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

_Would you like to shape the services that help colleagues communicate, collaborate and work productively every day?

_As Service Owner, Collaboration & Productivity, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of these services at GlobalConnect, with Microsoft 365 at the center of your portfolio.

You’ll combine service reliability and governance with the opportunity to shape how our collaboration and productivity services develop over time.

**To Thrive In This Role, You’ll Likely Bring

**

• Experience with IT service management and governance, including service transition, incident and problem management, change management and continuous improvement.

**About The Role And The Team

**You’ll own the lifecycle of GlobalConnect’s Collaboration & Productivity portfolio, including Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Copilot and other strategic collaboration platforms. Your focus will be to keep these business-critical services secure, reliable and well managed, while continuously improving them and helping set the long-term direction for the area.

You’ll be part of the Digital Workplace organization, in a team of 17 colleagues with experience in IT support, system ownership and specialist roles. Working across business and IT, you’ll also partner with Security, Identity Governance & Administration, system owners and external suppliers. **

We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. _Are you a passionate jewellery designer with extensive experience creating iconic products and collections? Do you have a strong creative vision, exceptional sketching abilities, and a deep understanding of craftsmanship, materials, and the jewellery design process? Would you like to shape the future of Pandora's Modern Classics & Diamonds category by creating innovative designs that combine timeless elegance with modern expression?

__**Lead creative projects that define the future of Pandora's most iconic collections

**_As our new Senior Designer, Modern Classics & Diamonds, you will work closely with the Design Director to lead creative projects from initial concept generation through design execution and prototype development. Utilizing your strong creative skills, technical expertise, and deep understanding of Pandora's brand DNA, you will play a key role in developing compelling collections that inspire customers around the world.

**Your Role

****Design & Collection Development

**

• Partner with the team to create and develop new collections within the Modern Classics & Diamonds category.

• Translate creative briefs into innovative product concepts, designs, and sketches that align with Pandora's brand identity.

• Lead individual design projects from initial research and concept development through CAD and prototype stages.

• Propose original and future-thinking product ideas that support the strategic direction of the category.

• Ensure projects are developed and launched within agreed timelines and project requirements.

• Review and provide comprehensive feedback on CADs within agreed timeframes.

• Develop creative mood boards, concept presentations, creative sketches, and technical drawings to support product development.

• Brief products to Design Operations & Development (DoD) and collaborate closely to ensure successful prototype execution.

• Review early prototypes and provide feedback ahead of formal prototype review sessions.

• Support prototype reviews and creative evaluations when required.

• Collaborate with Creative Sourcing to explore new materials, techniques, and innovation opportunities.

• Partner with Creative Merchandising to align category and collection structures.

• Ensure legal documentation and inspiration references are provided within agreed timelines.

• Maintain accurate design documentation, presentations, folders, and project records throughout the design process.

• Support and mentor Junior Designers, providing guidance on both creative and technical aspects of their work.

**Research & Innovation

**

• Conduct research projects based on briefs from Creative Leadership.

• Participate in research trips to identify emerging trends, products, techniques, materials, and creative inspiration.

• Translate research findings into strong creative concepts and collection ideas.

• Contribute to the development of new concepts, innovation opportunities, and future category directions.

• Ensure all research, concept development, reviews, and launches are delivered according to agreed timelines and processes.

• Update design presentations with relevant concepts, sketches, and final designs throughout project development.

**A Creative Visionary with a Passion for Jewellery Design

**You might be the person we are looking for if you combine exceptional creativity with strong technical expertise and an eye for commercial product design. You are skilled at transforming inspiration into compelling jewellery concepts and are comfortable working across all stages of the design process, from initial idea generation to final product execution.

You understand how to balance innovation with brand consistency and have a proven ability to create products that strengthen and evolve an established global brand. You enjoy working collaboratively in a fast-paced international environment and thrive when bringing new ideas to life.

**Requirements

**

• Extensive experience designing jewellery within a fashion, luxury, or jewellery brand.

• Strong creative portfolio demonstrating concept development, mood boards, sketches, and finished products.

• Proven experience leading design projects from concept to prototype.

• Advanced knowledge of jewellery design and manufacturing processes.

• Strong hand-sketching and visual communication skills.

• Experience working with CAD development and cross-functional product development teams.

• Ability to translate creative direction into commercially successful products.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Experience mentoring or supporting junior designers is an advantage.

• Proficiency in relevant design tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.

**Important

**Please include a portfolio showcasing your design work, creative process, technical skills, and collection development experience as part of your application.

**Your New Team

**As a key member of Pandora's Product Design team, you will join an international group of passionate, ambitious, and highly skilled designers dedicated to creating beautiful and innovative jewellery. You will report to the Design Director and collaborate closely with colleagues across Creative Direction, Design Operations & Development, Creative Merchandising, Creative Sourcing, and Product Development.

**Additional Information

**This role is based at Pandora's Global Office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**Did We Get Your Attention?

**If you see yourself in this position and would like to become part of Pandora's future, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please submit your CV and portfolio through our online application system. We look forward to hearing from you.

We process applications on an ongoing basis and therefore encourage you to submit your application at your earliest convenience. You can read more about Pandora on our corporate website Pandora Group.

**Icing on the Cake

**You will be working from our beautiful Global Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Alongside our inspiring work environment, we are proud to hold LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design, reflecting our commitment to sustainability and responsible use of resources.

The result is a professional and dynamic workspace that is unique, comfortable, and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here and visits our offices.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

**_Ready to build the AI engine behind the world's largest jewellery brand?

_**As Lead AI Platform Engineer, you will be the technical force behind Pandora's AI platform, shaping how AI systems are built, scaled, and secured across the business. Combining deep hands-on engineering expertise with strong technical leadership, you will drive architectural excellence, elevate engineering standards, and deliver reliable, production-ready AI solutions at scale.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Be To

****Technical Leadership

**

• Serve as the technical lead for the AI platform engineering team — setting the implementation direction, defining coding standards, and making key technical decisions that govern how the platform is built and evolved.

• Lead code reviews and drive architecture discussions, ensuring engineering decisions are well-reasoned, documented, and aligned with the broader platform strategy — championing engineering standards across code quality, testing practices, documentation, observability, and security hardening.

• Act as a technical mentor and go-to resource for all engineers — sharing knowledge, unblocking complex problems, and actively investing in the technical growth of both senior and junior team members.

**Platform Engineering & AI Infrastructure

**

• Design, build, and operate scalable, high-performance services and platform components that expose AI/ML capabilities across Pandora's digital ecosystem.

• Own and define the standards and governance for Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC) — ensuring all Azure infrastructure is reproducible, auditable, and securely configured.

• Apply strong network architecture knowledge to design and govern secure connectivity between platform services, AI gateways, and external integrations, including VNet, private endpoints, NSGs, and ingress/egress controls, while collaborating with security stakeholders to uphold the platform's overall security posture.

• Leverage Databricks for big data processing, feature engineering, and ML pipeline support.

**AI Services & Agentic Development

**

• Integrate and operationalise AI services including LLM APIs, vector search, RAG pipelines, embeddings, and multi-layer caching into platform-level services.

• Lead the agentic code development practice: architecting autonomous execution loops that enable tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to safely write, test, and self-correct software within isolated sandboxes.

• Own MLflow governance standards for experiment tracking, model versioning, and ML lifecycle management across the team.

• Configure and manage AI gateways to ensure secure, scalable, and governed access to AI capabilities at production scale.

**CI/CD & Reliability

**

• Define and govern the CI/CD standards for the AI platform team — establishing quality gates, testing frameworks, deployment patterns, and pipeline architecture that all engineers build to.

• Ensure performance, availability, and maintainability of platform services in production; handle incidents in a timely manner to minimise Mean Time to Contain (MTTC).

**Job Requirements

****Education & Experience

**

• Relevant background from Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field with experience in backend or platform engineering, with at least 2 years operating in a technical leadership capacity within AI or cloud-native platform teams.

• Proven experience building and operating AI/ML platform services or LLM-based integrations in a production environment.

**Technical Skills

**

• Strong backend engineering fundamentals: service architecture, REST API design, performance optimisation, and production reliability by design and monitoring, with hands-on proficiency in Python.

• Deep Kubernetes expertise — workload configuration, networking, security policy design, and production debugging; hands-on Docker and Azure App Services.

• Expert-level Terraform and IaC ownership — defining standards, patterns, and governance for cloud infrastructure on Azure.

• Strong network architecture and configuration skills, including Azure networking concepts (VNet, NSG, private endpoints, DNS, ingress/egress).

• MLflow governance, Databricks for ML pipeline integration, and experience with ML serving infrastructure, LLM APIs, prompt integration, and multi-layer caching.

• Proficiency in PostgreSQL and experience in configuring AI gateways for centralized AI governance

• Experience in agentic code development practice, harness engineering and spec-driven development is a plus.

**Soft Skills

**Ideally you are a trusted technical leader who combines strong engineering expertise with clear thinking and a collaborative approach to drive sound decisions, communicate complex platform, security, and architecture topics in a business-friendly way, and foster team growth. Brings a proactive and curious mindset, with a passion for emerging AI technologies balanced by a pragmatic focus on execution and delivery.

**About The Team

**You will be part of Pandora's AI Platform team within AI CoE at Digital & Analytics & AI — a passionate, forward-thinking group dedicated to building the infrastructure and services that bring AI to life across the business. The team works at the intersection of data science, machine learning, cloud engineering, and product development, collaborating closely with ML Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Architects, and Product stakeholders.

You will report to the AI Platform Manager and serve as the senior technical voice that shapes how the platform is designed, secured, and evolved — influencing both what gets built and how it gets built.

**Did we get your attention?

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel confident applying for this position. If you see yourself in the role and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply! We are an international team, so please make sure to send us your application in English to be considered. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**Icing on the cake

**You will be working out of our beautiful Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen, in a rapidly growing environment of highly skilled and experienced colleagues, which is a key initiative that goes along with Pandora’s experience & ambitions.Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

Veo runs on a fast-growing estate of devices, SaaS tools and offices across Copenhagen, Berlin and Miami. As the first operational IT security hire, you'll own the security of that environment: the devices our people use, the identities and access that connect them to our tools, and how we respond when something goes wrong.

This isn't a "follow the runbook" role. You'll sit in our IT team, assess where we are today, set the direction, and build the processes and tooling that keep Veo secure as we scale.

What You Will Do

• 
You'll be hands-on across endpoint, identity, and operational security, and you'll be the go-to person for IT security across the business.

• 
Own endpoint security across our macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android devices, including EDR, MDM, patching, encryption and hardening baselines

• 
Define and enforce our BYOD approach, using conditional access, device compliance checks and data separation so people can work flexibly without putting company data at risk

• 
Run SSO, SCIM and MFA across our SaaS applications, and own onboarding and offboarding so access is granted and removed on time, every time.

• 
Build identity governance, including regular access reviews, least-privilege access, and clear ownership of who has access to what

• 
Lead IT incident response from detection and triage through containment, investigation and post-incident review, and keep our playbooks sharp

• 
Monitor and respond to CVEs affecting our endpoints and SaaS tools, assessing risk, prioritizing fixes, and making sure patches are applied on time

• 
Plan and run phishing simulations and security awareness training that change behavior, and measure the results

• 
Drive day-to-day operational security, including alert monitoring, vulnerability management, SaaS vendor assessments, and keeping policies and runbooks current

• 
Lead our IT security work for GDPR and NIS2, from implementing controls to maintaining documentation and evidence, together with Legal and GRC

• 
Help lay the groundwork for future SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certification

• 
Own our office security systems, such as CCTV and door access, working with our Office Manager

What You Could Bring

• 
You've likely spent several years in IT security or security operations, ideally in a growing tech company, and you're comfortable being the person who owns security end-to-end.

That experience tends to show up in several of the following:

• 
Endpoint and device security: hands-on with EDR and MDM tools such as CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Hexnode, Intune or Kandji, across desktop and mobile, including securing BYOD environments

• 
Identity and access: deep experience with Google Workspace and Entra rolling out SSO, SCIM, and MFA, and running joiner/mover/leaver processes and access reviews.

• 
Incident response: you've led real incidents end-to-end and can stay calm and clear under pressure.

• 
Vulnerability management: you track CVEs, judge real-world risk quickly, and get fixes rolled out.

• 
Security culture: you've run phishing awareness programs and can explain risk in plain language to people who aren't technical.

• 
Compliance in practice: you've applied GDPR and NIS2 requirements in an operational role. Experience with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 is a strong advantage as we work towards them.

• 
Linux: administration and hardening experience is highly valued.

Nice To Have

• 
Scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash)

• 
SIEM experience

• 
Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, OSCP, or GIAC

How We Work

You'll be part of the IT team within Administration & Finance and work most closely with GRC, the Security Enablement Team, and Legal. We're pragmatic; we prioritize what matters most, and we favor simple solutions that help people work securely without slowing them down.

If you match on several of these areas but not all, apply anyway. We care more about how you think and what you'll own than about ticking every box.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.
