We’re looking for a commercially minded Legal Counsel to join us on our journey to become one stronger, more integrated SaaS business. You’ll work across commercial contracts, privacy and cybersecurity in the European and North American market, partnering with colleagues across the organisation to find practical solutions and support our growth.

Reporting to our General Counsel, you’ll work at the intersection of commercial law, privacy, cybersecurity and business transformation. You’ll play a key role in enabling business growth, supporting complex customer deals, and ensuring that our legal commitments are practical, proportionate and aligned with how we operate.

Whether you’re building on your experience in private practice or looking to grow further in an in-house role, this is an opportunity for you to take ownership, learn along the way, and make a real difference.

We are open to on-site (offices in Copenhagen and Wrocław), hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET), plus the US East Coast.

**About Us

**Cookie Information, Piwik PRO, and Sheltr, are leading SaaS brands specialising in privacy-first compliance and analytics. Together, we’re building intuitive, user-friendly products that help organisations navigate data privacy and marketing insights. With headquarters in Copenhagen and an office in Wrocław, our teams have been working across various industries to build trusted data privacy solutions since 2011.

We’re bringing our brands closer together to build one company with a shared identity in the group, a clear focus and ambitious plan for the future. The Legal, Compliance and Cybersecurity team has a core role to play in making that happen.

The role

These will be your main tasks:

Handle commercial contracts, particularly sales contracts

• Draft, review and negotiate customer contracts for EU and US customers.

• Support partner, reseller and supplier agreements, as well as more specialised regulatory requirements such as DORA-related terms and US healthcare BAAs.

• Work closely with Sales and Account Management to find solutions that support our commercial goals while managing legal risks.

Privacy compliance and cybersecurity

• Support GDPR compliance, international data transfers, sub-processor management and relevant UK and US privacy requirements.

• Work with our Cybersecurity team on NIS2 compliance and related contractual requirements.

• Help our Cyber Security and Compliance teams to respond to customer privacy and security questionnaires, audits and due diligence requests.

• Advise Product teams on privacy, consent and data protection, helping ensure that our commitments reflect how we actually work.

Help shape the way we work

• Improve legal templates, processes and ways of working as the business grows.

• Collaborate with colleagues across Sales, Product, Security, Finance and Operations.

• Contribute to shaping our legal function and how we support the wider business.

**About You

**You’re a structured, independent, and commercially minded lawyer who enjoys working with people and finding practical solutions. You combine sound legal judgement with a practical understanding of how a business operates. You’re comfortable challenging assumptions, thinking creatively and making decisions, even when the answer isn’t entirely straightforward.

You know that good legal advice is not just about identifying risks; it’s about helping the business understand those risks and finding a way forward.

You bring:

• 2-5 years of experience with commercial contracts, gained in-house or at a law firm.

• An understanding of B2B contracting and an interest in SaaS or technology businesses.

• Working knowledge of GDPR and privacy law in a commercial context, or relevant experience with HIPAA and US privacy law.

• The ability to communicate clearly, and comfortable working directly with Sales on live deals and making pragmatic judgement calls.

• Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves

• Experience with cybersecurity regulations (NIS2 and/or DORA).

• Experience with HIPAA, including negotiating BAAs.

• Knowledge of corporate governance, employment/HR legal matters (DK, PL, DE, and/or US).

• Experience with US customers and US commercial contracting, including state privacy laws and/or wiretap/tracking litigation risk.

• Experience building processes and templates in a growing legal function.

What we offer

• The opportunity to make a real impact. You’ll help shape a growing international SaaS business as it evolves towards a more integrated, enterprise-ready organisation. You won’t simply be maintaining existing processes; you’ll help develop the legal and commercial foundations for our next stage of growth.

• International exposure and commercial ownership. You’ll work on customer and partner relationships across the US and Europe, gaining exposure to complex commercial negotiations and a broad range of legal and regulatory challenges.

• The chance to broaden your expertise, take ownership of meaningful projects and grow with the business.

• Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

• A positive, informal workplace.

Application process

We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.

This is what our recruitment process looks like:

• A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

• An in-depth interview with the General Counsel and a stakeholder from the company (online)

• A final interview with our General Counsel including a live case (online or in-person, TBD)

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

With an IoT platform connecting more than 6 million units — and growing — Trackunit is building the platform that will enable the construction industry to work faster, smarter, and more securely. And we need you to help run and scale it.

As an SRE, you will join our Europe-based team and be part of a global SRE organization spanning Europe and Canada. This is a hands-on role focused on the daily operation and continuous improvement of our platform, with room to grow into larger design and architecture work as you build depth.

The platform owned by SRE consists of an AWS cloud, Kubernetes clusters (EKS), and our IaC setup running Terraform and Terramate, as well as a GitOps delivery platform built on Argo CD and Atlantis.

We support engineering teams with 150+ developers. You will help keep a platform used by 15,000+ active users every day secure, available, and easy to build on.

We're looking for someone curious and collaborative — happy to share knowledge and ask questions as well.

Experience level: roughly 2–5 years in an SRE, DevOps, platform, or infrastructure operations role. If you're further along and the day-to-day scope appeals to you, apply anyway — we'll have the conversation.

With locations in the heart of Copenhagen, Kolding, Aarhus, and Aalborg, we offer a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations — or remotely from anywhere in Denmark.

**What's in it for you?

**

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching, and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We offer a flexible setup because we believe you know best how to structure your work. Once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring — we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.

**What You'll Do

**Your week will be a mix of keeping things running well and making them better.

• Operate and improve the platform. Monitoring, alerting, capacity, cost, and the steady stream of small improvements that keep a large AWS and Kubernetes estate healthy.

• Work in code, not consoles. Infrastructure changes go through Terraform and Helm, reviewed as pull requests and delivered through Atlantis and Argo CD.

• Keep the platform secure. Patching, vulnerability remediation, base image updates, and closing findings — a recurring, meaningful part of the job rather than a side task.

• Take part in incident response. You'll join our on-call rotation (SRE team, business hours) and contribute to incidents and follow-up work.

• Handle triage and requests from developer teams. Understanding what they need, unblocking them, and spotting when a repeated request could be automated.

**Who You Are

**We think you'll need

• Hands-on experience running workloads on AWS.

• Basic knowledge with Kubernetes.

• Basic knowledge about infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform.

• Comfortable with Git, Linux and Windows.

• Clear written communication — a lot of our work happens in tickets, PRs, and docs.

**Nice to have, not expected

**

• EKS specifically, or tooling like Karpenter, Argo CD, Atlantis, or Terramate.

• Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Sumo Logic, or similar).

• Scripting in Python or Go.

• Security or compliance work — vulnerability management, CIS benchmarks, certification programmes.

• Multi-region or multi-account AWS architecture.

**What Matters More Than The Checklist

**

• You’re curious and self-driven, while also knowing when to ask for help when needed.

• You finish things. Small, well-tested changes shipped consistently beat big ideas that stall.

• You care about the developers and customers using the platform, not just the platform itself.

On AI: experience with AI tooling is not a requirement. An interest in working with it is. We already use AI in our daily engineering work — including MCP servers and agents against our own platform — and we expect that to grow. We don’t expect you to have experience with this—but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to learn.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries — this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're excited about this role and your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply.

**How You'll Grow Here

**We hire at this level expecting you to move beyond it, and we've structured the team so that happens on purpose rather than by accident.

• A rotation model that protects your focus. The team splits between operational duty and project work, so you're not permanently interrupt-driven. You get real blocks of time to go deep on something.

• Mentorship that's built in. Senior colleagues review your PRs and pair with you on incidents. Asking questions is the expected behaviour, not a sign you're struggling.

• Exposure to the big architecture work. You'll start with scoped pieces and take on more as you build context.

• A clear conversation about your development. Regular 1:1s that cover where you want to be, not just what you shipped last sprint.

**What We're Building Next

**Trackunit is moving from a SaaS company to a platform built on telemetry data from the construction industry worldwide. For SRE, that means going beyond delivering infrastructure to building the capabilities that let our developers and customers spin up environments tailored to their needs in the regions they need them.

Things on our roadmap include:

• Expanding the platform into a true multi-region architecture.

• Building self-service platform capabilities so developer teams move at their own pace.

• Making better use of AI in our own operations, through MCP servers and agents.

You won't be expected to lead these on day one. You will be in the room, and there will be pieces with your name on them.

**What Happens From Here — Recruitment Process Overview

**

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with a member of our Talent Partner team

• Personality-based interview. You will be asked to complete an online personality assessment prior to the interview. There are no correct answers and we are not trying to categorise you — the aim is a dialogue about the results and Trackunit's culture, so you get to know us better as well.

• Assignment-specific interview. You will be given a case to prepare after the initial screening interview. You will present the case to relevant colleagues across Trackunit, who you will also work closely with in the role.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with Engineering Manager, Kåre Brandborg and an SRE team member.

• References and background checks (if needed). If required, we will obtain references from former employers and perform level-specific background checks, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We're lucky to have you!

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We're committed to construction — one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products — it's a way of life at Trackunit. We're proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

jobs.occupation: Experienced Senior Lean Consultant for Project Excellence at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you’re energised by driving lean transformation at a company level and you thrive on turning complex challenges into tangible business impact, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Lean Consultant to join our team of highly skilled colleagues in the Project Excellence department. In Project Excellence, we act as internal consultants grounded in Lean, supporting projects and leadership across NNE by strengthening performance management, structured problem solving and continuous improvement practices.

As a Senior Lean Consultant, you will work closely with project organisations and leaders to set direction for improvement initiatives, build Lean capabilities and drive performance. At the same time, you will take an active, hands-on role in facilitating problem solving and implementing improvements on our most critical projects, ensuring that ideas translate into real impact.

This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of leadership, Lean transformation and project execution, contributing to building a strong and sustainable performance and improvement culture across NNE.

You’ll be based in our Virum Office, but the role requires you to visit our project sites in Kalundborg and around the Copenhagen area on a regular basis.

How you might spend your days

As a Senior Lean Consultant, you’ll be:

• Helping the Project Excellence department set direction for continuous improvement and Lean in NNE, aligned with NNE’s strategy

• Building Lean capabilities by developing and embedding structured problem solving, lean project management and continuous improvement practices

• Designing and delivering training in Lean tools, Lean principles and Lean ways of working across NNE

• Coaching leaders and teams to strengthen performance management and Lean leadership behaviours

• Facilitating and driving structured problem-solving on major projects, using A3 thinking as our core approach

• Advising on consistent implementation of improvements, ensuring solutions are anchored and deliver real impact

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• Passionate about Lean thinking and driven to create real lasting business impact

• Confident in engaging, challenging and developing leaders and teams at all levels

• Comfortable operating in complex environments, bringing clarity, structure and direction

• Pragmatic and execution-focused with a great drive to turn ideas into results

• A credible role model who takes ownership and leads by example

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• Extensive experience driving continuous improvement and lean transformations in complex organisations

• Proven ability to lead and implement change with measurable impact

• Solid experience working closely with senior leaders on performance and improvement agendas

• A relevant academic degree at Master level

• Excellent facilitation, coaching and stakeholder management skills across organisational levels

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 13th November 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Please Contact Director Daniel Iwarsson at +45 3075 7823 or Principal Consultant, Mikkel Bonne at +45 3191 8723 between 12.00-15.00 (12 AM-3 PM) on weekdays.

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Build the mobile app that construction professionals rely on every day.

**Every day, tens of thousands of construction professionals around the world use the Dalux app to inspect buildings, document progress, navigate BIM models, capture photos, report issues and collaborate directly from active construction sites.

We're looking for Mobile Software Engineers who want to build software that solves real-world problems at scale.

**What You'll Be Building

**You'll join one of our cross-functional product teams responsible for developing and improving the Dalux mobile application.

Together with developers, product managers and designers, you'll help shape new features from the product discussion through implementation, testing and release.

Our app is built using C# and .NET MAUI , allowing us to share the majority of our codebase while integrating with native iOS and Android capabilities whenever it makes sense.

**Some of the challenges you'll work on

**Mobile development at Dalux goes far beyond forms and lists. You'll help solve challenges such as:

• Building reliable workflows for construction sites with limited connectivity

• Integrating with mobile hardware such as 360 cameras and GPS antennas

• Optimizing performance across both Android and iOS devices

• Designing intuitive user experiences for professionals working in demanding environments

• Continuously improving the speed, quality and usability of one of the industry's leading mobile applications

**Our engineering culture

**You'll become part of a product team where engineers have real ownership.

We believe the people building the software should influence how it's built. That means short decision paths, close collaboration with product and design, and plenty of room to propose new ideas.

Our development teams work using agile principles with a strong focus on quality, collaboration and continuous improvement.

**We'd love to hear from you if you

**

• Have a degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a similar technical field

• Enjoy solving complex engineering problems

• Care about building products that people genuinely enjoy using

• Like collaborating with other developers, designers and product managers

Experience with one or more of the following is a plus:

• C#

• .NET MAUI

• Kotlin

• Swift

• Flutter

• React Native

If you don't have professional mobile experience yet but are passionate about mobile development and have a strong software engineering foundation, we'd still encourage you to apply.

**Why Dalux?

**At Dalux, you'll build software that makes one of the world's largest industries more digital, efficient and sustainable.

Our products are used in more than 140 countries, and mobile is central to that experience.

All software development happens from our headquarters in Copenhagen, where you'll work alongside a growing community of software engineers in an environment that values knowledge sharing, technical discussions and continuous learning. We also have monthly social events and various clubs for those who want to take part.

You'll find a flat organization with a high degree of trust, opportunities to influence the product, and colleagues who care deeply about building great software.

**Ready to join us?

**If you'd like to help build the mobile platform used by tens of thousands of construction professionals every day, we'd love to hear from you.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

**About Dalux

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005. We develop digital tools that help make the construction industry smarter and more efficient through intuitive software and Building Information Modelling (BIM). Today, our solutions are used on construction projects in more than 140 countries worldwide.

**Join our Pizza & Beer event

**Sign-up for our free Pizza & Beer event the 29th of October 2026 at Dalux from 16:00: Pizza and Beer with Dalux

During the event, you can hear more about Dalux and the career options through presentations and mingling - all while getting delicious Pizza and beer/drinks!

All Gravy is the AI-native people operating platform for hospitality and retail. 🥞

We're modernising how frontline teams work, replacing scattered tools and outdated systems with a single app that's actually built for the way people work & socialise today. Our AI Colleague gives staff instant answers & executes day-to-day tasks, freeing up managers to focus on people & customers instead of paperwork. We work with some of the most exciting brands in hospitality and retail, including Gail's, L'Osteria, Dishoom, Pizza Pilgrims, Ottolenghi, Q8 and 7-Eleven. Today over 2,000 restaurants and stores trust us to run their teams.

We've grown 10x in two years and are accelerating into new markets. Our team spans a wide range of nationalities and backgrounds, united by one mission: to create better work lives for the 80% of the world that do not sit behind a desk. 🚀

**🤩 About The Role

**We are looking for Senior Account Executive who loves the chase, the close and the craft. You’ll own a territory and build your own pipeline of high-value targets, and booming inbound channel feeding you qualified opportunities. You call the shots on where to hunt, who to warm, and how to win. We’ll back you with marketing air cover, product firepower, and leadership you can trust for support and development.

**🎯 What You Will Do

**

• Create and run your target list of dream logos in our ICP. Name them, map them, multi-thread them.

• Work a blended pipe: your self-sourced opportunities plus SDR-sourced meetings you turn into revenue.

• Full cycle everything: discovery → tailored demo → value proof → commercial design → close → high-five.

• Build business cases that make budget holders nod and sign (ROI, payback, the whole nine yards).

• Feedback like a pro: turn deal learnings into sharper messaging, better product bets, and smoother process.

• Beat targets without burning out.

🙌 **You’ll thrive here if you…

**

• You speak excellent English and are based in Copenhagen.

• 5+ years of SaaS sales under your belt, fluent in consultative selling, and MEDPICC. Psst... If you’ve sold into hospitality, we’re listening even harder.

• You’re curious, ambitious, disciplined, and self-driven.

• Are owner-minded. You don’t wait for leads, you create momentum and you love a clean CRM.

• Can navigate complex cycles and senior stakeholders, you’re credible in the boardroom and fun.

• Are data-curious and coachable. You test, learn, and iterate faster than most people.

**💎 Why All Gravy

**

• Grow fast, for real. We promote from within, move quickly, and give you real responsibility from day one.

• A culture that actually develops you. Honest feedback, active coaching, and the autonomy to experiment. We invest in you because your growth is our growth.

• Work that matters. Your work will directly impact the daily lives of millions of frontline workers.

• You'll work with people who've built, scaled, and won. Ex-founders, operators, all here because they want to do it again, bigger.

• The good stuff too. Prime office location, team lunches, Friday bars, padel tournaments, wine tastings, offsites, top-tier equipment, and a fridge that's always stocked. We work hard and celebrate harder.

Ready to roll? Curious, competitive, kind? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. Attitude and growth mindset matter. Let’s build the future of frontline work together.

About ChemoMetec

ChemoMetec is a worldwide leading manufacturer of cell counting and analysis equipment. We specialize in developing and producing high-precision instrumentation, delivering consistent data for thousands of customers across biotech, pharma, and academic segments.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and scientifically skilled Product Specialist - Technical Support & Documentation to lead technical support for ChemoMetec’s portfolio of analytical cell-counting instruments. In this support-centered role, you will handle technical inquiries from both customers and colleagues and act as the go-to reference for technically accurate and compliant solutions. The role combines life science, technical documentation, and QA collaboration, making it ideal for someone with a strong scientific background and a passion for structured problem-solving.

We are hiring two Product Specialists for our technical support team: one focused on documentation and one on data analysis. You will be part of the Product Management Department and work closely with QA, Field Application Scientists, and product teams to resolve customer complaints, complete technical documentation, and maintain our support infrastructure. A solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, along with a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements, is essential to succeed in this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical support across all instrument platforms, with a focus on structured problem-solving and documentation.

• Collaborate with QA to complete technical questionnaires and support the resolution of customer complaints.

• Maintain and organize our support database platform, ensuring technical records are accurate and accessible.

• Proofread and write technical notes, user guides, and comparison studies.

• Develop and implement procedures to support both existing and new products.

• Ensure all support activities comply with GMP and relevant quality standards.

• Act as a subject matter expert on instrumentation and scientific applications, providing technical insight to internal teams.

Your Profile

• PhD in Biology, Physics, or a related scientific discipline.

• Solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, and a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements.

• Strong understanding of microscopy, analytical instrumentation, and pharmaceutical workflows.

• Highly organized, structured, and detail-oriented.

• Excellent written communication skills, with experience producing technical documentation.

• Familiarity with support platforms or ticketing systems is a plus.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, technical environment.

Why join ChemoMetec?

At ChemoMetec, we believe that great people make a great workplace. We value both personal and professional development and offer an environment where you can grow, take responsibility, and make an impact. You will become part of a team of talented and supportive colleagues who enjoy working together in an informal and welcoming atmosphere. We also believe that strong relationships go beyond the workplace, which is why we regularly bring colleagues together through company-wide events to build connections and strengthen relationships across the organization.

Practical information

Both positions are on-site at our HQ in Allerød, Denmark. You will refer to Director, Ph.D. Product Management Bassam Tawfik.

Starting date is as soon as possible, and we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Deadline for applying is 20 November 2026.

If you have any further questions about this job opportunity, feel free to contact Frederikke Hvidberg, fhv@chemometec.com

**OrderYOYO | Copenhagen based

****What We Do At OrderYOYO

**We help restaurants succeed online by providing them with personalised branded mobile apps, websites and personalised marketing. We are ensuring that small to medium-sized restaurants and chains are not subjected to lofty commissions and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success.

**About The Role

**Commercial Data Analyst

Location: Copenhagen base

Hours: 40hours/ week

Salary: up to 40,000DKK/ month

We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded Commercial Data Analyst to join us, reporting to our CCO. You’ll turn data from across our commercial teams, covering sales, account management, customer success, B2B marketing, pricing and partner performance, into clear, actionable insight, giving our leaders one trusted view of performance across every OrderYOYO market. Working closely with market leads, Sales, Marketing, Finance and Product, you’ll help us understand what drives growth in each market and focus our efforts where they’ll make the biggest difference!

**Here’s a taste of what you’ll be doing:

**

• Analysing performance across all our commercial activities, including sales, account management, customer success, marketing and partnerships, in every market.

• Tracking and reporting on key commercial metrics such as new restaurant acquisition, revenue, order volumes, churn, retention and pipeline conversion.

• Owning our regular commercial reporting, including weekly, monthly and quarterly performance packs for leadership.

• Designing, building and maintaining dashboards that give a single, trusted view of performance and let teams self-serve their data.

• Comparing performance between our 11 markets, teams and channels to spot what’s working, where we can improve and where the risks are.

• Analysing the impact of pricing, campaigns and commercial initiatives on performance.

• Delivering ad hoc analysis to answer business questions and support commercial decisions, business cases and initiatives.

• Making sure commercial data is accurate and consistent across markets, working with CRM and system owners to close any gaps.

• Defining and documenting KPIs so everyone measures performance in the same way.

• Supporting forecasting, target setting and planning with Finance, and flagging variances against target early.

• Your success will be measured on the accuracy and timeliness of reporting, dashboard adoption, data quality, turnaround on ad hoc requests, forecast accuracy and stakeholder satisfaction.

**What We Are Looking For In You

**

• Proven experience in a commercial, sales, revenue or business analyst role.

• Experience building dashboards and reports in BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, and experience working with CRM data (e.g. HubSpot or Salesforce).

• A strong understanding of commercial metrics such as revenue, pipeline, conversion, churn and retention, ideally within B2B SaaS.

• Analytical and curious: you can turn data into clear, actionable insight and recommendations.

• A confident communicator who can present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels.

• Highly organised, with great attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Experience working across multiple markets, or with Python or R, is an advantage.

**Great to Have

**

• Experience working across multiple markets or countries.

• Experience with Python or R.

• Experience working in a high-growth, fast-paced business.

• Experience supporting forecasting, target setting or commercial planning alongside Finance.

• Experience defining KPIs or improving data governance and processes.

**About The Company Culture

**Who we are at OrderYOYO: Company culture is at the forefront of our minds creating an enjoyable, safe working environment where employee personal expression is supported. We are one team here at OrderYOYO and strive to help others succeed. Personal development and training plans are a key part of your journey within OrderYOYO, helping you be the best you can be by providing consistent and ongoing training for all aspects of the business. Our values (Passion, Action, Compassion, One Team) are what make us who we are and will be embedded in your day-to-day no matter what area of the business you work in.

**Benefits

**

• Monthly Friday Socials and regular ad-hoc socials.

• Quarterly Conferences and training days.

• Employee Awards.

• Holiday buying Scheme.

jobs.description:
Are you approaching the end of your studies and looking for a graduation project early 2027. Does deep dive into the protection of the primary equipment enabling transport of wind energy to shore excite you? Then we have the project for you.

The projects

Protection study

Today we apply state of the art, cutting edge protections of the primary equipment, 220/66kV transformers, shunt reactors, subsea cables etc. Functions like line differential protection, restricted earth fault protection, distance protection with fiber optic accelerations schemes and different mechanical protections.

But how well do the different protections cover the primary equipment?

Are all protections feasible, considering how often we statistically experience faults?

Grounding

Today the MV grid, connecting the wind turbines to the Offshore Sub Station is impedance grounded. This creates different problems and side effects that needs to be considered during engineering. Some primary equipment becomes expensive and hard to procure. Protection against earth faults becomes challenging because of the reduced fault current.

Investigate the benefits and disadvantages of isolated, impedance and effectively grounded MV grid.

How will the protections need to be set up?

What will the implications be on primary equipment, transformers, cables, wind turbines etc.

Your Profile & Qualifications

We image that you are studying to become an Electrical Engineer. As a person you are ambitious and result oriented. You have an analytical mindset and strive to find solutions for complex problems and at the same time you enjoy collaborating within a team. Furthermore, you have a strong interest in learning and taking on challenges.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have the following qualifications:

• Interest in electrical systems.

• Focus on digitalization and innovation.

• Can communicate in English, both written and verbal.

• Flexible, committed, loyal and dedicated.

• Great communication skills.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

Flatpay is looking for an experienced Product Manager to join our Financial Services team. In this role, you'll help develop our customer-facing banking product, including the app that supports small and medium-sized businesses in their day-to-day financial activities. Hands-on product management experience with customer-facing apps is essential for this role.

You will work closely with engineers, designers, operations, commercial teams, and external partners to turn customer needs, business priorities, and technical requirements into clear product improvements. The role suits someone with product experience from a banking environment who can combine customer understanding, app expertise, and technical fluency.

**What You Will Work On

**

• Develop and continuously improve Flatpay’s banking product and customer-facing app for SMEs.

• Turn customer feedback, product and user data, and business needs into well-defined product improvements.

• Work closely with other product managers, designers, and engineers throughout product discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration.

• Translate customer, business, operational, technical, and relevant regulatory requirements into clear product priorities.

• Coordinate with commercial teams, operations, legal, and external partners.

• Track product performance and customer behavior to identify opportunities and resolve pain points.

• Contribute to product planning, prioritization, and post-launch improvements.

• Travel occasionally across Flatpay’s markets to collaborate with local teams, partners, and other stakeholders.

**Who You Are

**You're proactive, structured, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment. You take a hands-on approach and are willing to step into the details when needed. You can work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities, and move initiatives forward while keeping relevant colleagues informed and aligned.

You enjoy working closely with engineers, designers, and commercial teams, and you can turn complex requirements into practical product improvements. You combine customer focus with clear communication across different functions, and use evidence to make informed decisions.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner, or in a similar role.

• Demonstrated product management experience launching, improving, and scaling customer-facing apps.

• Strong technical fluency and the ability to work effectively with engineers on APIs, data flows, integrations, and technical trade-offs related to app development.

• Previous product experience from a banking environment.

• Strong collaboration skills and experience working with engineers and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Ability to balance customer needs with technical, operational, commercial, and relevant regulatory considerations.

• A structured and analytical approach, with confidence using product data and customer insight to guide decisions.

• Practical experience applying AI tools to product discovery, analysis, or delivery is an advantage.

• Willingness and ability to travel occasionally across Flatpay’s markets.

• Professional-level English proficiency.

**Why Flatpay?

**Making life easier for SMEs is at the core of Flatpay’s work. As we continue to grow, our financial services help small and medium-sized businesses manage their finances and run their businesses more effectively. You'll help shape a banking product that is an important part of that experience.

Flatpay has more than 2,500 employees across seven markets. We value work-life balance, creativity, and collaboration, and you will join a supportive product environment with room to take initiative, learn, and improve how we serve our customers. Our Herlev office also offers an in-office gym, a fully equipped gamer room, free slush ice, and other ways to enjoy life at the office.

Reporting to the Product Director, you'll contribute to a banking product that supports Flatpay’s continued growth in financial services. This position is based in our Herlev office.

**If this sounds like the right next step for you, we would love to hear from you!

**Established in 2022 in Copenhagen with a commitment to transparency, we've streamlined card payments to small and medium-sized businesses. Our innovative pricing model eliminates hidden costs and fees, offering a simple flat rate for all cards with no monthly subscription for our point-of-sale and payment solutions.

Operating in Denmark, Finland, Germany, Italy, France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands, we're more than just a service provider; we are your trusted business partner.

We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our clients' evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary?

At Acodyne, you will help develop the software, high-power electronics, and robotic systems that bring our next generation of high-speed, heavy-lift cargo UAS to life, moving between code, schematics, the lab bench, and real flight hardware.

Your Role

You Will Work Closely With Our CTO And Engineering Team On The Electrical And Software Systems That Power And Control Our Aircraft. From Firmware To High-power Distribution, This Is As Real As Engineering Gets. You Will

• 
Develop and test embedded software and firmware for flight-critical and ground systems (C/C++, Python)

• 
Design, build, and test high-power electronics such as power distribution, battery systems, and motor drives

• 
Integrate sensors, actuators, and robotic/autonomous subsystems into the aircraft and ground equipment

• 
Develop tools for test automation, data logging, and analysis

• 
Bring up, debug, and validate hardware on the bench and during flight tests

• 
Document designs, code, and test results for certification purposes

**About You

**You enjoy writing code as much as holding an oscilloscope probe or a soldering iron. You're the type who builds things outside class and wants to take that to the next level. You likely:

• 
Are currently pursuing a degree in electrical engineering, software/computer engineering, robotics, mechatronics, or similar

• 
Have programming experience in C/C++ and/or Python

• 
Have a solid understanding of electronics and circuit design

• 
Enjoy hands-on lab work, prototyping, and debugging real hardware

• 
Are curious about UAVs, robotics, or high-performance systems

• 
Are proactive, independent, and eager to learn fast

**Nice To Have

**

• 
Experience with power electronics, high-voltage systems, motor control, or battery management systems (BMS)

• 
Experience with embedded platforms (STM32, ARM, etc.), RTOS, or communication buses (CAN, UART, SPI, I²C)

• 
Exposure to ROS, PX4/ArduPilot, or control and autonomy algorithms

• 
PCB design experience (KiCad, Altium, etc.)

**About Acodyne

**We are a UAS company developing heavy-lift, high-speed eVTOL UAS for defence and industrial logistics. We are currently 18 people, based at our workshop at Avedøre Airfield, and plan to double our team in the next year.

**About The Internship

**

• 
Duration: Full-time for 5–6 months, with start in January/February 2027.

• 
Time off: 2.08 vacation days per month + Danish public holidays.

• 
Location: Avedøre Flyveplads, workshop-based, approximately 45 minutes by public transport from Copenhagen city center.

• 
Compensation: DKK 6,000-8,000 per month before tax. Please note this is a contribution to living and transport. It will likely not cover full living costs. Interns are expected to supplement with grants or other funding.

• 
Visa: Acodyne is unfortunately not able to help obtain a work visa. It is expected that the candidate has a legal right to work in Denmark.

• 
Please note: The internship opportunity is intended for currently enrolled students who wish to gain relevant work experience as part of their studies. We particularly encourage applications from students who are able to use the internship as an integrated part of their degree programme, for example through ECTS credits, a project-based internship, or another formal study-related arrangement.

The Fabrication Support team at DTU Nanolab is seeking one to two Process generalist for permanent positions. 

As a Process Generalist in the Fabrication Support team, you will be working in a highly advanced cleanroom environment. In this role, you will support and advise students and researchers at DTU and external users on fabrication processes, as well as train users in the operation of state-of-the-art semiconductor processing equipment. You will also collaborate closely with industrial partners to realize their devices, designing and executing complete fabrication processes to meet customer requirements.

The job
A significant part of your working day will be spent in the DTU Nanolab cleanroom. We are looking for a person who already has substantial experience in advanced micro-fabrication in a cleanroom environment You should enjoy helping and teaching students and other facility users to operate advanced tools. You have great attention to detail and a structured approach to developing and fine-tuning fabrication processes.

Our expectations of you
We expect you to hold a Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline with at least 3 years’ experience in semiconductor fabrication. We also expect that you are already skilled in essential nano- and microfabrication techniques such as

• UV lithography
• Thin film deposition
• Deep reactive ion etching
• Scanning electron microscopy
We also expect that you

• Can work independently on given tasks
• Will systematically document process development results
• Enjoy working on projects alone, but also in cooperation with other team members
• Are fluent in English
At DTU Nanolab, safety is a core value. We are therefore seeking candidates who are comfortable working in a highly safety-focused environment and who can meet the following physical and mental requirements:

• Comfortable wearing specialized personal protective equipment (PPE) when required.
• Able to respond promptly and appropriately in emergency situations, including evacuations.
• Capable of performing duties that involve extended periods of standing and movement.
• Confident working with potentially hazardous chemicals and gases while following established safety protocols and procedures.
What we offer in return
We offer an interesting and challenging job in an international environment. A job where you will work with state-of-the-art semiconductor fabrication equipment. The Technical University of Denmark is a leading university in Northen Europe, and our facility is among the largest and most advanced fair access facilities in Europe. Please notice that this is not a research position, it is a technical position with emphasis on user assistance and customer fabrication orders.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement for academic employees with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The position is a full-time position. Starting date is 1 January 2026 (or according to mutual agreement).

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 15 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Head of Fabrication Support, Maria Matschuk on 4525 5723 or mmat@dtu.dk.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Nanolab is the National Center for Nanofabrication and Characterization in Denmark and an open-access research infrastructure at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU). As one of Europe’s largest fair-access micro- and nanofabrication centers, it offers a large cleanroom and advanced electron microscopy facilities. DTU Nanolab supports cutting-edge research and small-scale production within MEMS/NEMS, photonics, and quantum technologies, covering nano- and microfabrication as well as advanced analysis of hard and soft matter. Since 2018, DTU Nanolab extended to provide expertise in soft matter from small molecule complexes to biological cells.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own charge point management for public CPOs on the Spirii platform. You will own the product area end-to-end and work across multiple teams, from charger connectivity and protocols to monitoring and device capabilities. You will shape the strategy, build the commercial case for it, and help drive its impact on revenue, margin and retention.

**The Role

**As Product Manager for Public CPOs, you will work closely with engineering, design and commercial teams to solve meaningful customer problems in ways that deliver business impact. You will shape the product vision, own an outcome-focused roadmap, and lead discovery based on evidence. You will also share your knowledge with other Product Managers and help build a strong, data-driven product culture across the organisation.

**What You Will Do

**

• Vision & Strategy: Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for charge point management, and decide which problems are worth solving and which are not.

• Outcome-Focused Roadmapping: Prioritise initiatives based on customer value, business impact and feasibility.

• Discovery & Validation: Lead continuous discovery with customers, design and engineering. Test ideas early and use evidence, not assumptions, to make decisions.

**

**Benefits

**It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work life balance.

The position is a permanent position in Copenhagen, Denmark. Danish language is not a requirement, but Fluent English language skills are required.

**About Spirii – Who We Are

**Spirii is a full-service e-mobility provider which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii was founded seven years ago as a company. Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

Building keeps getting cheaper every quarter. What used to take a senior engineer a few weeks now takes an afternoon. The work that does not get cheaper is helping a real business absorb new technology, sequencing the rollout, and knowing when to slow down because something is starting to break under load.

At Heyra, we build operational AI: systems, workflows, and data platforms that live in production from day one. We work with companies that are moving quickly and need solutions that improve the way they operate.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer. Someone who goes into a client, understands the operation, spots where the real optimisation potential sits, and pushes it all the way through to execution with a strong engineering team behind them.

The role sits between engineering and consulting without fitting cleanly into either. You need to be technical enough to understand data and AI at a deep level. Commercial enough to spot where the business value sits. Patient enough to sit with a manager who is genuinely worried about the tool you just put in front of them. And stubborn enough to stay around once the launch excitement fades and the real adoption work begins.

Most people are strong in one of those. Some in two. Almost nobody walks in with all four. That is exactly the profile we are looking for.

What you will work on

You will embed directly with clients to understand the operation and where the real value sits. You will drive adoption by sequencing rollouts, working with the people who have to use the tool, and staying through the unglamorous part. You will translate business needs into AI solutions that actually ship. And you will learn when to push, when to slow down, and when something is starting to break under load.

You work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists, and designers in a company where the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

**Requirements

**Experience with management consulting, change management, or adoption of AI solutions in production. An understanding of software development, ML or data engineering. Familiarity with AI and GenAI frameworks, possibly with some MLOps and evals exposure. Experience with cloud environments like Azure or GCP.

Coding with agents like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. Working directly with clients and stakeholders. Owning delivery end to end, from a vague problem to a live, adopted solution.

Curiosity, taste and a builder mentality matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience.

Why Heyra

We believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We are building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build and operate AI products that change how enterprises work, from problem to prototype to production.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high. We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

People here care about what they build. Good ideas move quickly. New technology gets explored early. There is room to shape both the company and the way we work.

We are around 45 people today, and we are only just getting started.

If this sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

**Benefits

**

• Healthcare insurance

• Pension plan

• Parental leave

• Social gatherings

• New tech gear

• Central office

• Free lunch, coffee, snacks, and Friday beers

• Skill development

• Paid holiday

• Remote work allowed

• Pet friendly

Would you like to set the technical direction for Denmark's national, digitally sovereign supercomputing and cloud platform? DTU Computerome is looking for a Chief Technology Officer to lead the architecture, engineering and long-term technology strategy of a platform used by researchers, public institutions and industry across Denmark. 

About DTU Computerome 
DTU Computerome is a national High-Performance Computing (HPC) and secure cloud platform designed to support sensitive data processing and the hosting of advanced applications and services. 

The platform is developed and operated as a fully digitally sovereign infrastructure. Critical research workloads, sensitive data, and digital services for the public sector and Danish industry are hosted within a trusted, nationally controlled environment. 

Computerome functions as a general infrastructure and service provider, offering: 

• High-performance computing resources for complex workloads 
• Secure environments for processing sensitive and regulated data 
• Infrastructure for hosting research platforms, digital services and scientific applications 
• Flexible environments for innovation, experimentation and development of new digital solutions 
Users include research groups from all Danish universities, international research collaborations, public authorities and industry partners. Many rely on Computerome as a stable platform for long-running services, data platforms and research applications. 

The infrastructure includes a large-scale Linux-based HPC cluster, a 50 PB high-performance storage system, a custom-built secure cloud environment, and platforms for containerized applications, research services and data workflows. Computerome is physically located at DTU Risø, while the operations and development team is based at DTU Lyngby. 

The Job 
As CTO, you will own Computerome's technology strategy and platform architecture, and lead the engineering and DevOps organisation that operates and develops it. You will be part of Computerome's management team and work closely with the Director and COO on strategy, investments and partnerships. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

• Defining and owning the technology strategy and multi-year roadmap for the HPC, storage, network and cloud platform 
• Leading, developing and recruiting the DevOps and platform engineering teams, including the five new DevOps engineers currently being hired 
• Owning the overall platform architecture and making key design decisions across compute, storage, networking and cloud 
• Ensuring stable, secure and scalable operation, including incident management, on-call structure and service levels 
• Driving automation, Infrastructure-as-Code and modern DevOps practices across the organisation 
• Leading technical evaluation, requirement specification and vendor selection in procurements and tenders 
• Planning capacity, lifecycle and hardware refresh, and owning the technical side of investment cases and budgets 
• Representing Computerome technically towards users, partners, authorities and national and European infrastructure initiatives 
Strategic Focus Areas 
Computerome is growing from a research HPC facility into a broader national provider of sovereign compute, data and cloud services. As CTO you will shape how the platform meets that ambition. Key areas include: 

• Digital sovereignty: Designing an architecture built on open, European-controllable technologies that reduces dependence on non-European hyperscalers, and ensuring data portability and national control over critical workloads 
• AI and GPU infrastructure: Expanding capacity and services for AI, large-scale analytics and GPU-intensive research 
• Secure and regulated environments: Strengthening platforms for sensitive personal and health data, in line with GDPR, NIS2, ISO and relevant security standards 
• Cloud and platform services: Evolving the secure cloud, container and Kubernetes offerings so that public institutions and industry can host long-running services and products 
• Scalability and new capacity: Contributing technically to new datacenter capacity, energy efficiency and long-term infrastructure planning 
• Operational excellence: Building monitoring, observability, service management and processes that match the expectations of critical national infrastructure 
Your Profile 
We are looking for an experienced technology leader who combines deep infrastructure expertise with strategic overview and the ability to build strong teams. 

Required qualifications 

• A master's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience 
• At least 10 years of experience with large-scale IT infrastructure, of which several years in a technical leadership role 
• Proven experience leading engineering, DevOps or operations teams, including people management and recruitment 
• Deep knowledge of Linux-based infrastructure, virtualization and cloud platforms (e.g. OpenStack, Kubernetes) 
• Solid understanding of storage, networking and IT security architecture 
• Experience with automation, Infrastructure-as-Code and modern DevOps practices 
• Experience with technical procurement, vendor management and budget responsibility 
• Ability to translate technology into strategy and communicate clearly with management, users and partners 
• Fluency in English; Danish is an advantage 
It is an advantage if you also have experience with 

• HPC environments, job scheduling and parallel file systems (e.g. IBM Storage Scale) 
• AI workloads and GPU infrastructure at scale 
• Sensitive data environments and compliance (GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001) 
• Public sector procurement, EU tenders or research infrastructure 
• European cloud and sovereignty initiatives 
• Datacenter design, power and cooling 
What We Offer 
We offer a key leadership role with real influence on how a national, digitally sovereign computing platform evolves. You will lead skilled colleagues in an international research environment where advanced infrastructure directly enables scientific discovery and digital innovation. 

At DTU we emphasize: 

• A high level of technical professionalism 
• Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development 
• The possibility to shape national digital infrastructure 
• A collaborative environment with highly skilled colleagues 
Salary and Appointment Terms 
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). You are employed as an Academic Officer, Senior Officer, Senior Executive Officer. In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): https://www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures 

The position is full-time and based at DTU Lyngby with regular presence at DTU Risø.

Application and Contact

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Mads Bager Hoffmann on mabho@dtu.dk

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

Do you enjoy turning complex business requirements into clear, practical software solutions? Join Keylane as a Senior Business Analyst and help shape the pension processes that support people through important life events, from retirement to disability and the loss of a loved one.

**Key About Your Team

**You will join Life Events, an area of approximately 70 colleagues working at the heart of Plexus, our pension platform. We are organised into three teams that support pension processes related to retirement, death and disability, as well as premium and benefit calculations. You will be part of Life Events B, a team with 30 colleagues across Denmark, Netherlands and India. Our developers, testers and business analysts work closely together throughout the development process, from planning to delivery. Guided by client needs, we combine business knowledge and technical expertise to deliver a standardised, consistent solution across clients and countries.

**As a Senior Business Analyst in the Life Events department, you will work closely with our Product Owner, Development team, and and Delivery to ensure our products continue being the leading solutions. You will analyse and elaborate requirements coming in from our customers via Delivery and help evolve and design a standard solution to support customer's needs.

• Analysing business requirements for pension processes and translating them into clear development and test tasks

• Shaping functional solutions and guiding developers throughout implementation within Life Events— Ranging from supporting brand new processes within the system, to help defining the implementation of new calculations

• Demoing new features and enhancements to stakeholders

**Requirements

Ideally, you have:

• An educational background in pension, math, IT or a related field

• At least +5 years experience with software projects.

• Experience with or knowledge of the pension industry - this is a strong advantage

• Experience with SQL or are comfortable working with databases and data analysis is a plus

**Benefits

**

Join Pharmacosmos in a newly established role and take a leading scientific role in shaping the analytical development capabilities.

**Lead complex Analytical Development across a growing development pipeline

**As Principal Analytical Development Chemist at Pharmacosmos, you will serve as the Analytical Lead across CMC development programs, driving analytical development, characterization, control strategies, and regulatory readiness from early-stage development through commercialization to lifecycle activities.

In this high impact role, you will be responsible for driving analytical development and ensuring that robust analytical methods, specifications, stability strategies, and control frameworks are established to support successful product development, regulatory submissions, and commercial manufacturing. You will apply your scientific expertise to complex analytical challenges, including product characterization, impurity profiling, method development, method qualification, validation strategy, comparability assessments, and technical investigations, helping to de-risk development programs and accelerate progress.

Working closely with Drug Substance Leads, Drug Product Leads, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, and external development partners, you will provide strategic guidance and scientific leadership across the organization. You will oversee analytical activities performed both internally and through CROs, CDMOs, and specialist laboratories, ensuring high-quality execution, sound scientific decision-making, and timely delivery of project objectives.

Beyond supporting individual projects, you will contribute to strengthening Pharmacosmos' analytical capabilities by advancing laboratory technologies, scientific best practices, and knowledge sharing across teams. As a trusted technical expert, you will mentor colleagues, influence key decisions, and help build a culture of scientific excellence, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration.

**Highly skilled Analytical Development Chemist with strong project management capabilities

**We are seeking a highly qualified candidate with an MSc or PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline. You bring extensive experience from the pharmaceutical industry, typically gained over 10 years or more, and possess a strong track record within analytical development ideally across both drug substance and drug product development. You have in-depth experience with analytical characterization, method development, qualification, and transfer, as well as specification setting, stability programs, impurity characterization, and analytical control strategies. Experience working with CROs, CDMOs, external laboratories, and cross-functional CMC teams is essential, together with a solid understanding of regulatory requirements and CMC documentation. Through strong collaboration and stakeholder engagement, you create alignment across functions and external partners while maintaining focus on quality, timelines, and business objectives. You are structured, proactive, and resilient, with a strong sense of integrity and accountability, and you enjoy sharing knowledge and contributing to a culture of scientific excellence and continuous improvement. Finally, you are fluent in English, both written and verbal.

**Play a crucial role in an exciting international growth journey

**This is your chance to embark upon a personal and organizational journey in a dynamic company where your know-how is greatly needed for the future development of Pharmacosmos. The recruitment process is carried out by Venaris Executive Search. For more information regarding the position, please reach out to Sr. Executive Search Consultant, Lars Nordlund, on +45 3123 3018. Pharmacosmos

Pharmacosmos A/S is a global leader in carbohydrate chemistry and innovative treatments for iron deficiency and iron deficiency anaemia. Founded in 1965 and headquartered in Denmark, our team is made up of more than 650 specialists across the UK, Ireland, the Nordics, Germany, Canada, and the USA. Associate Project Director

• Driving cross-disciplinary collaboration across COWI’s teams and geographies

Why join COWI?

At COWI, your work contributes to shaping a sustainable and liveable world. By combining deep knowledge, curiosity, and courage, COWI develops solutions that address today’s challenges and enable a better tomorrow. COWI has committed to phasing out fossil-based projects and aspires for 100% of its revenue to stem from sustainability-focused initiatives.

COWI values diversity, continuous development, and a sense of belonging. They foster a supportive and enjoyable workplace, knowing that a healthy work-life balance enhances performance both professionally and personally. You will report to the Vice President of the group and be offered a competitive compensation package, aligned with your experience and qualifications.

You are an experienced Multidisciplinary Project Manager who thrives in collaboration with colleagues, partners, and clients. Diversity and inclusion:

Diversity is a core value at COWI, and inclusion is a strategic priority. The company is committed to fostering a respectful, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities for growth. At Semco Maritime, we are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to strengthen our Renewables Service business. You will play a key role in developing strategic sales opportunities, supporting key customer relationships, and securing service contracts for offshore wind assets in selected international markets. 

Your position 

As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will have end-to-end commercial ownership of strategic sales opportunities within the Renewables Division. Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will lead the external commercial journey from early opportunity identification and qualification through tender management, contract negotiation, award, and handover to project execution. 

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. 

You will be accountable for building and converting a strong pipeline of strategic opportunities into profitable contracts while developing long-term relationships with selected key customers. You will shape winning commercial strategies based on customer needs, market dynamics, and Semco’s capabilities, and ensure that commercial priorities are aligned across relevant functions.

You will contribute to defining our commercial focus for selected customers and market segments, helping ensure that we invest our efforts where Semco Maritime has the strongest position to win. Your success will be measured by your ability to build strategic customer relationships, develop high-quality pipeline and convert complex opportunities into sustainable and profitable business.

Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg, our office located in Copenhagen or our future office in Aarhus. The position is full-time, and you can expect to up to 30 travel days per year. 

Your tasks & responsibilities 
As our new Senior Sales Manager, you will take ownership of strategic sales opportunities throughout the entire commercial lifecycle.

Working closely with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders, you will develop winning strategies, build strong commercial relationships, and identify growth opportunities across existing and new accounts. You will play a central role in shaping account strategies, developing customer-focused value propositions, and ensuring that commercial solutions are aligned with both customer needs and operational capabilities.

In addition, you will represent Semco Maritime in customer interactions and industry forums, contribute valuable market insights, and help strengthen our commercial processes and best practices across the organisation.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
