Get to know us. Start following us on Instagram (ey_denmark) to learn more about our culture and community.

__________

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

At GetWhy, we’re on a mission to change the way brands understand people. We help the world's biggest brands get closer to their consumers—faster, smarter, and with a human touch - through breakthrough research powered by AI. Companies like Coca-Cola, Heineken, Unilever and more trust us to deliver consumer insights in hours, not weeks.

We are building an end-to-end AI-powered human insights platform, redefining the boundaries of qualitative research. To fuel our journey, we raised a $34.5M Series A investment from PeakSpan Capital in 2024, making it one of Denmark’s largest Series A rounds to date.

What the AI team does

We are dedicated to delivering high-quality AI products leveraging the latest tools and techniques and to serve them across our core products in a scalable way.

For this, we use classic machine learning for predictive models to deal with fraud detection, language classification, visual understanding and automating internal workflows. These make heavy use of video processing, speech-to-text and multilingual translations models and pipelines.

We also build a lot of functionality around state of the art LLMs. We treat off-the-shelf LLMs as future commodities and aim to benefit from their strengths while employing principled methodologies to build guardrails and fallback strategies for their weaknesses. We strive to achieve a deep understanding of prompt engineering, context management, and LLM behavior quirks (e.g., hallucinations, non-determinism, context management), by focusing on evaluation and observability through monitoring for latency, accuracy, and usage.

Who you are

We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our growing stellar AI team. You will be responsible for all stages in the machine learning lifecycles across projects, from designing and defining data annotation steps to model training, validation and deployment.

More Specifically, You Should Have These Minimum Qualifications

• At least 5+ years developing machine learning systems, in particular NLP models.

• Proficiency in Python, along with a solid understanding of data structures and algorithms, and the capability to write production-quality code.

• Significant experience working with LLMs at scale, Prompt Engineering and AI Agents.

• Solid understanding of LLM evaluation, dealing with hallucinations, inconsistent outputs, context management, conversational AI and voice technologies, including text-to-speech.

• Proven experience formulating hypotheses, conducting experiments, and analyzing results.

• Exceptional English skills, both spoken and in writing.

What you will do

• Build AI-powered features at scale using the latest advancements in LLMs.

• Research, prototype, and build advanced NLP/ML models to enable automated resolution of end-user problems.

• Design and conduct rigorous experiments and evaluations to enhance model accuracy and reliability.

• Refine prompts and tune hyper-parameters to maximize the performance of cutting-edge retrieval and generative AI systems.

• Work closely with researchers, engineers, and product teams to define feature scope and implementation strategies.

• Mentor junior team members and engage in collaborative learning with peers to promote knowledge sharing.

• Contribute to technical reviews and share expertise in ML methodologies and best practices

• Writing clean, maintainable, and well-structured code to meet delivery goals.

What we offer

• A highly ambitious AI team driven by sky-is-the-limit long term vision and goals, while working to identify and deliver intermediate milestones.

• A full-time position with a competitive salary plus benefits.

• A flexible work schedule with opportunities to work from home.

• A vibrant and international work environment with 60+ colleagues from 15+ nationalities.

• A modern, newly renovated Nordhavnen office with stunning waterfront views, office lunch, relaxation areas, gym, free daily energizers, snacks, and drinks.

• A company culture that values innovation, collaboration, and transparency.

• Annual company retreats and Friday bar events – we work hard, we celebrate hard.

How do I apply?

Click on the apply button and upload your resumé or LinkedIn profile. If we see a potential match, we’ll invite you for a conversation at our office to get to know you better and share more about our culture and this opportunity.

So, what are you waiting for? Hit the apply button and come join the next Danish unicorn.

_Are you an experienced and motivated OT Security Architect and do you want to leave your mark on the global energy industry? If so, we want to hear from you!

**Your position

**In your new position as OT Security Architect in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the OT Security Team, whose mission is to ensure excellent OT security deliveries on large-scale EPC substation projects. You will have the chance to take the architectural lead and help shape a collaborative team culture built on expertise and knowledge-sharing. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be at one of our offices in either Esbjerg, Aarhus or Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel 10–30 days per year.

“Every day, we help enable the green energy transition by building secure, resilient OT solutions that ensure renewable energy assets operate safely and reliably.” - OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.

**Your Tasks & Responsibilities

**In our Renewables division, we have major EPC projects in the pipeline for both short- and long-term operations. As an OT Security Architect, you will take the architectural lead and support all OT Security areas across the EPC substation projects.

**Your Tasks Will Include But Are Not Limited To

**

• Contributing to the implementation of industry-accepted good practice and required Cyber/OT Security architecture at solution level, typically based on standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and NIS

• Helping define products and standards relevant to OT Security and infrastructure

• Hands-on experience with cybersecurity audits and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Critical Infrastructure regulations, and IEC 62443

• Reviewing requirements/ITT packages and providing input to tenders consisting of calculations, solutions, descriptions, clarifications, and reservations

• Taking on an advisory or active role in infrastructure, identity access management, or logging/event-based activities

• Being responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing FAT, SAT, and SIT activities to ensure successful system delivery and integration

• Implementing customer-specific Cyber/OT Security requirements in substation design for multiple systems and subsystems, such as SCADA, low-voltage, HVAC, Auxiliary Control and Monitoring System, etc.

Crucial to this position is your ability to take ownership of project deliverables and coordinate OT Security deadlines with internal and external stakeholders. You should thrive in a leading role where your skills, collaboration, and structured approach help ensure that requirements are met.

**Your Profile & Qualifications

**You are a team player who enjoys leading projects and working with stakeholders to align on timing, scope, and objectives. You know when technical expertise should be brought in to support delivery. To us, this means that you have a structured and solution-oriented approach, the ability to influence stakeholders, and the dedication to see tasks through to completion.

You will be part of a team of six colleagues that values quality, attention to detail, and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, and we work in a dedicated, structured, and execution-focused way while respecting the agility that is a natural part of our core tasks. We want the same from you.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

• A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT Security from a similar position

• A Tech Lead mentality – we are not seeking an extreme subject matter expert, but a well-rounded colleague who can work through heavily structured large projects involving many stakeholders

• The ability to know when additional technical specialists or resources are needed to complete a project

• Excellent communication skills and fluency in English

• Experience working in complex engineering projects, as well as project and stakeholder management, is an advantage

If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.

**Welcome to Semco Maritime

**At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer — Wealth Management Systems
jobs.description:
Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement—replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our customers include wealth managers, asset managers, family offices, and financial institutions across Europe and beyond. We are on an ambitious scaling journey, supported by leading global venture capital investors, and are working to become the platform on which modern wealth management runs.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

As our new Senior Software Engineer — Wealth Management Systems 📈

You will help the team solve some of the hardest product and data problems across Performativ’s investment platform.

You will work where financial workflows, product decisions, and technical systems meet: portfolio data, reporting, fees, reconciliation, instruments, transactions, cash, performance, and trading. Your contribution will be turning that complexity into coherent solutions that work across customers rather than becoming a collection of one-off customisations.

This is not a narrowly scoped position. We work as one team, and you should be willing to tackle any important problem within our area.

• 
You will apply deep experience from wealth management, asset management, private banking, portfolio management, investment operations, trading, custody, or related financial infrastructure to develop sound product and system designs.

• 
You will investigate problems that cross financial data, calculations, APIs, integrations, operational processes, and production systems—determining their root causes and delivering reliable solutions that others can understand and extend.

• 
You will bring product thinking to ambiguous requirements, working closely with users and customer-facing colleagues to distinguish reusable platform needs from customer-specific preferences.

• 
You will use AI agents to produce much of the implementation. We expect you to design the solution, direct agents effectively, challenge their assumptions, review their output, and establish the tests and evidence needed for safe production deployment.

• 
You will lead when your knowledge makes you the right person to lead, follow through on what you take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

Experience with performance calculations, valuations, fees, reporting, reconciliation, corporate actions, or portfolio-management systems would be particularly valuable.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. Autonomy works only when paired with initiative, collaboration, sound judgment, and follow-through.

AI increases our delivery speed, but it does not reduce our engineering standard or our accountability for the result. You must be technically strong enough to recognise weak abstractions, incorrect assumptions, missing edge cases, security problems, and unsafe production behaviour.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• 
Trust and meaningful responsibility from your first day, with the opportunity to influence both our platform and how we build it.

• 
Difficult and consequential problems involving financial data, product design, reliability, security, and real operational workflows.

• 
The opportunity to define an AI-native approach to developing complex financial software and see your work reach customers quickly.

• 
An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• 
Strong opportunities for professional development as Performativ grows into a European market leader.

jobs.description:
Student assistant interested in turning data and insights into actions

Would you like to help strengthen climate adaptation across the Nordic region? Join Tryg’s Climate Excellence team as a student assistant and help turn data into insights that support better decisions.

About the job | A student job that creates value

You will join the newly established Climate Excellence team, part of Tryg’s Insurance Technical Group Function. The function drives technical excellence and data-driven decision-making across the Nordic business to support Tryg’s long-term competitiveness.

The goal of Climate Excellence is to help Tryg better understand and respond to climate risks, supporting smarter decisions for both the business and our customers.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Collecting, structuring, and visualizing data and information for analysis

• Exploring trends across multiple data sources and translating findings into practical recommendations

• Preparing presentations and decision-support material for colleagues and management

• Supporting projects and initiatives related to climate adaptation and resilience

You will gain insight into how data, insurance, climate adaptation, and business strategy come together in practice while developing analytical and communication skills in a Nordic organization.

The role is based in Ballerup and involves collaboration with colleagues in Denmark, Sweden, and Norway. We occasionally meet as a Nordic team in Bergen or Stockholm, approximately once a month. Participation is optional, and online attendance is always possible.

About you | Curious, collaborative, and interested in working with data

You are currently enrolled in a relevant higher education programme, such as business, economics, engineering, technology, mathematics, data science, climate studies, or a related field. Ideally, you have at least two years remaining in your studies.

You enjoy working with both quantitative and qualitative information, identifying patterns, and presenting insights in a clear and structured way. You are curious about developments in society and motivated by learning through varied tasks and collaborations.

The following skills will help you succeed in the role:

• Experience using Excel to structure and analyze data

• Experience using PowerPoint to communicate insights and recommendations

• An interest in data analysis and tools such as Python

• Strong written and spoken English skills

You do not need to meet every criterion to apply. We are primarily looking for someone with curiosity, motivation, and the willingness to learn. Danish language skills are an advantage but not a requirement.

About us | Personal and professional development

Climate Excellence works across Tryg’s Nordic business to develop and standardize climate-related initiatives and strengthen climate knowledge throughout the organization.

You will join a small Nordic team with backgrounds in climate, analytics, insurance, and business development. We collaborate closely across countries and functions and believe the best solutions are created through teamwork, knowledge sharing, and diverse perspectives.

• A supportive environment with responsibility and guidance

• Flexible working arrangements that accommodate your studies

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Business Analyst Oliver Christensen at: oliver.c@tryg.dk

Application deadline: 15 November 2026.

Imagine a future where you are a key part of our Asset Integrity Team operating some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets both onshore and offshore

Welcome to Asset Integrity

You’ll be part of Asset Integrity where you, together with your engineering colleague will support the organisation with your mechanical engineering skills in the operation, inspection, engineering, integrity and asset management. As a team we foster collaboration and innovation. We are a group of ambitious professionals within different engineering disciplines, who are passionate and motivated and who value teamwork as an essential part of safeguarding our assets.

You’ll play an important role in:

• executing various engineering studies and tasks for onshore oil&gas terminals and offshore and onshore pipelines both internally and by defining scope of work and liaison with external engineering consultants

• performing inspection data analysis and integrity assessment of our approx 800km of pipelines

• supporting the  offshore inspection and maintenance campaigns.

• liaison with Authorities, Contractors, Oil&Gas companies and other third parties.

• act as offshore company representative/supervisor onboard contractors’ vessels

• ensure and perform engineering and quality check and final delivery of inspection results to our Integrity engineers

• providing input to budgets and reporting to management.

Once familiar with our systems, you will be included in a 24/7 duty roster to respond to emergency situations.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have key focus on safety, which shall be embedded in all the work you do;

• hold an engineering degree, preferably in mechanical engineering

• have experience working with oil&gas plant and pipeline integrity and engineering both onshore and  offshore

• have experience working with engineering companies, contractors and/or suppliers;

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. You’ll receive the training needed to maintain and further develop your competencies.

The role involves some travel, including two to three day trips per month to onshore sites, a two-week offshore campaign in summer, and a few conferences or courses each year.

Working at Ørsted

In the Asset Integrity department we have the responsibility for looking after some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets. We have highly skilled employees dedicated to safeguard and care for our assets.

We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and diverse workplace with constructive feedback and continuous learning, enabling our people to develop their expertise in asset integrity and engineering.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

Position salary range:

For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr68,100.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

Our benefits package:

For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

Pre-employment background check:

This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Digital Servicebook is a Danish automotive tech and SaaS company, founded in 2015. We make car service history digital, accessible and aggregated across car brands and connect independent workshops, car manufacturers' digital service registers and other players in the automotive industry.

Our platform is supported globally and is widely used in Europe. We have sales offices in Denmark, Sweden, Norway, the UK and the Netherlands, are continuously working to expand our presence in more markets and collaborate with some of the biggest players in the industry.

We work purposefully with AI and new technologies that make everyday life easier and our processes more efficient. We are a small, dynamic organization in growth, and now our finance function must keep up.

About the position

You will be responsible for the entire day-to-day finance function – from vouchers and reconciliations to monthly reporting, budgets and forecasts. It is a hands-on role: you do the bookkeeping yourself, and you are also the one who gives the management and the board a true and timely picture of the finances.

You will work closely with the COO and management, and you will have a real influence on how we structure processes, systems and reporting as we grow.

Your primary tasks

• Ongoing bookkeeping, voucher management and reconciliation of bank, debtors, creditors and intermediate accounts

• Invoicing and customer follow-up across subscriptions, transaction-based services and payment flows (e.g. e-conomic and Stripe)

• Reconciliation between CRM, payment platform and accounting, so we know that all customers are invoiced correctly

• Month, quarterly and year-end closing as well as collaboration with the auditor

• VAT and duties, including VAT on sales abroad

• Coordination of payroll and payroll-related tasks, also for employees in other countries

• Controlling and monthly management and board reporting (profit, balance sheet and key figures)

• Preparation and follow-up on budget and ongoing forecast, including cash management

• Finances across companies and countries in the group

• Continuous improvement and automation of financial processes and systems

Your profile

• You have solid experience with independent bookkeeping and closing of accounts – preferably 5+ years

• You have experience with controlling, budgeting and forecasting and can translate numbers into clear recommendations

• Relevant education, accountant background or equivalent experience

• You are strong in Excel and have experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

• You are good at Danish and English in writing and speech

• It is an advantage if you have experience with SaaS/subscription finance, foreign companies or VAT across countries

• You are structured, accurate and self-driven – and you thrive on having both your hands in the bookkeeping and the overview of the whole

We offer

• A central role with great independence and direct influence in a growing company

• Short path to decisions and close cooperation with management

• An international industry in digital transformation

• Salary, according to qualifications,

• Working hours / flexibility

Apply →

The Impact You'll Make

Brand

Danfoss engineers solutions that increase machine productivity, reduce emissions, lower energy consumption, and enable electrification.

Our solutions are used in areas such as refrigeration, air conditioning, heating, power conversion, motor control, industrial machinery, marine, and on- and off-highway equipment. We also provide solutions for data centers, renewable energy, energy storage, heat recovery, as well as contribute to district energy solutions for cities.

Our innovative engineering dates back to 1933. Danfoss is family-owned and employs over 39,000 people. We create long-term value for our customers in more than 100 countries with a global footprint of around 100 factories.

**A Snapshot of Your Day

**For our Product Cybersecurity department, we are looking for an experienced, highly skilled and motivated Product Cybersecurity Architect to drive the definition and implementation of solution-wide security across exciting industrial product ranges. In this role, you will provide cybersecurity architecture expertise across multiple product and engineering domains, contribute to the development of cybersecurity standards and architectural principles, and work closely with development teams to strengthen the security and resilience of our products and solutions.

You will be part of Product Cybersecurity department, an international team of cybersecurity professionals united by a shared mission: enabling secure digitalization and ensuring that cybersecurity is built into products and solutions by design.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**

• Define and maintain overall cybersecurity architectural framework for products and solutions

• Establish and maintain cybersecurity principles, standards, guardrails, reference architectures, and secure development practices aligned with industry standards.

• Translate business, regulatory, and customer requirements into secure and scalable architectural solutions.

• Drive the adoption of Secure-by-Design principles and practices across products, solutions, and engineering processes.

• Facilitate cybersecurity architecture and design reviews, ensuring alignment with secure-by-design principles and organizational security objectives.

• Provide cybersecurity guidance on design and implementation to product development teams.

• Perform threat modeling and risk assessments at component, system, and solution levels.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to integrate cybersecurity requirements into product roadmaps, development processes, and engineering practices.

• Provide cybersecurity expertise and advisory support throughout customer projects, from proposal and design phases through implementation and delivery.

• Support cybersecurity certification, compliance, and assessment activities, including alignment with ISA/IEC 62443, Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2, and other applicable requirements.

**What You Bring

**

• An academic degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a comparable field.

• Several years of experience in cybersecurity, product security, or OT cybersecurity in an architect, lead specialist, or similar role.

• Excellent technical security knowledge based on cybersecurity standards and good practices.

• Experience with widely recognized OT cybersecurity standards, including ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, and ISO 27001.

• Experience with threat modeling, risk assessment, and security architecture reviews.

• Experience with SCADA systems, Industrial Control Systems (ICS), and industrial communication networks.

• Knowledge of containerization and container orchestration security.

• Knowledge of cloud security principles and architecture.

• Understanding of AI-driven cybersecurity, including the use of AI in both offensive and defensive security contexts, and its implications for product security, threat detection, and secure system architecture.

• Fluency in English. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate technical information to non-technical stakeholders

• Proven ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

You are an ideal candidate, if you have:

• Relevant cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, CCSP, or ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Expert.

• Knowledge of security and enterprise architecture frameworks such as SABSA and TOGAF.

• Experience with regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to OT and connected products, including NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and NERC CIP.

• Experience with software supply chain security, SBOM governance, and vulnerability management processes.

**About The Team

**Digital Products and Solutions (DPS) serves as Siemens Energy’s in-house digital product delivery partner and a global center of excellence for software engineering. Our mission is to develop standardized, high-quality, and scalable software products and services that strengthen the company’s digital foundation and create significant value for both internal and external customers.

By accelerating the delivery of new software engineering products and services, we help reduce time to market and contribute directly to Siemens Energy’s business success.

As part of the Product Cybersecurity team, you will play a key role in embedding cybersecurity into the design, development, and delivery of Siemens Energy's products and solutions, helping ensure they remain secure, resilient, and compliant in an evolving threat landscape. The team works closely with product owners, architects, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to define security principles, provide practical guidance, and support the implementation of scalable security solutions across the product lifecycle.Who is Siemens Energy?

**Who is Siemens Energy?

**At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. jobs.occupation: Nationalmuseet søger en Konsevator eller Konserveringstekniker til projektansættelse
jobs.description:
The National Museum’s Conservation and Restoration unit is seeking a conservator for a 2-year project, focusing on recent wood conservation within the museum, with a focus on church furnishings and furniture.

Work areas

You will be part of a team of conservators with many specialties. Your main responsibility will be the conservation and documentation of wooden objects, furniture, and interiors, as well as the dismantling and assembly of interiors in historic buildings and churches. The tasks also include preventive conservation. The work is part of the unit’s revenue-generating business.

In addition, there may be tasks within the National Museum’s own exhibitions, involving work with installations, exhibition care, and possibly in our magazines.

Qualifications

We expect you to have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in conservation from a recognized educational institution or equivalent. In addition, we will emphasize that you have the following:

• Practical experience with the conservation of wooden objects or knowledge of traditional craft techniques within carpentry or furniture making

• Experience with the conservation of cultural and historical objects that are still in use. Specific experience with church furnishings is desirable, but not a requirement

• Experience with pest control, treatment of fungally infected wood and stabilization of decayed wood, including the conservation of wooden objects exhibited outdoors

• Experience with budgeting and time management

• Good teamwork skills

• Driving license (B)

Wage and employment conditions

The average working hours are 37 hours per week. We have flexible hours. Wage and employment conditions are determined according to the current collective agreement for academics in the State or the organizational agreement for technical employees.

The workplace is Brede north of Copenhagen. There will be business trips of shorter or longer periods in relation to specific projects.

The National Museum must have the opportunity to assess a criminal record for private use prior to employment.

The position is to be filled with effect from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is limited in time to 2 years.

Application

The National Museum’s ambition is to create a workplace where diversity is not only tolerated, but actively promoted and valued. We therefore encourage all qualified individuals, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

We are actively working to reduce bias in the recruitment process to ensure a diverse workforce and to ensure that we hire the most suitable candidates based on professional and personal qualifications. We therefore ask that you refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

Written applications (in Danish or English) with information about education and previous employment should be sent via our electronic recruitment system on the National Museum’s website and must reach the museum no later than Tuesday, November 24, 2026.

We expect to hold job interviews at the beginning of week 49.

For further information regarding the position, please contact conservator Kim Alberdi at +45 41 20 65 94, kim.alberdi@natmus.dk or unit manager Eva Bøje Nielsen at + 45 41 20 65 70, eva.boje.nielsen@natmus.dk

If you are passionate about transforming customer data, behavioral signals, and business priorities into connected, personalized customer experiences, this could be your next professional challenge. The role gives you a unique opportunity to combine strategic influence with hands-on orchestration and optimization, helping build and evolve the capabilities, frameworks, and ways of working that enable teams to turn customer data and technology into connected, relevant experiences that drive engagement and commercial growth. As our new colleague, you will be owning the business operation, development, and optimization of our omnichannel orchestration and personalization capabilities, turning customer data and commercial priorities into connected and personalized customer experiences at scale.

An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

jobs.occupation: Bliv en del af holdet hos Le Petit Vinbar i Torvehallerne
jobs.description:
Bliv en del af holdet hos Le Petit Vinbar i Torvehallerne

Har du interesse for vin, sans for godt værtskab og lyst til at gøre en forskel? Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Hos Le Petit Vinbar søger vi en eller to ekstraordinære kolleger til et lille, men stærkt internationalt team af engagerede mennesker, der brænder for at skabe oplevelser som gæsterne husker – og vender tilbage til.

Vi tilbyder op til 120 timer om måneden til en person eller ca. 60 timer hver til to personer. Vagterne ligger mellem kl. 9 og 21, både på hverdage og i weekender.

Godt værtskab er kernen i det, vi laver

Vi søger dig, der tager initiativ, har blik for detaljerne og møder mennesker med varme og nysgerrighed. Du lægger mærke til, hvad gæsterne har brug for, og gør dig umage for, at alle føler sig set, velkomne og godt taget hånd om – også når der er travlt.

Du har erfaring fra café, bar eller restaurant og trives med at tage ansvar. Du behøver ikke være faglært tjener eller vinekspert, men du er interesseret i vin og har lyst til at lære og dele din viden med gæsterne. Interesse for mad er også et plus. Du kan kommunikere med vores gæster på dansk eller engelsk.

Vi er et lille hold, hvor alle tager del i hverdagens opgaver: vinservering, gæsteservice, madlavning, opfyldning og oprydning. Vi hjælper hinanden og lægger vægt på både godt samarbejde og omhu i det daglige arbejde.

Om Le Petit Vinbar

Le Petit Vinbar er en lille, livlig vin- og champagnebar midt i Torvehallerne i København. Baren blev grundlagt i 2013 af Ole Mejlby og Sylvain Codron, og vi importerer selv vores vine direkte fra små producenter i Frankrig, Italien og Østrig.

Hos os mødes vininteresse og personligt værtskab. Vi deler gerne historierne bag vinene og hjælper gæsterne med at finde noget, de bliver glade for – uanset om de kommer for et enkelt glas eller en hel eftermiddag.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team med mulighed for at lære mere om vin, mad og service og sætte dit præg på gæsternes oplevelse.

Praktisk information og ansøgning

Løn og tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV til job@lepetitvinbar.dk. Fortæl os gerne, hvorfor du har lyst til at arbejde hos os, om du søger ca. 60 eller op til 120 timer om måneden, og hvornår du kan starte.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette eller de rette kolleger. Send derfor gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Join the team at Le Petit Vinbar in Torvehallerne

Do you have an interest in wine, a flair for hospitality and a desire to make a difference? Then we’d love to hear from you.

At Le Petit Vinbar, we’re looking for one or two extraordinary colleagues to join our small but strong international team of dedicated people who are passionate about creating experiences that guests remember—and return for.

We offer up to 120 hours per month for one person, or approximately 60 hours each for two people. Shifts fall between 9 am and 9 pm, on both weekdays and weekends.

Hospitality is at the heart of everything we do

We’re looking for someone who takes initiative, pays attention to detail and approaches people with warmth and curiosity. You notice what guests need and take care to make everyone feel seen, welcome and well looked after—even when it’s busy.

You have experience working in a café, bar or restaurant and enjoy taking responsibility. You don’t need to be a formally trained waiter or a wine expert, but you have an interest in wine and are keen to learn and share your knowledge with guests. An interest in food is also a plus. You can communicate with our guests in Danish or English.

We’re a small team where everyone contributes to the daily tasks: serving wine, looking after guests, preparing food, restocking and keeping things clean and tidy. We help each other and value teamwork and care in our everyday work.

About Le Petit Vinbar

Le Petit Vinbar is a small, lively wine and champagne bar in the heart of Torvehallerne in Copenhagen. Founded in 2013 by Ole Mejlby and Sylvain Codron, we import our wines directly from small producers in France, Italy and Austria.

Here, a love of wine meets personal hospitality. We enjoy sharing the stories behind our wines and helping guests find something they’ll love—whether they’re stopping by for a single glass or spending the whole afternoon with us.

You’ll join a dedicated team, with opportunities to learn more about wine, food and service, and to make your mark on our guests’ experience.

Practical information and how to apply

Salary and start date by agreement.

Send a short application and your CV to job@lepetitvinbar.dk. Tell us why you’d like to work with us, whether you’re looking for approximately 60 or up to 120 hours per month, and when you can start.

We review applications and hold interviews on an ongoing basis, and will hire once we’ve found the right person or people. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Do you thrive in designing and developing software solutions for modular robotics platforms? Are you motivated by taking responsibility for the entire software development process and ensuring compliance with quality and architectural standards?

As a Software Engineer within vision and robotics, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining software solutions while ensuring compliance with quality and architectural standards. Moreover, you will contribute to the successful implementation of solutions by conducting training sessions for internal stakeholders and end users. You will support projects, collaborate closely with the Technical Product Owner (TPO), and ensure valuable feedback from projects and site integration is used for adjustments and further development.

Responsibility for Vision and Robotics

We are a global organization, but you will be working from our office in Aarhus and be part of a small team of highly skilled colleagues in logistics. You will join the Robot Product Team, which covers multiple disciplines – Electrical, Mechanical, Automation – with you as the software responsible. You will work in close collaboration with the TPO, who acts as Product Owner, and you will have sparring opportunities with software colleagues across the organization to support knowledge sharing and development. Here, your responsibilities will be:

• Improving new software products related to vision and robotic applications and supporting their use in projects.

• Maintaining and developing software applications according to our operating model and applicable standards.

• Ensuring code quality through reviews, documentation, and adherence to coding and architectural guidelines.

• Offering input to automation strategy and technical requirements and setting product requirements in collaboration with the business.

• Testing and validating functionalities on our local test loop or on sites.

• Collaborating with interdisciplinary teams on a common system and evaluating and selecting appropriate technologies for automation and system integration.

Experienced Software Developer

You are familiar with commonly used tools, frameworks, and libraries relevant to 3D vision, point cloud processing, and AI development, and can evaluate and apply them effectively based on product needs. Additionally, we imagine that:

• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree, or an equivalent qualification in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

• You have solid proficiency developing real-time applications in C# and Python.

• You possess solid expertise in classical computer vision and 3D geometry, with a strong focus on point cloud processing and object recognition.

• Experience or interest in machine learning and signal processing is highly relevant, as these fields play an increasing role in advancing vision and robotics applications.

• You have experience in developing and maintaining various software architectures such as Docker and Kubernetes.

• You possess strong knowledge of software design principles, design patterns, and effort estimation for development tasks, and have hands-on experience with version control systems (e.g., Git), as well as software prototyping and conceptualization.

• You bring a solid understanding of high-level integration with robotic systems and can design and implement interfaces that enable effective communication between software components and robotic controls.

• You can combine input from multiple sensors into valuable insights. This could be cameras, LiDAR's, encoders, safety sensors etc.

Moreover, you demonstrate innovative thinking, analytical skills, and a strong problem-solving mindset. You bring excellent communication skills, team spirit, and a high willingness to learn. You enjoy working collaboratively across disciplines in a diverse and inclusive environment.

Interested?

If you find the description interesting, please do not hesitate to contact Henning Horn Lauritsen +45 8741 4674 with any question you might have or apply via the link.

atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, and Sweden.

We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

**Project Scheduler at atNorth

**Are you a master of project controls who thrives on turning complex infrastructure dependencies into highly predictable, synchronized execution plans? As a Project Scheduler at atNorth, you will ensure accurate planning, coordination, and tracking of all activities across the entire data center construction lifecycle. You will act as the critical link connecting our engineering, procurement, and construction teams, ensuring that every milestone from initial design to final commissioning stays firmly on track.

This is a high-impact position within our PMO structure where your analytical insights, critical path analyses, and proactive risk-mapping will directly drive predictable, on-time project delivery across our rapidly expanding Nordic footprint.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Develop, baseline, and maintain fully integrated master schedules for our data center projects, meticulously covering design, permitting, civil works, MEP installation, commissioning, and final handover.

• Ensure procurement timelines for long-lead items (LLI) and owner-furnished, contractor-installed (OFCI) equipment are seamlessly integrated into the active construction schedules.

• Monitor schedule performance using Earned Value Management (EVM) and progress metrics. Identify deviations, track float, and proactively flag critical path risks and delay mitigation opportunities to Project Managers and senior stakeholders.

• Rigorously review and challenge external contractor schedules for logic, realism, and contractual compliance, highlighting gaps or inconsistencies before they impact the site.

• Support weekly and monthly programme reviews by preparing updated schedules, dashboards, look-aheads, and scenario/what-if analyses. Partner with Cost Management to align schedule tracking with cash flow forecasting.

• Refine planning standards, templates, and scheduling methodologies in coordination with the PMO to increase delivery efficiency portfolio-wide.

**Your profile:

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Process Simulation and Techno-Economic Optimization of Large-Scale Power-to-X Systems
jobs.description:
The Center for Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD position focusing on process simulation, techno-economic assessment, and optimization of large-scale Power-to-X (PtX) systems for the production of renewable fuels and chemicals. The preferred start date is February 1, 2027. 

The application deadline is November 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Job Description

The PhD position is part of SDU Life Cycle Engineering's research activities on PtX technologies, renewable fuel production, sector coupling, and the transition toward climate-neutral energy systems.

PtX technologies are expected to play an important role in decarbonizing hard-to-abate sectors by converting renewable electricity into synthetic fuels, and chemicals. However, their large-scale deployment requires efficient process design, effective integration with local energy system and biomass availability, and economically competitive operation under variable renewable electricity supply and changing market conditions.

The PhD project aims to develop and apply advanced process simulation and techno-economic optimization frameworks for large-scale PtX systems. A central focus will be on linking detailed process simulations with techno-economic models to evaluate alternative process configurations, identify opportunities for sector coupling, and optimize technology capacities and operating conditions. The project will also investigate how electricity prices, renewable electricity availability, hydrogen, biogas and CO2 supply, and process flexibility influence the economic performance of industrial-scale PtX facilities. The research will combine process simulation tools, particularly Aspen Plus, with computational modelling and optimization approaches. 

The successful candidate will contribute to ongoing national and international research projects and collaborate with academic and industrial partners working on PtX technologies and sustainable energy systems.

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering (SDU LCE) at the University of Southern Denmark's main campus in Odense. 

SDU LCE is a rapidly expanding research center with a strong international profile in net-zero transitions and sustainable energy systems. The center conducts research on integrated energy system design, renewable energy integration, PtX technologies, carbon management, sustainable biomass utilization, sector coupling, and CCUS integration.

SDU LCE is actively engaged in national and international research projects supported by the EU, national innovation programs, private companies, and other organizations.

Within SDU LCE, the research group focusing on renewable fuel production, process integration, techno-economic assessment, and energy system optimization is experiencing significant growth. The group combines detailed process modelling with system-level analysis to address the technological and economic challenges associated with industrial decarbonization.

For more information about SDU LCE, please visit www.sdu.dk/lifecycle. 

 

Qualifications

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate with a master’s degree in chemical engineering. The ideal candidate should have a strong interest in process modelling, thermodynamic analysis, techno-economic assessment, and optimization of renewable energy conversion technologies. Experience in the following areas will be considered an advantage: 

• 
Process simulation using Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, or similar software.

• 
Modelling of Power-to-X technologies.

• 
Thermodynamic modelling, mass and energy balances, process design, and heat integration.

• 
Techno-economic assessment, including capital and operating cost estimation, levelized production costs, and economic sensitivity analysis.

• 
Programming and numerical optimization using Python, MATLAB, or similar tools.

• 
Understanding of renewable electricity integration, process flexibility, and sector coupling.

The successful candidate should demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, an independent and curious research mindset, and an interest in interdisciplinary collaboration. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills are required.

 

Responsibilities

The successful PhD candidate will be expected to: 

• 
Develop detailed process simulation models of selected large-scale Power-to-X technologies and integrated production pathways.

• 
Perform thermodynamic analysis, mass and energy balances, and process integration assessments.

• 
Develop techno-economic models to estimate investment costs, operating costs, and levelized production costs of renewable fuels and chemicals.

• 
Apply optimization approaches to investigate process configurations, operating conditions, technology capacities, and economic performance.

• 
Evaluate the impacts of electricity prices, renewable energy availability, and feedstock supply on PtX system design and operation.

• 
Identify opportunities for improving energy efficiency, heat recovery, resource utilization, and process flexibility.

• 
Collaborate with academic and industrial partners involved in the research.

• 
Complete the required PhD courses (30 ECTS) and undertake a research stay abroad.

• 
Publish research findings in high-impact scientific journals and present results at international conferences.

• 
Prepare and successfully defend a PhD thesis based on the research conducted.

 

About the team

The PhD fellow will work in the SDU Life Cycle Engineering (SDU LCE) center at the Department of Green Technology. The main supervisor will be Associate Professor Hossein Nami and co-supervision will be provided by Professor Henrik Wenzel.

 

Further information 

For further information regarding the position, please contact Associate Professor Hossein Nami at tel.: +45 52751924, email: hon@igt.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
1-page application letter including a statement of motivation.

• 
Curriculum Vitae.

• 
List of publications and maximum 3 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

• 
Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

• 
Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

• 
Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

• 
An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

• 
Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

• 
References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.313 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. 

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

The academic focus of the SDU Centre for Software Technology is to conduct research in interactive information technology and software engineering. The areas will be complementing each other to make way for the engineering of the next generation of reliable, intelligent and interactive software solutions. This includes understanding how AI technologies and data-informed software development with a human-centred perspective can change the engineering of products and software infrastructures.

The centre is involved in a variety of research and collaboration projects nationally and internationally. The centre has a strong collaboration with industry to solve challenging research problems from real applications, and to participate in implementing the achieved results into real solutions with end users. The work in the centre is structured around a number of laboratories.

The work and responsibilities for the applicant will be within the areas of:

• 
Prototyping interactive technologies such as Arduino, Raspberry Pi, circuits, microcontrollers, soldering, sensors, and actuators

• 
Software development in relation to advanced interaction technologies, intelligent systems, cyber-physical systems, e.g. in the areas of critical infrastructure and healthcare systems

• 
Developing and maintaining infrastructures to support the laboratories in close collaboration with the associated researchers

• 
Support for research and educational activities

• 
Managing lab space including inventory, supplies and materials, space maintenance and organization, developing and enforcing safety procedures, providing and managing training for specialized fabrication equipment

• 
Digital/physical fabrication with laser cutters, 3D printers, 3D modeling, making enclosures for interactive electronics, making professional robust physical artifacts

• 
Facilitating and participation in business development in collaboration with local industry and municipality

• 
Using AI technologies effectively, ethically and systematically in the context of engineering applications 

The applicant we are looking for should have one or more of the following competencies:

• 
Experience with collaboration projects that involve industry and academia

• 
Experience with implementing software solutions in a variety of programming languages

• 
Experience with managing a lab space including managing training for specialized fabrication equipment.

• 
Experience with prototyping interactive technologies and digital/physical fabrication

• 
Experience with software development processes and methods

• 
Experience with infrastructures to support software development (e.g. Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud infrastructures)

• 
Experience with the development of middleware, services, micro services, and databases

• 
Experience with Generative AI and Prompt Engineering, e.g. tailoring effective prompts to instruct LLMs; knowing the dos and don’ts of GenAI from ethical angles 

• 
Experience with data engineering including the use of machine learning frameworks with software such as PyTorch and TensorFlow

It is expected that the candidate has documented qualifications related to the position, for example, shown by a degree in the field of software engineering, interaction technologies, computer engineering, computer science or similar or previous related job positions.

A candidate should be able to achieve a Danish security clearance to take part in the development of critical technology.

We offer a dynamic and diverse work environment with a large variety of tasks, and you will be given the opportunity to work on different research projects applying your skills within the software domain. It is expected that you can work in a team, but also solve your tasks independently.

Further information is available from LEGO® Chair and Professor Mikkel Baun Kjærgaard, mbkj@mmmi.sdu.dk, +45 2197 2447.

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Positions within Mobile Robotics at SDU Robotics
jobs.description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within mobile robotics. We therefore invite applications for one or more postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

What we offer

• 
An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

• 
A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

• 
Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

• 
Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to the mobile robotics lab specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automated agriculture as well as related applications that require mobility in open terrain. We expect that the research activities involve both computer vision for scene understanding, tracking of relevant artefacts, as well as the integration and development of AI-based solutions for autonomous operation in scenarios within, e.g., field processing. The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in testing facilities at SDU as well as project partners and head the evaluation efforts in collaboration with a consortium of interdisciplinary project partners. 

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching and supervision responsibilities could also be part of employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

• 
Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics.

• 
Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

• 
Supporting the team in securing external funding.

• 
Participation in ongoing and future research projects.

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to mobile robots controlled with multimodal feedback. The candidates are hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

• 
Expert knowledge with ROS2 and relevant modules such as the Nav2

• 
Strong knowledge in multi-object tracking

• 
Experience in simulation of robotic systems

• 
Experience in design, development and integration of robotic systems

Furthermore, the successful candidates are expected to:

• 
Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

• 
Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

• 
Have the ability of working independently.

• 
Have a strong sense of responsibility.

• 
Conduct independent research. 

Research environment

The candidates will be integrated in the unit SDU Robotics. We are a team of approximately 60 researchers and engineers based in Odense. We actively work across traditional disciplinary boundaries to develop new technologies and scientific knowledge. Our research contributes to novel solutions with applications in welfare, industrial automation, lab automation, and healthcare. Furthermore, the unit has a long-standing tradition of collaboration with industrial partners.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics.

We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international working environment with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your growth as a researcher within the field of robotics.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

•

• 
Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

• 
Verified copies of official certificates/diplomas and transcripts of exams (MSc and PhD), both the original documents and in professional English translation.

•

Employment terms

This postdoc position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

jobs.occupation: Agroecological approaches to reduce nitrogen losses in vegetable production
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Food Science programme. The position is available from 15 January 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Agroecological approaches to reduce nitrogen losses in vegetable production

Research area and project description
This PhD project will investigate how to reduce nitrogen losses from vegetable production systems. The aim is to successfully introduce and optimize mitigation measures such as catch crops, biomass removal, precision fertilization and irrigation in open field vegetable crop rotations to reduce residual soil N. The focus will be on losses by nitrate leaching as well as vegetable growth and nitrogen use efficiency. The aim is to optimize resource use and reduce environmental and climate impact of both organic and conventional vegetable systems using agroecological approaches. Relationships will be studied by experimental and modelling methodologies between soil nitrogen availability, crop nitrogen uptake and nitrate leaching losses based on soil water, soil and plant sampling from field trials at research and commercial fields. Investigations of losses of nitrous oxide may be included.

Research questions to be addressed include:
 
• How do crop traits influence the effectiveness of various mitigation measures in efficiently reducing nitrogen losses in organic and conventional vegetable production?
• How to optimize fertilization and irrigation practices for adequate root zone availability of nitrogen for high yielding and low nitrogen leaching vegetable production? 
Statistically designed field experiments will be available for studying mitigation measures on nitrate leaching in vegetable crop rotations at the research station AU-Auning. Fields at vegetable producers are equipped and available. The Department provides access to the state-of-the-art field and laboratory facilities. The PhD student will join the Science Team of Plant, Food and Sustainability, which includes PhD students and other scientific and technical staff. We foster a friendly and respectful working environment in an international atmosphere. We aim to collaborate and enjoy while contributing to the sustainability of food production.

The study will be conducted as part of Danish (Nvirkværk, GUDP) and European (Gound2Live, Agroecology Partnership, HEU) projects, which aim to: Integrate cover crops and other measures in sustainable vegetable cropping; Reduce losses of nitrate and nitrous oxide from intensive vegetable production; A Living Lab methodology is used in an agroecological framework, including European stakeholders from horticultural industries and universities.

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants are expected to have a relevant master’s degree in Plant, Horticultural, Agricultural, Biological, Environmental or Soil Science (120 ECTS)
 
• Write and speak English fluently
• Knowledge of handling and analysing experimental data
• Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team
• Experience in field experiments
It is an advantage to have:
 
• Experience in conducting plant and soil experiments
• A proven record in scientific writing
 Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is FOOD, Agro Food Park 48, 8200 Aarhus N., Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Hanne Lakkenborg Kristensen, e-mail: hanne.kristensen@food.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Mesfin T. Gebremikael, e-mail: mesfin.gebremikael@food.au.dk (co-supervisor)
For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk
How to apply

Application deadline is 01 December 2026 at 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 15 January 2027.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Cheminformatics and Machine Learning
jobs.description:
SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a PhD position in cheminformatics and machine learning. 

The position will contribute to PFAROS, a flagship European research project dedicated to driving sustainable innovation and supporting the transition toward PFAS-free healthcare in Europe. Working at the intersection of chemistry, environmental science, artificial intelligence, and data science, the successful candidate will help advance next-generation approaches for chemical assessment by integrating diverse data streams, developing cutting-edge predictive models, and generating knowledge that supports safer and more sustainable chemical and material innovation. Through collaboration with leading international researchers and stakeholders, the position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to high-impact science addressing some of society’s most pressing environmental and health challenges.

The position will contribute to ongoing research projects and activities at SDU Life Cycle Engineering.

 

Main tasks

The main tasks include:

• 
Collect, curate, and validate high-quality physicochemical, environmental, and hazard property data for chemicals in commerce. 

• 
Evaluate and document the applicability domains and coverage of existing machine learning models used for predicting chemical properties. 

• 
Develop, train, validate, and benchmark new models for chemical property prediction, including machine learning and generative AI-based approaches. 

• 
Contribute to the integration of experimental data, computational methods, and machine learning workflows. 

• 
Participate in collaborative research activities within the PFAROS consortium and interact with international project partners. 

• 
Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, reports, and the development of new research proposals.

 

Qualifications

The successful candidate should have:

• 
MSc degree (or equivalent) in chemistry, environmental science, chemical engineering, computer science, data science, bioinformatics, or a related field. 

• 
Strong interest in machine learning, cheminformatics, data science, and chemical risk assessment. 

• 
Experience with programming in Python and scientific computing. 

• 
Familiarity with machine learning methods, data management, and statistical analysis. 

• 
Experience with chemical databases, molecular descriptors, QSAR models, or cheminformatics tools is an advantage. 

• 
Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. 

• 
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an international research environment.

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering
