jobs.occupation: Associate Director, Trial Delivery Team Lead
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**Overview

**The Associate Director, Trial Delivery Team Lead plays a key leadership role in overseeing Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs) and Clinical Trial Associates (CTAs) while supporting the broader Clinical Trial Management (CTM) organization. This individual ensures high-quality clinical trial execution by providing strategic guidance, mentorship, and operational oversight. The Line Manager is responsible for team development, resource allocation, process optimization, and ensuring alignment with organizational goals and regulatory standards. The Trial Delivery Team Lead may assume Global Trial Lead (GTL) responsibilities to address fluctuating demands.

**Roles & Responsibilities

****Leadership and Line Management:

**

• Directly manage, mentor, and develop Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs) and Clinical Trial Associates (CTAs), fostering professional growth.

• Conduct performance evaluations, provide feedback, and identify training and career development opportunities.

• Ensure adequate resourcing, workload distribution, and succession planning within the team.

• Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and knowledge-sharing within the clinical operations team.

• Collaborate with Global Trial Leads (GTLs) on trial activities for assigned direct reports.

• Support trial deliverables by facilitating progress, coaching, and mentoring CTMs and CTAs.

• Advise on resource needs and support overall clinical trial resource planning.

• Ensure team success through setting clear expectations, guiding performance, and leading competency development.

• Lead functional working groups; serve as process owner or Subject Matter Expert (SME) within Clinical Operations.

• Support training initiatives across Trial Operations as needed.

• Collaborate with senior leadership to define and implement best practices within the Development Operations organization.

**Process & Compliance Management

**

• Ensure team adherence to Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines, and regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, etc.).

• Develop and refine Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to optimize trial efficiency and compliance.

• Support audits, inspections, and regulatory interactions by ensuring inspection readiness across clinical trials.

• Identify and drive process improvements to enhance trial execution and data quality.

• Lead cross-trial initiatives as needed, such as implementation of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) or new process rollouts across the program.

• Manages the execution and implementation of CTM and CTA tasks, ensuring operational success.

• Initiates and supports the development of processes within the CTM and CTA group, focusing on practical application and continuous improvement.

• Collaborates across functions to drive efficiencies and provide day-to-day guidance to the CTM and CTA groups.

**Requirements – What You Must Have

**

• Bachelor of science degree with relevant specialization; Master of science degree preferred

• Minimum requirement of 12 or more years of experience in clinical operations

• Significant experience in leading and managing complex global clinical projects/programs

• Significant experience managing/guiding internal (cross-functional) and external (CRO, regulatory authorities) teams

• Experience with operational management and budget planning

• Proven performance in earlier role/comparable role

• Global clinical program level experience required

• Experience within the field of oncology is preferred

• Minimum 2 years’ experience as Clinical Operations representative in Clinical Development Teams (CDTs) or Global Project Teams (GPTs) would be preferable

• Experience leading team members in global matrix environment, leveraging tools and technology to ensure business needs are met.

• Strategic thinking with ability to optimize organizational resources for successful program execution

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

**Moreover, You Meet The Following Personal Requirements

**

• Dedicated team player who enjoys leading teams and inspire trust among colleagues

• Quality mindset and able to prioritize your work in a fast paced and changing environment

• Result- and goal-oriented and committed to contributing to the overall success of Genmab

For US based candidates, the proposed salary band for this position is as follows:

$158,720.00---$238,080.00

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When You Join Genmab, You’re Joining a Culture That Supports Your Physical, Financial, Social, And Emotional Wellness. Within The First Year, Regular Full-time U.S. Employees Are Eligible For

• 401(k) Plan: 100% match on the first 6% of contributions

• Health Benefits: Two medical plan options (including HDHP with HSA), dental, and vision insurance

• Voluntary Plans: Critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity insurance

• Time Off: Paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and 12 weeks of discretionary paid parental leave

• Support Resources: Access to child and adult backup care, family support programs, financial wellness tools, and emotional well-being support

• Additional Perks: Commuter benefits, tuition reimbursement, and a Lifestyle Spending Account for wellness and personal expenses

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on role will be provided during the recruitment process

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Please note that if you are applying for a position in the Netherlands, Genmab’s policy for all permanently budgeted hires in NL is initially to offer a fixed-term employment contract for a year, if the employee performs well and if the business conditions do not change, renewal for an indefinite term may be considered after the fixed-term employment contract.

Spare Parts Coordinator

Are you passionate about customer service, coordination, and delivering results in an international environment? We are looking for a structured and service-minded Spare Parts Coordinator to join our Customer Service team. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the efficient handling of spare parts inquiries, quotations, and sales orders, contributing to an excellent customer experience through professional support, proactive communication, and reliable order execution.

As a Spare Parts Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing the spare parts process from initial customer inquiry through to final delivery. You will handle spare parts requests, prepare quotations, process sales orders, and proactively follow up with customers regarding availability, lead times, and order status. Working closely with procurement, planning, logistics, warehouse operations, and other internal stakeholders, you will help ensure smooth and timely order fulfillment while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.

To succeed in this role, you have experience within customer service, order processing, spare parts sales, logistics, or a similar operational function. You are comfortable working with ERP systems and digital tools and ideally have the ability to understand and work with technical product information. Strong communication skills in both Danish and English are important, as you will interact with customers and colleagues across different functions and locations.

As a person, you are service-oriented, structured, and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and attention to detail. You are able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment while maintaining a high level of quality and professionalism. You enjoy working collaboratively across departments, are solution-oriented in your approach, and take pride in delivering excellent service to both customers and colleagues.

We offer an exciting and varied position in a growing international company where you will become part of a dedicated and professional team. You will have the opportunity to work closely with customers and colleagues across the organization while contributing to continuous improvements, operational excellence, and the company's ongoing growth and success.

Why Should You Join Körber Supply Chain DK?

We offer an exciting role in an international company in growth, where you will work with advanced technical solutions and be part of a strong professional environment characterized by collaboration and dedication. We offer a range of attractive employee benefits:

Security & Health: In addition to a competitive salary package, you will be enrolled in our mandatory pension scheme, which also includes both health insurance and dental insurance, as well as access to physiotherapy. You will also be part of our lunch program, where our canteen provides healthy and exciting meals every day.

Development: We continuously offer training and courses, as we believe that our success is built on satisfied and skilled employees. That’s why we focus on both personal and professional development to ensure continuous growth.

Social Events: We have a strong company culture that we invest heavily in maintaining and developing. This includes a wide range of events and an active employee association that organizes activities such as Friday bars, Christmas parties, an annual ski trip, cultural events, and much more!

Körber – Conquer Supply Chain Complexity

We value diversity and welcome all applicants, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, identity, or any other protected status.

Apply now:

If you would like to create your future as a part of the Körber Supply Chain DK A/S team, please forward your application and CV already today!

Applications for this position have no deadline, as we will include candidates in the recruitment process on a continuous basis and will close the process once we have found the right candidate.

Apply now and join our team!

Ready for your next step? Click on ‘Apply now’ to get started right away! As long as the position is advertised, you can apply at any time.

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applicants - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity, and any other protected status. jobs.occupation: Expert, Business Area Manager Ecotoxicology and Environment
jobs.description:
Could your expertise in ecotoxicology help shape better environmental decisions—and unlock new opportunities for science-led advisory services?

At DHI, you’ll connect ecotoxicology, environmental science and water modelling to help clients tackle complex challenges in aquatic environments. Join our international Environment & Toxicology team to broaden your impact while helping grow our environmental advisory business.

Responsibilities and Challenges

We are looking for a senior colleague with expertise in ecotoxicology and environmental science with insights and interests in developing our advisory solutions and business.

As a member of DHI’s international Environment & Toxicology team, you will help clients address complex challenges related to chemicals, ecotoxicology and the aquatic environment. You will work closely with clients and colleagues across disciplines to develop practical, science-based solutions that protect human health and the environment.

The main responsibilities are to:

• Deliver expert advisory within the area of regulatory and scientific aspects of eco-toxicology, environmental exposure- and risk assessment, management of chemicals and/or environmental hazardous substances in water environments, and other client projects.

• Lead business development within advisory area of environment and eco-toxicology, enabling and bringing to life the strategy to build on the markets for advisory on environmental exposure- and risk assessment, management of chemicals and/or environmental hazardous substances (incl. micropollutants) in water environments.

• Plan and execute of internal and external activities of knowledge distribution (i.e. network meetings, conferences or courses) as well as business development activities.

• Serve as project manager in own projects, as well as deliver as project participant in projects within the portfolio.

• Perform quality assurance and mentor young colleagues, ensuring high scientific level of solutions.

• Establish and maintain good practices for international collaboration in E&T.

What We're Looking For

Required education, experience and capabilities

• A relevant university degree in ecotoxicology, environmental chemistry, environmental science, biology, chemistry, chemical engineering, water or environmental engineering, or a closely related discipline. A PhD or other advanced qualification is an advantage.

• At least 7 years of relevant professional experience in ecotoxicology, environmental chemistry, environmental risk assessment, chemicals in the environment or a closely related advisory field.

• A strong professional track record gained in consultancy, industry, public authority, research organization, or a comparable environment.

• Demonstrated experience assessing chemicals or environmentally hazardous substances in aquatic or water-related environments.

• Experience leading technically complex projects, including responsibility for scope, quality, budget, schedule and stakeholder management.

• A proven ability to originate or develop business, build client relationships and contribute to successful proposals or tenders.

• A good understanding of relevant environmental regulation, market developments and the needs of industry and public-sector clients.

• Experience working in an international or multidisciplinary setting.

• Proficient in English (professional level)

Additional experience and strengths, which will contribute to success in this role:

• Experience with establishing environmental quality standards and predicted no-effect concentrations, and/or assessing chemicals in wastewater or other water environments

• Knowledge of the EU Water Framework Directive, Urban Waste Water Treatment Directive, Drinking Water Directive or related national requirements.

• Experience with environmental fate, transport or exposure modelling

• Collaboration with authorities, utilities, industrial clients, industry associations, research programmes or international consortia.

• Experience developing services or markets across Denmark and the wider European region.

• Serving as the technical lead and/or mentor for colleagues in a team.

Skills and competences

The successful candidate combines scientific credibility with commercial awareness and a genuine interest in understanding client needs. We are looking for a person who can translate complex scientific and regulatory matters into clear advice and practical solutions.

You are:

• Scientifically strong, with the ability to provide authoritative advice within your field.

• Client-oriented and commercially aware, with the confidence to initiate conversations, develop opportunities and build lasting professional relationships.

• An effective project leader, able to maintain direction and quality across technically complex assignments.

• A clear communicator, capable of engaging scientific experts, decision-makers, authorities and other stakeholders.

• Collaborative and internationally oriented, with an interest in working across disciplines, markets and organisational boundaries.

• Proactive and accountable, taking ownership and exercising sound professional judgement.

• Generous with your expertise, contributing to knowledge sharing, mentoring and the professional development of colleagues.

Why join DHI?

To work at DHI means being part of an organisation that is the global leader in solving the world’s toughest challenges in water, environment and sustainability.

In this position we offer to you the opportunity to join a strong company with dedicated colleagues to:

• Shape and grow DHI’s ecotoxicology and environmental advisory business.

• Work at the intersection of chemicals, water environments, environmental regulation and data-driven decision-making.

• Collaborate with ecotoxicologists, environmental scientists, toxicologists, water specialists and modellers across an international organisation.

• Lead meaningful assignments for industry, authorities, utilities and partners.

• Take on a visible expert role with opportunities to influence strategy, develop clients, lead projects and mentor colleagues.

DHI is a global and independent company dedicated to working on challenges within the fields of water and environment and sustainability. Within these fields, we provide a wide range of advisory, digital advisory, research and water governance services as well as providing leading edge MIKE technologies and products to the market. At DHI, we are constantly looking for passionate and talented people who are eager to join our team.

By joining DHI, you will not only become part of a dynamic and collaborative global team of experts; you will be empowered to innovate, engage and grow in your area of expertise. DHI is committed to disseminate our knowledge effectively and across our worldwide network of offices.

Location & Mobility

Travelling must be expected in the role to enable collaboration with clients and/or inside DHI. Travelling rules as included in employment contract

• Deadline for application is 26th November 2026.

Architect, build, and scale AI systems that hold up in production

Take ownership of how AI is architected, built, and scaled across our products. You will design the agentic systems at the core of our pension and advisory platforms, with a focus on reliable and responsible AI.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help lead our newly established AI team, working on our Life product for pension companies. The team is focused on the practical and responsible use of AI and is still in its early stages, so as a senior member you will play a defining role in setting the technical foundation, design patterns, and ways of working that the rest of the team builds on.

You will work closely with the AI Team Lead and Chief Architect, who own the overall architecture, helping shape the design within that direction. You will also be part of an agile team with a flat structure, where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning are central to the culture.

This role is primarily about designing and building agentic and LLM systems end to end, with a meaningful share of your time spent owning how we evaluate them and prove they hold up. It suits someone with 5+ years of relevant experience who wants to move beyond implementation into designing AI systems, and who enjoys raising the bar for the engineers around them.

Why this matters

This is core infrastructure, not edge tooling. Our Life product runs policy and capital administration for some of Europe’s largest pension providers, including PensionDanmark and APG, and is on track to support more than 8 million members and over €800bn in retirement assets.

The AI you design must meet that bar: fast and innovative, but also accurate, secure, and reliable enough for systems that people depend on for their financial security in retirement. Building it well and being able to prove it works, are two sides of the same job.

What you’ll do

As a senior member of the AI team, you will help shape how we build with Large Language Models and agentic systems across our products, contributing to high‑level design decisions, turning ambiguous business problems into robust system designs, and ensuring high‑quality coding standards and design. You will be hands‑on, with a real say in the architecture, standards, and technical judgement that guide the team.

In practice, you will:

Help shape the technical direction

• Contribute to the AI tech stack across our products: help define the high‑level system design, reference architectures, and design patterns the team builds on.

• Help shape AI strategy: identify where AI can create genuine value, frame the trade‑offs, and feed into a coherent, prioritised technical roadmap that fits our wider platform.

• Inform major architectural decisions: model and framework selection, build‑versus‑buy, and how AI components fit into our existing Java platform, integrate with surrounding systems, scale, and stay maintainable over time.

• Reason about trade‑offs in the open: weigh latency, cost, accuracy, security, and reliability, and explain and defend those choices to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Architect and build (hands‑on)

• Design LLM systems end to end: from retrieval, agent orchestration, and data pipelines through to deployment and monitoring.

• Design and build agentic systems: single‑ and multi‑agent, covering orchestration, tool use, action groups, knowledge‑base integrations, and patterns such as routing, delegation, parallelisation, and result aggregation for complex, reliable production workflows.

• Engineer RAG pipelines that connect agents to internal structured and unstructured data.

• Drive quality through design: prompt strategy, system prompts, and memory systems that produce hallucination‑resistant outputs with strong relevance and faithfulness.

• Make cost‑aware architectural choices: balancing latency, cost, and quality across model selection and orchestration patterns so what we ship is sustainable at scale.

• Set the standards for prompt strategy, RAG, orchestration, and cost management that the wider team adopts.

Evaluate and prove

• Build evaluation frameworks: eval sets, golden datasets, and LLM‑as‑judge pipelines, with offline regression suites wired into CI and online evaluation on production traces.

• Evaluate the whole agent, not just the answer: task success, trajectory and tool‑use correctness, and RAG faithfulness and grounding, so you know whether failures come from retrieval, reasoning, or generation.

• Measure what gates shipping: relevance, faithfulness, latency, cost, and reliability across repeated runs, turned into quality gates the team ships against.

Collaborate and grow the team

• Collaborate and mentor: work with the AI Team Lead, Chief Architect, senior developers, and product teams to translate business needs into working, well‑tested solutions, and support more junior engineers as the team grows.

What we’re looking for

You bring a strong technical foundation, hands‑on depth with modern AI tooling, and the judgement to design systems that hold up in the real world. You don’t need deep expertise in every area below, but we do expect real depth in agentic systems and AI architecture, backed by a solid grasp of how to evaluate what you build.

Required

• A master’s degree in computer science or a similar field, preferably with an AI focus.

• 5+ years building software, with significant hands‑on work applying Large Language Models.

• Strong proficiency in a statically typed, object‑oriented language, Java or C# (we build in Java). Python is welcome for demos, evaluation tooling, and experiments, but it is not our production language.

• Deep experience designing, building, and operating agent‑based systems, with hands‑on use of one or more orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain/LangGraph, Microsoft Agents, Claude Agent SDK, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel).

• A track record of designing and building AI systems, including how the components fit together, scale, and are maintained over time.

• Solid, practical experience with prompt strategy, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and the cost considerations of LLM usage and model selection.

• Working knowledge of LLM and agent evaluation: eval sets, LLM‑as‑judge, and the metrics that distinguish a good system from a confident‑but‑wrong one (faithfulness, relevance, task success, latency, and cost).

• Experience designing AI or backend systems that fit into a larger production platform, collaborating with senior engineers and architects to align on a shared technical direction.

• Strong communication skills to explain and defend architectural trade‑offs to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Nice to have

• Experience building automated evaluation pipelines or CI gates for AI systems.

• Familiarity with observability and tracing tooling for LLM applications (e.g. LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, Braintrust).

• Familiarity with LLM evaluation, automation, and red teaming.

• Broader machine learning experience.

• Hands‑on experience building and integrating MCP servers.

• Experience working in regulated or high‑reliability domains such as finance, insurance, or healthcare.

Who you are

You are a confident, hands‑on engineer who takes ownership of complex and sometimes undefined problems, and who is just as comfortable designing a system as proving it holds up. You think in systems, balance pragmatism with quality, and care about building things that work in production rather than just in a demo. You lift the people around you, stay open to feedback, and bring strong technical judgement of your own. You are curious, persistent, and result‑oriented.

jobs.occupation: PhD stipend in thermal modeling and advanced solutions for high-power modules and magnetic components
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend is available within the general study programme in Electrical and Electronic Engineering. The stipend is open for appointment from 1 December 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years and the position is full-time.

Your work tasks
The position is offered in relation to the GreenMag project, and you will be positioned in the Section of Power Electronics Systems and Materials within the research programme Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification (SPELL) at AAU Energy, Aalborg University. You will be based at the Aalborg campus in a highly international research environment with close collaboration with academic and industrial partners in the field of power electronics and energy systems.

The increasing electrification of transport, industry and renewable energy systems is driving the development of high-power-density power converters operating at megawatt levels. Advanced planar magnetic components are emerging as a key technology for achieving higher power density, manufacturability and integration in such converters. However, thermal management remains one of the major challenges that limit the performance, reliability and scalability of planar magnetic solutions, especially at high power and high frequency.

In this PhD project, you will work on the development of innovative thermal management technologies for megawatt planar magnetics used in future electrification systems. Your research will combine advanced modelling, experimental validation and prototype development to improve heat dissipation and thermal reliability while maintaining the required electrical and magnetic performance. You will analyse thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in high-power planar magnetic components, design and evaluate cooling concepts and contribute to the integration of these solutions in realistic converter systems.

You will conduct cutting-edge research on thermal behaviour and heat transfer mechanisms in megawatt-class planar magnetic components and use this knowledge to propose and evaluate new design strategies. You will develop multiphysics simulation models using finite element modelling tools to investigate the thermal performance of planar magnetics and to study alternative cooling concepts and material choices. You will design, manufacture and experimentally validate novel thermal management solutions for planar magnetic structures, and you will explore advanced materials and cooling technologies that can be applied in megawatt-class magnetic components. As part of the GreenMag project, you will collaborate with academic and industrial partners, disseminate your research results through publications in international journals and conferences, and contribute to teaching and supervision activities within the department as part of the PhD education programme.

Your competencies 
You have a relevant educational background within Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, Energy Engineering or a closely related field, and you hold a Master’s degree that qualifies you for enrolment in the PhD programme. You are motivated to work at the interface between thermal science, electromagnetics and power electronics, and you are interested in both theoretical and experimental research.

You bring strong analytical skills and a structured approach to modelling and problem solving, and you are comfortable working with numerical tools for thermal and multiphysics analysis. Experience with thermal analysis, power electronics or magnetic component design will be considered an advantage, as will experience with finite element analysis tools such as COMSOL Multiphysics or ANSYS. It is beneficial if you have worked with experimental testing, prototype development or laboratory work in previous projects and if you are prepared to work with both simulation and hands-on experiments in this PhD.

As a person, you are curious and creative, and you are motivated by addressing challenging research questions in collaboration with others. You are able to work independently, take responsibility for your project and contribute actively to collaborative research activities across groups and institutions. Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as you will present your results in scientific publications, at international conferences and in meetings with project partners.

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges. Aalborg University is recognised internationally for excellence in power electronics and energy systems research, and AAU has been ranked among the leading universities in Europe within energy research. At AAU Energy, you will be part of a highly international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges associated with electrification and the green transition.

The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs approximately 300 staff members from a broad range of nationalities and disciplinary backgrounds, creating a vibrant international research environment with extensive opportunities for collaboration and professional growth. The department offers world-class laboratory and workshop facilities, and maintains close collaboration with industrial partners. As a PhD student, you will have access to advanced facilities for the design, manufacturing and testing of high-power magnetic components and power electronic systems, and you will be part of an active research community in Sustainable Power Electronics and Electrification.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
• Curriculum Vitae (CV)
• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
• Other relevant documents
The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Do you have any questions?     
If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Regional Sales Director – Oticon Export

At Oticon Export, we believe sustainable growth is built on strong partnerships, mutual trust, and a deep understanding of people and businesses.

Through our global network of partners, we help bring life-changing hearing care solutions to people around the world. Every market is different, with its own opportunities, challenges, and level of maturity. We see these differences as opportunities to learn, collaborate, and create sustainable growth together.

As Regional Sales Director (RSD), you will play a key role in developing partner relationships, accelerating business performance, and supporting long-term market development across a diverse portfolio of countries.

Working closely with distributors and colleagues across the Demant organization, you will help shape the future of hearing care while creating value for partners, customers, and the people who rely on our solutions.

We are looking for a relationship-oriented sales leader who understands that growth is achieved through people. Someone who can identify opportunities behind market dynamics and recognize the strengths, motivations, and potential of individuals and organizations.

The role

As Regional Sales Director, you will be responsible for driving commercial success across an assigned portfolio of partner markets. Working closely with each partner, you will develop market strategies, identify growth opportunities, and ensure the successful implementation of Oticon's commercial initiatives.

A key part of the role is building trusted relationships across all levels of partner organizations and acting as a bridge between partners and the expertise available throughout Demant and Oticon Export.

You will help partners strengthen their commercial capabilities, leadership practices, and overall business performance, while ensuring initiatives are tailored to local market realities and cultural contexts.

We are a team of approximately 20 colleagues within Export Sales and work closely alongside three highly experienced Regional Sales Directors.

The position is based at Demant Headquarters in Smørum, Denmark. While the role involves significant international travel, we also place great importance on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and spending meaningful time with colleagues at headquarters.

Key responsibilities

• Develop and execute regional business plans that deliver sustainable sales growth and market share expansion.

• Build strong, long-term partnerships with distributors based on trust, transparency, and shared objectives.

• Identify commercial opportunities and co-create growth strategies with partners.

• Support partners in strengthening organizational capabilities, leadership practices, and commercial excellence.

• Challenge and inspire partners to elevate performance while respecting local market realities and cultural differences.

• Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across Demant, including Oticon Export's functional experts, while building a strong network throughout the wider Demant Group.

• Share best practices across markets and foster a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.

• Act as a trusted ambassador of Oticon and the values that define our partnerships around the world.

Who you are

You bring curiosity, humility, and a long-term perspective to your work.

Building trust and creating meaningful connections come naturally to you, and you thrive in an international environment where relationships, cultural understanding, and collaboration are key to success.

You understand that every partner is unique. Rather than applying a one-size-fits-all approach, you adapt your style to different people, organizations, and situations. You know how to challenge constructively, support development, and help partners progress from where they are today to where they aspire to be tomorrow.

You combine strong commercial acumen with genuine interest in people, and you are motivated by helping others succeed with achieving sustainable business results.

Qualifications

• Highly experienced commercial leader with a strong international track record and the ability to engage, influence, and challenge senior executives within partner organizations.

• Experience working with distributors, indirect sales channels, or partner-led business models.

• Strong commercial mindset with a track record of delivering sustainable growth.

• Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

• Experience working across cultures and diverse international markets.

• Fluent in English; proficiency in French would be considered an advantage.

• Willingness and ability to travel internationally for more than 70 days per year.

Why join Oticon Export?

At Oticon Export, you will join a highly engaged international team committed to helping partners succeed and grow. We combine entrepreneurial thinking with the strength, expertise, and resources of the Demant Group.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to influence business performance across multiple international markets, collaborate with senior stakeholders, expand your global network, and contribute to bringing life-changing hearing care solutions to more people around the world.

Together, we create an environment where partners, customers, and colleagues thrive through strong partnerships, continuous development, and sustainable growth.

We look forward to welcoming you

Please submit your CV no later than November 12, 2026.

For questions about the position, please contact General Manager, Jakob Brøgger Kjærgaard at  jkbo@demant.com.

About Demant

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health and innovation since 1904. The Group offers innovative technologies, solutions and expertise to help people hear better. From hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment, services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged across the hearing healthcare industry. Headquartered in Denmark, the Group employs more than 21,000 people globally and is present with solutions in 130 countries, where we create life-changing hearing health solutions as well as high-end audio and video solutions. The William Demant Foundation holds the majority of shares in Demant A/S, which is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and is among the 25 most traded stocks.

Customer Support Agent – for students or candidates taking a sabbatical year

Are you good at explaining technical solutions in a simple way? Do you enjoy helping different types of people – and would you like to build valuable experience in customer service and IT?

Then you might be our new Customer Support Agent.

At BEC, you will help customers use digital solutions that are an important part of Denmark’s financial infrastructure. You do not need to know everything from day one. We will make sure you receive the training and support you need to become confident in supporting customers with online and mobile banking.

Your role

As a Customer Support Agent, you will be part of our Customer Service team and work closely with colleagues across BEC.

A typical workday will include:

• 
Supporting customers by phone and email

• 
Handling more than 60 customer enquiries during a busy day

• 
Guiding customers in the use of online and mobile banking

• 
Troubleshooting and explaining technical solutions in a clear and helpful way

• 
Sharing knowledge and contributing to a supportive team environment

The pace can be high, so it is important that you can stay focused, keep an overview and provide a good customer experience – also when several customers need your help.

Who are you?

You may be studying or taking a sabbatical year. Your educational background is less important than your motivation, curiosity and willingness to learn.

We imagine that you:

• 
Have a basic understanding of IT systems and apps

• 
Are curious about technology and enjoy learning new things

• 
Communicate fluently in Danish, both written and spoken

• 
Can communicate in English with colleagues across BEC

• 
Are patient and able to explain technical topics in an easy-to-understand way

• 
Take responsibility for your tasks and follow them through

• 
Enjoy working as part of a team and sharing knowledge with others

• 
Can stay positive and professional in a busy environment

Experience from customer service, support or a similar role is an advantage, but it is not a requirement.

Working hours and location

The position is based at BEC’s office at Havsteensvej 4 in Roskilde.

Most shifts are scheduled during daytime hours on weekdays. However, occasional evening and weekend shifts may occur, so some flexibility is important.

The number of working hours will be agreed individually and will depend on whether you are studying or taking a sabbatical year. This allows us to find a setup that works for both you and the team.

The role is primarily office-based, with the possibility of working from home in accordance with BEC’s current guidelines.

What you can expect from us

You will join a team of helpful and ambitious colleagues who enjoy technology, solving problems and supporting each other.

We offer:

• 
Thorough onboarding and training

• 
Hands-on experience with customer service and IT support

• 
A collaborative and informal work environment

• 
The opportunity to develop your communication and technical skills

• 
A flexible setup that can be adapted to your studies or sabbatical year

Ready to join us?

Send us your application and CV in Danish or English as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Manager Nadeem Nielsen at +45 42 12 40 10.

We look forward to hearing from you.

BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. In the transition phase, we are recruiting for roles that we expect to be highly needed in our future organization.

IT Business Analyst – Global IT

We are looking for an experienced and analytical IT Business Analyst to join our OneHearingCare program, a key initiative in Demant's global transformation journey. You will play an important role in translating business needs into scalable digital solutions and supporting the design and implementation of our next-generation CRM platform.

You will contribute throughout the full solution lifecycle, from requirements discovery and solution design to testing, training and deployment, helping create a standardized and future-ready platform for our global Hearing Care business.

Welcome to Hearing Care IT – Sales and Service Team

You will join Demant's global Hearing Care business as part of the OneHearingCare program, a strategic initiative focused on standardizing and modernizing our global operations through Microsoft Dynamics 365.

The program will deliver a unified CRM and ERP platform supporting more than 15,000 employees across hearing care clinics and business units worldwide. Our ambition is to create a scalable and future-ready solution that balances global standardization with local legal requirements and unique business needs.

Working alongside Business Analysts, Product Owners, Developers and global and local business representatives, you will help bridge the gap between business and technology, ensuring that requirements are translated into effective, sustainable solutions aligned with the program's strategic objectives.

Furthermore, if you are motivated to take on additional responsibility, there are opportunities to learn about other IT disciplines, such as configuration management, allowing you to broaden your skillset and develop towards a more functional IT role.

Turn Business Needs into Scalable Solutions

Joining us, you will be a trusted member of the program, helping stakeholders understand, challenge and translate business needs into clear requirements and effective solutions. Below, you will find the responsibilities in this role:

• Gather and translate business requirements, working with stakeholders and Product Owners to define solution requirements, features, user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Facilitate stakeholder collaboration, leading workshops and discussions to establish a shared understanding of business objectives, priorities and requirements.

• Analyze and map business processes, create process maps, user journeys, workflow diagrams and functional specifications to support solution design and process optimization.

• Support solution development, collaborating with developers and technical specialists to clarify requirements, facilitate knowledge transfer and ensure alignment with business expectations.

• Contribute to testing and quality assurance, participating in functional testing, integration testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure solutions meet business needs.

• Support implementation and adoption, contributing to change management through training materials, user guides and train-the-trainer activities.

• Drive continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to optimize business processes through technology while balancing global standards with local requirements.

The role includes approximately 20–30 days of travel per year, typically together with other project team members.

What You Bring

You probably already have some experience as an IT Business Analyst, preferably from a large-scale business transformation or system implementation. You understand how to gather, analyze and document business requirements and translate them into clear, actionable specifications that support effective solution delivery.

You have experience working with CRM solutions, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE) or similar platforms or CRM systems such as Salesforce. Furthermore, understanding how system integrations and how enterprise applications interact across a technology landscape will also be valuable. Experience with customer-facing processes in retail or healthcare environments is also considered an advantage.

As a colleague, you are analytical, structured and collaborative. You are comfortable facilitating workshops, engaging stakeholders at different organizational levels and navigating business needs. You can communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences and build working relationships across functions and geographies.

Furthermore, you have good documentation skills and attention to detail, combined with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset. You take ownership of your work, value knowledge sharing and you are motivated by finding practical ways to improve processes and create business value through technology.

Finally, your written and verbal communication skills in English are at a high level, and you thrive in an international, cross-functional environment.

Come and Join Us

This is an opportunity to take an active role in a major global transformation and help shape the future of Demant's Hearing Care operations.

You will work with skilled colleagues and stakeholders across business and IT, gaining exposure to complex business challenges and modern Microsoft technologies. Your contribution will help deliver solutions that support thousands of employees and improve experience for customers across our global Hearing Care business.

At Demant, our purpose is clear: We create life-changing differences through hearing health. You will join a global organization that combines technological innovation with a meaningful purpose, supported by a collaborative culture built on trust, respect and shared success.

Our modern headquarters are located in Smørum, just outside Copenhagen, and we offer opportunities for professional development and career growth.

If you enjoy connecting business and technology, solving complex challenges and contributing to solutions with global impact, we would like to hear from you.

Send your application before the deadline: November 15, 2026.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information about the position, please contact:

Dina Bjørn Andersen

Head of Customer Engagement, Hearing Care IT

dibj@demant.com

We are curious to meet you.

Recruitment Process Information

We will begin inviting candidates for interviews after the application deadline. First round of interviews are scheduled for the 19th and 20th of November. You can expect the final round interviews to be held on the 26th and 27th of November. #LI-NB1 #LI-HYBRID

Demant is a world-leading hearing healthcare and technology group built on a heritage of care, health, and innovation since 1904. In every aspect, from hearing care, hearing aids and hearing implants to diagnostic equipment and services and audio solutions, Demant is active and engaged. Curious about a role where you can make a real difference to production planning? As our End-to-End Planner, you will connect Operations, Procurement and Commercial—turning complex supply challenges into clear plans and informed decisions.

The role

You will own operational and tactical planning for relevant production lines, help balancing production, purchasing, inventory and customer needs. You will also contribute to a stronger, globally consistent planning processes.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Managing the full planning horizon in SAP ePPDS, from operational to tactical levels, including placing purchase orders with suppliers

• Maintaining and acting on SAP exception reports daily, managing process orders and due dates, and addressing risks to order fulfillment and stock levels in the monthly S&OP process

• Planning specific production lines in Frederikssund while ensuring alignment with global operations. Develop and maintain production plans while keeping a global overview.

• Owning the monthly Sales & Operations (S&OP) supply reviews for your lines, presenting data-driven insights, imbalances and trade-off scenarios

• Optimizing inventory and safety-stock levels, and support continuous improvement of planning processes

After your first year, success will mean that production lines have clear plans for order volumes and start/end dates. Decision-makers can make aligned, fact-based decisions, and risks to order fulfilment or inventory are identified, escalated and addressed in time.

What you bring

We expect that you have some years of practical experience with integrated supply chain planning, ideally in process industry or a technology-service environment. You have obtained knowledge of the S&OP cycle and supply planning for finished goods and/or raw materials, probably in a production environment.

Strong proficiency in SAP ePPDS, APS solutions, Business Warehouse, Excel and PowerPoint.

As a person you have a structured, analytical approach, you pay attention to detail and have the ability to turn complex data into clear decision-making material. You succeed in your stakeholder management because of your strong communication and collaboration skills and the confidence to work across functions.

On the more formal side, you hold a relevant academic technical engineering, Supply Chain Management or Economics degree.

Fluency in written and spoken English, as well as Danish, is a prerequisite.

The role requires physic presence in Lyngby and Frederikssund.

Why join us

You will have a hands-on role with a broad view of the planning process—from daily operational decisions to tactical supply planning. Your analyses and recommendations will help balance production, purchasing, inventory and customer delivery needs.

**

**

• Basic knowledge of building management systems and CSA/MEP engineering (depending on which relevant engineering area is covered by a degree)

• Familiar with project and design management processes across multiple stakeholders, internal and external

• Fluent in English

• Proactive, self-driven, and adaptable mindset

• Willingness to travel across the Nordics, including outside regular business hours

**About The AtNorth Culture

**We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together. #99

jobs.occupation: GRC Specialist, Netcompany Group CISO Office
jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you want to help shape how a large IT company measures, manages and documents its information security? Are you motivated by turning data, risk and regulation into practical decisions? If so, you may be our next colleague in the newly established GRC team in Netcompany's Group CISO Office.

Responsibilities and technologies

As a member of the GRC team, you will help ensure that Netcompany has an accurate, data-driven view of the effectiveness of its security controls and its level of compliance. The team takes a pragmatic and technically grounded approach to governance, risk and compliance, and works closely with the Application Security team, the Operations organisation, Internal IT and other business functions across the group.

The GRC team is a small team of colleagues with complementary profiles. We do not expect any one candidate to cover every area described below. Instead, we are looking for broad profiles with solid experience across several of these areas and the motivation to develop within the rest.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Developing and maintaining risk scenarios, assessing the effectiveness of mitigating controls against the scenarios, and conducting risk assessments to support business decisions

• Establishing automated measurements and KPIs that provide insight into the implementation and effectiveness of security controls across the business

• Interpreting regulatory and contractual security requirements and translating these into Netcompany's security baselines and standard methodologies

• Planning and executing security awareness activities, including phishing simulations, targeted micro-learning, and onboarding/yearly awareness training

• Driving smaller security improvement projects from planning to implementation, combining coordination with hands-on execution

• Developing, maintaining and testing internal security processes, such as major incident response, crisis management and business continuityDeveloping, maintaining and testing internal security processes, such as major incident response, crisis management and business continuity

About you

You have broad experience within information security and a solid understanding of its technical aspects alongside a general understanding of the software development life cycle. You combine this with the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical solutions. Furthermore, you are pragmatic, take ownership of your work and prefer a hands-on approach.

To succeed in this role you:

• Hold a relevant degree or equivalent experience; within IT, engineering, computer science or a similar field.

• Strong analytic skills, with the ability to interpret data and draw meaningful conclusions independently.

• Experience within several of the areas listed in the overview of responsibilities in the role.

• Solid communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical teams, business functions, management and, on occasion, customers.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken).

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Partaking alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

We are looking for a motivated Fundraising & Project Development Intern to help Pangaea Youth Network develop new projects and secure funding for our local and international activities. You will have the opportunity to work on real funding applications and contribute directly to the growth and development of a youth NGO.

LocationHorsensHorsens, Denmark/Hybrid

DurationFlexible, adjustable

TypeInternship

Description

Position Overview:

This is a hands-on internship where you will work closely with our management and project team to identify funding opportunities, develop fundraising strategies, create new project ideas, and prepare grant applications.

You will help turn ideas into real projects by researching funding programmes, developing project concepts, planning activities, preparing budgets, and writing applications for funding.

Our main focus is on Erasmus+ projects, Danish foundations, municipal funding opportunities, and international programmes supporting youth work, education, inclusion, community development, sustainability, and international cooperation.

Responsibilities:

• 
Fundraising Strategy: Research and develop fundraising strategies for PYN, identify potential funding sources, analyse funding requirements, and help create a long-term fundraising plan for the organisation.

• 
Funding Research: Identify relevant grants and funding opportunities from Erasmus+, Danish foundations, municipalities, EU programmes, and international funding organisations. Monitor application deadlines, eligibility requirements, funding priorities, and available budgets.

• 
Project Development: Help develop new local and international project ideas based on PYN’s mission, community needs, and funding opportunities. Contribute to defining project objectives, target groups, activities, expected results, and long-term impact.

• 
Grant Writing: Prepare and write funding applications, including project descriptions, needs analysis, objectives, activities, methodology, expected outcomes, sustainability plans, and dissemination strategies.

• 
Project Budgets: Support the preparation of project budgets, financial plans, funding requests, and cost estimates in cooperation with the management and accounting team.

• 
Partnership Development: Research potential local and international project partners, foundations, sponsors, and organisations. Support communication with stakeholders and help develop partnerships for future funding applications.

• 
Project Planning: Help create project timelines, work plans, activity schedules, responsibilities, and implementation strategies for proposed projects.

• 
Funding Database: Maintain an organised overview of funding opportunities, application deadlines, eligibility criteria, application progress, submitted proposals, and funding results.

• 
Organisational Development: Contribute ideas for improving PYN’s financial sustainability, expanding its activities, and developing new services or initiatives that could attract additional funding.

Skills & Qualifications:

We are looking for someone who is interested in fundraising, project management, international cooperation, and NGO development. And has:

• 
Good written English (preferably B2 or higher)

• 
Strong research and analytical skills

• 
Good organisational skills

• 
Attention to details

• 
Creativity

• 
The ability to work independently

You should feel comfortable using Google Docs, Google Sheets, or similar digital tools and be interested in developing and writing structured project proposals.

Nice to have:

Previous experience with Erasmus+, grant writing, fundraising, project management, budgeting, research, or NGO work. Familiarity with EU funding programmes, Danish foundations, or project application processes is an advantage but not required.

Personal qualities:

We appreciate people who are proactive, curious, responsible, detail-oriented, and motivated to learn. You should enjoy developing ideas, researching opportunities, solving problems, and turning concepts into practical project proposals.

Relevant study backgrounds:

Project Management, International Relations, Business Administration, Economics, Public Administration, Political Science, Social Sciences, European Studies, Nonprofit Management, or related fields. Students from other backgrounds are also welcome to apply.

Working Style & Environment:

Our office and youth space are located in Student Village Kamtjatka, in the city centre of Horsens, Denmark.

A hybrid working setup is possible, but we prefer interns who can be present on-site for teamwork, project development meetings, and organisational activities.

Typical office hours are around 9:00:00–16:30, Monday–Friday, with the remaining working hours arranged according to the internship agreement and team needs.

You will join a small, international team working across project management, fundraising, marketing, community events, accounting, web development, and youth work.

You will work closely with PYN’s management and receive guidance on project development, funding research, and grant writing. At the same time, you will have opportunities to take responsibility for your own research, project concepts, and application drafts.

Practical Fundraising Experience: Learn how NGOs identify funding opportunities, approach funders, develop fundraising strategies, and prepare grant applications.

• 
Real Project Development Experience: Participate in developing actual local and international projects, from the initial idea to a complete funding application.

• 
Erasmus+ Knowledge: Gain practical insight into European funding programmes, international partnerships, project planning, grant writing, and the management of EU-funded initiatives.

• 
Professional Development: Improve your research, analytical thinking, project design, budgeting, strategic planning, professional writing, and stakeholder communication skills.

• 
International Working Environment: Become part of a supportive international community and collaborate with young people, interns, volunteers, and partners from different countries.

Networking Opportunities: Build connections with NGOs, foundations, international organisations, local stakeholders, and potential project partners.

We offer practical professional experience, supervision, an international working environment, networking opportunities, access to relevant Erasmus+ activities, and opportunities to contribute to real projects with a positive social impact.

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Integration of High-Temperature Heat Pumps in Industrial Processes - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
Do you want your research to help industry decide how to electrify its heat supply? At DTU Construct you will combine thermodynamics, optimisation and machine learning to build tools that make the business case for industrial high-temperature heat pumps clear, fast and reliable.

We invite applications for a fully funded PhD position in the Thermal Energy Section of the Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at the Technical University of Denmark. The position is part of HeatMinds, a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network funded by Horizon Europe. HeatMinds brings together 6 universities and research institutes and 12 industrial and research partners across Europe to develop industrial high-temperature heat pumps that upgrade low-grade waste heat to up to about 250 °C.

Your project will address decision making support for heat pump end-users from a first viability check to integration with the process, to flexible operation. You will demonstrate the findings in industrial use cases together with our partners.

Supervision: Prof. Ahmad Arabkoohsar and Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your overall goal will be, through adequate methodological advancements, to cuts the time and effort needed to assess where and how high-temperature heat pumps should be integrated into industrial sites, and what is their economic value. Your main task will be:

• Develop models to rapidly estimate performance and break-even point for specific sites
• Extent methods for heat pump integration that co-optimize heat recovery, electrification and flexibility provided by heat pumps
• Refine and validate methods during industrial secondments 
• Publish in international journals, present at conferences and take part in HeatMinds network training, summer schools and outreach.
 
You have:

• A solid background in engineering thermodynamics, heat transfer and energy technologies, e.g. conversion or storage systems 
• Familiarity with modelling and numerical simulations, for example for MSc thesis or student projects 
• Programming skills, preferably in Python, Matlab, Modelica or similar 
• Excellent written and spoken English, and the motivation to work in an international, goal-oriented environment.
 
MSCA eligibility: at the time of recruitment, you must not already hold a doctoral degree. You must also not have resided or carried out your main activities (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before your recruitment date.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The PhD salary will be based on the Marie S. Curie compensation scheme conditions and according to the grant agreement. Based on seniority the candidate will receive a minimum of DKK 30.264,08 (base salary) and DKK 1580,90 (PhD supplement). In addition, DTU will also pay pension consisting of 18,07%. Finally, it is possible to apply for family allowance. 

The period of employment is 3 years. The position is a full-time position. Starting date is anticipated as 1 April 2027 or according to mutual agreement. 

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information 
Further information may be obtained from Professor Ahmad Arabkoohsar ahmar@dtu.dk and Professor Adriano Sciacovelli adrsc@dtu.dk.

You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk. 

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 24 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A copy of thesis (if available) or other publications (if available)
• A short critical literature review (max. 3 pages) on integration of high-temperature heat in industrial processes: select up to 5 relevant publications and explain your choice, compare their methods & findings, identify possible open research questions, explaining how your background would help you address them. Include at least one figure or table of your own making. 
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.
