• Have extensive, hands on experience providing trading driven market research and recommendations within power markets, gained in a trading house, power utility, bank, hedge fund or equivalent trading environment

• Have a proven track record of supporting hedging and proprietary trading decisions, with demonstrated impact on positioning and results

• Have deep understanding of European power market fundamentals and their interaction with forwards, options, and curve dynamics

• Have strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to form clear, well reasoned market views under uncertainty

• Have the ability to communicate complex analysis into decisive, trader ready recommendations

• Have a Master’s degree in economics, finance, energy, engineering or a related quantitative field or a Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA®) designation.

**It would be great if you also have:

**

• Experience with North-Western European power markets specifically

• Familiarity with fundamental power market stack modelling concepts

• Experience mentoring or coaching junior analysts

• A passion for continuous improvement, innovation, and knowledge sharing

• Proficiency in Python and experience with statistical analysis and time series analysis.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr60,000.00- kr90,000.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Are you organised, proactive and great at keeping things running smoothly? Do you enjoy coordinating tasks, solving problems and putting your French language skills to use? Then you could be the perfect addition to our customer service team.

We are looking for an enthusiastic French-speaking Customer Supporter who thrives in a busy environment and enjoys a varied working day. Your main responsibilities will include:

• Processing orders and returns, and coordinating shipments to the French and Italian markets

• Keeping installers and dealers updated on important delivery information

• Handling enquiries from dealers, installers and agents by phone and email

• Supporting our external sales team

• Managing after-sales enquiries and cases

In this role, you'll be juggling multiple tasks and deadlines, often working across different departments. That's why we're looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys finding solutions and isn't afraid to reach out to colleagues when needed.

And don't worry – you won't be doing it alone! You'll be part of a supportive team that's always happy to help. Bring your curiosity, enthusiasm and willingness to learn, and we'll help you with the rest.

Do you fit this profile?

You're a natural problem-solver with a strong understanding of systems and processes, a service-minded approach and plenty of drive. Your educational background is not crucial, but your personal profile is. Therefore, it is a prerequisite that you:

• Speak and write fluent French (perhaps it's even your native language?)

• Have basic written and spoken English skills, as English is our corporate language

• Have experience of working with different systems (you may already be familiar with Microsoft CRM or BC365)

• Understands customers' needs and knows how to adapt their communication to different situations

It would also be a bonus if you:

• Have experience with EDI

• Speak and write Italian

Good to know

The position is full-time and requires on-site attendance, with working hours from 8-16 Monday to Thursday and 8-15.30 on Fridays.

Ready to join us?

Send your CV and a short, tailored application to HR@aduro.dk, with "Customer Supporter – French” in the subject line. Tell us why you are a good fit for the position and what motivates you to apply for the job.

We're looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, but we're happy to wait for the right person. Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, so don't wait too long to apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact our Customer Service Manager, Helle Kammer Riis, on +45 60 11 05 71.

About Aduro

At Aduro, we develop, manufacture and market wood-burning stoves, pellet stoves, hybrid stoves and bioethanol fireplaces, all combining innovative technology with modern Danish design. Today, we're proud to be among Europe's five largest wood-burning stove manufacturers, exporting 90% of our production.

Innovation is at the heart of what we do. Several of our products are patented, and we're constantly working to develop new solutions that push the boundaries of our industry.

Sollten wir Ihr neuer Arbeitsplatz sein?

At Aduro, you'll join a growing, dynamic company with a strong entrepreneurial spirit. We believe in sharing ideas, taking responsibility and helping each other succeed. Our working environment is informal and collaborative, with plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

We're proud of what we've achieved along the way. We've received the prestigious Gazelle Award seven times, recognising our strong growth. In 2024, we were also finalists for EY's Entrepreneur of the Year award and won the SME Inspiration Award in the Internationalisation category for our international outlook.

At our headquarters, you'll become part of an international team representing seven different nationalities. Different cultures and perspectives come together in an energetic workplace where ambition, teamwork and a good sense of humour go hand in hand. We offer modern facilities, social activities, a company lunch scheme and opportunities to develop your skills and take on new challenges.

Great code is only half the job

Cadpeople is hiring a frontend developer in Aarhus who writes solid code, understands the client, designs the system, and makes it feel right.

For 30 years, we've made the complex simple for companies like Vestas, Ørsted, Grundfos, Novo Nordisk and Fred. Olsen. We do it with 3D, XR, digital training simulators, virtual campuses, and digital learning, all built on our in-house frameworks.

The craft is changing too. AI tools already have a big impact on how we develop, and we're on a journey to strengthen our AI coding capabilities. But AI only pays off in the hands of developers with real knowledge and experience. That's why we look for systems thinking, client dialogue, and close collaboration with our creatives, as much as we do code.

What you'll do

You'll build bespoke applications for large enterprise clients, from the first workshop to the live solution. Typical work:

• Turn client needs into systems. Join client meetings and workshops, ask the right questions, and shape the solution before anyone writes code.

• Think across frameworks. Combine our in-house building blocks (Vue.js and Three.js frontends, Digital simulators, Umbraco headless CMS, .NET microservices on Azure, and Electron for offline use) into the right architecture for each case.

• Use what we've already built. Draw on experience from delivered projects to show the client what's possible, and to avoid building the same thing twice.

• Help shape how we build with AI. Use AI tools in your daily work, and help us strengthen our AI coding capabilities as we go.

• Work closely with creatives. Art directors, 3D artists, learning specialists, and project managers are your daily team. You make their ideas run in the browser, on a kiosk, or in a headset.

• Strengthen the foundation. Improve the frameworks on which every future project stands.

Who you are

We don't expect you to know it all. But you'll recognise yourself in most of this:

• You have at least 3 years of experience as a frontend developer, with solid JavaScript/TypeScript and Vue.js skills.

• You think in systems, not just screens: APIs, data, hosting, security and how it all fits together.

• You use AI coding tools fluently, and you still understand, review, and own every line that ships.

• You can explain technical choices to a client who isn't technical, in English. Danish is a plus.

• You care about how things look and feel, and you enjoy working with designers and 3D artists.

• You think big. A request for "an e-learning module" makes you wonder whether it should be a simulator, a virtual campus, or an AI coach.

• It's a plus if you know Three.js, WebGL, Umbraco, Node.js, .NET, Azure, CI/CD and security by design (OWASP Top 10).

Your education matters less than your curiosity and how well you work with others.

What you get

• Work that matters. Train wind turbine technicians, onboard energy workers, and help industrial companies explain products that change the world, often with a sustainability angle.

• Big clients, small team. Enterprise-scale projects with the speed and closeness of a 50-person agency in Aarhus and Edinburgh.

• A global parent with reach. Cadpeople is part of RelyOn, a global safety and training provider with more than 50 facilities worldwide. That gives us stability, new clients, and the chance to see your work train people in safety-critical jobs around the world.

• A head start on every project. Our own tested frameworks mean you start from a solid foundation, not a blank page.

• A say in what comes next. We're building up our AI coding capabilities, and this role can help shape how we get there.

• A creative workplace. An office in the heart of Aarhus, surrounded by people who make 3D, film, XR and learning. See our culture.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short application. A classic application is welcome, as long as it sounds like you. Generic AI-written applications will not be prioritised.

Want to stand out? You can add something small that shows your character and how you'd fit in at Cadpeople. It's optional, and it doesn't need to be big or complex. For example:

• A story about a time you turned a vague client need into something that worked.

• A short video, even filmed on your phone, about something you built or care about.

• A skill or tool, like a small AI agent, workflow or utility you made to work smarter.

• A thought on one of our cases: what you'd have done differently, or how you'd take it further.

Our office language is Danish, and we use English with many of our clients. You don't need to be fluent in Danish, but it helps if you understand it.

Questions about the role? Contact Nikolaj Have, CTO, at nikolaj.have@cadpeople.dk.

Start as soon as possible, or by agreement. All applications are treated confidentially, and submitted material is deleted after 6 months in line with GDPR.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**We are looking for an FP&A Specialist to strengthen our Corporate FP&A team and take ownership of cash flow forecasting, balance sheet planning, working capital management, and other key planning activities below Adjusted EBITDA across the Group.

Reporting directly to the Head of FP&A, you will play a key role in advancing our financial planning capabilities and driving transparency across cash flow, liquidity, and balance sheet performance. You will work closely with Accounting, Tax, Controlling, regional Finance teams, and key business stakeholders to ensure robust planning processes and high-quality management reporting.

This is a unique opportunity to:

• Take ownership of the Group's cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital planning agenda, helping to improve cash generation and support management decision-making.

• Shape and develop our Workday Adaptive Planning capabilities, leading key initiatives to establish scalable planning models and reporting structures.

• Work across markets and functions, partnering with regional Finance teams and senior stakeholders to strengthen forecasting, reporting, and business insight throughout the organization.

The successful candidate will help establish best-in-class planning processes that connect P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow forecasting, providing management with greater visibility into liquidity, working capital performance, and long-term value creation. The role is a full-time role and reports to the Head of Group Financial Planning & Analysis.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own the Group's cash flow planning across forecast, budget, and long-range planning cycles.

• Drive the development of balance sheet forecasting capabilities and ensure alignment between P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow planning.

• Lead the implementation and continuous development of cash flow and balance sheet planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning.

• Define business requirements and partner closely with the BI Team to improve planning processes, reporting capabilities, and system functionality.

• Partner with Accounting, Controlling, Tax, and regional Finance teams to strengthen cash flow and balance sheet reporting, improve forecast accuracy, and establish clear ownership across planning activities.

• Develop and maintain monthly cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital reporting, including variance analysis, key risks and opportunities, and actionable management insights.

• Establish and maintain a clear RACI framework across Finance for balance sheet and cash flow planning, forecasting, and follow-up activities.

• Develop driver-based forecasting methodologies for key working capital metrics, including inventory, receivables, payables, and other material balance sheet accounts.

• Monitor working capital performance and identify opportunities to improve cash conversion and optimize working capital.

• Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Controlling to strengthen understanding of working capital drivers and improve forecast accuracy.

• Support Executive Management and Board reporting by providing insights on cash generation, liquidity, working capital performance, and financial risks and opportunities.

• Drive continuous improvement of forecasting methodologies, planning processes, and financial transparency across the organization.

• Support the ongoing development of FP&A capabilities by integrating balance sheet and cash flow considerations into strategic and long-range planning processes.

**WHO YOU ARE

**You are a curious and analytical finance professional with a passion for turning data into insights and helping the business make better decisions. You enjoy working across functions, building strong stakeholder relationships, and taking ownership of complex planning processes.

You thrive in a dynamic and growing environment and are comfortable navigating between operational details and the bigger picture. You enjoy driving improvements, challenging assumptions, and creating structure where it is needed.

You are comfortable working across Finance functions and partnering with regional Finance teams to improve forecasting, strengthen financial transparency, and drive continuous improvement. Most importantly, you are proactive, structured, and motivated by creating impact through high-quality financial planning and analysis.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 5+ years of experience within FP&A, Financial Controlling, Corporate Finance, or a similar role.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.

• Experience working with cash flow forecasting, working capital, balance sheet analysis, or investment planning.

• Solid financial modelling and analytical skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.

• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning or other EPM/planning tools is an advantage.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• A proactive mindset and a passion for improving processes, systems, and ways of working.

• Experience from retail, hospitality, food & beverage, consumer goods, or other multi-site businesses is considered a plus.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

**Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

****ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Campaign Design - Store Creative
jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly creative and experienced Campaign Design Manager to join our Campaign Creative team in Copenhagen.

In this role, you will transform global campaign ideas into immersive and engaging retail experiences. From windows and in-store creative to activations, installations and pop-ups, you will shape how campaigns come to life across the physical customer journey, ensuring every touchpoint feels connected, inspiring and unmistakably on brand.

You will combine strategic creative thinking with hands-on leadership, guiding projects from concept to implementation-ready toolkits while collaborating with cross-functional teams, external partners and creative specialists.

What you will do

Drive retail campaign experiences

• 
Translate global campaigns and brand direction into compelling retail concepts.

• 
Create cohesive experiences across windows, stores, activations, installations and pop-ups.

• 
Develop concepts that balance creativity, customer engagement and commercial impact.

• 
Explore new formats, materials and creative collaborations that elevate brand storytelling.

• 
Ensure solutions are scalable globally while remaining flexible for local markets.

Lead global campaign toolkits

• 
Develop and define creative direction for global retail campaign toolkits.

• 
Create clear, inspiring guidance that supports local adaptation and execution.

• 
Partner closely with key stakeholders to ensure creative intent is maintained from concept through implementation.

Lead and develop creative talent

• 
Inspire, coach and develop a multidisciplinary creative team.

• 
Guide concept development and provide constructive creative feedback.

• 
Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation and high creative standards.

Partner across the business

• 
Collaborate with Communications, Operations, Product Design and other key functions to deliver cohesive campaign experiences.

• 
Present concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders.

• 
Work with external agencies, artists and production partners to bring ideas to life.

Deliver from concept to execution

• 
Lead projects through concept development, prototyping and production handover.

• 
Balance creative ambition with timelines, budgets and operational realities.

• 
Manage multiple campaign workstreams while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

Who you are

You are a creative leader with a passion for physical retail and experiential design. You understand how to turn campaign ideas into engaging customer experiences and are equally comfortable defining the big-picture vision and refining the details that make execution exceptional.

You thrive in a global environment, build strong relationships across diverse stakeholder groups and know how to bring people together around a shared creative direction.

We imagine you bring

• 
Significant experience, typically gained over 8+ years, in retail design, visual merchandising, spatial design, experiential design, or a related creative discipline.

• 
Experience creating retail experiences for premium, fashion, jewellery, lifestyle or other design-led brands.

• 
A strong portfolio demonstrating both conceptual thinking and executed work.

• 
Experience translating campaign or brand ideas into physical retail environments.

• 
Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.

• 
Experience leading or mentoring creative teams.

• 
Knowledge of the end-to-end process from concept through production and implementation.

• 
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and related creative tools.

• 
Professional fluency in English.

What will make you stand out

A portfolio that demonstrates how you have transformed ideas into compelling physical experiences, connecting storytelling, product, space and customer interaction.

We're looking for someone who can combine creative vision, leadership and execution, bringing bold ideas to life at a global scale.

About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

You will join a global brand known for combining creativity, craftsmanship and innovation, helping shape inspiring customer experiences that connect people with the stories behind our jewellery. As part of Pandora's Campaign Creative team, you will have the opportunity to influence how our campaigns come to life in stores around the world, creating meaningful moments for millions of customers every day.

It’s an exciting time to join Tactile. We're a diverse team of storytellers, puzzle enthusiasts, and casual mobile game creators. Our story began in 2008 in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, and since then, we have experienced continuous growth, establishing ourselves as one of the largest gaming companies in Denmark. In more recent years, we have been scaling fast, in large part thanks to the success of a little game called Lily’s Garden. Now we’re on a mission to solidify our position as one of the leaders in creating out-of-the-ordinary casual puzzle games.

With more than 350 talented individuals, we are a mix of over 50 nationalities and 43% women. We truly appreciate the richness of different experiences and perspectives that Tactilers bring to the game. This is why we foster a lean organisational culture, in which each individual is encouraged to take responsibility, be open, and grow in their own way. We pride ourselves on cultivating a studio environment that avoids crunch, fosters your skills regardless of your discipline, and provides a space for you to be creative alongside other passionate and invested storytellers.

🚀 Your role & impact:

We're currently growing our Core team and are on the lookout for another Product Designer to join our team of talented engineers.

The Core team builds the internal tools behind Tactile own LiveOps, Marketing and Data operations, the backbone of our studio. We're looking for a second Product Designer to join Joy and our engineers in designing business-critical tools that every team at Tactile depends on.

This role is based in our Copenhagen office.

How we design:

• Our tools are data-heavy: dashboards, large tables, complex filters, multi-step workflows. Static mockups can't show how they behave with real data, so we prototype first, in code. We use Claude Code and agentic workflows to build working prototypes, and those prototypes are what we hand off to developers. Figma is still where we sketch and brainstorm

• AI amplifies our design. It doesn't do design for us. It lets us take on complex workflows that used to get skipped because they took too much effort

• Quality is not up for debate. We know what good looks like, and we don't ship slop

• Our product design philosophies are inspired by Vercel, Linear and GitHub

This is roughly how we work today. It isn't strict, and we're open to what you bring. Here's a talk that captures our thinking.

Okay, let’s get a little bit more specific. Here’s what you’ll be doing on the day-to-day:

• Research, design and prototype interfaces for our internal tools, then hand working prototypes off to developers

• Work with your team who use our tools to simplify their workflows

• Use AI to explore, iterate and prototype efficiently, while you stay responsible for every design decision and not outsource creative thinking.

• Evolve and contribute to our design system and processes

• We don't have a big UX team, and that's on purpose. You'll work every day with Product Managers, Frontend and Backend engineers, Artists, Game Programmers. We believe good products come from working across disciplines, so we care about the end product, not design operations

What we’re looking for:

• Hands-on experience with technical B2B products: dashboards, tables, filters, dense interfaces

• You care more about the end product than about design process, and you thrive working across disciplines

• Comfortable contributing directly to projects via PRs to improve designs or UX without waiting for programmers to implement them

• Experience in designing with Claude Code or similar agentic tools

• Real openness to agentic workflows, without an "AI produces slop" mindset

• Comfort prototyping in code, or a strong drive to learn

• A sharp eye for high design craft, quality, and candour when something isn't good enough

You'll make us extra excited if you also have:

• Experience in using Figma/Figma Make or similar design tools

• Programmer background, comfortable diving into fronted code if necessary

• Know-how of shadcn, Untitled UI or similar SaaS UI libraries

What’s in it for you?

🌆 Beautiful office space with probably the best view in Copenhagen

🩺 Pension and private health insurance

💻 A chance to work with the latest tools and technology

📚 Opportunities for individual growth with development talks as well as workshops, books and courses

🌮 Daily, healthy organic breakfast and lunch prepared by our professional chefs in-house

🥳 Social activities, including game nights, book club, Friday bar and more

🔍 Free Danish lessons with our in-house Danish teacher

Our interview process

Submit your application via the fill-in form at the top of this page. This is the easiest and fastest way to get in touch with our recruiters. We foster an inclusive culture and accessible workplace and want to make sure we provide everyone with the same opportunities for success. This is why we encourage you to apply regardless of your gender, sexuality, age, nationality, neurodiversity or disability. We review applications based on competencies and experience, so please do tell us about your favorite projects and technologies.

After we review your application, you can expect to go through the following conversations:

☕ Introductory coffee chat, primarily to ensure that we’re aligned on the scope of the role and that all of your questions are answered.

🧪 In person technical interview (mix of design whiteboarding and designing with AI) with Joy, your future product design colleague, and Gab, Core Team Lead.

💜 The final conversation will be with your future team, to discuss if you’re aligned on values and ways of working.

We are thorough in our hiring process, as it's essential to us that we select new Tactilers carefully - just as it is vital to ensure that we are the right place for you.

We want to ensure you have a great candidate experience whilst in our recruitment process. We will do everything within reason to ensure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please let us know.

We look forward to receiving your application! 👋

jobs.occupation: Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS, Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for colleagues to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

You will be working in an enthusiastic Process Automation team with more than 80 colleagues in Denmark. Globally, the Process Automation team has more than 200 employees.

The Process Automation team works with consultancy, design & development, implementation and validation of Automation solutions for the Pharma and Biotech industries. Our work is project based, and currently we are looking into an exciting pipeline of large data driven, greenfield plants with modular/scalable designs.

We are skilled in a broad range of process areas within API production e.g. fermentation, recovery and purification, utility, and cleaning systems. And the solutions we provide to our customers are always based on a deep understanding of the customers’ production processes – and if standard components can’t do the job, we develop our own.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Senior Process Automation Engineer, you’ll be:

• Advising customers on their application process solutions

• Design developing, programming, commissioning, qualifying, FAT, SAT, UAT and Handover of applications for Distributed Control Systems (DCS)

• Interacting with process experts and colleagues with expertise in surrounding systems and equipment like MES, Historian systems, instruments, production equipment etc.

• Developing and optimizing automation methods and strategies to meet our customers’ needs and sharing working knowledge with colleagues and partners

• Forming the basis of automation strategies and architectures to support our sister departments internationally and expand NNE’s Process Automation engagement

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Understand your colleagues’ individual and cultural difference

• Are aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Are agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Are team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Are reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Are appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You have 6+ years or more of working experience and hold a degree as an engineer, ideally within electrical, automation, process or marine engineering

• You have 4 years or more of working experience with PCS/DCS Application development (for example ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine), working in GMP/GAMP environment or with execution of Automation projects

• Knowledge of batch production is valued

• You find the complexity of the GMP/GAMP environment exciting

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 13th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Christian Ljørring on +45 30 79 29 08 or Manager Rasmus Sølbeck Hansen +45 31 91 89 30

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

The position is based in Roskilde or Warsaw at BEC Financial Technologies' headquarters. The position is organizationally anchored in Service Integration & Security with reference to the Head of Projects & Continuity.

The Service Integration & Security area is responsible for ensuring robust, reliable, and compliant operations across BEC. We work closely with stakeholders across the organization to strengthen operational resilience, including business continuity, IT disaster recovery, crisis management, and risk governance.

As Business Continuity Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring that BEC can continue critical operations during and after disruptive incidents. You will drive the development, implementation, and maintenance of BEC’s continuity framework and collaborate across all domains, programs, and areas.

At BEC, we prefer to collaborate often in the office, while also offering the opportunity to work remotely on average up to 1 day per week.

Primary tasks and responsibilities include:

Continuity & resilience framework:

• Implementing and maintaining BEC’s business continuity management framework

• Maintaining governance for continuity-related processes (Business Continuity, IT Disaster Recovery, Crisis Management, Business Impact Analysis, IT redundancy, Backup & Restore)

• Developing and maintaining Business Continuity Plans (BCPs), Disaster Recovery Plans (DRPs), and Crisis Management Plans

• Defining and maintaining technical requirements for backup and restore processes, including backup scope, retention, encryption, immutability, recovery procedures, and restore validation

• Translating business impact and recovery objectives into technical IT disaster recovery requirements, dependencies, and recovery sequencing

• Defining and assessing redundancy requirements for critical infrastructure, applications, data, and third-party services, including identification of single points of failure and failover capabilities

• Ensuring compliance with relevant standards and regulations (e.g., ISO 22301)

Coordination & stakeholder engagement:

• Coordinating with stakeholders across 1st line, IT, and support functions to assess risks and define recovery strategies

• Collaborating with system owners, SMEs, and process owners to ensure alignment between business and IT recovery capabilities

Testing, exercises & continuous improvement:

• Facilitating continuity, IT disaster recovery, and crisis exercises (e.g., table-top tests and simulations)

• Planning and evaluating technical recovery tests, including backup restore tests, component and service failover, and end-to-end disaster recovery exercises

• Ensuring lessons learned from incidents and exercises are incorporated into the framework

• Driving continuous improvement of continuity capabilities.

Governance, reporting & insight:

• Delivering reporting and presentations on continuity readiness, and performance

• Supporting management with insights into operational resilience, and recovery capabilities

To succeed you will have:

• Experience working with business continuity, IT disaster recovery, or operational resilience

• Knowledge of continuity frameworks, BIA, BCP, DRP, and Crisis Management practices

• Solid technical understanding of enterprise backup and restore processes, including backup architecture, retention, replication, encryption, immutability, recovery validation, and common failure scenarios

• Experience reviewing or developing technical IT disaster recovery plans, including recovery architectures, system dependencies, recovery sequencing, and alignment with RTO and RPO targets

• Ability to assess redundancy and resilience designs across infrastructure, networks, applications, databases, and cloud services, and to identify single points of failure

• Capability to challenge technical solutions and document clear, testable recovery, backup, restore, and redundancy requirements in collaboration with architects, engineers, system owners, and service providers

• Experience facilitating workshops, or cross-organizational processes

• Stakeholder management skills and can collaborate across technical and business domains

• Structure, analytical skills, and ability to translate complex risks into clear actions

• A proactive approach and capability of driving initiatives across the organization

• Ability to communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken

It’s nice-to-have:

• Experience with enterprise backup platforms, storage technologies, high-availability solutions, infrastructure, or cloud recovery patterns

• Experience from the financial sector or a regulated IT environment

• Familiarity with IT Service Management processes

The role will offer:

• A key role in strengthening BEC’s operational resilience and continuity capabilities

• High visibility across the organization and interaction with senior stakeholders

• The opportunity to shape and evolve BEC’s continuity practices

• A collaborative environment with strong professional expertise

• A role with tangible impact on BEC’s ability to operate under disruption

R30528 Senior Group Financial Controller with consolidation focus, GN

Do you want to make your financial knowledge count? Imagine a possibility where you will be responsible for financial excellence by supporting and further developing the finance function in a global organization.

The team you will be part of

As a Senior Group Financial Controller at GN, you will join Group Finance and take a central role in ensuring accurate, timely and high-quality consolidated financial reporting.

Working closely with local finance teams, Group controllers and external auditors, you will drive the consolidation process while helping to simplify, standardise and strengthen the Group’s closing and reporting set-up.

Your contribution is appreciated and your responsibilities will include:

Consolidation, closing and Group reporting

You will own and drive the monthly, quarterly and annual Group consolidation process, ensuring a robust, efficient and well-documented close.

You will:

• Lead and coordinate the Group consolidation process, from entity reporting to consolidated reporting

• Review reporting from Group entities and perform consolidation entries, including intercompany eliminations, foreign currency translation and other Group adjustments.

• Support the preparation of the consolidated financial statements

• Act as a on of the key point of contact for subsidiaries during the closing process, providing guidance on reporting and consolidation matters

• Support the transition of selected consolidation and reporting activities from external providers to an in-house Group Finance set-up

Process optimisation and reporting development

A key part of the role is to make the closing and reporting process faster, simpler and more reliable.

You will:

• Identify and drive improvements to closing, consolidation and reporting processes, including automation and standardisation opportunities

• Develop and maintain reporting packages in the consolidation system and process documentation

• Support the development and maintenance of consolidation and reporting systems and act as a key user where relevant

Financial controlling and collaboration

In close collaboration with other Group controllers, you will support the review and quality assurance of financial reporting from subsidiaries.

You will:

• Review and challenge selected financial information reported by subsidiaries

• Follow up on reporting issues, unusual developments and data-quality matters

• Contribute to the continued development of controls, governance and documentation within the Group reporting process

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

jobs.occupation: Følsgaard is looking for a Customer Relations & Order Manager – MarineTech
jobs.description:
Do you build the kind of customer relationships where trust makes the difference?

At MarineTech, we are looking for a Customer Relations & Order Manager who will take responsibility for a small portfolio of key customers and ensure an excellent customer experience from agreement to delivery.

This is not a traditional sales role focused on hunting for new business. Your success will come from knowing your customers, understanding their needs and business, and building strong, long-term relationships based on trust, reliability and professional advice.

Your role

You will be the customer’s primary point of contact and trusted advisor, working closely with colleagues, suppliers and partners to make sure everything comes together.

You will combine customer relationship management with hands-on responsibility for orders, forecasts and deliveries. This means staying close to your customers, anticipating their needs and ensuring that commitments are followed through.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Build, maintain and develop strong relationships with existing customers

• Act as the customer’s primary contact and advise on products, solutions and delivery options

• Manage orders from A to Z, including requirements, prices, terms, documentation and delivery

• Follow up on customer forecasts and coordinate internally to support material and delivery planning

• Coordinate closely with customers, suppliers and internal teams

• Proactively keep customers informed about quotations, orders, deliveries and deviations

• Maintain accurate customer, order and activity data in ERP and CRM

• Identify opportunities to further develop existing customer accounts

• Look forward to 10–15 travel days per year as an opportunity to meet customers, build stronger relationships and get closer to their business.

You probably have experience from B2B customer management, order coordination, sales or customer service. More importantly, you enjoy building relationships and creating a customer experience where people know they can rely on you.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience working with B2B customers and coordinating orders or deliveries

• Have a good commercial understanding and an interest in technical products and solutions

• Are comfortable working with ERP and CRM systems and structured follow-up

• Ideally have experience coordinating with suppliers, carriers and complex deliveries

• Communicate professionally in both Danish and English

As a person

You are outgoing and approachable and naturally create good relationships with customers and colleagues. You are service-minded without losing sight of the commercial perspective.

At the same time, you are structured and proactive. You take ownership, keep an overview when several things are happening at once, and make sure agreements and commitments are followed through to completion.

Why this role?

You will get a role where relationships matter. Rather than constantly chasing the next customer, you will have the opportunity to understand a smaller number of important customers in depth and become a trusted partner in their day-to-day business.

You will be close to both customers and the internal organization, giving you a central role in turning customer needs into reliable solutions and deliveries.

Interested?

If you want to help develop the specialized container and maritime transport industry – while developing yourself professionally and personally – then we look forward to hearing from you.

Send your application and CV as soon as possible. Interviews are held continuously and we will hire once we find the right candidate.

If you have questions, feel free to contact HR Manager Louise Buur at +45 21 20 44 67.

**About Hans Følsgaard (**Hans Følsgaard A/S)

Hans Følsgaard A/S is a global technology company with roots in engineering and a clear ambition to support the green transition through intelligent, reliable solutions. Since 1922, we have provided specialised technology expertise to industry, and our team of more than 120 employees is based across locations in Denmark, Norway, Germany, India and China.

Collaboration, accountability and integrity are at the heart of how we work. We operate with flat organisational structures, take a long-term perspective and value curiosity, professional expertise and initiative.

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for Sales Operations Specialist to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we are around 450 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Sales Operations Specialist who wants to make a difference.

The Role

As a Sales Operations Specialist, you will support the sales organization and other parts of Truesec through sales administration and the coordination of sales-related processes. The role is central to ensuring that our sales operations run smoothly, efficiently, and in line with internal processes, policies, and business requirements.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with a variety of functions across the organization, including Sales, Finance, Legal, Expert Services, and Managed Services. You will play an important part in driving structure, quality, and efficiency throughout our business and customer-facing processes.

As the first Sales Operations Specialist in Denmark, you will have a unique opportunity to shape and develop the role locally while being part of an established team based in Stockholm and Malmö. The role includes occasional travel to our Swedish offices to support collaboration and team development.

Examples of responsibilities:

• 
Create and administer offers, agreements, and digital signing.

• 
Manage deal registrations, incoming communication, and administrative follow-up.

• 
Set up and administer projects in Visma.

• 
Support Finance with data and processes to ensure accurate and efficient invoicing.

• 
Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to ensure smooth and quality-assured sales processes.

Your Potential Background

We believe you are structured, detail-oriented, and service-minded, with a strong ability to combine administration, coordination, and business understanding. You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy creating structure, driving initiatives forward, and ensuring that every detail is handled with care and accuracy.

You are comfortable managing multiple priorities simultaneously, have a strong attention to detail, and communicate clearly and effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.

We believe you have:

• 
Experience from a similar role within Sales Operations, sales support, administration, or business coordination.

• 
Strong organizational skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple workflows simultaneously.

• 
The ability to analyze information and translate insights into documentation, reports, and recommendations that support decision-making and follow-up.

• 
Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

It is an advantage if you have:

• 
Experience working with Visma, Jira, or similar finance or administration systems.

• 
Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Finance, and Legal teams in business-critical processes.

• 
A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and business needs.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish citizenship, citizenship in an EU country, or a Danish work permit.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you’ll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company – and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

jobs.occupation: Student assistants for Digital Archives and Methods, spring 2027
jobs.description:
Introduction to Digital Archives and Methods is a moderately computationally intensive standalone course in History BA.

This course is scheduled on Tuesdays 8 -12 and Thursdays 10 - 14 in weeks 6 - 20. The bulk of assistance is needed in Weeks 6 - 15 in a minimum of 4 hr intervals. Each class is attended by circa 50-60 students who work in groups to complete digital tasks. The course is in-person.

We are looking for 2 teaching student assistants who can support the learners in this course through troubleshooting, assistance and conceptual guidance on the main tasks and themes of the course.

The tasks of the assistants are to provide in-class/remote assistance (in class-time):

· setup:

• assist with local software installations or online instantiations of Voyant, Transkribus, UCloud, R, OpenRefine, etc.

• access to course sources and computational environments

· operation:

• help students operate the tools introduced in the course and

• guide students in the pursuit of course tasks. Help interpret tool outputs during the conceptual work towards assessments.

• Act as student liaisons, translating student needs into technical questions for the instructors.

Selected candidates should show initiative, be digitally savvy and enthusiastic as well as reliable and well-organized. The work requires independence, flexibility, and attention to detail. Furthermore, the candidate should have good interpersonal skills.

The ideal candidate's application should demonstrate the following qualifications:

• Good command of English and Danish, both oral and written

• Familiarity with the course materials as well as the digital tools introduced: previous attendance of Digital Archives and Methods or equivalent is recommended.

• Experience with troubleshooting code and a knack for digital problem-solving

• Proactive, motivated and enthusiastic attitude

• Ability to communicate effectively with students and fellow assistants, as well as liaise with instructors.

Please contact Kathrine Juul Svejstrup kjs@cas.au.dk for more information about the positions.

Applications should address how the applicant fits the qualifications listed above, be written in English and accompanied by a brief CV. Please indicate your availability in class time in weeks 6 to 15 and state which operating systems you are comfortable troubleshooting.

A prerequisite for employment is that the applicant is an actively enrolled student. Employment is subject to the availability of the necessary funding.

Applicants will be notified of the outcome of their application within four weeks of the application deadline.

Terms of Employment

Employment is in accordance with the Ministry of Finance and SUL Finansministeriet og SUL (student instructors).

The application must include a copy of your diploma and any documentation of previous teaching experience.

jobs.description:

The Head of Medical Affairs International Markets will serve as a therapeutic and disease area expert who is responsible for the Medical Affairs strategy development and structured, consistent and strategically aligned medical engagement across International Markets. International Markets in ALK covers all territories outside Europe and North America. The primary focus is Asia, Middle East and Latin America. The International Markets team is small and diverse with people sitting all over the world and currently covering 12 different native languages. You will be reporting directly to SVP International Markets, Morten Essendrop.

Your Primary Tasks Will Be

Medical Strategy Development

• Responsible for the Medical Affairs strategy and plan for International Markets, leveraging learnings and best practices from Region Europe and Region US Medical Affairs.

• Ensure consistency between strategies, communication and messaging within ALK and across partners allowing for local adaption.

• Support partners with medical expertise and education on ALK products.

• Accountable for publication planning (including congress abstracts, poster presentations, manuscripts) working in close collaboration with local teams and Global Medical Affairs.

External Medical Representation

• Define stakeholder engagement strategies and develop professional relationships with thought leaders to ensure education and scientific communication on ALK products and therapeutic areas of interest. Lead scientific and external engagement strategy for International Markets.

• Represent ALK as medical expert and speaker at selected international congresses, advisory boards, partner meetings and scientific events within International Markets.

• Act as a senior medical ambassador for ALK in key International Markets.

• Strong knowledge of the immunology field, strong presentation skills and scientific expertise. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with allergy treatment including allergen specific immunotherapy.

• Knowledge of Medical Affairs standards and processes.

• Ability to develop Medical Affairs strategies and tactical plans.

• Build and interact with a network of allergy/immunology experts, partners and represent ALK in scientific and medical matters. Capable of conducting doctoral level discussions with key customers.

• Ability to collaborate with Global Medical Affairs, and Commercial Operations functions locally and globally. Working in a matrix environment.

Become a part of ALK

We provide an attractive working environment for individuals looking for both personal and professional development. ALK is a global pharmaceutical company specialised in allergy immunotherapy. Data is becoming one of the most important foundations for Blue Water’s future. As we continue our digital transformation through BlueCore and the implementation of SAP S/4HANA and CargoWise, we are building the capabilities needed to support future analytics, AI and smarter decision-making across the business. This is a rare opportunity to join at a stage where you can influence and shape the outcome.

As our new Data Architect, you will help shape how data flows across Blue Water. You will establish the principles, models and standards that enable data to be understood, trusted and used consistently across a global organisation. Your work will influence major business initiatives and help create the foundation for technologies and capabilities we have yet to introduce.

This is where you make a difference

You will join our Data Management team within Operational Excellence and work closely with Enterprise Architecture, IT, application teams and business stakeholders across the organisation.

One of your first priorities will be to create transparency across our data landscape. You will map key data domains, data flows, integrations and dependencies, helping us understand where we are today and what needs to evolve to support tomorrow’s business.

From there, you will play a central role in defining the target-state data architecture and building the roadmap to get there. This includes developing conceptual and logical data models, establishing architectural principles and guiding decisions around critical business data and system ownership.

You will also help shape the architecture behind our future Data Platform, ensuring we have the right foundations for metadata, lineage, data quality, security and governance. Along the way, you will review solution designs, challenge assumptions when needed and act as a trusted sparring partner for architects, project teams and business stakeholders. We value being close to key stakeholders and work in a hybrid setup, with around two to three days per week on site in Esbjerg.

Key responsibilities include:

• Defining and maintaining Blue Water’s enterprise data architecture, standards and modelling principles

• Supporting strategic transformation initiatives, including BlueCore, by ensuring alignment with agreed architectural principles

• Translating business requirements and data definitions into scalable and implementable data models

• Guiding internal teams and external partners on data-related architecture decisions

What you bring

You have experience working with data architecture, data modelling or solution design in complex enterprise environments. You understand that good architecture is not about drawing perfect diagrams. It is about creating practical solutions that balance business needs, technology realities and long-term sustainability. Essential skills:

• Experience with data architecture, data modelling or solution design across multiple systems or business domains

• Experience with cloud data platforms and integration architecture

• SAP S/4HANA experience, particularly around Business Partner data

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics to different audiences

• Professional proficiency in English

It is an advantage if you also have experience with:

• Data engineering, integration or enterprise architecture

• Master data management, metadata, lineage and data quality disciplines

• Event-driven, API-based and batch integration patterns

• CargoWise, logistics or transport-related operations

• Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake or similar technologies

• Advanced analytics, AI or relevant certifications such as TOGAF or DAMA

Why Blue Water

You will become part of a well-established Data Management team with strong professional capabilities across governance, master data, migration and quality.

What characterises the team is not only its expertise, but also its willingness to help each other succeed. We work closely together, challenge each other’s thinking and believe that the best solutions are created through collaboration across business and IT.

As part of the wider Operational Excellence organisation, you will work alongside colleagues specialising in process improvement, training and change management. Together, we are helping Blue Water build the capabilities needed for the future.

Interested?

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of data at Blue Water. If you are ready to make a real impact in a global organisation undergoing significant transformation, we would love to hear from you.

For questions about the role, please contact Kamil J. Karolak, Head of Data Management.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What we do – Together we create solutions

Blue Water Shipping is a global provider of all logistics services in modern supply chain management. Founded in Denmark in 1972, Blue Water is a global organisation of professionals, skilled in offering complete and tailor-made solutions to any shipping requirement anywhere in the world. jobs.description:
Are you motivated by ensuring full compliance in a complex and fast-evolving regulatory landscape? As our new Customs & Trade Compliance Professional, you'll play a key role in safeguarding STG's global trade flows and reducing customs-related risk. You'll work closely with Planning, Customs & Transportation, Procurement, and Finance to keep customs processes compliant, efficient, and well-documented.

What your day will look like

• Manage and follow up on import and export procedures to ensure compliant, timely customs flows

• Monitor and implement customs legislation changes and country-specific obligations

• Set up and oversee customs regimes such as EMCS (Excise Movement and Control System), IPR (Inward Processing Relief), and bonded warehouse processes

• Classify products and determine valuation and origin (HS – Harmonized System, ECS – Export Control System, FTA – Free Trade Agreement) for accurate declarations and duty management

• Support SAP-based customs processes as a basic user (training provided)

• Conduct regular risk assessments and manage customs claims, with proactive mitigation and clear documentation

Keystakeholders

Material Planning · Customs & Transportation · Procurement · Finance · Manufacturing · Tax/Legal · IT/Reporting · SST · Warehousing

What you'll bring

• Proven experience in customs & trade compliance, including hands-on work with import/export processes and customs regimes

• Strong attention to detail and accuracy in declarations and documentation

• Analytical ability to interpret and apply legislation

• Proactive, service-oriented mindset with strong stakeholder collaboration skills

• Danish language proficiency and valid Danish ID Card

• Working proficiency in English

Nice-to-have: Descartes software experience

• Advantage: experience with AEO (Authorised Economic Operator), UCC (Union Customs Code), CBAM (Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism), EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation), or customs audits

Working at STG & What to expect

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next.  At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact.

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from DKK 432,000–648,000 annually corresponding to the level of the position, expected experience and responsibilities.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Our recruitment process

Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against the key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you’ll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which may include the following steps:.

• Recruiter screening

• First round: interview with the Hiring Manager - 1 hour, technical depth

• PI assessment

• Second round: interview with a Senior Stakeholder – 30–45 min

Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Please be informed that this Direct Search is conducted exclusively by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. We do not accept applications from agencies, and we will not provide compensation for unsolicited CVs.

Identify opportunities for AI-enabled process optimisation.

Build strong partnerships across Operations, Data & Analytics, and Digital & Technology.

Experience within analytics, performance management, process improvement or operational excellence.

• 
Experience working across multiple operational functions, ideally within an international or global environment.

• 
The ability to influence stakeholders and establish alignment across teams and functions.

• 
An understanding of modern analytics, data governance and AI-enabled business capabilities.

• 
A bachelor’s degree within Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, Analytics, Data Management or a related discipline.

• 
Experience working with reporting and analytics platforms, together with strong Microsoft Office skills.

Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

You communicate complex topics clearly, make considered decisions and maintain momentum across different stakeholder groups. Most importantly, you bring a continuous-improvement mindset and a genuine interest in how data, technology and AI can contribute to better business processes

• Oversee compliance with Danish tonnage tax requirements, including calculations, documentation and relevant controls.

• Coordinate corporate tax, VAT and employment tax compliance and reporting across jurisdictions, ensuring timely filings and robust documentation.

• Advise on tax matters related to international employee mobility and contractor arrangements.

• Monitor relevant tax and regulatory developments, including OECD Pillar Two and environmental and emissions-related taxes, and assess their impact on Clipper.

• Act as Clipper’s internal tax expert and trusted sparring partner, advising management on tax implications of strategic and operational decisions.

What we are looking for

At Clipper, our employees shape our work environment, so bringing a positive attitude is essential.

• We imagine that you have a relevant educational background within finance, tax, business administration, law or similar, combined with solid experience in corporate and international tax.

• You have hands-on experience with tax governance and tax risk management, combined with strong knowledge of transfer pricing, cross-border taxation and international tax principles.

• You are comfortable working with external advisors while also challenging and validating tax positions when needed.

• You are structured and analytical, but also pragmatic and commercially minded.

• You enjoy taking ownership, working independently and turning complex tax matters into practical advice and solutions for the business.

• You communicate confidently across functions and levels of the organisation and are fluent in both Danish and English.

• Shipping experience, including knowledge of tonnage tax or other shipping-specific tax matters, is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Don’t meet every single requirement?

If you’re enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You could be the ideal candidate for this position, or for another opportunity with us.

What you will love about us

At Clipper, you will become part of a growing and professional work environment where we strive to be the best. We offer:

• The opportunity to build and shape an internal tax function

• Close collaboration with senior management and exposure to strategic decision-making

• A welcoming and inclusive work environment with a variety of socal, sports, and cultural events throughout the year

jobs.occupation: Better Nitrogen efficiency by improving Cow Resilience, Eating Dynamics, Breeding and Lifetime Efficiency
jobs.employer_name: Center for Kvantitativ Genetik og Genomforskning
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Quantitative Genetics and Genomics programme. The position is available from 1 March 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Better Nitrogen efficiency by improving Cow Resilience, Eating Dynamics, Breeding and Lifetime Efficiency

Research area and project description
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) holds a leading position in cattle breeding research, particularly in genetic studies on data generated by advanced phenotyping technologies such as the CFIT 3D camera system through industry collaboration with VikingGenetics. This state-of-the-art system enables large-scale, non-invasive measurement of feed intake, body weight, and milk production data in over 30,000 cows directly in their production environment. This PhD project will leverage this extensive phenotypic dataset generated by CFIT, in combination with feeding parameters and other phenotypes from the Danish Cattle Database, to develop genetic tools aimed at enhancing nitrogen efficiency, resilience, eating dynamics and feed efficiency. The goal is to develop novel genomic breeding values for nitrogen efficiency, while considering other important breeding goal traits (e.g., productivity, health, fertility) and other traits, such as resilience, eating dynamics and feed efficiency. The project will apply advanced statistical methods, artificial intelligence, and cutting-edge genetic models to support and enhance management and breeding decision-making by dairy farmers. This project offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the green transition in agriculture by breeding cows that are both more sustainable and economically viable for the future of Danish dairy farming. We encourage candidates finishing their MSc in summer 2027 also to apply.

Qualifications and specific competences
A relevant master’s degree (120 ECTS) in Animal Breeding
Experience with data handling softwares (e.g., R, SAS, Python, Unix Shell) and genetic softwares (e.g., DMU, BLUPF90, AIREML).
Background in working with Livestock data is an advantage.
The ability to speak and write English fluently is a prerequisite for the applicant.
Can speak and write English fluently is a prerequisite.

Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics, C.F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C., Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Associate Professor Bingjie Li, e-mail: bingjie.li@qgg.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Tenure Track Assistant Professor Rasmus Bak Stephansen, e-mail: rasmus.stephansen@qgg.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk 
How to apply
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 29 November 2026 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 March 2027.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Please note:
• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.
• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.

jobs.description:
Copenhagen Business School invites applications for two vacant 3-year Postdoc positions in Leadership Studies, both based on a broad understanding of leadership as studies of both governance, organising and management. One Postdoc position will be affiliated with Department of Management, Society and Communication and the other with Department of Organisation. For more information about the two departments, please follow the links.

The two positions form part of CBS Executive Education’s Talent Programme (ETP). The ETP sets out to strengthen CBS’ leadership related research and education capacity within executive education and life-long learning. Expected starting date is 15 February 2027.

Examples of research areas that the Postdocs might cover:

• Leadership Studies with a particular focus on leadership practices and developments in the Nordic context
• Leadership Studies with a particular focus on life-long learning for working professions
The Postdoc positions are non-tenured positions, each for a three-year period with both research and teaching obligations.

To fulfill the research requirements of the positions, the applicants chosen are expected to be physically present on a regular basis and actively participate in the teaching and research activities of their respective Departments.

Qualifications
