**Your role

**You will assess how our distribution network performs today and identify how it can better balance cost, service, lead time, capacity and resilience. Turning network data and operational insights into a prioritized roadmap, you will work with colleagues and logistics partners to put agreed improvements into practice.

You will report to the Head of Global Distribution & Logistics. The role has no direct reports, so your impact will come through your analytical expertise, project leadership and ability to create alignment across functions.

You will collaborate closely with Distribution Leads, Global Planning, Regional Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain Compliance, Quality and the I2O Process Manager, as well as logistics service providers and carriers.

**What You Will Do

**Your responsibilities will cover three connected areas:

Optimize the distribution network

• Assess the current network and develop a prioritized optimization roadmap covering cost, service, lead time, capacity and risk.

• Analyse distribution lanes, shipment profiles, routes, transport modes and network flows to identify improvement opportunities.

• Build transparency on distribution costs and cost-to-serve to support informed decisions.

• Identify opportunities for shipment consolidation, routing improvements, changes in transport mode and network redesign.

• Lead or support the implementation of agreed changes, working with Distribution Leads to turn recurring operational issues into lasting improvements.

**Strengthen supplier strategy and performance

**

• Develop logistics supplier and carrier strategies in close collaboration with Procurement.

• Establish a supplier performance framework with clear KPIs, governance, performance reviews and improvement plans.

• Support logistics tenders, supplier selection and contract optimization.

• Work with suppliers, carriers and internal stakeholders to deliver measurable improvements in cost and service.

**Build Capabilities That Last

**

• Establish analytical tools, standards and governance that make network optimization an ongoing part of how we work.

• Support future digital ways of working, including the use of transportation management systems (TMS) to improve visibility and decision support.

• Build and transfer knowledge so that colleagues can sustain and develop the capability beyond the assignment.

**What Success Looks Like

**During the assignment, you will establish a clear network optimization roadmap and a prioritized set of improvement opportunities. You will provide better visibility of distribution costs, develop practical lane and routing recommendations, and put a supplier performance framework and strategy in place.

Success will also mean implementing changes that deliver tangible improvements in cost, service and network resilience—and leaving colleagues with the tools and knowledge to continue that work.

**What You Bring

**You have strong experience in logistics, transportation, distribution or supply chain network optimization. You understand both the commercial drivers of a distribution network and the operational realities of making changes work.

**We are looking for someone with:

**

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex data into practical business decisions.

• Experience in logistics sourcing, tenders, carrier management and supplier performance management.

• A strong commercial and cost mindset, with the ability to assess trade-offs across service, lead time, capacity and risk.

• Strong project and change management skills, including the ability to move improvements from analysis into implementation.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence across functions.

**How You Work

**You combine a strategic perspective with a practical approach. You are comfortable challenging existing arrangements but take the time to understand operational needs before recommending changes.

You create clarity around opportunities, priorities and expected benefits, and bring colleagues with you through implementation. You also share your knowledge openly, helping others take ownership of new tools and ways of working.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**This is an opportunity to deliver meaningful improvements within a defined assignment while shaping how global distribution develops over the longer term. You will influence network decisions, supplier strategies and the analytical capabilities that support reliable vaccine distribution.

At Bavarian Nordic, we work to improve and save lives through vaccines. Our culture values persistence, openness to change and collaboration. In this role, you can put those values into practice by solving complex distribution challenges and building improvements together with colleagues across the business.

**Caught your interest?

**If you are ready to take on a pivotal role in a growing organization and drive meaningful change in healthcare, apply now and join Bavarian Nordic in our mission to improve health outcomes and foster sustainable growth.

We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

_Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

_Bavarian Nordic is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applications will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

For more information, visit _www.bavarian-nordic.com

As a Senior Planning Specialist, Global Planning, you will play a key role in strengthening and continuously improving Ambu’s global planning capabilities. You will combine data, process expertise and stakeholder collaboration to turn planning information into actionable insights that support better decisions on cost, efficiency, service, and inventory performance.

You will help shape and improve our global planning processes by identifying opportunities, challenging existing ways of working, and translating best practices into scalable solutions. Working closely with stakeholders across Global Supply Chain, you will connect global standards and strategy with effective local execution.

This is more than an analytical role. You will act as a key driver of planning excellence, helping build best-in-class planning processes and enabling smarter, more efficient and resilient ways of working across our global operations.

**Key Responsibilities

****Your mission is to improve our global planning landscape through process excellence, data-driven insights and effective change implementation.

****More Specifically, Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• 
Process Excellence: Assess and continuously improve global planning processes, identifying opportunities to increase efficiency, standardization and scalability across regions.

• 
Change & Implementation: Lead and support implementation of new processes, tools and best practices, ensuring effective adoption and sustainable change across the orgnization.

• 
Stakeholder Partnership: Partner closely with stakeholders across Global Supply Chain to align local execution with global planning standards, processes, and strategic priorities.

• 
Data & Insights: Transform complex planning data into clear, actionable insights that support global decision-making and improve cost, service and operational performance.

• 
Performance Management: Develop, maintain and optimize KPIs, reporting and dashboards to monitor planning performance, identify bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• 
Have 5-7+ years of experience within supply chain planning, planning excellence, process improvement, supply chain analytics, S&OP/IBP, or related areas.

• 
Have solid experience driving process improvements, standardization initiatives, or transformation projects in a complex international supply chain environment.

• 
Are comfortable translating data and business needs into actionable insights, recommendations, and scalable solutions.

• 
Thrive in a stakeholder-facing role and have a proven ability to influence and drive change across functions, regions, and organizational levels.

• 
Combine a strategic mindset with a hands-on approach and enjoy turning ideas and opportunities into tangible improvements.

• 
Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering, Business, or a related field.

• 
Experience from MedTech or another complex, regulated industry is an advantage.

Above all, you bring curiosity, ownership, and a passion for continuous improvement. You are naturally proactive, challenge the status quo constructively, and enjoy collaborating with others to turn insights into tangible business improvements. You are equally comfortable working with detailed analyses and broader strategic initiatives, and you thrive in environments where you can make a visible impact on processes and performance.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms.

**Welcome to Generation CE

**You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions.

As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations

• translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes

• ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends

• overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives

• strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams

• promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience

• bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team

• understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry

• have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management

• can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions

• communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

The Impact You'll Make

At Danfoss Sensing Solutions, we develop advanced sensing technologies supporting applications across the Danfoss portfolio. Our work includes solutions for areas such as data centers, gas sensing, energy-efficient cooling, and environmental monitoring.

As our Development Engineer, you’ll help bring new sensing technologies and product concepts from idea to reality. Working alongside experienced engineers and technology specialists, you’ll contribute to developing products supporting our Data Center, Gas Sensing, and future technology programs.

You’ll have the opportunity to work across different areas of engineering, from mechanical design and prototyping to testing and integration with electronics and software. With a solid foundation in mechanical and electrical engineering and a curiosity to learn, you’ll build hands-on experience while contributing to meaningful product innovation from day one.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**You’ll work across a variety of development activities, gaining exposure to different engineering disciplines while helping bring new ideas and technologies to life.

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Supporting the development of new sensing products and technology platforms from concept generation through prototype development and testing

• Creating CAD models, drawings, fixtures, mechanical components, and development tooling to support new product designs

• Building, assembling, and evaluating prototypes, while collecting and analyzing test data to support engineering decisions

• Collaborating with engineers across mechanical, electronics, software, and systems disciplines to mature new concepts and solve technical challenges

• Contributing to design verification, technical investigations, and engineering documentation

As your experience grows, you’ll have the opportunity to develop your skills across product development and explore different technical disciplines based on your strengths and interests.

**What We're Looking For

**You don’t need to have experience in every area of the role. What matters most is a strong mechanical foundation, a practical mindset, and the curiosity and motivation to keep learning.

To be successful in this role, we would expect you to have:

• A BSc or MSc degree in Mechatronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline

• A solid understanding of mechanical engineering fundamentals

• Experience using CAD tools for design and engineering documentation

• Practical, hands-on engineering experience gained through work, university projects, internships, or personal projects

• Curiosity, initiative, and an interest in developing your skills across different engineering disciplines

It Would Be An Advantage If You Have Gained Exposure To One Or More Of The Following Through Work, Studies, Projects, Or Personal Interests

• Product development

• Prototyping and testing

• Electronics and sensors

• Software development

**What You'll Get From Us

**You’ll join an environment where collaboration, learning, and continuous development are part of how we work, with the opportunity to broaden your experience as you grow in the role.

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Senior Gameplay Programmer on WHAT THE CAR?

Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? What about having creative and technical ownership from ideation through to release? Read on!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to help us continue to build upon CAR’s success by expanding upon its absurdly silly universe! We believe the best people to come up with ideas are the ones implementing them, so we expect a high degree of creativity and game design knowledge from our Gameplay Programmers, in addition to their crazy tech skills. This role involves around 60% programming and 40% game design.

**Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

**

• Build and ship gameplay code. You’ll implement features end-to-end in an existing Unity/C# codebase and ship regularly in a live environment.

• Generate design ideas. You’ll take part in shaping features, articulate intent, evaluate tradeoffs, and iterate through discussion with the team.

• Keep the game healthy. Fix bugs, improve systems, review test videos, and document findings so issues don’t come back to haunt us.

• Extend and refine what’s there. You’ll build on existing mechanics, making them more robust and enjoyable for players.

• Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.

• Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

**You’re a great match if

**

• You have 8+ years of commercial game development experience, having shipped at least two games as part of a team

• You have strong Unity and C# skills. You’re comfortable navigating a shared codebase and writing maintainable code you’d be proud to hand off

• You care about stability, performance, and long-term maintainability, and you leave systems better than you found them

• You genuinely value collaboration and working very closely with every member of the team

• You approach other people’s ideas with openness and try to understand the intention before giving feedback or pushing back

**Nice to have

**

• Experience working on live games

**Requirements For Any Job At Triband

**

• You thrive in taking ownership - you spot problems, design and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture

• You value a positive work environment

• You contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place

**Practicalities

**

• Primarily work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen

• Only open to candidates who are already eligible to work in Denmark as we don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role

• 37-hour work week, with flexible work hours

• No crunch, we put people before deadlines

• Our working language is English

**We offer

**

• Silly but ambitious projects

• The chance to contribute to great games that reach millions of players

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights and team events

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of paid vacation

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked

• Pension plan and private health insurance

• Endless amounts of coffee

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

We're looking for an experienced cyber and information security consultant in the GRC domain who has hands-on experience building automation and/or agentic tools into their work.

**What You'll Do

**We're scaling our GRC services team, a team dedicated to making governance, risk, and compliance of cyber and information security more efficient, effective, and valuable to organisations. We do this by automating processes through software and agentic tools, and by defining tasks, inputs, and outputs more clearly than is currently the norm.

As our client list grows, we need someone who can deliver GRC consulting from day one and open up new paths to delivery by developing and implementing our own tools and automations.

This role is open to being shaped by your own passions and talents, whether that's software development, sales and marketing, or deep industry knowledge.

**In This Role, You'll Definitely Be

**

• Helping companies implement and comply with laws, standards, and frameworks like NIS 2, ISO 27001, and the CIS Controls

• Driving projects independently and managing senior stakeholders

• Influencing decisions on cyber and information security at some of Denmark's leading companies and public institutions

**Depending on your experience and interests, you may also be:

**

• Developing your own client networks

• Programming and deploying your own agentic software tools

• Performing technical cybersecurity tasks in client environments

• Building new services from the ground up, targeting industries or problems you understand uniquely well

**What You'll Bring

**You may be a great fit for this role if you have delivered GRC consulting for at least three years, ideally across several clients at once. On top of that, you should have:

• Automated GRC tasks with software and LLMs, refining the output until it beats human work in at least some aspects

• Driven the delivery of software products in collaboration with developers

• Gotten up to speed on new regulatory requirements under tight deadlines

• Fought the least valuable and most dull parts of GRC work while defending the value of good GRC against sceptics and cynics

The ideal candidate must be fluent in English – Danish is a plus, but not required – and we value a relevant master's degree or equivalent hands-on experience.

**To Fit In At The Tech Collective, You Should

**

• Thrive among diverse colleagues, from highly technical security professionals to energetic commercial profiles whose common language is a mix of humour, sarcasm, and passion

• Know how to break down and structure complex assignments, and enjoy sharing your knowledge with your team

• Bring a startup mentality that helps drive the innovation and ingenuity of our GRC services

This role is based in Copenhagen. We combine remote work with meaningful in-person work, and you should expect to be physically present at our office or with clients most of the time.

**What We Offer

**On top of a competitive salary and bonus package, we offer the chance to join a unique team of experts and enthusiasts in your field. Our expectations are matched by our willingness to invest in your development, whether through training, conferences, or the opportunity to pursue research in areas you're passionate about.

**How To Apply

**We review applications on an ongoing basis and encourage you to apply ASAP, as the role will close once filled.

Please submit your CV and a short motivation. If you've built tools, automations, or agentic workflows you're proud of, make sure to include a link or short description as we'd love to see them.

**For Questions, Reach Out To

**

• Niklas Rendboe — nire@thetechcollective.eu

• +45 27 14 55 56

• Úlfur Sonjuson — ulso@thetechcollective.eu

• +45 25 53 19 98

**About Us

**The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement Consulting Group. We're passionate about technology, and we have a genuine interest in people. We aim to make a positive difference in the consulting industry because we believe the ability to create change with impact and purpose is a prerequisite for success in a turbulent world. We're rapidly expanding our Cyber Tech Services team, and we're excited to meet people who want to build the future of GRC at the intersection of business and technology.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Consultant - Fund Administration & Accounting
jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values : caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As a Senior Business Consultant in Consulting, you will support our clients with best-practice market solutions and with services related to the use of SimCorp Dimension and beyond. You will work closely with local and global SimCorp teams, serving clients in their post-implementation phases. Drawing on your coordination skills and SimCorp Dimension expertise, you will collaborate with client and internal stakeholders on investment solutions, incident and problem management, and small changes or enhancements to current or future flows, all aimed at raising the level of automation and the end-user experience and satisfaction. Because the role is functional, Fund Administration & Accounting expertise is required. As part of your induction, you will work hands-on with our software and attend the three-week SimCorp Dimension® Academy, so you have steady support as you grow into the role.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Contribute to all aspects of SimCorp Dimension implementation projects.

• Advise on process improvements through better use of SimCorp Dimension, and help improve and document best practices for implementations.

• Map client needs to SimCorp Dimension functions and processes, and design and configure the setup.

• Lead the delivery of customised solutions with focus on Fund administration and Accounting.

• Assist clients in developing an overall test strategy and test plans, and support them in executing those plans.

• Drive the preparation and execution of test cases.

• Facilitate workshops to gather requirements for new and existing clients.

• Mentor, coach and enable colleagues to secure reliable project deliveries.

**What We Value

**

• Motivation to contribute and thrive in the position described above, which matters most.

• Proven skills in the areas below, however you gained them, as the route matters less than the capability.

• Investment accounting knowledge, some familiarity with any local GAAPS, IFRS9 would be an advantage

• Fund administration knowledge, including NAV calculation, Fund Structure and NAV Validation

• A strong background in effective consulting and project management.

• Demonstrated experience in software implementation projects.

• Enthusiasm for learning and using new software.

• A desire to act as a mentor and coach to less experienced colleagues.

• Good English, our corporate language, which is used in all communications.

• Knowledge of another European language is also appreciated. Danish is also an advantage

**Benefits

**SimCorp provides a range of benefits that may influence decisions regarding job offers. With operations in more than 30 offices globally, the benefits package can differ depending on the country. SimCorp implements a global hybrid work policy, requiring employees to be in the office two days per week and permitting remote work on other days. Additional information about location-specific benefits is available from the recruiter.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Launchpad user our Lead Talent Acquisition Partner. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp and you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above, but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway.

SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

We’re looking for a proactive and curious student worker to join our Public Affairs Europe team. This is a unique opportunity to step into a highly visible role where personality, initiative, and strong interpersonal skills matter just as much as experience. In this role, you will support political engagement across multiple European markets, stakeholder coordination, and the operational excellence that makes strategic work possible.

You will gain direct exposure to a leading oncology biotech’s European policy landscape, develop insight into pharmaceutical policy and political strategy, and experience the dynamics of multi-market stakeholder engagement. At the same time, you will build hands-on experience in vendor management, procurement processes, and contract administration.

We are a small and agile team in Europe, currently the only Public Affairs presence in the region, working closely with colleagues in the US and across markets. This role is ideal for someone who is a self-starter, confident in sharing ideas, and not afraid to speak up. You enjoy working with others, building relationships, and navigating different stakeholders with empathy and strong communication skills. We offer flexibility around exams and study schedules, and an inclusive, supportive team environment where you are encouraged to grow and contribute from day one. Intended start date: 1 / 15 May.

Help us get to know you by submitting a comprehensive application, including your CV and motivational letter!

Responsibilities

Public Affairs

• Helping the team stay on top of political developments and initiatives across Europe.

• Supporting contact with different stakeholders like governments, patient organisations, and health authorities.

• Assisting in organising meetings and roundtables with external partners across European markets.

• Helping prepare clear and simple summaries, briefings, and communication materials.

• Supporting the organisation of events and conferences.

Operations & Administration

• Assisting with setting up and managing suppliers (vendors)

• Helping out with day-to-day administrative tasks where needed

• Supporting budget tracking and keeping an overview of costs

Department: R&D

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**Factbird helps manufacturers turn real-time production data into decisions they can actually act on. Since 2016, we've helped manufacturers in 28 countries cut waste, boost uptime, and run smarter — from the shop floor to the boardroom. Over 300 companies trust us to make sense of their operations, and we're a team of 80+ people across Copenhagen and the US who care about making complex things simple.

We're creating a new role at the top of our Engineering career ladder: Lead Architect. It's the senior end of our Technical Track — the rung above Tech Lead — and today it's a role we've deliberately left lightly defined, because we want the first person in it to help define it. You'll set Factbird's technical direction: architecture, tooling, and the multi-year technology bets that shape where the product goes next.

This is our most senior technical role, with no direct reports — your authority comes from judgment and track record, not the org chart. You'll work alongside our Tech Leads in Factbird's technical leadership group, partner closely with our Director of Engineering, and be the person other senior engineers go to when a decision is genuinely hard to reverse.

**About the Role

**As Lead Architect, you own Factbird's company-wide technical vision: the architecture our services run on, the tooling and standards our engineers use every day, and the multi-year technology strategy that ties it all together. You make — or sign off on — the high-stakes, hard-to-reverse architecture calls, and you're accountable for getting them right with the full context of where the business is headed, not just where the code is today.

You'll work across a team built on Rust, React, Node.js, and AWS, with AI-assisted development already a core part of how we ship. Some of what this role owns is already well-defined — reviewing RFCs, stewarding language and platform standards, setting the team's AI-tooling strategy. Some of it isn't yet: Factbird is still a growing company, and part of the job is helping us figure out what technical leadership at this level should look like as we scale.

You'll thrive here if you'd rather be trusted with genuinely hard calls than manage a team, and if you can hold both the technical detail and the commercial context — cost, risk, market direction — well enough to make a technology bet you can still defend a year later.

**

What you'll do

**Architecture & technical strategy

• Own Factbird's multi-year technology strategy, and make the high-stakes architecture calls that are hard to reverse — with cost, risk, and business context factored in, not just engineering elegance

• Author and drive major RFCs from proposal through to an actual decision, and review the highest-risk architecture changes across the team

• Act as steward for our core languages and frameworks — setting standards, library choices, and the platform's overall shape

• Make build-vs-buy calls for new technical capabilities, and bring a clear point of view on emerging technologies worth adopting

• Define the observability, reliability, and security posture the platform is held to

**

Tooling & standards**

• Set the team's technical tooling and platform standards, and keep them evolving as the stack and the company grow

• Define Factbird's strategy for AI-assisted development — which tools we adopt, how we balance velocity against code quality, security, and IP risk, and where we draw the line

• Shape engineering-wide quality philosophy and help set the technical bar used in hiring interviews

• Help define shared components and reference architecture that other engineers build on, rather than reinvent

• Give input into technical org design and team topology as Engineering scales

**

Technical leadership & mentorship**

• Act as the trusted technical advisor to our Director of Engineering and the technical leadership group, partnering with Tech Leads and Product Leads on cross-team alignment

• Mentor senior engineers and Tech Leads toward architect-level thinking, without formal ownership of their people management

• Communicate technical vision and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including leadership

• Identify technical risks to the business early, and say so before they become expensive

• Represent Factbird's technical thinking externally where it makes sense — a talk, a blog post, an open-source contribution — though this isn't a requirement on day one

**What we’re looking for

**We're looking for someone who's already earned this kind of trust somewhere else — someone whose technical opinions carry weight because they're right more often than not, and who'd rather solve the interesting, ambiguous problem than manage the team solving it.

**

The ideal background**

• 8+ years of hands-on engineering experience, including real time spent as an architect or equivalent senior technical authority, not just a senior engineer with a bigger title

• A track record of owning multi-year technology strategy or platform architecture decisions that other teams had to live with — and that held up

• Has led major RFCs or architecture proposals cross-team, through genuine pushback, to an actual decision

• Comfortable making build-vs-buy and technology-adoption calls that account for cost, risk, and where the market is heading, not just what's technically interesting

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or Tech Leads toward architect-level thinking, without needing formal authority to do it

• Practical, current experience with AI-assisted development, and a clear point of view on where it genuinely helps versus where it creates risk

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

**

Here's what you can look forward to:**

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn't one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We'll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we'll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what's next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We're proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**

We'd love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we'd be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out to Cristina Vartej at **crva@factbird.com

Composite Process Engineer for FirePoint Rocket Technology – Denmark

FirePoint Rocket Technology (FPRT) is building one of the most unique and strategically important industrial projects in Denmark – a brand new production facility for solid rocket propellant and advanced defense-tech components. Our ambition is significant: we are scaling from the early operational phase to 300+ employees within the next 18 months.

By joining our team now, you will become part of the core team shaping a new high-tech, safety-critical production environment from the ground up. We are looking for a Composite Process Engineer who will ensure that our composite manufacturing processes are safe, stable, repeatable, and ready for serial production. You will report directly to our Senior Composite Process Technology Manager and collaborate closely with Production, Quality, Materials, HSE, and Maintenance.

Duties and Responsibilities

• Translate composite technology and material requirements into practical production parameters, SOPs, and work instructions.

• Own day-to-day process stability by monitoring variation, investigating deviations, and defining corrective actions.

• Prepare and verify process readiness prior to production runs, including equipment settings, tooling, and environmental requirements.

• Lead and support technical trials, pilot builds, process prove-outs, and qualification activities.

• Support the commissioning and validation of production equipment, tooling, ovens, curing systems, and machining equipment.

• Drive continuous process improvement to reduce variability, scrap, cycle times, and material loss.

• Manage technical change control for changes to process parameters, tooling, equipment, or manufacturing methods.

Qualifications and Competencies

Professional and Operational Skills

• Degree in Engineering (BSc or MSc) in Materials, Mechanical, Chemical, Manufacturing, Composite Engineering, or equivalent strong industrial experience.

• 3–5+ years of experience in composite manufacturing, process engineering, or materials engineering.

• Practical experience with fiber-reinforced composites and thermoset resin-based processes (epoxy experience is highly desirable).

• Hands-on experience with processes such as resin infusion/transfer, filament winding, lay-up, prepreg, molding, curing, or composite machining/finishing.

• Proven experience creating or improving SOPs, work instructions, and manufacturing standards.

• Background in industrialization, production ramp-up, technology transfer, or process stabilization.

• Professional English language skills are a requirement; Danish language skills are considered an advantage.

Personal Attributes

• A hands-on, highly structured, and solution-oriented approach to your tasks.

• Strong problem-solving skills with a mindset for root-cause analysis (e.g., FMEA, 5 Whys).

• Ability to work close to shop-floor operations and maintain a clear overview under ramp-up pressure.

The Ideal Candidate

We are seeking a proactive engineer who combines strong technical capabilities with a practical understanding of production. You thrive on being close to the shop floor, working with operators to ensure that process standards are practical, understood, and followed. You are motivated by establishing structure and stability in a dynamic Greenfield environment, and you maintain a clear perspective—even when working under tight deadlines in an accelerating growth phase.

Why Apply for This Position

At FPRT, you are offered a rare career opportunity to shape one of Denmark's most unique industrial and defense-tech projects. You will take on a central role with real impact, where your expertise directly determines the integrity and manufacturability of safety-critical products. We provide a professional, international environment with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a clear mission. Additionally, we offer top-of-market compensation and modern office facilities including an on-site gym and sauna.

Product Manager – Notifications | Help Dalux Users Focus on What Matters

Construction projects generate an enormous amount of information. Files change. Tasks are assigned. Deadlines approach. Comments are added. Reviews require action. Issues are reported. People are mentioned. Workflows progress. But more information does not necessarily make people better informed.

Dalux is looking for a Product Manager to take dedicated ownership of Notifications and help us answer a deceptively difficult product question:

How do we make sure users know what requires their attention – without overwhelming them with information?

Notifications exist throughout our products today, across email, mobile, and in-product experiences. As Dalux has grown, so has their complexity. We believe this area deserves dedicated product ownership and a coherent strategy across our products.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Notification Strategy: Define a coherent product direction for how Dalux communicates important events and required actions to users.

• Product Discovery: Understand when users need to be informed, when they need to take action, and when a notification simply creates unnecessary noise.

• Customer Insights: Research how different users manage information and attention across complex projects and busy working days.

• Cross-product Ownership: Map and improve notification experiences across Dalux products rather than optimizing individual notifications in isolation.

• Channels & Preferences: Develop experiences spanning in-app notifications, email, mobile push, notification preferences, subscriptions, following, mentions, reminders, and digests.

• Relevance & Prioritization: Explore grouping, prioritization, timing, and deduplication to ensure important information stands out.

• Actionability: Make notifications useful by ensuring users understand why they received them, what has changed, and what action they should take.

• Product Analytics: Use quantitative and qualitative insights to understand which notifications create value and which create noise.

• Shared Capabilities: Work with Development and other Product Managers to create common notification principles and platform capabilities that can be reused across Dalux.

About You

You probably don't currently have "Notifications Product Manager" as your job title – and that's perfectly fine.

We're looking for an experienced Product Manager who finds the underlying problem interesting and has the product and systems thinking required to solve it.

We believe you:

• Have strong Product Management experience, preferably from B2B SaaS, collaboration, productivity, workflow, communication, or similar software.

• Have excellent product discovery and UX instincts.

• Think systematically and can turn many individual use cases into coherent product concepts.

• Understand the tension between keeping users informed and creating notification fatigue.

• Are comfortable owning a horizontal capability spanning multiple products and development teams.

• Can combine user research with product analytics to understand behavior.

• Care about interaction details and understand how seemingly small product decisions can have a large cumulative impact on user experience.

• Can simplify complex systems involving events, recipients, relevance, timing, preferences, and communication channels.

• Communicate fluently in English, written and spoken.

Construction Technology Experience Is Welcome But Not Required .

Experience from collaboration, communication, workflow, or productivity software would be particularly relevant.

What To Expect At Dalux

At Dalux, you'll join a product-driven company where ideas quickly become reality and where you'll have a direct impact on the products we build.

We offer:

• A collaborative and informal work environment with flat hierarchies

• High ownership, trust, and the freedom to drive initiatives

• Talented and dedicated colleagues in an international team

• A central Copenhagen office, flexible work hours, and no dress code

• Monthly social events and an active community

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, and free parking

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

Ready for the next step?

We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so please submit your resume and application as soon as possible.

About Dalux

Founded in 2005, Dalux is a Danish Contech company revolutionizing the construction industry with innovative software built on geometric processing and 3D computer graphics.

Over the past years, we’ve grown by 40% annually and now have over 900 employees across 50+ offices in more than 25 countries. All product development takes place in our Østerbro, Copenhagen office, where we focus on building the future of construction technology. We place great value on our strong social community and close collaboration with colleagues, which is why we primarily work from our Copenhagen location.

Are you an experienced developer interested in building high-quality software and contributing to critical applications that support the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of the Nordic power grid? If you are looking to make an impact in supporting the green transition of the energy sector across Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark, you might be the person we are looking for.

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment, where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.

As part of our continued growth, Application Development is expanding significantly. We are strengthening our department with two Lead Developers and five Senior Developers, creating exciting opportunities to join a growing team and help shape the future of software development at Nordic RCC.

Your role

As a Lead Developer in Application Development, you will join a collaborative department of approximately 23 developers who design, develop and maintain the internal applications supporting our current and future business services. If you are curious about Nordic RCC and what we do, learn more about our innovative solutions on the Nordic RCC webpage.

Your role combines hands-on development with broader technical leadership. You will work closely with Application Architects to help define and communicate technical direction, translate architectural principles into practical solutions and promote consistency across our application landscape.

You will connect technical expertise across teams, identify shared challenges, and contribute to reusable, sustainable solutions. Through cross-departmental collaboration, you will build alignment around technical opportunities, constraints, and impacts across the organization.

What you will do :

• 
Design, develop, and maintain robust applications using C# and .NET, while promoting consistent standards, code quality, maintainability and operational stability

• 
Contribute to improving system architecture by identifying areas for technical refinement, refactoring, or modernization

• 
Collaborating across the organization, represent Application Development by collaborating with Product Owners, Delivery Management, testers, Quality Management and other departments

• 
Set and communicate technical direction with Application Architects, translating architectural principles and business needs into practical solutions and Architecture Decision Records

• 
Connect technical expertise across teams and applications, enabling collaboration on dependencies, common challenges and reusable solutions

• 
Support operational excellence by helping diagnose and resolve production issues and continuously optimize existing systems

• 
Share knowledge and technical expertise supporting colleagues’ professional development and help strengthen development practices across the team. This role does not include formal line-management responsibilities

Technology Stack:

• 
Primary languages and frameworks  C#, .NET, SolidJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Functional programming, Python

• 
Architecture, design patterns & integrations  Clean Architecture, SOLID, Event-driven Architecture, Message-driven Architecture, REST APIs

• 
Databases & storage Relational databases (SQL Server), NoSQL databases (MongoDB), GridFS, S3

• 
Infrastructure & Platform (on-prem)  Kubernetes (on-prem), Docker, Rancher, Prometheus/Grafana, ArgoCD, NginX

• 
Tooling and collaboration  Git, Visual Studio, VS Code, JetBrains Rider, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines

We’re looking for someone with:

• 
Collaborative Attitude: You will be working closely with our team of Application Architects, shaping architectural decisions for supporting maintainable, scalable and robust systems

• 
Technical Foundation: A degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field

• 
Proven Expertise: Minimum 5 years’ experience as full-stack developer in C# for the .NET platform. Experience providing technical guidance, facilitating technical decisions, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating development activities is a definite plus.

• 
Nice to have: Experience working with functional programming, Clean Architecture principles, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes and Scrum processes

• 
Energy Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with the power systems domain is a plus but not required

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

Job Description

How does Europe reap the benefits of AI, while remaining secure, sovereign and true to its democratic values? These are some of the questions that Netcompany Institute has set out to answer, and we are looking for two student assistants to help us do just that.

Netcompany Institute is a new analytical unit providing data-driven analyses of how AI and digitalization affect Europe. The aim is to strengthen the evidence base for public debate and help decision-makers navigate the choices that will shape Europe’s digital future.  You'll join a small team: a Chief Economist and two full-time Analytics Consultants.

Responsibilities

You will support analyses throughout their lifecycle – from framing questions to communicating results. Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Monitor policy developments and research on AI and digitalisation in Europe

• Collect and structure data from Eurostat, OECD and statistical offices

• Produce descriptive statistics, tables and charts publication-ready

• Write analytical text and fact-check sources

Responsibility grows with experience. At the beginning you will work closely with an Analytics Consultant on clearly defined tasks; over time we expect you to take ownership of analyses in your own right.

How we work with AI

AI tools are integral to our work. We use them for literature searches, data work and monitoring – so human time focuses on what matters most: finding the right questions, interpreting results and communicating them clearly. You don't need expertise at the start, but must be willing to learn and maintain high accuracy standards.

About you

We are looking for two students who can each work approximately 16 hours per week. We are flexible during exam periods, but availability is expected in the lead-up to publication deadlines and events. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are in the final year of your bachelor’s degree or have started a master’s degree in economics, political science, statistics, data science or a similar field.

• Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a must; Danish is an advantage.

• Are comfortable working with data: confident in Excel and ideally familiar with Python, R, Stata or a similar tool.

• Are curious about how AI and digitalisation are changing European economies and societies

• Are willing to learn to use AI tools effectively in your own work, and to keep relating output critically to prior knowledge and theory.

Continue developing with us

jobs.description:
Do you want to be a valued part of a global team that works passionately every day to ensure employees at DFDS go to work for DFDS and return safely and unharmed home to their loved ones? If this excites you then look no further and come join us.

About The Role  Be part of the movement - and play your part.   As Excellence & Engagement Manager in the Global Health, Safety & Security Team, you will be part of the continuous strengthening of DFDS’ health, safety and security culture. This is a new global role, and we expect you to participate in shaping and developing it. We anticipate that you will contribute by developing, implementing and continuously improving the frameworks, standards, tools, learning processes, communications and engagement activities that enable a strong Health, Safety & Security (HSS) performance across DFDS landside operations.

You will be responsible for ensuring consistent and effective deployment of group-wide HSS initiatives across DFDS operations area, supporting operational teams in anchoring safe and secure behaviors. The role works closely with the HSS Business Partners, other operational stakeholders and senior management to strengthen organizational learning, capability, culture and performance.

The role reports directly to the Global Director for HSS, and you will be based at our Global Headquarters in the port of Copenhagen. The role requires on-site presence.

What kind of exciting challenges can you expect to meet in this role?:  **Role

**As Excellence & Engagement Manager - HSS you will get the opportunity to influence and develop the role but the initial areas we expect you to cover are:

• Develop, coordinate and monitor global HSS initiatives.

• Develop, coordinate and maintain global HSS culture-building activities, campaigns and engagement programs aiming to strengthen safe and secure behaviors.

• Maintain and continuously improve our HSSEQ Management System.

• Develop, implement and continuously improve a Managers Toolkit on HSS.

• Manage Performance Monitoring and Improvement related to HSS in close collaboration with HSS Business Partners.

• Develop and coordinate DFDS’ organizational learning processes on HSS, ensuring learnings from incidents, audits etc. are translated into practical improvements and shared across the organization.

• Support leadership teams in understanding and applying HSS frameworks, standards and improvement methodologies.

• Build strong working relationships with operational leaders, local HSS teams, and functional stakeholders.

About You We think that the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. With this in mind, we think that you are passionate about health, safety & security, have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, are a good listener and can digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions.

You Are Structured, Self-supporting And Capable Of Both Prioritizing And Multitasking In a Demanding Environment. Moreover, We Imagine That The Ideal Candidate Brings

• Ability to think strategically, translating HSS strategy into practical solutions and measurable business outcomes.

• A passion for building a strong HSS culture through engagement, communication and leadership influence.

• Experience in developing and implementing standards, frameworks and management systems within operational environments.

• Natural collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence without direct authority.

• Strong organizing skills, bringing structure, governance and consistency to complex initiatives.

• Capability to operate between strategy and execution, balancing long-term objectives with day-to-day deliveries, in a global corporate function.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, good listening abilities, and the ability to digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions.

• A self-driven approach, with the ability to prioritize and multitask in a demanding environment.

**Furthermore, You Have

**

• A degree in business, organizational development, safety or security management, or related field.

• Proven experience (5+ years) within safety or security related functions in a global or matrixed organization.

• Experience in shipping, logistics, or industrial sectors is highly desirable.

• Strong understanding of safety/security culture principles and organizational behavior is an advantage.

• Excellent presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Knowledge of or certification in change management methodologies is a plus.

• Project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) is an advantage.

• Proficiency in English (oral and written) as English is corporate language.

• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 suite.

• Experience in utilizing AI tools is an advantage.

Working at DFDS  Join the movement and grow with us.  While you’re with us, we want you to develop and move yourself on. We’ll encourage you to challenge yourself to acquire new skills and perspectives.

At DFDS, we promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.   If you think your personality, skills, experience and aspirations match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Send us your resume as soon as possible as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

Is there something you need to know, we haven’t covered here, please do not hesitate to reach out to Global Director HSS (Landside) Steffen Conradsen on sconr@dfds.com.

Please note that response times may be slightly longer than usual due to the autumn holiday period and business travel activities within the hiring team, however, rest assured that we will get back to you at earliest convenience.

We look forward to hearing from you.   This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation

Hybrid (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)

**

Shape the Future of Privacy**

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

**About the Role

**Revenue Operations is the horizontal backbone behind Usercentrics' three go-to-market motions — Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led. As we scale, our Salesforce ecosystem and wider GTM tech stack need a single owner who can turn ambitious business requirements into governed, scalable systems. As Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation, you'll lead a team spanning Salesforce administration and GTM engineering, and you'll be the one deciding how AI-native automation gets built into our GTM workflows. You'll partner closely with other Revenue Operations teams, the broader GTM organization, and stakeholders across Finance and Product to translate business requirements into efficient, reliable systems.

**Responsibilities

**> Own CRM architecture and governance end-to-end, ensuring Salesforce supports Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led without compromising on data integrity.

> Set the roadmap and standards for the wider GTM tech stack, tying every major investment to a clear business outcome - pipeline quality, forecasting reliability, or support efficiency - not just tool delivery.

> Lead and grow a small team spanning Salesforce administration, Salesforce architecture, and GTM engineering, keeping the team focused on high-impact initiatives tied to clear business outcomes, and acting as the final technical decision-maker on system changes.

> Drive AI-native workflows and automation across GTM - from propensity and churn scoring models to workflow automation - that reduce manual work, increase seller and CS productivity, and improve the customer experience.

> Own attribution and data hygiene practices, partnering closely with BI on the underlying data infrastructure and pipeline.

> Drive adoption and value realization of the systems you build, partnering with GTM Enablement to make sure new capabilities actually change day-to-day behavior, not just go live.

> Continuously evaluate GTM tooling and market trends, bringing investment recommendations to the VP of Revenue Operations based on expected business impact and ROI.

Requirements

Experience

> 5+ years of experience in RevOps, Salesforce administration and GTM systems, with real ownership of architecture-level decisions.

> Experience managing a technical team in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

Technical Skills

> Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise (architecture, automation, integrations).

> Practical experience with tools like n8n, Clay, and Outreach, and with AI-assisted workflows in a revenue context.

Operating Skills

> Strong data instincts: comfortable owning attribution, data hygiene, and governance across a growing tech stack.

> Confident operating independently and making system decisions without needing to escalate every call.

> Comfortable being the technical backstop for a Solution Architect, Administrator, and Engineer, without needing to do the hands-on build yourself day to day.

Benefits

Include:

> Development Budget for every employee: 800,- EUR / year

> Job-related Language Courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish etc.): 350,- EUR / year

> Hybrid working policy and the possibility to take a workcation (90 days per year from a European country

> Online yoga sessions

> Massages

> Headspace App

> Events - Team Buildings, happy hours, parties/get togethers, occasional company covered breakfasts/lunches, in/across offices, online/in person etc

> Gifts - We celebrate life & work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new born babies and similar)

> Snacks, fruits, coffee and drinks in the office

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**Why this role is important to us

**Group IT keeps SimCorp running. The same discipline we bring to our clients' investment operations is applied to our own enterprise platforms. Workday and Salesforce are at the center of how we manage our people and client relationships.

As Senior Director, Enterprise Applications, you will own the strategy, governance, and operational health of Workday and Salesforce across the organization. You will serve as the primary accountable leader for these platforms, partnering closely with business functions to ensure secure, compliant, and reliable operations through your leadership team and subject matter experts.

This is a senior leadership position with high visibility across Group IT, P&C, and Sales, providing direct influence over the evolution of two of SimCorp's most business-critical enterprise platforms.

You will step directly into a strategic and business-critical transformation initiative: the migration of financial processes and data from Workday to SAP S/4HANA, with a planned go-live in January 2027. Success in this role requires the ability to quickly engage in data mapping, integration planning, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional execution from day one.

**The organization consists of:

**

• 5 individual contributors reporting directly to the role

• 2 managers reporting directly to the role

• 29 employees in total across the Enterprise Applications area

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

jobs.occupation: Kok med speciale i kinesisk gastronomi søges til YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS i Hundested & Chef Specializing in Chinese Cuisine Wanted at YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS in Hundested
jobs.description:
Vi søger 1 kok til vores restaurant i Hundested.

Har du passion for autentisk kinesisk madlavning, gode råvarer og kulinariske oplevelser? Har du samtidig erfaring med sushi, er det en ekstra fordel. Så er du måske vores nye kollega!

YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS er en kinesisk restaurant beliggende på Nørregade 29A, 3390 Hundested. Vi lægger vægt på traditionelle kinesiske retter, autentiske smagsoplevelser og god service i hyggelige omgivelser. Vores køkken kombinerer kinesiske madtraditioner med et udvalg af andre asiatiske retter, herunder sushi.

Vi søger en dygtig og engageret kok med erfaring inden for kinesisk gastronomi, som kan bidrage til den daglige drift og den fortsatte udvikling af vores køkken. Du bliver en del af et team, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og respekt for asiatiske madtraditioner er i centrum.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

• 
Tilberede autentiske kinesiske retter med fokus på kvalitet, smag og præsentation.

• 
Klargøre råvarer samt fremstille saucer, marinader og andre centrale elementer i det kinesiske køkken.

• 
Medvirke til udvikling og tilpasning af menuer og nye retter.

• 
Efter behov bidrage til tilberedning og anretning af sushi og andre asiatisk inspirerede retter.

• 
Sikre korrekt håndtering og opbevaring af råvarer samt overholdelse af gældende hygiejne- og fødevaresikkerhedsregler.

• 
Bidrage til en effektiv og velfungerende daglig drift i samarbejde med resten af køkkenteamet.

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har praktisk erfaring med kinesisk gastronomi og gerne kendskab til forskellige regionale kinesiske køkkentraditioner.

• 
Har en god forståelse for råvarer, traditionelle tilberedningsteknikker og sammensætning af smage.

• 
Gerne har erfaring med tilberedning af sushi, herunder håndtering af råvarer, tilberedning af sushiris, rulleteknikker og anretning. Erfaring med sushi er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

• 
Kan arbejde selvstændigt, struktureret og effektivt – også i travle perioder.

• 
Har sans for detaljer, kvalitet og præsentation af maden.

• 
Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og har gode samarbejdsevner.

• 
Har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til restaurantens udvikling og fastholde en høj gastronomisk standard.

• 
Gerne taler kinesisk, da det kan være en fordel i den daglige kommunikation og i arbejdet med traditionelle kinesiske opskrifter. Det er dog ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

• 
En spændende stilling i en veletableret kinesisk restaurant med stærk lokal forankring.

• 
Mulighed for faglig udvikling og indflydelse på køkkenets retter og menuer.

• 
Mulighed for at arbejde med både traditionelle kinesiske retter og andre asiatiske specialiteter, herunder sushi.

• 
Et uformelt og samarbejdsorienteret arbejdsmiljø med plads til engagement og faglig stolthed.

• 
En varieret arbejdsdag med engagerede kollegaer.

• 
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter kvalifikationer og nærmere aftale.

Om os

Hos YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS handler mad om mere end blot at stille sulten. Vi ønsker at skabe autentiske madoplevelser, hvor traditionelle tilberedningsmetoder, velafbalancerede smage og gode råvarer går hånd i hånd.

Fra duften af frisklavede wokretter til omhyggeligt tilberedt sushi stræber vi efter at tilbyde vores gæster en varieret og mindeværdig asiatisk madoplevelse i hjertet af Hundested.

Ansøgning

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig? Så hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til restauranten, eller kontakt os for yderligere oplysninger om stillingen.

YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS

3390 Hundested

Prepare ingredients, sauces, marinades, and other essential components of traditional Chinese cuisine.

Participate in developing and refining menus and introducing new dishes.

•

Ability to work independently, efficiently, and systematically, including during busy service periods.
