Strong attention to detail, food quality, and presentation.

• 
Reliability, responsibility, and good teamwork skills.

• 
Motivation to contribute to the restaurant's continued development and maintain high culinary standards.

• 
Chinese language skills are considered an advantage, as they may support daily kitchen communication and the preparation of traditional Chinese recipes. However, they are not mandatory.

What We Offer

• 
An exciting position at an established Chinese restaurant with strong connections to the local community.

• 
Opportunities for professional development and involvement in menu planning.

• 
The opportunity to work with both traditional Chinese dishes and other Asian specialties, including sushi.

• 
A friendly, informal, and collaborative working environment that values dedication and professional pride.

• 
A varied working day alongside dedicated colleagues.

Salary and employment conditions based on qualifications and mutual agreement.

At YoYo Restaurantionsselskab ApS, food is about more than simply satisfying hunger. We aim to create authentic dining experiences by combining traditional cooking techniques, balanced flavors, and quality ingredients.

From the aroma of freshly prepared wok dishes to carefully crafted sushi, we strive to offer our guests a diverse and memorable Asian dining experience in the heart of Hundested.

Interested in joining our team? We would be pleased to hear from you.

Please send your application and CV to the restaurant or contact us for further information about the position.

Siteimprove helps organisations make their digital content accessible to everyone. Our accessibility products scan entire web estates and document libraries, find the barriers that stop people using them, and increasingly fix those barriers automatically. The work is measured in public: our customers are universities, health systems, government agencies and Fortune 500 companies who have legal deadlines to meet and auditors to satisfy.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead one of our two accessibility product teams. You will own the delivery, quality and technical direction of a cross-functional team of engineers working alongside a Product Manager and a Designer, and you will be accountable for what that team ships and for how the people in it grow.

This role sits at a genuine inflection point. We are moving from finding accessibility problems to explaining and fixing them, and we are rebuilding how we develop software around AI agents that write, test and review code under human direction. We need a leader who is credible in the code, fluent in modern AI-assisted development, and able to coach a team through that change without trading away quality or the well-being of the people doing the work.

What we will be doing

• Own delivery for your team. Turn a product roadmap into a sequenced, realistic plan, keep commitments honest, and be the person who says early and clearly when something will not land.

• Lead the people. Hold regular one-to-ones, give direct and useful feedback, run performance and growth conversations, and build a team where engineers at different levels can do their best work. Recruit, onboard and retain.

• Stay hands-on enough to be credible. Read and review code and designs, take part in architectural decisions, and pair with engineers when it helps. You are not expected to carry a full delivery load, but you are expected to understand the system well enough to challenge a design and to know when an estimate is wrong.

• Coach the team in AI-assisted development. Raise the whole team's effectiveness with AI tooling: how to decompose a problem so an agent can take it, how to write a prompt and a specification that produce reviewable work, and how to review agent-generated code properly rather than approving it on sight.

• Set the standards for how AI-generated work is accepted. Define with your engineers how such work is reviewed, tested, secured and documented before it merges, and hold the line that a human is always accountable for what ships.

• Partner with Product and Design as equals. Work with your Product Manager on outcomes, scope and sequencing, and make the technical trade-offs visible so the three of you decide together.

• Work across teams. Depend on and contribute to Platform, AI and other product teams. Much of what your team needs will be built elsewhere, and much of what it builds will be consumed elsewhere.

• Protect engineering health. Hold a deliberate balance between roadmap delivery, compliance obligations, customer-reported defects and technical debt, and make that balance explicit rather than letting it be decided by whatever is loudest.

• Own quality and operational responsibility. Testing, accessibility conformance of our own products, security and vulnerability remediation, incident response and the reliability of what your team runs in production.

• Adjust your working hours to overlap with the United States. This role reports to a manager on the US Pacific coast and partners with colleagues across the US. You will regularly take meetings in the late afternoon or early evening Central European Time, and we will protect the rest of your week in return.

• Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

• Perform other duties as assigned

What we will require of you

• Engineering management experience. Several years leading software engineering teams as their direct manager, including hiring, performance management and developing engineers at more than one level. You have owned delivery for a team over a sustained period, not just a project.

• A real software engineering background. You have built and shipped production software yourself and can still read a pull request, follow a design discussion and form your own view. We will talk about systems you have built.

• Depth in at least one of our core languages, and comfort across the rest. Our services are written mainly in C# and .NET, TypeScript and JavaScript, Go, Rust and Python. You do not need all of them; you do need to be genuinely strong in one and unafraid of the others.

• Modern cloud and delivery practice. AWS, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, observability and on-call practice.

• Practical use of AI in the software lifecycle. You have personally used AI coding assistants and agents on real work, you know where they help and where they mislead, and you have opinions about how their output should be reviewed. Experience helping other engineers adopt them is what sets this role apart.

• Strong partnership with Product. A track record of working with Product Managers and Designers as a peer, shaping scope rather than receiving it.

• Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical audience.

• Willingness to work a shifted day. Regular overlap with US Pacific time, and occasional travel.

What we will love about you

• Digital accessibility knowledge. Familiarity with WCAG, assistive technology, or the accessibility conformance and reporting that regulated customers require. If you do not have it, you must be willing to learn it properly — it is the product.

• Experience in a compliance or regulated environment, such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 or a public-sector authorisation, and comfort working inside an audited change process.

• Open-source stewardship. We build and maintain an open-source accessibility rules engine, and experience running a public project and its community is valuable.

• Large-scale data or crawling systems, document processing, or machine learning applied to content analysis.

• Experience leading a distributed or multi-site team, including working effectively with contractors and vendor partners.

• Having introduced AI-assisted development to an organisation, including the governance, measurement and change management that goes with it.

• Danish language skills are a nice-to-have and are not required; our working language is English.

What you'll love about us

We’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

In addition, we hope you will appreciate:

At Siteimprove, we're committed to supporting your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Our Denmark benefits are designed to help you thrive personally and professionally.

Rest and relaxation: Generous time off including Danish holiday entitlements, five additional FF Days, child sick leave, and bereavement leave.

Comprehensive benefits: Health insurance, company-paid mobile phone support, and internet allowance to support your day-to-day needs.

jobs.description:
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) at Aarhus University, Denmark, invites applications for a two-year postdoctoral position in plant regulatory genomics and artificial intelligence, starting 1 April 2027.

You will design new sequence-to-expression deep learning models that predict gene expression from DNA sequence in plants, using new experimental datasets generated in the project. The position includes a 6- to 12-month research stay at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA, combining plant genomics expertise at Aarhus with AI expertise at CSHL.

This is an opportunity to advance the state of the art in AI for plant biology while working across two leading research environments. For more information, feel free to reach out to Guillaume Ramstein (QGG) and Peter Koo (CSHL).

Expected start date and duration of employment

This is a 2-year position from April 1st 2027, or as soon as possible.

Job description

You will advance the field of artificial intelligence applied to regulatory genomics, as part of the GRASP project funded by the Independent Research Fund Denmark. In this project, you will leverage new training sets, build novel deep learning architectures and define dedicated learning objectives, to learn the effects of genetic variants on gene expression.

The position will focus on data science and genomics in a model plant species, Brachypodium distachyon. You will work at the cutting edge of AI in biology and propose new solutions to predict the effects of regulatory variants in plant genomes, which remains an open research problem in plant genomics. 

These activities will be carried out in close collaboration with the Koo lab, a leading group in AI and regulatory genomics at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA. As part of this collaboration, the position will include a 6- to 12-month research stay in the Koo lab.

Your profile

Applicants should hold a PhD in computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field, or expect to complete it before the start date. They should have research experience in deep learning.

Applicants are expected to have published in international peer-reviewed journals, preferably on topics related to AI and genomics. Experience in developing new deep learning techniques (model architectures or learning objectives) is especially relevant to this position. 

Good communication skills in English are required, as well as the ability to work in an interdisciplinary team of AI experts, computational geneticists, and plant biologists.

Who we are

The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) is a major center for research and education in quantitative genetics and genomics at Aarhus University (http://www.qgg.au.dk/en). We conduct basic and applied research in animal, plant, and human genetics. Our focus areas include quantitative genetics, artificial intelligence applied to agriculture and medicine, population genetics, and integrative genomics. Research within QGG is characterized by a very close synergy between method development and application on practical problems across species, in collaboration with industry partners. QGG is an international research center with about 70 employees and visiting researchers from over 15 nations. QGG works in teams and strives for an excellent working environment, in which we value self-leadership, open communication, and commitment to diversity and inclusion.

What we offer

The succesful candidate will be offered:

• A 6- to 12-month research stay in the Koo lab at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA, providing international experience and the opportunity to work across two leading labs in plant genomics and AI.
• Computational ressources, including the GenomeDK high-performance computing cluster, with growing capabilities such as high-memory nodes and state-of-the-art GPUs.
• An interdisciplinary interdisciplinary environment, in which the candidate will be able to exchange across research fields (machine learning, bioinformatics, biology, and quantitative genetics) and applications (plant biology, agriculture, and biomedicine).
• A research environment characterized by collaboration, professionalism, commitment to diversity and inclusion, and success in mentoring and supervision.
• A healthy work-life balance.
Place of work and area of employment

The primary place of work is C. F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000, Aarhus (Denmark), and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments.

The position will also include a 6- to 12-month research stay at 1 Bungtown Rd, Cold Spring Harbor, NY 11724, United States. The time and duration of the research stay may be negotiated with the supervisors Guillaume Ramstein and Peter Koo.

Contact information

For further information, please contact:

• Tenure-Track Assistant Professor Guillaume Ramstein, +45 42 52 12 66, ramstein@qgg.au.dk
• Associate Professor Peter Koo, +1 516 367 5520, koo@cshl.edu
Deadline

Applications must be received no later than November 20th, 2026.

Om Aarhus Universitet

Aarhus Universitet er et fagligt bredt og forskningsintensivt universitet med høj kvalitet i uddannelse og forskning, og et stærkt engagement i samfundsudviklingen nationalt og globalt. Universitetet tilbyder et inspirerende uddannelses- og forskningsmiljø for 37.500 studerende og 9.000 medarbejdere med en årlig omsætning på 8,9 mia. kr. Læs mere på www.au.dk

jobs.description:

As our new Laboratory Technician, you will become part of our Quality Assurance Lifecycle Laboratory, where we support products and processes throughout their lifecycle. You will work with ongoing production, helping ensure that our products meet the required quality standards.

If you are motivated by laboratory work, quality assurance, data evaluation, and close collaboration with colleagues across different functions, we offer you an interesting permanent position in a laboratory with a broad range of tasks and stakeholders.

“This is an opportunity to work with quality assurance at different stages of a product’s lifecycle. Join a skilled and collaborative laboratory team

You will become part of an engaged and supportive team with a strong team spirit and a valuable mix of practical laboratory experience and specialist knowledge. We place great emphasis on engagement, collaboration, and creating a working environment where people feel included, support one another, and share knowledge across tasks and responsibilities. In our daily work, we collaborate closely with colleagues across Quality Assurance, Research and Development, and Operations, and we value curiosity, flexibility, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Laboratory work across the product lifecycle

As a Laboratory Technician, you will perform laboratory testing and ensure that results and documentation meet applicable quality requirements. Your tasks will vary depending on production needs, development activities, investigations, and project priorities.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

•    Planning and performing laboratory tests according to approved procedures, instructions, and test methods

•    Documenting test activities and results accurately and in accordance with quality requirements

•    Reviewing and evaluating test results, including basic statistical analysis and interpretation of data

•    Supporting ongoing production with laboratory testing

•    Contributing to investigations related to unexpected or non-conforming test results

•    Supporting test verification and transfer activities

•    Participating in equipment-related activities, including maintenance, calibration, qualification, and troubleshooting

•    Writing, reviewing, and updating laboratory procedures, test methods, and work instructions

•    Supporting change control, corrective and preventive actions, and audit activities

•    Participating in daily stand-up meetings and contributing to task prioritization and workflow

•    Ensuring that laboratory activities are carried out in compliance with environmental, health, and safety requirements

•    Contributing to continuous improvement of laboratory processes, workflows, and ways of working

You can expect a role with both routine and non-routine laboratory activities. You will have the opportunity to build a broad network across the organization and gain experience with quality assurance at several stages of a product’s lifecycle.

Bring quality and reliability to every laboratory task

To succeed in this position, you work carefully and systematically and understand the importance of accurate documentation and data integrity. You take responsibility for your tasks, follow established procedures, and

communicate clearly if you identify unexpected results, quality risks or challenges.

You enjoy working both independently and as part of a team. As priorities may change depending on production and project needs, you are flexible and able to organize your work accordingly.

We imagine that you:

•    Are a qualified Laboratory Technician or have a comparable laboratory education

•    Have experience with practical laboratory work, preferably within quality control, quality assurance, production, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or another regulated industry

•    Have a strong quality mindset and a structured approach to documentation

•    Have knowledge of basic statistics and experience evaluating and presenting laboratory data

•    Are able to write and maintain procedures, test methods, and work instructions

•    Are comfortable working according to procedures, test methods, and quality requirements

•    Have experience with laboratory equipment and general laboratory practices

•    Are curious, solution-oriented, and willing to learn new methods and technologies

•    Work well with colleagues from different professional backgrounds

•    Communicate clearly and professionally

•    Are comfortable using digital systems for laboratory documentation and data handling

•    Are fluent in Danish and able to communicate in English

Experience from the medical device industry, working under Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements, or using a Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Interested?

Job Description

We are looking for a Business Consultant who is motivated by creating solutions that make a real difference for our many clients. Responsibilities

We are looking for a Business Consultant with a strong and well-documented interest in digitalisation to support initiatives related to user involvement, training, benefits realisation, process optimisation, and change management. Your work will be tied to our large-scale projects across both the public and private sectors.

As a Business Consultant, you will help ensure that Netcompany’s IT projects are successfully anchored within our clients’ organisations and business processes. You will also play a key role in making sure users have the right capabilities and readiness, so that both users and the organisation are fully prepared when new solutions go live.

jobs.occupation: Senior Frontend Engineer - with an interest in fullstack
jobs.description:
About Cardlay
Cardlay is a Danish fintech building white-label card and spend management solutions. Banks, issuers and financial partners in Europe and the US offer our platform to their business customers using their own brand.

We are a small dedicated team with short decision paths. We make bold decisions, turn them into results by helping each other, and give people the mandate to own what they build.
About the job
Our web portal is where companies run their spend: cards, expenses, accounting and people management. Every bank offers it under its own brand.

Some of the core capabilities include

• Cards: card programs, card orders and requests, and funding accounts
• Expenses: transactions, receipts, mileages and expense policies
• Accounting: categories, cost dimensions, GL accounts and exports to external accounting systems
• People and teams: onboarding, invitations, roles and company settings
Under the hood, it's React, TypeScript, pnpm workspaces and Vite.

Every new bank brings its own brand and requirements, and AI agents now write a growing share of our code. We need a senior engineer who builds the product and keeps the shared components and patterns behind them consistent, so new screens, whether built by people or AI agents, look and work like the rest of the product.

This is a hands-on product role with significant ownership: you will build features every day and help set our frontend direction.

What success looks like after a year

• Customers use features you built and shipped end to end
• A new feature takes less code and fewer review rounds than it does today
• New screens are built from shared components by default, by people and AI agents alike
• The core libraries are up to date with latest security updates and we are on a clear upgrade path going forward
The challenge

Customers rely on the platform every day, and it has grown over several years:

• Some pages use our new design system and some don't yet. Deciding what to migrate, and when, to keep the experience consistent is ongoing work
• You work closely with our UI/UX Lead. That takes the confidence to push back on designs that hurt the user experience, and the taste to know when you're right
• There are several ways of handling data and state in the codebase, and picking the right one for each case directly affects what customers experience
• We're a small team, and other developers contribute a lot to the web portal. As the senior frontend engineer, you decide what's good enough to merge and where our code style and stack go next
• You look beyond your own domain. When the answer is on the other side of the API, you read the backend code and unblock yourself where you canWhat you'll do
As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will own the frontend of our web portal. You take responsibility for what we ship, make decisions others can build on, drive projects forward and help the people around you grow.

You will be the primary frontend engineer in an engineering team of 10 people across frontend, backend, mobile and DevOps. You will work closely with Product and our UI/UX Lead, and report to our Head of Engineering.

Your responsibilities will include

• Take responsibility for the frontend as a whole: its quality, performance and direction
• Make the key frontend decisions and stand by them: architecture, what goes into the design system and when to say no
• Drive projects from idea to production with Product and our UI/UX Lead, and own them until customers are using them
• Build reusable components and patterns as part of your product work, not one-off solutions
• Move legacy screens onto the design system as you work on them, without silent visual regressions
• Set up component APIs, lint rules and docs so AI agents produce code that fits
• Mentor other engineers and share what you know through reviews, docs and pairingWho you are
We are looking for an experienced frontend engineer who loves building a product and cares about the quality and consistency behind it.

You likely bring

• Deep experience with React and TypeScript

Would you like to combine your engineering studies with practical experience in project management and learn how technical solutions and business priorities come together?

At Gram Equipment, we develop and deliver equipment for industrial ice cream production worldwide. We are looking for an engineering student to join our Project Management team in Kolding, either as an intern or a student worker.

You will work alongside experienced colleagues and gain insight into how we coordinate projects, from technical requirements and planning to delivery. Along the way, you will learn how mechanical solutions, customer expectations, budgets and deadlines influence project decisions.

What you will be doing
You will support our project managers in their daily work, with tasks adapted to your skills, interests and study requirements. Your tasks may include:

• Supporting project planning and following up on milestones, deadlines and outstanding actions.
• Preparing and updating project documentation, status reports and meeting materials.
• Participating in project meetings and following up on agreed actions.
• Helping coordinate activities across Engineering, Sales, Production, Installation and Service.
• Supporting the follow-up on project costs, changes and risks.
• Contributing ideas to improve project processes and ways of working.

As you develop your understanding of our projects, you will have the opportunity to take responsibility for defined tasks with guidance from the team.

Who we are looking for
You are studying Mechanical Engineering, Global Business Engineering or a related engineering programme. You have a good understanding of mechanical principles and an interest in the business side of engineering, particularly how technical decisions affect costs, delivery and customer value.

We also imagine that you:

• Are curious about project management and eager to apply your knowledge in practice.
• Work in a structured way and follow through on your tasks.
• Enjoy collaborating with people across different functions.
• Take initiative and ask questions when you need input.
• Communicate clearly in English, both spoken and written.
You do not need previous project management experience. What matters is your willingness to learn and contribute.

What we offer
You will gain practical experience in an international engineering company, with support and feedback from experienced project managers. You will work on real projects and develop your technical, commercial and coordination skills.

Our main office in Kolding offers an informal working environment with dedicated colleagues.

Looking for an internship? We will agree on the duration, scope and learning objectives in line with your study programme.

Looking for a student job? We will agree on working hours that fit in with your studies, with flexibility during exam periods.

Interested?

Please send your CV and a short application explaining your motivation. Let us know whether you are interested in an internship, a student job or either option, and include your preferred start date and availability.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.description:
We are extra[not]ordinary

*(ex· tra· not· or· di· nary |\ ik-ˈstr-not-ȯr-də-ˌner-ē)

Adjective: A unique word for Genmab meaning to go way beyond what is

usual; to be remarkable; proudly unique and authentic

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

Genmab is searching for an energized Senior Associate to be part of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing in Copenhagen within commute distance from our office locations to work according to your hybrid work arrangement.

With an impressive pipeline and many ongoing clinical trials, you will have a central role in supporting inspection readiness across our late-stage clinical development portfolio. Your work will help ensure that documentation is complete, compliant and readily available to support the successful execution of business-critical GMP and GCP inspections.

You will support inspection readiness activities within Global Clinical Supply, collecting, organizing and performing completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation. During inspections, you will participate in back-office activities and help ensure timely retrieval and follow-up of requested information.

The role also offers an opportunity to develop beyond inspection readiness. You will work closely with the Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing and support selected functional initiatives, providing exposure to broader activities across the organization and our CMO and vendor network. In parallel, you will have the opportunity to build your GMP and clinical supply knowledge by learning and supporting selected operational activities related to outsourced packaging and labelling of IMP and AxMP.

The position reports to the Director, Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing based in Copenhagen.

Responsibilities

• Support inspection readiness across late-stage clinical trials by collecting, organizing and maintaining relevant clinical supply documentation.

• Perform completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation against applicable procedures and inspection-readiness expectations.

• Participate in back-office activities during GMP and GCP inspections, including document retrieval, request coordination and tracking of responses and follow-up items.

• Support preparation for mock inspections, audits and health authority inspections, including compilation and review of supporting documentation for completeness and readiness.

• Support the Head of Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing with selected functional initiatives and tasks across the organization.

• Support activities related to our external CMO and vendor network, including coordination, follow-up and preparation of relevant material and documentation.

• Build knowledge of GMP and clinical supply activities within Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing and learn and support selected operational tasks related to outsourced packaging and labelling of IMP and AxMP.

• Participate in maintenance and continuous improvement of procedures, tools and ways of working supporting inspection readiness and clinical supply activities.

• Responsible to be compliant with Genmab´s quality system.

Requirements

• Minimum a bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

• Some experience working with documentation, quality or compliance activities in the pharmaceutical, biotech, clinical research or another regulated environment is an advantage.

• Knowledge and understanding of GMP and GCP; experience with inspection or audit readiness is an advantage.

• Strong interest in documentation, quality and compliance, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work.

• Ability to coordinate activities, maintain structure and follow up on actions involving multiple stakeholders.

• Ability to work successfully under pressure in a fast-paced environment and with tight timelines, including during inspections.

• Ability to be proactive, enthusiastic, curious and goal orientated, with a willingness to learn new GMP-related activities.

• A team player with demonstrated ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including CMOs and vendors.

• Strong communication skills in English - both oral and written.

The Team

You will be part of a highly competent team focused on GMP applicable to packaging and labelling of supplies for clinical trials, with a strong focus on quality, inspection readiness and successful collaboration with our internal stakeholders and CMOs.

Together with Global Clinical Supply Portfolio & Project Delivery and Global Clinical Supply Systems, the teams make up the Global Clinical Supply department.

We have an international and informal working environment with a high pace, strong one-team spirit and close collaboration across functions.

Application

Has this sparked your interest? Then we encourage you to upload your CV and cover letter including your motivation for this position. We screen candidates on a continuous basis and call in for interviews.

Fully remote applicants will not be considered, so please indicate if you are willing to relocate if you’re not currently living in commute distance.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK544.000,00---816.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Job Description

Are you passionate about data and driven by the opportunity to make a real impact by helping companies turn facts into actionable insights? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you work with some of the most complex and modern data solutions? If so, you might be our next colleague.

Responsibilities & technologies

In Data Management, you will become part of a team that contributes to enabling our customers to develop and manage their business based on data and knowledge.

You will work in the intersection of technology and business. Information and data are at the core of our work, and we can see that our analyses, advice, and final solutions create value for our customers. The work involves developing technical solutions to collect, process, model, analyze, and visualize data.

To provide the best possible advice and support to our customers, we place great importance on staying up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data management. You will work with a broad range of market-leading technologies, including: Azure SQL Server, Snowflake, dbt, Microsoft SQL Server, and others.

Your tasks are highly varied and depend on your skills and the direction you wish to develop.

Your responsibilites will typically include:

• Design, modeling, and building of data structures such as databases.

• Structuring and collection of data from various sources.

• Implementation of business logic on data for use in reporting.

• Customer advisory, strategy work, and business analysis in collaboration with our customers.

• Development of reports for business users with a focus on front-end.

About you

You are newly graduated or have up to a couple of years of relevant professional experience within data management. Through your education, you have gained a solid professional foundation and a logical approach to handling complex data and challenges. You thrive in a development-oriented environment with a focus on collaboration and continuous personal and professional development.

To succeed in this role, you have experience with or the interest to learn:

• ETL and Database technologies.

• Languages such as various versions of SQL, Python, and R.

• Business Intelligence tools: Power BI, Tableau, and others.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

**System Architect (Principal) – Shape the Future of Medical Device Innovation

**Would you like to help drive the transformation from product-centric to platform-centric development in global innovate medtech company?

Then we offer you an opportunity to join a highly skilled R&D environment where collaboration, learning, and innovation go hand in hand. Your role will drive how we work with system architecture, requirements, modularization, and platform building across the organization – while contributing to products that make a difference for our users every day.

At Coloplast, we work every day to improve the lives of people with intimate healthcare needs. And you will play a key role in bringing our strategy to life by helping shape the future of how we develop innovative medical devices.

**Join a team shaping the future of R&D

**You will become part of our Requirements Engineering Team, which forms an essential part of our new Centre of Excellence in R&D, bringing together almost 500 talented colleagues.

In your new team, you will meet 7 colleagues who are global process owners of regulated medical device processes and our system architects driving our large strategic development projects.

Together, we define and improve ways of working across R&D to enable ambitious innovation to reach our users faster through a more structured and scalable development approach.

And of course, we make sure to have fun along the way.

**Lead the development of the System Architecture discipline

**As our new Principal System Architect, you will lead the development of the system architecture discipline and help position it for the future. This means you will lead Coloplast’s journey from developing individual products towards platform building and building up competences within system architecture discipline.

Specifically, you will:

• Lead and support the implementation of platform-based product development and manufacturing process development.

• Strengthen and mature the system architecture discipline by defining and evolving processes, methods, and best practices.

• Contribute to building system architecture capabilities across the organisation through training, sparring, coaching and knowledge sharing.

• Shape and communicate the value of system architecture as part of ongoing transformation initiatives.

• Build alignment across stakeholders in a complex, cross-functional environment by engaging, listening, and creating shared understanding.

• Driving results through colleagues, including other system architects, project managers, program managers and system engineers, in a motivating and engaging way.

• Contribute hands-on to development projects as a trusted architecture resource, working closely with teams to define and deliver system architecture artefacts (e.g. system design, interface specifications, functional analysis and impact analysis)

• Translate inputs from across the business (e.g. commercial, regulatory, manufacturing) into clear and usable system architecture decision and artefacts, ensuring different perspectives are reflected

• Ensure system architecture is effectively integrated with related development disciplines such as requirements engineering, test, and documentation management

**Solid Experience In System Architecture For Physical Product Development

**You are a team player, with strong communication skills and the ability to communicate clearly and concisely as you manage stakeholders across a complex and large organization. Moreover, you have the ability to balance and consider cross-functional concerns in decision-making, and you take a coaching leadership approach to support and develop colleagues and stakeholders.

While experience from the medical device industry is valuable, we also welcome candidates with a strong systems engineering and architecture background from other complex product development industries such as aerospace, defense, industrial automation, robotics, windmill industry or advanced consumer products.

**What We Expect From You

**

• 7+ years of experience in system architecture, preferably for physical products and hardware-based systems, not solely software.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and a proven ability to drive alignment across functions, disciplines, and organizational levels.

• Comfortable working across engineering, product management, quality, regulatory, manufacturing, and other key functions.

• Experience leading or influencing organizational change, including the implementation of new ways of working, processes, or engineering practices.

• Ability to provide technical leadership, coaching, and architectural guidance to teams and stakeholders.

• Extensive hands-on experience with systems engineering for complex products, including system architecture, requirements management, interface management, verification, and validation.

• Proven experience establishing, evolving, and governing system architecture and systems engineering practices.

• Experience with modular architecture, product platforms, and reusable architecture strategies.

• Strong knowledge and practical application of systems engineering principles, methods, and best practices, including recognized industry frameworks such as INCOSE.

• Experience contributing directly to development projects and delivering architecture artefacts from concept through implementation.

• Proven experience operating in regulated product development environments and balancing technical, quality, risk, regulatory, and design control requirements.

• Ability to translate diverse business, user, and technical needs into clear architecture decisions and system-level solutions.

• Strong architectural judgement and ability to balance commercial, technical, regulatory, manufacturing, and user considerations.

• Experience defining system boundaries, interfaces, and reusable architectural building blocks that support platform-based product development.

• Motivated by both shaping long-term architectural direction and contributing to successful day-to-day product delivery.

**You might also bring

**

• Experience from medical device development or other highly regulated industries.

• Knowledge of relevant standards and frameworks such as ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, IEC 62366, or equivalent.

• Understanding manufacturing, industrialization, and production processes, ensuring architectures are scalable, manufacturable, testable, and cost-effective throughout the product lifecycle.

• Experience supporting product strategy through platform thinking, technology roadmaps, and long-term architecture planning.

Please note: Seniority level will be determined based on your experience (principal, senior principal)

**Interested?

**If you would like to know more about this position, please contact Head of Requirement Engineering, Centre of Excellence, R&D, Stine Renberg at +45 49113320. We continuously review applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.

Please note: Stine is back from holiday 27th July.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, employees are the key to success. Growing from one store in 1979 to more than 3,600 stores worldwide today, JYSK is a true retail success story – and Logistics play a crucial role in enabling our growth, both in stores and online.

The three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behavior and attitude you can expect from your new colleagues.

At JYSK, colleagues trust each other, and believe in delegation and freedom with responsibility. You are expected to speak up and have a say in your working environment.

Job Description

WHAT YOUR NEW JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As Product Owner for our WMS solutions, you are responsible for setting direction, driving priorities and ensuring that business-critical solutions continue to support JYSK's highly automated Distribution Centers across Europe. Working closely with Logistics, IT and external partners, you balance operational stability with continuous improvements that create real business value.

In this role, you ensure that our WMS platform continues to meet business needs while remaining stable and reliable in daily operations. You identify improvement opportunities, prioritize development efforts and help ensure that new functionality is implemented successfully and delivers value to our logistics setup.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

• 
Secure the stability and continuous development of our WMS solutions

• 
Own and prioritize the Team Backlog to maximize business value and impact

• 
Act as the connecting link between Distribution Centers, Logistics, IT and external partners

• 
Provide people leadership and development for a Business Solution Specialist in the Scrum team

• 
Enable high-quality delivery by making timely decisions and setting clear direction

• 
Drive refinement and alignment to ensure shared understanding across teams

Your primary base will be at our Distribution Center in Uldum. As the role is international, 20–40 travel days per year are expected.

• Has worked closely with elite or semi-elite football players

jobs.occupation: Deciphering host-pathogen interplay by utilizing biostructure prediction and New Genomic Techniques (NGTs) to engineer durable disease resistance in plants
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Agroecology programme. The position is available from 01 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Deciphering host-pathogen interplay by utilizing biostructure prediction and New Genomic Techniques (NGTs) to engineer durable disease resistance in plants

Research area and project description
The Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University is offering a PhD position focused on genetic modification of plants for higher resistance to pathogens. The position is available from 01-02-2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

The PhD is part of the project that aims to develop novel and durable disease resistance in cereals by targeting key protein–protein interactions between plants and pathogens. Using hexaploid wheat (Triticum aestivum) and diploid barley (Hordeum vulgare) as model systems, the project will focus on
powdery mildew disease caused by Blumeria graminis f. sp. tritici (Bgt) and B. hordei (Bh).

The PhD student will establish and optimize an AI-based structural biology modelling and prime editing toolbox and apply it to introduce genome modification in vitro culture. These edits are designed to disrupt critical plant-pathogen protein interactions, thereby enhancing disease resistance without relying on classical resistance genes. Computational prediction tools, including AlphaFold-based protein-protein interaction modeling, will be used to guide target selection and interpret the molecular effects of the edits. Wheat transformation will be carried out in three varieties with contrasting resistance profiles, and barley transformation will be done in Golden Promise. Disease resistance will be assessed through controlled inoculation experiments. Edited and wild-type plants will be inoculated with Blumeria graminis isolates and evaluated at the whole-plant level.

Overall, the project aims to establish a new resistance concept based on blocking essential plant-pathogen interactions rather than relying on single resistance genes. This strategy has the potential to deliver more robust and durable disease resistance and to open new avenues for precision breeding in cereal crops.

The position is funded by a project supported by the DFF, in collaboration with Copenhagen University and will last 3 years.

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants to the PhD position must hold a relevant MSc degree within molecular biology, plant or agricultural sciences, biology, biotechnology or similar.
• Knowledge in plant transformation and in vitro culture
• Experience with Alphafold and/or structural biology.
• Be fluent in English (written and spoken).
• Have scientific writing and communication skills.
• Have the ability to manage your own tasks and collaborate in an international research team.
Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Department of Agroecology, Forsøgsvej 1, 4200 Slagelse, Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Associate Professor Kim Hebelstrup, e-mail: Kim.hebelstrup@agro.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Tenure Track Assistant Professor Olga A. Oxholm, e-mail: olgaa@agro.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

jobs.occupation: Lead Developer to support the Green Energy Transition

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment, where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.  

As part of our continued growth, Application Development is expanding significantly. We are strengthening our department with two Lead Developers and five Senior Developers, creating exciting opportunities to join a growing team and help shape the future of software development at Nordic RCC. 

Your role 

As a Lead Developer in Application Development, you will join a collaborative department of approximately 23 developers who design, develop and maintain the internal applications supporting our current and future business services. If you are curious about Nordic RCC and what we do, learn more about our innovative solutions on the Nordic RCC webpage. 

Your role combines hands-on development with broader technical leadership. You will work closely with Application Architects to help define and communicate technical direction, translate architectural principles into practical solutions and promote consistency across our application landscape. 

You will connect technical expertise across teams, identify shared challenges, and contribute to reusable, sustainable solutions. Through cross-departmental collaboration, you will build alignment around technical opportunities, constraints, and impacts across the organization. 

What you will do :  

• 
Design, develop, and maintain robust applications using C# and .NET, while promoting consistent standards, code quality, maintainability and operational stability

• 
Contribute to improving system architecture by identifying areas for technical refinement, refactoring, or modernization  

• 
Collaborating across the organization, represent Application Development by collaborating with Product Owners, Delivery Management, testers, Quality Management and other departments

• 
Set and communicate technical direction with Application Architects, translating architectural principles and business needs into practical solutions and Architecture Decision Records

• 
Connect technical expertise across teams and applications, enabling collaboration on dependencies, common challenges and reusable solutions

• 
Support operational excellence by helping diagnose and resolve production issues and continuously optimize existing systems  

• 
Share knowledge and technical expertise supporting colleagues’ professional development and help strengthen development practices across the team. This role does not include formal line-management responsibilities

Technology Stack:  

• 
Primary languages and frameworks  
C#, .NET, SolidJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Functional programming, Python  

• 
Architecture, design patterns & integrations  
Clean Architecture, SOLID, Event-driven Architecture, Message-driven Architecture, REST APIs 

• 
Databases & storage 
Relational databases (SQL Server), NoSQL databases (MongoDB), GridFS, S3 

• 
Infrastructure & Platform (on-prem)  
Kubernetes (on-prem), Docker, Rancher, Prometheus/Grafana, ArgoCD, NginX  

• 
Tooling and collaboration  
Git, Visual Studio, VS Code, JetBrains Rider, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines  

We’re looking for someone with:  

• 
Collaborative Attitude: You will be working closely with our team of Application Architects, shaping architectural decisions for supporting maintainable, scalable and robust systems

• 
Technical Foundation: A degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field

• 
Proven Expertise: Minimum 5 years’ experience as full-stack developer in C# for the .NET platform. Experience providing technical guidance, facilitating technical decisions, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating development activities is a definite plus. 

• 
Nice to have: Experience working with functional programming, Clean Architecture principles, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes and Scrum processes

• 
Energy Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with the power systems domain is a plus but not required

If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.   

What We Offer: A Flexible and Inclusive Workplace  

You will join a diverse organization of 23 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.  

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   

Application deadline and contact information  

Please apply online (in English) no later than 15/11-2026. Interviews will be held on a rolling  basis up until the right candidate has been found.  

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.  

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

If you have any questions, please contact Pernille Yde Juul Hansen, Manager, Application Development pyh@nordic-rcc.net / +45 3092 3111.

**Turn complexity into one plan the business can act on.

****What if planning could shape the future, not just react to it?

**Across the Nordics, demand is shaped by tenders, contracts, launches and changing customer needs. The opportunity is to bring those signals together early, translate them into clear choices and create a healthier balance between product availability and inventory. That is where you come in.

As our Demand & Supply Manager Nordics, you will create one reliable view of demand and supply across Denmark, Sweden, and Finland. You will own the Nordic Sales and Operations Planning cycle, lead a distributed planning team and help move the organization from reactive expediting towards confident, forward-looking decisions.

**Your impact

****Role

**This is not a role where you simply maintain a forecast. You will set the direction for how the Nordics plan, decide and improve. You will:

• Own one Nordic demand and supply plan, bringing tender and contract intelligence into the forecast early enough to influence decisions.

• Lead the full S&OP cycle, from portfolio and demand reviews through supply and management review, with clear monthly decisions and ownership.

• Take accountability for inventory health, availability and the working-capital effect of the plan, while preventing excess and risk stock from rebuilding.

• Lead and develop four planners and one analyst across Denmark, Sweden and Finland, creating one way of working that is resilient across countries and absences.

• Connect sales, category, tender, sourcing, finance, warehouse and transport around the same facts, priorities and actions.

**What Will Make You Successful

**You combine strong planning craft with practical leadership. You are comfortable moving between item-level detail and senior stakeholder decisions, and you know how to challenge constructively when the numbers tell a different story.

**You Are Likely To Bring

**

• 8-12 years in supply chain, including at least five years in demand and supply planning or S&OP.

• Experience owning a full S&OP or IBP cycle and leading a planning team, ideally across more than one country.

• Strong knowledge of inventory, working capital, forecast quality and excess or obsolete stock.

• Hands-on experience with an advanced planning system such as Slim4, o9, Kinaxis, SAP IBP or a comparable platform, plus strong Excel or BI skills.

• Professional English and, preferably, Danish or Swedish.

• A relevant Bachelor or Master degree. APICS, IBF or an equivalent certification is an advantage.

**The environment you will step into

**The scope is genuinely Nordic and the mandate is broad. You will have the space to shape the process while keeping the daily business moving.

You will work closely on standards, tools and the group excess and risk stock process. Your influence will reach well beyond your direct team, so trust, clarity and follow-through will matter as much as technical expertise.

**Ready to build what comes next?

**If you want to lead a cross-border team, create one Nordic planning approach and turn better demand and supply decisions into stronger service and healthier inventory, we would like to hear from you.

Location: Copenhagen Denmark or Kungsbacka Sweden. Travel: Regular travel within the Nordics and Europe is part of the role.

jobs.occupation: Senior AI Engineer for The Tech Collective
jobs.description:
Job Description

We're looking for a senior AI engineer with hands-on experience in generative AI, API integrations, and advanced agent-based applications. The ideal candidate brings a mix of full-stack, AI, and cloud engineering experience.

What you'll do

This role cuts across multiple tech stacks and is a central part of how we deliver AI solutions for our clients.

In this role, you'll:

• Translating early ideas into working prototypes and iterating them into production-ready solutions using modern full-stack frameworks

• Designing and deploying generative AI applications and autonomous agents using LLM APIs and established agent frameworks

• Integrating AI capabilities into client systems and managing deployment pipelines in cloud environments

• Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to build solutions that address real needs

• Mentoring junior engineers and keeping pace with emerging AI and software engineering paradigms

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone with at least five years of software development experience, including at least two in generative AI and agent-based applications, and a master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

Beyond that, you'll bring:

• Full-stack capability across TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite) and Python, with experience shipping production systems

• Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, CrewAI, Agno, or DSPy

• Proficiency with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and containerisation tools such as Docker and Kubernetes

• Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Relevant AI or cloud certifications are a plus. English is our corporate language; however, proficiency in one or more additional languages is a plus for this role.

What we offer

You'll join a fast-growing team backed by Implement Consulting Group — nerdy by nature, genuinely curious about both technology and people, and serious about craft. You'll have real autonomy, a strong culture of learning, and meaningful AI challenges across industries.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the role once filled, so apply ASAP.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About The Tech Collective

The Tech Collective is a fast-growing consulting company powered by Implement. We help organisations unlock the immense potential of data, AI and analytics, ensuring that they are fit for the digital future. Through co-creation and passionate advisory, we aim to make our clients’ data easy to handle and provide useful insights.

In our collective, you will find people with a combination of nerdiness and infectious energy. We are passionate about technology, but we also have a sincere interest in people.

The Role

Our Purpose

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

We are introducing customer marketing as a dedicated discipline at Planday, and this is the role that will build it.

This is a builder's role: you will define how we market to our existing customers, establishing the strategy, the programmes, and the ways of working from the ground up. Across the UK, Nordics, and Germany, you will design and deliver 1:many marketing that drives adoption, deepens engagement, and turns customers into long-term advocates and expansion opportunities.

You will sit at the heart of our commercial ambition: as we target growth in the UK, defend our leadership in the Nordics, and build momentum in Germany, customer marketing is one of the key levers that connects product value to commercial outcomes. This is a role for someone who is energised by creating from scratch, earns trust through execution, and knows that the best customer marketing is grounded in deep empathy for the people you are marketing to.

What You'll Do

Establish the Discipline

• 
Define the customer marketing strategy - audit the current state of customer engagement across all three markets, identify gaps, and build a clear plan for how customer marketing will drive retention, adoption, and expansion at Planday

• 
Set the operating model - establish the ways of working, tools, segmentation logic, and measurement framework that will underpin everything the function delivers

• 
Act as the internal champion for customer marketing - educating and aligning stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales on the role and value of the discipline

Lifecycle & Engagement Programmes

• 
Build always-on 1:many customer engagement across the customer journey through marketing owned channels (e.g. email, in-product, socials, website)

• 
Develop localised programmes for UK, Nordics (Denmark, Norway, Sweden), and Germany - adapting content, tone, and sequencing to reflect the dynamics and customer expectations of each market

Adoption & Expansion

• 
Lead feature adoption campaigns - work closely with Product Marketing to identify the product features most strongly correlated with retention and satisfaction, and creating targeted campaigns that help customers get more from the platform

• 
Own upsell and expansion marketing - delivering behaviour-triggered campaigns that move customers up the tiers, support seat growth, and help customers discover the full value of Planday's offering

• 
Partner with Product Marketing on subscription plan communications and pricing changes, ensuring every customer-facing message reinforces product value and supports commercial goals

Advocacy & Community

• 
Build Planday's customer advocacy programme - identifying and activating champions within the customer base to generate case studies, reviews, testimonials, and referrals

• 
Support reference and social proof pipelines across markets - working with Sales, CS, Brand and Regional marketing to ensure high-quality customer stories are available for every stage of the buyer journey

• 
Explore community-building opportunities - partner with Regional Marketing to execute local community building opportunities such as webinars, customer events, and user groups, that deepen belonging and peer connection among Planday customers

Performance & Insight

• 
Define and own customer marketing metrics - including engagement rates, adoption scores, NRR contribution, upsell pipeline generated, and advocacy outputs and report regularly against them

• 
Use customer health data and behavioural signals to identify at-risk segments and inform targeted retention interventions

• 
Feed customer insight back into the wider marketing and product teams - ensuring the voice of the existing customer shapes how Planday communicates, evolves, and grows

What You'll Bring

Experience & Skills

• 
4–6 years in B2B marketing, with clear experience in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, or retention-focused roles, ideally within a SaaS or technology business

• 
A track record of building programmes from scratch. You have experience establishing a new discipline, process, or team, not just inheriting and maintaining an existing one

• 
Multi-market experience, you are comfortable adapting strategy and execution for audiences across different regions, with an understanding of how culture and market maturity shape customer expectations

• 
Strong lifecycle marketing execution - you know how to design and deliver segmented, behaviour-triggered campaigns across email and in-product channels, and you understand the tools that power them

• 
Data-led - you use customer health scores, product usage data, and campaign performance metrics to make decisions, not just to report on them

• 
Experience working cross-functionally with Customer Success, Customer Support, Product, and Sales, you understand the role each function plays in the customer journey and know how to align activity across them

• 
Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce, SFMC, HubSpot) and an appetite to make better use of the data and tooling available

How You Show Up

•

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Coastal Engineering (Wave-Vegetation Interaction) - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
How can coastal vegetation help protect our coastlines from waves and flooding? Understanding how waves interact with vegetation is key to exploring its potential for coastal protection and climate adaptation. Are you interested in combining fluid mechanics, mathematical analysis and numerical modelling to help answer this question.

Then join us for a 3-year PhD fellowship in coastal engineering at the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering, Section for Fluid Mechanics, Coastal and Maritime Engineering.

Your PhD research will play an integral part in the project “Marine advection and dissipation in the vegetated coastal environment”, financed by the Independent Research Fund Denmark.

You will collaborate with researchers at DTU and DHI in Denmark, as well as at University College Dublin, Ireland and Northeastern University, USA.

Responsibilities 
Your primary tasks will be to develop analytical and numerical models for waves interacting with coastal vegetation. Particular emphasis will be placed on the wave-averaged flow generated by surface waves and on the changes introduced by vegetation canopies.

The research will include:

• Development and validation of models for wave-induced mean velocity profiles over vegetated beds under regular waves.
• Extension of these models to irregular wave fields, including derivation of wave-averaged shear-stress distributions and mean velocity profiles.
• Investigation of undertow and circulation currents above vegetated beds in the surf zone under breaking waves.
• Development of a cross-shore momentum balance describing wave-induced changes in mean water level and the potential reduction of storm-surge flooding by coastal vegetation.
• Numerical simulations using computational fluid dynamics 
• Application of advanced turbulence models for surface-wave flows, modified to account for vegetation.
• Validation of the developed models against existing high-quality laboratory datasets.
• Development of practical parameterizations suitable for implementation in larger-scale coastal and hydrodynamic models.
The project combines fundamental fluid mechanics with applications directly relevant to coastal protection and climate adaptation. A major scientific objective is to move beyond conventional empirical vegetation models and instead explicitly account for the modification of the wave-induced velocity field within and above vegetation canopies.

Qualifications
We are looking for candidates with a strong background in one or more of the following areas:

• Coastal or ocean engineering
• Fluid mechanics or hydrodynamics
• Computational fluid dynamics
• Environmental hydraulics
• Applied mathematics or a closely related field
Experience with numerical modelling, programming and/or CFD is highly desirable. Experience with turbulence modelling, wave mechanics or coastal hydrodynamics would be advantageous, but is not essential. Strong mathematical skills and an interest in combining theoretical analysis with numerical modelling are important.

You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU.
