jobs.occupation: Student Assistants - Customer Experience Operations & Insights
jobs.description:
Want to work at the intersection of customer experience, analytics and operational excellence?

This is your chance to help create the structure, insights and quality processes that enable great customer experiences in a global MedTech company.

We are looking for two student assistants to join our Customer Experience organization at HQ in Humlebæk. One of our recent student assistants has just transitioned into a full-time role after two years in the team — and we are now looking for new talent to continue building the function.

In Customer Experience, we work to deliver superior customer experiences and be the trusted partner for our users/patients and healthcare professionals (e.g. nurses).

Join Customer Experience and collaborate across four global teams

You will be part of a newly established Customer Experience organization, working across four teams: User Experience, HCP Experience, Service Operational Excellence, and Digital Marketing & Demand Generation.

Together, we define, develop and implement the future customer experience — from understanding user needs and shaping digital journeys to creating content and enabling scalable solutions across markets. In this role, you will get hands-on experience working across all four teams and learn how different parts of a global commercial organization come together.

Build your commercial understanding and competencies

As a Student Assistant, you will work approx. 15–20 hours per week and support across the department — gaining exposure to a broad range of topics by collaborating across multiple teams, which is a unique opportunity in a student role. You will refer to a manager who will help you prioritize and develop in the role.

Tasks will vary, but are likely to include:

•    Supporting content and asset approval processes in PromoMats (Veeva), including uploading documents and coordinating inputs — helping ensure that everything we share externally is accurate, compliant and trusted

•    Supporting broader Customer Experience projects across user experience, HCP experience, service operations and digital marketing

•    Conducting analyses of patients, healthcare professionals and competitors

•    Supporting reporting, data analysis and insight generation

•    Supporting the team with administrative and ad hoc tasks

You should expect that approximately 10 hours per week will be dedicated to PromoMats-related tasks. While not every week, this is a recurring and important responsibility. You will receive training in the tool, so prior experience is not required.

An analytical student who enjoys creating structure and quality

You are curious about how processes, systems and data come together to create value. You enjoy creating structure, ensuring quality and finding opportunities for improvement. You take ownership of your work, have a strong attention to detail and are comfortable challenging existing ways of working when there is a better solution.

We imagine that you:

•    Are currently studying a bachelor’s or master’s degree within business, marketing, digital, innovation or similar

•    Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and drive work across structured processes

•    Comfortable working with content, workflows, approvals, and process optimisation

•    Have strong PowerPoint skills

•    Are fluent in English, written and spoken

•    Have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy understanding patterns and insights

•    Experience with Excel, reporting tools or content platforms is an advantage

What we offer

You will become part of a global, purpose-driven organization with strong ambitions for Customer Experience. You will gain hands-on experience working across projects, teams and disciplines — and contribute to work that makes a real difference for users and healthcare professionals.

You will also have the opportunity to be part of Coloplast Young Professionals, a community where students and early-career colleagues connect, network and participate in both professional and social events across the organization.

Working in Humlebæk might feel far from your studies (e.g. in Copenhagen), but Coloplast offers a shuttle bus between the train station and the office. As you get into the role and become more confident in your tasks, you will also have flexibility to work from home when needed — especially during busy periods like exams.

Ready to apply?

If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply today. For more information about the role, feel free to reach out to Signe Bunke at dksbun@coloplast.com.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Job Description

Do you want to take senior hands-on technical ownership of how mission-critical data centers are designed, expanded, and handed over for operation?

GlobalConnect is expanding data center capacity across the Nordics and Northern Europe. To support this growth, we are strengthening our Large Projects organization with a Data Center Designer based in Taastrup.

This is a senior specialist role at our highest specialist level. You will act as a technical authority across large data center projects, influence design direction, challenge key technical decisions, and help shape more consistent ways of working across countries.

The role is a hands-on role. You will work directly with layouts, power and cooling concepts, system architecture, technical documentation, supplier designs, commissioning readiness, and operational handover. This is not a technician or installation role, but you should enjoy getting close to the technical solution and being present in the data center environment.

What you need to succeed

• Hands on experience with data center infrastructure or other mission-critical environments, such as energy, pharma, industrial facilities, or similar

• Strong understanding of cooling systems and power infrastructure in mission-critical environments

• Proven hands-on experience with alarm and monitoring systems, including system architecture and integration with critical infrastructure such as power, cooling, and security

• Ability to interpret, review, and challenge engineering drawings, technical documentation, specifications, supplier designs, and system architecture choices

• Fluent English. Danish or another Nordic language is an advantage

About the role and the team

You will join a small, senior, and specialized team working across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Germany. The team works closely across borders and is building a more consistent pan-Nordic approach to data center design, expansion, and operational readiness.

In Denmark, this role closes an important capability gap. You will bring deep technical design expertise into a setup that already has strong project management capability. You will work closely with Project Managers, Sales, Procurement, external consultants, vendors, customers, and Operations.

A key part of the role is to act as a trusted technical advisor. You will help translate customer needs into technically sound solutions, challenge assumptions when needed, and ensure that design choices support long-term reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.

What you’ll be working on

• Act as technical authority within large data center projects, from early concept through commissioning, acceptance, and handover

• Own and challenge system-level design decisions across power, cooling, controls, alarm and monitoring systems, security, and building interfaces

• Review layouts, airflow concepts, cooling capacity assumptions, power distribution principles, single-line diagrams, and supplier designs

• Develop and review technical requirements, specifications, scopes of supply, risk assessments, and design documentation

• Support FATs, site inspections, commissioning activities, acceptance testing, and operational handover

• Strengthen standardisation, repeatable technical solutions, and design quality across projects and countries

Who we are looking for

You are a senior mechanical technical specialist who enjoys working with complex systems, high expectations, and decisions that have long-term operational impact.

You are confident in your technical judgement and comfortable challenging designs, suppliers, consultants, customers, and internal stakeholders when the solution needs to be improved. You can explain complex technical choices clearly and help others understand the trade-offs between reliability, cost, schedule, scalability, and operational readiness.

You enjoy working close to the physical technical solution. You are comfortable reviewing drawings, questioning assumptions, calculating capacity, discussing design alternatives, and explaining why a solution will work in practice.

To succeed in this role, you should also be motivated by building trust across teams. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Projects, Operations, vendors, and customers, especially where expectations, technical reality, and operational needs must be aligned.

Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you.

Our recruitment process

• Talent Acquisition Screen

• Hiring Manager interview

• Personality and ability tests feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition

• Case interview with Hiring Manager and peer/stakeholder

• Final alignment meeting

• References

Practical information

This role is based in Taastrup, Denmark, and requires strong on-site presence in the data center environment. We are only open to applicants already based in Denmark

Due to security clearance requirements, you must be able to document that you have lived and worked in an EU or NATO country for the past 7 years and we are not able to offer work visa support or sponsorship for this role

At GlobalConnect, you will play a key role in building and safeguarding critical digital infrastructure that society depends on every day. You will have real technical influence, work on complex data center projects, and help shape how we design and deliver reliable infrastructure across multiple countries.

No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!

Design the systems that guide satellites in orbit for new ambitious missions

We are seeking an experienced AOCS/GNC Engineer to design, develop, and validate attitude determination, orbit control, and autonomous navigation solutions for small satellite missions. In this role, you will develop guidance and control strategies across diverse and demanding mission profiles — from VLEO drag-dominated regimes to deep-space trajectories and asteroid proximity operations.

You will join our Advanced Missions global team, developing next-generation AOCS/GNC concepts while collaborating closely with GomSpace's established AOCS team in Aalborg — who built and flew the AOCS for the Juventas CubeSat on ESA's Hera mission and are currently developing full 6-DoF GNC for the Llevant (RAMSES) asteroid rendezvous mission.

**

Your Role**

As AOCS/GNC Engineer, you will own the attitude and orbit control design for advanced mission proposals — from requirements definition and algorithm design through high-fidelity simulation and hardware-in-the-loop validation.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Design and implement AOCS/GNC algorithms for attitude determination, control, and autonomous navigation across diverse mission profiles.

• Develop guidance and orbit-control strategies tailored to SSA, VLEO drag-dominated regimes, and deep-space trajectories.

• Model and simulate spacecraft dynamics, environmental disturbances, and sensor/actuator performance for mission-specific scenarios.

• Validate algorithms through high-fidelity simulations, Monte-Carlo analyses, and hardware-in-the-loop setups.

• Collaborate with systems, propulsion, and mission design teams to define control requirements and ensure end-to-end stability and performance.

**

What Success Looks Like**

In the initial phase, success means:

• Understanding GomSpace's AOCS product portfolio (GSW-600 reaction wheels, Auriga/Twinkle star trackers, STIM300 IMU, AOCS Flightcore software).

• Delivering your first AOCS sizing and mode analysis for a mission proposal and setting up a reusable MATLAB/Simulink simulation environment.

• Establishing working relationships with the Aalborg AOCS team and communicating AOCS trade-offs clearly to non-AOCS stakeholders.

Over time, you will be recognised for owning end-to-end AOCS/GNC design for advanced mission proposals, developing and maintaining GNC strategies across multiple mission regimes, and achieving successful Monte-Carlo validation campaigns that demonstrate algorithm robustness.

**

What You Bring**

You are an AOCS/GNC specialist with deep analytical rigour and a passion for solving complex spacecraft dynamics and control challenges across unconventional mission profiles.

You likely bring:

• An MSc or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Astrodynamics, Control Systems, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. A PhD focused on GNC, spacecraft dynamics, or autonomous navigation is a strong plus.

• 3–5+ years of experience in AOCS/GNC algorithm design, simulation, and validation for spacecraft missions.

• Experience with attitude determination (gyro-stellar estimators, EKF/UKF), 3-axis control (sliding mode, PD/PID, LQR), and momentum management.

• Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink for spacecraft dynamics modelling and Monte-Carlo analysis.

• Experience with C/C++ implementation of flight algorithms and familiarity with AOCS sensors and actuators (star trackers, IMUs, reaction wheels, magnetorquers, RCS thrusters).

• Exposure to ESA/ECSS project lifecycle and AOCS design reviews (PDR, CDR) is highly valued.

**

Who You Are**

You combine deep mathematical rigour with creative engineering intuition. You are energised by the challenge of designing control solutions for missions that push the boundaries of what nanosatellites can do.

You are known for:

• Analytical depth — AOCS/GNC demands mathematical precision, and you deliver it.

• Creative problem solving — developing novel control strategies for unconventional mission profiles.

• Collaborative communication — translating complex dynamics and control concepts into clear requirements for systems and propulsion teams.

• Self-driven initiative — comfortable with ambiguity in early-phase mission design.

• Execution discipline – ensuring commitments are met in demanding environments.

• Customer focus – ensuring focus on customer’s success.

• True leadership — taking ownership of your domain and driving technical excellence.

**

Why Join Us**

You will play a key role in shaping future space missions at their most decisive stage. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with leading institutional customers, influence mission architectures from the start, and contribute to programs with long-term strategic impact.

**

Join our mission**

You are welcome to send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. If you have any questions regarding the position do not hesitate to contact: Gaetano Livornese, Department Manager. E-mail: gali@gomspace.com

Workplace will be at our premises at Langagervej 6 in Aalborg, Denmark. Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

We kindly draw your attention to the fact that we do not receive applications and resumes via e-mail or by personal appearance. This is to protect and show consideration for your personal information. Apply for the job by following the link below.

**

About GomSpace**

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. At the core of our mission are our core values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 200 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries.

Learn more on www.gomspace.com

At GomSpace WE MAKE SPACE YOURS.

Join us in shaping the future of space exploration!

**

Application deadline:**

As soon as possible

jobs.occupation: Associated Project Director/Multidisciplinary Project Manager, COWI/1920
jobs.description:
The Company

COWI is a leading international consultancy within engineering, architecture, energy, and the environment. In close collaboration with clients, COWI co-creates innovative and sustainable solutions that enhance quality of life for current and future generations. With a primary presence in Scandinavia, the United Kingdom, North America, and India, COWI employs approximately 7,500 professionals who bring expertise across a wide range of disciplines.

If you are curious to learn more, we invite you to explore some of COWI’s featured projects at www.cowi.com or view their global portfolio at: Projects around the world (cowi.com)

On behalf of COWI, Best Talent is now seeking an Associate Project Director.

The organisation & the Team

COWI’s Building & Industry Executing Unit in Denmark, consists of approximately 1050 professionals and specialists across building related disciplines.

Within this framework, you will be part of a dedicated Multidisciplinary Project Management team in Lyngby, consisting of approximately 38 committed colleagues. This structure ensures a strong, supportive, and highly professional environment focused on excellence in project delivery.

As part of this strong professional community, you will work alongside dedicated, talented, and ambitious colleagues who are strongly committed to excellence in project leadership and management. Moreover, you will have the opportunity to realize your full potential within an inclusive and supportive professional environment.

Associate Project Director

Exiting Multidisciplinary Building Projects – From Design to Execution

• Strong focus on clients and project delivery

• Thrive in a collaborative and supportive culture

• Shape your own professional development

• Contribute to a more sustainable and livable world

The Challenge

As Associated Project Director for construction projects in Denmark, you will be responsible for the comprehensive management of building projects—from initial planning through to execution. Your role will encompass quality assurance, budget control, contractual and financial oversight, as well as the coordination of timelines and resources.

You will also act as the key liaison with clients and collaborate closely with stakeholders such as public authorities, contractors, and design partners.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading new construction and renovation projects from concept to completion

• Participating in large-scale projects as part of a broader project management team

• Managing complex stakeholder environments, clients, authorities, contractors, and design partners

• Maintain close collaboration with clients to ensure their needs and expectations are consistently met

• Overseeing project scope, schedule, risks, and cost management

• Ensuring high standards of quality, safety, and sustainability across all project stages

• Driving cross-disciplinary collaboration across COWI’s teams and geographies

• Contributing to the professional development of project team members

Why join COWI?

At COWI, your work contributes to shaping a sustainable and liveable world. By combining deep knowledge, curiosity, and courage, COWI develops solutions that address today’s challenges and enable a better tomorrow. COWI has committed to phasing out fossil-based projects and aspires for 100% of its revenue to stem from sustainability-focused initiatives.

COWI values diversity, continuous development, and a sense of belonging. They foster a supportive and enjoyable workplace, knowing that a healthy work-life balance enhances performance both professionally and personally. You will report to the Vice President of the group and be offered a competitive compensation package, aligned with your experience and qualifications.

Your profile & Talent:

You are an experienced Multidisciplinary Project Manager who thrives in collaboration with colleagues, partners, and clients. You foster strong relationships through integrity, accountability, and a proactive mindset. Your background has equipped you to confidently lead medium- to large-scale design projects.

Qualifications and key competencies:

• A relevant academic background in civil engineering, architecture, or a related discipline

• Professional experience in Denmark, with in-depth knowledge of all phases of the Danish building project lifecycle

• Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to manage complex project environments

• A proactive and structured approach to work, with keen attention to detail

• A self-motivated and inspiring personality that promotes teamwork and positive dynamics

• Proficiency in Danish and English, both spoken and written

Diversity and inclusion:

Diversity is a core value at COWI, and inclusion is a strategic priority. The company is committed to fostering a respectful, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities for growth. Leaders at COWI are expected to model inclusive behaviour and embrace diverse perspectives as a strength in team formation and decision-making processes. These commitments are not only embedded in COWI’s values—they are part of what the company believes is the right thing to do.

Application

Best Talent is managing the recruitment process and will treat all applications with strict confidentiality.

Please send your application in English, marked “1920/Associated Project Director, COWI”, to job@besttalent.dk. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible due to the urgency of this position. For more information about Best Talent, please visit www.besttalent.dk.

Ready to build, not just support?

Are you a curious and driven student who loves structure, details and making things work better? Do you want real responsibility, broad HR exposure, and the chance to help build HR processes in a global industrial company with more than 125 years of history?

At DISA Industries, part of the Norican Group, we are looking for a Student Assistant in HR who is ready to take ownership, ask questions, and help us strengthen and develop our HR foundation.

This is not a “fetch‑and‑file” student job. This is a role where you’ll learn, contribute, and grow.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us

• A small, dynamic HR setup – locally it will be you and the HR Business Partner, working closely together with real responsibility and short decision paths

• Hands‑on HR from day one – you’ll help build, structure and improve HR processes rather than just support existing ones

• Strong global backing – while the local team is small, we are part of a larger global HR team across the Norican Group

• A business in motion – DISA combines more than a century of industrial heritage with ongoing change, digitalisation and development

• A pragmatic, people‑focused environment where things get done through trust, collaboration and ownership

This role is ideal for you, if you thrive in a setting where you get responsibility, variety and ample of opportunities to learn. At DISA, many people stay for a long time – not because they have to, but because they want to.

Who You Are

You’re about to finish your bachelor’s degree or currently studying your master’s, for example cand.merc.psyk, cand.soc.hrm or a similar relevant programme, and you’re ready to put theory into practice.

You are:

• Proactive, driven and curious, with a strong sense of ownership

• Genuinely interested in HR processes, people data and organisational structures

• Structured, detail‑oriented and analytical. You like things to be correct and well‑organised

• Comfortable working independently and following tasks through from start to finish

• Motivated by learning and by being part of building something, not just maintaining it

Most importantly: you enjoy learning, improving things, are curious by heart and enjoy being part of a small dynamic team.

What We Offer

• A student job with substance, responsibility and learning

• Insight into HR in a global industrial organisation

• A chance to build skills that matter for your future career

• A welcoming, down‑to‑earth culture with high professionalism

This role is a strong match if you’re looking for a student job where you learn by doing, take responsibility, and build a solid foundation for a future HR career. You bring the curiosity and drive, and we will help develop your skillset.

What You’ll Do

Your tasks will evolve as you grow in the role, but will include a mix of operational HR work, such as:

• Supporting and developing core HR processes across the employee lifecycle

• Preparing and maintaining employment contracts, amendments and HR documentation for payroll

• Supporting the implementation and use of an HRIS, including data structure, quality and processes

• Ensuring HR data accuracy and well‑structured documentation

• Contributing to process design, standardisation and improvement

• Preparing analyses, overviews and HR material for local and global use

• Acting as a trusted HR support for employees and managers in daily matters

You’ll work closely with the HR Business Partner and gain insight into both local HR responsibility and global HR ways of working within Norican.

Want to know more? Ready to apply?

Ready to learn more and ready to apply?

We review applications continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If you want to build HR skills, take ownership, and be part of a company where people and values truly matter – we’d love to hear from you.

About Norican

NORICAN. Shaping Industry.

We are Norican, a global industrial group designing, building and supporting best‑in‑class machines and technologies for metal formation and surface treatment.

Bringing together five leading brands - DISA, Simpson, StrikoWestofen, Wheelabrator and Monitizer – we deliver one connected solution across the production process, supported by full‑service expertise and digital solutions.

Across green sand molding, die casting, sand preparation, melting, transport and dosing, and surface treatment, we help manufacturers improve performance and transform production across a wide range of industries. We build lifetime quality and long‑term partnerships by combining the strengths of our legacy brands to lead the industry through innovation, sustainability and profitable growth.

DISA

DISA design, build and support premium green sand moulding and cashing machines for the ferrous and non-ferrous foundry industries. For 125 years they have delivered machines that last for decades, and they are highly respected by customers and peers for excellent levels of quality and service. DISA machines keep customers producing relentlessly to the very highest standards. And they empower foundry productivity with a lifetime of efficient and a lower cost per casting.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer (Linux, Rust, Python, C)
jobs.description:
Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

At the heart of our technology is an embedded Linux–based camera system that records sports matches using multiple sensors. Using our advanced video processing algorithms, these streams are stitched together to present one continuous playfield.

Our AI and cloud teams then process the video using proprietary models that lead the industry in our field, enabling players and coaches to access detailed statistics such as goals, ball possession, passes, and more.

While dedicated teams own most of the video processing and AI development, you will interface closely with both worlds and have the opportunity to gain exposure across these domains.

Most work in this role focuses on Rust- and Python-based user-space Linux applications, Linux platform engineering, and firmware architecture, rather than low-level hardware or driver development. Our firmware stack primarily uses Rust, Python, and C, and fluency in at least two of these languages is preferred.

What You Will Do

• Develop and maintain Rust- and Python-based user-space applications running on Veo’s embedded Linux camera platform.

• Contribute to firmware architecture and Linux platform engineering for our camera system.

• Build and maintain integrations with cloud services, including REST APIs, OpenTelemetry, and AWS S3.

• Implement wireless communication features using BLE and Wi-Fi for connectivity with mobile devices.

• Develop and maintain application-layer protocols, including GATT services, Protobuf-based communication, and data serialization.

• Collaborate closely with AI, video processing, and cloud teams to support the broader camera platform.

• Improve system reliability and observability through diagnostics, state management, and monitoring.

What You Could Bring

• At least 5 years of experience and a background in electrical or software engineering.

• Strong foundation in modern software development practices, architecture, and design patterns.

• Experience building and evolving user-space applications in Rust or Python, with a focus on clean APIs, testability, and maintainability across an embedded device fleet.

• Experience developing software for embedded Linux systems (Yocto), including system services, D-Bus, device trees, state management, and diagnostics.

• Experience integrating embedded systems with cloud services such as REST APIs, OpenTelemetry, and AWS S3, including debugging and operational troubleshooting.

• Experience building applications that integrate BLE and Wi-Fi, including GATT services, connection management, Protobuf-based protocols, and communication with mobile devices.

• Familiarity with MCU development and RTOS environments are a nice to have. While most work happens in Linux user-space, exposure to low-level firmware or peripheral interfacing can be helpful when interacting with MCU firmware.

Environment

• Languages: Rust, Python, C

• Embedded Linux: Yocto / OpenEmbedded / meta-tegra

• RTOS: Zephyr

• Cloud & Observability: AWS S3, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loggly

• Infrastructure: NixOS

• Tooling: GitHub (Actions)

We want to enable all teams around the world recording their football matches without the obstacles of finding a cameraman. Tembi is building the intelligence layer for European e-commerce.

We monitor more than 1 million online retailers across Europe and transform billions of datapoints into market intelligence that helps logistics providers, retailers and technology companies understand where the market is moving before their competitors do.

The next generation of market intelligence will not be built on static reports and dashboards. It will be built on continuously evolving data pipelines, AI-assisted enrichment, and systems capable of turning fragmented web signals into trusted commercial insight at scale.

We are at a rare moment in the company’s journey:

the market opportunity is large, our product is gaining traction across Europe, and the engineering team is still small enough that great engineers leave fingerprints on everything they build.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong foundations in Python, infrastructure, data engineering and large-scale data systems to help us build the core of that platform.

The team you’ll join

You will join a tight-knit engineering team of software engineers and data engineers working closely together to evolve our Market Intelligence platform.

We are around 20 colleagues today, with customers across Europe and a multicultural office in central Copenhagen.

We work with flat hierarchies, short decision paths and high ownership. Engineers at Tembi work closely with Product, Customer Success and customers themselves to understand real problems and ship solutions that create value quickly.

This is not an environment where engineers disappear into narrow silos or spend months building in isolation. We value pragmatic execution, strong collaboration and people who enjoy solving difficult problems head-on.

Current technology environment

Our platform and data infrastructure currently includes technologies such as:

• 
Python

• 
Azure

• 
MySQL

• 
Databricks

• 
Distributed scraping infrastructure

• 
Large-scale data processing pipelines

• 
CI/CD automation

• 
TypeScript services and tooling

We continuously evolve our architecture as we expand into new markets, products and AI-driven capabilities.

What you’ll do

• 
Evolve and maintain our scraping engine while expanding into new European markets and adapting to an increasingly dynamic and competitive web landscape.

• 
Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines and backend services powering Tembi’s market intelligence platform.

• 
Explore practical applications of generative AI and LLMs to improve data extraction, classification, normalisation and enrichment at scale.

• 
Safeguard data quality, reliability and lineage across our platform so customers can trust the intelligence we deliver.

• 
Improve CI/CD workflows, observability and engineering practices to help the team ship safely and frequently.

• 
Collaborate closely with data scientists, product engineers and commercial teams to turn experiments into production-ready systems.

• 
Help shape the architecture of our data platform as we expand into new markets and product areas.

• 
Mentor other engineers and contribute to a pragmatic, responsible and high-trust engineering culture.

• 
Take ownership from idea to production — understanding both the technical and customer side of the problems you solve.

What success looks like after 12 months

• 
Expanded and stabilised data collection in new European markets.

• 
Improved reliability and quality of core datasets used directly by customers and AI models.

• 
Helped productionise AI-assisted enrichment and classification capabilities.

• 
Contributed meaningful improvements to platform scalability, observability and operational efficiency.

• 
Raised engineering standards through strong collaboration, ownership and pragmatic technical leadership.

• 
Delivered systems and improvements that customers actively use and see value from.

What we’re looking for

• 
6+ years of professional software engineering experience.

• 
Strong Python skills and experience building production-grade systems.

• 
Experience designing and operating scalable backend services and data pipelines.

• 
Strong SQL and database fundamentals.

• 
Hands-on experience with CI/CD, testing, deployment workflows and operational ownership.

• 
Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP.

• 
Comfortable reasoning about performance, scalability, reliability and infrastructure cost.

• 
Experience with web scraping or large-scale open web data extraction.

• 
A pragmatic, ownership-driven mindset — you care about solving real customer problems, not just closing tickets.

Nice to have

• 
Experience applying LLMs or generative AI techniques to extraction, classification or enrichment problems.

• 
Experience with Databricks, Spark or modern lakehouse architectures.

• 
Experience with TypeScript and backend development beyond Python.

• 
Experience building internal tooling or developer platforms.

Why you’ll enjoy it here

• 
You will work on genuinely difficult engineering and data problems with direct business impact.

• 
Your work will influence product decisions, customer outcomes and the future direction of the platform.

• 
You’ll join a senior, highly collaborative team that values ownership, honesty and pragmatic engineering.

• 
We move fast, but we care deeply about building reliable systems and long-term value.

• 
You’ll have direct visibility into how customers use what you build — often within weeks, not quarters.

• 
We care more about curiosity, responsibility and impact than prestige or corporate titles.

• 
Our office is located in central Copenhagen at Fiolstræde near Nørreport, with canteen, snacks, soda and coffee included.

Compensation and growth

We are a startup building for long-term impact, not a large corporation optimising for hierarchy and process.

This role is best suited for engineers motivated by ownership, meaningful technical challenges, customer impact and the opportunity to help shape a growing platform and engineering culture from the inside.

Compensation is tailored individually based on experience, responsibilities and team fit.

Application process

The process starts with an initial review and introductory conversation.

Selected candidates will continue through technical and team interviews, and we may include a practical technical assessment and personality assessment as part of the process.

We aim to move quickly while making thoughtful decisions for both the candidate and the team.

This is not a consultancy opportunity, and we respectfully ask not to be contacted regarding consultancy offers.

Tembi is a platform that helps companies use open data about markets and companies to focus their strategy and implement it in the daily routines. Many companies are now able to use their own data about their customers and sales processes etc. (business intelligence). But accessing and using the vast amounts of data from the world outside is much more difficult. Most companies don't have the competencies to do it. That makes it difficult for these companies to act optimally in a dynamic world with uncertain information. We help solving this problem. We collect and combine vast amounts of data from different sources and countries. We apply economic impact models and advanced analytics to solve business critical questions for our customers, such as which markets should they focus on, where is the next big client for us, what do we need to do to be competitive? Our dashboard based solution is easy to use and enables everyone from C-level to the floor to act more efficiently. Come work with us! 👋 We are currently around 20 people in the Tembi team, mostly working within Business Development & Sales and Product Development. But will be growing even more over the coming months. Our office is located in Fiolstræde, right in the heart of Copenhagen. We do a lot of social activities together, and always try to celebrate our success in some way. We have one monthly social activity, such as sports or escape room etc. And we also have summer parties, christmas parties and a friday bar with a different theme every month. When the circumstances require it, we can of course work remotely, but we generally like working together in the office - and we have a super nice lunch every day. Our company culture is based on four pillars. This is who we are: - Inspiring friends - Agile ignitors - Confident navigators - Curious enthusiasts

About the Job

Are you passionate about optimizing data platforms and ensuring seamless performance? Join our dynamic team in Copenhagen and play a key role in managing mission-critical database environments. We are a collaborative, solution-oriented team that thrives on innovation and efficiency.

As part of our Data Platforms team, you will work closely with developers, DevOps engineers, and system administrators to ensure high availability, security, and performance across on-premise SQL Servers and Azure SQL Managed Instances. This is an on-site position in Copenhagen with minimal travel expectations.

Responsibilities

• 
Diagnose and resolve database-related issues, including performance bottlenecks and connectivity problems.

• 
Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing, and configuration adjustments.

• 
Manage and maintain SQL Server (2019–2022) and Azure SQL Managed Instances for high availability and security.

• 
Collaborate with developers and DevOps teams to automate provisioning, deployments, and monitoring using CI/CD pipelines.

• 
Implement security policies, access controls, and compliance measures.

• 
Maintain comprehensive documentation for configurations and troubleshooting.

Your Profile

You are a proactive team player with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. You communicate clearly, work collaboratively, and bring a positive, solution-oriented mindset to every challenge.

Required competencies:

• 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent experience.

• 
5+ years of experience as a Database Administrator with expertise in troubleshooting and performance tuning.

• 
Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure PaaS services and SQL Server environments.

• 
Familiarity with DevOps practices, version control (Git), and CI/CD pipelines.

• 
Proficiency in SQL query optimization and scripting.

• 
Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Azure) are a plus.

Nice-to-have skills:

• 
Experience with PostgreSQL administration and performance tuning.

• 
Knowledge of Azure Cosmos DB (especially with MongoDB API).

We're building KickOff, our next-generation GitOps platform. You'll join during a pivotal moment: we're actively migrating services to KickOff, establishing new platform patterns and enabling 100+ engineers to ship faster and more reliably. We also maintain separate on-premises Kubernetes clusters running model training and video processing workloads.

This isn't a "keep the lights on" role. You'll shape platform architecture, drive technical decisions, and directly impact engineering velocity across both cloud and on-prem environments.

What You Will Do

You'll join the platform engineering team that owns these areas together. We share ownership, pair on complex work, and rotate responsibilities.

• Evolve KickOff (our GitOps platform) to improve developer experience.

• Support service migrations to KickOff, partnering with product teams.

• Maintain and optimize KickOff on AWS EKS.

• Manage our on-premises Kubernetes clusters running ML training workloads.

• Establish monitoring, alerting, and observability using LGTM.

• Debug distributed systems spanning multiple environments.

• Create documentation and tooling that makes infrastructure approachable

As the platform matures, you'll have opportunities to shape multi-cluster architecture, GPU workload scheduling, disaster recovery strategy, and cloud provider independence.

What You Could Bring

We're looking for someone with 3-5 years running production infrastructure, including:

• Production Kubernetes: You've operated K8s in production and understand the operational reality, not just tutorials.

• Platform-as-product mindset: You've built internal tooling that real teams use, gathered feedback, and measured impact on productivity.

• Infrastructure as Code: Strong Terraform, Crossplane, or similar experience.

• Observability: You've implemented monitoring and alerting that helps teams operate confidently.

• Security awareness: You know how to embed security into platform design without slowing teams down.

• Problem-solving: You debug complex distributed systems and design practical solutions.

• Collaboration: You work through discussion and feedback, share context effectively.

Nice to have: GitOps tools (Flux, ArgoCD), Cilium, multi-cloud architecture, on-prem K8s experience.

How We Work

You’ll join a Copenhagen-based platform team of 5 engineers with shared ownership of KickOff and our on-prem Kubernetes clusters. We work closely together day to day through pairing, code reviews, and a rotating ownership model for operational responsibilities and platform improvements.

You’ll collaborate regularly with the Processing Platform team on workload needs, reliability, and developer experience, and you’ll use feedback from product and engineering teams to shape platform priorities and improve how teams build and ship on KickOff.

We work pragmatically and iterate quickly. We document decisions, favor simple solutions where possible, and focus on tooling and platform patterns that help teams move faster with confidence.

You should be willing to work at the Playdead office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

You should be willing to work at the Playdead office in Copenhagen, Denmark.

jobs.occupation: Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS, Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for colleagues to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

You will be working in an enthusiastic Process Automation team with more than 80 colleagues in Denmark. Globally, the Process Automation team has more than 200 employees.

The Process Automation team works with consultancy, design & development, implementation and validation of Automation solutions for the Pharma and Biotech industries. Our work is project based, and currently we are looking into an exciting pipeline of large data driven, greenfield plants with modular/scalable designs.

We are skilled in a broad range of process areas within API production e.g. fermentation, recovery and purification, utility, and cleaning systems. And the solutions we provide to our customers are always based on a deep understanding of the customers’ production processes – and if standard components can’t do the job, we develop our own.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Senior Process Automation Engineer, you’ll be:

• Advising customers on their application process solutions

• Design developing, programming, commissioning, qualifying, FAT, SAT, UAT and Handover of applications for Distributed Control Systems (DCS)

• Interacting with process experts and colleagues with expertise in surrounding systems and equipment like MES, Historian systems, instruments, production equipment etc.

• Developing and optimizing automation methods and strategies to meet our customers’ needs and sharing working knowledge with colleagues and partners

• Forming the basis of automation strategies and architectures to support our sister departments internationally and expand NNE’s Process Automation engagement

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Understand your colleagues’ individual and cultural difference

• Are aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Are agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Are team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Are reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Are appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You have 6+ years or more of working experience and hold a degree as an engineer, ideally within electrical, automation, process or marine engineering

• You have 4 years or more of working experience with PCS/DCS Application development (for example ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine), working in GMP/GAMP environment or with execution of Automation projects

• Knowledge of batch production is valued

• You find the complexity of the GMP/GAMP environment exciting

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 13th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Christian Ljørring on +45 30 79 29 08 or Manager Rasmus Sølbeck Hansen +45 31 91 89 30

Please note:

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

jobs.occupation: Experienced ServiceNow Advisor and Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Company Description

With more than 3,000 employees, Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, Technology, and Transformations.

About the team

Deloitte’s ServiceNow department is looking for an experienced Enterprise Service Management Advisor and Solution Architect to join our A-team of ServiceNow advisors. As a Manager in our ServiceNow department, you will serve as a trusted advisor for our clients, guiding them on their digitalization journey. In this role, you will work with industry leading professionals, guiding clients through end-to-end digital transformation initiatives and driving complex enterprise-wide service modernization.

As a trusted advisor, you will play a key role in identifying and pursuing strategic business opportunities while leading the design and implementation of innovative ServiceNow solutions. You will collaborate with clients to transform IT, HR, Finance, Risk, and core business functions into streamlined, service-based organizations. This involves assessing the client’s needs, translating business requirements into tailored technology solutions, and providing strategic and best practice advisory. You will oversee the full project lifecycle, ensuring seamless execution from strategy to deployment, while providing thought leadership and industry insights that shape best practices.

Success in this role requires a deep understanding of enterprise service management, strong leadership in project execution, and the ability to build long-term client relationships based on trust and value creation. By delivering impactful solutions and driving meaningful business outcomes, you will help position Deloitte as the premier partner for digital transformation.

Job Description

ServiceNow is its own department, and you will join a team of incredibly dedicated, ambitious and great colleagues. Our team works closely together on projects across the Nordics, combining the right expertise and competencies to deliver the best solutions for our clients. While we thrive on cross-border collaboration, you will also have a strong local presence in our Copenhagen office, where we emphasize teamwork, community, and a shared commitment to excellence.

In this role, you will make an impact by:

• Providing strategic advisory for some of the largest ServiceNow clients in Denmark and the Nordics.

• Engaging proactively with clients, advising on solution and problem scoping across the organization to ensure alignment with business objectives.

• Designing comprehensive solutions, including technical design using design thinking methodologies to ensure alignment with ServiceNow’s Enterprise Service Management capabilities and best practices.

• Helping our clients in defining and optimizing Service Management processes to drive efficiency.

• Offering insights and guidance on application development, agile development, software development lifecycle and cloud applications.

• Leading the delivery of solutions and support teams in corrective measures.

• Work closely with Program Leadership to oversee and lead multiple workstreams of technical design- and delivery activities, create and maintain a network of potential clients, and be known as a trusted advisor and participate in consulting sales activities, including writing service proposals.

Qualifications

By joining our team as a Manager, you will become part of and contribute to our shared success. You will build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients to exceed expectations. Key responsibilities and tasks will involve:

You have the following skills and experience:

• A minimum of 5 years of experience working with ServiceNow or other digitalization platforms.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Hands-on experience leading end-to-end transformation projects in areas such as IT, HR, Finance, Risk or core business operations.

• Experience with IT Project Management and have the ability to oversee complex implementations and drive successful outcomes.

• Demonstrated consulting experience or prior experience as a Platform Owner, showcasing your ability to advise and lead clients through transformation initiatives.

• Familiarity with process frameworks such as Lean, TBM, ITIL or other methodologies relevant to your area of expertise.

• A strong technical background with an advanced understanding of key technical principles and best practices.

• Experience or a solid understanding of application development and software lifecycle management.

• Knowledge of technologies using client-server model and understanding of data-modelling, SQL data structures and system integrations.

• You are fluent in written and spoken English, and you should ideally have a high proficiency in Danish or a willingness to learn the language.

• You must have the right to live and work in Denmark.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can contribute to our team’s success**.**

What we offer you:

At Deloitte, we provide an environment where you can grow, innovate, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the ServiceNow field. Joining our team means becoming part of a dynamic and supportive workplace that values both professional and personal development.

• You will work alongside experts in the ServiceNow field, gaining insights and knowledge from top professionals in the field.

• You will experience a culture of continuous growth, where feedback and learning opportunities empower you to advance at your own pace.

• You will enjoy the flexibility of a hybrid work environment, allowing you to balance work and personal commitments in a way that suits you the best.

• You will gain access to ServiceNow certifications in the areas that interest you, enhancing your expertise and career prospects.

Additional Information

Do you want to be part of our team?

Click the "I am interested" button above if you are ready to join our team.

Send your CV and cover letter. In your cover letter, please describe your motivation and answer these following questions:

• ServiceNow Experience: Can you detail your hands-on experience with ServiceNow, including specific modules and functionalities you have worked with? Please provide examples of complex implementations or customizations you have led.

• Project Management Experience: Describe your project management experience, if possible in the context of ServiceNow projects. How have you managed multiple stakeholders and ensured project success?

We process applications and arrange interviews continually, so we recommend that you apply as soon as possible.

Expected start date: As soon as possible.

Please do not hesitate to contact Timothy Edward Intennimeo, Consultant at tintennimeo@deloitte.dk if you have any questions about the position.

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

By applying for this job, you will be assessed against the Deloitte Global Talent Standards. We have designed these standards to provide a consistent and exceptional Deloitte employee experience globally.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Are you an experienced project professional who excels at building structure, driving consistency, and elevating project execution?

To support our growth and expanding portfolio of projects, we are strengthening our focus on the Project Management Office (PMO). You’ll get a key role in developing, maintain, train, and educate on the processes, methodology, and tool chain used in project execution.

Your Role

As PMO Lead, you will report to the Head of Projects & Delivery. You will become responsible for all aspects of our best-practice project execution and will be deeply involved in improving and developing our methodologies.

The PMO standardizes project practices, supports project managers and project teams, and represents a highly operational function.

The PMO ensures alignment with business goals by supporting Business Management and provides oversight across the project portfolio. The PMO spans governance, methodology, reporting, process development, and process control. The PMO leads the development of methodologies used during the scale-up of the organization – and may potentially evolve into the competence center for Project Management.

Your tasks include:

• Governance & Standards: Define, maintain, and continuously improve PM methodologies, templates, and best practices, ensuring compliance with processes, quality standards, and stage-gate governance.

• Project Monitoring & Reporting: Monitor project performance across scope, schedule, budget, and risks, and consolidate insights into portfolio dashboards and KPIs for leadership decision-making.

• Resource & Capacity Support: Support resource allocation and forecasting with Team Leads and Project Managers, identify bottlenecks, and help optimize utilization across the project portfolio.

• Support & Enablement: Enable Project Managers through coaching, training, and hands-on support with documentation, planning, tools, and evaluation of new project opportunities.

• Risk, Issue & Change Management: Support structured identification and handling of risks, issues, and changes, including escalation processes and decision forums.

• PMO Development: Drive continuous improvement of PMO methodologies and capabilities to support faster, more scalable, and predictable project delivery aligned with business growth.

The PMO Lead role is highly central to harmonizing and further professionalizing our project execution capability. Running activities according to standards, ensuring quality in execution, and ensuring predictability and repeatability will be key elements of our success. This work will happen in close collaboration with the Engineering Excellence Manager. Furthermore, the PMO Lead will act as the deputy to the Head of Projects & Delivery when required.

Short- and Long-Term Success

In the first 6–12 months, success means:

• Establishing clear structure and ownership of PMO processes and methodologies

• Delivering consistent, high-quality reporting and portfolio visibility

• Building trust and strong collaboration with project managers and key stakeholders

Longer term, you’ll take ownership of maturing the PMO into a scalable capability that supports faster, more predictable project execution, while acting as a competence center for project management across the organization.

What You Bring

You’re an experienced project professional with a strong knowledge of project, program, and portfolio management methodologies, and governance frameworks. You have the ability to design, implement, and continuously improve processes, standards, and tools. You have a strategic and analytical mindset that makes it possible to align project execution with business objectives.

You likely:

• Have 3+ years of PMO or similar experience

• Have 5+ years of project management experience

• Preferably, have a technical background as an engineer or equivalent higher education

• Balance supportive guidance with governance and control responsibilities

• Have the experience to drive change and ensure adoption of new processes and ways of working

Who You Are

You’re not just defining processes - you ensure they are used, understood, and create value. You take ownership of execution and help teams succeed through clarity, structure, and support.

You bring:

• Strong organizational awareness and ability to manage cross-functional complexity

• Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills

• Continuous improvement mindset focused on efficiency, quality, and predictable delivery

• Capability to coach and develop project managers and build organizational competence

• True leadership: you take ownership of the PMO function and act with integrity

Why Join Us?

At GomSpace, we’re on a mission to shape the future of space – one mission at a time. Here, you’ll be part of something bigger than just a project or a product. You’ll help build systems that connect people, enable science, and expand humanity’s reach beyond Earth.

What You Bring

In this role, you will lead, and coordinate business development activities related to offsets, acting as the go-to expert internally and externally. You will translate national offset policies and political objectives into actionable business strategies and drive collaboration across internal teams to align resources and priorities.

Your tasks will include:

• Leading the development and implementation of offset and industrial cooperation strategies that support long-term growth.

As an Account Executive for the French Mid-Market, you’ll join our team at the heart of the action, right on our home turf in Copenhagen. You'll be literally at the centre of where the fun happens, with a unique opportunity to drive change and see the direct impact of your work on our business growth.

You’ll engage with senior decision-makers, uncover complex business needs and build compelling business cases that demonstrate the commercial value of Trustpilot. We’re not just selling SaaS. • Own and exceed a monthly revenue target through consistent pipeline creation and strong deal execution.

• Manage opportunities created through your own outreach, BDR-booked meetings and qualified inbound leads.

• Identify and engage key decision-makers, including C-level stakeholders, across multiple industries.

• Run structured discovery conversations to understand each prospect’s priorities, challenges, commercial objectives and decision-making process.

• Build compelling business cases and deliver tailored product demonstrations that clearly connect Trustpilot’s solutions to the prospect’s needs.

• Navigate more complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders, commercial negotiations and higher-value solutions.

• Use your initiative and commercial judgement to prioritise opportunities and manage your sales funnel effectively.

• Maintain accurate pipeline management and forecasting in Salesforce.

• Develop your capabilities for continued growth within Mid-Market and Enterprise SaaS sales.

• 3 years of experienced in full-cycle B2B sales, including outbound prospecting, qualification, discovery, demonstration, negotiation and closing.

• Proven track record in SaaS or Tech sales, with consistent quota achievement.

• Comfortable generating your own opportunities and maintaining a high level of outbound activity.

• Experienced in selling higher-value solutions to mid-market businesses and managing several stakeholders throughout the sales process.

• Confident in engaging with senior and C-level decision-makers and adapting your approach to the French business environment.

• Strong discovery and consultative selling skills, with the ability to translate business challenges into clear commercial value.

• Able to manage a varied pipeline while prioritising the opportunities most likely to progress and close.

• Competitive, resilient and motivated by achieving and exceeding targets.

• A proactive self-starter with the ambition to grow a career in Mid-Market and Enterprise SaaS sales.

• Knowledge of e-commerce, digital marketing or online reputation management is a plus.

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

Join Clobotics as a Sparrow Robot Operator and take part in robotic wind turbine blade repair operations at onshore and offshore locations worldwide. This hands-on role combines robotics, field operations, technical maintenance, and close coordination with wind industry teams.

The position is based in Esbjerg, Denmark.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct safe and efficient Sparrow robotic repair operations on wind turbines in accordance with regulatory requirements, company policies, and industry best practices.

• Remain calm under pressure, communicate clearly with team members, and follow operational checklists diligently.

• Perform regular maintenance checks, calibrations, and equipment troubleshooting to maintain system functionality and minimize downtime.

• Follow Clobotics safety protocols and risk-assessment procedures to mitigate potential hazards and maintain a safe working environment.

• Collaborate closely with vessel crews, client technicians, and control-room teams to support clear communication and effective use of working time.

• Maintain accurate records of daily progress and other required operational documentation.

• Keep up with industry best practices and emerging trends, pursuing opportunities for training and professional development.

Qualifications & Experience

• Relevant occupational certificates and training in line with our Occupational Training Matrix, along with any required client- or turbine-specific certifications.

• Clear written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Experience working offshore on crew transfer vessels or other support vessels, with technical or process equipment, or at onshore or offshore wind park sites is preferred.

• Good physical fitness for physically demanding work, a strong commitment to safety, and excellent attention to detail.

• Strong problem-solving skills, sound technical competence, and the ability to thrive as part of a team.

What We Offer

• A global working environment at a leading company in the automation and digitalization of wind turbine blade maintenance.

• Supportive colleagues, room for personal development, and a relaxed atmosphere with a winning mentality.

• A unique opportunity to work with advanced robotic technology in a growing company.

• Professional development and further training within the wind turbine service and robotics sector.

About Clobotics Wind Services

Clobotics is a global market leader in onshore and offshore wind turbine blade maintenance. We provide wind turbine operators and manufacturers with a full-scope service offering based on groundbreaking technology developed in-house, including robotics, autonomous drones, cloud processing, web portals, apps, and material technology.

Our EMEA operation is based in Esbjerg, Denmark, with sister companies in Seattle, Shanghai, and Singapore. The Danish team manages EMEA operations and develops projects designed for the European market.

Genmab is seeking an experienced Senior Clinical Drug Supply Manager to join our Global Clinical Drug Supply in Copenhagen. The role requires candidates to be within commuting distance of our office locations to work according to our hybrid work arrangement. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality clinical trial supplies for both early and late-stage trials.

As a Senior Manager, Global Clinical Drug Supply, you will play a pivot role supporting the development and execution of clinical drug demand forecasts and supply plans to ensure uninterrupted delivery of clinical development products across Genmab’s pipeline. Your responsibilities will include managing the demand planning and supply planning of clinical supplies. This role will partner closely with cross-functional clinical development and CMC teams to maintain accurate forecasts, support supply strategy execution, and contribute to the operational success of clinical programs. The Senior Manager will apply strong analytical, communication, and planning skills to ensure reliable clinical supply while contributing to continuous process improvement across GCDS.

As a Senior Clinical Drug Supply Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring efficient delivery of high-quality clinical trial supplies for both early and late-stage Genmab clinical trials worldwide.

The ideal candidate possesses an understanding of cGMP and a strong commitment to delivering high-quality work, demonstrating a proactive approach and willingness to go the extra mile to ensure the best outcome for patients.

This position is hybrid and requires you to be in the office 60% of the time.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Demand Planning & Forecasting

• Support the development, maintenance, and updates of clinical drug demand forecasts across assigned studies and programs.

• Collaborate with, CTT, and Finance to collect inputs and ensure forecasts reflect current enrollment trends, protocol changes, and assumptions.

• Manage the demand planning discussions as part of the Clinical Project Supply Team (CPST) and support forecasting activities within the CSIOP process.

• Identify potential demand risks and escalate issues in a timely manner, recommending mitigation actions where appropriate.

• Prepare demand plan summaries, enrollment updates, and cost forecasts to support program planning and operational reviews.

Supply Strategy & Execution

• Coordinate clinical supply–related planning activities, ensuring alignment between forecasted needs, study timelines, and supply availability.

• Support the execution of clinical supply chain sourcing strategies using third-party providers, in collaboration with Clinical Operations and Supply Leads.

• Contribute to communication of GCDS Planning Strategy within Global Clinical Teams, ensuring supply planning assumptions are clearly understood.

• Track supply readiness and highlight risks or gaps that could affect clinical trial continuity.

Supplier & Stakeholder Management

• Support Supplier Relationship Management activities by tracking supplier performance metrics and helping identify improvement opportunities.

• Build collaborative working relationships with cross-functional partners (Clinical Operations, CTT, CDM, Regulatory, CMC, QA, and Finance) to enable timely and accurate supply planning.

Budget & Cost Optimization

• Support budget development activities by preparing supply planning inputs and cost forecasts aligned with program needs.

• Monitor budget performance and identify variances, working with senior team members to implement cost-effective solutions.

Governance & Continuous Improvement

• Provide planning updates and forecasting insights to support governance forums (IRC, CTT, Asset Meetings).

• Ensure consistent use of supply chain processes, tools, and systems by adhering to established standards and contributing feedback for enhancements.

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives focused on advancing forecasting accuracy, operational efficiency, and collaboration across GCDS.

Quality & Regulatory Compliance

• Ensure demand planning and supply–related activities comply with GxP, regulatory standards, and Genmab quality expectations.

• Maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation for demand forecasts, planning assumptions, and supply updates.

• Support identification and resolution of compliance gaps and contribute to corrective and preventive actions as needed

• Adhere to the Genmab Quality Management System

Qualifications

•    Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or Supply Chain Management).

•    Minimum 8+ years of experience in clinical drug supply forecasting, supply planning, and demand planning

•    Demonstrated stakeholder management skills, both internally and externally.

•    Experience working with vendors and CMOs for clinical trial supplies will be an advantage.

•    Solid knowledge of GDP and GMP. Knowledge of GCP will be an advantage.

•    Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to excel in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

•    Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

•    Highly organized with a structured, process-oriented mindset that supports continuous improvement.

•    Ability to prioritize effectively while maintaining a high level of quality and compliance.

•    Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work both independently and within global teams.

•    Results-driven and goal-oriented, committed to contributing to Genmab’s success.

The Team

You will join a highly competent team focused on demand planning and supply planning on clinical supplies, collaborating closely with the Global Clinical Drug Supply Execution team. Together with the Global Clinical Drug Supply Systems team and Global Clinical Drug Supply Manufacturing team, these four functions form the Global Clinical Drug Supply department. We foster a supportive, international, and fast-paced work environment centered on collaboration, excellence, and a can-do attitude to achieve results.
