Job description

Trackman is the leading brand in its field, trusted by elite athletes worldwide. We’re growing and looking for a Senior Full Stack SDET who is passionate about quality engineering and excited to help test and improve world-class sports technology products.

This senior, full-stack quality engineering role spans backend API testing and frontend (Windows and web) application testing. You’ll combine strong automation skills with the ability to define end-to-end quality strategies across the Trackman ecosystem—from radar data pipelines to TM Performance Studio used by athletes and coaches worldwide.

You’ll join an international team and help elevate quality practices by mentoring peers, partnering closely with developers, product owners, and UI/UX designers, and championing a quality-first approach throughout the development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Design, build, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for both backend APIs (REST/GraphQL), web applications and Windows desktop applications

• 
Architect end-to-end test strategies covering integration, system, performance, and regression testing

• 
Lead test planning and review sessions within Agile/Scrum ceremonies alongside developers and product owners

• 
Drive quality across the full stack: from data ingestion APIs and cloud services through to client-facing Windows/Web applications

• 
Define and enforce test coverage standards, reporting metrics, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)

• 
Explore and implement AI-assisted testing techniques — including AI-generated test cases, intelligent test prioritisation, and anomaly detection — to increase testing efficiency and coverage

• 
Mentor and guide junior QA engineers and SDETs across the team

• 
Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineers to embed testing earlier in the development pipeline (shift-left)

• 
Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical architecture discussions from a testability perspective

• 
Conduct exploratory and risk-based testing to uncover edge cases beyond automated suites

Job requirements

The Ideal Candidate

• 
Holds a relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent (bachelor's level minimum)

• 
Has 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or SDET roles, with proven seniority in at least two of: backend API testing, desktop/Windows application testing, or test framework architecture

• 
Is highly proficient in C# for test automation, with strong understanding of object-oriented design principles.

• 
Has hands-on experience with API testing tools and frameworks (e.g., RestEaze, Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, or similar)

• 
Has experience testing Windows/Web based applications and understands UI automation frameworks

• 
Is experienced with Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD platforms for pipeline integration and test reporting

• 
Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to diagnose complex, cross-layer defects

AI & Emerging Technologies

• Has experience with and understands how AI and machine learning concepts can be applied within a quality engineering context

It Will Also Be a Plus If You Have

• 
Experience in the gaming or sports technology industry

• 
Knowledge of radar, computer vision, or sensor data systems

• 
Golf knowledge or broader sports interest — you don't need to be a pro, but a genuine passion for sports helps!

We Offer

• 
A senior, high-impact role in which you will directly shape Trackman's quality engineering culture and practices

• 
The chance to work with and test the world's leading sports tracking technology, trusted by elite athletes across golf, baseball, and football

• 
A collaborative, cross-functional team with 40+ highly skilled colleagues from more than 35 nationalities

• 
Exposure to cutting-edge technology — radar, computer vision, real-time data, and AI — in a unique product domain

• 
An open, informal, and ambitious company culture where great ideas are heard and innovation is encouraged

• 
Continuous learning and growth opportunities as Trackman scales

• 
Social activities and a vibrant team culture

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Job Description

Do you want to be a part of the development of our new e-commerce platform with more than 3.600 stores and 29 web shops? Or some of our more than 80 other java applications? In that case, come and join our Java department.

JYSK is a frontrunner in the development of online cross channel E-commerce. And with Unified Commerce, JYSK has launched its biggest IT initiative ever,

We are looking for a Student Software Engineer to join our Java Core team. In this role, you will not only support building applications - you will also support our Java developers across all agile teams.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We are in the middle of restructuring our IT landscape, turning it into a headless, event driven and microservice architecture. You will have a unique opportunity to build deep technical competencies while making a tangible difference for your colleagues.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• 
A student position averaging approximately 15 hours per week, with flexibility around your studies because we believe your education comes first

• 
A relaxed and open-minded atmosphere

• 
Sparring and feedback from skilled colleagues at all levels in the organisation

• 
A job with rich possibilities to influence the demanding technical solutions

• 
A corporate culture with a short distance from thought to action

• 
A job where you get the opportunity to develop professionally and personally

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As a Student Software Engineer in the Java Core team, your mission is to create hyper-productivity through AI enablement while simultaneously raising the quality, security, and consistency across teams and codebases. You will help identify opportunities to leverage AI in software development and contribute to building scalable tools and solutions that enable developers to work more efficiently and deliver high-quality software.

Your tasks and responsibilities will include:

• 
Supporting Java developers across all agile teams with cross-cutting tooling, standards, and best practices

• 
Exploring and implementing new ways to leverage AI, including GitHub Copilot and other AI-powered developer tools, to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and the overall developer experience

• 
Taking ownership of smaller applications and general shared libraries used across the organisation

• 
Working with modern technologies and frameworks, including Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and Kubernetes/Docker.

The Java team is responsible for a wide range of in-house developed applications. So, you will get the opportunity to work in different business areas and with different technologies.

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a new colleague who:

• 
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, with plans to continue into a Master's degree. Ideally, you are in the final stage of your Bachelor’s degree or have recently completed it.

• 
Has hands-on experience with software development through university, personal or hobby projects.

• 
Is passionate about software engineering and enjoys building tools that solve real problems.

• 
Is motivated to become a highly skilled software engineer and continuously strives to improve their technical and professional skills

• 
Writes clean, secure code and has a strong focus on quality and consistency

• 
Values testing and writes thorough unit and integration tests to ensure reliable software (familiarity with Test-Driven Development is a plus)

• 
Is curious about emerging technologies, engineering productivity, and AI-assisted development

• 
Enjoys learning and experimenting with innovative approaches

Additional Information

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Liliana Hajek, leh@jysk.com

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among our employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

CABIN CREW SAS

City:  Kastrup

Cabin Crew Opportunities at SAS

Join SAS Cabin Crew – Opportunities Across Scandinavia

SAS is expanding—connecting people, cultures, and destinations like never before, and we invite you to be part of the journey.

We are now recruiting Cabin Crew - Air Hosts/ Hostesses on different base locations across Scandinavia and also Air Stewards in Copenhagen.

• Copenhagen

• Stockholm

• Oslo

• Bergen

By joining SAS, you will become part of a passionate team dedicated to safety, service, and creating memorable travel experiences for our customers every day.

As Cabin Crew at SAS, you will meet people from all around the world while ensuring onboard safety, delivering excellent service, and representing one of Scandinavia’s leading airlines. Our Air Steward opportunities also include additional responsibilities connected to onboard dining and premium service delivery for candidates with strong hospitality and food & beverage backgrounds.

Whether you already have Cabin Crew experience or are looking for a new career beyond the ordinary, this is your opportunity to take off with SAS.

Minimum Requirements

To apply, you must:

• Be at least 18 years old ( 20 years old for Norway base location)

• Have completed high school education or equivalent

• Be between 160 cm and 190 cm tall (without shoes)

• Have a minimum of 2 years’ experience in a customer-facing role

• Be fluent in English, both spoken and written

• Have strong swimming skills

• Hold a valid EU passport allowing free travel worldwide

• Be able to work irregular hours, including weekends and public holidays

• Meet local residency and commuting requirements for your selected base location

• Be able to comply with SAS uniform regulations

The successful candidate

Experience from hospitality, sales, food & beverage service, restaurants, hotels, catering, or events is considered an advantage.

For some specialist onboard service opportunities, candidates with hospitality, culinary, wine, or premium service backgrounds may be especially relevant.

Previous Cabin Crew experience is considered an advantage but is not required for all positions.

Additional requirements for experienced Cabin Crew:

• Valid EASA Attestation and Medical

• Minimum one year of continuous experience as Senior Cabin Crew within the past five years

Security & Medical Requirements

• Employment requires an approved Security Assessment, including a security interview, 5-year background check, reference checks, and an exhaustive police certificate/clean record.

• Successful completion of the training course and meeting all company requirements for Cabin Crew employment.

• Good physical and mental health, as well as good vision (+/- 0.7 with or without correction). Candidates must be able to obtain medical approval according to EASA regulations. To read more about medical certification for Cabin Crew, click here: www.trafikstyrelsen.dk/arbejdsomraader/luftfart/flyvemedicin/-for-piloter-kabinepersonale-samt-flyveledere

• Employment also requires successful completion of drug and alcohol tests (blood and urine samples).

• Our premises and work are located within airport security restricted areas; therefore, candidates must be approved by the relevant aviation authorities.

• All steps above must be successfully completed before commencing Cabin Crew training.

We are looking for candidates who are:

• Strong team players with a positive and professional attitude

• Passionate about service, food, and guest experience

• Structured, punctual, and able to stay ahead in a busy environment

• Calm under pressure with strong problem-solving skills

• Comfortable taking responsibility and guiding others when needed

Our Culture at SAS

At Scandinavian Airlines, we focus on caring for people, delivering exceptional experiences for travelers, and advancing the transition toward more sustainable aviation. This is guided by our iCARE framework, reflecting our commitment to Inspiration, Collaboration, Accountability, Recognition, and Execution in everything we do.

As a future team member, you can expect to be part of a collaborative environment where shared goals drive performance, contributions are recognized, and successes are celebrated. We place strong emphasis on safe, sustainable, and punctual operations while actively working to reduce environmental impact and transform for the future.

Additional information

Recruitment Process

Our recruitment process includes:

• Application and online assessment

• Video introduction

• Assessment Center

• Background and security checks

• Medical examination and testing

• Cabin Crew training

Recruitment takes place based on operational needs. Upcoming training courses are planned for fall 2026 and spring 2027.

How to Apply

Please note that SAS is partnering with AAP Aviation for this recruitment process. To apply, please use the relevant application links below. Only applications submitted through these channels will be accepted.

Air Stewards Copenhagen

SAS | Air Steward | Copenhagen | 2026-2027 – AAP Aviation Job Portal

Air Host/Hostess Stockholm

SAS | Cabin Crew | Stockholm | 2026-2027 – AAP Aviation Job Portal

Air Host/Hostess Copenhagen

SAS | Cabin Crew | Copenhagen | 2026-2027 – AAP Aviation Job Portal

Air Host/Hostess in Oslo

SAS | Cabin Crew | Oslo | 2026-2027 – AAP Aviation Job Portal

Due to the high number of applications, response times may be longer than usual. If you have not received a rejection, your application may still be under review.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact: cc@aapaviation.com

Looking forward to meeting you - come and fly with us!

SAS, Scandinavia's leading airline since 1946, operates from its principal hub at Copenhagen Airport (CPH), complemented by hubs in Oslo (OSL) and Stockholm (ARN). Our mission is to connect Scandinavia with the world and the world with Scandinavia. Each year, SAS serves more than 25 million passengers and transports 55 tons of cargo to 135 destinations across Europe, the USA, and Asia. With a passionate workforce of over 10,000 colleagues, we collaborate with partners and customers to drive transformative changes in aviation. We are committed to achieving net-zero emissions by 2050, embodying the visionary spirit of our founders: “To move from the old to what is about to come, is the only tradition worth keeping”. Innovation and societal progress are at the heart of everything we do. For more information, visit our website at www.flysas.com or follow us on social media for the latest updates and promotions.

Do you want to use your skills in pioneering technology in a highly dynamic, ambitious environment with broad variety of exciting projects? In Welltec, cutting-edge technology and global development are high on the agenda, and we are looking for colleagues within mechanical engineering to take this journey to the next level.

A world-class company

Welltec® is an international oilfield service company and a leading specialist partner to the energy industry.

Our values are to be Pioneering, Visionary, Dedicated, and Agile.

We develop and manufacture precision-controlled technologies which provide the most unique and advanced Completion and Intervention solutions, which assist our clients in maximizing recovery from their assets.

We always look to the future, utilizing our intelligence, imagination and expertise to create new opportunities. We have won several industry awards for innovative thinking. We are enjoying constant growth worldwide through the wide adoption of our cutting-edge solutions.

Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we are active and train our employees to operate our state-of-the-art technologies to provide services to our high-profile clients in the region.

The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employees come with very different backgrounds but with a common wish to collaborate and succeed.

The department

At Welltec, you will join our mechanical department situated in our completions Design & Engineering (D&E) function which currently consists of over 20 colleagues worldwide with various educational backgrounds and nationalities. In D&E we closely together - in order to get a holistic approach to our products and tools and to benefit from each other’s knowledge and expertise. In D&E, the work environment is informal, creative and fun but at times it can be complex, challenging, and fast-paced.

The team that you will join is responsible for the development and maintenance of Welltec’s proprietary metal expandable packer technology and other innovative technologies which we constantly introduce to the market through our global footprint.

The position

As a mechanical engineer within Design and Engineering (D&E) you will have the possibility to be innovative and create technology solutions from the idea phase to the commercial implementation. The main task is to develop new technologies where your focus will be development of mechanical systems. You will, together with the team, be part of conceptualization of products and detailed design development both for prototypes and commercial design. You will work in an environment where you will be able to develop your skills and where innovation is a key focus and you will be part of an agile business where your input will be heard. Travelling for exhibition and conferences related to the energy market can be expected to a smaller extent.

As our new Mechanical Engineer, you will:

• Be part of concept phase as team and have ownership of design and manufacturing package

• Conduct prototype assembly and function testing/troubleshooting

Ensure collaboration with relevant teams and stakeholders within the organisation

• Cooperate with sub-contractors

• Take ownership of schedules and delivery times

• Challenge the business with new ideas and concepts

• Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the Design and Engineering (D&E) department

Your tasks will include:

• Work on technical projects through all development phases

• Working in teams on development projects with both own and shared tasks

• Conceptualization and feasibility studies

• Design review guided by DFM, FMEA principles and robust design thinking

• 3D mechanical design

• Trouble shooting on both existing solutions as well as new solutions under development

• Provide your guidance and input in your specific expert areas across the whole organization

The candidate

You are proactive in your daily tasks and have an analytical and critical approach to problem solving. You have a quick, creative mind with a natural understanding of complex concepts and systems. The ideal candidate is someone who gets excited by technology and open-ended challenges as described above. In order to perform well in this role, you should also have the following qualifications or similar competencies:

The preferred candidate has the following profile:

• Mechanical Engineer B.Sc, M.Sc. or similar background

• Experience from oilfield, energy sector, hydraulics, precision mechanics, electro mechanical systems, mechatronics or similar is a plus

• Takes ownership of tasks and projects – enjoys broad responsibility

• Agile Project Management skills

• Is an experienced CAD user in Catia Software or similar system

• Is experienced in the use of FEA simulations in ANSYS or similar system

• Most importantly – commitment to learn the skills not yet acquired but required for the job

What we offer

Working with Welltec® means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting and rewarding, and it is a varied place to work. Welltec® is an equal opportunity employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate. Also, Welltec® has a competitive compensation package.

The process

If you are interested in the position submit your resume and cover letter online via the link below.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon if you believe you fit the role.

Does the idea of working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment excite you? Are you an ambitious individual with a strong interest in energy markets? Then you might be our new Junior Gas Trader!

As a Junior Gas Trader at Nitor Energy, you will play a key role in an established commodity trading desk and contribute to our common goal – always being the best at what we do! As part of our gas team, you will trade gas across Europe as well as developing and improving trading strategies.

This role is ideal for someone who is finalizing their master’s degree (or a recent graduate) and is eager to challenge the status quo of the energy sector. No prior experience in the industry is required – we are ready to teach you everything you need to know and help you grow. However, being analytical, reflective, and quick on your feet is essential to excel in this role.

Let’s dive into the details!

Your responsibilities will include

• Trading European gas like a strategy game, where every decision counts

• Analyzing real-time market data to spot opportunities and make winning trades. Think of it as solving a puzzle where the pieces keep moving

• Developing and executing trading strategies in a fast-paced, competitive environment

• Managing risk and reward

• Keeping an eye on market trends, news, and data to stay ahead of the competition

• Balancing quick ad hoc tasks with bigger quantitative projects, all aimed at improving your trading performance

• Collaborating with your team to refine strategies and share insights

What we’re looking for

• You are currently finalizing your master’s degree in finance, business, mathematics, physics or similar (or have recently graduated)

• You are a true team player with a positive mindset and ready to participate in our 24/7/365 shift setup

• You hold strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills

• You have an executing mindset and are confident in making quick decisions both independently and as part of a team

• You have a winning mentality and are willing to go the extra mile to challenge the status quo

• You thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same, and where your team members are always tossing you the ball – figuratively and literally – so you must be ready to catch it!

What we offer

• A young, dynamic, ambitious and fun work environment

• Extensive opportunities for personal development and career growth. You will be given responsibility from day one and receive close sparring with skilled colleagues

• The opportunity to contribute and make your mark on a young company’s development

• A competitive salary package

• A fun and social work environment with regular team events and social activities throughout the year. We also offer weekly sports activities to strengthen team spirit, including our Nitor running club.

• Delicious lunch arrangement with food from Meyers in our own canteen

• Brand new office facilities located in the heart of Aarhus, right next to Dokk1 and Letbanen

Expected start date: Flexible within the next 6 months

DESIGN OF INTELIGENT HYDRAULIC SYSTEMS FOR CUSTOMIZED BRAKING APPLICATIONS

Vejstrup

Can you see yourself working in a well-established Application & Control department with competent and motivated colleagues? Can you envision yourself designing solutions that create safety and security in every type of braking application where large forces or special conditions apply?

Then you might be the next engineer to join the team at Svendborg Brakes.

Develop innovative brake solutions for demanding applications

Together with your competent colleagues in the Application & Control Department, you will be involved in projects related to customer-specific applications. These applications must function in environments such as underwater turbines, submarines, elevators, or at high altitudes in the mountains of Tibet. The applications are diverse and offer plenty of design challenges.

Based on specifications and timelines, projects are led by a Project Manager. This allows you to focus on the technical aspects of the projects as well as managing your own project timeline. Your tasks will include:

• 
Technical adjustments of the core product and components for braking systems

• 
Design and construction of braking systems and components, including hydraulic systems

• 
Leading and ensuring the execution of testing these designs in the test center and production facilities

• 
Preparing technical documentation, including drawings and bills of materials (BOMs)

• 
Participation in development projects, including new material types and customer-specific projects.

Your typical workday will be a mix of independent work and a cross-functional collaboration, as solutions are often found through interdisciplinary collaboration. Among other things, you will work closely with a technical designer who supports you by creating technical documentation.

Svendborg Brakes has its own hydraulic manufacturing and test center, where designs can be tested and where customers visit to follow the project progress. This means you will be able to see your projects through from start to finish.

You are passionate about engineering and intelligent hydraulic systems

We are looking for an engineer with a strong passion for engineering and hydraulics. You have both an interest in and experience with mechanical design, hydraulics, and electrical control systems, and you are motivated by continuously developing your skills. You most likely hold a degree in mechatronics or mechanical engineering and have at least three years of professional experience.

You take a structured approach to your work and maintain a strong overview of tasks and processes. You understand that respecting specifications and timelines leads to the best results and strongest collaboration. You communicate effectively with people from different professional backgrounds and interact effortlessly with both customers and colleagues across departments.

In addition, you are fully comfortable communicating in English, both verbally and in writing.

Do you want to join the team?

At Svendborg Brakes, you will experience a flat organizational structure and an informal culture, where you have the freedom to plan your own workday and the projects you are involved in. You will also be part of a close cross-functional collaboration, where colleagues complement each other across projects with their individual areas of expertise.

Svendborg Brakes’ willingness and motivation to explore new technologies - as one of the world leaders in this field - is evident throughout the company. In other words, you will join a team with high level of expertise and a strong dedication to continuous development. This gives you a unique opportunity to develop your skills based on your interests and motivation.

jobs.description:
The Position:

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is seeking candidates for its newly established Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026. These internship opportunities are on-site at SCMU’s office in the UN City headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

SCMU offers specialized functional streams aligned with its operational needs, including:

• Data & Analytics

• Logistics & Supply Chain

• Procurement & Business

• Humanitarian Supplies

• Supply Chain & Customer Service

• Governance, Risk & Compliance

• Communications

• Human Resources

• Information and Communications Technology (ICT)

• Administration & Business

To ensure effective team integration and maximize the value of the internship, candidates must be logistically and financially prepared to undertake full-time, on-site work in Copenhagen for the duration of the internship.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead UN agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is wanted, every childbirth is safe and every young person's potential is fulfilled.  UNFPA’s strategic plan (2026-2029), reaffirms the relevance of the current strategic direction of UNFPA and focuses on three transformative results: to end preventable maternal deaths; end unmet need for family planning; and end gender-based violence and harmful practices. These results capture our strategic commitments on accelerating progress towards realizing the ICPD and SDGs in the Decade of Action leading up to 2030. Our strategic plan calls upon UN Member States, organizations and individuals to “build forward better”, while addressing the negative impacts of the Covid-19 pandemic on women’s and girls’ access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights, recover lost gains and realize our goals.

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is self-funded and was made operational in January 2022. It is tasked with ensuring that UNFPA is able to effectively and efficiently support the delivery of life-saving reproductive health products and other programme supplies to the end user when and where they are needed. To achieve this, it is important to strengthen the capacity of governments and implementing partners to ensure coordination, end-to-end visibility and accountability on all supply chain and logistics management related activities, in particular for programme supplies, across all UNFPA programmes.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff, who embody these international norms and standards, and who will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates that transform, inspire and deliver high impact and sustained results; we need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them and who commit to deliver excellence in programme results.

Eligibility:

Educational requirements

a. Be enrolled in a first university degree programme (such as bachelor’s degree or equivalent) and have completed one full academic year;

b. Be enrolled in a postgraduate degree programme (such as master’s programme or higher);

c. Have recently graduated with a university degree as defined above and, if selected, must start the internship within one-year of graduation; or

d. Be enrolled in a postgraduate professional trainee programme and undertake the internship as part of this programme.

Other eligibility requirements

e. Demonstrate interest in the field of development;

f.  Demonstrate written and spoken proficiency in at least one of the working languages of the United Nations (English or French) and fluency in the official language (Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian or Spanish) of the UNFPA office; and

g. Demonstrate ability to adapt to new environments and to establish and maintain good working relations with individuals of different cultural backgrounds.

An individual whose father, mother, son, daughter, brother or sister is a UNFPA staff member is not eligible for an internship with UNFPA.

Required Competencies:

Values:

• Exemplifying integrity,

• Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,

• Embracing cultural diversity,

• Embracing change

Core Competencies:

• Achieving results,

• Being accountable,

• Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen,

• Thinking analytically and strategically,

• Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships,

Financial Support:

Interns who do not receive financial support from an outside party (such as an academic institution, university, government) are eligible to receive a stipend as a contribution towards living expenses. The stipend is based on the intern’s agreed place of work, which may be different from the duty station of the hiring office in cases of remote arrangements. The stipend is normally paid in local currency at the end of each month.

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is at the heart of UNFPA's workforce - click here to learn more.

Disclaimer:

UNFPA does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process and does not concern itself with information on applicants' bank accounts.

The Deloitte Master's Thesis Hub bridges bright students with unanswered questions Deloitte is curious about.

The program is a great place to meet like-minded students navigating the ups and downs of thesis writing. Best of all, you'll have the invaluable opportunity to get guidance and support during the writing process and tap into the expertise of Deloitte's thought leaders, who will guide you on the path of creating an impactful master thesis!

Our Deloitte experts will be able to provide collaboration and guidance within the following five research topics:

• M&A & Strategy

• Sustainability & ESG

• Financial Performance & Reporting

• Digital Transformation & AI

• Organization & Change Management

Deloitte invests in providing relevant business insight and latest industry trends, challenging your thought process, and giving access to a large network of experts in the specific problem domain. We help develop your problem-solving skills and show you tips and tricks to present research findings concisely. Most importantly, the Master's Thesis Hub offers a room for reflection and shared learning between participants and experts.

By applying to the Master’s Thesis Hub, you will commit to attending four dedicated sessions from January – April 2026 for shared learning and pro-level guidance. To round of the Master Thesis Hub we will have a celebration dinner in June 2026, to congratulate you on your new degree. All sessions will be held in the Deloitte office in Copenhagen (Weidekampsgade 6, 2300 Copenhagen S). Note that it is a requirement to attend all sessions physically at the Copenhagen office to be a part of the program.

Are you ready? We are looking forward to receiving your application!

How to apply?

To apply, click "I'm interested" and upload your CV (along with the CVs of your group members if applicable). You will also be asked to answer a few practical questions.

Final deadline for signing up is the 4th of December. You will receive a response regarding your application shortly thereafter.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Location

This position can be based in either Denmark or London/Oxford, United Kingdom.

Your impact begins here

As AI Execution Manager, you will help shape how AI transforms Research & Development at Novo. Working at the intersection of science, digital innovation and business execution, you will partner with senior leaders, researchers and technology teams to turn strategic priorities into high-impact initiatives that create measurable value. Your work will accelerate the pace at which AI and digital capabilities translate into progress for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you'll bring

• An advanced degree (Master's or PhD preferred) in life sciences, providing the scientific foundation to engage confidently with experts across Research & Development.

• A strategic mindset with the ability to bring structure to ambiguity, shape complex initiatives and connect scientific and technical opportunities with broader organisational priorities.

• A proven track record of leading high-impact initiatives, influencing senior stakeholders and building alignment across complex matrix organisations to deliver measurable outcomes.

• Strong digital and AI understanding, including appreciation of how technology products and capabilities are developed, implemented and scaled within large organisations.

• A demonstrated understanding of how large pharmaceutical or life sciences organisations operate, with experience working across scientific, technical and business functions.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with scientific, technical and executive audiences.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Desirable:

• Experience from management consulting, digital transformation or a related strategic advisory environment.

• Direct experience in pharmaceutical or biotech R&D settings.

What you'll do

You will translate strategic AI and digital priorities into successful execution across Research & Development, from target discovery through to clinical development. Your focus will be on shaping, coordinating and delivering initiatives that create tangible organisational impact.

• Partner with scientific and business leaders to identify and shape high-impact AI and digital initiatives, translating opportunities into clear, actionable programmes.

• Lead complex cross-functional initiatives across R&D, including collaborations with external partners and technology leaders.

• Provide strategic guidance and coordination across AI initiatives, ensuring alignment between scientific objectives, technology capabilities and business priorities.

• Act as a trusted partner who translates between scientific, technical and business perspectives to support informed decision-making.

• Build alignment across senior stakeholders and drive complex initiatives through to successful delivery in a global matrix organisation.

Who you'll work with

You will join the AI Execution team within AI & Digital Innovation, part of Research & Development. The team partners across R&D, from target discovery through to clinical development, to identify, shape and deliver high-impact initiatives that create measurable value. Working across science, technology and business, your team helps transform ambitious ideas into tangible organisational impact.

Your closest partners will include senior scientific and business leaders across R&D, technology and digital teams, and external partners. You will work across functions and organisational levels, bringing different perspectives together to build alignment and move initiatives forward with clarity and pace.

What you can expect here

You will work at the forefront of AI and digital innovation in a global healthcare company that is investing significantly in science and technology. The role offers the opportunity to shape how R&D operates, build new skills through cross-functional collaboration and grow your expertise at the intersection of science, AI and business.

You will be trusted to take ownership, make your voice heard and contribute your expertise where it matters most. The work moves at pace, and curiosity, adaptability and a drive for impact are valued every day.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

Start now

Mission

The role in Supply is a vital part of Newrest’s operations, and contributes to a safe, accurate and efficient operation of the warehouse inventory. This role ensures that the inventory is accurate daily and that full Inventory counts are done according to local guidelines.

Responsibilities:

Receiving:

• 
Assisting when needed and the first point of entry for our products

• 
Restacking pallets for counting date coding and item numbering

• 
Rejecting any product that does not meet our quality standards

 Inventory Control:

• 
Ensuring all boxes have codes, receipt dates and expiration dates

• 
First in First Out (FIFO) – First Expired First Out (FEFO)

• 
Ensuring all boxes are closed and on pallets

• 
Ensuring any decanted products are in plastic crates

• 
Repacking pallets and putting them away into their correct locations

Communication:

• 
 Via messaging platforms

• 
Use Winrest to control our inventory

Gate Keeping:

• 
Recounting any product that leaves the warehouse (Verification at the gate)

• 
Taking photos of products leaving the warehouse with the label showing

• 
Ensuring products are correctly decanted

• 
Ensuring the Output Forms (OF) are accurate on Winrest from other departments and from within the warehouse

Inventory Counts:

• 
 Daily cycle counts (Top moving and highest value)

• 
Change shifts to accommodate the Company inventory counts every 10 days

• 
Swap another day off to ensure that the full team is at the inventory count

• 
Participate in the counting and inputting of the inventory from start to finish

• 
Understand and be accountable for inventory discrepancies

• 
Ensure warehouse organization & stock rotation including cleanliness

• 
Reporting of discrepancies with corrective actions to stop issues reoccurring

• 
Compliance with Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP)/General manufacturing practices (GMP) guidelines for personal hygiene and observe security precautions as mandated by unit management.

Profile:

 Qualifications:

• 
 High School diploma or equivalent.

• 
Previous experience in warehouse operations, stock counting, or logistics preferred.

• 
Attention to detail and ability to work efficiently under pressure.

• 
Forklift certification is a plus.

• 
Must be able to read, write and speak English and preferably Danish (not a must)

• 
You must live in Denmark of Sweden. Applicants who do not live in Denmark or Sweden will not be taken into consideration.

• 
Permanent working permit is a plus.

Some of your tasks require lifting and pushing pallets in an occasionally cold environment, so you must be in good physical shape. 

You must be able to perform and maintain a background check throughout the employment as you must be eligible for working in Denmark. This includes an unmarked criminal record.

We are looking forward to receiving your cv (you do not have to submit a cover letter) as soon as possible. The opening is closed as soon as we get the ideal candidates.

If you haven't heard from us, no later than 14 days after applying, we have moved on with other candidates.

 Newrest Denmark is a French based catering company providing catering services to SAS in Copenhagen Airport. We are approximately 400 employees, located in Dragør close to the Airport.

Are you a Maintenance Technician looking for a stable and rewarding career in a high‑tech production environment? Do you want to work with state‑of‑the‑art automation and electrical systems while developing your skills with the potential to progress into a leadership role?

At C&D Foods (Denmark), we take pride in producing high‑quality pet food that customers and pet owners trust. As a key member of our engineering team, you will play a vital role in maintaining our commitment to excellence by ensuring all products meet the highest food safety and quality standards. You will work as part of a team of multi‑skilled technicians, apprentices, and contractors to maintain, install, and improve processing equipment across production areas (kitchen operations, filling, packing, and site services).

We are looking for highly motivated professionals to strengthen our technical team. We offer a dynamic work environment, modern technology, and a strong team culture where your expertise will make a real difference!

Maintenance Operations

Automation & Electrical Systems

•

Work close with production and other internal departments to ensure equipment reliability and maintain up‑to‑date documentation

In addition to the examples mentioned above, all maintenance and engineering activities must comply with applicable Health & Safety, food safety, and quality standards, ensuring full adherence to internal procedures and regulatory requirements relevant to food and pet food production environments.

• 
Relevant mechanical and/or electrical experience)

Fluent in English (It will be an advantage if you speak Danish or are currently learning it).

Experience with PLC systems, automation, and industrial electrical installations is a plus.

• 
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently

• 
You have a "can do attitude"

• 
A proactive team player with a structured and solution-oriented mindset

• 
Open to learning and growing into a leadership role in the future

We offer

You will become part of the C&D Foods family, an international company with a multicultural environment, across nationalities and cross-functional teams, where collaboration, diversity, and inclusion are part of everyday life. We prioritize employee well-being, work-life balance, and personal development.

• 
Competitive salary

• 
Health and dental insurance

• 
3 × 12‑hour shift pattern

• 
4 consecutive days off

• 
Modern automation and production technology

• 
Continuous learning and technical development

• 
Broad exposure across multiple disciplines

• 
Supportive and collaborative team culture

You will take on a responsible role with varied tasks in an international company with a solid financial foundation and strong values.

How to apply

Please send your CV describing your interest in the position. Please note that applications should only be submitted via our website and not by other means.

About C&D Foods

C&D Foods is one of Europe’s leading producers of private label pet food, manufacturing a wide range of both wet and dry food. The company’s headquarters are located in Mullingar, County Westmeath.

As part of ABP Food Group, C&D Foods has grown to become one of the industry’s leading pet food manufacturers.

C&D Foods currently operates 9 production facilities across 7 countries (Ireland, United Kingdom, France, Denmark, Austria, Spain, and the Netherlands) as well as 2 sales offices in Manchester and Italy.

jobs.occupation: Personal Assistant to the Sales Director
jobs.description:
Are you naturally organised, commercially curious and motivated by working close to business decisions? Do you enjoy connecting people, keeping things moving and making sure the details are in place? 

Then this could be your opportunity to take on a central role in SELECTED's international sales organisation.

YOUR TEAMYou will become part of SELECTED's international wholesale organisation, working closely with the Sales Director and Sales Management Team. From this central position, you will collaborate with colleagues across departments and markets, helping connect people, priorities and business initiatives.You will also work closely with the PA network across SELECTED and take part in the strategic steering group, giving you insight into the decisions and priorities shaping our sales organisation.

YOUR ROLEAs Personal Assistant to our Sales Director, you will combine business support, coordination and project-related responsibilities with the day-to-day tasks that keep a busy sales organisation running smoothly. You will work closely with the Sales Director as a trusted sparring partner, contributing your own perspectives, asking questions and challenging ideas when you see opportunities to do things differently.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Coordinating and following up on projects and strategic initiatives across the Wholesale organisation.

• 
Preparing presentations, business updates and management materials that support discussions and decisions.

• 
Supporting business reporting, KPI follow-up and the preparation of relevant insights.

• 
Working with colleagues across departments and markets to ensure clear communication and progress on agreed actions.

• 
Managing day-to-day PA responsibilities, including meeting preparation, minutes, scheduling and practical coordination.

• 
Improving processes and exploring how AI and digital tools can simplify administrative tasks and ways of working.

YOUR BENEFITSAt SELECTED, you'll have the opportunity to get close to the business and build valuable experience in an international sales organisation. You can look forward to:

• 
Working directly with the Sales Director and getting involved in the priorities and initiatives shaping our commercial direction.

• 
Collaborating with colleagues across markets and departments, building relationships and gaining insight into different parts of the business.

• 
Taking ownership of your work, contributing your ideas and developing your skills through varied responsibilities.

YOUR PROFILEYou are curious about business, naturally outgoing and enjoy working with people across different teams and levels. You find it easy to build relationships and bring structure to a busy environment. You take initiative, speak up when you have a different perspective and are comfortable questioning decisions when something doesn't make sense. At the same time, you take pride in getting the practical details right and following through on your commitments.Your background could be in business support, coordination or a related field, but previous experience as a Personal Assistant is not essential. What matters most is your willingness to take responsibility for both the administrative and business-related aspects of the role.

We also imagine that you:

• 
Have strong organisational skills and know how to prioritise when several things need your attention.

• 
Are comfortable using Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook.

• 
Are interested in AI, digital tools and using data to support better decisions.

• 
Are fluent in written and spoken English and Danish.

Experience from the fashion industry or knowledge of German would be an advantage, but neither is a requirement.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOUIf you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to reach out to Pernille Dyrendom Thøgersen, Personal Assistant, on +45 30 85 33 58. Otherwise send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 4 December 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to close the recruitment once we have found the right candidate.

jobs.occupation: Communications Student Assistant – Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team
jobs.description:
About ICARS    The International Centre for Antimicrobial Resistance Solutions (ICARS) is an independent international organisation established by the Danish Government to support low- and middle-income countries in developing evidence-based and context-appropriate solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Working across the One Health spectrum, ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation.    About the role   We are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team. This is a great opportunity for a student interested in digital communications, creative media, data management and global health and development. You’ll support our day-to-day activities and help communicate ICARS’ work on AMR in LMICs.   We’re looking for someone with strong technical skills who also takes initiative to bring fresh ideas to the team. Alongside delivering assigned tasks, you will be encouraged to suggest improvements and take ownership of agreed activities, with support and feedback from colleagues.      Key responsibilities    Website management:    	
•  	Maintain and update content on ICARS’ WordPress website, keeping it accurate, accessible and user-friendly.  	    	
•  	Track website performance using analytics tools and suggest improvements based on the findings.  	    	
•  	Proactively identify outdated content, gaps and opportunities to better showcase our work.  	   Graphic design & visual content:    	
•  	Create engaging infographics, social media graphics and report layouts that align with ICARS’ brand.  	    	
•  	Help develop templates and designs for reports and presentations, bringing fresh ideas for communicating complex information clearly.  	    	
•  	Video editing & multimedia:  	    	
•  	Edit videos for ICARS’ social media, presentations and events.  	    	
•  	Support video production and identify opportunities to turn existing footage into useful, engaging content.  	   Social media support :    	
•  	Support ICARS’ LinkedIn presence through content creation and community engagement.  	    	
•  	Keep an eye on relevant conversations, project updates and sector developments, suggesting timely stories and opportunities for ICARS to contribute.  	   Internal communications support:    	
•  	Maintain our internal SharePoint, including keeping our media library organised and up to date.  	    	
•  	Support colleagues with designing clear, engaging PowerPoint slides and formatting Word documents.  	   Press Office and external communications support:    	
•  	Assist with event promotion and Mailchimp newsletter creation.  	    	
•  	Monitor our communications mailbox, respond to routine enquiries and coordinate with colleagues on requests from stakeholders, including regional and national press.  	    	
•  	Flag relevant media and communications opportunities for the team to consider.  	   Data and stakeholder information management:    	
•  	Support the team in entering and maintaining accurate, up-to-date data and contact information in ATLAS, our CRM system.  	    	
•  	Other tasks related to deliverables of the Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team.   	      Desired profile    We are seeking an organised and curious student who enjoys both developing ideas and getting things done in a pro-active and structured manner. You take the initiative to find information, ask useful questions and suggest practical next steps. You can work independently, recognise when to seek guidance and lead tasks through to completion, while keeping colleagues informed. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly, and you bring strong digital fluency, technical skills and the ability to pick up new tools with ease.   Required qualifications:    	
•  	Currently studying for a Master’s degree in IT, Media Studies, Marketing, Graphic Design or a related field.  	    	
•  	Proficiency in WordPress and basic website management.  	    	
•  	Experience using MS Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.  	    	
•  	Experience with graphic design tools, such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.  	    	
•  	Basic video editing skills, using Premiere Pro, Final Cut or similar software.  	    	
•  	Strong organisational skills, working in a structured manner and with attention to detail.  	    	
•  	Ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks.  	    	
•  	Ability to identify opportunities, propose ideas and take responsibility for delivering agreed tasks.  	    	
•  	Strong written and verbal communication skills in perfect and fluent English, including the ability to adapt content for different audiences.  	   Preferred qualifications:    	
•  	Knowledge of Google Analytics, or a willingness to learn.  	    	
•  	Experience using CRM platforms (Dynamics 365)  	    	
•  	Skills and interest in drafting technical and scientific communication material.  	      What we offer     	
•  	Hands-on experience: Contribute to drafting communications material, external stakeholder management and partnerships, developing your skills through practical work and feedback.  	    	
•  	Impact: Help communicate solutions to one of the world’s most critical global health and development challenges, with space to contribute your own ideas and see them put into practice.  	    	
•  	Flexible working hours: Our working hours between 8 am and 5 pm with accommodation of your academic schedule.  	    	
•  	International environment: Work alongside experts and colleagues from diverse backgrounds in a global organisation.  	   If you enjoy turning ideas into action and want to use your communications skills to support global health, we would love to hear from you!      Terms of employment   The position as student assistant will be covered by the terms of the collective agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation of Public Employees (OAO-S-Fællesoverenskomsten) and the organizational agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation for Salaried Employees HK/Stat (Organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK)), according to chapter 6 in the agreement concerning hourly paid employees.   The successful candidate is enrolled at graduate level in a Danish University with at around two years of studies remaining. They will predominantly work from the ICARS HQ office, based at the Statens Serum Institut in Copenhagen, Denmark.      Application and recruitment process     Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying.     We would like to receive your application by 20 November 2026 and expect to conduct interviews 24-27 November 2026.   For questions about the role, please contact Communications Officer Chloe Modvig-Cole (checo@icars-global.org) and for other questions about the position you may contact Head of Partnerships and Global Relations Theresa Hogenhaug (tcah@icars-global.org). We are committed to cultivating a fair and healthy environment, where everyone can be themselves and thrive. We are happy to discuss flexible working options for all roles. We work to ensure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible to everyone. This includes adjusting for people who have a disability or long-term condition.   We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Development of High Temperature Heat Pumps with Thermal Energy Storage - DTU Construct
jobs.description:
Do you want to start your research career by making industrial heat clean, flexible and affordable? At DTU Construct you will work at the forefront of technologies key to decarbonizing industries: high-temperature heat pumps and high-temperature thermal energy storage.We invite applications for a fully funded PhD position in the Thermal Energy Section of the Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at the Technical University of Denmark. The position is part of HeatMinds, a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network funded by Horizon Europe. HeatMinds brings together 6 universities and research institutes and 12 industrial and research partners across Europe to develop industrial high-temperature heat pumps and thermal energy storage. Your project will develop new Carnot Battery technologies: systems that combine heat pumps based on high temperature thermodynamic cycles together with high-temperature thermal energy storage, such as molten salts and dual-media packed beds. These systems will deliver clean process heat while also giving industry flexibility on the electricity market.Supervision: Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson with industrial secondments. Responsibilities and qualificationsYour overall goal will be to find out how industrial high temperature heat pumps can benefit from integrated thermal energy storage by developing new cost-effective, high-performance hybrid configurations. You will work with fellow doctoral candidates across the network and with industrial partners in Denmark and abroad.Your main tasks will be:
• Develop and Design new architectures comprising cycles using natural working fluids and thermal energy storage, optimised for efficiency, cost, and fast response to electricity price signals
• Carry out multi-objective optimisation and dynamic system analysis of alternative layouts
• Validate results by carrying out experiments and data comparison during industrial secondments, turning the results into innovations with real-world impact (e.g. patents, future commercial solutions) 
• Publish in international journals, present at conferences and take part in HeatMinds network training, summer schools and outreach.You have:
• A solid background in engineering thermodynamics, heat transfer and energy technologies, e.g. conversion or storage systems 
• Familiarity with modelling and numerical simulations, for example for MSc thesis or student projects 
• Programming skills, preferably in Python, Matlab, Modelica or similar 
• Excellent written and spoken English, and the motivation to work in an international, goal-oriented environment.MSCA eligibility: at the time of recruitment, you must not already hold a doctoral degree. You must also not have resided or carried out your main activities (work, studies, etc) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before your recruitment date.You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.Approval and Enrolment The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. We offerDTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.Salary and appointment termsThe appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures. The PhD salary will be based on the Marie S. Curie compensation scheme conditions and according to the grant agreement. Based on seniority the candidate will receive a minimum of DKK 30.264,08 (base salary) and DKK 1580,90 (PhD supplement). In addition, DTU will also pay pension consisting of 18,07%. Finally, it is possible to apply for family allowance. The period of employment is 3 years. The position is a full-time position. Starting date is anticipated as 1 April 2027, or according to mutual agreement. You can read more about career paths at DTU here.Further informationFurther information may be obtained from Prof. Adriano Sciacovelli, adrsc@dtu.dk and Prof. Anders Christiansen Erlandsson, acerl@dtu.dk. You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk. If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. Application procedure Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 24 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:
• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A copy of thesis (if available) or other publications (if available)
• A short critical literature review (max. 3 pages) on high-temperature heat pumps combined with thermal energy storage (e.g. Carnot Batteries): select up to 5 relevant publications and explain your choice, compare their methods & findings, identify possible open research questions, explaining how your background would help you address them. Include at least one figure or table of your own making.You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

jobs.occupation: Lead Portfolio Manager to Support the Green Energy Transition
jobs.description:
Nordic RCC is a fast-developing company providing regional power system planning data and security analysis to support the national Transmission System Operators of Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark - to ensure the efficient operation of the Nordic Power System and high security of power supply at any time, with a vision of green transition.

Right now, we are looking for a Lead Portfolio Manager who likes making a difference!

Job description

As a Lead Portfolio Manager, you will join a team of skilled colleagues and contribute to Nordic RCC ambitious goals of green transition together with our owners in the 4 Nordic countries.

The Portfolio team is sitting in the PMO organization, together with Nordic Project Support team and the local project management team. You will report directly to the Head of PMO and have a close collaboration with the Senior Portfolio Manager and the local project management group, as well as the leadership team, Finance, and the manager of the Nordic Project Support team in PMO.

Responsibilities

Your tasks will include:

Portfolio management

• 
Drive continuous optimization of the Nordic RCC project portfolio with a focus on efficiency and strategic alignment.

• 
Lead financial budgeting and long-term planning in close collaboration with Finance.

• 
Deliver monthly portfolio reporting, including dependency tracking, to the leadership team and relevant stakeholders.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Coordination

• 
Foster collaboration between internal and external stakeholders to enhance efficiency and ensure continuous project execution.

• 
Act as the central point of contact for project-related inquiries from local project managers and teams.

• 
Maintain a comprehensive overview of project dependencies and support departments in addressing organizational challenges related to products, processes, and resources.

Governance & Best Practices

• 
Own and maintain the project Stage-Gate model, including governance structures and project management guidance.

• 
Ensure best practices are documented and prepare evidence for future audits.

• 
Drive continuous improvement by identifying inefficiencies, standardizing processes, and enhancing project governance within the PMO.

Tools & Processes

• 
Oversee portfolio and resource management processes and tools, ensuring they support strategic decision-making and operational efficiency.

Qualifications

• 
Hold a master’s degree in mathematics, economics, engineering, or a related field.

• 
Are proficient in English, both written and spoken. Additional languages are a plus.

• 
Exhibit strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions.

• 
Value teamwork and have a collaborative mindset.

• 
Respectful of agreements, deadlines, other people’s time and ideas, and listening to customer needs.

• 
Structured in your work and approach to tasks, working in an orderly manner.

• 
Strong interpersonal skills

• 
Advanced Excel skills

Requirements

• 
Have significant experience (more than 5-10 years) as a Project Portfolio Manager or similar within the European renewable energy sector.

• 
You bring a strong financial background and analytical mindset, enabling you to lead long-term planning and budgeting in close collaboration with Finance. Your financial insights make you a trusted advisor to the leadership team.

• 
You like to prepare management reports, presentations and follow up on activities.

• 
You like to gain and share knowledge/experience of various portfolio methods and processes.

• 
Have experience with both portfolio management and project management

• 
Knowledge of implementing IT solutions.

Employment conditions

You will join a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently more than 23 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined. 

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 15 November 2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

If any questions, please contact Head of PMO, Signe Uhre Guldfeldt by writing an email to sgu@nordic-rcc.net.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.
